reviewsWithMentions.title: Stephen at front desk was truly a superstars
reviewsWithMentions.text: Wow! When I talk about incredible service this is probably the best and most helpful service I have experienced throughout my entire stay in the U.S, I was greeted by Stephen who took care of everything and even noticed it was my birthday, he put us on the highest floor and even provided us with the opportunity to upgrade. His service was the kind of experience you witness celebrities deal with in movies he was just incredible! We will 100% be back.The hotel itself is located at the end of Fremont street if you want to party and have a good time then this is the perfect location Fremont street has tones to do there’s so many live music options and bars and casinos around it’s really incredible! The music stops at 3am be mindful if you’re a family you will hear the attractions until 3am but nothing a little white noise can’t cancel out. The amenities in the hotel are really awesome! The grand tower studio suite is really beautiful! I struggled to find YouTube reviews on it but it was really just a dream. If you need a microwave it’s $15 a night and if you want transport the deuces bus is around the corner and is about $8 for the entire day/night.The Bellagio etc is a 15 min drive in a taxi or about 25/28 mins on the bus! Overall the hotel is very well priced, great amenities there is also free parking and the service from Stephen and if his colleagues are anything like him is a 10/10! Really great experience for our first time as Australians over to Vegas!

allReviews.title: My Grand experience
allReviews.text: The check in was quick and easy, the free parking was convenient , the room was nice.. we had an issue in the room but was handled very quickly and the front desk staff were very friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: A Grand stay at the Downtown Grand
allReviews.text: First time staying at this modern hotel right off the Fremont cluster of hotels.  Tania checked us out upon arrival.  I was frustrated about an issue that affected my disability and I explained that I was extremely upset. Tania was professional and immediately de escalated the situation. I was impressed by her ability to keep a smile on her face and accommodate me  I can’t explain how much it meant to me for her to turn the situation around and make me leave the front desk excited about my stay. The hotel is clean and modern and offers all the amenities you need like any of the big resorts  plenty of restaurants in the area some of them owned by the downtown grand and I was able to charge things to my room  the casino floor offered plenty of options for gambling with a bar and close proximity.  Every staff member we encountered was super friendly and accommodating for every need. I know I love this hotel and would highly recommend it to my friends and family  thanks again Tania;  a first impression can sometimes make or break a short visit to a hotel and you “made my stay”.

allReviews.title: Love this place
allReviews.text: Stayed here a couple times now. Love staying here, great location,  just walk dow stairs and your in fremont,awesome staff, nice clean rooms.

allReviews.title: Location & Casino
allReviews.text: The hotel location is a plus.It is close to Fremont Street, which has a lot of activities to do.My husband and I really had a  great time.We will definitely come back.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: They were so amazing and helpful all the way. Accommodated us very polite room was clean atmosphere was excellent. I definitely will come back.

allReviews.title: Birthday Week in Las Vegas!!!
allReviews.text: Very nice place to stay!!! Exceptional Staff!!! Room was very clean. I definitely would stay here again!! Location to the Fremont Experience was excellent!!!!

allReviews.title: Vacation time
allReviews.text: Had a great time at the grand! Lots to do, great atmosphere! The staff was great.. downtown is within a couple hundred feet, restaurants live entertainment. Had a great time.

allReviews.title: 3 star hotel
allReviews.text: The hotel facilities is not the best with the coffee shop not open in the afternoon,  house keeping not cleaning the room and basic service levels.  So if looking for high end accommodation this will not be the place.

allReviews.title: Bad experience
allReviews.text: Shower in bath room not working properly.water in casino bathroom not working. Casino server went down on last night and people playing machines had to wait 4 hours to get paid. Won't go back

allReviews.title: Downtown Grand Deals Wining Hand
allReviews.text: First time visit… Great place to stay for location to Freemont St. The hotel, immunities, staff all notch. Special thanks to Gregory and house staff for helping me get what I needed. Casino gaming staff hard working and friendly a bonus. Top it off room rates and daily comps make the stay affordable and fun! Thanks DTG for making my Las  Vegas stay comfortable and fun! Side recommendation for Triple George - yummy food, nice staff.

allReviews.title: TruthandMercy,real Ratings,byEYE
allReviews.text: I don't want to be a Negative Nancy,but I'm wasn't given any opinions of room size, luxury, penthouse or anything,it was just seen and said from whoever checked me in for one and will that be a single bed,but the room was standard by any means ,as well as no fridge,no bath tube and the water look so long to get hot I had to run the sink water to o help get water to my room , lastly valet Took my car out of Valet because my doors wouldn't lock on my s550 AMG Mercedes Benz luckily I had all my cars in valet the night of but I had tipped those guys like crazy oh and the complainted about my abs system it taking 2-4 mins to rise, okay that's your job, but yes I give it a two I give your guest a whopping 10 I loved the spicy behavior it's pleasing and much needed at times and staff as well .I would stay again and do it all again I just genuinely know how to rate thanks staff for keeping my property safe while I was in jail for Almost two weeks you guys are great, Godspeed,.

allReviews.title: Had a wonderful time!
allReviews.text: I’ll be honest, we booked here because of the room rates during SEMA and we weren’t expecting a lot more than a place to hang our hat, but Downtown Grand absolutely knocked it out of the park. It’s a fun place to gamble, sociable dealers, good choice of machines, who doesn’t love a $3 hot dog and a beer. If you want pizza, some of the best in LV Is right across the street and the Triple George is an excellent fine dining option. (Hey DG, open a diner for breakfast and you’ll be in like flint) Also, it’s extremely close to the food court at the Fremont Hotel and Casino, plus you’re basically on Fremont Street but far enough back to not have the music bleed into your room when you’re trying to sleep. When weighing the pluses of free play and food/beverage credit offers along with everything else, if you’re someone who enjoys Downtown over the Strip I’d put Downtown Grand up in my Top 3! Great place to stay and play!

allReviews.title: Never going back
allReviews.text: Service was awful. Way under staffed in bars, Casino floor for payout to a hour!!!Stayed 8 days and I sled several times for my rooms to be cleaned and it never happened.

allReviews.title: Outstanding accommodations
allReviews.text: Everything in one spot.  Tons of entertainment, or go explore. Either way the stay was enjoyable.Just a note...need more hours for pool access...

allReviews.title: First Time in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Wow! First time in LV and loved the Downtown Grand! A block away from the fun Fremont Experience and the area is chocked full of reasonable priced, delicious restaurants. Pizza Rock is across the street from the Grand. Fabulous! The hotel has gambling tables that are great for those on a budget. Our room was in the tower and very nice and clean. Coffee pot was provided with coffee each day. Room was spacious with a place to hang your clothes. We took an Uber each day to the Strip and back. Still cost way less to stay at the Grand. Plus, it’s close to liquor, beer, snacks and live bands on Fremont St.

allReviews.title: Mixed, smoky experience
allReviews.text: The good: incredibly comfortable bed, good night of sleep. The bad: first room was vibrating from super loud music, had to change rooms. Second room away from Fremont was much better. I called ahead of time to confirm pool was open, but it wasn’t. Pool restaurant was also closed despite multiple texts a day from hotel saying “join us poolside for breakfast/lunch/drinks”.  Had to go thru very smoky casino to get to elevators for room - if you are in the tower section you can avoid this. The pool restaurant and the diner were both closed so no breakfast onsite.

allReviews.title: Hidden costs and gimmicks!!!
allReviews.text: The web site stated there was a refrigerator and coffee in the room, there was not. We requested a handicap room, we did not get one. It was supposed to be non smoking, no mention the casino was smoking. Everything was dependent on having a player's card, and how many points you acquired for food prices, drinks, valet parking, etc. We were very disappointed at the methods you used to extract money for services that the web site stated were included. We have not received our deposit back, and the cost of the room and resort fees were higher than stated in you booking site. If you want people to return, stop trying to nickel and dime us, and get rid of of the false resort fees!!!

allReviews.title: Great visit
allReviews.text: Spent the day with my daughter at NHRA Dodge nationals at the Strip. We haven't been there for 20 year's.  Had a great time.  Came to DT vegas. Stayed here before. Nice casino hotel. Very pleasant stay

allReviews.title: Great time
allReviews.text: Met my family here for Halloween vacation. The room was very clean  just lacking a microwave and they even let me swim all day after checkout.

allReviews.title: Not Impressed
allReviews.text: Housekeeping was very inattentive!! Called down two days in a row to have maid service. No response the first day, tge 2nd day all I got was extra towels and a couple bottles of water. They did not make up the bed or clean out trash cans.

allReviews.title: Great experience at Downtown Grand Hotel
allReviews.text: Great Location near Fremont Street. Very Clean and well maintained. Parking was very convenient and Free for Hotel guests.Will be back to stay again.

allReviews.title: Thank you Jennifer!
allReviews.text: Jennifer Lawhorn is amazing to work with and is the only reason I choose to stay at the downtown grand and nowhere else! Thank you!!

allReviews.title: Exceptional experience
allReviews.text: Room 3763 Hansen Farrell.   We love this casino hotel.  Our room was excellent.  Housekeeper (on Thursday) - Ms Alejandra - meticulously refreshed our suite and was very sensitive to not disturbing our personal items.  Front desk representative - Gregory (3-11pm) - was efficient and very courteous toward my small party.   :::  We are half-way thru our stay here; expecting only the best at Downtown Grand, until Saturday check-out

allReviews.title: Grand Welcome
allReviews.text: We stay at the Grand 2-3 times a year.  Each and every time we check in or have a question during our stay, we are greeted by the friendliest, most proficient staff.  This time, we were lucky to have Hope assisting us and sharing some laughs.  Thank you, Hope!  You were a great start to our vacation.

allReviews.title: Love this hotel but looking for new options.
allReviews.text: No hot water.  Had to take cold showers all week.  Reported several times.  Unable to fix apparently this is an ongoing problem in this block of rooms.  Staff did comp resort fees however it the second year in a row we've had a plumbing problem.   Moving rooms is almost as inconvenient as no hot water. Art bar furniture is filthy.  Vagrants wander into the Casino and lobby randomly. American grill is closedFree parking is great.Looking for new hotels next year.

allReviews.title: Not good
allReviews.text: The power went out horrible experience. then when the power  did come back on only one elevator worked.Had to wait a good 15 to 20 min.It also sucked because I wanted to enjoy the band play at the pool they couldn't start on time because of the power. I end up missing that whole experience.They should offered the guest something for the inconvenience.

allReviews.title: Casino and food, coffee, good 4 stars...rooms and being updated 2 stars
allReviews.text: Nice casino hotel, staff was very nice and helpful.. Room was ok.. shower had no door, no where to put soap or shampoo 🤔 no fridge, no microwave,  old TV with no wifi or smart options...

allReviews.title: A hidden gem
allReviews.text: Amazing hidden gem, first off free parking in garage. If you're not using valet the garage across the street is free if you book a room, you will collect a ticket once you pull into the garage and then walk into the hotel when you take the ticket to the front counter, they will give you a parking pass in exchange for the rest of your stay. Secondly, the Hotel check-in staff was amazing especially Gregory. He was very sweet kind insured. We had the best view for the room we chose with our booking. We also received credit for a coffee and bagel and or sandwich depending from the café right next to the hotel lobby check-in it's lava coffee, which is amazing. The hotel itself is smoke free. They do offer some really great meal deals. We saw signs for. Our room was clean and modern as is the rest of the hotel along with an amazing rooftop pool. I do recommend getting rooms closer to the mob museum near the pool instead of near Fremont Street as you could hear the music throughout the night other than that a flawless stay.

allReviews.title: Disappointed
allReviews.text: We were "upgraded" to a suite on the top floor, so I can't speak to the entire place... but the top floor was not what I expected. Our room looked straight out of 1982, was tacky and had no charm. Our TV didn't work. The elevator area was dirty the entire trip, including the elevator door that had black smudges on it. The elevator itself could also use some renovating, as it looks like its been torn up by someone and never repaired. Was not impressed.It's a shame, because the staff etc were all great. But I wouldn't stay there again or recommend it. Clean that disgusting 18th floor, repair and clean the elevators, and do some renovations. If that was an upgrade, I can't imagine being a step down.

allReviews.title: Bummer no restaurant!
allReviews.text: You need a restaurant. I was sad that I had to leave to get breakfast. I miss the morning mimosas the football games and be able to watch. I won't be coming back because of that.

allReviews.title: Very Bad for Customers
allReviews.text: They need to tell u whenever book that they won’t clean your room or drop off clean towels. Only if u stay more then a 5 days. They also have table game with customers waiting but they don’t schedule the personal at the right table. Had 9 people in the pit working the tables but they were all just standing no one at any of the games. I went to the the nugget to play the Texas Holdem that was not open and all other just standing around. I will be staying at a hotel that has the most popular holdem take game open for customers to play. Not good business 😖

allReviews.title: Great location but skip this place for a stay
allReviews.text: The hotel was clean and modern but parking is not convenient at all. Parking structures are not connected and both are across the street. One had a broken elevator and the other one still charged us for parking even with our pass. Worst bed ever and we had the worst sleep! We could hear the person above our room walking around and they weren’t stomping but walking which was so loud on our end. Great Blues and Jazz bar connected to hotel room which I do recommend. I love the Arts District and this place is in the heart of it. However we would NEVER stay here again.

allReviews.title: Cozy
allReviews.text: Excellent location, close to the busiest nightlife area of the city, the hotel is cozy and quiet and is a few steps from the Mafia museum

allReviews.title: Over the top customer service
allReviews.text: Aundrea was very kind and gracious. The hotel was booked but she seemingly worked magic and accommodated my stay. I watched her help others as I waited for my turn to be service and she was kind and gracious with them as well. I can’t wait to return soon.

allReviews.title: Happy Anniversary!
allReviews.text: Perfect location to Freemont st. Nice room. The staff was very professional and friendly. THANK YOU HOPE, YOU WERE AWESOME!!! We will recommend the Grand to our friends and we will be back.Thank you for making our anniversary stay in Las Vegas GREAT!

allReviews.title: Good value for the price
allReviews.text: The hotel and room were clean and the bed was comfy. It was fairly quiet in the casino and hotel because it is away from the busy end of the strip. The hotel validates parking so it is free. The pool area is large with a bar, music, and food options. The hotel is definitely a good value for the price. I will be returning.

allReviews.title: Enjoyable Stay
allReviews.text: Great price for only one night stay. Room was ok just needed a place toRest. Very calm atmosphere. Great location very short distance to attractions and restaurants.

allReviews.title: Nice stay
allReviews.text: We have stayed here many times and will stay again.   I like the location just a quick walk to Freemont experience.  The staff is very friendly our room was in the gallery towers it was a nice room it was clean but not detailed clean . It really needed a good scrubbing the nightstands were dusty maybe the room hadn’t been used in awhile the baseboards really needed a good dusting the tile in bathroom needed a good scrub the shower doors had hard water spots the shower itself need a good deep cleaning there was something on shower tile  I got a wash cloth to scrub it and it came off I do not want to know what it was i just threw cloth on floor. Don’t get me wrong room was good .  Just not the quality im used to seeing in this hotel.    But I would still recommend it thank you downtown grand for always treating us right!!     And of course the Hot Dog and. Beer for 3.00 is a hit!.

allReviews.title: Worst.
allReviews.text: Smooth and smelly tobacco.The hotel staff said the casino building was noisy, but they performed outside and couldn't sleep until 3:00.Can you call this a lodge? No room cleaning. Ginger or insects in bed

allReviews.title: Awesome Find…staying at the Grand!
allReviews.text: We have never stayed on Freemont street. For the last 15 years we always stayed in the strip.  We decided to try something new.  It was the best trip we’ve ever had to Vegas.  We stayed at the Grand Hotel.  That was the best decision we made for our trip.  The Hotel is so clean and the rooms  were great. The pool   was the nicest and there’s plenty of room and nice furniture.  Every person came in contact with were the nicest we’ve ever seen in Vegas. This was the most relaxing g vacation we’ve ever had.  There are so many things to do and see. Everything is within walking distance.  The Grand Hotel has several package deals that are well worth it.  We really loved that we didn’t have to constantly take Ubers to get somewhere.  We walked everyday with no issues.  Checking in was quick and the same when checking out.  Hotel staff always smiling and helpful.  We are already planning another trip and will definitely stay at the Grand.  We highly recommend staying there.  We did take a Uber to the strip and we were happy to return to the Grand!    It’s well worth it!  🤗🎰❤️

allReviews.title: We love the hotel, simple and very complete!
allReviews.text: The hotel has everything. WiFi, casino, swimming poolNot a luxury hotel but perfect to meet the basics, good cleanliness, the bed is delicious, the hotdog with the $3 beer is great!!! Next to the Freemont experience, all very well!You have to go to the bar where blues and jazz play every day

allReviews.title: Happy Bride
allReviews.text: Amazing staff, amenities are top notch and hotel is beautiful. Best decision I made for my bridal weekend. Food, service and location all top notch

allReviews.title: I thought it was the MGM Grand?
allReviews.text: Is this the MGM Grand Hotel?Are you related to the MGM Grand hotel in Las Vegas?The Grand Hotel was grand hotel Please tell the George steakhouse that their happy hour menu was not included in the steak and fries order

allReviews.title: Best Hotel in LV
allReviews.text: Me & my wife booked a room at the Downtown Grand Hotel for the first time.We were greeted by Gregory and the manager Aundrea who were amazing, friendly and welcoming.I asked if we could be in the new renovated towers and Aundrea went above and beyond. Our room was amazing, clean, big, and had a great view. I personally don’t think I’ll stay anywhere else when visiting Las Vegas. The hotel and staff were great, me and the wife were very pleased with our stay. I’ll be recommending this hotel to friends and family.Thank you Aundrea for a wonderful stay at your beautiful hotel.

allReviews.title: Winning tables and slot!!!
allReviews.text: I had thee most amazing time at this hotel. The staff was amazing the hotel was clean and the tables were hitting lolThis was my first time but not my last I can’t wait to book my next trip back.

allReviews.title: Disappointing experience
allReviews.text: The bathroom was not the cleanliness, along with the half of a shower door only being present and water covering the bathroom floor.Entry way light did not work

allReviews.title: Great location, safe and comfortable
allReviews.text: Awesome location. Very underated resort, comfortable beds, and very secure parking garage. If your looking for food your right across the fremont food court and pizza rock. The hidden gem of this place is their Jazz club near the lobby and their breakfast by the pool. Also the receptionist named Hope was so kind and helpful it really made the difference for our stay.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: Great place to stay very clean and conveniently located in the Freemont district rooms were really nice and updated … great customer service

allReviews.title: Staff is awesome...
allReviews.text: Jennifer the Inside Casino Sales Manager is a Rock Star.We have had the easiest time booking and having questions answered quickly and politely. She is a great asset and a very good front person to make a good impression on your new guests as well.We go to Vegas 3-4 times a year, and in a sea of marginal service seemingly everywhere, the Grand stands out and our 20+ stays there should be evidence of how much we like the difference and great service we experience there.Great bartenders and staff always remember us and are a lot of fun.Rooms are nice!Triple George Grill is great.Even the $3 hotdog and beer is good.Keep it going!

allReviews.title: Housekeeping can do better
allReviews.text: Normally I stay here is fine. I thought that in the newer tower/the gallery tower there would at least be a full curtain for the shower. The half shower door thing, while aesthetically looks cool does not work functionally. Even with a bathmat. The water needs to stay in the shower as well as the heat. Consider putting in an optional curtain to keep the water in the shower Also, I had switched rooms mid trip. And realized that I left some of my medication and one of my medical devices inside of the side table next to the bed. We called housekeeping and the front desk and they told us to call the room where the new guest was staying to ask if it was still there. So we called them and they said nothing was in the drawer. We called housekeeping back and they said they didn’t have it. Which means that they threw all that away. Instead of lying and say that you don’t have it just say that those things get thrown away. Maybe consider holding onto guest medication’s for at least three days so people have the chance to get them if they forget them in the room. That was kind of messed up.

allReviews.title: Decent stay but wish it was better
allReviews.text: I wanted to give this place a better rating because it is a cool place and the vibe was definitely what we were looking for (a little quieter and not as crazy as some of the others on fremont), but too many issues.Started a few days before the trip when I found out the only restaurant on site (freedom beat) was closed.   The one tiny shelf in the shower hadn't been cleaned (dried up soap all over).  On our 2nd day the power in the hotel went out and apparently took out a boiler or water heater because we had no hot water for an entire night and morning.  To their credit, they did remove our resort fees after this.  And thru the entire stay I don't know if we had a baby hippo in the room above us or what, but there was CONSTANT noise in the ceiling from whatever was over us.  The AC worked well but was very loud. Staff was all very nice, with the exception of one rude cashier in the casino).  Art bar was good for coffee in the morning. Overall if I ever go back to Vegas I would probably stay here again, just wish we didnt have the issues we had.

allReviews.title: Fun trip but service should be better
allReviews.text: The casino was very clean with refreshing cool air to breathe. The casino floor staff was very hospital. When I checked into my room it was clean and fresh but it was missing the normal house phone on the night stand. I went down to the front desk and they said I'm on the list. So, after asking them 3 times during to install a phone, it never was installed. After my 5 day stay, no phone! This was the most disappointing part of my stay.The pool was clean and temperature controlled.  The food at St. George grill was very good. Very nice staff there.

allReviews.title: Unmatched service
allReviews.text: The entire staff was great, but Wesley went above and beyond to make our stay exceptional. Will definitely be staying here again.

allReviews.title: Provides the basics
allReviews.text: Excellent customer service. Slightly outdated but serves its purpose. Our shower only had half a door so water would get everywhere.  Room didn't have a fridge but the front desk got us one

allReviews.title: The perfect location and beautiful smaller resort!
allReviews.text: We came here because a friend recommended it. We were tired of the strip and wanted a luxury place to stay in a smaller hotel but still had a great location. The Downtown Grand is it! The new Gallery tower rooms are absolutely gorgeous. Being downtown and walkable to everything is wonderful. Do yourself a favor and give it a try. We know you won’t regret it!

allReviews.title: Jackpot@The Grand
allReviews.text: Here's a hidden gem with great access to Freemont.   Room in the Pool Tower was ample in size; clean and beds were "home like" comfortable.   Front Desk staff was welcoming during check in/out.   Smiles were abundant.  Thank for going the extra mile Aundrea and Hope.  Your grace and service made me feel acknowledged and appreciated.   Will be making Downtown Grand and Casino my go to.  Viva Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: 100% would go back
allReviews.text: Stayed in the gallery tower and the room was great.  Casino table games are the cheapest you’ll find.  There were a ton of dining options within a block or so.

allReviews.title: Front Desk Service
allReviews.text: Andrea at the front desk was amazing. I was nervous I'd run into some problems and she went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable and take care of my issue. She made an excellent first impression. Thank you Andrea!!!!

allReviews.title: Amazing
allReviews.text: It was an amazing experience. I went on my birthday. There was a gentleman that checked me in it was on August 20th at around 2:40ish or so . Anyways he was great and professional.Breakfeast was great and I definitely will come back

allReviews.title: Will not consider stay again
allReviews.text: Hotel is remodeled. Look good. Stuff are poorly trained. Security guard are all 500 lb fat people. My room was not clean. Called front desk 5 time. But never get done. Finally spoke to manager for 6 call I got water for my medicine and coffee for morning. At 11 pm. Fire alarm go loud couldn’t go to sleep. Alarm stop after 50 minutes. I was pissed vending machines took my $14. . Will not consider stay again

allReviews.title: Pretty disappointing but not awful
allReviews.text: My first and probably last stay at the Downtown Grand. I will start with the positive aspects.The bed was clean and comfortable, pillows were ok (all hotel pillows are too soft imo)Water pressure was decent. Air conditioning was awesome. Now to the bad. We had two rooms for my friend and I, we checked my friends room first and immediately noticed scratches and smudges all over every wall. We found a empty beer bottle and stuffed in the couch cushions. And it was obvious deep thorough cleaning was not done.Entering my room immediately found rhe same scratches, dings and smudges on every wall, plus someone had stolen the artwork off the wall leaving holes in the wall above the bed. The vanity light in the bathroom did not work and it's outlet was loose in the wall. There was mildew growing in the cracks and crevices of the shower, again showing signs of not thorough cleaning. They must have been working on the room directly above mine, early morning heavy footsteps and what sounded like furniture being moved around non stop all day everyday.We had dining vouchers so we went to use them at freedom beat which I have been to in the past and enjoy. They were closed and not one employee could tell me when or if they will open again. They directed me to the hot dog stand "luckys" coffee bar "artbar" or restaurant across the street "triple george grill" I thought Pizza Rock and hot and juicy crawfish were owned/partners or somehow connected to downtown grand, I was almost positive they were but they would not accept the food vouchers. So we settled on triple george grill which was pretty darn good but extremely expensive to where I had to pay $60 on top of the $50 food voucher. The portions are easily shareable.We had two bad experiences with staff, one bar tender actually mocked me when I  asked for a virgin drink as I've been sober for 4 years. And one dealer was very rude the entire time, he then moved/centered my friends bet on roulette that then hit and when we asked if he was going to give us the winnings on that bet he said he didn't see it there and we had to ask the pit boss to check the cameras. After that he missed another bet from a lady playing at the same table. All other staff were very friendly and professional.  We were annoyed that the table games did not open until 2pm One $1 bj table One $5 bj table, One $10 bj table and One $5 roulette table is all they had. One $5 Craps did not open until 8pm. It wasn't terrible but there are better options downtown.

allReviews.title: Great Stay
allReviews.text: Love this place, convenient location, friendly staff. Got upgraded for our anniversary to a suite. Prices are very reasonable here and you are right across the street from Fremont St.

allReviews.title: Great anniversary trip at a nice hotel
allReviews.text: It has been many years since I went to Las Vegas and the grand hotel downtown (the old Lady Luck, was a great place. Cheap gambling, good food, and nice rooms. Would definitely stay there again. Their free WiFi alone was worth it.

allReviews.title: Great location and nice hotel and staff.
allReviews.text: We stayed for 2 nights (Friday & Saturday) in this well located downtown hotel. We parked in the parking garage across the road which although convenient was disappointing because the elevator was out of order. We were in the Gallery Tower on the 8th floor in one of their Augmented Reality rooms. Sadly the design on the walls was peeling off but using the App on iPad it still worked. Room had a very comfy bed and we had no noise issue while there. Rooftop pool area is great and serve drinks and food. All staff we engaged with were friendly and helpful. I would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Downtown Gem. Book here
allReviews.text: Friendly and 10/10 value.Huge room, and very cool place to stay. Spotlessly clean. 90 or so steps to Freemont St, and 1 block away so doesn't get hit with the band amplification.Slots seem pretty loose, and good table games Ultimate and 3 cardEvery single member of staff was customer focused and smiling. Can't fault this placeExtra special thanks to Marcus, security lead and his staff, who located my lost cellphone with the help of surveillance.I will be backThis place is quiet, modern and has great staff.

allReviews.title: Perfect low-key spot!
allReviews.text: This was our second stay and we were celebrating our 12 year anniversary. We were able to get a complimentary upgrade and the staff was incredible!

allReviews.title: OK
allReviews.text: Very good location to Freemont street. Rooms were clean could be improvement on the beds. No fridge or coffee facilities in room. Very noisy rooms but they do give you white noise to help block it out. Pool was just like a giant bath with people just posing and standing and not even that big. 3 dollar hotdogs and a pint in the casino was a good deal though. I do think there are better hotels in the area we stayed in the golden nugget before and much prefer that.

allReviews.title: Great Service!
allReviews.text: The best customer service I’ve had in a long time! Greg was super helpful and patient during check in. He made my arrival stress free and steamless

allReviews.title: Disappointment with a side of mold
allReviews.text: Hotel room itself was fine. But there was a noticeable lack of personnel throughout my stay, which led to very slow service, and issues not being addressed or resolved in timely manner.A point that stood out for me was that there was mold in the food that was served at the pool. The food served was nothing like that was pictured, and it was moldy

allReviews.title: Best Experience
allReviews.text: Best Experience Ever!!!!! The service was great! They made my stay awesome!!!! All the workers made sure I had a great time and everything was perfect!

allReviews.title: Amazing staff that go above and beyond.
allReviews.text: The staff are compassionate and do a wonderful job. They care about thier guests experiences and always try to be helpful. The casino games are so fun to play, with attentive staff ensuring you have fun and are taken care of. The room was clean and had a great view. The pool is a great depth, with a lawn deck full of games and couches that don't need to be reserved.

allReviews.title: Tremendous value and perfect location for a fun Vegas weekend
allReviews.text: Stayed at the Downtown Grand from 8/8 - 8/10 and could not have had a better experience. Friendly staff, very clean and comfortable room (stayed in the Gallery Tower), and unbeatable value with the $250 Summer Weekend Retreat package, which was $250 total for 2 nights and that included a $100 F&B credit, 4 drink vouchers, and a 1pm checkout (not sure if the late checkout was standard but they did give it to us which was awesome).Great home base casino with friendly dealers. Perfectly situated near Fremont Street but quieter than staying on the street itself. Mere 5 minute walk to other incredible casinos. Chicken Sandwich and Mojitos by the pool were unbeatable. $3 PBR and Hot Dog combo also unbeatable and we had this many times. Pool itself was really nice - very limited shaded poolside loungers though, so recommend getting there at open or getting lucky. Highly highly recommend staying here. This was my first time staying downtown in Vegas and i think it's a much better experience than staying on the strip IMO. It's very walkable to casinos and restaurants (including pizza rock across the street - don't miss it! get the wings too). I can't wait to come back here soon!

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: It was really clean, close to everything downtown, everyone was really nice except the 2 males bartenders at night on 8/8, couldn’t see their name tags, felt that was intentional, however Jodi, bartender next day made up for it she was super fabulous, wish she was there the night before, we would have stayed at the bar longer. Hopefully management will read this and see who worked that night, both were rude and ignored us. Would stay here again as everything else was really great, and I recommend this hotel.

allReviews.title: Some Places Don’t Deserve a Second Chance
allReviews.text: Horrible service. We gave them a second chance and what a mistake!!! As a local doing a staycation I thought the first experience was a fluke but I have now learned they do not train their staff and have forgotten this is a town known for their hospitality. I would not recommend staying at this to a local let alone a friend visiting from out of town!

allReviews.title: Loud, cute, and cost saving
allReviews.text: Cute, hip, right in the heart of Fremont, and all this at a discount. It's in the heart of a busy city, so don't expect a soundproof sleep, but if you party hearty and wanna make your money last the longest, the sleep will be there. Close to everything, grab a slice at pizza rock, even if you're a pizza snob.

allReviews.title: Poor service
allReviews.text: Terrible room service. I was calling the front desk for 2 days from the room’s phone to get TP and a couple towels and nobody ever answered. The elevators are slow and full off people. You gotta wait in line to go up and down. The pool closes at 7pm. They close early. That really sucks . The room sucked. No refrigerator no microwave

allReviews.title: A comfortable stay with a different vibe than the Strip.
allReviews.text: The rooms are spacious and comfortable. No they do not come with refrigerators or coffee makers.   The hotel itself has a very well appointed workout area available 24 hours a day and a pool with a lounge and restaurant on the third floor. One good note is that parking is free.  The location is just off the Fremont Street experience in downtown Las Vegas, which is a very different vibe than the one you would find on the Strip.  If things take us to Vegas again, I would highly consider staying again at the Grand.

allReviews.title: Can't wait to return!
allReviews.text: Excellent value for your money! Room was clean and spacious enough. Comfy bed and pillows. Nice pool area,but needed more shade. Just a few minutes walk to Freemont Experience. Casino was on the smaller side, but it was never too crowded, and payouts were good. 8.5/10 would recommend!

allReviews.title: Nice stay
allReviews.text: Room was great. Customer service was exceptional. Overall atmosphere of the casino area was great. Definitely will book this hotel on my next vacation to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Great value at the Downtown Grand
allReviews.text: We make an annual Vegas trip for our Anniversary, and have stated at the Downtown Grand the past 3 years. We booked direct and got a great deal on the room, with a food & beverage credit. Rooms are always clean and comfortable, convenient parking is right across the street, coffee stand in the lobby. We didn’t take advantage of their huge pool this trip, but it never looked crowded. Employees are consistently friendly & helpful, throughout the property. My only “complaint” is the $1 blackjack table seats were always full, so we didn’t get a chance to play it !

allReviews.title: The Grand was a Great Choice.
allReviews.text: Very clean, great customer service, great amenities, our favorite was the pool. Walking distance to Freemont where you are sure to have fun.Make sure to get your parking pass from the front desk if you park across in the parking structure across the st.AC ❄️Take advantage of all the specials, free drinks at the bar, $3 hot dogs and beer, $ credit from restaurant across the st. Good food and service recomend over all.

allReviews.title: Disappointing Stay – Not Worth the Hype
allReviews.text: We were drawn to the Downtown Grand by the promise of a $40/day food credit, but it ended up being pretty useless. The main restaurant (Freedom Beat) was completely closed during our entire stay, and there were very limited on-site dining options left to use the credit on. Most of the time, we had to leave the hotel just to find a decent meal.To add to the letdown, the pool was closed for one of the three days we were there — not ideal when you're in Vegas to relax. The room itself was fine — clean and functional — but if you’re looking for entertainment, food, or atmosphere, you’ll have to go elsewhere. Definitely felt like we were missing out staying here. Wouldn’t book again.

allReviews.title: Won’t be back after 13 years.
allReviews.text: Absolutely the worst service in the 25-30 times we have been there. The owners are tying to sell, treat the employees horrible, which shows, actually was going to extend a night but the night people at the desk were to lazy and wanted us to come back in the morning, it was 6pm. Literally the worst stay there ever, have found a new place to stay won’t be back this place has become garbage.

allReviews.title: Disappointing and Unwelcoming Stay
allReviews.text: We were very disappointed with our experience at the Downtown Grand Hotel. The overall environment felt hostile and uninviting from the moment we arrived. The front desk staff were particularly rude and unhelpful, lacking the basic courtesy you’d expect at any hotel. Honesty and hospitality seemed to be missing entirely.To make matters worse, the restaurant was closed, which was not clearly communicated beforehand. 40$ food & beverage credit was a scam . This added to the inconvenience and frustration of our stay. It’s unfortunate, because we were really looking forward to enjoying our time here, but instead we felt uncomfortable and unwelcome.I wouldn’t recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a relaxing or enjoyable stay in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Fair enough, tricky parking
allReviews.text: I stayed here with a friend AUG 2025 for a concert at the Sphere.The hotel is walking distance to Fremont Street Experience.The hotel’s parking is a bit of a chore, it’s in a garage across the street.  However, the parking is free if you get a validated ticket to scan as you come and go from the garage.  In and out privileges permitted. There are check-in / loading spaces in front of the lobby which are handy.I stayed in the newer tower.  The rooms are nice enough, clean-ish, and modern.  My friend though the rooms were noisy, but I slept well.  However, I was exhausted lol.Nice shower, comfortable beds, clothes iron in room.The front desk staff was nice.  I do hate when they assign adjoining rooms without first asking you if that’s okay.  Fortunately, I think the adjoining room was vacant.  Assigned a low floor, not much of a view.I didn’t have time try out any of the amenities, but the pool deck looked nice.I would stay here again, but if you find a solid deal on the strip, that might be more optimal.Safe travles!

allReviews.title: Stellar experience
allReviews.text: Stellar experience good people good food good times and the the beds are stellar I always get the best rest here at the Grand it's a great experience good people what else can I say if you need help they will help you I love the GRAND ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐

allReviews.title: Great hotel !
allReviews.text: Convenience parking, great different choice of the food, easy to get food to eat, close to  Fremont Street Experience.  Great service.

allReviews.title: $3 beer and hotdogs & a great stat minus that AC loud unit
allReviews.text: Three dollar hotdog beer combos and drink tickets at check in!? We loved it here minus a few down falls.First off price point was amazing, check in with Gregory (give this man a raise) was even better he was great and so helpful! Now the rooms were good the bed so soft, clean, and the pillows amazing. The issue… the air conditioner was so loud we had to have the tv at level 50 to hear it over it. And we were in a remodeled room.The pool was good, not kid friendly because it is small and raised above ground. But I mean it’s a hotel on Fremont so I wasn’t expecting kid friendliest. Did have corn hole that my kids enjoyed.Parking is actually annoying, you do get a parking pass but trying to figure out where to go to check in and then having to move the car down the road and walk out a side door because the elevator was broken. The issue with the walk is out the door at least 4 homeless always sleeping and that rough with kids.Over all, fix the loud AC and it’s a great little get away even with kids.

allReviews.title: Well..it’s somewhere
allReviews.text: Staff was nice and you’re in a fun location, I prefer Fremont to the Strip. My bed had a huge drip and made sleep uncomfortable and sheets weren’t the cleanest, my toilet was clogged upon arrival but did get resolved. They charge an additional $100 on top of the resort fee which I was not a fan of. Have yet to get my refund back on that and will call if worst comes to worst.

allReviews.title: A GRAND STAY!
allReviews.text: Very friendly ,very helpful and very clean    to the staff who cleaned my room, they did an awesome job.  Great location for some attractions and restaurants walking distance. Good food in-house as well it was a fantastic “GRAND “ experience. I definitely recommend this hotel to anyone who stays in Vegas you won’t regret it and of course they have a casino in house.
Greatest place to stay downtown. Grateful for every single worker here they are the best an deserve the highest praises from the above an beyond job they all do.

We have been going to Las Vegas since 1989. We have tried Strip, Downtown and off-strip properties. We have never had a cleaner room, nicer pool or better employee interaction than we had at the Downtown Grand. Yes, the casino is smaller than most. But because of that, by the third morning we were there, the cocktail waitress was like seeing an old friend (wish I had gotten a name, but by far the most attentive CW in Las Vegas.  The pool was beautiful, clean and a great place to unwind. The room (Gallery tower, King w/ mini fridge & Coffee) was super clean. The bed was comfortable. The shower was strong with no temp issues. We asked for the "quietest" room at check-in and were told the view would be of a mural (we no longer care about view, we care about quiet). It was fantastic. no sound from Fremont or container park, no street sound at all. Had read other reviews that mention thin walls, but we noticed nothing. The elevators (3 in the bank) were quick, smooth, and I cannot stress this enough, clean!  As for the casino , they offer good blackJack rules - 3/2 etc... (it is continuing shuffle), low min-$10, and a good variety of machines. Since it is smaller, they may have a lower number of identical machines, but the selection is still very varied. The player's club is one of the most helpful and accommodating ones we have encountered. Mike was helpful on the floor with questions about freeplay, as well as in the booth with point accumulation and using points. Everyone was helpful with whom we talked.    The only thing I wish they had, is a logo gift shop. I have worn many hats and Tees from previous properties that we stayed and liked, and The Downtown Grand would have been a great addition. Certainly will recommend this property to others.

allReviews.title: Highly Recommend
allReviews.text: Great hotel. Clean, comfy bed, staff and service was excellent! One block off of Fremont was perfect! Received an upgrade upon check-in, which included coffee in room. Big plus for us! We will stay here when returning to Vegas!

allReviews.title: PLEASE DO NOT STAY HERE
allReviews.text: I was expecting what I reserved before arrival which was the Virtual Superior 2 Queen, but upon check in I was given a standard Superior 2 Queen with no explanation as to why. I even got an email minutes later saying my reservation was modified. I chose the Virtual for my son whose birthday we were celebrating on this trip. You have to pay extra for a refrigerator. Also, the beds don’t have blankets, just several layered sheets. The two young women who work at the Art Bar were very rude and immature. They did not give me my full order and were laughing hysterically when I had to come all the way back down from my room to get the rest of it. Nothing was said, no apology, just two teens laughing about it. If you make the unfortunate decision to stay here, please be careful as there are a lot of homeless people who linger at the front of the hotel/casino. There are no cameras down the hotel halls. On my floor there were maybe 1 or 2 cameras I saw closer to the elevators, and lots of blind spots down the hallways.  It was also darker than you would expect and gave a creepy vibe. Spend a little more on a hotel for safety, comfort, and good customer service.

allReviews.title: This is the place to go!
allReviews.text: We go to DTG about once a month.  We live in town but stay here when we head to Fremont St. for an evening or two out. Easy parking, and great location. A few minute walk and you are in the middle of Fremont St. Clean, basic rooms here, nothing fancy but definitely get the job done.  Rarely a line at check in, and Royale and Gregory at the front desk are the best. This is the only place we stay when heading to Fremont St. area in Las Vegas.  Give it a try!

Room bed ok. 1 of 2 Bathroom lights was out. The upsetting part is that I was looking EXTREMELY forward to enjoy the pool on an early evening and the POOL WAS CLOSE from someone puking in the pool!  Saturday July 19th, 2025. Very disappointed and upset since I live in Washington state ! If the hotel offers me a free night stay I’ll be back otherwise, never again. So disappointed.

allReviews.title: Horrible customer service
allReviews.text: Asked for housekeeping 2days in a row Never came to our room We have stayed there the last 6 trips and we will never stay there again Also the front desk is rude

allReviews.title: Bad time the second time around
allReviews.text: The first room didn't have a work desk. I was moved to another room in the tower building. Had a work desk no desk lamp. Toilet poorly flush. 1st room on 3rd floor near elevator. 2nd floor 11th floor at the far end of the floor. I am elderly. Ice machine not on floor. No good view at second room.Stayed at the hotel 2 years ago and had a good experience which is why I chose the hotel this time. Experience this time not even close. Will seriously reconsider choosing the hotel in the future.

allReviews.title: Just did one night stay for a pool day
allReviews.text: Clean and updated rooms, the pool area could use more lounge chairs with shade and cleaned more often water was very cloudy and warm..

allReviews.title: ADA friendly
allReviews.text: I needed a ADA room and was able to get accommodated, that helped out so much, the bathroom was helpful for my injury. I only went into parking garage once, I didn't notice any handicap spots but we were able to locate a close spot.

allReviews.title: Awful, awful experience
allReviews.text: I was not informed of the noise or vibrations that we would hear from our room., we are an elderly couple and we should not have been assigned to a room next to the pool, we were literally right next to the pool on the same floor.   The music from the pool was so loud we could not sleep or watch TV. It was a total awful experience.

allReviews.title: Great Value Hotel
allReviews.text: Room was nice, spacious and very clean! I would like some type of 24hr or late night snack bar, because you’d have to venture to the Fremont Experience for any options. I would stay here again in a heartbeat, casino is lively but drink service can be slow. Great value nonetheless and everyone was nice!

allReviews.title: Disappointing Experience from Start to Finish
allReviews.text: From the moment I checked in, it was a bad experience. We were placed in the wrong room despite specifically booking a certain type, and the reservation notes clearly reflected this, but staff overlooked it. The cleanliness was unacceptable, there was hair all over the sheets, including what looked like pubic hair. Absolutely disgusting.Some staff members were decent, but overall you could tell they were overworked and exhausted. A few were downright rude. I did notice they were short-staffed, which may explain some of it, but that’s not my responsibility to manage. At the end of the day, I didn’t stay for free, paid for this experience, and I expected better customer service and basic cleanliness. Very disappointing.

allReviews.title: Quality vacation experience at affordable prices.
allReviews.text: My new favorite place to stay.  Service at every place within the hotel was superb.  The pool was perfect.  It was unexpectedly reasonable especially considering the very clean, updated facilities and quality food and drinks.   Thank you to all of the amazing staff for a short, relaxing stay.

allReviews.title: Great check-in at the DTG
allReviews.text: The DTG is wonderful.  Great location and the check-in process was so quick and simple.  Thank you Royale M for helping me feel welcome!

allReviews.title: Family weekend
allReviews.text: Pool area was fantastic.  Room was spacious and clean.  Casino had all of the latest games.  Triple George is a top restaurant downtown with old school charm.  Staff was friendly.  Can’t wait to come back and get a cabana.  Great location to Fremont St.

allReviews.title: Downtown Gem !
allReviews.text: The Downtown Grand is a very nice place to stay in downtown Las Vegas. Just off Fremont St, across from the Triple George and Pizza Rock it's a little oasis off Fremont. The casino is very nice and it's the home of the $3 hot dog and a PBR. The pool area is good but not a lot of shade. Staff was fantastic and was helpful to all our needs. The Gallery tower is very clean and the room was very clean and comfortable with a fairly large bathroom. I will definitely be back for another stay.

allReviews.title: Service was not rendered
allReviews.text: I requested to service our room to the front desk and I was disappointed when we came back to our room nothing was done, the bed was not fixed neither the bathroom.I complained to the front desk supervisor only then my room was cleaned and the towels was refreshed.

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: Love this hotel!! Close enough to Fremont Street but far enough away that you don't get the noise. Our room was in the new tower very clean and spacious great view of the pool and comfy bed and pillows. Lin at front desk was amazing. Asked for a pool view room and she delivered!! The casino is fun and they have cheap roulette and black jack table's however only downside is not enough servers on the floor to get drinks. Oh and not to forget 3$ all beef hotdogs and Pabst Blue ribbon or shot of tequila!!

allReviews.title: Good location, clean rooms
allReviews.text: We wanted to stay on Fremont and not on the strip.  First time staying here. Great location easily walkable to most destinations around the area. Due to status with Expedia I do get free room upgrades so paid for room in older Grand tower but got upgraded to 1 bedroom suite in newer Gallery tower. The room was nice and big. I would say equivalent to 3.5 star hotel. I loved that the bathroom was huge and had 2 sinks. Living room area was large but we never used it. The first few nights the hallway smelt like literal poo and pee it was disgusting. Luckily our room was at end of hall and didn't smell. Yes it is loud from street noise but that is to be expected.  It did say that you don't get room service but we stayed 4 nights and 5 days and got room service 2 days.  We had to call on other days to ask for water and amenities, that is free. We rented a car so it was nice to have free parking.   The issues I had were the phone in our room didnt work, i reported it several times and nothing, so it was a pain to call front desk to get anything. You would call the main number and no answer so it would roll to reservation line that cant help you so you are in an endless loop to reach someone. Once you do get someone the staff is very nice. The air wasnt consistently working so you have to fiddle with it daily. They arent helpful with their rewards program and discounts and offers. I went to the rewards desk to ask since the website says you need rewards card to get discounts on food and attractions but when you ask they say there are no discounts. I specifically asked about the mob museum so they finaly gave me a BOGO ticket so its a hassle and they obviously dont care about loyalty. The pool area is big but for the size of the hotel the pool was so overcrowded you're shoulder to shoulder in it. Also there are only like 16 chairs by the pool so it's impossible to get a seat.  Pool opened at 9 am i went at 10 am on a Thursday and couldnt get a seat until 1130. They provide limited seating because they try to sell you the cabana to get a seat, they were all empty. Weekday costs $150-250 plus a 26% fee for the kitchen and bar and you tip on top of that.  Weekend costs $200-300 plus fee and tip. Since we were there on 4th weekend and it was so hard to get a seat we got the cabana for friday the 3rd. It cost $300 with the cababa charge, mandatory fee and tip. Mandatory 26% tip for bar and kitchen is odd because why penalized for ordering food and drink in cabana when you dont pay that fee sitting in a regular chair. It was just 2 of us so it's not cheap. If you have a larger group easier to defray costs. Also you dont get dedicated waitress and I asked to order and it took almost an hour to get service. I had to wave and flag down because she forgot I wanted to order. Service was great until pool got busy. Im sorry im paying the fee I deserve service first before non paying customers.  Dining options stink and we had to eat elsewhere. We went down at 930-10 on a Friday night and it was closed !!! Who closes that early? It's vegas you stay up late. Also the casino was a joke. I wasted hundreds and hundreds and couldn't even get a win or break even, straight loss. I was down there for hours and never heard any of the slot machines go off or make noise or see anyone win.  Talked to a lot of people at the pool who all said they were big losers first few nights so going elsewhere to gamble.  All in all it was affordable especially due to free upgrade but amenities lacking and with a $40 night resort fees in top of stay charge not worth it.  Might stay there again if can get free upgrade but probably try somewhere different next time.  The staff is all very nice.

allReviews.title: I’ll be back!!
allReviews.text: The pillows are great, lolll but the location is what I like best. Clean environment and friendly staff. Thanks Downtown Grand!!

allReviews.title: Not good if you have walking issues
allReviews.text: I booked an accessible room because we have walking issues. There is a lot of walking to get to the rooms. The ADA rooms are not very close to the elevators. The room had low beds that were uncomfortable and difficult to get in and out of. There was only one chair which was quite low. There also didn't seem to be very much walking room. To add to everything the A/C roared like a jet engine. Fortunately, the housekeeping staff helped so much to make things better. The bellman was so awesome and helpful too! If it hadn't been for these wonderful people our visit would have been awful.

allReviews.title: Nice deal
allReviews.text: The room was nice but small and had no fridge. Nice weekend deal for $250 but limited dinner menu and craps table was $10 minimum instead of usual $5. Staff very nice and nice deal overall plus easy access to Fremont. Would go again if similar deal existed which was $100 food and beverage credit plus 4 free well drinks no resort fees and free parking for 125 a night on weekend.

allReviews.title: Stay elsewhere unless you get a great deal.
allReviews.text: The parking garage sucked. No elevator, so have to take stairs 3 floors down. Freedom beat restaurant had poor service food was good.Casino has very few table games, black jack on continuous shuffles. No Pai Gow. Spent most of the time at other casinos.Rooms were decent.Best part across from Pizza Rock.Best pizza in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Ac and elevators not working
allReviews.text: I have stayed at this hotel multiple times and always loved it but this last stay was so bad I checked out at night. The AC in the rooms stopped working for several floors (I talked to other guests), the elevators weren’t working and some friends of mine were stuck in their elevator for 30 minutes. No compensation was offered or given for these issues. The food and beverage staff were less than friendly and seemed over worked as well as underpaid. I don’t know if I would ever stay there again because of this last trip.

allReviews.title: Never again.
allReviews.text: Stayed in the Gallery tower twice now. Can't speak for the other older tower. But we'll never stay here again. This building has some serious issues! I understand it was built during the pandemic when it was hard to get workers I understand. But this tower just reeks cheapness soddy appreciate. The first time we stayed during November 24 we had hot water issues. Like no hot water, like no matter how long you left it run. They moved us to another room didn't have any problems after that. Except when your neighbor above you walks across the floor the ceiling creaks. When my 105 lb wife walks across our floor the floor bounces her shakes. Will you walk down the hallway The floor is creak. Fast forward to 4th of July '25, a phone check and they had noted "oh we see you had a problem of hot water last time". And what do they do, they put us right next door to the first room that we had the first time we stayed there. Guess what same damn issues with hot water. It was hit and miss it didn't matter who took their shower first You need to get hot water or cold water. Every morning when I shaved it was was cold water. Don't waste your time staying here there's plenty of other choices. The only thing I can save for the places that it was convenient for Fremont Street it was a block north so you didn't hear all the loud music all the time.

allReviews.title: Pros and cons
allReviews.text: Pros: Lovely check in experience. Great sized room and clean amenities, part of that area of Fremont can feel tired - not this establishment. The hotel also provides complimentary refrigerators if for medical use.Cons: no refrigerator use permitted for a 2 hour window post check out. Disappointing customer service at check out from the manager, Tania. No empathy or customer centricity, unfortunately.Pool wasn’t clean - murky water and full of hair. That being said, the actual surrounding area by the pool was lovely.Overall, if you’re looking for a budget stay then this does the trick. Some small changes could make this hotel a 5 bubble, excellent facility

allReviews.title: Don't waste your money here.
allReviews.text: We decided to stay at the downtown Grand for part of our 12 year anniversary trip after watching several reviews from local youtubers. When we arrived, our check-in experience was good and our room was fairly nice in the Gallery tower. Unfortunately, that ends all of my positivity. The biggest negative about this property was the poor customer service. Each time I went to the cashier or the player's club, I had to wait for long periods because people were not at their posts. Several machines on the gambling floor weren't working and the cocktail waitresses came around with frequency of a comet. My wife and I went up to our room to rest and watch TV before we were going to hang out on Fremont. After about 30 minutes in our room, the TV cut off randomly. I went over to troubleshoot the TV and realized that all power was out in our room. I called downstairs 5 times and didn't get an answer. My wife wanted to shower before leaving, but the hot water was out and at that point we didn't have any idea how bad the outage was or if there was an ETA on a fix. We were literally and figuratively in the dark! We took a nap because that seemed to be all we could do. I called downstairs again after I woke up. At this point, power had been out for over 3 hours, but they finally answered. The front desk attendant quickly told me that "we are aware of the issue and engineering is working on it" and then hung up. My wife decided to take a cold shower and we went to our 9pm show on the strip. When we returned around midnight, the power was back on. I told the clerk at the front desk about our power outage experience and I asked if we could have another bottle of water. She replied that she would have someone send it up. They never sent that bottle of water. They also didn't replenish the water daily as they advertised. When I was checking out, I went to a front desk clerk to check out because I wanted to possibly explain our experience and get a printout of the receipt. The front desk clerk didn't bother to ask about my experience and didn't print the receipt. I may be a little spoiled because I usually stay in nicer hotels than this, but from my perception the only reason to skip asking someone about their experience at your establishment is that you don't care. The TL;DR of our experience is that the Downtown Grand offers lots of value on paper, but the customer service is so lackluster that you will be better off spending more money at The Plaza, The D, or Circa if you're set on staying downtown. The downtown Grand doesn't care about their customers as long as you pay. Don't let them ruin your anniversary!!!

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: Everything was nice really enjoyed our stay on the tower.  wish the pool hours were a little extended. Room service was great.

allReviews.title: Best birthday weekend
allReviews.text: The hotel was wonderful the room was really nice, staff was great food was food a little pricey but good. I really had a good time for my birthday weekend I will be returning again.

allReviews.title: Not sure if I’d be happy to go back, but I was happy to win money
allReviews.text: I was really surprised not to find a refrigerator in the room as a little difficult going back-and-forth for ice. It was really required with the heat there and a disappointment in the shower either it was missing a door or it’s odd that the door is missing and not supposed to be there because water was everywhere. I got no health service with my stay for two days. I had to call to have someone bring me towels, other than that we made the best of it

allReviews.title: Great bang for your buck.
allReviews.text: Rooms were clean and simple just what me and my wife needed. Staff was fantastic they quickly addressed an issue with the sink getting left open on accident during cleaning that flooded the bathroom a bit and quickly got us another room and threw in a fridge at no extra cost. Pool and the food was also really good. Overall a great time spent.

allReviews.title: Fun Trip to Vegas
allReviews.text: The hotel was clean and fun. The service is great! We reserved a Cabana at the pool and it didn't disappoint. Great drinks, music and service. The hotel is across the street from the DT Experience and next to the Mob Museum, Triple George and the Hogs and Heifers. So much fun and great food!

allReviews.title: Awesome place to stay
allReviews.text: Alicia at the Downtown Grand Hotel was awesome. She took care of us and made the experience awesome and very easy from the time we arrived!

allReviews.title: Getting your steps in
allReviews.text: Friends and I were staying here for the week of EDC.  The location was perfect for our stay as it was close to so many points of interest, entertainment and our shuttle for EDC.  The beds are comfortable, more towards the medium to medium soft side.  The beds have large pillows, a deep bathtub and plenty of outlets for everything.  Freemont Street, the Mob Museum and Lux brand outlets are just a few places close by or within walking distance.  Please note that their parking structure is Not attached to the hotel, but across the street.  The elevator for the parking structure is also not in service so you will need to bring all of your luggage to and from.

allReviews.title: Power kept going out
allReviews.text: In the beginning of June, my wife and I made a two-night reservation. It is a place we have visited many times and always had a positive experience. I had problems sleeping the first night after the power went out. The room became extremely hot, and I missed a planned family breakfast at another location. We made the decision to have breakfast at the Freedom Beat when the power was restored. Since they were behind schedule in getting everything ready, they were unable to serve us straight away. For the money we paid, the breakfast was subpar and expensive. After deciding to visit the pool, the electricity went out once more. My wife had to use the restroom by the swimming pool. It was really hard to see, even with the flashlight on her phone. With no Wi-Fi, I was unable to do business. We learned from employees that power outages have been occurring pretty regularly. This significantly hampered our trip. And when we complained to the front desk employee about our displeasure at check-out, they offered to reimburse us $40 for our two nights of valet parking.

allReviews.title: Downtown Grand FUN!
allReviews.text: My husband and I enjoyed the over all customer service, the casino and all the offerings that the Downtown Grand provides. From Gregory at the front desk making a great first impression to Vaughn at the bell desk the service was all you could ask for. Rooms are clean and comfortable and really enjoy their location, close enough to the Fremont Street Experience but far enough to enjoy everything that the Downtown Grand has to enjoy. We will be back! Laura

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: We love everything about this hotel. Comfortable beds, good restaurant, nice pool.. we can't wait to go back! The location is perfect and everyone we encountered that works  there were friendly. A++

allReviews.title: Nice clean hotel
allReviews.text: Great location, far from the music on Fremont Street at night. Easy to sleep, clean and comfortable. Nice restaurant across the street with great food.

allReviews.title: Value, Service, and Location
allReviews.text: My wife and I spent the weekend at The Grand and really enjoyed the value, quality of service, and gaming action available. Their Summer Weekend Getaway offer is an excellent value and provided us with everything we could have asked for to enjoy our weekend.  We will definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Restful night after all day with family.
allReviews.text: Best sleep ever. Pillows just the right firmness and the mattress is very comfortable. Spent a day at the poolside cabana. So much fun

allReviews.title: Grand grand
allReviews.text: Evan did a great job of straightening out the resort fee problem.  Very comfortable and clean rooms but the view was lacking.

allReviews.title: Decent stay
allReviews.text: The elevator was near our room was very loud and kept us up most of the night. The pool was awesome and food was good. The prices were good and would stay again.

allReviews.title: Downtown Grand, Best Stay Downtown
allReviews.text: This was My second stay at The Downtown Grand. It is a very Good Location,( One block from Fremont Street Experience). The rooms are clean, The beds are comfy.The Casino is on the smaller side, but, very comfortable. This is My Favorite Property in Downtown Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Downtown Grand Staff
allReviews.text: After going to Vegas for the past 40 years, (35 legally!) I don't normally think much about hotel staff...   But, I must state that my experience booking a stay was worthy of praise.  I called their booking line as the links in the promotional email weren't working and got voicemail.   Oh great...   Here's where the praise comes in:  Within about 20 minutes someone actually called me back!   A "Jennifer Lawhorn".  She was helpful, knowledgeable AND super nice on the phone.  She even talked me out of an upgrade as my lodging needs didn't jibe with the more costly room(s) as she truly wanted my stay to be a pleasant one.  These days that is SO rare.  So, shout out to Downtown Grand and the staff and look foreword to many more stays!!!

allReviews.title: Poor because of room type was not what was reserved.
allReviews.text: Hotel is being remodeled (alleged). No longer have suites. Only generic rooms are available. When we checked into the first room, someone was occupyingThe room. Next room assigned was on a lower floor level. We will never stay here again when we visit Fremont Street.

allReviews.title: So so
allReviews.text: The room was nice. The television remote did not work. The air would not stay on. We had to keep waking up to turn a/c back on throughout the night. Shower had no door so restroom floor was soaked unless towels were put down.Other than that it was a nice stay. Pool area was fun! I probably wouldn’t recommend.

allReviews.title: Unhappy!!!
allReviews.text: We went for Our wedding anniversary, We have been going for Years! Unfortunately We Will not returning! The Lady at the front desk was Very Rude! Said Our room was sold out, and they were going to upgrade Us to another room, and it was a Regular room! Then Went to the Pool, and Was told it closed at 6pm, in the evening! When We rented a cabana, never brought Our drinks, had hunt down someone to serve Us! They were Rude!!! Over charged Us!! It was the Worse Ever!!!

allReviews.title: The place was ok
allReviews.text: The room didn't have a refrigerator or a microwave. The bathroom was outdated. There wasn't any counter space. The beds were uncomfortable. The TV in room was small and outdated. The elevator in the parking garage didn't work. The lady at the front desk seem like she had a attitude. Almost like she didn't want to be there. At least the room was clean.

allReviews.title: THANK YOU Aundrea & Lin for being awesome!!
allReviews.text: After having an awful experience down the block with the El Cortez we needed to find a place for our 2 kids ages 22 + 16 yrs to stay overnight for one night, we had a flight to catch the next day.  While I understand that minors under the age of 21 are not allowed to be in the "casinos" but for the hotel use if a minor is staying with an adult family Member I  don't understand why some hotels allow families and others do not---beware and stay clear of the El Cortez if you are travelling with family/kids under 21.  Aundrea was a life saver and helped us book a room on short notice.  The downtown Grand has way more amenities including a swimming pool & we would stay there again.  We'd stay just about anyplace except the El Cortez, including a hotel closer to the airport.  Thank you Aundrea & your team for your excellent customer service, hope you all have a great summer!

allReviews.title: Nice but cold showers
allReviews.text: Room was nice but there was no hot water in the shower or sink. Like I mean cold showers after waking up hungover from being downtown. The casino and property are nice . I would just make sure the showers hot water is working upon check in. The location is also very convenient

allReviews.title: Special offer to attract business..
allReviews.text: The downtown Grand offered a cheaper rate during the week with food credit and drink credit sounds good right. So I book a two night stay. An option while booking was please let us know if you need anything special with your stay, so in the space provided. I made mention that I needed early check-in. I called before I arrived at the hotel. Spoke with someone and let them know that I want to have early check-in and I placed it in the notes during my reservation process. They say fine early check-in is available. Up upon arrival for early check-in they wanted a $35 early check-in fee. Which at no point did they mention this earlier and they had two opportunities to one via email and one via phone call. Needless to say I declined so I had to wait an hour and a half for my room. Check-in was at 1 PM. After checking in I went to my room. Very clean very decent. It’s in the new tower. But up on exiting my room to get ice I noticed the the hallway was super warm so they did not turn on the air conditioning either in this tower so that the hallway would be cool or there’s a malfunction somewhere in any case I would surmise the first option. Stay tune, more to come.

allReviews.title: It was very quiet and enjoyable to stay
allReviews.text: It's walking distance from freemont . The gallery side is amazing quality of room has a beautiful swimming pool. We only had an issue with a slot machine when asked for service no one showed up. So we left even though we thought we won.  We will be staying here again .

allReviews.title: Perfect Downtown Fremont Stay
allReviews.text: The location is perfect. Right off a side street in downtown Fremont, so everything is within walking distance. No need for an Uber unless you’re heading to the Strip. The rooms were clean, modern, and came with free bottled waters. The best part was the customer service. Andy at the front desk was incredibly friendly and helpful. He made our stay even better. I’ve stayed 3 times and looking forward next visit. Highly recommend staying here!

allReviews.title: Downtown but Not So Grand
allReviews.text: Got a corner room with a nice view of the Mob museum but we had issues with the AC as it wouldn’t work between 11am-8pm. Sometimes the room would reach 81 degrees and I should have called the front desk but was avoiding moving to another room. The hotel also doesn’t have many amenities, cafe, restaurant close early. On a Thursday night they only had one cocktail lady and she was overwhelmed kind of ignoring the new comers. This hotel didn’t feel welcoming at times with some dealers and pit boss. I will say the room was clean. There was a point we needed water bottles and someone came to help with that right away. Valet and bartenders had great service.

allReviews.title: Nice Hotel could have been better
allReviews.text: Nice hotel but could have been better, we booked 2 rooms in the Gallery tower at the time of booking I requested adjoining rooms, I also called prior and was told it shouldn’t be a problem as it was mid-week but they could not guarantee, when we arrived to check in I did they $20.00 trick in hopes we would have the requested adjoining rooms, the lady who checked us in stated that there were no adjoining rooms available, but she sure didn’t hesitate to keep the $20.00 when she couldn’t fulfill the request and didn’t make much effort to try.  There are no white noise machines in the room as stated on the website, never saw housekeeping and had to go request additional towels at the front desk, no bottles of water other than what was in the room at check in, bathroom sink very slow draining, towels were pretty worn.  The air conditioner is extremely loud and does block out noise but the vents blow directly at the bed making in very uncomfortable.
