Eventually it was taken care of as soon as I made it to a live staff member at the main desk.I would definitely stay here again, was only a block walk to Fremont Street, awesome rooftop pool area too! If you have a vehicle, they do offer free self parking as well.

allReviews.title: 2 star hotel
allReviews.text: Stayed 3 nights took me until the 3rd day to get housekeeping.You only get 2 small pillowsShampoo, conditioner, soap are the cheapest Looked like they never clean behind toilet pretty nasty. No coffee machines in the room, no mini fridge, no microwave. Bad experience not recommended by me.

allReviews.title: Would not stay again
allReviews.text: Location good, room was in new tower & very small, if you have any mobility problems whower is very difficult to get in, AC air ducts blew on person in bed next to window.  Pool was horrible! no umbrellas the only way to get out of sun was to rent a cabanna for $300, also if you have any mobility problems the pool is very difficult to get in/out of.  Woud not stay here again!

allReviews.title: Great place to stay in Vegas!
allReviews.text: April at the front desk was an absolute gem! Very helpful, kind, and accommodating. We enjoyed our stay so much we extended a night! This hotel and casino has $1 blackjack, great slots, a very nice rooftop pool with great tacos, and a lovely brunch with bottles mimosas and bloody Mary’s with a live band and good eats on the weekends! It is also pet friendly and we were able to enjoy our stay in Vegas with our pup! Great experience and great location walking distance to Fremont downtown! We will definitely be back here!

allReviews.title: Poor overall
allReviews.text: Could not recommend even if you are looking just for a bed. The daily fee turns out to be the most expensive 2 bottles of water you can buyStayed in the grand tower and the noise from the bar across the street was very loud all night long. If you want a lounge chair by the pool the vast majority need to payed for. No shade. The soap in the room doesn’t lather make sure you pack your own. The free breakfast they offer is not free there was a tax charge related to it on the final bill. Found the manager at the front desk to be condescending and rude. I did enjoy the music themed restaurant in the hotel.

allReviews.title: Clean and comfortable
allReviews.text: The good:  The room was very clean and spacious.  Bed was comfortable. Close to the bus that goes down the strip so we didn't have to drive through the construction.  The  bottled water included was nice.  The restaurant by the casino has good food. The pool was a good temperature.The so--so:  A couple of water comments - the tap water tastes odd and water pressure was a bit low - but since we were on the 19th floor in the middle of the desert I suppose any water is good.  We could hear the music from Fremont but it was muffled enough that we didn't need to run the white noise machine.  I was not fond of having to park across the street in the garage especially with the street people wandering around but the car was safe. Since smoking is allowed in the casino and it's an open floor plan the smoke did filter through the building, even with the A/C on full blast.  It was a bit of a bother . o have to take the elevator to the third floor then walk across the sky walk to the other building and take another elevator to our floor.  Finally, I'm not fond of the industry standard of advertising a price then adding on a required resort fee.  I would rather see  the complete price at a glance when comparing places online.

allReviews.title: Great Downtown Hotel, Solid Value
allReviews.text: We are regulars at the Downtown Grand and visit at least yearly.  The location downtown is perfect as it is in the heart of things but just far enough from Fremont Experience that it’s calmer.  We spend much or time at the rooftop pool that has a great vibe… not too rowdy and not too sleepy, great music.  We choose to stay in the new Gallery Tower and rooms are nice and well appointed with a frig and coffeemakers (something you don’t often get at many comparable hotels.  The casino is smaller but lively and fun and it’s great that their table games were the lowest limits anywhere ($1 blackjack and $5 craps).  A shout out to blackjack dealer David who was great fun.  Staff members are incredible throughout.  Shout out to pool staff Tianna and Isabel as well as security officer Derrick.  Final note of thanks to desk clerk April who is friendly and super professional.  We’ll be back.

allReviews.title: Great Value!
allReviews.text: This is a very good value. Hotel is very clean, the rooms are very nice, and the casino host Eric was helpful on room como s. You get a nice quiet sleep since it is not directly on Fremont Street. The pool is very nice and spacious.Staff is really friendly, and the dealers are very professional.Only problem is that there seems to be a problem with being able to fully staff the craps table. I stayed at the Grand  specifically because I like to play craps at this casino so I had to find other casinos. Ironic, and hope this was just a one time thing.For sure I will come back.

allReviews.title: Friendly stay
allReviews.text: The front desk staff were friendly and helpful. The room were clean and beds comfortable. The restraint had great food. The pool staff were amazing.  The machines were tighter than other casinos. It was hard to get drinks while playing. I would recommend staying here and gambling elsewhere.

allReviews.title: Wonderful hotel, awesome staff!
allReviews.text: April at check in was brilliant, such a lovely manner and incredibly efficient, friendly, professional and genuine. We love staying here - great rooms, price, amenities, location - but our experience with staff like April really make it for us. Thanks April!

allReviews.title: Front desk amazing!
allReviews.text: Amazing room corner suite!  April on the front desk showed passion for her job and was a pleasure to work with!  Thank you April for making my stay awesome!  I've stayed in a lot of fancy hotels and the ones I return too are because of amazing service!

allReviews.title: Going Downhill
allReviews.text: I have just completed a 5 night stay at Downtown Grand. I have stayed here several times in the past. Overall, my room was fine. The concern I have is housekeeping, and I feel that has gone downhill over the course of several visits. On my last visit, upon check in, I saw a couple of items on the floor that hadn't been cleaned from previous guests, and then on the nightstand there was a used Q-tip, which told me that nightstand hadn't been cleaned. What else had they "missed"? I brought it to their attention and they moved me to a new room, which was fine. On this trip, I was told I needed to call each day to request housekeeping, which I did. On two of the four days, I was told they would only do "refresh" service, which essentially meant providing new towels and not making bed, cleaning or taking out the trash. They didn't replace soap, shampoo, lotion or bottled water on one of the days, and I had to get them from the front desk. At the end of my stay, I contacted the front desk to ask if an adjustment could be made to my bill for the two days that I wasn't able to receive full housekeeping service, and I was told no. I also wish they the rooms included a refrigerator for what they charge for a "Grand Experience Fee". Certainly my experience wasn't "grand".

allReviews.title: Good hotel; noise levels problematic
allReviews.text: Very friendly and efficient staff (they arranged a room change for me). Rooms are clean and modern. Hotel is only a couple of blocks from Fremont Street Experience. So why the “poor” review? There were some musical performances  a couple of the nights I was there. The first night it was as if the band were in the room with me. That’s why I asked for a room change, but even in a room that was placed further back from the pool (where there was a second performance a couple of nights later), it was steady thumping noises until 1 a.m. -- and I was wearing ear plugs.

allReviews.title: Good clean rooms
allReviews.text: Good clean room and pretty spacious - No refrigerator though.Good value for money, but still charge a resort fee upon arrival which I thought was already included in what I'd paid on here when booking. Excellent location for all your Downtown Vegas exploring.I definitely recommend staying here.

allReviews.title: Great place! Don’t hesitate.
allReviews.text: Great place to stay! Clean! Staff was very friendly and attentive. Mob museum and Fremont Street are a short walk. The casino could used to have a High Limits slot area but took that out. It would be nice to see them dedicate an area to this again.

allReviews.title: Happy customer
allReviews.text: Awesome experience. Had a great time. Several restaurants inside the hotel and right outside the door. The casino was right downstairs, so it didn't require leaving the building.  The staff was polite and courteous. I would recommend this hotel.

allReviews.title: Amazing stay / Bad security
allReviews.text: I would have rated this hotel a 5 if it wasn't for their lack of security. The food was amazing (shout out to Sienna! It was her 1st day on the job and she was our favorite waitress. If I was a restaurant owner reading this, I'd steal her away because she was probably one of the best waitresses I've had in a long time), hotel was clean, we loved our room and the pool was amazing. I appreciated the cleaning ladies in the hall all the time because it was easy to get an extra towel or a bottle of water. They were always very nice. Saturday night one of our party members got their phone stolen. It was reported right away to security and we had it on Life360. They did very little to help us. So our entire group walked around trying to find it. Sunday night at midnight we were having a final drink and there was a guy that came and asked us if we wanted pot, we said no and he continued talking to us, all while looking at our phones we had sitting on our table. Then he walked away but there were 3 of them and while we watched, they were clearly scouting the joint.  If 4 of use from ND could tell what these 3 were doing, you'd think the security would as well and would have kicked these guys out. Monday morning we talked to security again just to warn them what we were experiencing, thinking they'd like to know so the casino doesn't get this type of reputation. Or they watch these 3 to make sure they aren't scouting the joint. The security guard did not care at all. Acted as if we were wasting his time and went back looking at his phone. So either security guards truly don't care what's happening or they are getting a cut of this theft. Truly horrible that we had to see and experience this because everything else was simply perfect. So if you are reading reviews, I'd highly recommend staying here. I'd just strongly suggest to keep track of your phone, watch your drinks because you can't trust security keeping you safe.

allReviews.title: Great Hidding Hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: Great walking distance to Old Las Vegas Strip. Rooms are nices, spacious, and comfortable. Clean rooms. Great location to Mob  Museum.Several restaurants in walking distance.Ice machines are a little bit inconvenient to locate ( not all floors have them)

allReviews.title: Downtown Grand is as good as the reviews
allReviews.text: We stayed at the downtown grand nights  3/28 - 3/31.  I chose the grand partially based on the positive reviews here and because I wanted to stay close to fremont st.  For what and where it is the grand is 5 stars, and pretty much everything you read here in reviews is true: the hotel is clean and comfortable, the checkin is a breeze, the location is perfect, the gaming floor is fun and not too crazy busy, and the bathrooms in the rooms absolutly suck. I knew they were going to be terrible by the number and descriptions of the complaints I read here, and they are. They make absolutly zero sense when the rest of the room is big and spacious and thoughtfully laid out.Yes there are homeless, and more on fremont than the strip. Unless you live in flyover America they are nothing more than you will find in any other city. I will stay at the grand again in a heartbeat.  Much better than the plaza or golden nugget. Thanks for a great 3 nights!

allReviews.title: A WIN WIN AT THE DOWNTOWN GRAND
allReviews.text: I came back to the Downtown Grand after my great stay several months ago. Jennifer L. in Casino Reservations was fantastic as usual assisting me with my reservations. My room in the Grand Tower was great!  The entire Furnace Bar staff makes you feel like family especially Tara and Grayce. This includes all the cocktail waitresses as well, all are very friendly. Front Desk,Bell Desk,Housekeeping and Casino staff were very professional and accommodating. And to make my stay even better I won a JACKPOT!  LETS GO DOWNTOWN GRAND!!  Love this place, a WIN WIN!

allReviews.title: Outside the hotel.....
allReviews.text: We stay at this hotel every year.  We love everything about this hotel, except the location...  In front of the hotel (next to their parking structure), a bunch of homeless people hung out throughout the day, it is very scary to walk by.  Sometimes they touch your shoulder while begging.  The problem is there is no security nearby.   it seems the hotel doesn't care about customers' safety.   we might start staying at other hotels for this reason.

allReviews.title: Book it, do not hesitate!
allReviews.text: Delight in the details! Ladies & gentleman do not hesitate to book this place. I was a solo, female traveller. Arrived late and had excellent service from Andrea at the front desk. She put me in a renovated room. Room was beautifully clean inside. Two bottles of water and coffee were greatly appreciated. Room overlooked an atrium, which was a bit noisy. Noisy room is my only complaint. I really appreciated the new furniture, awesome bed, and sparkling clean bathroom. The $13 room credit exactly purchased an excellent continental breakfast at the café. Lastly the purse hanger was a cool/amazing design feature! :)

allReviews.title: Great stay.
allReviews.text: Had a great stay, check in staff were excellent upgraded us to the new tower and were helpful with any questions or requests, rooms were clean and modern with a good selection of cable channels. Casino is not huge but nice with 1$ black jack and some other affordable games. Great location with pizza rock and Freemont close.  Would have liked to have the pool stay open later to just take a swim as I don’t need to have the bar open to swim but the pool area was nice only wished I could have got to use it more. I would definitely stay again.

allReviews.title: Fabulous place to stay from check-in to checkout.Valets super friendly and quick to attend to. Will be back again soon!!
allReviews.text: Fabulous place to stay from check-in to checkout.Valets super friendly and quick to attend to. Will be back again soon!!

allReviews.title: If you just need a bed that’s all it’s good for
allReviews.text: There aren't desks in all the rooms which makes it difficult to work. No fridge. No microwave. Then They want to charge $15/EACH per day for a fridge/microwave if they do bring one to you. absolutely ridiculous when you’re paying

allReviews.title: Great service
allReviews.text: I upgraded my room so that I could check in earlier, and I was put in a room on the 2nd floor directly across from Gold Spike (which is loud). I asked to move to another room and the lady at the front desk was very accomidating and moved me to another room. One thing to keep in mind, the floors are very thin and creaky so you will hear the people above you. Art bar has great cheap options for a quick breakfast, and the ladies woring there are all awesome.

allReviews.title: Nice Hotel; Casino WARNING WALK AWAY
allReviews.text: Easy check in, nice front desk staff. Room was not ready when arrived. So they put me another room and it was half price. Also when they did that they took all breakfast away packages away and late check out. Kinda sucked but worked. Room was beautiful.  Updated fridge in corner suites.  House keeping was good with our needs.     Now let me tell you about the casino. DONT GO THERE. Tightest machines and tables I've ever been too. It's off from the main strip, so they don't get as much of the crowd like Freemont or The D. So I believe they make it a little tighter, cause they don't get the crowd like those others do. So do yourself  a favor and walk a block over. Won real nice from The D n Freemont n Circa. Other then that for a hotel not casino excellent.

allReviews.title: Great wee spot
allReviews.text: This is a very nice, clean hotel. It is in a brilliant spot to enjoy freemount experience. When you exit the hotel, walk for 3/4 minutes and you are at freemount and its amazing. I never heard any loud music etc when I was in my hotel room. Rooms were clean and tidy. The casino is very good, I liked the roulette table. I found you got better waitress service in the golden nugget etc as they have more waitresses. For example, I sat in the downtown casino for an hour and barley managed to get 2 drinks but when I was at the golden nugget in an hour I recieved 6 drinks. I tipped the same. it just seems like when they are busy, the waitress stuck to certain groups. Very doggie friendly, which I loved to see. Nice sitting areas so you can people watch. I never ate at the hotel but it all looked clean. There's a Dennys 5 minutes away. If you happen to be Vegan, the whole area doesn't appear to be vegan friendly but a member of our party who is vegan found vegan nation which had lots of food just doesn't open until 11am. Feb was very cold but when the sun was out and the wind calmed down, it was lovely. Great hotel in a great spot and if I'm going back to Vegas, I would book back in here as its just so handy for everything. Yes the strip is fabulous but old town is something you need to experience too.

allReviews.title: Downtown after 53 years
allReviews.text: After 53 years of staying on the Strip the prices drove us to try staying downtown. I knew I wanted to get away from the band stand on FSE so the Downtown Grand was perfect. With the new food court at the Fremont you only have to cross the street outside to get from FSE to the Grand. Solves all the safety issues. We also picked a room in the new Gallery Tower facing north away from the band stand. We were not bothered by the noise at all. The Tower rooms are spacious and well appointed. Bigger than its Strip equivilent and just as well appointed. The casino tables didn't open very early but we are from the EST zone so we were up early for Vegas standards. Dunkin Donuts is in the food court at the Fremont so eating early was easy. There are coffee makers in the rooms so no wandering around looking for caffine. Staff and dealers were very nice. Stadium craps, only $3 to play was a blast. Video poker was ok but all the other games were present and at decent odds. I can only say good things about our stay. This sentence sums all you need to know, " we will never stay on the strip again".If you haven't tried Downtown I highly recommend it.

allReviews.title: Mostly very good.
allReviews.text: I would have given a 5 star except for one little thing.  When we made theReservation, we were supposed to get a $5 Amazon gift card. I got the link via email to redeem it, but it did not work. After 2 phone calls and 5 emails, I’ve all but given up on that. Aside from that:  the room was clean, maid service exceptional, casino typical downtown casino…cheap $1 options.Oh yeah one other thing.The room above us…was like they were having stomp dance lessons. SO LOUD. I assume kids running around all morning. For hours. Parking is convenient right across the street.  Easy walk to Fremont..   Rock Pizza right across the street. Easy electronic check in and check out.

allReviews.title: Honestly could not have been better
allReviews.text: I honestly don’t have any complaints. Comfiest bed I’ve ever slept on, it was like sleeping in a cloud😂 the rooms were super clean and the all the staff I encountered were really nice and friendly. Would 100% go back. The location was 10/10 as I didn’t want to stay on the strip.

allReviews.title: Good location. Horrible room decor for the cost
allReviews.text: Very overpriced. Location is ideal, being steps away from Freemont, but the room was absolutely outdated.It was great we could book this last minute on a very late Saturday night. The staff was very good. Rated a 3 because of the horrible room

allReviews.title: Good choice for Downtown
allReviews.text: Decent choice for Downtown Las Vegas. Better than everything else except The Nugget. Great proximity to Fremont Street. Not a luxury hotel but nothing downtown really is. Good service. Checkin line can be long. Would stay here again over The Plaza.

allReviews.title: Amazing Family Stay!
allReviews.text: This Hotel is perfect for families with children! Especially for someone is a newborn! It’s quiet, very clean! The staff are so nice & quick on responding to calls from the rooms & quick for check in and check out! They as well provide every other day & or everyday new sheets & beds made! 5 min walk from the end of strip, and have a White Castle near parking garage! Also they have amazing food that’s worth the price!($$$) kid friendly food options and at coffee bar! Bagels, danishes, cereal, fruit

allReviews.title: My Go to
allReviews.text: Pretty nice. A short walk from Fremont Street. No outrageous early check in fee. Food options are limited on site.But quality restaurants are in walking distance. My Go to when staying Downtown. Can't complain

allReviews.title: Fantastic Location and Service, the Grand Hotel and Casino is the PERFECT go to spot when staying in Las Vegas.
allReviews.text: Fantastic Location and Service, the Grand Hotel and Casino is the PERFECT go to spot when staying in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: FANTASTIC little hidden gem downtown Las Vegas - updates to the casino coming soon!
allReviews.text: LOVE this casino and hotel! Everything seems so much nicer and cleaner than the main drag of Fremont. It's like Circa quality atmosphere without the price hike. It's just a couple blocks off the strip - not dodgy - and they have DOLLAR BLACK JACK! The rooms are beautiful and affordable. It's my new fave downtown spot. If you found this review helpful, check out our room tours, gambling games, and general Vegas tips & tricks on YouTube, @HopsAndHardways

allReviews.title: Nice Stay Downtown
allReviews.text: We came for the furniture market, and this was a nice place to stay. Beds were clean and comfortable, but water temp regulation was pretty bad. Some cold showers, some scalding hot showers and would change back and forth during the shower. Casino games were fun and like all the others, coffee shop was quite a wait everyday, but good.

allReviews.title: Great spot to enjoy Downtown Vegas!
allReviews.text: This was a comfortable stay, although the Casino tower is a bit tired. We loved the proximity to downtown. A nice walk to chef Nat’s EAT and to The Parlour for amazing brunches, a couple minutes from Fremont Street, Walgreens, easy drive to anywhere in Vegas. Unfortunately, I love water and the pool was not warm enough with 60 degree weather (I know, I needed a hot tub—but I’m from Montana!).  Nice spots to eat, hear music, easy free parking is much appreciated too. Would totally stay here again. Oh-the gym is terrific! Lots of equipment in semi-separated areas instead of one big room and open 24/7–big plus for me!!  Finally, we only heard the Fremont music one night—surprising!

allReviews.title: Value for money! Fun spot!
allReviews.text: Its a good enough hotel. Nothing fancy. I come here during weekdays so theres really not much people. The staff is always friendly and the casino almost empty. This is a great location though. Its a block away from Fremont St which is an old school fun vegas spot. The rooms are big, really good beds. Service is inconsistent for the two times ive been here. I cant stand their choice of aqua green everywhere. All in all, this is a great hotel for the price and parking is free!

allReviews.title: Military week
allReviews.text: Had a great time!!! Excellent staff (front desk and housekeeping). Walking distance from everything I needed. Even with the remodeling and road construction it was one of my best stays in Las Vegas.  Thank you.  Until the next trip.

allReviews.title: Vegas Hidden Gem
allReviews.text: The staff are all great from the hotel staff the everyone on the casino floor. The Gallery tower is new rooms are nice. The shower has no door for some reason. I could hear music from The Gold Spike next door but the bed and pillows put me right to sleep. The car aps guy are fun and the dealers will laugh and have fun . The waitress is anyway near by.

allReviews.title: No hot water 110 degrees pathetic
allReviews.text: No hot water, it was warm. 110 degrees us pathetic especially on chilly days and NO SHOWER DOOR. Stayed here since choice owned it, we won’t ever be back. Was offered last day resort fee refund. No thanks. 8% refund is a laugh for inconvenience of 4 night stay, we stay elsewhere the last night.

allReviews.title: great Vegas stay
allReviews.text: a nice hotel if you stay in the new built tower. I had a very nice room with awesome bed. New and fresh ❤️👍 This was a very good downtown Vegas stay. I did not enjoy breakfast at the hotel. Staff was ok and the stay was good. Only bad was shower with low water pressure

allReviews.title: Good hotel
allReviews.text: Good hotel, clean and professional staff. Pity for poor offer for internal restaurant and breakfast but around the hotel there are.many alternatives. Positive experience.   Clean rooms, good service.                              X.

allReviews.title: A friendly, comfortable hotel.
allReviews.text: The hotel is very well located close to the Freemont Street Experience and directly across the street from the Mob museum, but slightly out of the way, and not as bustling as some of the other hotels appeared to be. My only negative comment would be that there is loud music playing until well into the night. This is purely the downside to staying in such a lively area and isn't the fault of the hotel. I liked the feel of the Downtown area more than that of the strip, but some of the tours won't pick up there.The room was nice and was cleaned daily. I would have liked coffee making facilities, but other than that it had all the amenities you'd expect. I travelled out of season so the pool was closed. I didn't use the other facilities in the hotel, but the gym and casino both looked well kept. The breakfast at the Art Bar was lovely.All the staff I encountered around the hotel were very friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: NYE ‘22
allReviews.text: Do yourself a favor and ignore the low to mid reviews.  Some people on here complain that they aren’t getting a $500/night level property for a fraction of that.  Perfectly comfortable and very clean room for the price.  If you’re doing downtown Vegas right, you’re only in the room to sleep and shower. Super friendly staff all around from check-in, continental breakfast hosts, casino dealers, cocktail servers, just top notch. This was my second stay and I’ll be back again next time.

allReviews.title: Great location!
allReviews.text: We stayed at Downtown Grand for the Downtown experience. Wow...great location...one block to Fremont...next door to the Mob Museum...great atmosphere...near the Free Loop Bus route..best pizza across the street, Pizza Rock, George's Grill, and Hog and Heifers. Highly recommend this hotel for price and location. Bang for your buck. We stayed in the newly renovated Gallery Tower.

allReviews.title: Not User Friendly For Handicapped People
allReviews.text: I am a senior citizen with mobility issues. I was put into their 26 story building across the street from the building that I checked in. There was about  1/4 mile walk (including an escalator ride (w/me with luggage) to finally get to the building that had my room. I had to navigate this daily.The housekeeping left a lot to be desired as far as cleanliness.The in house restaurant was a luncheonette and I had one meal here (pancakes) and could not eat them. Under-cooked and gloppy.I got the impression that no employee that I interacted with, liked their job. We ate at a restaurant affiliated with the hotel to get our $20 valet ticked comped. The place, Triple George was terrific. I really enjoyed the food/atmosphere/service. However I noticed on the bill the day I left, the charge was NOT removed.All in all if I was 50 years younger and in better shape I would give it an additional star. But I won't be back.

allReviews.title: We will be back! Thank you Stephen at the front desk!
allReviews.text: This review is all about Stephen at the front desk. As soon as we arrived, he made us feel welcome. He took care of all of our needs and really kicked off our amazing 2022 holiday trip. The hotel is really clean, super dog friendly and new! This is our second time staying here. We will be back! @Stephen, if you see this, thanks so very much! See you again!

allReviews.title: Great Hotel!
allReviews.text: First time at this hotel and when i travel to Vegas this will be the hotel i am staying at. close to Freemont and free parking if you stay there, id also love how they give you free water if you are a guest in the hotel that really did it for me, all the staff was lovely  and friendly not too overprices drinks and the décor was modern and chic.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel, close to the Fremont Street Experience
allReviews.text: Great hotel, reasonable pricing, good food, great gambling area, and only a few steps from Fremont Street. When I go Vegas, I always go to Fremont Street, so, this time I decided to stay downtown near Fremont. The Downtown Grand Hotel and Casino was in the perfect spot, not directly on Fremont but close enough to walk and get the full experience.So, if you’re looking for a great hotel in downtown Vegas, close to Fremont but not with all the noise, the Downtown Grand is the way to go; easy check-in/check-out, knowledgeable and helpful staff, & a top notch casino floor. Downtown Grand Hotel, you can’t go wrong!

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: Great hotel. Facilities excellent.Clean and comfortable stay. Huge bed in room.shower goodWould recommend.Great restaurant on site serving breakfast attentive staff.Would stay again. Central to Fairmount street which is a must see for visitors.

allReviews.title: Our ReConnection Getaway
allReviews.text: The property was very convenient for restaurants, bars & Fremont Street. Your staff was very helpful & courteous with info around the area. Room was very clean & spacious. We would definitely stay at the Grand in the future. Mahalo for making our weekend special. 🤙 Mr. & Mrs. Faleto Ulufale, Maui Hawaii

allReviews.title: Acceptable but could be better.
allReviews.text: I stayed here for 4 nights while my house was painted - I am a local Las Vegan. I do hope that the hotel and restaurant GMs read this and implement a few changes. Here are the positives and areas of improvement: Needs improvement:- Beds slide all over the platform. You might end up on the floor. Put a simple metal bar to hold beds in place - The room has no ventilation and gets musky. Add ventilation from the outside and in the bathroom - Hot water - what is up with this? Every day it took almost 15 minutes to get the water warm and it was only like warm. Update your heating system - Pool is nice but the Fake grass is dirty. The days I was out there I saw the same trash. Nothing had been cleaned up. - Elevators in Casino Tower - add lighting please! As a single woman I don't feel safe standing there in the dingy lights. - Add a house phone at every floor by the elevators for the safety of single women - Gym - I am sure this is temporary but there are only 2 treadmills and an elliptical for a huge hotel. The room was dark and smelled bad. The air was locked and I could not cool it off and there were no windows. I was told the gym is being remodeled. - Parking garage - once again I can't stress this enough - did not feel safe in the garage. It's dingy and dark with bad lighting. The stairwell stunk of urine. Seal the garage floor. Add lighting and security guards or you might end up having a law suit. Better to keep your guests safe. Add a bridge from the garage so guests don't have to go down to the street level. Positives - - Value - really a great value for Las Vegas. I was pleased with what I paid for the week. - The free continental breakfast was a nice touch - Your Staff was friendly and helpful - Rooms were clean and nicely remodeled. I slept well. - The noise makers in the room were welcome as it drown the sounds from Fremont - Conveniently locates across from Pizza Rock and Triple Geoege and much more. No worries drinking and walking home or from bar to bar. - Casino was pretty good. Need more updating of machines. I would add Wheel of Fortune Cash Link and Megabucks Super Stacks games in penny denom. -

allReviews.title: Stephen at front desk was truly a superstars
allReviews.text: Wow! When I talk about incredible service this is probably the best and most helpful service I have experienced throughout my entire stay in the U.S, I was greeted by Stephen who took care of everything and even noticed it was my birthday, he put us on the highest floor and even provided us with the opportunity to upgrade. His service was the kind of experience you witness celebrities deal with in movies he was just incredible! We will 100% be back.The hotel itself is located at the end of Fremont street if you want to party and have a good time then this is the perfect location Fremont street has tones to do there’s so many live music options and bars and casinos around it’s really incredible! The music stops at 3am be mindful if you’re a family you will hear the attractions until 3am but nothing a little white noise can’t cancel out. The amenities in the hotel are really awesome! The grand tower studio suite is really beautiful! I struggled to find YouTube reviews on it but it was really just a dream. If you need a microwave it’s $15 a night and if you want transport the deuces bus is around the corner and is about $8 for the entire day/night.The Bellagio etc is a 15 min drive in a taxi or about 25/28 mins on the bus! Overall the hotel is very well priced, great amenities there is also free parking and the service from Stephen and if his colleagues are anything like him is a 10/10! Really great experience for our first time as Australians over to Vegas!

allReviews.title: Nice place, but they are not fair, and don’t care about your opinion
allReviews.text: We got an extra bill on 50$ for something we didn’t buy. I complain about many times. And they said we will figure it out. Almost 2 months later, they don’t answer my emails, I did send many, but no answer. We didn’t get our money back.I guess it’s okay to steel from guests, but it’s not okay to steel from the hotel.Thanks for a bad experience DownTown Grand.

allReviews.title: Not a premium experience
allReviews.text: Did not have a good experience on this trip. The front desk staff were great on checking in and kindly allowed me to get an early check-in. On the other hand the room was incredibly noisy from the property across the street. Not just noisy but the furniture was shaking from the loud party across the street. The front desk said it would quiet down around 1 am. I asked for a different room and the front desk said I could get a "virtual room" but then said that I couldn't and that there were no rooms left in the hotel. The next day the front desk said that there were rooms available and that I should have gotten one. Really dysfunctional. And then the bathroom sink overflowed drenching the carpet. The engineers who seemed pretty harried and busy said that the sink and faucet were "poorly designed." They put towels down on the carpet but I still had to get my feet wet going the bathroom. Never did they offer me another room.  The casino was fine but the entire stay was disappointing, especially for a hotel that is pretty pricey and bills itself as premium. I will not stay again.

allReviews.title: Newish hotel, freshly RENOVATED rooms, really LOW room rates, and the casino is absolutely HOPPING!
allReviews.text: The reason the casino is hopping is because they have two $1 Blackjack tables, two $5 Blackjack tables, and a $5 and $10 Crap table, plus a couple "Carny" table games.  The low limits stayed the SAME even during Friday and Saturday night, when most properties (but NOT this one) jack up minimum bets significantly.The casino is FIRST CLASS, too.  Modern, bright, clean, high ceilings, and the FREE drink service may be the FASTEST in all of Las Vegas.  Just be aware, the table games do NOT run from 3 - 11 AM.The rooms are gorgeous and look just like the photos on the website.  I stayed in a renovated Grand Tower room, and my SPECIAL rate (they're having a November and December room blowout) was $25 for Thursday night, $65 for Friday night, and $65 for Saturday night.  With this sale, the Resort Fee has also been slashed down to $10 per night (usually it's $30 per night).I've been staying here since the place opened in 2013 and it's running on full speed on all cylinders now (probably due to the fact they have a new and progressive General Manager).If you're going to stay in the Fremont Street area of Las Vegas, this hotel, BY FAR, is your best overall choice!.....Now go play some $1 Blackjack and guzzle some FREE drinks!!!

allReviews.title: Downtown Grand - great stay and helpful staff
allReviews.text: We had an excellent stay at the Downtown Grand Hotel & Casino. April, at the front desk, went above and beyond to help us feel at home. She thoroughly explained the hotel amenities (including the rooftop pool which we loved), bus schedules, restaurants in the area, activities, and info for return to the airport (for example, our bus passes allowed us a return trip to the airport for no additional charge). She was courteous, informative, and very professional. Thank you April!

allReviews.title: Not that Grand of an experience
allReviews.text: I booked a room at the Grand with them, thinking since it was off Fremont St. it would be quieter. NOPE! my room faced Fremont St. still got all the noise til 1 AM. There may be something to slipping the clerk at the check in desk a $20 to get a better room- but I use what I'm given.  And if your car has a loud exhaust, Ogden between 3rd and 4th is the place to rev your engine and get that 'canyon' effect. The cops need to write a few tickets. The room itself was nice. The AC was noisy, I had to chill the room before bedtime and turn it off til the next morning. The shower had 2 shower heads and a wand along with a bench. The floor was also very slippery when it got wet and soapy.HINT- take a bathmat!  It has a 42 inch TV, iron & board, plenty of drawer space. The king bed was comfy. They included towels, soap, shampoo and such. There was a coffee maker that looked like it was never used. The casino was smoky and was not that well populated with gamblers playing the slots. I had places to eat so I didn't try their restaurants. The parking garage is across Ogden. The elevator broke the evening before I left. That meant hiking up the ramps to the 2nd floor with bags in hand or tow. When I checked out the next morning, (12 hours later) the clerk at the desk assured me the elevator was working- NOPE again. Another hike up the driveways to my car with bags. A lousy last impression. Would i stay here again? Hell NO. Would I recommend staying here? NO NO NO

allReviews.title: Excellent location!
allReviews.text: Excellent location! Right at the Freemont Experience, but far enough to muffle the noise. Also, easy public transport to the strip and other areas. Our room was clean and very comfy. I recommend and I would stay again.

allReviews.title: Good visit
allReviews.text: Friendly staff at hotel and casino, Easy check in/check out. Upgraded to grand tower, room was clean, fresh and not disturbed by Freemont activities or hotel guests. Would certainly stay again when we return

allReviews.title: nice hotel -
allReviews.text: the hotel is well cared for.  the rooms comfortable and well appointed.  it is not an overpriced old na,e. at last look they are not among the cheapie hotels in town.  there are other hotels in walking distance, freemont street is a nlock away. the mob museum is next door.  thwy have an eatery in the hotel, not bad and three across the street - if you are a couple check for $$$ off to eat there.

allReviews.title: Perfect downtown stay
allReviews.text: Lovely hotel with clean and spacious rooms. Very nice! We walked up on a Staurday night and were well taken care of with a nice room at a fair price. The location is a short walk to everything downtown and I would be happy to stay here again.

allReviews.title: Customer service makes all the difference!
allReviews.text: Stephen went above and beyond to meet our needs. He has an infectious attitude and made us feel more than welcome. Thank you for my pineapple 🍍 pin! From the valet to the check-in everyone was great. Thank for Downtown Grand!

allReviews.title: Don’t stay here!
allReviews.text: This hotel had better reviews than the Golden Nugget, so we thought we’d switch it up and stay here this visit.  It was AWFUL!  (Except for the housekeeping staff and the valet parking attendants! They were all awesome!). The rooms are old, the beds are old, there’s dust in the air vents, there’s dust on the floor boards, the soap doesn’t even lather.  The windows are also so thin. We were on the 17th floor and it sounded like we were on ground floor of Fremont Street. The “free Parking” in the garage across the street is ridiculous.  The elevator never worked the 4 days we were here.  Got in at 2 am and had to carry our luggage down 4 flights of stairs and THEN walk a half a block to go check in.  DON’T STAY HERE!!  Spend a little more and treat yourself.  Not impressed…at all.

allReviews.title: Barking Dog
allReviews.text: I am at the Grand now, fairly nice place, But there is a Barking dog across the hall from me, and I can't sleep, I have notified the front desk 3 times during my stay security did come up last night. But go figure dog wasn't barking, I am quite sure the owners are probably out for the night and left there pooch alone in the room and he is freaking out.  I love dogs, I have 3 of my own, but when your paying good Money for a room and can't get a relaxing night's sleep, That not right.

allReviews.title: Amazing Customer Service Front desk-Stephen
allReviews.text: I just have to say that I had the best front desk person. Stephen gave us the  best customer service I’ve had in quite some time. Very respectful in a genuine way. Felt integrity. A class act. Thank you for your kindness and going that extra mile, so that my colleague and I could be in the same floor!

allReviews.title: Best Craps in Vegas
allReviews.text: This is the best place to play craps  in Las Vegas, period.  Table minimums are low, odds payouts are high, and the dealers seemed happy that we were there playing. There are several excellent dealers, but Greg is our favorite. He is always friendly and always helpful.

allReviews.title: Charged multiple times for a room we already paid for.
allReviews.text: A manager needs to contact us immediately, the hotel has our details - we have already tried to get a response from the hotel through email, Facebook and through the contact page on their own website. We have been overcharged during the trip and again after our return to the UK. This needs to be resolved immediately. Our next review will go into the full details if this also receives no response.

allReviews.title: The Grand was great
allReviews.text: We had a wonderful 2 night stay at the Grand.  The sink not draining problem was fixed within the hour.  The maids took some of our unopened water bottles  but hey were replaced immediately.  Yes the place is noisy, but you are one block off of Freemont Street and should expect some noise.  We stayed in the new tower and the room was comfortable and clean.  We both slept through the noise and had 2 great night's sleep. We have stayed at several other Freemont Street hotels and would rather stay here.

allReviews.title: Can't wait to come back.
allReviews.text: Clean, comfortable, spacious rooms. Loved the atmosphere of the rooms and hotel. Great location (next to Fremont Street Experience). On-site free parking was a definite bonus. For some reason housekeeping skipped us but it wasn't that big of a deal since we only stayed 2 nights. After a few trips to the Las Vegas Strip we thought this one would be our last but have since changed our mind.

allReviews.title: Bsd
allReviews.text: Right across street from biker bar. If you like it noisy, you’ll love it here. Food was not very good. All in all, a second rate hotel. Would recommend that you look elsewhere if you wish to enjoy your stay.

allReviews.title: Very good as always
allReviews.text: This was the trip we should have taken from UK to Vegas that was cancelled in 2020 due to COVID. The Downtown Grand didn’t disappoint again. The room maybe needed a bit of freshening up but that’s me being picky. The staff were excellent. Not too keen on how the Freedom Beat operates just now but I understand the reasons why. This was our 4th stay and we’ll definitely be back for a 5th.

allReviews.title: Great
allReviews.text: Not a huge hotel and not upscale at all but for the price you cant beat it.  It was 2 blocks away from Fremont street was, where our event, Skankfest was at.  Casino is okay size and fun and food in the restaurant downstairs was good minus that white queso dip.  Our room was made everyday - thanks for that.

allReviews.title: Vegas……. But also listen to all your neighbors around you 24/7! Paper thin walls
allReviews.text: If you’re interested in checking out the scene and hanging around near Fremont Street then the location is good for you. Unfortunately this area is less than safe (what part of Vegas is actually safe though).  Let’s get down to the room. The bed is literally a thin mattress on a frame. No mattress cover, just a paper thin, rough sheet on a thin hard mattress. The pillows are so fat I had to sleep pillow less to save my neck. There’s 0 view, depending on the guest tower you could be staring straight at a painted wall with 0 natural light. They have iPads to use to make the wall mural come to life, but personally I think that money could have been spent on mattresses and bedding. Bathroom is decent size and it was a walk in shower but only a half a glass wall so water sprayed all over the floor.Walls are thinner than the sheets on the bed so you can hear EVERY. SINGLE. THING. happening on all sides around you, top and bottom included. Literally every breath your neighbor takes and every step your upstairs neighbor makes…..  hopefully they ain’t watching youuuuuu. (Shameless song reference) ANYWAYS….The room didn’t stink like casino but the halls did.Pool was less than impressive honestly. So murky and gross. We snagged some lawn chairs for a bit and it was nice to be in the sun but the highly edited photos the hotel posts are not accurate. It’s more run down in real life. And seriously, the water is so foggy ya can’t see your own legs, they disappear into the abyss. The staff I chatted to were friendly but honestly I just wasn’t a huge fan of the location or the room itself.

allReviews.title: Host and staff
allReviews.text: Just spent 4 night at the Grand in Las Vegas. Best time we’ve ever had thanks to the casino host Curtis who was super accommodating and the friendly and helpful staff. Played slots and craps. The staff at the crap tables made it so enjoyable it really didn’t matter if I won or lost ( I don’t bet that much ). Been to Vegas many times and stayed at many places. The Downtown Grand is by far the best.

allReviews.title: Fantastic Staff
allReviews.text: I had the great pleasure to work with Jennifer Lawhorn, Telemarketing Coordinator at The Grand. She was very professional and very helpful in working with me to coordinate my changing schedule.  I have always enjoyed the Downtown Grand and usually make it my first choice. This further solidifies that belief and I will be reaching out to Ms. Lawhorn for my next trip!

allReviews.title: 70 th birthday surprise
allReviews.text: We made a quick trip last year to LVG and now my husband refuses to stay anywhere else. So naturally when our kids wanted to surprise him with a trip Vegas, we made the return.  Love the hotel. Reserved 3 rooms each were great.  The check-/out process is effortless, not to mention great location and affordability

allReviews.title: Great staff
allReviews.text: Stephen was so helpful when we had an issue. 10/10! We checked in and the room was dirty, and we were immediately upgraded for the inconvenience. He was helpful and fast which we appreciated. Everyone we came across was very helpful too

allReviews.title: Sad experience- Don't go!
allReviews.text: It was a very poor & annoying experience. We arrived for a family vacation and only upon arrival we were told the pool is closed for a private party  they said was on there website- not true.During the nigh we couldn't sleep till 4.40 AM because a full volume party was practically in our room.The manager was too pre occupied to speak to us since he had to deal with other complaints.  Stay Away from this Hotel!

allReviews.title: “Great Stay “
allReviews.text: Another great time at the Downtown Grand. A big Thank You to Jennifer L. from Casino Reservations for assisting me with my reservations,my room was perfect. I spent six nights on the property and would rate my stay a 10 out of 10. Front desk check in was a breeze and I even got to check in early since I arrived earlier than expected. Housekeeping was prompt and courteous. Tara and the entire Furnace Bar crew treat you like family, always quick with a smile, friendly conversation and great drinks. Cocktail waitresses,dealers were all inviting and friendly. I have stayed at the DTG for many years and it’s my go to Hotel/Casino when I go to Fremont St. Always clean,inviting with a professional,courteous staff. THANK YOU DOWNTOWN GRAND !!Kenneth Scott Todd

allReviews.title: Super Service with a Smile!
allReviews.text: My husband and I had a pleasant stay at the Downtown Grand. The location is within easy walking distance to Fremont Street, yet far enough away that the noise level at night was comfortably decreased. What stood out during our trip was the outstanding customer service given by two employees. The first was a hotel registration clerk named April.  My husband has health issues and I had booked an ADA room. Unfortunately, this room did not fit his needs. The following morning we inquired about changing rooms. The hotel registration clerk, April, happily helped us in finding a room that was more suitable to his needs. From her friendly smile upon approaching the front desk to her quick and efficient ability to switch our room for better accommodations was heartwarming. She displayed truly impressive customer service. The second was Wayne at the rewards desk. When my rewards card was malfunctioning he was able to speedily fix the issue. All of this was done  with a praiseworthy demeanor. Both April and Wayne sincerely helped make this a great customer experience.

allReviews.title: Awesome Experience
allReviews.text: April was fantastic! We had some credit card trouble and she made the experience seamless. We appreciate that.we stay here once or twice a year and have always had the best service and experience. The pool is nice, Pizza Rock is awesome and Triple George has great food too. Thank you everyone.

allReviews.title: Going downhill
allReviews.text: My husband and I have loved the Downtown grand since it opened. We love the location and the casino and have stayed multiple times. The last couple of times it just seems to be going downhill. My Mom got us a suite for our anniversary last year and it was super underwhelming! Nothing at all special about it, got in and there were used towels, I called down and they moved us. Was hoping it would be to a better room, but it was not. We live in Vegas and got tickets and booked a room for Life is Beautiful in April or beginning of May for the fest in September. We got to the hotel at quarter til 2 to wait in line and check in. They said the rooms weren’t ready and that we would have to check in at a kiosk around 330. We tried every 5-10 min lugging around all of our things and losing money in the casino and weren’t able to check in until 430. We had already missed two artists we wanted to see at the festival. 1 of our 2 shower towels was inside the shower soaked and it looked like someone was walking around the shower in their shoes. The bathroom floor looked like it hadn’t been scrubbed in a few years. Pretty disappointing.

allReviews.title: Weekend Getaway
allReviews.text: The hotel was great. The location was great. Stephen who worked the front Desk Was very friendly and very helpful. The room was very clean and comfortable. The only complaint was the people upstairs was very loud all night long but will definitely stay here again

allReviews.title: Another Great Stay at DTG
allReviews.text: Room was great.  Very clean.  Had everything we needed.  Loved the pool as usual.  Great drink service in the casino.  Only complaint is that some of the machines in the casino need maintenance.  Some wouldn't accept a players card.  Others wouldn't accept money/titos.  Overall can't wait to return.

allReviews.title: Loved the Downtown Grand!
allReviews.text: April at the front desk was amazing and so helpful. Her customer service really stood out on our trip, as we did have accommodations at another hotel prior to our stay here. We would definitely stay again, and highly recommend it to others.

allReviews.title: Derive
allReviews.text: Very pleasant great lady super smooth with service search for discounts for military giving us a direction to are room and other close venues to go see hotel art looks very nice and very attractive was easy to find

allReviews.title: Don’t pay extra for Breakfast
allReviews.text: The rooms are clean. No microwave or fridge. Paid extra for breakfast. BIG MISTAKE!!! Don’t. Just go and pay for what you want. It’s a rip off. 1 drink, yogurt or tiny cereal, a fruit, ( they only had banana) muffin.No second cup of coffee. Other casinos have better options.

allReviews.title: Birthday trip
allReviews.text: When we got there we were able to check in early,  an issue I had with booking was immediately resolved, and we were updated to a suite without extra charge. Front desk gal also waived early check in and gave us late check out (even though we got a notice on our door about check out at 11am). All hotel staff were super nice except for one of the gals working the rewards desk. Pool area was nice and were able to find chairs mid afternoon. Overall one of the best experiences I've ever had at a casino/hotel and will definitely be back to stay. Ive stayed at several different hotels/casinos around fremont st and wanted to stay at all but may just keep coming back to downtown grand!

allReviews.title: Good hotel close to Freemont Street
allReviews.text: We did an overnight stop here on our way to Zion National Park Room was clean and spacious and had a  very comfortable bed. Pool was quite busy but nice to cool off.  Hotel is located close to Freemont Street which is a busy wee area. Staff very pleasant and helpful.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel in Downtown LV
allReviews.text: We really like the hotel and the location. Very friendly and accommodating workers as well. They allowed us to leave our car in their parking garage while we needed to fly home.  Walking distance to Fremont Street and Container Park. We had a corner room with great views!

allReviews.title: Not a second time - unclean, unfriendly staff, noisy.....
allReviews.text: Good:- free parking, but this is given for a multitude of hotel guests anyway in downtown  Bad:- Hair in the bathroom and in the bed- the pillow as well as the sheets have to Cigarette smoke stunk- the rooms are very noisy- the windows are not well insulated - you can hear everything from outside! And since Downtown isn't exactly known for its tranquillity, the night was horrific!I addressed all of these points when I checked out in the morning and the receptionist then showed little interest and was still unfriendly.  Even though I showed him photos, he just said he was sorry.Even the manager who was standing next to him didn't comment on the incidents!  From my side I can not recommend the hotel!

allReviews.title: Extremely mean employees and unethical customer service
allReviews.text: Extremely unfortunate experience staying at this hotel. Due to the festival being in town, we paid $500 for service that compared to a one-star hotel. The room was in very poor condition, it was clean but in very poor condition. The worst part was the customer service: was completely unethical and unacceptable. April the front desk attendant ended up belittling us. She acted racist towards us and raised her voice towards us over a simple problem that we ran into with them not giving the room we paid for it. She then turned childish and would not speak to us, when we asked for assistance.Another front desk attendant named AJ directly lied to our face. We called her out for it as well and had to speak with management about it.Given the price we paid, I would never stay here again even if the price was 80% less due to the horrible customer service. You cannot treat guests in such a poor manner and not think that they will retaliate by leaving reviews like this or stay again. Especially when you're paying $500 a night for a worn down hotel with mean employees.There are many options these days, especially in Las Vegas, so when you're looking to choose one definitely veer clear of this one.

allReviews.title: Great Front Desk Service!
allReviews.text: Stephen at the front desk of the hotel was AMAZING! So quick in his service, we saw him move the line quickly while checking the many guests for Life is Beautiful festival that was happening this weekend. Friendly, approachable, and super helpful… although the early check-in we requested for 11am wasn’t available at the time, he made sure we were called when our room was ready, which he guesstimated would be around 12 or 1. We received a call 12:40pm that our keys were ready and made our way back to pick up the keys. He made our check-in process so simple, easy and relaxed. Great start to our vacation!

allReviews.title: Is Anything working No
allReviews.text: TV was not working at all Hair dry was not working iron had a burn looks like with plastic but couldn't use it.Toilet was not flushing Shower was getting water on the floor .I did ask to change room they said their was no more rooms I then asked to give me my money back. And I'll find another room. Was told the refund would not go back right away so I was basically forced to stay in the room. I will be writing to BBB and to whom else I need to write to. I would of been better off staying in a hostel or just staying at the airport.

allReviews.title: Okay-ish hotel, rubbish service
allReviews.text: Checked in for two nights and AC was on in first room, making temperature freezing - 64 Fahrenheit! Called front desk, who sent very helpful maintenance man. He came and went three times after checking system and controls, saying they have “a lot of problems with the AC”. Got moved to another room about 40 minutes later. AC didn’t work in this room either. But at least room wasn’t cold. Every time I’ve ring front desk, they’ve been rude and surly. Housekeeping was random, replenishing toiletries and towels, except bath mat, but not making bed. All in all, rubbish experience. Won’t be staying off-strip or at the Downtown again.

allReviews.title: I Hate Being Lied To
allReviews.text: I don't feel bad only giving the Downtown Grand two blobs. Honestly, this hotel earned those two blobs for cleanliness and comfort and that's about it. Can't say honesty because while this hotel SEEMS like a good value and says that the resort fee includes parking, well... Try getting out of the garage without paying $20 each time. I literally ONLY booked here because the listing said "free parking" and yet I ultimately paid $40 extra for it. My booking said "enjoy early check-in when available." COOL. Nope, $20 more dollars for THAT. I should point out that the room was nice, it was clean, the bed was comfortable. Those are the positives. The shower was... well, it was dumb. Pretty much wide open with poor water pressure. And the walls? Very thin. It's one thing to very clearly hear a concert at street level on the 25th floor, that they have little control over but clearly hearing someone's phone conversation in the next room? I didn't like that. Overall I regret having booked at the Downtown Grand and certainly won't make the same mistake twice.

allReviews.title: Great stay!
allReviews.text: Stayed here over Labor Day weekend and was really pleasantly surprised. Room was nice and modern and all staff we interacted with were helpful and polite. Small casino, just a couple of mins off Fremont Street. I only docked a star as we could hear music from a nearby party in the area, but that is not the fault of the hotel. Would stay again! Also enjoyed breakfast at Freedom Beat.

allReviews.title: Worst Stay Ever
allReviews.text: I stay at the Grand all the time. But this time it was the worst of all First there was only one elevator working 10-15 wait to get up are down. I went down to speak with a manager and she stated that there was a concert going on. I didn't understand the concert was at the pool concert goers did not have the use this elevator so she was not help. Then I get in the elevator to go home and there is sign in the elevator that says wet floor so we get in thinking floor is just wet  no it's VOMIT why would they allow the elevator to continue take passengers. This had to be a HIPA violation, I went to the manager on duty he stated that it's Labor Day Weekend and  they had a concert last night. NO ASSISTANCE AGAIN SO I GUESS I PAID FOR BAD SERVICE DUE TO THE HOLIDAY AND THE CONCERT WITH TOO SHORT BEING THEIR.  NO HAPPY AT ALL WITH GRAND HOTEL.

allReviews.title: Forget resting or sleeping at this hotel. Pure waste of money
allReviews.text: The place is located next to an outdoor venue and it’s louder than loud. As the night wore on it got even louder extreme thumping bass way past me writing this at 2 am don’t plan on sleeping if you book a room here it’s insane. And yes I have noise canceling headphones

allReviews.title: Our favorite spot in Vegas. April is the best!!!
allReviews.text: We absolutely love staying at downtown grand. Great spot in downtown vegas. 1 minute walk from Fremont so you’re close to the action while able to stay away from the craziness and noise. Clean boutique hotel with cheap table games! April at the front desk is the best! I always look forward to having her check us in and am always hopeful she’ll be working when we check in! She’s so sweet and always does her best to accommodate our requests. She is such a pleasure every time we check in and we love chatting with her during the check in process. She makes us feel like we’re VIPs!

allReviews.title: Last second trip
allReviews.text: I could stay anywhere when I come To Vegas, but my first choice when I need an awesome room, with great customer service, food and amenities, I call Jake Franquez at Downtown Grand!! Jake is always there when we have a last minute trip or when we plan an extended stay, his follow up and attention to detail on room type and takes care of all of our needs, so DTG is an easy choice. Five star service, large rooms and great food!!

allReviews.title: Here's the SECRET to navigating that parking garage across the street from the Downtown Grand!
allReviews.text: I've stayed at the Downtown Grand about a dozen times now and ALWAYS park my rental car in that garage.  Yes, pretty well ANY urban parking garage in America can be sketchy, but here's how to AVOID the problem:When you drive into the garage, DON'T turn right as directed.  Instead, go straight and then to the left (yes, AGAINST the flow of traffic).  Once you pass the handful of reserved spots, you'll find oodles CLEAN and SAFE spaces to park your car.  Then, simply walk back down the ramp, and you won't have to deal with stairwells or elevators.As for the hotel/casino itself, it's a wonderful place to stay.  First class lodging one short block away from vibrant & colorful Fremont Street.  Downtown Grand and Circa are the best hotels in the area now.  The great thing about the Grand is you'll only pay 1/4 to 1/3 of the rate at Circa.  Why?  Being one block off Fremont Street means the Downtown Grand still hasn't been "discovered" by the average Vegas tourist yet.  Many of the guests there are knowledgeable airline crews and Nevada Government Employees.The pool is wonderful and the casino provides perhaps the fastest drink service in all of Las Vegas.  The casino may be the cleanest in Vegas, as well.  Also, you'll find low-limit gaming here.  They even have a ONE dollar blackjack table, in addition to $5 and $10 tables.If you need a desk in your room during your stay, ask for one of the two original towers, as the new Gallery Tower has a modern design that skips the traditional workstation.My midweek rate was $38, plus the $29 Resort Fee.  Try matching that rate in Las Vegas!  I'll be back in September.Enjoy!

allReviews.title: Disgusting, Urine, Garbage, Bird Droppings
allReviews.text: An old POS hotel that has been spruced up but overall they do not care about their customers. You will be left asking yourself do I breath the old urine, garbage, and bird droppings through your nose or your mouth. Taste the air or smell it??? I gagged and came very close to throwing up in their parking garageDO NOT PARK A CAR HERELet's see Bethany Chang, in charge of On-Site Property Management stay at this disgusting hotel. Hint: It won't happen, but it is okay for YOUR familyThey polished a turd of a hotel, but they obviously don't care about their customers. They could make large improvements with just $10,000 of cost and show some actual concern for under a millionFree rooms would not be worth the cost.

allReviews.title: Dangerous area, Minimal amenities
allReviews.text: Homeless vagrants everywhere. Semi conscious drug user (with drugs) laying in parking elevator. Coffee bar only open in morning and several items not available. Only one restaurant on the property. Sports book closes at 9pm and all tv's are turned off. Most table games in casino closed. Area around the property is partially under construction and not well lit.

allReviews.title: REGULAR HOTEL NOT CHEAP NOT SO EXPENSIVE
allReviews.text: It was ok , however we are still waiting for the 150 USD deposit they charge us.Breakfast was not included eventhough we saw this stated in the website.Pool was not so clean , a little bit noisy too.

allReviews.title: Great stay and great hotel!
allReviews.text: The staff at the Casino, led by Josh was typical of a 5 Star Resort! Moving over to the Hotel led by Rosco was also run like a 5 Star Resort! The front desk was an experience of perfection! Thanks Eashon, your customer service skills are amazing!I highly recommend this Hotel, I look forward to ciming back soon!.Thanks Rosco for running a Great Team!Sincerely Judge Terrence Aronson

allReviews.title: Terrible
allReviews.text: If you booked through a travel agent don't expect to get the room you booked. They literally will not even talk to you about it. They said our room was bigger than the one booked and it was 150 sq. feet smaller.  Also, we were placed directly across from the Goldspike which blares music louder than your tv can even go until 3am. Called down to the desk and they said we should be safe until we left. But nope...the night before we flew out we were kept up all night by it again.  When I mentioned it at checkout the dest lady informed me I should research where I stay more carefully.  Um, this was my 12th trip to Vegas and I've always stayed right on Fremont St. and have NEVER had music this loud blaring and shaking my room. We also paid $15 a day for a mini fridge that looked like it went through World War 2. It was either warm or froze water solid.  When I mentioned this she said "did you call to complain?" And I said no. Quite frankly I was sick of saying anything because I usually don't complain about anything! Also, the pool hours are horrible.  11am-7pm. No shade unless you want to pay $350 for a cabana for just 2 people.

allReviews.title: Better than the strip.
allReviews.text: 2nd time here had a room on 26th floor. Very little noise from Freemont during the night. The hotel is clean, staff are kind and helpful. The parking garage across the street is sketchy at best.Spent days by the pool they have food and drink service. But no shade what so ever. In the 109 degree sun it’s hot. Nice proximity to Freemont and surrounding area. So much better than the strip with so many restaurants and free shows to enjoy. The hotel has a new section recently built. Didn’t get to see it. The older sections And pool area are due for a little renewal getting worn out a bit. We’d come back next time. Didn’t gamble but the casino is on the smaller side and very nice.

allReviews.title: Great Stay, but not the Gallery Tower
allReviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

allReviews.title: A Staycation for our 31st Wedding Anniversary
allReviews.text: I had initially booked a Suite for a three-night staty at Circa but decided to cancel it and book at DTG since it had been years since our last visit before moving to Las Vegas.  Our room on 26th floor had an amazing view! But you could tell it lacked some TLC!  The air condition unit was VERY loud, the carpet dirty with stains and the jacuzzi bath DIDN'T work! We called maintenance and they were not able to repair it!  Apparently after looking, they determined that the bath had not been connected! Needless to say, we didn't have our "Romantic Night" like we planned. We could have probably moved to another suite, but we didn't want to repack and give up the top corner view! So, we stuck it out! The Customer Service Rep was very apologetic and compensated us for one night.  !

allReviews.title: Good location-close to Fremont Street but quieter
allReviews.text: I an a fan of the old part of Las Vegas and it's current renewal.  There was no parking fee here albeit, it is across the street with vagrants in the stairwells but just avoid that.  The hotel has a pool available for guests until 7 when it begins to rent it out for pool parties.  Casino was easy to move around and there are sufficient restaurants inside and outside to keep you satisfied.  Staff was super nice too!  Good price

allReviews.title: Nope!
allReviews.text: The room is spacious and clean. No coffee machine or kettle, you only get two bottles of water. I gave it three stars because of the Staff. They are not friendly and they seem bored and they just want to get you out of their faces. Would I consider of coming again? Not at all.

allReviews.title: Just okay, nothing special
allReviews.text: The service was good and the room was quiet. Huge pluses. We also LOVE The location of the hotel but wouldn't stay there again. The beds were not comfortable, nor the pillows. There was no TV remote in the room and the TV and wifi didn't work in our tower. No view to speak of, only a wall. Had to pay $15 a night for a fridge, but it was worth it. The staff were apologetic about the TV and comped us the cost of the fridge. They also gave us a late check out and let us store our bags until we had to leave for the airport. Decent overall, but not spectacular.

allReviews.title: Great location; rooms could use some updating
allReviews.text: I stayed at the Downtown Grand 1 weekend night back in April - this is a late review; my bad. Parking is supposed to be included in the resort fee at the parking garage across the way. There was a lot of construction ongoing at the time and I found it difficult to find the garage. Between the one-ways and construction I always ended up on the wrong side of the road with no way to cut back over. At one point, I just gave up and decided on valet. Valet was $20 for the night, and can be validated by spending $$ at one of their on property outlets or gambling using their card. This is what we ended up doing. From what I was told from others that parking garage was not very clean and the gate(s) weren't working as intended. Sounds like I made the correct choice as far as parking/valet/validation goes.To check-in I had to wait in line and get a physical key. Not really an issue, but many other hotels now offer contactless check-in which I generally prefer. I was placed in (what I assume) was the older tower. It was a little bit of a walk, but that's typical with most LV properties. The room seemed to be on the older side and could definitely do with some proper updating. I had no issue with sound...guess I was lucky there.Location is fabulous. It's not directly on Fremont, but certainly close enough. I am a fan of Pizza Rock and Triple George which are directly across the street. Pizza Rock has a lovely happy hour. The Mob Museum is directly behind the casino/hotel in walking distance. Casino has $1 blackjack which appears to be a big attraction. The rest of the carnival type games go for $5 a spot, until it goes to $10 in the evenings. I even saw a $25 table or two on this particular...never seen that before. And those tables were empty...not surprised.Not sure that I would stay here again, though the location was good and the casino has pretty good minimums. There are other hotels I may try in the Fremont Street area unless I get another good deal with DG.

allReviews.title: Final day of vacation ruined.
allReviews.text: Ruined final day of vacation.We arrived early and they couldn’t check us into our room but could check us into an “upgraded” room for $20 more per night. Room was nice. Pool was nice although food was supposed to be available and was not.  4 drinks was $50.   Craps table was the beat part of the stay.  Freedom Beat restaurant was ok. Would be a better review except -Our flight didn’t leave until 8pm and they wouldn’t hold our luggage.  So we had to drag our luggage around with us.  We ended up just going to the airport  extremely early.   Most hotels offer this service.  We would have paid a fee…. Big miss, DG.

allReviews.title: Not good for services or even any service at all
allReviews.text: Be aware due to the Fremont experience all the hotel rooms you can hear the music until 2am and later with the bass rocking through in the outside rooms, totally ruined my stay making it hell - they should warn you on the description when booking. Also the stated 'continental' breakfast is diabolical and people should be warned as nothing like a continental breakfast, on a good day you have a coffee, a pastry (so croissant or bagel) a pot of yoghurt and a piece of fruit (apple or banana) and packed in a bag for you. Yesterday i arrived at 9.50am and there was no pastry and no fruit so i had a coffee and a yoghurt only, this is all that was available and the staff did not care one bit, it seems the hotel is perfectly alright with accepting this as an included paid for breakfast?

allReviews.title: Choose Another Hotel
allReviews.text: Do yourself a favor and choose another hotel.  We have traveled a lot and have seen a lot of properties but this one is not worth your money.  This hotel hosts pool parties on the weekends (cost $20--$50 to attend) and the noise from the party is so loud we could not sleep even with ear plugs in.  Also, during the day you cannot sit by the pool unless you pay at least $30 to have a lounger (money goes towards drinks but so what?)  No wonder there were so many people hanging on the walls of the pool.  The bed sheets are not fitted and are too short for the queen beds so the bottom and top of the mattress pad is exposed (Yuck!).  The shower has a half wall...does not have a door or curtain so the floor gets wet and you are cold during your shower.  Also, there is no refrigerator or coffee maker in the rooms (but whoo hoo!  They have an ironing board! JOKE)  There are plenty of other hotels to choose from so go somewhere else.  Only good things here... room did not smell and we enjoyed the $1 blackjack tables so our adult children could learn to play.

allReviews.title: It doesn’t worth
allReviews.text: The room was good and clean, beds comfortable but it doesn’t even have a refrigerator in the room. Parking was in a public parking in the back of the hotel, not a safe parking, a lot of homeless on the way from the parking garage to the hotel, it was so dirty and stinky because people were peeing and doing gross stuff around the parking, not to mention that for many times I had to spend a lot of time looking for a spot because it gets full during nighttime because of the parties and clubs around. Also, we need to validate the parking ticket at the front desk every time we needed to get out of the parking which is such a bummer. We were in the 9th floor and I could hear from my room the noise from outside that was very loud, specially because of the pool parties at the hotel pool. During the day the access to the bridge to our tower was so crowded because of the party and we had to go in the middle of those people to get to the elevator. Paid for the resort but didn’t get to enjoy anything that was involved with that fee.

allReviews.title: Don't expect to sleep
allReviews.text: Music from pol deck is annoying!   Hotel is clean, but a maxe to get to room.  Nickel  and dime you for everything,  $20 for early check in, $15 per day for a fridge the size of a shoebox.  Won't return, other places in are much better.

allReviews.title: Not a good experience at the pool.
allReviews.text: We stayed during EDC weekend. On our second day there was a pool party that required a paid ticket to get into the pool area. Luckily they offered a wrist band so that we could access the pool area free of charge... but was told no bags unless they were see through, my wife was told she couldn't bring in her book! We were told there was no rentry if we choose to leave from the area. In the pool area there are 32 chairs that are available free of charge, all the nice colourful couches and shaded cabana are reserved and only available to people that have a tab of $150 or more. So don't plan on any free shade except from the eating area. Front desk told us that there was umbrellas available so just ask for one, pool manager told us that all the umbrellas were stolen so nope. This was the situation everyday that we were there.Everything else was good. We really enjoyed the baristas at the art bar in the morning. Location to Fremont is really good.
