Although there were lots of homeless people right outside the parking garage. And if you use the parking garage for your vehicle watch out for the fresh puddle of urine at the bottom of the stairs everyday that stinks so bad.

allReviews.title: Watch out for being overcharged
allReviews.text: This hotel had comfy rooms, albeit a dated bathroom. The rooms are a good 5-10 minute walk from the lobby. The gym is well equipped. There are a couple of food options. It’s great for Fremont St if that’s what you want to see.The downsides - The hotel overcharged us by a LOT - like several hundred dollars each over. We got in contact a few days after checking out and got no response. Chased again - just got sent an automated invoice that didn’t match the amount that had been charged. Chased again - zero response but got a credit card refund. Very rude, very suspicious - I’m pretty sure they were trying to fleece us and if we hadn’t noticed, they’d have pocketed the extra money. Breakfast - it’s basic and you have to queue for a good 20-30 mins to get it from the tiny cafe. Very noisy. But it’s Vegas, so everything is noisy I guess.The reception staff there were quite rude, both when we checked in and checked out.

allReviews.title: Loud + Unfriendly
allReviews.text: We arrived at a very sketchy parking lot, but told ourselves, “This is normal for downtown area,” hoping our car would not get used as a beer pong table. Nice pile of feces going into the elevator. Brushed that off, and went to check-in. The room was clean, standard provisions provided for the price point paid. No fridge, but the front desk said we could have one for $15 per night. In the bathroom there was no division for the shower so the whole floor was a constant puddle, making it hard to use electronics like a hair dryer. I could not sleep much at all due to the constant bass coming through every wall and floor. This lasted well into the morning hours. It felt like a waking nightmare of sound torture. The room was located right above a major intersection on the fourth floor, making it so the patrons leaving the motorcycle bar across the street would have to stop there at the red light with their glorious engine sounds feeling like they were vibrating the whole building. In the morning, I headed out to my nail appointment, but the door hydraulics were not working 100% and it slammed shut, smashing two of my fingers between the door and the frame. I broke one finger and bruised the bone of the other, both are still unusable as they heal. Our group was supposed to have several tables reserved and the hotel decided it was too busy that night to honor the contract. Funny enough, the reason the floor was busy was because our group was there - which then left to gamble elsewhere.The second morning, we wanted to get brunch, so we went downstairs to the Freedom Café. After a little bit of a wait, we were sat at a table by the host. We waited, and waited, and waited, but never got service, not even a menu, so we left hungry. Thankfully, Pizza Rock is right across the street.Flash forward to check-out, and after a 30-minute wait, successfully checked out! Only to find we were over-charged on our resort fee, so we went back in line to resolve. We were told the total was correct. We said to please look again as we had a contracted rate. It was like pulling teeth to get help from this woman. After she conferred with her co-worker, we were told we could not be helped because we booked with a third-party. We asked who we could speak to that could help us, and were told the person was not in that day. We asked for their contact information and were told that the hotel would email them for us. After a week we got resolution.

allReviews.title: Nice rooms in quiet downtown corner.
allReviews.text: Checking in early with April was a rare treat in excellent customer service. She had us feeling good about our first ever downtown Vegas hotel stay. Then after depositing bags in the large, upgraded room we made the mistake of stopping at the Freedom Beat for late lunch to be basically ignored and then told by the bartender/host/order-taker that there was no cheese in the place other than blue? Right. Left when it seemed obvious that’s what the charming fella wanted. Oh well. April earned 5 stars. FBeat earned -1. Took off another star for checking out where they made an error on our bill and needed to be asked twice to check and correct it, confirmation of which didn’t come through for a few days. Enjoyed the casino, the discounted prime rib dinner was good, but sack breakfast after a long lineup, and no fridge in the room were negatives. Would stay again but lower expectations will make for a better stay.

allReviews.title: Fantastic 30th anniversary getaway
allReviews.text: First time staying downtown. Chose Downtown Grand after researching online. We picked a winner! Easy one-block walk to Fremont Street which offers a more laid-back, quiet and relaxing environment than the bigger casino hotels downtown. Perfect fit for us.Staff was great.  Jake greeted us at the front desk and accommodated us with an early check-in and an upgrade to the new Gallery Tower. The room was clean, comfortable and modern.Special shout out to craps dealer Steve T! His professional, outgoing and welcoming personality made my time on the craps table 100% enjoyable. Noriel was fantastic as well.Two suggestions to make a great property even better.1. More servers on the casino floor. It frequently took quite a while for a server to come around, then quite a while longer for drinks to arrive. Also, the mixed drinks were in tiny plastic cups (6-8 oz).2. My wife was really looking forward to an hour or two of pool time and sunshine Friday and Saturday. The number of free chairs were limited and taken. We were told the remaining sofas and cabanas required minimum food/drink spending of $300-$500. For a party of two who simply wanted to spend an hour or two at the pool that was a real disappointment. Also, the pool area should have umbrellas to offer shade for guests using chairs and sofas.Overall, we had a great time at the Downtown Grand and will definitely return.

allReviews.title: Wouldnt Change a Thing!
allReviews.text: I stayed here for about à week while I attended Crimecon. This was my second trip to Vegas feel Georgia (twice in just à few months!). My first stay was Fremont. I had a very early AM flight. I was in Vegas by 6, tired from a sleepless night. I rather hopelessly asked about an early check in, which was granted for $25 (well worth it!!! Heavy luggage for a solo female travler). I was given a free upgrade into the new tower (Gallery, I think?).  The room was BEAUTIFUL and spacious. It had a lot of natural lighting. Felt so welcoming. It made me feel great about being in Vegas! My stay was quiet, clean, comfortable and I felt safe during my entire trip. It was exactly what I'd hoped for. The hallways and rooms were modern and everything felt new. The bathrooms were great and the beds were copy. I would definitely consider à future stay here. I will send friends and family your way as well! Also, the pancakes from the bar downstairs are amazing!! Id eat them everyday if I could! 😅

allReviews.title: Great location and comfortable stay Downtown
allReviews.text: My friend and I stayed here for the Lovers and Friends festival, having been to Vegas before but never been ‘Downtown’ we chose this location to mix it up a bit. We were slightly nervous due to some of the reviews but honestly couldn’t have found it any better. We asked for a quiet room which we received, an internal facing one in the Gallery tower meaning the noise pollution from Fremont street which goes on until 3am didn’t bother us. Our room was spacious, clean, good lighting, nice bathroom. The staff were all really friendly, especially in the Freedom Beat bar which did a fab breakfast. Great location, super easy for Lyft rides to find you, minute walk to Fremont, good bar and pizza place opposite. We would definitely stay again and we usually stay at Caesers or the Wynn and honestly had such a good time here. Thanks!

allReviews.title: Favorite in downtown LV
allReviews.text: We've stayed here a couple of times now and it's our favorite in LV! Perfect location one block from Fremontstreet but a little outside the most busy areas. Spacious, comfy rooms, good rooftop pool, good breakfast, laid back atmosphere, also in casino. We hope to be back!

allReviews.title: Rooms Are Nice But ………  NEVER AGAIN
allReviews.text: The rooms were really nice and exceptionally clean I stayed in the newest tower. However they charge a resort fee and it doesn’t feel even remotely like you’re staying at a resort. Valet was not available on the day that I was there and only offered on the weekends. So there is a parking garage that is across the street that you have to lug all of your luggage across to the hotel. It is not in the nicest of neighborhoods they are transients and homeless people all around even inside of the parking structure. Not a good place for a lady or even a guy to walk out of or to at night. On top of that what is included in the resort fee is the garage which was not working properly and it didn’t function correctly given the parking pass they gave me. On top of that the elevators kept breaking down so I had to wait for engineering to fix it in order for me to get to the sixth floor unless I wanted to use the stairs. The Internet wasn’t working which is also a part of that resort fee. So I’m just curious how you don’t have a massage parlor or anything of the such that even resembles a resort but the things that you are charging that is covered underneath that resort fee aren’t even working but you still have the nerve to charge the fee. The key to your room is supposed to give you some sort of security even in the elevator so that people that are not staying there aren’t able to just hop on and get to any floor that wasn’t working either so anyone can hop on the elevator and go to any floor. I had a guy ask the person that I was with if he was with me and followed him up to the floor we were staying on and continue to ask him questions about me. I don’t know if they were trying to rob us and I don’t know if that guy was some type of trafficker  but it was quite scary. In the neighborhood at that hotel is in I would not put any of those things past the random guy asking those questions. Like I said the rooms are really nice and clean and the rate is really nice as well but you cannot place a dollar amount uncomfortability overall and safety. Last but not least as I was leaving the hotel for good there was a homeless person that was killed on the side of the hotel and the police were there at the crime scene as I was exiting.

allReviews.title: Fun time
allReviews.text: We were quite delighted to have stayed here. We got to gamble and not have to stray too far. Staff we encountered were all welcoming. We were there just to hang out with family and friends so it was very convenient.

allReviews.title: Not for over 60 crowd
allReviews.text: Not for over 60 crowd that wants to sleep at night. 3rd floor pool turns into an outdoor nightclub at night & the bam bam bam of the music lasts past midnight. We reserved a 2 queen room for 4 people & we only had 3 towels for 4 people. Their App to check-in did not work. Clerk at check-in should ask older guests if they are light sleepers & if so- automatically put them facing away from the pool. Felt bed was too soft. Hotel is dated & the smoke from the casino goes onto every floor and into the Grand tower- which is across the street! Old and ineffective black out curtains, no coffee maker, low grade soap & only 2 bottles of water! D/T the above & the massive homeless population in the surrounding area (urine soaked streets) - Next time -we will stay elsewhere. On the plus side- the young ladies working the coffee cafe were nice!

allReviews.title: Great Hotel but beware of ATM in Casino
allReviews.text: The premium hotel rooms in the Grand Tower are spacious and very comfortable. The Casino is not impressive. Beware of the ATM is you are a foreigner! We got $400 against a rate of €419 which is ridiculous. It should be between €379 and €390. The ATM is placed in a dark corner and the screenlight is dim. So our advice is to check the conversion rate very carefully!

allReviews.title: Gaming only
allReviews.text: Only went there after 10pm to play Blackjack 3 out of 4 nights.  All these dealers and Pit Boss were so friendly.  Place is slow at night during the week.  Really enjoyed the tables.  Good luck getting a drink if you are not on a table.  Service is slow on the floor.  At the bar there is one bartender who did not want to serve my sober self because I had to "put a $20 in the machine."  Well, please look here as I had $37.00 in credit- off my $20. Then I ask for a Tito's and water and she said, "We don't say Titos here."  OK- how do I know this?  Rude.  Not a fan.  Her tip went from an intended $5.00 to $1.00.  You can tell me not to say Titos, but don't be snarky. Place was dead and still had to wait forever for a drink.    If walking from Freemont day or night you will see people sleeping/resting/living on the street.  Just say hello.  Be kind.  They will not hurt you.

allReviews.title: The Security Deposit Will Gets You Every Time, But Lower Resort Fee
allReviews.text: This hotel is right in the middle of downtown Las Vegas, right next to Freemont street. The hotel rates are average for an off strip hotel, but they will slap a security deposit of $100 per night on you. I don't understand why security deposit  has to be per night, how many furniture can one breaks per night? I do like the lower resort fee than the strip hotels. Warning, don't get the rooms by the street, the 4th street facing the hotel is lined with bars and restaurants, and they play LOUD music at night like 12am at night. Get the room with an interactive Windows view, It's much more quiet....er. The room I have was clean and the bathroom have shower with no door to keep the water out, so the bathroom floor will be wet after a shower. The hotel café open until noon, the restaurant is not something to write home about. The casino is like any other mid-western casinos except you are in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Decent, affordable casino near Fremont St
allReviews.text: Stayed here for 4 nights for a Las Vegas Conference Center event. It is a bit of a taxi/Uber or bus ride. But right by Fremont Street and plenty of restaurants. The casino is not big or overly fancy. Rooms are large, with desk, TV, good bathrooms. The bed was just ok...a bit hard. They have a white noise machine in the room, very nice.

allReviews.title: Great as Usual
allReviews.text: Love staying at Downtown Grand.  Clean rooms and great staff.  Casino is so much fun.  Bre at the Furnace Bar is an awesome bartender and takes care of everyone.My only complaint would be slow service at the pool, but I'm guessing that is a staffing issue like everywhere has.Will definitely stay again!

allReviews.title: Winter Get Away
allReviews.text: Stayed in the new Gallery  tower in mid February. I had no problem with the area.Thought the room was a good value. Only issue was the in room phone did not work and they could not fix it. No problem with the staff. Room was always clean.

allReviews.title: Wedding
allReviews.text: Cesar was wonderful assisting with our party we had handicap guest and service here was very accommodating this was from checking in till checkout. The front desk ladies were very helpful as well.  Thank you Downtown Grand Hotel

allReviews.title: Staying at the downtown Grand for the first time
allReviews.text: April the front desk personnel was very wonderful and very professional and helped us out and got us checked in without any incidences. She was very good for what I observed when waiting for my coffee. Her supervisor needs to reward her for a job well done. The downtown Grand is blessed to have her as a personnel

allReviews.title: not a friendly bunch
allReviews.text: I will not step foot in a place that is rude and will treat their customers with no respect.  This place will only care about making money off you. They don't want to build a relationship. They could care less who you are and all they want is your money.

allReviews.title: The SECRET jewel of old Downtown Las Vegas (Fremont Street area).  Best VALUE, by far, too!
allReviews.text: This always-fresh first-class property is one short block off the main Fremont Street area.  The reason for the INCREDIBLY low prices, is that virtually nobody is aware that it exists.  They almost always have room specials on.  Their "Buy two nights, get one free" usually offers their best rate.I paid $45 for night one, $42 for night two, and my third night was FREE.  Also, this is no ordinary hotel.  It's the second-best Downtown, behind the recently opened Circa.  Of course at Circa, you'll pay 3 to 4X as much.  The rooms always look brand new and are always SPOTLESSLY clean.The casino here is a great deal, as well.  Five dollar blackjack is STILL often available.  Believe it or not, they also have a ONE dollar table.  Get there early in the day to get a seat!Get in on the SECRET, and you'll LOVE your stay here!

allReviews.title: Long hike to rooms
allReviews.text: The casino is nice but it's about a quarter of a mile to get to the rooms.  Located in a really skanky area.   The room was clean and large.  Nice hemp store just around the corner on  Fremont street.  Very skunky.

allReviews.title: Very nice
allReviews.text: Very nice quiet rooms. The casino is small and perfect along with a great little restaurant and bar inside with good food. Just a very short walk to Fremont street but don't get the noise. Also has a great morning coffee bar near the hotel lobby.

allReviews.title: TERRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE
allReviews.text: I just got off the phone with the rudest front desk employee named Jessica. It is approximately 1am on Saturday, April 9. I purposely waited late to call, so front desk wasn't too busy to answer my questions. I was asking her very simple questions about the different room types in the hotel as I haven't visited the hotel in over 7 years and a lot has changed since then. Originally I called and she picked up and then I said "Hello" and she hung up. Then I called back and she answered after 10 rings. She sounded very annoyed and told me to go on the website and everything was there. I told her that my specific questions were not answered on the site. She continued to talk over me and rudely insist I go on the website instead of just answering me. Then I asked if I could speak to someone else because of her impatience and lack of helpfulness.  She stated noone else was there with her. Then I proceeded to ask her about price points, she said that's what reservations deals with, and totally dismisses me. I WAS going to book a week at DOWNTOWN GRAND, but if I'm going to be treated the way Jessica just treated me, I'd rather give my money to ANY other hotel!!! She needs to be re-trained or let go.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay in downtown Las Vegas
allReviews.text: My wife and I stayed for a three night stay in March 2022.  I researched many hotels in the downtown area.  We wanted to be near Freemont Street, stay close, but away from the noise.  The Downtown Grand delivers.  We stayed on the sixth floor in the gallery tower and did not hear any noise from Freemont Street.  Our room was very nice and had everything we needed.  (I would've preferred to have a mini fridge but they charge $15 per night for one) .  We enjoyed the casino, they do have one table that has $1 blackjack.  The table was always busy and you have to be patient to get an open seat.  The dealers are awesome!   They only had one waitress for the entire casino but we stayed during the week so she came around quite often since the casino was not that busy.  We played both the $1 and $5 blackjack tables.  We would love to visit downtown again and play to stay at the Downtown Grand again!

allReviews.title: Great find just off of Fremont Street
allReviews.text: First night stop off a two day trip for concert. Wanted something on our near Fremont Street but hotels on Fremont are a little tired and loud. Found this nice surprise while looking for place to stay. Large king bed room in the Grand Tower. Room was amazing, spacious, and large comfy king bed. Close to Fremont Street. Mob Museum is across the street.The Freedom Beat Café was a bit of a disappointment but won’t stop from staying again and already planning to stay again.  Plenty of slot machines and a small selection of table games but adequate. Staff was great and all we encountered were great!

allReviews.title: Mrs.
allReviews.text: Super Clean room, complementary waters, not most places do that, Also April at  front desk was really nice and had great costumer service , she helped us check in and check out and always with a smile , we will definitely be back!

allReviews.title: Awesome Check-In
allReviews.text: April at the front desk made the check-in process so smooth and easy. She was very professional, approachable and knowledgeable. She reminded me of some of the perks that came w/my reservation through my silver membership w/hotels.com which was very helpful and made our stay awesome!

allReviews.title: Excellent service
allReviews.text: I was assisted with my by April who was welcoming, polite and helpful. She identified that I was a returning guest and a premier guest! She searched for and upgraded my room and was altogether a delight!

allReviews.title: Will Never Stay Here Again
allReviews.text: The pictures online were one part of the hotel.  The part we stayed in, looked nothing like the pictures.  It was old and smelly.  The room decor was tacky and super outdated.  It was nice to have 2 bathrooms in our suite but would have been even nicer had one of the showers not taken literally 5 minutes for the water to get hot.  The lines at check-in were long and slow moving at all hours so if you needed anything from the front desk, you needed to give yourself an additional 20 mins.  The hotel brags that it is 100% non smoking except it's not.  Maybe it's only limited to the casino but the ventilation is so bad that the entire hotel reeks of smoke.  There is no store on premisis so nowhere to purchase water, snacks, toiletries....I learned my lesson about straying from the usual places we stay and would never recommend this property to anyone.

allReviews.title: Bachelorette!
allReviews.text: Exactly what we were looking for: affordable, fun, clean, and surprisingly good food!  The customer service was exceptional from the second of arrival to leaving, not kidding, actually amazing, from the reception staff, the room service, the pool employees – like amazing!Such spacious suites also, we could have easily cramped more girls in the rooms that we did. Great everything.

allReviews.title: Pick Another Hotel - Terrable
allReviews.text: From the start the check out n was a disaster. AJ was the worst at check in did not care and was rude. The process to check in and then to check out could not have been slower. It took almost 2 hours combined. Housekeeping almost never came to clean the room and left on occasions no towels! Lots of choices in the area pick another hotel.

allReviews.title: Mediocre at Best
allReviews.text: Rude check-in and waitstaff at the restaurant next to check-in. If Watson is at the desk you want to talk to him vs a counterpart. He's the best. Rooms are basic and just okay. They'll try to charge you $15/day for a fridge. No coffee maker. No hairdryer.Beds slide off the frames. Stay at the Golden Nuggett Instead.

allReviews.title: Terrible loud music till 3am
allReviews.text: We have been staying at different hotels for over 20 years,  downtown and on the strip.  This hotel was the loudest ever, super loud music till 3am.  The pool closed at 5, so why am i paying a resort fee.  I know it's Vegas and there is always loud noise, but this was terrible when you have to get up early.  Be aware if getting up early music doesn't start till about 10:30.

allReviews.title: Modern, clean, great!
allReviews.text: Modern, clean, quiet with all amenities in the room I wish to have. Missed room service a bit tho. Staff was friendly and checkin was smooth. The rooms must be recently refurbed as everything was brand spaking new. Will stay here again if needed.

allReviews.title: Would stay here again
allReviews.text: Close to Fremont Street and the Mob Museum. The room was nice but there was no mini fridge, microwave or coffee maker. The outdoor pool area looked beautiful from our room. This was our first time staying downtown and we would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Okay hotel. Noisy
allReviews.text: The check in was a bit slow. They said they just changed the computer system. The front desk staff were nice. However, if you are parking at the self park, you have to get the ticket from the garage first before they will give you the parking pass. It wasted an extra 10 min of my time. I don’t know why they didn’t just give the pass to people who are staying upfront. The hotel room is old. There is a newer part but I got the old Grand tower. Maybe the newer part would be a better experience. It’s not clear on the website which room is in which building (depending on where you book it from). The non smoking room smelled weird. Then there’s intermittent smoke smell coming through during the stay. There were strands of hair on the bathroom floor. The water drained slowly from the bathtub and sink. The room was large. The bed was fairly comfortable. The outlets at the desk don't work well - the plugs would slide/fall out after being plugged in. The WiFi was good and fast. The outside noise was the worst part of the stay. There was an outdoor concert. It was loud even on a very high floor and went on until 2 am on a weekday!! There’s a white noise machine in the room but the bass was too loud for it to be useful. The self parking garage is scary, dirty and smells. Be warned and not leave valuables in there. If you had a choice between staying at the Strip versus downtown Vegas, I strongly suggest the Strip.

allReviews.title: Excellent customer service
allReviews.text: The customer service was amazing. We stayed in the new tower and it was beautiful. You really get a great deal. The hotel is very close to Fremont street do there is a ton to do, and the best part is that it’s not super loud. The location is excellent. Lots of food options.  The  Hotel and casino does not smell like smoke! Thank God! Osciel was excellent 10/10

allReviews.title: Clean rooms great atmosphere
allReviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at the Downtown Grand. Just a block off of Freemont St. So it wasn't so congested. Staff extremely friendly. Rooms in the Gallery Tower modern and clean. The food at the restaurant was good and reasonably priced.  Highly recommend and would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Hotel discriminates against mentally disabled persons
allReviews.text: For those of you requiring travel with an ESA/PSD service animals, be advised the hotel does not recognize mental disabilities and will charge you $50 plus tax for your pet.  I was told by the manager it is due to their independent "hotel policy" and was forced to sign a document acknowledging their unlawful policy in order for the dog to stay with me and also could not cancel the same day reservation without penalty.  After explaining to the manager the policy was in violation with the Americans with Disability Act, Fair Housing Act and Nevada Disability Laws (NRS 426.325), I took it a step further and offered to show him my ESA/PSD documentation, even though it was well within my rights not to disclose them, as a means to prove I was not lying to the hotel about having a service animal, and was told "it did not matter" because hotel policy doesn't recognize them.I have submitted the violation to the DOJ Civil Rights Division in the meantime I would highly recommend you to spend your money elsewhere.

allReviews.title: Close to Freemont
allReviews.text: We were very pleased with this hotel and casino.  The room was great, the food was great, and the casino had cheaper priced table games than the strip.  We could actually play a $5 crap table!!  The people at the hotel and casino were super nice and friendly.  The room was clean and the casino was clean.  The hotel is just off Fremont street which is nice.  At least from the room we were in, we could hear the base from the music.  They did provide a sound machine thing in the room.  It helped, possibly should bring ear plugs or head phones if you can't sleep with the base sound.  The room did not have a refrigerator but we did not ask for one.  There is a safe in the room.We enjoyed our stay so much we are coming back in the spring.  Would recommend this hotel to others.Masks were required for all people regardless of vaccination status.  But that was everywhere in Vegas when we were there.  Dec. 2021

allReviews.title: Lack luster
allReviews.text: King size bed was barely a queen. Breakfast was supposed to start at 6 and didn’t open till 8. Charged when should of been free. Let customer service know. Didn’t offer anything accept a “sorry for the inconvenience” text. A lot of choices in Vegas, would of been easy to remedy with a comp.

allReviews.title: Great room, close to Fremont
allReviews.text: Started off great with a friendly check-in from Angel. Got to be in a new tower room. Very nice and stylish. Hotel is very close to Fremont Street Experience, which is exactly what I wanted. Free breakfasts included. Parking is a block away, which is a bit inconvenient with luggage, but there is valet parking

allReviews.title: Good hotel.
allReviews.text: Nice stay at the downtown grand. Room was good, nice and clean. Housekeeping was helpful and kind. April at the front desk did a great job helping us check in and sorting out the exact room that was best for us. She really nailed the selection. Thanks!

allReviews.title: Great Service by Ruby
allReviews.text: Staying at the Downtown Grand and needed some help with the guest WIFI. Ruby at the front desk was a big help and goty wofe and I set up on a jiffy and then showed us how to get logged in again if needed. Thanks

allReviews.title: Christmas family vacation
allReviews.text: Really nice hotel extremely friendly staff, Jerrick was awesome! Everything you need is available in this hotel. Casino, restaurants and bar. Close walking distance to many of other attractions. Great!!

allReviews.title: Great Staff and Accommodations
allReviews.text: We had a large group meeting in November (2021) for a number of days. The staff led by Jennifer Scott went beyond being courteous and allowed our stay to accomplish it’s mission, to reach the under-served in the nearby area. The rooms were well maintained and they were very flexible in allowing us to conduct meetings and even materially contributing to the effort. Bless you all!

allReviews.title: Gallery   Tower Corner RM3403 was clean and large
allReviews.text: Came for the Rodeo and had a Great time at DTG...we have been here before but never stayed at the Newer Tower....Gallery Tower rooms are Cleaner and Newer...Ms. April checked us in and recommended the corner rooms....She was efficient and very friendly.....Corner room 3403 had a view of The Mob Museum, mountains and Main Street Casino lights....Ms. April gave us a FREE late check out, since we were there for my B-day!!!  We ate breakfast at the cafe (next to Lobby) and Triple George, (pricey but very good service and meal)... Only downside, was the Gambler Grill, no wait staff ...You had to order at the bar and Howard would cook, serve and bus the table.....One hard working employee with good personality! Finally, we felt very safe at DTG and only less than 100 yards to Fremont Experience...Also, won 500 bucks on the Slots....We will Return

allReviews.title: Off Fremont Street, but a good bet.
allReviews.text: One block off Fremont Street. Right across street from Mob Museum.  Older hotel but they've kept it up nice.  The casino is small but the staff is very friendly.  Jake and Watson at the front desk were very helpful.  Room was very nice, very comfortable.  Valet staff was very great and helpful.

allReviews.title: Gray first impression
allReviews.text: April was awesome! She was quick and helpful. Very friendly. Some of the best front desk service I have received in Vegas. We got an early check in as well. Great way to start the trip! We can’t wait to go explore Fremont!

allReviews.title: DTG ROCKS
allReviews.text: Hello to the reader of this review. Hands down DTG is the place to stay in LasVegas. My husband and I have been coming to Las Vegas for 7 years, typically a few times a year. 4 years ago we found this place. Simply put, we never stay anywhere else. The list of reasons why is too long to list. The high level version…. intimate atmosphere, super clean and the the best part is the staff/employees. We stay for a week and rarely find ourselves outside of the 4 walls of this wonderful casino. When you are here make sure to say hi to Eleanor who works in the pit, she is welcoming and genuinely loves her customers.

allReviews.title: Not the best welcome I've ever had
allReviews.text: After I checked in, I went up to my room, sat on the bed, and felt something. I lifted the sheet and found a used condom under the sheets. I went downstairs, pulled the manager aside, and informed him. I said that I was going out to eat, and when I got back I'd appreciate it if the condom was removed, and all new sheets and pillow cases were put on the bed. I returned a while later and saw that housekeeping had just straightened out the sheets I had pulled back (to, you know, make sure there wasn't anything else on the mattress that shouldn't be there) without even bothering to tuck them in. I lifted the sheet and saw that the condom was still there. I went back downstairs, told the manager, said I'd throw the thing out myself, if he could just have someone bring me fresh sheets and pillow cases. A little while later, housekeeping brought me four flat sheets, no fitted sheet, no pillow cases. I called down, spoke to the manager, and asked if someone could please bring up fresh pillow cases. They did. I unfurled the sheets, saw that one had what appeared to be a cigarette burn on it, and the other had stains in the corner, as if from coffee (I hope it was just coffee). I was exhausted when I arrived and had to prepare for a conference the next day, otherwise I would have left. The rest of the stay was uneventful, perhaps because I left a Do Not Disturb sign on my door for the next three days.

allReviews.title: Valet
allReviews.text: Last night I used the valet. All the team from when I left my car and when I picked it up. They were super friendly and helpful.  When I came out of the hotel. I was immediately greeted by Alex  who was very polite and took speedy care of me.Great customer service

allReviews.title: Bartender
allReviews.text: Always great service!!…Pedro and Monica are always very attentive and friendly, always recommend the bar at the grand, great service, delicious drinks, and always get lucky in the machines playing Leno…Forget the other casinos this is the casino to be while visits if downtown Vegas!!

allReviews.title: Hi bro
allReviews.text: Monica and Pedro were Amazing! Great service as we played machines and hung out having a blast!  It was so much fun. We love the Grand. We will always come here and we will always ask for our favorite cocktail server and bartender!!!!

allReviews.title: Disappointing stay
allReviews.text: This was our 3rd time at this hotel and we have always  spoken very highly of it but not this time. We had a premium king room and had to call maintenence out as soon as we checked in because half of the lights didn't work. Paul came and sorted this for us, he was very helpful and pleasant to chat with. The room was supposed to be none smoking but had a very strong smell of stale smoke. Paul arranged for a air purifier to be put in the room which helped for the 30 minutes it was there.  The bed linen didn't fit the beds so you would wake in the morning with the sheets hanging off the bed. The room was not cleaned well, I wrote my initials in the dust on the lamp, the carpet was heavily stained and there were marks all down the wall where some liquid had been spilt. I didn't want to be in the room any longer than I had to be, it was not a room I could relax in.  Upon check out we again expressed our dissatisfaction about the room, mainly the strong odour. The lady at check out explained there is nothing they can do about the smell but people should not smoke on that floor. She suggested next time we book the new tower as the smoking in that tower is policed much more. We also showed pictures of the filth in the room as I didn't want to appear to be complaining for no reason. They knocked off one night resort fee, which was pretty insulting. We left this hotel and checked into a suite at the Bellagio which was like heaven. We will not stay at this hotel again which I feel disappointed about as we like to spend time downtown. Circa will be our next spot.

allReviews.title: Title
allReviews.text: Jodi at the bar and Michael at player services are great!!!   She makes one of the best bloody Mary’s I’ve ever had. Michael was was so informative and nice. Made the players card so easy to get. I’ll be back

allReviews.title: Best room and services
allReviews.text: I should start with the room but . . Jodi at the center bar was amazing and one of the best bloody Mary’s I’ve had. Michael from player services suggested a card and was so simple to do. Very informative as well. The rooms here were awesome. We checked in a tad late and managed to get an upgrade to a non smoking room. Love this place.

allReviews.title: Best Service !
allReviews.text: We frequent here a lot! We bring family, eat here at the cafe. Have a great time and the best part is that when we need a room fast or great service.We are always working with Jennifer Lawhorn. As we travel a lot and she is very attentive to our needs! Don’t think your service is undervalued we truly do appreciate the stays and assistance! It’s always a good time to bring family and enjoy a time in Vegas! Thanks again ! Jermaine SteeleAllRoadsLeadhere.Com

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: We loved the service at the bar from Jodi and Pedro. Hotel was nice and clean and bed was comfortable. Drinks are great and location is amazing to drive Freemont and restaurants. I would definitely stay here again. Came for a football game and was really easy to get a cab .

allReviews.title: I Love the Grand!
allReviews.text: I love the Grand because it is small enough to find your friends and close to many other casinos for a change of pace.  The pool is very comfortable and the rooms are always clean with good showers.  Beds and pillows are first class and comfy as can be.  Elevators are fast and restaurants are very good.  Free parking across the street.  Downtown isn’t for everyone but I love the old Vegas feel

allReviews.title: Best hotel in Las Vegas *****
allReviews.text: We have been coming to Las Vegas for more than 30 years now and finally found the best hotel. We have tried every hotel on the strip and nothing can compete to where we just stayed. THE DOWNTOWN GRAND HOTEL & CASINO. This is the best hotel in Las Vegas. You can chuck all other hotels out of the window, even the 5-star ones. This hotel has so much more to offer, like super clean rooms, a small, but exciting casino, great food and people that care about the guests. The staff are just unbelievable and will go out of the way to help you and explain everything too you. AJ checked us in and was so fantastic, she took the time to explain everything to us. It was also my husband's Birthday and AJ upgraded us to a one-bedroom Jr suite. Our friends who came to Vegas to help celebrate were staying at the Four Queens and we invited them over for a small pizza party on the first night were so impressed with our room, that they want us to book for them the next time we go. All I have to say to DOWNTOWN GRAND HOTEL & CASINO is, keep up the good work and we will be back. REAL SOON. Our friends and family will also be joining us.        Thank you, DOWNTOWN GRAND. We look forward to many more visits to the best hotel in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Nice Hotel. Need to work on Cleanliness.
allReviews.text: When we arrived there was an empty Monster can on the desk. And the hand soap was used and the wrapper was on the counter. The carpets were very stained, especially around the foot of the bed, looked like red juice. When we woke up the first morning, there was a dirty sock in our sheets, that wasn't ours.  When I hopped in bed the first night, i noticed the bottom sheet was rolled up at the end. I did not receive the ANGEL App. I called and the front desk said they would reconfigure it.  I never did get it.  I called about needing Kleenex and about the sock.  They did remake the bed and get us Kleenex. Loved the Freedom Beat restaurant.  Food was perfect. Gerardo was awesome!

allReviews.title: Just OK
allReviews.text: It was decent and clean. Over priced. Off Fremont Street which is a positive because Fremont Street was really noisy. Rooms are OK but dated.  Definitely nothing special about the place. I think it’s fine but it definitely wouldn’t be my first choice.

allReviews.title: This place really has its act together
allReviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised by every aspect of my three- night stay at this hotel just off Freemont St. Outstanding check-ins, continental breakfast (included in my package) was better than expected, rooms were clean and generally well appointed (if you can ignore the absence of a fridge, micro or coffee-maker. Just far enough off Freemont for a decent night's sleep but a minute away from the action. Had less of a "factory" feel than some of the others.  Good value!  Could have used better lighting.

allReviews.title: Josh at Players Club was super awesome!!
allReviews.text: Josh was extremely nice and very helpful at the Players Club booth to get us set up with our rewards cards. Love staying at the Downtown Grand! Love the location and free parking. Thank you for another great stay!

allReviews.title: Noisy and watch for the upcharges
allReviews.text: I booked this hotel over the phone after I had researched it online. The rate was a suite room with continental breakfast. we went to bed around 2 am after we played all night and the noise in the room was so loud the window was shacking! I called the desk several times before someone would answer. They had several complaints and moved me to a interior room on the same floor and told me they would remove the resort fee, the noise was still so bad we didn't sleep. I explained this to the front desk and they just shrugged. we then went for continental breakfast and they charged it to my room she said they will take it off after checkout. They did not take it off. after complaining for two days in a row they removed the resort fee and the deposit not the continental breakfast. This hotel is not worth the money they charge as a travel agent I do not recommend this place at all.

allReviews.title: Don't Stay Here Unless You Like to Party All Nigjt
allReviews.text: This is my first time staying downtown and its one big party that extends inside your hotel room. The first room I checked into shaked from the music outside which can go on to 4 AM. I went back downstairs to get earplugs (which they have at the front desk) and begged for another room. Yerika was kind enough to give me one in the Gallery Tower which is much nicer and quieter (although they were drilling in the next room at 7:00 AM). The star is for Yerrika since I would not have survived this visit without her.

allReviews.title: not recommended
allReviews.text: The rooms are nice... the hotel is nice...But the noise from Freemont is way too loud for anyone who is trying to get a good nights rest.. the music goes on until at least 2am nightly.  Definitely do not recommend this place.. if you're trying to get some sleep. Also,  the parking garage across the street is disgusting...reeks of urine, and is covered in broken glass.. absolutely disgusting. I won't be staying there anymore... only because of the loud music ...i can honestly say...i did not get any restful sleep the time i was there... not good.

allReviews.title: Birthday
allReviews.text: Michael S and Jodi are the BEST/ We visit every year and Michael has gone “overboard “ with niceness and service. Jodi is always friendly and welcomes you back. We’re here for a 70th birthday party. Michael is awesome.

allReviews.title: Vegas Trip
allReviews.text: Jodi and Lena at the Veil Bar were fantastic!!They were always smiling.  Our suite Was fantastic the games were fun thanks so much   Everyone was very nice the bathrooms were clean the hallways were cleaning the pool look beautiful the lobby was great

allReviews.title: Worth the stay
allReviews.text: My husband and I are regular travelers and also enjoy Vegas often.  This is the first time we've stayed here and we will definitely stay again.   We stayed in the deluxe king.  Beds were comfy, rooms were clean.  There was water to drink (that didn't cost you at all), a hair dryer (nice one) and lots of room.  The casino is small and there are no table games on Wednesday's (bummer), however they have some great restaurants and you ate only a block off Fremont with table games galore.   The pool was 100% amazing.   Great space, open and lots of sun.  I was disappointed that it closed so early though, but it is October,  so there is that.  Overall I highly recommend a stay in this property.  Staff was very friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: Close to everything!
allReviews.text: This place is a solid four! I thought the hotel was clean and well-maintained and the service was outstanding. My only complaint is the hot water wasn’t exactly hot , more like lukewarm, so I didn’t get the hottest shower there. It was within walking distance to everything downtown and there are wonderful food selections right by the hotel. I didn’t have any luck at the hotel casino, but I would definitely say it was a great stay for the price!

allReviews.title: Amazing Service
allReviews.text: Brenda keeps the casino floor looking spotless!  One of the sanitizer stations were empty, I saw Brenda on the floor and asked her if someone can please refill the station.  Within minutes Brenda was back with a refill.  She always greets me with a smile and treats me like family every time I am there.  You can see Brenda is a team player always helping out others.  Thank you for always helping me out Brenda!

allReviews.title: Guest
allReviews.text: Noise level from the outside is ridiculous . Loud music played  pass 2:00 a.m each night . If you are planning on sleeping , you  will not be able to ! The music is very loud . Good luck on trying to get some sleep !

allReviews.title: Good stay at the downtown grand hotel
allReviews.text: Good hotel in the Downtown area of Las Vegas. They were able to deal with my changing accomodation plans and were always polite.I especially liked the breakfast bar (and service by Jessica Noriega) at the "Art Bar".The pool was ok, but not my kind of place for a business trip. Free WiFi at 10mbps and car parking as well

allReviews.title: The place to stay for Punk Rock Bowling
allReviews.text: My wife and I stayed here for 2021 Punk Rock Bowling. Location wise, it is a little dumpy.  There is a lot of homeless folks. Fremont Street is nearby, which we found filled with annoying people and isn’t much better than walking through Times Square in NYC. You are a good deals away from the actual Las Vegas Strip, so you are best to have a car if you are wanting to travel around. The hotel itself wasn’t bad. It actually worked well for PRB. Our room was actually quite pleasant. Lots of space, good AC, comfy bed, decent shower and bathroom. The casino itself is small compared to other casinos in the area. The hotel was fairly clean.  They have free parking across the street in the garage. We had no issues with the garage and going in and out, but it was dirty and had homeless sleeping throughout. The patio and pool area is a cool setting. Some of the punk bands played there during the noon timeframe of the weekend.  I would stay here again for Punk Rock Bowling. Not sure if I would stay here otherwise.

allReviews.title: Las vegas
allReviews.text: We had a wonderful time at the grand our daughter was getting married Jennifer the casino host was very friendly very courteous  The hotel room was clean and nice she went out of her way to make sure we had a nice time Their restaurant across the street triple George was the most awesome meal that we ate the whole time we were there

allReviews.title: Staff is AWESOME!!
allReviews.text: Whenever I come to Vegas I more times then not will stay at DTG, just in the surface the location is perfect, minuted to walk to freemont, several great eateries, fun stuff to do! That being said, the main reason I stay at DTG is becaue JAKE FRANQUEZ, the Front Desk Manager, that young man goes above an beyond to insure our stay is as enjoyable as it can be, his staff is a reflection of his can do personality and they always do whatever needs to be done to make the stay AWESOME!! We will be back soon amd we will stay at DOWNTOWN GRAND, we hope to see Jake!

allReviews.title: Evening out
allReviews.text: Had a blast at the downtown grand this week.  Jodi, Tara, Hector and Pedro at the bar were fantastic!  The drinks were exactly as requested and the gaming was friendly as well.  They do drawings for regular players as well as fantastic dining options

allReviews.title: Absolutely Horrible!!!
allReviews.text: Pictures are nothing, and I mean NOTHING like they are online. My first room had a broken shower head and shower bench which would not lift up and does not show in any picture you see online. We were moved to a new room and the shower was just as nasty, it looked like the curtain had never been changed. My bedding was gross, whatever bedding there was. I am beyond unimpressed. I do not recommend this hotel. Spend the same amount and get yourself a nicer place.

allReviews.title: Fremont Street Experience
allReviews.text: The Downtown Grand was a block from the Fremont Street Experience. Easy to locate the hotel and parking was conveniently close.  Parking was complimentary. Room was clean and the casino small but lucky.  We stayed on the 7th Floor and of course you could hear the noise from the music on Fremont Strip but it quiets down after midnight.The pool area is really nice with a bar area but it was a little cool the day we stayed to swim.Checked in around 4:30 and only one other person in line. No wait for the Bellman taking the luggage to the room and also picking it up at 7:00 a.m.  Express checkout was a plus, just drop the room keys in the slot by front desk.We would definitely stay at the Downtown Grand Hotel on our next trip to Vegas.

reviewsWithMentions.title: High expectations but left a little salty
reviewsWithMentions.text: When my wife and I walked in the lobby we felt like celebrities.  The place is beautiful and massive but after a few days it starts to feel like a hotel within a luxury mall.  Far enough away from the strip to avoid the congestion and chaos but close enough to walk there.  Also within walking distance of Fremont Street. The gym is spectacular.  The staff was great. The casino is clean and nice but allows smoking including cigars.  That was annoying and I smoke cigars. Most of the pools were closed due to ice rink set up.  Our suite was big and had a great view of strip and sphere.  I know it is Vegas but $54 for two glasses of house wine at the main casino bar is a joke.  $27 for a smoothie in the food court is also absurd.  My wife and I make great livings but overcharging for basic drinks and food pissed us off. We found a local liquor store and walked around with our own cocktails after night one. Also, as we read in several reviews, get rid of one ply toilette paper and clear some space in the room fridge for guest waters (so guests don’t have to buy $20 bottles from you).  Those little things make a five star hotel a four star. This is a nice, clean and modern hotel but we left feeling a little salty and will try somewhere else next time.

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau Las Vegas: Luxury, celebration, and modern elegance
allReviews.text: Our stay at Fontainebleau Las Vegas was truly spectacular. From the very beginning, Leslie at reception welcomed us with warmth and professionalism, surprising us with a $150 credit to celebrate my birthday and our anniversary. This thoughtful gesture elevated our celebration and set the tone for an unforgettable visit. Mike at concierge was equally outstanding, ensuring every detail was seamless.The room was impressive and ultra‑modern, with intuitive electronic controls for curtains, drapes, and lighting that added both comfort and sophistication. Housekeeping kept everything impeccable, enhancing the sense of refined luxury.Beyond the casino, the restaurants, the variety of bars, and the world‑class facilities were fabulous, offering a perfect mix of style, atmosphere, and culinary excellence. With its $3.7 billion investment, Fontainebleau is far from ordinary. It redefines what a Las Vegas resort can be. We are absolutely delighted with our experience and would recommend it wholeheartedly to anyone seeking an unforgettable stay.

allReviews.title: Our new favorite hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: Book your stay at the Fontainebleau without hesitation! I spent way too much time researching whether or not to stay here - only to decide to give it a try… and we LOVED it. In the past we’ve stayed at Mandalay Bay, Aria, Venetian, Cosmopolitan, Encore, and Wynn. Fountainbleau is our new favorite. For this trip, we spent 1 night at the Wynn before switching to the Fontainebleau for 3 nights.I have a separate review of our stay at Wynn, but suffice it to say it felt outdated and ‘tired’ compared to the Fontainebleau. We arrived at the Fontainebleau at 11:50am on a Wednesday. Were greeted by smiling valets who opened the doors for us. Seems like a small gesture, but great service gives the right vibe to start your stay (Wynn valets were chit chatting instead of opening doors for guests). The lobby is breathtaking. The smell of fresh flowers is a nice welcome. It looked like there was a small line about to form but Oscar directed the two families in front of us to different agents, then told us to follow him and checked us in himself. He was friendly and helpful. Room was ready, no wait. Oscar gave us a room of the 65th floor, with a great view of the Sphere. The friendliness of the staff at the Fountainebleau was significantly superior to the Wynn. The room is awesome. Clean. Beautiful. They did an incredible job with the design and branding. Bow ties everywhere. Clean white and blue design makes you think it’s a Vegas casino meet Santorini. High ceilings. Luxe atmosphere. Plenty of tables and slots. The casino is not crowded but not dead either, it strikes the right balance of enough people that it’s a buzz, but without the crowds. It’s perfect. A lot more people at night - still the right balance.  The promenade is great, and the food options are excellent. We ate here several times throughout our stay. The Salmon bowl at Bar Ito is excellent. The Black Jack burger at Capons incredible. The Bird (Turkey, avocado, bacon, Brie) sandwich at Nona is the best Turkey sandwich we’ve ever had. Lots of options for coffee, like ‘Break’ at the food court, Chez Bon Bon, or Cafe Cuto (very close to guest elevators, 2nd floor). The gym is superb! Large, spacious, lots of machines. Modern. Feels like going to a real upscale gym. I recognized Gaten Matarazzo (Dustin from Stranger Things) working out in the gym, but he had his headphones in so everyone left him alone. Turned out he was presenting one of the awards at the NHL Awards later that afternoon. Pool area is awesome. Lots of pool options and great service. The servers were on point and attentive. Limited menu selection to your chairs, but full menu if you want to go to La Cote for lunch. Food was delicious and service was great (believe our server was Nashawn. Super friendly). We also had dinner one night at the Washing Potato (upscale Chinese. Great food. Great vibe. Showed up at 9pm with no reservation and were seated promptly). Hotel checkout time is 11am but they extended us to noon without a fuss. If you’re doing Uber, there are 2 rideshare locations for pick up. Just stick with the North rideshare. It’s easier. The south rideshare is downstairs and every Uber driver seems to get confused (they circle around the Taxi area upstairs and don’t realize they need to go down the ramp). North rideshare is easier. Also, bring your own water bottle as the hotel has those airport water bottle stations throughout the casino, where you can refill your own water. The room also has a small cooling drawer besides the mini bar, which is great to chill BYO drinks or late night snacks.  Everything about this hotel just put all the other hotels on the strip to shame. And btw - the water pressure! Excellent. I’m buying the same shower head. Sportsbook is one of the better ones around too. I’m pretty set of sticking with Fountainebleau for my upcoming visits. Nothing else on the strip compares. If you don’t mind taking an Uber to/from shows or clubs - book this hotel without hesitation and have a blast!

allReviews.title: Great Hotel
allReviews.text: Absolutely brilliant hotel . The check is friendly . The rooms are the best - they are so clean and comfortable. Beds are amazingly comfy , there is a fridge for drinks and snacks . We had a view over looking  the sphere which was fab . The food court is really good with some really good places to eat . We ate at Dons Prime which I have to say was amazing both in service and food and would highly recommend . The casino is really good , it’s really spacious and drink service was good - there is a lovely bar in the center which is nice  . Highly recommend this hotel .

allReviews.title: Wanna-Be.
allReviews.text: TL;DR:  FONTAINEBLUEAU has potential, and the public areas are impressive. BUT it's low-class and disappointing.  Wanna-Be.  HOWEVER, I really want you to stay here because then you will help free up occupancy at the good places we like to go to normally :)   We (couple) go to Vegas an average of 1/month for 15 years now, almost all high-end casinos (we have our favorites).  This is the first time we stayed at FONTAINEBLUEAU (4 days), and we will not be back.FONTAINEBLEAU disappoints.-- Public areas are impressive. Shiny and huge. But!... -- Rooms are very subpar.--  Weird super disgusting grease (KY?) smeared in blobs on the window.  Very obvious.-- Room window in general super dirty (from the inside).-- Huge nest of long black hair inside the shower.  Yuck.-- Sinks have super water-savers, almost non-functional (drip drip drip) -- Very heavy (50 lbs+) rock room table not secured to tiny wooden foundation -- dangerous.-- Check out on TV did not work.-- Check out on email did not work.-- Half the number of towels of other casinos on the strip.-- Tiny individual shampoo pouches (reminds me of Motel 6, etc.). Smells disgusting (opinion).-- Tiny hard white soap for the sinks -- low quality and literally as bad as Motel-6 quality.-- Lamp in room did not work, and no access to plug to fix it.-- Window black-out shades/curtains close randomly during our entire 4-day stay.-- Housekeeping staff has very loud conversations for 45+ minutes daily outside the room door!... disruptive and insensitive.-- Concierge gave us completely wrong information regarding picking up our concert tickets.-- Location (not factored into my low review) is abysmal.  -- casino drinks were the worst I've had from anywhere in Vegas (including lowest-end places).

allReviews.title: Very nice and well-managed hotel - I would return!
allReviews.text: I had a wonderful time at my stay at Fontainebleau Las Vegas. My work convention was in the hotel and systematically, it was well organized. Our rooms were spacious. Service was top notch. The restaurants in the hotel never want to make you leave. I really love this hotel and would definitely go back to stay or stay at another location. Thank you for a stress-free stay.

allReviews.title: They're thieves.
allReviews.text: The worst hotel experience. After an external shattering of a glass, the supposed value of the card was charged “in Chinese”. Even when they reported it they said it had been a bird and even gave us another room.They never answered after they took office, but they did make a letter of claims to American Express full of lies. There's no other way to call this but a robbery.Never go to this hotel!

allReviews.title: Excellent stay!
allReviews.text: From check in to check out, everything was great. Ashley at the front desk was very sweet and welcoming. Our favorite bartenders are now Javier & Alex at the pool bar. They made our afternoon so much funner. Cant wait to go back!

allReviews.title: Fantastic Hotel
allReviews.text: Personally I didn't experience some of the negative comments around the piped scent (more to follow on that one) or the poor hygiene standards. The standards were immaculate in every area we experienced always people cleaning, housekeeping standards were excellent. The only issues I found was the smell of cigars around the casino area and the bleau bar in the centre of the ground floor (not a massive problem just when walking past a cigar smoker which may explain the comment/review about the overpowering piped scent, rather have that than disgusting cigars IMO). The drinks and food were expensive in the hotel however this is Vegas so kind of accept it but no more expensive than Dubai for example. The food we had was of excellent quality. Location was perfect in the slightly quieter north end of the strip, however only a 15min walk to the Strat or the Dueuce bus which goes up and down the strip for $16 a 24 hr pass stops outside north and south, its a 20 min ride up to Freemont Street or a 25 min ride down to the Las Vegas sign. Overall this hotel was fantastic and would highly recommend it, if in Vegas again we would definitely stop here.

allReviews.title: Warning for Allergy Sufferers and Guests Sensitive to Fragrance
allReviews.text: I want to leave a warning for anyone with allergies, asthma, mast-cell issues, or even mild chemical sensitivity: the scent diffusers at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas are overwhelming. The fragrance is so thick you could cut it with a knife—you can literally taste it. The smell is strong enough that you notice it 30 feet outside the property, and once inside it is intense enough to make people with even moderate sensitivities genuinely sick.For context, I do not live in a bubble and would describe my sensitivity level as somewhere between mild and moderate. I’m not opposed to signature scents at hotels either. In fact, if I could bottle whatever Wynn and Encore use, I’d run it in my own home. But staying and walking through Fontainebleau felt like spending 24 straight hours inside an Uber with the cheapest gas-station air fresheners hanging from every surface.The scent is so heavy it affects the taste of your food in the restaurants. I eventually learned to breathe through my mouth while covering my face with my shirt every time I left my room. My first day in Vegas was ruined before I even realized what was happening—just 30 minutes on the property triggered a pounding headache, itching of my scalp and back, and complete nasal congestion. When I called home to say I’d arrived safely, my boyfriend immediately said, “You sound awful,” without knowing I was having a full reaction.If you have any kind of fragrance sensitivity, I strongly recommend avoiding this property.For those without sensitivities, the hotel itself is lovely. The price was reasonable, the service excellent, and the rooms are comfortable. I was a bit disappointed that the developers didn’t take the opportunity to surpass Wynn and Encore in design and build quality (particularly with regard to the uninspired common areas) but perhaps there is only one Steve Wynn and one Roger Thomas.  If those spectacular properties were not next-door for comparison purposes, or if this were a large convention hotel and casino anywhere else, it would easily set a standard for quality and design.  I have two more nights here covering my face,  breathing through my mouth, dousing myself in antihistamines and avoiding common areas because it is a prepaid reservation through a third-party vendor.  Wish me luck!

allReviews.title: Disappointed and dirty room for a 5 star
allReviews.text: I was really excited to stay here. It looked like it could compete for #1 in LV. But when we got to our room, there was something smudged on the wall. Pubic hair was in the shower and bathroom floor. Cleanliness should be non negotiable for a 5 star. But it was an issue in our room. When we notified staff, they took their sweet time coming to help. They didn’t bother to clean it but just abruptly moved us to a new room, which is fine but there was no apology but they did give $25 casino credit. The new room was clean and beautiful, as you should expect from a 5 star.

allReviews.title: Still Extraordinary and Exceptional
allReviews.text: Many a stay at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas since our first and still extraordinary:  A at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas decidedly did not disappoint to say the very least. The establishment presented with exceptional and extraordinary attention to the most minute of guest and aesthetic detail only overshadowed by the exemplary level of servicing.The accommodations were superb and well thought-out inclusive of provided amenities. Where the likes of the Bellagio rooms have become dated and stale, this resort is fresh, innovative, welcoming and crisp. Similarly, the common areas exhibit the same ambiance and thoughtfulness to curating the overall experience. Unfortunately, where the culinary offerings within were vehemently energetic serving up remarkably brilliant fare, the gaming area lacked said energy and vibe due to the simple lack of persons therein.The writer is confidently hopeful that given time that this outstanding and incomparable venue will draw in the crowds in filling the common areas. With this said, the lack of masses in attendance did not significantly detract from the experience and was soundly augmented by consummate and commendable servicing. The staff came across as being a genuine part of the Fontainebleau “family” providing caring and conscientious servicing to the extent of making the guest feel more than welcome and an appreciated included member of the same intimate family. In speaking with staff, the majority seem to have come from other top-tier competitors in the fervent belief that they could contribute in such a significant way in making this establishment the best on the Strip. Consequently, “exemplary” servicing throughout….Finally, for those concerned with the distance from the central Strip, a short walk destines one in the heart of everything. Although, with such extensive offerings within the Fontainebleau Las Vegas, there really is no reason necessitating leaving in the first place.My entire group looks forward to many more return engagements….

allReviews.title: A five star rating but could still be subtly improved......
allReviews.text: My wife and I stayed at the Fontainbleau for 5 nights, with five other relatives and friends also joining us.I had spent ages looking at the various reviews of all the other hotels in Las Vegas, and that the Fontainbleau hotel had still only been open for less than 2 years, and its modern look and feel swung it for us.   Hotel roomWe stayed in a best view golden room on the 69th floor.   I had pre requested a suite, but none were available on checkin.   We were not that disappointed though and the view was really good looking out onto the sphere.   These rooms have a large walk in shower, rather than a bath tub/shower as per the rooms that have the mountain view.  The fit and finish of the room was very nice and of a good standard and the bed very comfortable.   The air con was also efficient and relatively quiet.  One aspect to be careful with is the minibar and adjacent snacks.   If you remove an item for more than 60 seconds, you will be charged for it automatically.  On checkin we were also cautioned about this.   One aspect for us europeans that was also lacking, was an in-room coffee/tea making facility.   A minor issue but we missed that option.   The room was made up every day but again one minor comment is that the floors were only vacuumed once during our 5 day stay.   While we are not untidy, we would have expected this more frequently.   The rooms have touch panels for the lighting and also to close the curtains.  A nice touch, but they seemed to have a mind of their own on occasion and could take several goes to get the curtains either fully open or closed.   I suspect that long term these may be problematic.     Location.  We were aware that the hotel is located toward the far end of the strip, but we were aware of that and used the nearby monorail station at the Westgate hotel a couple of times, and equally enjoyed the walk to the other hotels, such as Caesars Palace etc.    On site parking.   The hotel has a huge self parking garage, which was free for the period of our stay having signed up to the members club.    Overall hotel quality.   As others have mentioned, the hotel communal areas are kept very clean and tidy and are beautifully finished, providing a modern, spacious and elegant feel.   Restaurant and bar options.  There is a wide range of options and all that we ate at, Dons Prime, Washing Potato (twice) and The Tavern were really very good.   During our visit, the SEMA car show was on, and the hotel was really busy as the exhibition centre is attached to the hotel.   It was pretty imperative that you booked the restaurant in advance to avoid disappointments, especially when looking to seat larger groups.  Fortunately I had made bookings on three nights for us well in advance.   The main bar area on level 1 was really busy in the evening and the staff were struggling to keep up, and it could take some time to obtain a drink and all seats taken.   On occasion we gave up and went to the bar on level 2 near the food court and koyu restaurant, as this tended to be less busy.   Collins bar was lovely and we enjoyed several visits there.  Worth a visit !I will be writing separate reviews for Don Prime and Washing potato.   One thing that I find frustrating though is that the online menus do not include the prices.  I really wish that this could be corrected, but note that others do a similar thing.   I just like to have an idea of approximate prices ahead of a visit.  Overall, a really lovely hotel and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.   It's definitely a five star award but with some minor improvements could make it unbeatable.   We would certainly return again.

allReviews.title: I really want to like this hotel…but I can’t
allReviews.text: First time staying at the Fontainebleau. Had high expectations since it’s a one Michelin Key hotel.All the hardware are modern, elegant, more elevated than other luxury hotels on the strip.However, the hardware is the only thing to be impressed about. Our trip took a turn at night.Our room is facing the swimming pool. At 9 PM, some staff started working on the pool, likely cleaning as we hear loud jet stream cleaner noise. We thought it will be just an hour, so did not mind too much about it.They continued on deep into the night. With the loud machine noise until 3AM. Called the front desk at 1AM to complain and ask if they can start cleaning in the morning. I was shocked by the response: “We are a 24 hour resort, the staff needs to do things when it needs to be done”There was no apology at all about the noises, just a cold answer. This unprofessional is at a 5 star luxury hotel doubts me why they were awarded the Michelin key. Don’t think I would stay here again, the service is way below what it should be.

allReviews.title: First and NOT last stay at Fontainebleau
allReviews.text: This was our first stay at Fontainebleau and it will not be the last. The resort is the cleanest I have seen in Vegas in a very long time. From our room to the gaming area, it was spotless. We had numerous meals there and they were all delicious. The staff was extremely friendly and went out of their way at numerous times during our 4-day stay. It was refreshing knowing that it is hard to attract and retain good help in so many of the service industries all over the world... but they have some keepers!

allReviews.title: Excellent hotel with great customer service!
allReviews.text: This hotel is great! It is very clean, modern, and spacious. The rooms are large and technologically advanced. It is also a very short walk to the Sahara, which has the monorail to take you down the strip. We had a small issue with one of the room appliances and the staff were extremely accommodating to help us get it resolved. I’d recommend this to anyone coming to Vegas!

allReviews.title: First Class Experience
allReviews.text: An overall excellent experience.  The fact that the property is very new, certainly doesn't hurt.  Beyond that the hotel has a luxury feel without the Las Vegas tackiness.  The rooms are good size with large bathrooms.  The rooms that don't have a bath have a huge shower.  Until 12/31, they are not charging for o/n guest parking.  They also, do not charge that annoying "resort fee".  There is a large number working at the checkin desk.  No wait for checkin or out.  Service was excellent overall as well.

allReviews.title: Luxury Stay
allReviews.text: I had a great experience during my stay. From the moment we arrived, things started off on the right foot—we were able to check in early and the staff greeted us warmly even offering complimentary bottled water.The room was lovely spacious, clean, and with a beautiful strip view. The shower was impressively large, and the bed was comfortable.There was a minor hiccup with the toilet not flushing properly, but I called the front desk and maintenance arrived within about 10 minutes. They fixed it quickly and professionally.We appreciated the combination of comfort, service, and amenities and would definitely go back!

allReviews.title: Worst hotel experience ever.
allReviews.text: My wife, daughter and I stayed at Fontainebleau Las Vegas from August 28th to August 31st, 2025, and I’m disgusted by our experience. On the morning of the last day of our stay, we heard a loud noise in the room, however after sitting up in bed and looking around, we did not find what caused the noise and went back to sleep. A couple of hours later when opening the curtains in the room we noticed that a window was cracked. We immediately contacted the front desk to let them know.  Shortly thereafter security guards, concierge and maintenance personnel from the hotel arrived to inspect the damage. After looking over everything, they mentioned that it was likely caused by an external impact. We were then asked to go to the front desk to speak with a resort manager.The resort manager, explained that security had determined the damage was due to a duck impact, as they had found a dead duck in the area below the window.When doing our checkout, we paid the resort fees and some restaurant charges and then left.After coming home, I was blindsided with a $11,000 charge to my credit card. When I reached out to dispute the charge, their response was dismissive, unprofessional, and completely lacking in accountability. No evidence was provided, and no effort was made to fairly resolve the issue. I felt totally taken advantage off and fell like they expected me to just accept it. The final straw was when I was advised that their third-party vendor determined that we were at fault, but no other information was presented. I have never encountered this kind of blatant dishonesty from a hotel. I have since disputed the charges with my bank and filed formal complaints and even had an attorney send a letter to the hotel to dispute the charge and yet, have not gotten any response from the hotel. This is not just bad customer service, it’s fraud. The hotel management should be ashamed of this behavior.

allReviews.title: Bogus resort fee
allReviews.text: This is not a 5 star hotel. There is no coffee in the room. Not even a free water bottle in the room. The food in the food court is RIDICULOUSLY expensive. They are renovating the largest pool into an ice rink, so we could not get lounge chairs at the pools. $55 resort fee for WHAT?! Total scam.

allReviews.title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Beautiful hotel with everything you need inside
allReviews.text: The hotel is really beautiful and very big, with a casino, restaurants, shops, and bars all inside … you almost don’t need to leave! Everything was clean, and the rooms were comfortable and nicely decorated. Definitely a great place to stay in Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Perfect Stay!
allReviews.text: Check in was a breeze and very courteous. Our room was on the 19th floor and the first impressions on the way was WOW! Chic and Posh! Our room was beautiful and had a great view of the Sphere. Overall, we had a wonderful 3 night stay!

allReviews.title: A spectacular hotel
allReviews.text: I was here for a two-day conference and was amazed by the beauty of this hotel. Brand new, it represents an unbridled luxury where the casino with its bright colors is out of tune in the midst of the many luxury boutiques (if there were no casino it would seem to be in Via Montenapoleone). Slightly outside position compared to the strip but really classy.

allReviews.title: Thiefs at this resort
allReviews.text: My eldest daughter decided to elope to Las Vegas so we booked three room at the Fountainebleau for the whole family. We were robbed!!! Someone came into my daughters room and took our families pearls and the Hermes bag that had her and her new husbands wedding gifts inside. We reported it to the resort and although they acted like they cared nothing was done. No return call, no follow up. I also reported the theft to the police as it  was over $4000. The officer that took my statement did tell me that when he was younger the same thing happened to him at the Venetian. So be aware!!!!

allReviews.title: Very good rooms and service.
allReviews.text: Despite being a massive convention hotel, it’s really a nice place to stay. Room was large and comfortable. Equally so for the bed. Bathroom super nice. Rooms on both sides of the hotel have beautiful night views of the city. You will want to be careful about staying on the side that faces music venues, since those can get very loud. I had to move rooms to the other side, but I figure that out quickly enough. Lots of good restaurants to eat at, judging by the menus. Casino is so-so. Location is mediocre as well, given that it is on the northernmost part of the strip. That said, I would stay here again in a heartbeat.

allReviews.title: This place is huge and amazing!
