allReviews.text: I’ve started staying at Fontainebleau regularly for business and it’s been outstanding. Easy to get off the Strip, with clean, modern rooms and great service. The casino and restaurants are top-notch, and rewards/comps are very fair. A perfect mix of convenience, comfort, and fun.

allReviews.title: A top notch Vegas experience
allReviews.text: We loved everything about our stay at Fontainebleau, from check-in to our guest room to drinks and dining to gaming. The entire resort is clean and well kept. The gym and pool are incredible. We'll definitely be back.

allReviews.title: Better than most of the strip hotels
allReviews.text: This is a great resort on the northern potion of the strip.   The casino is large with a great selection of table games and slots.   Many food choices with some great restaurants.  The room I stayed in was clean and modern.  The hotel staff provides excellent service.   This was my second stay in the past year and I will stay there again in the future.

allReviews.title: amazing experience
allReviews.text: the Hotel is amazing the facilites are great, the rooms are well decorated we strongly suggest the following restaurantsKomodo, Fontaine, Mother wolf, we travel with 3 and 6 years old kids pool was great for them

allReviews.title: Best Hotel in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: This hotel stands out as one of the finest in Las Vegas, offering an unparalleled level of luxury. For those seeking a VIP experience, this is undoubtedly the ideal destination.

allReviews.title: Wonderful resort to stay at in Vegas.
allReviews.text: I am a big fan of the Fountain Bleau Miami location.  the Vegas property did not disappoint.  The layout was well thought out.  Great restaurants.  The bar vibe was just what I needed after a long day.  The room was well designed with easily accessible lighting and drape controls throughout the room.  Elegant bathroom.  The room service was impeccable.   Overall, one of the most problem free stays in my travel history.  Beware of August though.  It was too hot to even enjoy the pool.  I think the sun bounces off the tinted windows directly into the pool area.  This would be great at a different time of year but in August was just too much for me.  However, if you are there to gamble, this is no big deal.  Great stay.  I would definitely go again for the right price!

allReviews.title: 10 out of 10!
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel with stunning views! Excellent water pressure in the shower and soft comfortable beds. The pools are amazing

allReviews.title: Luxury and friendly
allReviews.text: I loved my time in The Fountaineblue Las Vegas, the staffs members all the time was amazing; check in and check out was very easy and fast. The room was perfect.

allReviews.title: Wonderful spot
allReviews.text: Amazing hotel! I was there for business, but mixed in a bit of fun toward the end of my trip. I like how it is a little removed from the heart of the strip, as it lends itself to a calmer, higher-end vibe. However, you can still easily walk or rideshare to the more lively spots. The service, ambiance, and pool were incredible. My room had an amazing view of the Sphere which I enjoyed every night. The blackout shades were effective at keeping out the light. Overall, would definitely return if I find myself back in Las Veas.

allReviews.title: Best Las Vegas hotel by far
allReviews.text: I’ve been going to Las Vegas once or twice a year for the past 14 years and Fontainebleau is by far the best hotel here! The overall experience is great, rooms are nice and very clean, restaurants are amazing and the bars/club is the best! I don’t think I could have lost in the casino if I had wanted to! Definitely will be staying here from now on!

allReviews.title: Not the best experience I’ve ever had
allReviews.text: I don’t know what to say. It’s just a big impersonal casino. Seems to be overrun with too many people all jammed together. Dealers vary from good to sad

allReviews.title: Unwind and relax
allReviews.text: thee best hotel in Vegas hands down the place is super clean and family friendly  my whole stay was very relaxing and my family loves it

allReviews.title: Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Nice new hotel, clean and very large rooms with great views of the LV, especially the Sphere. Nice swimming pool and gym.I found the prices of minibar products and the general confusion of the lobby excessive

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau worst 5 star ever
allReviews.text: My first time staying here and last I had high expectations. When we got to the room it smells like sewage. It smelled so bad we had to stsy outside. We went back to front desk and they did nothing for us worst customer service ever. They down graded us to another room. Never staying here again. I never been treated so bad ever. There’s many other Hotels don’t stay here.

allReviews.title: Disgusting room and horrible service
allReviews.text: I have never received such horrible service from both the front desk and the manager about our room situation. We checked into our room to find it smelled horribly of sewage and when we went downstairs to switch rooms that’s when the rudeness and attitude came out from the blond lady in the front. She downgraded our room in response and said that was all she could do for us. Last time I stayed here I had such great service so I wanted to come back here and was instead treated like a speck of dirt on her foot. The manager came out and gave the same monotone unwelcoming response. This experience left such a sour taste in our mouths and we won’t be coming back here. There’s plenty of other great hotels to stay at in Vegas. We’ll definitely go back to sticking with Palazzo instead.

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel
allReviews.text: I stayed at the hotel for 2 days during a work trip and it was excellent. The room was bigger than I expected, with a stunning view of the pool area and the Sphere, staff was super helpful and friendly and all the amenities were amazing (eg. a "cold drawer" next to the mini fridge so you can store your water and stuff, perfect!) No coffee machine in the room, but I learned that's normal for Vegas.

allReviews.title: This is where you HAVE to stay in Las Vegas!
allReviews.text: Why are you considering any other resort?! This one is the best! It's spectacular, with its modern, eclectic artwork all around the resort, its relaxing pools, and its close proximity to the Convention Center and the Strip. I have never stayed at a hotel where the staff was consistently genuine, friendly, helpful, and extremely knowledgeable. Definitely check out Le Cote cafe, the Hall of Excellence sports museum, the Tavern sports bar, and the spa--you will not be disappointed!

allReviews.title: Bleu is top notch #1
allReviews.text: You will not be disappointed in staying at Bleu.  From gaming, to shoppes, food and shopping, it has it all for your every desire.

allReviews.title: Definitely going back!!!!!!
allReviews.text: We went for my son's 14th birthday! We got upgraded to a suite and made the experience really nice! The food was amazing and every drink we had from the multiple bars where all really delicious!

allReviews.title: Will be returning!
allReviews.text: Great new hotel! Stayed for an event and loved that you could walk right to the convention center. Highly recommend for that alone. Rooms were clean and comfortable. Staff was friendly and helpful. Self-Parking was a breeze and included during stay. Hotel was easy to navigate. Only minor note is on the in-room fridge drawers - they never got cold enough. Very minor issue that probably won't even bother most!

allReviews.title: Love this place!
allReviews.text: This Casino is fabulous. From the first step out of the vehicle, the scent in the air, fresh flowers inside and the overall sensual atmosphere makes this hotel a no brainer for us. We have stayed here 4 times and never been disappointed!

allReviews.title: DO NOT STAY HERE! AUGUST 2025 STAY RUINED
allReviews.text: Checked in 8/02 at 12:45 AM (mobile check-in, just picking up keys) and the front desk never returned my ID. I thought I’d lost it, tore apart my room, retraced my steps, and called the desk—was told “no” and to file a lost/found report. Not convinced, I went down 3 separate times and was told each time it wasn’t there. Security even told me to stay in my room or risk being kicked out for not having ID. After crying and missing a paid event, my friend asked the desk one last time—and guess what? It was there the whole time. This wasted nearly 3 hours. When I asked the GM (dark hair, started shift 10:45 PM) how this could happen, she was rude and dismissive, only offering $100 food credit + late checkout. BEYOND UNACCEPTABLE. It ruined my stay.

allReviews.title: Average Stay
allReviews.text: We have only ever stayed in the Wynn and Encore on our past trips so I don't know if our expectations were too high because although this hotel looks like luxury once your staying its not very luxurious at all.The casino is big and has lots of slots and tables but the drinks service was so slow I think its because the ladies had so long to walk to get the drinks there didn't seem enough of them to keep on top of it.Our room was good really loved the bathroom but when we checked in although it had been cleaned there were crumbs on the carpet and hairs all over the bathroom floor, called down they sent someone in to sort it but when we returned at the end of the evening they had hoovered most of the crumbs and hairs but left quite a lot so ended up using my antibacterial wipes to get rid of them! Everynight we stayed there were people outside our room sitting in the hallway chatting really loud at 3/4 am, if your from the UK like us you will know how hard it is to go back to sleep when your woken up at 3am your body thinks its daytime so that was annoying.We tried a lot of the bars all were very good with a high standard of service but was quite taken back that on the Saturday when the day club finished people who had been partying there came to the main bleu bar in trunks and bikinis standing around the bar being really loud, not being the fun police, all for people having a good time but don't really want to be dressed up for a fancy dinner paying for a $25 cocktail with a side of obnoxious drunk chat and body hair.We used the pool twice both times struggled to get beds, people were reserving beds with towels and then not using them, we didn't want to pay for day beds for a couple of hours so made do with what we could find, not enough umbrellas to stay out too long in the sun. The pool area was pretty dirty, spilled drinks, food left under beds.On a positive note all the staff we encountered through the hotel were polite, helpful and enthusiastic.On summary if your looking for high end luxury this is probably not the hotel for you but with the prices they charge you do get a luxury room for a lower cost than some of the other luxury hotels just not the same experience.Would we stay here on our next visit no but I would visit for drinks in some of the nicer bars yes.

allReviews.title: Luxury Hotel Experience
allReviews.text: The Fontainebleau is a luxurious hotel/casino on the north end of the Las Vegas Strip.The hotel offers free parking for guests.  A member of the concierge team told us that free parking continues until midnight after check-out.Their customer service is extraordinary.  Every employee we interacted with was outstanding.  Each was friendly, polite, and helpful.LocationFor me, the biggest drawback to this property is its location.  It's far from the majority of the Strip action.  But mostly, I wish they had better neighbors.  Directly to the north is a vacant lot with The Sahara on the other side.  It's across the street from Circus Circus and there are two more vacant lots to the south.  Getting anywhere off the property I genuinely want to be is a walk.  That being said, the journey is excellent exercise and fantastic people-watching.DiningOverall, the dining options are, expectedly, on the pricey side.  We ate dinner at Mother Wolf and had breakfast at Vida.  I will review those venues in detail separately.  However, both were enjoyable experiences.We grabbed drinks at Bleau Bar a couple of times.  The service is friendly but a bit inattentive, especially for the price.  I ordered the Pancakes & Dopamine cocktail ($21) and my husband ordered a Mango Cart beer ($9).  All of the beer comes in either a can or a bottle.  I don't believe they have draft beer.  My cocktail tasted great; super smooth.  The issue I had with my drink is that it was mostly ice cube.  I feel like I paid $21 for about a shot glass worth of beverage.  $9 for a 12-oz can of beer that costs $11.99 for a six-pack is rough enough.  The drinks and service are not worth the price.RoomWe stayed in a Bleau King Mountain Best View room.  The room was clean and comfortable.  The only issue we had with the room was that we had to move the showerhead to face the corner to prevent water from seeping out between the top of the ledge and the bottom of the door.  The water pressure was intense.  If you liked being beaten up by water, this shower is for you.Check-OutThe only real issue we encountered was during check-out.  Because of the booking portal we used, we received a late check-out of 4:00 pm (the standard check-out time is noon), which we verified with the front desk while checking in.  We went to our room around 3:30 pm to gather our belongings and leave, but our keycards would not unlock the door.  We then had to go to the front desk during the hectic check-in time (3:00 pm), which was frustrating.  In the grand scheme of things, it was merely an irritating hiccup.  But I'm not sure why their reservation system does not allow for a late check-out without the guest needing new keys.The actual check-out process is simple.  I received an email with a link to review our charges, with a button to check out and email the folio.  I clicked the button and checked out.  My only issue with that is that I never received my emailed folio.  I took a screenshot, so it wasn't much of a problem.I would stay at Fontainebleau Las Vegas anytime and recommend it to friends.

allReviews.title: Clean, well looked after hotel with great pool area
allReviews.text: For our first time visiting Vegas, we were very impressed with the hotel. We were given a choice of a higher or lower floor. We chose higher, and were also upgraded and given a room with a great view. Full height window was great for a view of the sphere and the strip.The pool area was clean, and plenty of sun lounges.The hotel is further away from the strip but we knew this when booking so it wasn’t an issue, but one to bear in mind if you like to be central. Only issue we had was lack of quick bites suitable for a family. Lots of high end dining. We settled on sharing a pizza one night and it was almost $70! Way too overpriced for what it was in my opinion.Overall, we had a great stay and would recommend the hotel.

allReviews.title: Impressed- would stay again
allReviews.text: Wow! This place was fantastic! Excellent customer service from the concierge and the bell staff. There was also an oversized tub and great water pressure in the shower. The room was clean with a comfy bed and soft pillows. The room had updated technology. Just watch out for the mini bar. It’s done on a weight system. If you remove an item for more than 30 seconds you’ve bought it. Good shopping and great restaurants. Loved breakfast at La Fontaine. They also have a great chocolate shop called Cocoa Dulce that’s not to be missed.

allReviews.title: No pool - denied a fun day in Vegas
allReviews.text: Booked this hotel specifically for the pool. After we checked in, we found out that the pool was closed. Was told this was due to wildfires and high winds, although Wynn had their pool open. The boy at the pool unlocked the door and admitted that the staff had been sent home - probably just a way to save money and ruin my experience.

allReviews.title: Looking forward to returning
allReviews.text: Such a beautiful resort!  The restaurants are exceptional.  I ate at Mother Wolf, always a standout.  Chez Bon Bon is open 24/7 - I can grab coffee at 5am!

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau uses clever marketing but the delivered product falls short in every area.
allReviews.text: Restaurants were closed too early or just not open. Limited facilities overall. Rooms not cleaned. Called down 3 times for fresh towels that were never delivered. Hotel layout was odd - a cocktail bar in what can only be described as a shopping mall food court? The whole hotel lacked any kind of ‘Vegas vibe’. Over priced resort fee. Bad location. The list is endless. Fontainebleau uses clever marketing but the delivered product falls short in every area.

allReviews.title: PESIMA
allReviews.text: IF YOU GO TO LAS VEGAS NEVER CONSIDER THIS OPTION THEY CHEAT YOU WITH THE COSTS AND BESIDES THEY WANT TO CHARGE YOU THINGS YOU ALREADY PAID IF YOU DON'T LOOK CLOSE YOU PAY DOUBLE

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel
allReviews.text: 2nd time staying at this beautiful hotel and it didn't disappoint. We had a comp match and stayed the last 2 nights of our 13 night trip. From start to finish, the stay was exceptional. The customer service was outstanding everywhere. The room was gorgeous, fantastic pool area and my husband said the chicken sandwich he had from the food court was the best he'd ever had - so good he had it 2 days running. The chicken tenders from the same place wete also fantastic. The location wasn't an issue as we'd already done 4 nights at NYNY and 3 nights Cosmo and we weren't planning on straying far from the hotel as I'd planned it as a 2 night chill out/wind down stay. We also got a 1st spin bonus on pinball on freeplay and won $120 - we did pretty well on the slots as well.I would stay again in a heartbeat - don't let the location put you off - it cost us about $8 to Uber from Cosmo

allReviews.title: Felt Misled and Overcharged
allReviews.text: Arrived thinking I had a special rate, left with a bill twice the price—nearly $9,000. Misled from the start, poor management attitude, and left Las Vegas more disappointed than ever.

allReviews.title: Clean hotel with great gaming and rooms
allReviews.text: Clean hotel. Very quiet. Definitely recommend. It's a little far away from the main strip which is a bit of a bummer but overall a very nice experience with lots to do.

allReviews.title: Best hotel on the strip we’ve been to in a long time
allReviews.text: FANTASTIC hotel!!!  Highly recommend from the minute you walk in the door you were treated so well by all the staff the room was beautiful clean the best view we’ve ever had in the strip in the 40+ times we’ve ever been there. Just a really great experience and would highly highly recommend and definitely will go back again.

allReviews.title: We will be back soon! The best hotel on the strip! Gorgeous!
allReviews.text: What A Wonderful Experience! Gorgeous hotel! Wouldn't stay anywhere else!  Wonderful staff, very personable, & friendly! Went for my husband's 60th birthday. They made it very special by upgrading my room. And a flight at breakfast at Viva! Thank you for a great experience!

allReviews.title: Wonderful stay near the Sphere
allReviews.text: Amazing beautiful hotel with loads of hrs and restaurants!  Rooms gorgeous and a great vibe.  Nice casino also. Pool area was amazing also

allReviews.title: Relaxing and opulent
allReviews.text: Beautiful property and easy to navigate. The pool is most excellent with plenty of room and chairs. Restaurants were great and plentiful. Rooms masterly appointed and clean. Gambling is too tight though and minimums too high for my blood. The theater is fairly intimate with great acoustics and sound. We saw the Alabama Shakes concert here and loved it.  When having an Uber pick you up, specify north or south entrance. There are two places to be picked up, with no signage as to which entrance.  The only signs I saw pointed you to the rideshare pickup area which takes you to the north area past the lobby.

allReviews.title: Great Experience! Would stay again.
allReviews.text: Had a great time at Fountainebleau Las Vegas. Staff was friendly and accommodating. Rooms were very clean. Komodo had great late night dining. Get the wagyu & lobster fried rice. It was outstanding! Go see Pam @ Gucci if you're in the market.

allReviews.title: Luxury in Las Vegas does not get better than this!
allReviews.text: As a luxury wedding planner, I have the pleasure of visiting some of the most incredible resosrts in the world.  Fontainebleau Las Vegas is one of my favorites.  From the stunning, dynamic casino to the most impeccably appointed rooms and suites, every inch of this property is beautiful, well maintained, and the staff excels in every interaction.  Their ballrooms are spectacular and the perfect foundation that allows me to build out the most incredible experiences for my couples.  I could not be more appreciative of their partnership and support.

allReviews.title: Resales ruining Fontainebleau concerts
allReviews.text: My experience on the Fontainebleau Website was very poor.The resale tickets on sale for Toto are ridiculous and don’t even list at to what the face value was.Reselling is fine if you generally can’t go but that’s clearly not the case here and the extra booking fee is just extortion and they are no better than STUBHUB and Viagogo.Very disappointing

allReviews.title: Worth the money
allReviews.text: Spacious, clean suite. Cleaning service great. We had a great stay. The only thing we did not get were the closing times at pool. One day it was 7pm, another day 5 pm. We loved Don’s Prime and the gym.

allReviews.title: New, Modern, Luxury Hotel in Vegas that’s seriously undervalued
allReviews.text: Undervalued luxury hotel at the north end of the Las Vegas Strip. Just visited the Fontainebleau Las Vegas for the first time last weekend and was very positively surprised. The hotel is north of the Resorts World and Wynn/Encore and the newest hotel on the strip. So everything is in great condition. Check in was easy and receptionist was very nice. Rooms were also very nice, spacious, and again in great condition (can’t be said about all properties on the strip). I also really liked the modern decor in the rooms and all around the hotel. Given the hotel is on the northern end of the strip, foot traffic is a bit lighter which was great and so the hotel didn’t feel as overcrowded as some of the other hotels more central on the strip feel like. Parking was also for free for hotel guests - another plus. Ate at 3 restaurants on the property and 2 out of 3 were quite good. All in all, the Fontainebleau is a great (if not one of the best) modern luxury hotel in a calmer area of the strip. Would definitely come here again!

allReviews.title: Gorgeous hotel with modern decor and technology, great service, everything you need in one spot!
allReviews.text: Absolutely wonderful stay at this beautiful hotel in Las Vegas. Massive property with a huge convention center. There is a large food court with everything from burgers to bagels to lobster rolls. They have everything from fine dining options to quick bites. The rooms were very spacious with modern decor. Huge bathrooms with separate showers and sinking tubs. The curtains and lights are all operated by a touch of a button… love the modern technology. They also have many restaurants, bars and shops. Of course there’s a large casino that serves free drinks while you play, Properly was ornately decorated and kept iextremely clean. There’s a massive gym with all of the most modern equipment and fitness classes are also offered. The pool area is beautiful and there a spa and even an IV bar. They have thought of everything. You don’t even need to leave the property if you don’t want to. Also LIV night club is on site . I highly recommend and would return.

allReviews.title: Can’t wait for the next event/visit!
allReviews.text: My stay at this property was perfectly enjoyable from start to finish. The staff were all very friendly and accommodating. I dined in only one restaurant, but the food was good. The coffee shop had an excellent latte. The meeting rooms and staff were outstanding. My pool experience was fantastic. My room was beautiful. I would highly recommend this property and event center.

allReviews.title: Hidden gem that is not so hard to find!
allReviews.text: We had a wonderful 3 night stay here. It was by far the best Vegas resort we’ve stay at. Every detail at FB exceeded my expectations. The high ceilings and artwork create a unique atmosphere that’s calming and peaceful. I am usually sensitive to smoke in casinos and never had an issue here. Check in was simple and staff was friendly. The security near the elevators are an extra touch and worth mentioning. We stayed in “basic” bleau queen room and can confirm was not least bit basic. The hallways are wide and highlighted with large frame art/lighting. We waited less than a min at the most for an elevator which was impressive considering the amount of floors here. The room was beautifully designed with so many extra touches including crown molding around the ceiling, a mini chiller for personal use, and the most plush/soft bed we’ve ever slept on in Vegas (wouldn’t recommend staying here if you prefer a firm mattress). I really appreciated the lighting options in the room and bathroom. It was so nice having a dim night light underneath the bathroom sink. Most importantly the room was spotless and I’m not saying that just bc the property is brand new but I must mention how clean the bathroom was. Housekeeping does an outstanding job here. Water pressure was 10/10 compare to other properties like cosmo and RW. We really enjoyed the shower and soak tub. The only “cons” here is that there were no coffee makers in room (probably standard in Vegas now) and the walls/connecting walls were a bit thin and could hear the people next door playing music in the mornings. If possible it may be worth requesting a room that is not a joining room to reduce the sound.The gym was fantastic and reminded me of an equinox style fitness center with many different types of machines/specialty equipment like Pilates reformers and TRX. They also offer free workout classes like yoga and Zumba in the mornings.The pool was lovely as it had tons of free umbrellas which is rare in Vegas and makes all the difference in 106 degree heat. The area is spacious and family friendly but with enough space to spread out if you prefer to have quiet adult convos/drinks. Pool is also open til 7 which is awesome. Overall no surprises here. We are already planning another trip back and look forward to checking out the dining options.

allReviews.title: 31st anniversary at the Fontainebleau was nothing short of unforgettable. Luxury, care, and unforgettable moments.
allReviews.text: 31st anniversary at the Fontainebleau was nothing short of unforgettable. Luxury, care, and unforgettable moments.

allReviews.title: Superb experience but not great value
allReviews.text: I stayed at FB, ate at Vida and La Cote, had drinks at the Taverb Bar, and hung out at the pool. It is a great hotel and the food and drink experience is outstanding, although it may not necessarily be a good value. It is definitely something worth splurging for. The drink service at the casino floor was responsive provided you are tipping appropriately. The pool is pretty chill and does not have loud music, with a good balance of adults and children, and not too crowded.

allReviews.title: Nice Resort
allReviews.text: Overall a good resort with good selection of venues.However, not a good experience at their main bar...Bleau.  Rude bar help. Bartenders who were very friendly and super nice.

allReviews.title: Ridiculous overcharge
allReviews.text: The hotel is ok really, not more than that. I booked 2 rooms for Memorial day weekend. When I check out - I always check the bills. I noticed there is an overcharge for $97.54 for minibar which we didn't use. The receptionist spoke to housekeeping, confirmed the whole minibar is there, and removed the charge. Imagine how I felt when this $97.54 was placed back on my credit card in June?! I called the hotel and explain that I have never used minibar and this is why I was credited this amount at the check out. However, the billing department wouldn't remove this amount from my card. Seriously, I spent $$$$$ at this hotel on 2 rooms, restaurants and casinos, do you imagine I would've fought $97.54?? This amount is not even worth a phone calls. It just I hate to be overcharged. After a few phone calls, you know what Fontaineblue - enjoy my $97.54, whoever had the drinks, which was not me.I will sure never stay there again. I know they don't care, since they will have enough other customers. Just advice - double check your bill and maybe shred your credit card after leaving.

allReviews.title: Good but pricey
allReviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, well-kept and the staff is very friendly but everything there is wildly overpriced compared to other hotels in the area

allReviews.title: Great Hotel in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Wonderful hotel..elegant with lots of great amenities.l, attentive staff, lots of dining options.  Overall one of the best Las Vegas has to offer and we have stayed at alot of them.

allReviews.title: New fav hotel on the strip!
allReviews.text: Really is the best hotel on the strip - don't underestimate the luxury of being away from the strip. The newness is wonderful and all the restaurants are fresh and innovative. The pool area is so lovely 3 pools loads of seating, good vibes and pool side blackjack for those that do. Shops are ok some cute kids bits - was missing teenage appeal . We will stay again.

allReviews.title: Will go back for sure!
allReviews.text: It’s our second time staying at this hotel! Very nice hotel, great amenities and excellent customer service! The resort fees included the parking!

allReviews.title: Close to a 5 star hotel, but not there yet, a few more teaks and it'll be amazing!!
allReviews.text: Nice new resort on the North end of the Strip. Arrive July 26 for 3 nights. Hotel was FULL up on opening night, so no upgrade available, so even with high floor (61) the view was rather poor, the back empty lot and the Sahara, disappointing, but understandable with full occupancy. Valet was tough on that day as being so full, they handled it well, but it was still a bit hectic. Check in, quite good, no issues. Arrival in room, very nice, spacious, modern, very clean and well appointed, bathroom excellent. Issues with phone, not operational, and with my having cell phone issues, this became a problem. Had to contact several people and was the next day before issues resolved, disappointing for a so-called 5 star hotel. Also porterage, badly done, they could not deliver bags for several hours so I had to go back down and collect myself. Not a huge issue, and everyone was very pleasant, but again, this can't happen, no matter how busy at a 5 star resort. Stay in general, once bags retrieved and phone issue resolved, was all terrific. Won at their casino, a nice perk, drinks at Collins, very nice, bartender terrific. Even got bought a drink by a perfect stranger, very nice gesture. Never got to say "thank you" to whoever it was, but I thank them now as being amazing people and most generous. Days later ate at Papi Steak, very pleased. (see additional review). Did not get a chance to use their pool area but it is AMAZING, probably one of the best in Vegas. Elevated above the street level, it has an amazing selection of diff pool area, jacuzzi's, cabanas, even bars, dining and gambling outside. It's quite spectacular. I wish I had more time to spend a few hours and just relax but this vacation was jammed packed. But if you're a pool person, this should get a HIGH consideration. Checked out 3 days later, all fine on check out, quick, valet good. Generally this gets a lot of bad reviews, and I am not sure why. Yup, maybe it's located, across from the dive Circus, Circus is a turn off, I agree, but don't blame the hotel for that. Once that North ends redevelops, and I hope it happens soon, and once they work out the few kinks I experienced, this is going to be a MAJOR resort, and a top place to stay. I'd def recommend it, and would have zero issues coming back for a return visit. One other thing, sign up for the players club, used the card for gambling obviously, but at the same time, for any drinks, meals etc, as here it allows you to build points, that's sweet. I wish I'd had more time to same other food options as well as other lounges, but again, that may come in 2026. For right now, very happy with the stay and def a recommendation for someone looking for a modern and very clean and well decorated resort. It's very nice.

allReviews.title: The best hotel in vegas!
allReviews.text: Amazing staff, beautiful rooms and the view! Lovely! 💜💕 i would stay here all the time whenever I am in Vegas. I love the combination of colors of the whole interior esp the furnitures in the room! The staff are very helpful and always cheerful which I did not get in any other hotels I stayed at this month.

allReviews.title: Nice Getaway
allReviews.text: It was a fabulous experience! The decor spectacular. When walking inside you feel as though you have entered another world.

allReviews.title: Hard to Believe.....but true
allReviews.text: There was no food available in the hotel past 10 p.m. (on a Thursday night) other than disgusting room service at  obvious inflated prices.  The room service took 50 minute plus so plan accordingly if you are hungry!  The casino floor is reminiscent of a zombie apocalypse movie!  Zero energy and few humans to be seen anywhere other than dealers sitting around doing nothing.  The slot machine and video poker return was the worst I've experienced in 40 plus years.  The resort is a complete NA (never again).

allReviews.title: Happy & Fun trip!
allReviews.text: Casino setup, Luxurious Swimming Pool, Excellent Bars & Restaurants, Fantastic Shows, Excellent selection of shopping stores, Clean & specious Guest Rooms with the best & friendly staffs!The two ladies who helped us at the check-in desk, Melissa & Kenda were very supportive & kind! They're a great asset to your company!

allReviews.title: Best getaway secret in Las Vegas.
allReviews.text: Gorgeous property, exceptional, hospitality, and service. Tremendous variety of gaming,  Pool experience is second to none.

allReviews.title: Fountaineblueau: A Jewel in Vegas
allReviews.text: My first stay at Fountainebleau was for a slot tournament and it was a fantastic stay. The rooms are clean, veru modern--you can control  the lights and curtains at a push of a button. The towels , bedding and mattress were very good quality and the "blue" coloring in the room was pleasing. The staff was attentive and professional the whole time from the check in, cashiers, wait staff, and maintenance. A special acknowledgement to the cleaning staff, very clean rooms. There are many restaurants I ate at Papi's Steak House and Don's Prime, both were quality establishments if you like steaks.

allReviews.title: Best hotel for gorgeous rooms and decor
allReviews.text: Excellent hotel! Stunning decor, lovely place to visit with gorgeous rooms! Clean, beautiful and the most comfortable stay! Thank you!

allReviews.title: Top notch!
allReviews.text: Beautiful, extravagant property. The rooms were clean, spacious, high tech and the bedding was perfect. I love the pillows!

allReviews.title: Great Times at the Fountainbleu
allReviews.text: Great room and a great view.  All very clean and fresh.  Staff was outstanding in every area.  Highly recommend. The Vida cafe food service was outstanding and tasty.  My only negative was a late night room service order of a club sandwich that was over $ 45

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau Las Vegas: A Great Place to enjoy some luxury
allReviews.text: If you're a business traveler headed to Las Vegas, the Fontainebleau is definitely worth checking out. It's a comfortable and fancy place to stay, perfect after a long day of meetings.Checking in is very easy, which is convenient after traveling. The suites are impressive, with comfortable beds and ample space for work or relaxation. The bathrooms feature large showers and tubs. They also provide nice toiletries (Italian), soft robes, and slippers (even though I didn't use them).The conference spaces are well-designed and make for easy use. The Royal Ballroom is particularly large and they also have a large theater. The resort's proximity to the Convention Center makes it easy to attend events, This is on the north end of the strip so there isn't nearly the foot traffic like the center of the strip which limits the type of people that go along with that such as the street performers, etc...The hotel has a sophisticated atmosphere, the central bar is a great hub for meet-ups.The Fontainebleau Las Vegas is a great choice for business travelers or leisure travelers. The fabulous suites, conference areas, and location allow for a blend of work and luxury. I loved it and will definitely return!

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau Vegas Noble Suite
allReviews.text: We are local Vegas people. My SO took me to the Fontainebleau  for my birthday as we have not stayed in that hotel yet  Beautiful and they up graded our room as it was middle of the week to the Noble Suite room Love the view of the Sphere !  Room had two full bathrooms  separate bedroom, kitchen area with sink and they brought in a mini fridge part of room package  Hotel was quiet during mid week but we enjoyed walking around and playing there. Staff were great and very helpful

allReviews.title: Check your bill at checkout
allReviews.text: I went with my 15-year-old son. The amenities were good.At checkout there were charges that were supposed to be waived due to the special rate such as valet and foodFurthermore, housekeeping walked into the room started cleaning while we were still in there. I had to step out with my hair, wet and in PJS to wait for her to complete the task. The hotel is clean overall the service was good. We enjoyed our stay but check your bill at check out.

allReviews.title: The best of the best
allReviews.text: This resort is amazing.The room was perfect.The casino has a great selection of slots.The spa is incredible.Many thanks to my host.Kim H.This  is by far the best in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Happy place
allReviews.text: The room perfect.  Large soaking tub, separate shower, terrific blow dryer. Plush robes, superb bed and linens.  Touch lighting and excellent air conditioner.  Great restaurants and swimming pools.  By far the best hotel in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Awesome surprise get-away!
allReviews.text: The room was incredibly clean and super well done. Bed was amazing! Spa was out of this world. Michael worked to make our pool days incredible! Great experience!

allReviews.title: Great place to stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: Great place to stay. Very clean. Lots of options to eat within. Easy access to rideshare and staff were great. The casino was extremely nice and lots of options to play different things.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: My wife and I stayed here from 23rd June to 3rd of July 25. We absolutely loved it the whole experience. Breakfasts to your room are a little pricey but good quality. The casino is great and the restaurant's are lovely especially Mother Wolf. If we could have we'd have stayed another week. I would absolutely love to go back there one day. Wonderful hotel x

Highly recommend.  Property is clean and new.  Rooms are fresh and crisp.  Service and employees are courteous.  Parking is safe.  Elevators are state of the art.  Only have to spend $2.5 for a tier credit.

allReviews.title: Great stay!
allReviews.text: My wife and I recently stayed here and loved it.  Place is so big and clean we found ourselves wanting to just go back here for everything versus going to explore.The other casinos we walked thru on the strip felt like they were dark dreary and stunk.Pool area was great, restaurants were excellent and the gym was great too.  I’ll definitely be going back next time I’m in Vegas

allReviews.title: Looks but not the service
allReviews.text: The Fontainebleau is a beautiful hotel, everything is new, the casino has super high ceilings, and the pools are great. Where it lacks is service. I've stayed at Fontainebleau twice now and both times there were service issues. This time around it was my check in which took about 30 minutes from the moment I was face to face with a rep. There was no line. My room was not ready despite having a reservation and checking in at almost midnight. I was given a room all the way at the end of the hall which was a terribly long walk. Got to my room and the bathroom was not well cleaned, it was covered in hairs, either from staff or the previous guest. The first morning at breakfast at Vida I was told to step aside and wait for a table as they proceeded to seat couple after couple after me with no reservations. Once I asked to speak to the manager I was told they can only seat a solo at a 2 person table so the 20 or so open tables in the restaurant were not an option but every single couple that walked up after me could sit wherever there was an opening. This after terrible service at this same restaurant my last stay. (They have limited breakfast options) Overall, its a nice looking place. Food is good, the casino is fun and not crowded. They just really really need to work on their service. Almost every other casino I've stayed at on the strip has friendlier staff.

allReviews.title: My fav spot
allReviews.text: Hotel is stunning, so many restaurants and stores! Great gaming options. Beds are super comfy pool is amazing. Food and cocktails at the pool were yummy!

allReviews.title: booking unbelievably difficult and website poor
allReviews.text: don't use direct booking through player's club at this hotel. Clueless re customer support--tried to send me to reservations after asking a basic question after web use on site wouldn't respond. Would not try to game here if this is their basic response to basic questions

allReviews.title: Nice experience! Location was the only negative
allReviews.text: Very modern, nice pool and rooms, staff was very friendly and helpful, gambling here was fun, the dealers and dice men were great, food hall was great, restaurants were nice but we only tried Don's Prime, It was a nice steakhouse but nothing special, the only downside to this property was it's location, had to take a cab anywhere, when the strip reaches this property it will be one of the best on the strip

allReviews.title: Awesome Stay, the perfect hotel out of the busy strip
allReviews.text: I had the pleasure of staying at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas from July 4–6, and wow — what an unforgettable experience! From the moment I walked into the lobby, the luxury and energy of the space blew me away. Everything screams modern glam meets classic Vegas.🎯 ROOMS:The room was beyond amazing — ultra-spacious, with floor-to-ceiling windows that gave me a stunning view of the Strip. The design was sleek yet cozy, with a bed that felt like sleeping on a cloud. The tech amenities made everything effortless — from lighting to shades and even the espacious tube was amazing.🕐 CHECK-OUT:Check-out was smooth and easy, with flexible options. The staff was super accommodating — you could tell they’re trained to deliver that signature Fontainebleau service.💎 AMENITIES:This place has it all — incredible pools with the perfect Vegas vibe, a world-class spa, and a gym that honestly rivals any top fitness club. Whether you’re looking to relax or party, Fontainebleau hits every note.🍴 FOOD EXPERIENCES THAT BLEW MY MIND:	•	Bleau Blanc Rouge — The French restaurant is a must. Iconic hotcakes like you’ve never had before, crispy on the outside and fluffy inside — divine. The brunch here is something I’ll be dreaming forever	•	Miami Slice — If you’re craving something casual but ridiculously good, this is it. The NY-style pizza with a Miami twist is addictive — especially late night. You need to taste it is really good	🎆 OVERALL:Fontainebleau made this 4th of July weekend one to remember. It’s stylish without being pretentious, luxurious without losing that fun Vegas spark. Whether you’re here to celebrate, unwind, or indulge, this place delivers.

allReviews.title: Amazing pool in Vegas
allReviews.text: The pool is one of the best in Vegas. There are lots of chairs and umbrellas available all day long. The bar at the pool was also really nice. Plus there are even lounge chairs in the pool!Our room was available right on time and everything in the hotel is extremely clean.

allReviews.title: Best hotel room in Vegas
allReviews.text: We have stayed at several places in Vegas... I think this is possibly the nicest. It is every bit as good as Caesar's or Bellagio. I also liked the Rio's remodel rooms - stayed there in Feb, 2025. Back to FBleau - The view from the room was awesome. Its not a great view of the strip becuase that road curves. You do have a great view of the Sphere. The elevators were fast which was impressive because we were on 67th floor. The bathroom/shower were really nice. Nice robes. Cool auto blinds. It had the annoying snacks and fridge with drinks that auto bill if you touch them... but it also had an empty fridge door where you could put stuff if you wanted. I thought this was cool because sometimes its nice to buy drinks and have them in a fridge. We had other stuff planned, so we didn't spend much time at the casino, but the little bit we did, we liked. We didn't eat any of the places in the hotel, so i don't have any comment on those. All in all, it was beautiful and i'd go back. Wife thinks its the best hotel in Vegas and she's much pickier than me!

allReviews.title: Great Accommodations and Experience
allReviews.text: This was a great experience from the time we checked in until departure. The staff was very friendly and welcoming. Always greeted us with a smile and the willingness to help us. I have stayed at many of the Las Vegas hotel. This was the best stay I have had hands down.

allReviews.title: We loved it.
allReviews.text: Beautiful place very modern and luxurious.  Great specious rooms and well decorated. Incredible window view. Great service. Fancy restaurants. Luxurious stores.

allReviews.title: Great atmosphere and food
allReviews.text: Great atmosphere. Quieter than other parts of the strip which my wife and I appreciated. Quick taxi to center strip. Amazing food and drinks. Good casino. Would definitely recommend and would absolutely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Hote
allReviews.text: Hotel is beautiful and rooms outstanding.I did not think food quality was the best for the price.Valet parking is 40.00 - a little excessve53.00 per night resort fee for any hotel will be the demise of Las Vegas

Attended for company conference which was held at same time as the NBA Summer League, so it was pretty busy. From the check-in to departure, the service was excellent. Lobby check-in agent took time to find me a room that I would like, and reviewed the location and floor. No issues with the room, very nice amenities, and very comfortable! Housekeeping cleaned just once as I don't want daily service. Excellent, clean and freshened room.  In - room dining team were professional and quick. Food was very good, and recommend the Crab and Corn bisque! Conference center was fantastic and the teams were very helpful. Overall, very happy with the location, and pool area looked fantastic though didn't have time for a dip.

allReviews.title: Luxury is Back!
allReviews.text: Beautiful ,classy well staffed. Every detail was carefully thought through. The Adult only pool area is a treasure. Excellent poolside bar service . Carefully curated beverages at the  bars, subtle security throughout. My only disdain was smoking areas in Casino if I was walking through to get coffee  or lunch.

allReviews.title: FontaineBleau and Sphere
allReviews.text: Certain rooms have the view of Sphere. On our way there, we saw the Sphere from the hotel's direction, so we asked the reception if there were any rooms facing the Sphere. She said yes and found a room facing the Sphere for us. It was such a plus for our stay.

allReviews.title: Clean but over sized, and careful on bills
allReviews.text: Check the bills as they overcharge fridge items, there were not breakfast and suitable dinning in the hotel area after 11 pm. Breakfast and pool closed at 7. Distance to elevator and lobby was a lot. Hotel was clean and brand new

allReviews.title: Stressful
allReviews.text: The persistent efforts by the security team to root out any potential loitering done by my son and his teammates (14 years old) was excessive. I can appreciate how serious gambling rules are about having minors on the casino floor, but even when they were on a different floor their goons went out of their way to make life miserable for the boys and me. Threatening to kick us out of the hotel (on the first night) and escorting the boys to their rooms and demanding to see my ID before releasing my son was beyond ridiculous. I’m the future the hotel should either make it clear that families are not welcome or at a minimum there should be a written policy about unattended minors and where they are allowed that should be provided when making a reservation and reiterated at check-in. I just can’t believe how stressful they made our 3 night vacation…Will definitely re-think where we go the next time we come to Vegas!

allReviews.title: Great hotel and experience
allReviews.text: The rooms are beautiful, clean, and have a high-end vibe without feeling over the top and a large bath tub you can sink into. We enjoyed the mini bar and variety of the room snacks.  Definitely one of the nicer spots I’ve stayed on the Strip.The restaurants didn’t disappoint either. Komodo and Papi Steak were both worth it, and even the food hall had solid options for a quick bite. The pool scene and LIV nightclub? Packed and full of energy — definitely Miami-style fun if that’s your thing.

allReviews.title: Quiet, laid-back, and pristine.
allReviews.text: I never stay this far north on the Strip; I'm often in the middle of the action, but staying in a newer resort was appealing and TripAdvisor offered me a Royal Suite at a deal I couldn't pass up.  I'm seeing lots of "Vegas is dead..." comments on social media.  No it isn't.  We were there for a Monday and Tuesday night; center Strip is a zoo.  Fontainebleau was quiet, though far from empty.  The pool was busy during all hours of the day.  The casino had plenty of players at all hours.  However, I love the atmosphere here.  I'm not in my 20s anymore and appreciate a resort that feels posh and relaxed.  Staff is at every entrance to keep trouble-makers at bay.  Elevator banks had additional staff to ensure you were supposed to be there.No parking fees made staying here an even easier decision and the garage made it very easy to navigate the property.  Very easy to get in and out of the resort, and being so far north on the Strip ensured traffic was never an issue.Get the room upgrade if you're able.  Our Royal Suite came with two full baths, my wife was very fond of the makeup counter in the master.  Two walk-in showers and a large soaking tub makes the room feel even more luxurious.  The water pressure was glorious.  Touch controls in bathrooms and next to the bed was also a very nice touch.  Our only dining experience here was breakfast at La Fontaine, which was very good.  We were seated immediately, though service was slow.  I will be coming back.  I do hope my next stay is as pleasant as the first.

allReviews.title: Not a 5 Star Hotel
allReviews.text: We were pretty excited walking in the door of the Fontainebleau hotel and just as disappointed walking out the door 2 days later.As other reviewers have noted, there are a lack of basic “amenities” offered.Should not have to walk 3 blocks to Walgreens because the hotel provides not even one freaking bottle of water in the room…..(unless you want to buy the big overpriced Fiji water via the room)Waited for turndown service that never came…..because there is none.Tried to go to the gym after dinner….closed at 7pm…..{Wow!}Went to Vida for breakfast for 2 mornings, first day excellent, second day eggs and turkey bacon came out ice cold.  Although she replaced it, Waitress completely disinterested and made excuse for kitchen saying “they’re very busy today.”Should also mention booked through my American Express Platinum FHR.Hotel provides only $60 for breakfast which is totally not enough.FYI, hotel sets the dollar amount allocated so they are knowingly being stingy!Mentioned all of the above on the way out, (after waiting 15+ minutes to check out because they only had 3 agents working at the desk!) and the girl said she was sorry….. that’s it.Other than being new and shiny, there is nothing that makes this hotel fancy or upscale.Go elsewhere…..we will next trip.

allReviews.title: Boring and no customers.
allReviews.text: This has to be the most boring resort on the planet. The casino was like a ghost town. One minute they offer rates with no resort fees the next minute they want to charge resort fees. Why email people offer rates with no resort fees then you try to book they want the resort fees. I decided to try the hotel for one night. It was a big mistake as even though the rooms were nice I couldn’t get over how they offer rates with no resort fees then they charge resort fees. The location is also miles away from most of the action on the Vegas Strip. If this resort wants to stay in business it needs to work out how to attract people to stay because at the moment the place is empty.

allReviews.title: Everything is top notch.
allReviews.text: It’s a great property. The rooms are obviously new and clean and they have great touches like automatic drapes and a bar set and refrigerated drawer. The hotel goes above and beyond to make guests comfortable. The pool is wonderful- even the handrails are stylish. And there’s ample shade from the desert sun provided by umbrellas at nearly every lounger. Unlike many Vegas resorts, there is no fee for them. There’s a great selection of restaurants- they’re a little pricey but not outside the normal range of other strip hotels. The location is perfect for conventions, but it is a long distance from center strip. Walking is not really an option, if not for the distance for the time one would have to account for.

allReviews.title: Strike 3
allReviews.text: Currently on the 3rd day of a 4 night stay at the Fontainbleau and will not be returning.•Started off on the wrong foot upon checking in.  Booked thru AMEX FHR.Agent who checked us in, (younger girl with braces but forgot her name) insisted that we weren't entitled to breakfast on the last day because "it wasn't considered a full day."  Told her I've booked with AMEX FHR about 75-80 times over the years including 2 previous times at this hotel but she continued to beligerantly insist she was correct.  Asked her to have a Mgr call me or my room to conform.  No call.  Had to resolve it myself and obviously she was completely misinformed.• Speaking of AMEX FHR, the hotel only allocates $60 for breakfast, which is the bare minimum required by AMEX.  Unfortunately, the amount  allocated by the hotel is completely insufficient for the free breakfast perk from AMEX  Does not adequately cover breakfast at Vida, In addition, the so-called breakfast menu at Vida is breakfast AND lunch; even at 8am!...But hey, it'll at least cover a bagel and coffee.  (Sarcasm)•NO water at all provided in the room. (Was 108° here yesterday •Fitness Center closes at 7pm, unheard of and inexcusable at a casino hotel.• Surprisingly, no turn-down service.• No cushions on chaises at pool,nor an attendant that sets you up.•Surprisingly, (again!),  nowhere to eat after 10pm(Only Chez Bon Bon is 24 hours; great if you want dessert or a bagel but not good if you want real food after 10 o'clock)This is the 3td trip here and will be the last.  As someone who spends 70+ nights in a hotel annually and all for leisure, sometimes 2 or 3 little issues is as unpleasant as 1 big issue.While the Fontainbleau is new and glitzy, you're getting the same service and extras you'd find in a plain old 3-star Marriott. Zero chance the family will be returning.....way too many other options in Vegas

allReviews.title: From Vegas with Love ❤️
allReviews.text: Magnificent from start to finish just go no regrets 5***** across the board location unique absolutely service and amenities fabulous loved it

allReviews.title: Treat Yourself. Book it here.
allReviews.text: We stayed at the noble one bedroom suite. If you are big on immaculate rooms, amazing, attentive staff, and awesome pools, this is it. This is an absolutely stunning top tier hotel. What an experience.

allReviews.title: It's a very excellent hotel and casino...
allReviews.text: They have a very nice bed and pillows, very excellent room service,a very nice bathroom, nice bath tub and a beautiful shower...

allReviews.title: Dirty-no customer service
allReviews.text: Check-in took over 20 minutes, which was frustrating after a long day of travel. To be fair, the gentleman at the counter was very polite and professional. However, once we got to our room, things quickly went downhill.We found what appeared to be multiple pubic hairs — in the shower, near the toilet, on the carpet, and even one on the bed. To make matters worse, there seemed to be a dried booger on the door. Completely unacceptable for any hotel, let alone one claiming to be five-star. I immediately called to speak with a manager. He said he would find us another room, but that took another 20 minutes.Eventually, we were handed a key to a new room, but at no point did anyone offer an apology or acknowledge how unpleasant this experience was. I expected much more in terms of cleanliness, efficiency, and basic hospitality.

allReviews.title: Luxury Experience
allReviews.text: This is my third time staying at this hotel and it never disappoints. The staff and service are so friendly and helpful. I have also noticed that compared to other hotels, the smoke smell is practically non existent (my allergies don't flare up at all) and all the machines are clean. All the dining experiences are top notch. Room is always clean.

allReviews.title: Wonderful experience with lots of fun.
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel with the best service I have ever encountered. The casino was beautiful and I enjoyed the dealer at the roulette table named Courtney.  I will be back.

allReviews.title: Great place to relax
allReviews.text: Great place to go to relax and play slots. Very clean and welcoming. The atmosphere is great and it's my favorite place to stay when I go to Vegas.

allReviews.title: I shall return
allReviews.text: EXCELLENT. I have travelled all over the world and have stayed in some OK places. But the experience at Fontainebleau is second to none. we had our doors opened for us. 1st impression. Atmosphere and reception of staff was exceptionally pleasant. Had it not been my birthday, I could have stayed in the room all weekend. Modern and comfortable. Fontainebleau went all out on the decor.

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel with all the amenties!
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel that smelled of roses from the moment you walk in! Spacious rooms, large tub, beds are comfy and all this with stunning views! The fitness center is superb with eceptional customer service. Do not hesitate to book this incredible hotel!

allReviews.title: Pool Life
allReviews.text: Fantastic experience, we definitely plan to go back! The hotel was gorgeous! We spent the day at the pool and absolutely loved our pool day!

allReviews.title: The best stay ever.
allReviews.text: The beds are very comfortable and clean. The restaurant food was superb and the services that was provided during our stay was very good.

allReviews.title: Stay at Aria or Cosmo instead. Overpriced on everything and just not worth it.
allReviews.text: I came in with very high hopes the property looked beautiful from the photos online. When we arrived at the hotel check-in went smooth and I tipped the receptionist $100. In the 40 years of coming to Las Vegas as an adult and tipping a receptionist this was a new standard. She handed each of us a mini bottle of water. We made our way up to the room 3533 it has a nice view of the strip. For a suite and what it cost I really wish we had booked the Aria instead we both agreed. We wanted something to eat so made our way to the “Promenade” signs said scan this QR code to order…well that didn’t work and the line to get a sandwich was 12 people deep. Ok…let’s just get something out by the pool, we were directed to LaCote. It looked nice enough we sat and ordered two sandwiches. As we were waiting it became obvious there were cleanliness issues. Food debris on the floor under tables, food debris on the bench seating next to me and on multiple other ones. The place only had a handful of diners yet the adjacent table remained uncleaned until halfway through our meal. Food came  yes they didn’t get one of the side orders correctly but alas this happens. We signed for our food It was $80 for two sandwiches and drinks, and returned to the room and locked the door to take a nap. 20 minutes later a knock on the door from “mini bar”. We let in the attendant who proceeded to refill the mini bar that had apparently been used by the previous guests. One would think that would have been done before new guests arrived. The hotel really does screw you on food prices. A morning coffee, latte and two pastries was $44 with tip (the were great pastries and we joked they must have been made offsite). Dinner at "the tavern" which is the sports book was $150. The property is pretty, The bellman out front were great. I'm in a wheelchair and they were always super helpful in and out of taxi's. For what the hotel costs vs what you get stay someplace else. They are billed as a high end resort and they are not. There is no contact email anyplace for customer service. I think that says a lot. They want your money and that's it. To many nice hotels in vegas to waste your money at this place.

allReviews.title: A little disappointed
allReviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, rooms are comfortable. I was able to check in earlier that was nice; saying that,  The front desk needs help in Costumer service, they are not too friendly or helpful. When i arrived to my room it was dirty, red sticky substance on the counter that spilled into the dresser , for the amount per night and the resorts fees, this hotel room needs to be spotless. The toiletries were empty when we arrived , it wasn't replaced.  Beautiful building, I'm not sure if I would go back again

allReviews.title: Great Hotel!!
allReviews.text: Best hotel we've stayed in. Our new place. Amazing service, feel safe, great staff, easy to check in and some of the best restaurants in the area. Great vibe too. Not crazy.

allReviews.title: Great destination for a wonderful stay and things to do.
allReviews.text: Great destination for a stay with very comfortable rooms and peaceful atmosphere. This place is huge and has many options for all tastes.

allReviews.title: Excellent Addition to the  Las Vegas Strip
allReviews.text: My wife & I stayed at Fontainebleau Las Vegas from June 29 to July 1, 2025. We stayed in room 58-811, which is classified as a Bleau King Mountain Best view room. Overall, since this hotel is quite new, everything in the room was in excellent condition. The room decor was modern & clean with minimalist touches. All the light and curtain controls are capacitive touch buttons that work quite well. The bed was very comfy and the water pressure of the shower was quite strong. The room size was also larger than we expected. The best comparison to the room size and quality is the Conrad at Resorts World (which is also quite nice). The best amenity that we experienced at this resort was its gym. It was absolutely gigantic, but also state-of-the-art. Everything was there for our workouts. It’s a must visit if you’re staying at this resort!Based on such a positive experience we had, we will definitely be back next time we visit Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Wonderful and amazing experience!
allReviews.text: Everything was excellent. We arrived in Las Vegas on a late flight and found that only the property's bars were open. A 24-hour restaurant would be a valuable amenity. We decided to dine off property instead. In every other respect, our experience was amazing.

allReviews.title: Elegant Relaxation
allReviews.text: Best place to stay on the strip! Fountainbleau truly has it all. Elegant and comfortable rooms, spacious pool with plenty of shade, fun games, delicious eats. I could spend my whole stay in Las Vegas at the Fountainebleau and be absolutely satisfied.

allReviews.title: Good experience within FB but limited option to venture out during hot summer
allReviews.text: Good facility, friendly staff, a little far away from casinos visit. the strip which made the walk too tired so I'll miss other

allReviews.title: Holiday July 2025
allReviews.text: We have previously stayed at Wynn annd Encore  and I thought that they were the best in Vegas. Not anymore Fontainebleau has exceeded our expectations and we cannot wait to return. The rooms are too die for, pool’s excellent and the restaurants are amazing. Could not fault it at all !!

allReviews.title: FountainBleu Vegas beats all expectations
allReviews.text: Room was super nice and spotless. Mother Wolff had some of the best pasta’s I have ever eaten outside of Italy. And Chez Bon Bon is great for coffee/pastries/gelato

allReviews.title: My Place to Stay!
allReviews.text: The hotel is beautiful! The attention paid to detail is extraordinary. The service was above and beyond! Everyone is very friendly and helpful. I love staying here!

allReviews.title: Chic hotel
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel! Every square inch is spotless and tastefully decorated. It's a very minimalistic, chic vibe. Fabulous restaurants and shopping. Rooms are beautiful, especially love the bathrobe

allReviews.title: Beware of Flying Pool Umbrellas!
allReviews.text: We stayed over 4th of July weekend. The hotel pools (6) are fabulous and a reason to stay there. The management of the hotel is absolutely horrible. My nephew was hit by a flying pool umbrella during a wind gust and was injured in the chest (as were two other guests).  We were checked by paramedics at the pool. The pool security and management  would only take our name and room number. They would not fill out a report. My nephew’s bruised and scratched chest grew bigger as the stay went on. I tried to get an accident report but the desk told us we could write what happened and they would print that and nothing else. Two times I went back and spoke with the front desk. At checkout  I mentioned it again and they comped two of the three $50 resort fees. However, when I arrived home, the charges were put back on. When I asked why, they said that it is their policy that we had to sign a release preventing us from taking further action for the $100.   What a horrible management/customer service team. This is a huge Vegas hotel, not some mom and pop place. It was their umbrella that hit us. They failed to secure their equipment properly.  I have stayed at multiple hotels on the strip. The customer service was incredible at every other hotel. As far as the hotel itself, the room  was beautiful.  The bathroom is gorgeous but the floors had hair on them and the toilet had water stains. We had a view of the parking lot, so we could see fireworks from downtown but not from the strip. The food throughout the hotel whether at a bar, restaurant, pool or food court was delicious. Expect to pay $25 for a frozen margarita, $15 for a soda without refills, $12 for a beer. A big drawback is the location on the strip. There is a bus stop across the street for $8/24hrs. Otherwise, a taxi or Uber will cost you $30-$50 during prime time to get where you are going. We paid $90 round trip for dinner one night, $30 each way to/from the airport in a taxi, $86 for a trip home from the stadium after a concert. There is a convenience store across the street, a Walgreens .4 miles from the hotel. There are a lot of unhoused people heading towards Walgreens and downtown.

allReviews.title: Great time at FB
allReviews.text: We loved our stay. The rooms were amazing and the bedding was heavenly. We slept really well. We loved eating at Vida and Komodo.

allReviews.title: Wait, Vegas Is This Classy??
allReviews.text: You will not find a resort in Vegas where you can have the Vegas experience, but feel like you are in a high end resort near an ocean destination. EVERY single employee loves their job, everything everywhere is spotless clean! Just like living in a dream. You MUST try it. WE have stayed there 5 times so far. Totally in on this place!!!!!

allReviews.title: Wonder Experience
allReviews.text: Great experience at a first rate hotel and Casio .  Rooms were exceptional and reasonably priced.  Staff was friendly and attentive

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau is definitely worth a stay in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: We returned to the Fontainebleau because of our previous positive experience there. Although we knew it was kind of far north, it seemed further away from the action this time. We returned because of the value, as well as being able to rent a car there without having any airport hassle. I tried three great restaurants, The Tavern, for deli type foods, Washing Potato for excellent Asian, and finally Mother Wolf for the bread! Overall, a great place to stay/play -just a quick 10 minute walk to the Wynn!

allReviews.title: Roses Fontainebleau
allReviews.text: For this July 4th long weekend in Las Vegas, we kicked things off with a stay at the Fontainebleau—and wow, what a structure. It’s massive, sleek, and hard to miss. I heard it’s one of the newest hotels on the Strip, and it definitely felt that way.The lobby made quite the impression—with a striking display of fresh roses that added a touch of opulence to the already glamorous space. Our room was lovely, with a stunning view of the city lights at night.✨You can tell it’s new by the small details—modern finishes, updated layouts—but also some curious things, like the quietness of the hotel and the not-so-obvious presence of cameras. It made me pause and wonder. Oh, and true to Vegas style, the lobby connects straight into the casino floor.It was a short but sweet stay at the Fontainebleau—and a unique start to our Vegas weekend. 💫🎲#FontainebleauLasVegas #VegasVibes #July4Weekend #VegasStrip #NewHotelFeel #CityLightsView #VegasLuxury #TravelWithMira #MiRasMoments #VegasGetaway #ModernLuxury #ShortStaySweetMemories #DesertLights #Vegas2025

allReviews.title: First time there had a great time.
allReviews.text: It was pretty cool. Checking in wasn’t bad at all I pretty much got serviced immediately. The guy at the front counter was also pretty chill. Told him it was my first time here and gave me a late checkout to really enjoy my time there. When I entered my room everything was pretty neat. Blinds opened by themselves when you first walk in. All controls are on the wall. Many outlets and a big tv. The main area where the casino and stores and restaurants are located. Was massive and a lot of fancy stores like Graff, Cartier, and etc. many cool restaurants. The pools don’t have anything that cool like mandalay but it’s still really good. I was there during July 4-6 since I was there for The Weeknd concert.

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau should not be overlooked!
allReviews.text: Wonderful property with terrific amenities, staff and food options. Yes, it's for North on the strip and this turns some people off but I have been going to Vegas multiple times for many years and I am not a "strip Walker". From FB I can easily catch a ride-share and go anywhere easily. Location is not an issue for me. As I said, the food options are terrific. The staff is friendly and helpful. Property is clean and fresh looking. Pool is great. Yes, it's not inexpensive but it is worth it IMO.

allReviews.title: Luxury addition to Vegas!
allReviews.text: Amazing luxurious hotel, good location  where you can easily access the strip and Freemont street. So many options available at the hotel that you don’t really need to leave!! The rooms are spacious and tastefully decorated with good views, and staff are very helpful and friendly. The hotel also offers a good rewards programme. I will definitely return again in future!

allReviews.title: security and lack of trained personnel and poor maintenance on casino equipment
allReviews.text: very bad security that let dangerous people into the floors who also urinated against doors and carpets in our hallway on the 53rd floor. Be careful when visiting

allReviews.title: $4,685 Stay, But Charged Extra for a Kettle  Not Worth It
allReviews.text: We booked a 9-night stay in one of the hotel’s premium suites and spent nearly $4,685.43 expecting a high-end, comfortable experience. Instead, we were shocked by the lack of basic hospitality and the way the hotel tries to squeeze money out of guests.We were asked to pay $22 just to rent a simple water kettle, and the same went for a coffee machine both of which are standard, complimentary items in even the most basic hotels. Charging for these during a long 9-night stay felt absurd, especially for the price we’re already paying.This isn’t about the money  it’s about how it made us feel. When you pay this much, you expect generosity, not petty charges and poor guest care.If you’re looking for true luxury or thoughtful service, I’d strongly reconsider booking here. Our experience was disappointing and frustrating, and we won’t be coming back.

allReviews.title: Great concert venue
allReviews.text: I visited here for the Jennifer Hudson Christmas concert and it was a great choice for the concert. Once inside, the venue wasn’t too crowded and it was accessible. The only thing is the walk from the entrance of the hotel to the concert area, it was longer than expected.

allReviews.title: Short stay in Las Vegas after Utah Park trip
allReviews.text: The Hotel is outstanding . It's has a laid back upscale vibe not found in other hotels . Not crowded due to the large amount of space. Great food at all restaurants we tried. Fantastic pool area. A bit removed from the main strip and shopping ,but I think that is a plus. Rooms are 1st rate. Would highly recommend .

allReviews.title: The Fontainebleau Experience
allReviews.text: We came for a conference which we do every year but to my surprise this resort was the cleanest that I have ever been in Vegas, also the security was amazing with top notch service. The Spa is the best so far I have been in Vegas and Papi steakhouse Wao!!! You better come to this Resort if you want to experience the Wao factor!Amazing Expo Hall Space!!!

allReviews.title: No blues at Fontainebleau!
allReviews.text: I almost want to keep it a secret!!! Fontainebleau is anazing in all of the ways that a hotel can be. The best part is that if you’re anything like me, there is no need to leave! Service, 10! Room, 10! Restaurants, 10! And the pool is a 10 too! The aesthetic of the hotel is beautiful inside & out! I won’t stay anywhere else at this point!

allReviews.title: Bachelorette getaway
allReviews.text: The room was clean and well prepared. The beds are super comfortable. They spare no expense even on the T3 hairdryers provided in the rooms. All of the staff are friendly and helpful and quick to accommodate their guests throughout their stay. I will be returning as long as they keep up with this stellar service and clean environment!

allReviews.title: Maintains its brand new charm
allReviews.text: The hotel still keeps its brand new feel. Beautiful hotel and rooms with a very comfortable bed, fluffy pillows and crisp sheets.

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel! So clean, friendly staff, huge rooms. We stayed for three nights and this hotel feels really comfortable. The AC is quiet and efficient, beds are comfy, linens have no weird smells.We had brunch at Lafontaine - delicious. Steak and eggs and lemon pancakes were both fantastic. Service very friendly. Bagel restaurant in the promenade is nice for a quick snack in the early morning. Supper at Don's prime was great too. Filet and strip loin both cooked perfectly. If you're making a reservation here it will offer a set menu, but be aware this is only until 6:30pm. This used to be stated on the reservation page but when we booked it was not so I assumed there were no time limitations. The first server was pretty cold when he told us this - the second was really friendly and made up for it. Maybe that's a thing they do? Anyways glad we just ordered off the menu as everything was delicious. Will definitely visit again. It's fun to walk to the arts district and breweries and stop at the Sahara on the way for a bit of roulette/blackjack. 10$ tables in the afternoon.

allReviews.title: Gorgeous building, poor service
allReviews.text: Gorgeous building, poor service.  Understaffed to shocking levels, indifferent to guests.  Overpriced food, many amenities not open or rarely open.  Restaurants not as good as some of the other resorts.  Pool Day Passes being sold absolutely ruins the vibe and cleanliness of the pools.  If you like trashy people and tons of screaming splashing kids, by all means book a room.

allReviews.title: Mixed feelings
allReviews.text: The hotel itself is beautiful. Everything looks nice and clean professional and five star. As you go deeper into the hotel and experience the staff the service that ambience and other guests you’ll notice the cracks and the inconsistency and discrimination on how they treat each guest. my experience was 50-50. I would either get great service or very rude and inconsistent service encountered many people who are kind and many of the staff that was very disrespectful. I felt like I was more in a security building rather than a resort like hotel, and my experience was not the best. It’s hard to say all the positive things how beautiful the room was how comfortable the beds were how clean it was because it gets tainted and overshadowed by how some people treated us. It’s an  overpriced prison with snotty employees.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: Love our experience. The staff were so attentive, friendly, and professional. One of the best bathrooms in Las Vegas. Shout out to Monica front desk and Claudia front desk for giving us their best service. We loved our time on the pool and the gym. It was so cleaned and so nice. Cafe cuto is so recommended. We will be back

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau - The Epitome Of Luxury
allReviews.text: I encountered Fontainebleau in June of 2012, sitting there vacant. I have been fascinated with the hotel ever since. After reading that Fontainebleau has been finished and open for business since December 2023, I had to come stay at Fontainebleau.
