allReviews.text: This was probably the best Vegas resort i've ever stayed. The purpose of my trip was just for relaxation. The rooms are immaculate, a beautiful shower and gigantic bathtub. Pool deck has enough chairs & umbrellas for everyone.  I'll be back!

allReviews.title: Very nice hotel with a confusing layout, but good amenities.
allReviews.text: The hotel is one of the nicest in Vegas, some good dining options and generally comfortable. We always enjoy Don's Prime, but the pool needs some better options. We had issues with cleanliness, although after a few calls management stepped in to help.

allReviews.title: Most Underrated Hotel of 2025
allReviews.text: Amazing hotel. Fresh and clean lobby. Bars are well established and plenty of options to hang out with people to talk and drink. Komodo restaurant is a must. Great vibes and amazing food. They have a very friendly team of staffs and the restaurants is surrounded with gorgeous aesthetics.

allReviews.title: Couple with a twist
allReviews.text: Like this place very clean elegant this time around it felt more populated and a more lively atmosphere than our last visit. I feel the rewards actually feel like your getting something Wish they had a bar that would have a DJ and would turn into a little club type of feel

allReviews.title: A Must!
allReviews.text: Everything about this hotel and property far exceeded my expectations. From the thoughtful design details throughout to the incredible dining options and standout restaurants, every aspect was exceptional. Most impressive of all was the outstanding team that runs the property — warm, professional, and attentive. This is officially my new go-to spot in Las Vegas. I enjoyed it so much, I’m now tempted to plan a trip to their Miami location.

allReviews.title: Probably won’t go again
allReviews.text: I had pre-booked this stay with a travel agent. It was prepaid in full with American Airlines vacations,. Michael at the desk wanted me to pay another $800, I refused and said I’ve already paid for this and showed him proof. he told me that he didn’t even have me down as a confirmed reservation (which is incorrect because I had previously called to verify the reservation on file ). I had given him my card to run for incidentals, but instead he had already ran my card without my authorization for the full amount. I refused to sign his document authorizing the charge because I didn’t authorize it. After Michael spent some time discussing on the phone with someone, it was determined that the Fontainebleau did not have my payment and they blamed it on American Airlines vacations. They did nothing to help resolve the issue. I had to go call American Airlines vacations and have a conversation for 30 minutes before I was able to come back to the desk and check in. allReviews.title: Great Experience at Fountainebleau
allReviews.text: What a beautiful resort! The pool is a hot spot and there are plenty of bars to keep the cocktails flowing. They also have some great shopping, wonderful gaming and the rooms are top notch.  I also like that it's not overly crowded in the casino, but the LIV night club is on point.

allReviews.title: Not a luxury Property -- One and DONE!
allReviews.text: Listen, it's just not a great property.  So sorry to provide negative feedback, but it's just the truth.  There are dozens of options in Las Vegas that offer better amenities, location, convenience, dining options, and certainly better trained and friendlier staff.  We had multiple rooms for 3 or 4 days in May 2025. The breakfast options are awful; service at Vida was unacceptable, we had to speak to the manager twice.  They had a 20 minute wait with more than 60% of the tables empty, probably because they were understaffed.  All the King Blue Suite rooms are most proximate to the elevators, if you want a quiet room it can only be a double queen.  But wait, 100% of the Suites are only King bed rooms.  They do not have Suites with double queens.   The light controls in the room are impossible to read, they are not internally lit, so not possible to use them in the dark.  turning off the lights also turns off the bathroom night light, thats really stupid.  The worst is the beds have a platform that has a wider footprint than the mattress so its very easy to misjudge the space needed to walk around the bed, I smashed my foot several times on the platform and so did several people in my party.  There is no Poker Room.  The convenience store is atrocious and opens late.  The Gym is amazing, I'll give them that.  I know running a luxury hotel in las vegas is probably one of the most challenging businesses one could imagine; but your ownership group elected to do it, so they knew what they were getting into.  I cannot recommend this hotel, and Fontainebleau will NEVER be on my list of places to stay.

allReviews.title: Overall a great experience
allReviews.text: On the one hand, the property is stunning! The staff are very attentive and do what they can to help with issues that might arise. We had a room key malfunction and had to change rooms. There was a mix-up, and everyone tried their best to help resolve it. Overall, the rooms, views, and location are great. On the other hand, the lack of in room coffee and the cost of food options is a bit of a negative. The layout is really odd from the front desk to your rooms feel disjointed. The best part of our stay was the pool! Excelent staff, excellent pitchers, of drinks and a fantastic cabana..$10 beers in a bucket... We were able to use a large cabana all day and only paid the food and drink  minimum of $500. For 4 people, we found it well worth the cost. Food is expensive, and the pervibsil $26 chips and dip are not a great value. We like the seclusion of the property and took taxis to anything relatively easy. I noticed the gap between Ride share and taxis is narrowed.

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau Hotel Review
allReviews.text: Review of Fontainebleau Hotel, Las VegasThe Fontainebleau Hotel in Las Vegas offers a mixed experience that may or may not suit all travellers. On the positive side, the rooms are spacious and well-maintained, featuring clean interiors, comfortable beds and pillows, and a good-quality shower—ideal for a relaxing rest after a long day in the city.However, the hotel itself is vast and somewhat impersonal, lacking the charm or character that some travellers might prefer. While it is technically located on the Strip, it sits toward the northern end, making it roughly a 20-minute walk to more central attractions such as the Venetian Hotel.There are a few practical inconveniences to note. Rooms do not include tea or coffee-making facilities, which can be an issue for guests who prefer a hot drink in the morning. Housekeeping services appear to be inconsistent, with some guests reporting missed cleanings or delays. Additionally, the soundproofing in the rooms is subpar, allowing noise from neighbouring rooms and hallways to filter through. Another aspect that may not appeal to all is the very relaxed dress code—guests wear a wide range of attire, or sometimes very little of it.Be prepared for an added cost, as the hotel charges a city tax of over $50 per night, excluding tax, which can significantly increase the final bill.In summary, while the Fontainebleau offers clean, comfortable accommodations with generous room sizes, the lack of certain in-room amenities and the overall impersonal atmosphere may not justify the price for some travellers. Personally, I would not choose to stay here again.

allReviews.title: Give Fontainebleau a try - you won’t be disappointed!
allReviews.text: I’ve stayed at many properties on the strip and will definitely return to the Fontainebleau. Spent most of our time eating and drinking on property as there was no need to leave. The hotel is simply beautiful.  Even though it’s at the north end, it is accessible. Stayed in 5839 and had a perfect view of the sphere!  Immaculately clean room.  Value was good but depends on the day. Fun to watch at night. LIV Beach Club was on that side and the music was bumping til the wee hours of the morning but it was fine. Every single staff member we encountered was helpful and nice. The Lapsis Spa was first rate and the massage was the best I have ever had in my lifetime. The pool area is beautiful but get there early as they don’t police people reserving chairs with towels and leaving. Mother Wolf (shoutout to Joey) is one of my favorite restaurants on the strip. Had another great experience. Will be back soon Fontainebleau. Hoping to book a suite next time.

10/10! This resort is beautiful. I’m not sure why it would have low reviews.  Everything was exceptional. Friendly attentive staff and extremely clean. The food and drink price were totally on par for a Vegas resort. Everything we ate was spectacular! Mother Wolf will be one of my favorite places forever! We will be back!

allReviews.title: Excellent experience
allReviews.text: Excellent service, from check in to check out. Brand new hotel. Room has nice amenities, a great bed with several fluffy pillows, and a steamer for the wrinkled clothes. Plenty of restaurants and shops, nice gym and a great pool! I will certainly be back!

allReviews.title: Fountainebleau - the best value 5* on the Strip
allReviews.text: Returned to Vegas for the 7th time at the beginning of May 2025. Decided to try the new luxury hotel on the block, Fountainebleau, after visiting the previous year, just after the opening. Situated at the north end of the strip, the hotel and casino floor were a lot calmer than mid-strip properties, but still carried a lively atmosphere in the evenings. Navigating the strip wasn’t a problem as the famous Deuce bus stops right outside ($20 for 3 day unlimited travel ticket) . Other than this, Uber rides were less than $10 - 2 x on-site Uber pick-up points, North and South. Always use North as this is where drivers go. Our stay started on a positive note when we requested and were granted a high room (58th floor) with a Sphere view - always helps flying into Vegas on a Sunday night, when weekend visitors are clearing out and going back home. More rooms likely to be available. Rewarded check-in staff with decent tip - everyone happy. Room was great - very spacious - everything new - remote controls for drapes/sheers/lights etc. - plenty of power/charging points. Floor to ceiling  view was spectacular - best we have had in Vegas. The Sphere at night is something else! Bed was massive and so comfortable - made up every day of our stay. Fridge space provided (very useful) but no kettle, so pack a travel kettle for early morning coffee, rather than waste 30 mins treking thru hotel to fetch from Chez Bon Bon cafe. Bathroom was excellent. Huge bath, separate shower and toilet room, 2 x wash basins - good water pressure in bath and shower, but taps in basins not brilliant. Plentiful lotions/potions supplied whenever needed, towels changed daily. Service staff were all very welcoming and polite, without exception - a credit to the hotel. Plenty of food options on-site, covering all budgets. Chez Bon Bon cafe very good for hot/cold drinks, pastries, breakfast bites etc etc or Denny’s just down the road. Food court not massive, but useful for a quick snack - pizza, taco’s, burgers all good. Pool complex really good. - 6 different pools. Plenty of beds (with brollies)  available, in full sunlight all day (unlike Venetian!). Poolside Drinks/food service very good + choice of bars to use if shade needed for a while or a sudden urge to play cards/gamble takes you. As you would imagine, everything very clean and maintained immaculately. Gym was very impressive - didn’t use though - on holiday!  Casino floor very impressive and spacious. All the usual slots games that you would expect to see. Table limits were $15 upwards. Quieter during the day, but good atmosphere in the evening, especially in the huge centre bar. Overall, couldn’t fault Fountainebleau - brilliant holiday - everything delivered to 5* standard. Priced very competitively when compared to Wynn/Encoe, Belagio, Venetian/Palazzo,  Cosmo - excellent value for money.

allReviews.title: Dirty towels
allReviews.text: The hotel was very clean and the room was very clean. Although I had a bad experience regarding the cleaning of the room since when I arrived I found the towels very dirty, I called house keeping they did not answer me and I had to call the reception where they also did not solve me.

allReviews.title: Anniversary Trip, First Timers
allReviews.text: Got a nice package deal from United for three nights including air fare and a $100 meal voucher for our anniversary. Check in and out was easy, room was very nice with mountain view and the hotel food and gambling was on par with nicer casinos on the strip.

allReviews.title: Pretty hotel, bad housekeeping.
allReviews.text: Housekeeping was less than satisfactory. Staff was indifferent to the errors they made. Once the door was open when we got back in the evening. When we called housekeeping, instead of apologizing she said if nothing is missing it’s all good. We were not told that water was free in the ice room. Paid 48 dollars for water during our stay.

allReviews.title: Dream Vegas
allReviews.text: Perfect stay, beautiful fixtures and design, excellent service, superb dinning, comfortable and entertaining. Will return to this resort because most places won’t compare. Felt like the old Vegas, lots of happenings and people enjoying their stay.

allReviews.title: Great staff!
allReviews.text: This is a great resort with an exceptional staff. I had so many great experiences but must point out a few that were exceptional. Phil T., Casino Host, is great, Kimia Khorshidi from Registration was wonderful, Layla from Rewards was so nice and so helpful, Maria Ramirez of Guest Services was fantastic, Kevin from Fontainebleau Express was outstanding and Anaiya S. from Morris & Co was just lovely. Great rooms and great restaurants - but they could definitely use a 24 hour sit down restaurant. The casino is very nice - it’s spacious and comfortable. I just wish they would play more of a variety and better music and also turn up the ac because it tends to be on the warm side. Overall I had a very nice time and will be returning again in the near future.

allReviews.title: What a waste!!!!
allReviews.text: It was my 3rd and while I found this hotel to be one of the 3 best in the city, I had an experience that gave me the real picture.As long as you don't have a problem, everything seems to be an establishment to recommend, despite some small defects (poor location, a poorly thought out and often dysfunctional computer site, ...). Nothing serious to have a good stay.Unfortunately, during my last stay, things got so bad that I left my room in the middle of the night. I had a room on the upper floors with a view of the STRIP. At first glance, the perfect room. Except you're also on the side of the nightclub. As it was impossible to sleep, I went to the reception to see if it would not be possible to move to the other side of the hotel.Very nicely the receptionist tells me that there are only 2 bed rooms left, but she just needs to ask her hierarchy for approval. It was from that moment that everything went wrong because for some unknown reason she told me that the manager did not accept my request and that all he could do was allow me a checkout at 1pm instead of 11am and provide me with quiescent balls. I thought I was dreaming. Already in a low-end hotel, I would find it more than limiting, but with rooms over $300/night, it was carelessly insulting. Not being able to sleep anyway, I decided to pack my bags and leave this hotel immediately. I took the opportunity to pay my bill and cancel more than $3,000 of reservations for a planned stay at the end of the year. Seeing the reaction, I have the impression that they do not care about this decision and prefer docile customers who pay without ever complaining. I would point out that the manager never came to explain his choice and I received no apology. I felt that guests at this property should be happy to be chosen as hosts. I travel between 4 and 6 months a year and I have never seen such sufficiency, rogance. But I wasn't at the end of my surprises. Indeed, in the early morning, for security, I check if the checkout had been recorded and there I notice that it was not the case and that they had billed the night that I had not stayed at their house. While still in town, I decided to go there to settle this incident definitively and I was hoping to finally meet another Manager. I thought the former had crossed certain lines and that I would finally be entitled to an apology.I did not know the "culture" of this hotel and on the contrary I was the "bad" guest again. For the refund of the night, I had to fight because for them, if the computer system counts, it is difficult to go against their procedure. After long minutes of talking, the last night's payment was cancelled and I managed to "snatch" an apology. Neither sincere nor commercial, but they found that to get me out of the hotel you had to make a little effort. Either they are very rich and their arrogance allows them not to respect the customers, or they have great financial difficulties and you have to take all the money that customers bring without any flexibility. For me, Mass was said and I would never stay in this hotel again. It is possible that this message will receive a response from a formatted apology, but as I did not feel any humanity when I was here, I will allow myself to doubt the sincerity of these.For me, it's a complete waste because I was gradually building up my budget to stay in this hotel. The rooms are beautiful and very clean. In some departments, the staff do a good job and are always very polite.However, I think they have a big problem with middle managers. Either they have incredible pressure to achieve goals that are difficult to achieve or they are totally inconvergent in their business.If the customer is not treated well, I imagine it must be a dream to work there!!

allReviews.title: Excellent place for a family trip, couples trip or bachelor party
allReviews.text: This resort keeps getting better and better! The service and accommodations have tremendously improved. I have been here for grand opening with my family, a couples trip with my partner and a bachelor party for 17 guys and all the experiences were amazing and with the vast differences in groups- everything was accommodated. I highly recommend FB Las Vegas and have been to all the resorts in Vegas and can confidently say it’s becoming the best new spot in Vegas.

allReviews.title: You won't get the Blue's at Fontainebleau!
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau is 18 month new hotel, casino and resort.  What an incredible experience.  You can understand how a newer hotel is better laid out.  Make the Ballagio look dated!  The 6 pools with chairs, daybeds and cabana's were located on the 3rd floor easily accessible to the elevators.  Don't have to prance through the casino half naked in your bathing suits.  The food was incredible, recommend Don's.  Even the owner goes there.  They had a 24-hour french cafe that was nice, the promenade had more causal dining.  Well laid out.   The spa is second to none.  Will be going back.  Highly recommend

allReviews.title: Celebrating Our 1st Anniversary
allReviews.text: We got engaged in 2024 at the airport on our way to Las Vegas, so this year, to celebrate our 1st anniversary, we decided to splurge and enjoy a few days at the Fountainebleau. It was perfection and flawless, from check-in to the suite, room service, and a memorable anniversary dinner at Don's Prime. Highly recommend for any occasion!

allReviews.title: Nightmare check-in experience
allReviews.text: My friends and I booked three rooms for our stay, and unfortunately, the check-in experience was extremely disappointing. Two of the rooms had serious issues.One room had not been cleaned at all—it was left in an unacceptable state with dirty towels and trash throughout. My friends in that room had to wait over two hours before a manager was finally able to provide them with a new room.In another case, the front desk issued the wrong key three separate times. My friends staying in that room were forced to repeatedly walk back and forth through the hotel and casino, only to eventually be placed in an ADA-accessible room they did not book.The entire process was chaotic, frustrating, and far below the standard we expected. I’ve never had a worse check-in experience at any hotel.

allReviews.title: Best hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: The best resort in Vegas. Rooms are impeccable, gorgeous decor and very clean. Hotel is not smoky, bright and fresh smelling overall. Lots of dining options and several pools to choose from. Have stayed at other luxury hotels on strip (Four Seasons, Wynn) and FB would be my first choice!

allReviews.title: Amazing hotel, wish location was better.
allReviews.text: An amazing new hotel in Vegas, lovely casino, room was amazing. Only thing that let's it down is the location, it's just a bit far to walk to & from everyday if you're heading up the strip. But if you've been to Vegas before you'll know this & you can catch the bus ir taxi if need be.Would definitely stay here again when I'm back in Vegas, free parking which was a bonus too!

allReviews.title: Top notch
allReviews.text: Top notch...my wife and I enjoyed it.  Everything from the spa, gym, casino, and rooms were elegant, clean and new.  Check in was a breeze, the spa and restaurants were able to accommodate us last minute.  Staff was professional and polite.  Looking forward to our next stay.

allReviews.title: Lovely place
allReviews.text: Loved it.  I will be back as soon as possible.  The staff was great, the place was so clean and the restaurants were uncreditable.  I had a weekend with my family and we will go back again this moth. So many memories, what happened there never happened

allReviews.title: An A-plus ultra hotel and casino.
allReviews.text: A beautiful hotel with a helpful and pleasant staff. Our room was spotless. Common areas were spotless also. Great food choices too! The hotel was very easy to navigate. The casino was player friendly with an open and airy vibe. The artwork throughout the hotel and casino was amazing. After a long, cold Midwestern winter this visit to the Fontainebleau was the realization of a dream. My new favorite hotel in Vegas. Thank you.

allReviews.title: Family trip with 90 year old mom!
allReviews.text: The Fontainebleau hotel experience was flawless, especially with the need for accessible services. We pretty much stayed at the hotel exclusively and leaned hard into many of the offerings. From the viewpoint of making things not just easy, but enjoyable for a person needing extra services, they excelled. I used their concierge to request things like an accessible adjoining suite and room, airport transportation, mini fridge, and microwave. Everything was set up in the room at check in. We had an accessible mountain/strip view suite and adjoining room on the 53 floor. (Caveat: a lot of the strip view was of Circus Circus and Resort World, but you could also see the Sphere!)We loved the suite for a central gathering point for our group. Dinner first night was at The Tavern - no complaints there and we caught some of the NBA playoffs. Tuesday we had a cabana booked in the 21+ area poolside for the day. Absolutely great service, food and beverage. It was a windy day so we had that pool mostly to ourselves.  We were concerned we couldn’t hit the $600 minimum spend but that fear was unfounded! Tax and tip was an additional $150 for those that want to know these things. Dinner was at Korean BBQ KYU at Fontainebleau. We took our servers suggestions and ordered family style so tried a good percent of the menu. It was a terrific experience - drinks, wine, meal and service.  Approx $100 pp inc tax and tip. We spent Wednesday at the Fontainebleau pool again, sans cabana, and had lunch poolside. Definitely busier but it was easy to find places to accommodate our group. I would absolutely recommend this resort property!

allReviews.title: Great property let down by housekeeping.
allReviews.text: Great room and facilities, friendly staff, enjoyable casino, but poor cleaning -  a condom wrapper by the side of one of the beds was reported and resolved with a $50 F&B credit, but then the resulting condom was found by the side of the other bed afterwards. If I'm honest, not a great start to the trip.

allReviews.title: Discriminatory Treatment of Disabled Guests at WWE Event
allReviews.text: I attended the WWE event at Fontainebleau and had purchased designated wheelchair-accessible seating along with a companion seat. Upon arrival, we were shocked to be directed to sit in the aisle walkway, as our allocated seats had been covered—apparently to make the venue appear full on the telecast. My son remained in his wheelchair, while I was given a dining chair to sit on.Due to back pain, I moved to an adjacent empty lounge chair, which remained unoccupied throughout the show. A staff member then approached, yelling at me to return to my seat. I explained that my seat had been covered and was inaccessible. I was told the lounge chairs were for VIPs only, despite them remaining empty. Another attendant also insisted I move. I refused until we were provided the seating we paid for.I lodged a complaint with Guest Services, as this experience felt discriminatory and disrespectful. I was promised follow-up from Dakota in Customer Service, but no one ever contacted me. Both the venue and event organiser passed blame. The treatment we received—particularly as guests with accessibility needs—was unacceptable and deeply disappointing.

allReviews.title: very nice hotel
allReviews.text: very nice resort a bit far from the strip brand new roomdon s restaurant was excellent la fontaine not so good the chef who has been working wth big namedoesnt bring for myself anything special for this restaurant but the service was good  the food so so

allReviews.title: May 2025
allReviews.text: The floor service was lacking. The selection of machines were fine. It's a large casino so you have plenty of room. The perfume sometimes will drug you crazy. The employees did seem like to like to stand around and talk to each other really hated to bother them

allReviews.title: New Vegas
allReviews.text: i let the front desk upsell me, so i had a great room with fun views. The best touch was that upon request they put a humidifer in my room AND included distilled water for it. Room was clean and service was unobtrusive. Felt very different from the old-line Vegas hotels. Somewhat not central but worked fine. The BEST pizza downstairs in the Italian restaurant. The large pool wasn't open when we were there in late Nov because they were transitioning to winter setup.

allReviews.title: Great for a relaxing family retreat!
allReviews.text: Fountainbleau was exceptional! From their staff (Kira Lee - Oasis Pool Deck), clean and well kept rooms, outstanding amenities and great selection of food places! I would definitely come back and refer this place to my family and friends!

allReviews.title: 10/10 experience- we will be back
allReviews.text: I was a little apprehensive about booking here due to the mixed reviews. I can honestly say this hotel exceeded expectations. From the moment your walk in, it’s clean, modern and every encounter was extremely positive. No queue on check in, we upgraded our room to a royal suite with great strip view from a standard pool view which I’m very glad we did. The rooms are stunning. The personal fridge is a fantastic touch. The royal suite was beautiful and no complaints. We had great housekeeping & turn down service every evening. The food options were great, the only downside to the food court is that is closed at 10pm during the week. We landed and got to the hotel hungry at 10pm and everything was closed. Chez Bon Bon is open 24 hour which helped but is more of a coffee shop. We tried Miami slice, washing potato & the food by the pool during our stay and all were great. The poolside food etc wasn’t actually bad value as portions were big. Miami slice was incredible so is a must. The drinks service on the casino floor can be very slow, one night we never got offered a drink when gambling for 2/3 hours and hardly saw cocktail waitresses. It was down to luck and where you’re sat. The tables always had drinks service so if you’re at a table you’ll get drinks. There are lots of staff cleaning to casino space but suggest they add more cocktail waitresses. That’s the only downfall on the casino floor. When we gambled earlier in the day it was better for drinks naturally. Also positive note- the casino wasn’t very Smokey. I struggled with the smell in all the other casinos bar this one. So if you’re a non smoker this hotel is great. Craig at the sports bar was one of the best members of staff we encountered. He was excellent and very good at his job. Pool staff great, very attentive. Always were beds around the pool, although very busy on some days. We went to the over 21 section where there were always spare beds and still great service. This pool is also a million times nicer than any other hotel we’ve stayed in vegas. This hotel blows all the other hotels out the water in my opinion. It’s a little quieter being new which actually was really enjoyable. That being said it was still vibey. The other hotels in vegas feel old and run down to me now. The bleau bar was packed in the evenings giving some good vibes on the casino floor. The music was really good also giving a nice touch. I am extremely fussy with hotels and this hotel was genuinely 10/10. I have no idea how it has bad reviews. If you’re considering this hotel, book it. It’s a short walk to wynn (10 mins), Lyft or Uber to centre strip $12-18.  We will return very soon! Thanks to all the staff for making our trip incredible.

allReviews.title: Scam
allReviews.text: By the bar is a machine that SAYS 10centsI put a one hundred dollar bill inPlayed the full amount on the button It took my $100 in two try’sI called the floor manager overHe AGREED I put $100  in AFTER OPENING THE MACHINE BUT IF YOU PLAY ALL LINES ON A 10Cents machine It is $50 a throw SCAM I WILL NEVER BET THERE AGAINBE VERY CAREFUL!!!!Never again

allReviews.title: Conference in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Amazing Hotel, at walking distance from the Strip with outstanding rooms and services. Conferences room's are fully equipped. If you have any spare time you can enjoy pool or the club during night. Great offer of food is also present. Brand new Spa and everything with a  great crew always ready to help.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
allReviews.text: My husband and I went to Vegas for our 30th Wedding Anniversary and stayed at Fontainebleau. We could not be more pleased with our stay. The staff was super friendly, happy and helpful. The hotel is so beautiful and clean. I loved all the options available for restaurants. We ate at Komodo's and the food and service was top notch. We spent the day at the pools which were very clean and saw Pitfall at the theater on the property in the evening. I would highly recommend this hotel and can't wait to go back.

allReviews.title: Another exquisite time at the Fontainebleau
allReviews.text: Our third visit to the Fontainebleau. Just as lovely and enjoyable as previous trips. The Fontainebleau is a stunningly beautiful property with exceptional service and amenities. The Lapis Spa is a must-try for anyone new to the Fontainebleau and be sure to time your spa services to catch the breathwork/contrast therapy session in the Aufguss event sauna.  We invited a group of 20ish friends to join us this time and had a wonderful trip.

allReviews.title: Book it! You won’t regret it.
allReviews.text: Classy, clean, and great amenities! Fantastic pool and didn’t have to fight for chairs r or deal with people “reserving” chairs in absentia with towels. Mother Wolf on premises is a wonderful restaurant! There is also a great selection of casual offerings in a food court area on the mezzanine level called the Promenade.

allReviews.title: Not bleau anymore
allReviews.text: The whole experience was amazing. Great rooms, excellent service and outstanding food and drinks. Hit the Collin’s bar, it’s an often overlooked spot but Alex the bartender was great! Don’a steakhouse was fantastic and the pool service was fantastic.

allReviews.title: Excellent!
allReviews.text: Everything was perfect. Even it's a huge hotel, all services work ok and on time. We were a group of 8 friends at a golf trip around LV, and Fontainebleau exceeded all our expectations. In house restaurantes are great and you have a very good variety of food to choose. A special mention for the gym, it was the best I visited in my whole life. I will repeat it again soon.

allReviews.title: Beautiful property; bad location
allReviews.text: We wanted to stay at this brand new property and we were excited for it after seeing LOVE with Kelly & Mark filming from this property last Spring. Typically we stay at the far south end at Mandalay Bay, so going into it we did know that it was not located in the best area of the strip. The property itself is very nice. The room was comfortable with nice bedding and towels. However, the room was smaller size and not as plush than our previous visits to Mandalay Bay and Encore. Every member of the staff that we spoke with from check-in to bellman to restaurant staff was very kind and professional and willingly helpful. Because we did have one issue, the employee at check out was so kind to drop the resort fees off our room charges without me even asking. That shows a well trained customer service employee. The biggest disappointment for us was walking past the disgusting area adjacent to the hotel every time we came and went. We found that Vegas as a whole has changed significantly in a negative way. It has become more dirty on the streets than it ever has been and people are out there smoking marijuana every place you walk outside. Unfortunately, after being annual visitors up till 2019, we most likely will never return. However, we are happy that we did get to enjoy a nice brand new Vegas hotel property.

allReviews.title: First class!
allReviews.text: I’ve stayed at my fair share of nice hotels but Fontainebleau might be my best experience ever. I was lucky to have an executive suite and am really impressed with how highend everything was built, the 5 star service with attention to detail and how clean everything was.The beds really stand out as do the restaurants there (Komodo has the best spicy edamame)The turndown service was 12/10 and valet / bell hops really took care of my group Fast Lane Drive. Really really impressive and worthy of this review Shout out to Bianca for helping our room block, Wes at LIV and both managers of the bellmen and valet. First class!

allReviews.title: Stunning
allReviews.text: Amazing 🤩 What can I say stunning , beautiful, well thought out, tasteful and modern.Shop fronts lovely just for the rich however lol.Casino not Smokey and gastly like others.Negatives. Conference delegates should be seperate from paying guests as so many of them.No facilities in room like a kettle with no free drinks or sun-dried like other hotels. Also spa is not open to hotel guests unless you pay extra🙄

allReviews.title: La la land spectacular
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel, I would say best in vegas. We almost chose Bellagio but were glad we chose this one as that had way too many tourists.Lovely clean rooms. Whole experience apart from no kettle  or additions in room was awesome. If you want to come away from the madness and have luxury after a full day on the strip this is the hotel for you 😊

allReviews.title: Incredible Fountainebleau!
allReviews.text: The room was luxurious and comfortable.  When I walked in the curtains automatically opened to the gorgeous floor to ceiling view of the City.  The tub was so long and deep that I could sit in it with water up to my shoulders.  Everything was absolutely perfect.

allReviews.title: Unmatched Service, Stunning Design, and the Best All-Around Vegas Experience
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas exceeded every expectation and is now my go-to resort whenever I visit the city. From the moment I arrived, I was met with warm, attentive service—including a generous complimentary upgrade that made my trip unforgettable. Every team member I encountered went above and beyond, showing a level of hospitality that truly sets this property apart.The resort offers something for everyone. The casino floor is full of energy with a wide variety of games, upbeat music, and a fun, social vibe that makes it my favorite place to play in Vegas. The Tavern was a personal highlight—an incredible spot to watch live sports, place bets, and enjoy great service in a high-energy atmosphere.Though my trip was brief, I was able to take advantage of the fitness center, which was impressively equipped and offered complimentary classes and personal training options—perfect for staying active even on vacation. While I didn’t get a chance to visit the spa this time, the facility looked serene and will definitely be on my list for next time.One of the most unique experiences at Fontainebleau is LIV Beach. Though I missed the Calvin Harris performance by a day, the buzz from other guests said it all—this is one of the best daylife venues in Vegas. From world-class DJs to luxury design and production, it’s more than a pool party—it’s a full-scale concert under the sun.Every detail of the resort is thoughtfully crafted—from modern room technology to sophisticated design and world-class amenities. Fontainebleau Las Vegas delivers an elevated, all-encompassing Vegas experience that I would highly recommend to anyone visiting the city. I can’t wait to return.

allReviews.title: Apa national
allReviews.text: Definitely a five-star everything in the room was top notch. The restaurants were tasty but obviously Vegas expensive. Floor service sucked but the employees did love to stand around and talk to each other we saw a lot of that. I do suggest wearing a mask as the perfume is so heavy you'd want them to bring back smoking. Are trip included parking but for some reason they've thrown it on my credit card so now I have to fight them on that. Very clean. And they have really shown the biggest slowdown the casino was not that busy and I noticed the payouts on the grand awards were lowered that it other casinos

allReviews.title: Relaxing vacation
allReviews.text: The rooms were smaller than I expected for the price and they have a touch panel to turn on the lights and open the drapes, but they were kind of a pain to work. The resort though is beautiful, great service and the upscale restaurants are really good. Must go to the pastry and Gelato shop! unfortunately they closed the pool if it rains and it was closed most of the weekend when we were there. Luckily the Venetian was still open, so we went over there and enjoyed their spa and pool.

allReviews.title: One of the best in Vegas!
allReviews.text: This resort is incredible; the entire place is beautiful! The staff are super friendly and personable. They have reasonable nightly hotel rates and table game minimums. They have a ton of great food options on-site as well. They are all a little expensive, but the quality is great. Pro tip: Don't order drinks by the pool, they are very expensive, make sure to play at the poolside backpack or craps tables and get free drinks! The dealers at the poolside tables are some of the best in Vegas! Yes, this resort is at the north end of the strip, but it's much easier than you think to get to the other parts of Vegas. The Deuce's bus picks up right outside the resort and is an easy and affordable way to get around the strip.

allReviews.title: Kind of conflicting
allReviews.text: This review is the subjective opinion of an individual traveller and not of Tripadvisor LLC nor of its partners. Tripadvisor performs checks on reviews as part of our industry-leading trust & safety standards. Read our transparency report to learn more.

allReviews.title: Amazing! Except guest services
allReviews.text: We were staying at the Wynn but visited friends staying at the Fountainblue. Overall had a wonderful experience and the resort is breathtaking. mother wolf and LIV are some of the best times I’ve had in a while. As we left, I Put my CC down for a friend’s room folio, a few days later notice an unfamiliar charge (no big deal)Called the hotel and spoke with a gentleman in customer/guest services named Lorenzo, he was helpful and rectified everything until the call was about to end and I heard “cheap b*tch” faintly before disconnecting. Obviously this was not intended for me to hear but sadly I did. As a Jewish woman this is more hurtful than anything and a heartbreaking level of unprofessionalism I’ve yet to experience in a place with so much potential. Understandably everyone has bad days but I will not be returning after that distasteful interaction but wanted to share my experience for future reference. Do better FountainBlue Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Use the hotel and a place to sleep and not much more
allReviews.text: Rooms are fine, view of the sphere was good. Bathroom was missing the most basic thing. A towel hook, you had to put the towel on the floor when you shower or walk across the bathroom for it.  Pool is ok, but the service at the pool was terrible. My wife was able to go earlier than I did, she was completely ignored the entire time by the young waitresses walking around. She felt like she wasn't pretty or skinny enough to deserve their attention. When I got there, she wanted to leave but I wanted her to at least have a drink and enjoy. I went to the bar and the bartender made the weakest $23 drink I have ever had. Poured our alcohol into a blender, added way too much ice, poured our two drinks and then the remainer of the blender down the sink. I just watched as the alcohol I had just paid for get thrown away. Tried our luck at Roulette. the dealer was terrible. He would just stand there looking around, bored out of his mind and would not help up place our bets at the other end of the table since we could not reach. Other players saw this and ended up helping up place the bets.  We were playing $250 a spin. You think a little assistance might be nice and land you a tip. We ended up stopping since he made my wife's first experience not one she would like to repeat. I have had great dealers at Caesars that actually want to help.

allReviews.title: A perfect 10. Absolutely Stunning
allReviews.text: Absolute gem of a hotel and conference center. Absolutely spectacular. Food, spa, fitness facilities and rooms. A perfect 10. The people were also very accommodating and easy to talk with. Concierge was very helpful with scheduling everything for shows and more. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend

allReviews.title: Stay at the Wynn instead
allReviews.text: Ive been to the FB 6 times since they opened. I spend more money than all of my other party members. All my party members receive comps and resort credits while I havent received anything.I normally split my time between the Wynn and FB. Going forward, the Wynn will be my hotel of choice. They at least know how to treat regular guests.

allReviews.title: Pretty hotel, pretty terrible service.
allReviews.text: The hotel is beautiful but the service is subpar to say the least.  Room service took over 40 minutes to answer the phone and another 1 hour 15 to deliver.  Tavern service was so slow we canceled our food and left.  They have a long way to go on the service side to catch up to the other marquis Vegas hotels.

allReviews.title: Wonderful and relaxing stay
allReviews.text: Great room with a nice view of the Las Vegas strip and the Sphere. Complimentary slippers. Very clean throughout the casino and lounge area. I look forward to a future visit. I definitely recommend FountaineBleau. The casino is one of the newer attractions on the Las Vegas strip.

allReviews.title: Disappointing Experience at a Property That Prioritizes Image Over Service
allReviews.text: I wanted to love the Fontainebleau Las Vegas, but from the moment we checked in, the experience fell far short of what you'd expect from a luxury hotel.We were initially placed in a room that directly faced their massive LED marquee. The blackout blinds didn’t close properly, so our room felt like a 2 AM nightclub—impossible to sleep in. It took two days and multiple requests to be moved to a quieter room. Even then, we were given a configuration that required my sister to sleep on a rollaway bed because none of their larger rooms offer two beds—a surprising and frustrating limitation for a luxury property.Service across the board was lacking. Every simple request—extra pillows, toothpaste, basic amenities—required multiple follow-ups. It seemed like nothing got done the first time. I spent more time calling down to the front desk and following up than actually enjoying my stay.The final straw came when our reservation at Komodo was denied because "A-list talent" was in the restaurant. We were told we could dine at the bar instead—not acceptable for a pricey, special-occasion dinner we had reserved in advance. When we asked the hostess for her name, she refused to provide it.To the hotel’s credit, a manager did reach out after our stay and apologized for the experience. He offered to refund half of our stay, which I reluctantly accepted. Ten days later—still no refund. Just like everything else with this hotel, it’s all style, no follow-through.The Fontainebleau may look impressive on the outside, but the substance just isn’t there. When you’re paying luxury rates, you expect consistency, professionalism, and a commitment to guest experience—not excuses and broken promises.

allReviews.title: Fourth time and keeps getting better
allReviews.text: Fourth time there and this time we just stayed at hotel the whole time for events, restaurants, pools, hanging in our amazing room, and gaming.  The personnel are all very friendly and professional.  Best pools in Vegas and best craft cocktails across multiple venues.  The promenade and room service also have great food for when you don't want to go all out in the nicer restraurants and there is such a variety of high quality food, drink, and things to do.

allReviews.title: Loved it!!!
allReviews.text: Johanna C was not at the same hotel I was — this hotel was immaculate and gorgeous!! She must love the Luxor and the Excalibur or something, and probably never even stayed at Fontainebleau!! IHad a wonderful time in the hotel- the one complaint I did have was the Casino floor did not have the greatest Slot games so they do need a new Slot manager over there

allReviews.title: Need better Housekeeping
allReviews.text: Rooms need more cleanliness, vacuum, change sheets every new guest, higher quality of tv's & internet.The hotel it's spectacular, as the restaurants & Bars, the pool it great as the Spa.Cafe La Fontaine for breakfast & lounge, need to be open more time, it's close at noon, incredible!

allReviews.title: 5 + Star Experience
allReviews.text: 5 + Star , from the arrival to to check-out. The entire stay, and overall property was immaculate. Always someone within reach to ask questions and noticed security when moving through out the property. The staff at all areas where friendly and provided a great experience.

allReviews.title: Good experience
allReviews.text: Friendly staff in the pool. Good experience in the room nice and clean. Smell good when you walk in. Definitely will be back again. Enjoy the live music. Need more choices of the food. Make more affordable to all. Limited food choices. Beautiful place

allReviews.title: They have a winner
allReviews.text: Absolutely love, pulling in and being greeted with professional valet, concierge, front desk, all very professional and upscale. The room is appointed beautifully. The brand goes the extra mile and how they integrated the brand in their design everywhere. The place is timeless, classy truly, my favorite.

allReviews.title: Lavish but a young vibe Hotel.
allReviews.text: A young vibe hotel. A very big spacious hotel. The rooms were gorgeous and the bed was the most comfortable bed I have ever slept in. The restaurants were very over priced. The pool had a noisy beach club vibe. There was nowhere to find some peace and quiet. I had no complaints it just wasn't my age group type of hotel. It would suit young successful adults/groups.

allReviews.title: Stylish Hotel With Great Amenities, But Security Deposit Felt Excessive
allReviews.text: We stayed here for the fourth leg of our honeymoon trip along the West Coast of the USA. Overall, it’s a very stylish, modern hotel that offers a comfortable and enjoyable experience.Rooms: Modern, well-designed, and very comfortable, with spacious bathrooms — no complaints here.Food: Delicious and well-prepared, though a bit on the pricey side. That said, we felt it was worth the cost.Casino: Bright, open layout with high ceilings, which made it feel much more comfortable and less claustrophobic compared to others we visited during our trip.Pool: A beautiful space — it felt like swimming in a Mediterranean resort.Downside: The only real drawback, and the reason for the 4-star rating instead of 5, was the security deposit. At $650, it felt excessive for a couple. We understand the need for deposits, but this amount seemed disproportionate and not tailored to the average guest profile. It’s something the hotel should reassess based on the type of clientele they’re hosting. however, appreciated the quick return of the deposit compared to other hotels on pour trip. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would recommend the hotel — just be aware of the upfront costs.

allReviews.title: Luxury in rooms, great beds,  ordinary casino, noisy location
allReviews.text: Too expensive. Not that special. Layout is confusing and garage needs more signage to find your way around. Room was beautiful and floor to ceiling window provided good views. But the downside was not sleeping because you hear every road sound. I had to get up at 1:00 am to actually look out the window to see if we were by a racetrack due to engines revving and zooming for two hours. And that was on the 50th floor.   Last thing to note is it gets stars because of the most comfortable beds I’ve ever had in 52 trips to Vegas. Just needed some earplugs.

allReviews.title: Foutainebleau Las Vegas -Spectacular!!
allReviews.text: Fountainebleau is spectacular casino / resort. Check in was fast despite there being many people in line - the wait was only 3 or 4 minutes.  We found our room in common areas to be extremely clean and well maintained. The restaurants offered A wide variety of very good food in a very clean atmosphere.  Must be a fantastic place to work because everyone we saw working there was smiling.This was my first time staying here and I will definitely look forward to returning soon

allReviews.title: This years Birthday outstanding!!
allReviews.text: This place wasn’t short of beauty, style and grace. From valet to front desk and everyone in between exceptional service!! Beautiful amenities, structure ,build  ,quality ,and a hint of pure class. FONTAINEBLEAU you owe me nothing you are truly amazing.. Thanks for giving me and my husband such an amazing opportunity to spend my birthday celebration with you all; and experience this amazing community of hospitality and class …

allReviews.title: Poolside covered in litter.
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel. Pool however, covered in litter. I asked a lifeguard if someone could pick it up but she said it’s not her job and she would let her manager know, but then sat and did nothing. Cups, napkins, cans all blowing into the pool. Where are the staff?!

allReviews.title: Bedbugs!
allReviews.text: Bedbug bites! Beware! Attitude of staff - they could care less. They see themselves as VIP in VIP lounge, instead of you!Strongly encourage people to look elsewhere, closer to the strip. Will NOT go back here .. Photos speak a thousand words!

allReviews.title: Wonderful stay!
allReviews.text: Absolutely gorgeous hotel! The accommodations are 5 star by far. Check in was a breeze and any staff that we dealt with were all professional and very friendly and helpful. The beds are super comfortable and the bathroom is luxurious. The rooms are beautifully decorated and the views are great! We will stay here  again for sure!

allReviews.title: Save your money, disgusting hotel
allReviews.text: What a garbage hotel. Disgusting, dirty and wanted $9 for an empty wine glass. NEVER AGAIN, don’t do it!!!!! POS hotel. Ghetto. UGH…what a disgusting place. Everything is low, ghetto, dirty and disgusting. The room is small and smells and the whole place is an arm pit garbage can. Save your money. Go to the flamingo if you must.

allReviews.title: Best New Casino Resort in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: In my opinion, Fontainebleau is currently the best hotel on the strip. Rooms are roomy, clean, and well decorated making us feel at home. Plenty of pillows and the bed was very comfortable.  There are plenty of choices of eateries to satisfy everyone's tastebuds. Love the decor of the whole casino and the promenade area. One must try La Fontaine if you're visiting Fontainebleau as their breakfast/ brunch is the best in Las Vegas. Try out the Souffle Pancake and French toast - you won't regret it.

allReviews.title: Best Hotel on the strip
allReviews.text: This place has everything that you can imagine and more.  You do not need to leave the Hotel. The food is pricey but phenomenal.  If you love jazz check out the live music at NoWhere. Very nice Spa and pool. They also have plenty of slot machines. Check it out!

allReviews.title: Family trip
allReviews.text: The rooms are clean and very nice. I would recommend this hotel completely. Their staff is courteous, friendly and helpful. Food is delicious in the upstairs food court. Casino was beautiful, spacious and alot of fun slots. The Vida resturant has amazing breakfasts as well.

allReviews.title: We will be back next year!
allReviews.text: The hotel is an excellent place ti stay. The amenities and the room are amazing. Beds are comfy with warm blanket and soft pillows. The casino has a lot of machines to choose from and it's very clean.  The staff is very pleasant and the pool area was fun.

allReviews.title: Hands down the best hotel on the strip and I've stayed at a *lot* of them
allReviews.text: The Fontainebleau Las Vegas is the future of hotels in Vegas. It's obviously new so it's very clean and well kept, but it's modern and always an A+ experience. While there are other "luxury hotels" on the strip that we are almost all familiar with, FB LV delivers on the whole experience. The food options are fantastic, always great service, and it's clean and feels like you are in 2025 vs. some of the other "luxury" ones feel like you are in a very nice hotel for 2001.

allReviews.title: Fontainebleau Las Vegas: Elevate Your Events, Embrace the Comfort, Ignite the Night
allReviews.text: Step into a haven of comfort and impeccable cleanliness within the rooms at The Fontainebleau Las Vegas. Beyond your tranquil retreat, a world of delights awaits. Indulge in the diverse and delicious dining experiences, invigorate yourself at the fitness center, or bask in the Las Vegas sunshine by the inviting pool. As the day unfolds, the thrill of the casino floor beckons, promising excitement with every stack of chips on the table.For business, The Fontainebleau really knows how to put on a company conference and every need is catered for from corporate kickoff events to team breakout sessions and those tasty coffee and snack breaks.

allReviews.title: The place you must visit in Vegas!
allReviews.text: It’s a great experience to visit Fontainebleau.  It has a wonderful view in the room and you can see it by the window. It’s a nice place to hang out with family and friends! We will plan to come back here anytime soon! Highly recommended to whoever wanna come to Vegas!

allReviews.title: Hope you don't want hot coffee!
allReviews.text: The hotel itself was great, the room was  great and very comfortable.  The bed was super comfortable and all the room amenities were fantastic. The issues was the simple pleasures in the morning, My wife and I wanted coffee every morning and the room service charges were Vegas exorbitant so we went to the only couple of to go options to take back to the room and they had ridiculous wait times and no coordination between ordering basic food and coffee's with up to 10-15 minutes between when your coffee came and your food, so hot coffee, cold food or the other way around, it was different every day. Once the coffee's (that I was planning to bring back to our room for my wife) came first and 15 minutes later the food came, got to the room, cold coffee and the food was not even heated through.  Don't know if super expensive room service would have been better but as they source from the same place I doubt it.

allReviews.title: 2 fun nights at Fountainbleau
allReviews.text: Great ambiance, excellent restaurants and for the most part, super friendly and helpful staff. The only downside was their nightclub LIV. Security team and bouncers were very unfriendly and  almost confrontational, which at that price is a shame.

allReviews.title: Amazingly awesome stay
allReviews.text: We were there for a Staycation and birthday celebration. Our room was a King with a view of the Strip. It was very clean, the bed was very comfortable. Lots of restaurants with choices of cuisines. Pool areas are very clean. Service was excellent. Staff was very friendly and helpful. I would recommend it to everyone.

allReviews.title: One of the best
allReviews.text: Exceptional service. Well appointed, clean and fresh rooms. It was a busy weekend with WWE event and we never heard noise from the halls when we were in our room. Great selection of restaurants and games. Never had to wait for games or drinks.

allReviews.title: HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE HORRIBLE HOTEL
allReviews.text: This is by far the worst hotel on the strip! Came to Vegas for Wrestlemania Weekend and you think as the hotel sponsoring the event they would be more organized but it was horrible! Firstly been to Vegas multiple times and this hotel has no idea what they’re doing!!! Do not be a sponsor hotel if you cannot handle the capacity of people! We booked on Costco Travel so got a good rate for the weekend but boy did it come with a price!! First we landed on Thursday night and upon checking in we asked the employee at the front desks about the $200 credit we received from booking with Costco Travel… the check in clerk tells us we cannot use it for any in-room service dining and can only use it in restaurants on the property we said ok no problem. We made sure to ask her 2-3 times since the lobby was jam packed with lots of people and she gave us the same response. No problem, we ordered room service that night and  when it arrived the employee said to call back when we were done so that they can come pick up the dirty dishes.. DIRTY DISHES WERE NEVER PICKED UP BY ANYONE… we called back after we were done and no one ever came.. so the next morning we called back again and still NO ONE CAME.. so on the Saturday we went to the front desk and advised the clerk of the issue, she apologized and trued to contact the manager of the in-room service dining and still the issue not resolved… so on Sunday we asked for room service to clean the room…. I specifically left a note asking to pick up the dirty dishes since apparently no staff member knows anything…. Later that night came back from Wrestlemania & the dirty dishes STILL IN THE ROOM!! so I went back down the lobby explained the whole issue… I advised her how absolutely disgusting and gross this is!! the front desk clerk tells me I can’t leave the dishes in the hallway on the floor & that house keeping doesn’t pick it up.. she then proceeds to tell me that in-room service dining is supposed to leave the tray table outside and that is where we’re supposed to leave the dishes… I said ok no one left me anything and housekeeping didn’t pick it up so what now??? She tells me she’ll contact them and have some one come right away.. guess what NO ONE CAME… So at check out they didn’t give any paper receipt they would send it to our email… they sent the receipt to my email… 1) I got charged $15 extra for room service without being advised when we literally asked the question at check in &  it was labelled as ‘AFTER HOURS’ on the receipt but it’s supposed to be 24/7 service????2) they used the $200 credit on the in-room service when I was told that was not possible 3) I called after checking out since I only got the receipt by email and the service again still terrible …. No acknowledgement of the issues or even taking responsibly of the misinformation we were given!!!!Overall even through it was a great weekend this hotel is absolutely notorious and should be more empathetic towards people who choose to stay at their hotel!!!!! 😡😡😡😡😡

allReviews.title: Could get better with major improvements
allReviews.text: I just wanna say that this hotel is beautiful. It has gorgeous rooms, amazing restaurants, and everything here is set for success, but I have to say that it needs a lot of work to be a 5 star property. Not once did we have our room cleaned. That wouldn’t be a reason enough for me to never stay here again, but my number one reason for never staying here again is that there is no hot water. Well let me say there is hot water, but it takes 10 minutes to access it And for me that’s just never gonna cut it.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
allReviews.text: This hotel is beautiful. Everyone was very friendly, helpful and good vibes. Our room was very spacious, super clean, and we had a beautiful view. The restaurant Komodo is amazing.  Everything we ordered was so delicious. The server was amazing can’t remember his name but everyone was very nice and attentive to us.

allReviews.title: Awesome gym, Ok suite
allReviews.text: Booked with Alex platinum. Stayed in royal suite with best view. No upgrade. Breakfast only $60 for two people. No priority checkin or direct access elevator for royal suite. Breakfast selection is limited if selected to use credit. Glass window was dirty so I couldn’t really have the best view. We stayed at pretty high floor but could still hear music from the pool right outside. Located far end of strip is not the most convenient. Room was great but AC directly blowing air to me on bed. Shower pressure low and wish there was a separate shower handle. Bathroom has good amenities like razer, toothbrush, Marvis toothpaste. TV poor quality but it got TLC channel. Fitness center was more than awesome but wish all treadmills were technogym.

allReviews.title: My favorite resort
allReviews.text: Fontainebleau has become my favorite hotel. I have stayed at all the major strip resorts, and it is nicer than any. But what really puts it over the top is how every employee seems to go out of the way to be nice to guests. Everyone from the front desk to the maids goes out of their way to be helpful and quite nice.  The room quality is second to none. The rooms are gorgeous with their own unique reserved style. Soft blues with pops of gold and other colors. Nice amenities like robes and slippers, excellent bath products, and essentially a built-in mini-fridge. The bathroom is lovely, functional, and spacious. Many rooms have an excellent view of the Sphere, which adds to the experience. And the resort has its own style. It is beautiful and totally cool but without trying too hard. It has over three thousand beds, but is relatively compact considering the size and is easy to get around once you understand the layout. You realize that it has a unifying theme and style, but it does not hit you over the head with it. I never feel crowded or rushed when in the hotel. Just an enjoyable oasis from which to experience Las Vegas. In short, it just seems to know who it is and does its thing. I just came back from a stay, and stayed there last June as well. It would be better if it were center strip, but It has so much going for it that I am happy to drive elsewhere for a meal or a show. I was by myself but had a great time at the Nowhere Lounge talking to the bartenders and listening to the live band. I also had a great time at Mother Wolf where the server Michelle and manager were very friendly. I will also note that within walking distance Westgate and the Sahara have cheaper eats and entertainment. For that matter, Circus Circus is close, and there is a McDonalds across the street from Fontainebleau. Fontainebleau is slowly gaining clientele and I would take advantage of the lower rates while you can.

allReviews.title: Very nice hotel on end of strip
allReviews.text: Really liked this hotel.  The only downside is that it's on the far end of the strip.  If it was in the middle...I'm sure prices would be much higher.   It's a really nice hotel...seems very modern...well designed.  Free parking is a plus and it's easy to get in and out.  Pool area is very well done with lots of shade opportunity.  Right next door to the convention center.  Overall...would definitely stay here again next time!

allReviews.title: Wynn North
allReviews.text: First the property is large. The openness in the first floor makes it feel very comforting. It never felt crowded even when all the machines ands tables were full. This was refreshing.  The openness also allows no smoke to linger. I never smelled any smoke in the property even with the guy next to me at the center bar smoking a cigar. Amazing. The food is outstanding. Didn't know what to expect> My first meal was a lunch at the Tavern which is the sportsbook restaurant. I had the fish with potato puree. It was amazing. This is the sportsbook! The room service waffle and French pressed coffee was Wynn level room service quality. All the restaurants here are amazing.I stayed at a Gold Level room/ Room was spacious and comfortable. The stand alone in this room was the shower. It was huge. Easily 6 times the size of my home shower. The shower head was high which was great for 6"4 me. also strong water pressure. The spa was great with an amazing massage and great spa amenities.Its the closest hotel on the strip to the Wynn. Excellent service without the Bougie..

allReviews.title: Disappointing Follow-Up Stay After an Incredible Start
allReviews.text: I stayed at Fontainebleau twice in the same week—first with my husband and child last Friday, and then again on Tuesday with my extended family. Our first stay was fantastic. The room was spotless, beautifully designed, and faced the Sphere—everything we hoped for and more. Based on that experience, I was excited to return and had high expectations.Unfortunately, our second visit was a complete letdown. I had booked three rooms and requested that they all be Sphere-facing and on the same floor. At check-in, I was told that wasn’t possible. The only Sphere-facing room available was on a different floor, and the rest had no views. We ended up giving the better room to our larger family group, assuming we’d still be well accommodated.What shocked me most was the front desk’s response: “You should have arrived earlier”—even though we checked in at 4 PM, the official check-in time. The tone felt dismissive and unprofessional.To make matters worse, the room I received was dirty. There were Dorito crumbs on the floor, makeup residue near the bed, dirty carpets I could feel through my slippers, and even pubic hair in the bathroom. It was unacceptable. I took photos because I honestly couldn’t believe the condition.After such a wonderful start to the week, this follow-up experience left a sour taste. I expected consistency in quality and service from a property of this caliber, and sadly, it fell short. I hope the hotel management takes this feedback seriously and improves both its cleanliness standards and customer service moving forward.

allReviews.title: Now the Best luxury in Vegas
allReviews.text: I’m a Vegas veteran and I finally found my favorite place   We’ve stated a lot of the big names down the road several times and even had our favorites but not anymore. This is the one.  From The check-in to the service to the room and the food the pool literally there’s nothing there. That’s not amazing. We’re already planning to go back ASAP.

allReviews.title: We love our stay at Fontainebleau!
allReviews.text: The room was spacious & really nice, the bedding, towels, toiletries were luxurious. The room and the entire hotel was perfectly clean. The staff and service was excellent everywhere in the hotel. The food was delicious in all the restaurant we ate and the drinks at the bars were really good. The food at the Sports Bar was amazing! It's a very safe place. They have beautiful pools and adult pools only. We stayed for an entire week and our stay was literally perfect! We will surely be back!

allReviews.title: Love it!
allReviews.text: Everything is clean and inviting. This resort is truly luxury. The pools sparkled and the adultpool made our vacation so relaxing. Service is top level. We were treated like important guests at every venue. The Tavern, which is supposed to be casual dining, had top notch food and drinks.

allReviews.title: Over the top!!!
allReviews.text: Floor to ceiling windows with view of strip!  Amazing bathroom design, comfy pillows and robes.  Electronic connected drapes to open/close.  Room design and flow was beautiful. Had dinner at Mother Wolf which I highly recommend!!  Pool design is stunning with daybeds and lounges in the pool!!!

allReviews.title: Do not let this hotel ruin your trip
allReviews.text: The hotel is new, but the staffs were not very friendly. We had two reservations from Amex FHR and stayed there for 3 nights. We can hear clearly what people were talking in the hall from our bed. The housekeeper did not clean our room. The empty tissues were not refilled. There was still hair in the shower drainage. They did not hang the ropes that we left on the chairs. And what pissed me the most is that they did not empty the trash! When I checked out my first reservation to check in for the second one, I showed the photos to the front desk manager, and they did not do anything! For such an upper scale hotel, this is definitely not the service that I was expecting.

allReviews.title: Room Perfect!
allReviews.text: First time at the Las Vegas branch as have been to the Fontainebleau hotel in Miami.  This hotel does not disappoint.  Room perfect spacious size, clean, ideal for family of 3. Staff were very friendly and helpful.  Ideal as not so far from Freemont Street and Sphere.  We will definitely be back.

allReviews.title: The Fontainebleu is our Numero Uno!
allReviews.text: The Fontainebleu exceeds all our expectations at all levels- atmosphere, comfort, cleanliness, and gaming.  We play slots and find they have a great selection of games to keep us coming back for more as well as great drink service. The staff is friendly and I appreciate that. This has become our number 1 resort and we’ve stayed at many of the upscale Strip hotels. I have to mention….being close to Tacos el Gordo doesn’t hurt either - best tacos  in town! Fontainebleu is 10/10!!

allReviews.title: Hiding prices for restaurants and spa
allReviews.text: I'm at the hotel now. I wanted to check the different restaurants around the hotel. When I went to the website, no restaurant, from the very best to casual, had no prices listed. I called to ask about getting menus with prices and was told none have any menus with prices, which include the menu you are handed at the restaurant (this is for the more pricy restaurants. I've been coming to Las Vegas for many years. I've stayed at every 5 star restaurant and never have I gone to a restaurant that didn't have published prices. Seriously, if they don't tell you the price when you order, how does one they just aren't making up prices?Every person is entitled to know how much they are paying without making it very embarrassing by having to ask the waiter.I find this practice to be extremely rude to the customers who come to the Fountainebleau.I also found it is very hard to get prices for the spa. I finally found out a 4 hour day pass is $180, whereas other hotels, like The Wynn and Encore charge $100 for a day pass, without a maximum amount of hours. I could actually go to the Encore for $125 all day as someone who is not staying at the Encore. The Encore has an awesome spa.This '5 star' hotel has pretty low prices for rooms right now, and then  they try to get you because the hotel is further away from the strip, but I would say to explore the other restaurants of Las Vegas and let 'other people' eat at very overpriced restaurants which don't tell you the prices.  I'll be eating at Mon Ami Gabi tonight and watch the fountains.Shame on the Fontainebleau.

allReviews.title: Disappointing start
allReviews.text: First off, I will say that hotel is very beautiful and looks very much like a 5-star hotel. Having just redone my upstairs at home, painting it a nice shade of blue, I was looking forward to trying a new hotel in the same shade. I checked in last night. I booked through Amex Fine Hotels which comes with some nice amenities. One amenity is a possible room upgrade. I asked the person checking me in if I got an upgrade and she said yes.I went up to my room and found out my room was at the end of a very long hallway, so that would be #1 of not getting a good room. I waited until morning so I could see the view. The view is horrible. Certainly not one anyone would prefer.I've only seen the view of the Fontainebleau from the strip. I come to Vegas 5 or 6 times a year and only at the finest hotels. My view shows that this hotel is shaped like a U. I'm in the inner part of the U where I can stare at the other part of the hotel, blocking me from any view of the strip. It almost feels like I'm not even in Las Vegas.I'm pretty sure there are plenty of people who book rooms from all kinds of websites, and even then, they would never be happy they were assigned the room I'm in.Basically, putting me in this room totally mocks what American Express is trying to do.I'm here for 4 days, but I actually have another 5 days booked for next week. I think I'll have to change that trips destination to something on the strip.Just really disappointed. I feel like I've been shoved into a corner.

allReviews.title: Beware of using the toiletries in the bathroom
allReviews.text: I am very disappointed that I was charged over $50 for in-room toiletries. I have stayed in some of the best hotels and resorts in the US and abroad and have never had this happen. I had forgotten my body wash and since I was only there overnight, I used the provided toiletries only to now find a charge on my card for the use. Why are they even there if not complimentary? I saw no signage that they were charges for them. Very disappointed.

allReviews.title: Best Casino on the strip
allReviews.text: The Fontainebleau Las Vegas is stunning—modern luxury, upscale dining, and elegant vibes. Gorgeous design, spacious rooms, and top-tier service make it a standout on the Strip. The service is attentive, and the atmosphere is classy without being stuffy. It’s a perfect spot for a refined Vegas getaway—definitely worth the splurge.

allReviews.title: Great Stay
allReviews.text: I’ve stayed in quite a number of hotels in Las Vegas throughout the years, and this property is definitely one of the nicest in town. Check in was super easy and quick and the lobby and casino floor were clean and airy. Our room was great - quite spacious and impeccably clean. The tavern and sports book were great - good vibe and generous pouts at the bar. Yes, I get the complaints that the hotel is a bit removed from the center of The Strip. But you know that when booking here. I actually like the calmer atmosphere and the fact you can walk to the Arts District in about 15 minutes.Only complaint (and I know Vegas has gotten very expensive) is that everything costs a small fortune, from drinks to food.

allReviews.title: Immaculate new property
allReviews.text: Immaculate new property. Great service. Vida was great. Travis is great server. Rooms all new very comfortable. Casino service and pool service best I've seen. Check in and out sooooeasy. Easy access to Uber taxis. Just great place with latest technology and wonderful service.

allReviews.title: Luxury!
allReviews.text: Luxurious and well appointed. From dinning to nightlife…you never have to leave! I certainly did not want to end my vacation. The staff was kind and engaging. The room was sublime. Don’t be discouraged about the end-of-strip location. This resort has everything you need to have a great time in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Wonderful hotel with excellent staff
allReviews.text: Great service. Clean and quiet rooms. Luxurious surroundings. Very helpful attentive staff. Loved our experience! Good selection of restaurants with great food. Staff provided a great room with excellent views. Just ask when checking in.

allReviews.title: Very good hotel
allReviews.text: The hotel is very good, the service, restaurants and bars are nice.  Cleaning of the rooms is ok, but could improve. It was a pleasant stay.  The jazz bar had a great jazz group.  The Collins bar is very nice, I suggest the piano man could perform more time, he finishes at 10 pm and I think it is too early.

allReviews.title: RUDE! Not willing to help find a solution, Extremely Poor!
allReviews.text: Filled out an online form to be contacted. No response.Called earlier today, reservations was going to call me back. No Response.Called again and talked to room reservations AGAIN explaining I needed 2 rooms for 1-0 days (or a suite including 2 sep bedrooms and baths) connecting as traveling with an elderly person who needs assistance. This was not possible, only based on availability upon arrival. I explained again and the need we have and that upon arrival was going to be very tricky and if there's nothing that could be done.Response: we don't do that, have a great day. AND SHE HANG UP!!!!! UNBELIEVABLE!

allReviews.title: Beautiful Hotel with Great Rooms, But Confusing Layout and Frustrating Bathroom Amenities Hold It Back
allReviews.text: Beautiful Hotel with Great Rooms, But Confusing Layout and Frustrating Bathroom Amenities Hold It Back

allReviews.title: Would be awesome if customer service was better
allReviews.text: Aesthetically, the hotel is visually appealing, but your customer service is very unorganized and that contributes to some stressors that guests should not experience.  Your lines were excessively long for checkout, which caused major frustration with several of your guests complaining as they waited for checkout.  You had very few people in your signature guest line, and some of your traffic should have been directed to these areas to cut down on wait times.  I had to request a manager, due to the possibility of missing my flight, because of the long checkout process.  I will say that your guest rooms were clean and spacious, but lacked some features that would be helpful.
