allReviews.title: Had a great time
allReviews.text: Staff was very friendly and accommodating   we got to check in early thanks to the hotel staff......  Looking forward to our return stay

allReviews.title: Excellent!
allReviews.text: Very nice rooms! Excellent service! Will definitely go back. The band High Octane was amazing! And the servers were prompt with drink orders

allReviews.title: Westgate Las Vegas tones of fun
allReviews.text: loads of fun. good live music. Room was great. you can ride the monorail into the strip from the Casino. we had a beautiful server at the bar. her name is Fasika. she was great

allReviews.title: Staff get a big thumbs up!!
allReviews.text: Met Carolyn Lesla when we were getting seated at the Manilow Concert on 6/21.  All of the staff from front door to concert were awesome but she went above and beyond to make sure all of her guests were taken care of.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Westgate
allReviews.text: We were greeted by Jose, Mr.Westgate on arrival and he was fabulous!  He greeted us every time we came or went.  He and my husband had quite the bond.  The room was fabulous!  We ate in two of the restaurants and they were delicious! We also loved the magic show!

allReviews.title: Great Place to Visit—Dining, Shopping, and Fun for All!
allReviews.text: We recently visited Westgate Las Vegas Resort and had a fantastic time! The resort is beautiful and has something for everyone. We dined at the incredible Steakhouse, enjoyed browsing the shops, and my family and friends had a blast gambling.There was a lot to see and do, from gaming and live entertainment to family-friendly spaces that made everyone feel comfortable. The atmosphere was lively but not overwhelming, and the staff we encountered were friendly and helpful.Even though we didn’t stay overnight, we were impressed with the variety of restaurants and activities available. It’s a great place to spend time whether you're looking for fine dining, fun, or just exploring. We’ll definitely be visiting again!

allReviews.title: Happy Couple
allReviews.text: The hotel provided a wonderful experience and an amazing stay. We had the privilege with being greeted by a warm welcome, sparkling smile and welcoming handshake by Jose (Mr. Westgate).  He made us feel welcomed and at home.  He was very helpful with providing information on activities at the hotel and with making himself available if we needed assistance. He was also a snazzy dresser.  We look forward to coming back again.

allReviews.title: Worst Hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: I find it unfathomable that anyone would rate this hotel higher than 1 or 2 stars.  It's old, in a terrible location and is poorly maintained.  My room in the central tower has a non-working TV (have called twice but no one came), the toilet barely flushes and every surface is sticky.    I visited the pool, but it's tiny and garbage is littered everyhwere.  There is no staff to clean up and no visible garbage receptacles for people to toss their own trash out.  The result is complete filth.  Avoid buying anything in the hotel - water runs $5-6 in the gift shop.  Don't plan on doing any work here as the internet is awful.  Speedtest shows download speeds of only 3.87 Mbps which is not fast enough to maintain a stable connection.  Internet drops in and out constantly.   Only positives so far - the air conditioner seems to be working well.  Unless you must stay here for a convention or other event, don't stay here.

allReviews.title: Thanks For Being Kind
allReviews.text: John S. The Greeter welcomed us and graciously took photos of our group and directed us to the concert. He was super nice as were all the staff we encountered.

allReviews.title: Jimmy is the best!!!

allReviews.title: Keep on Top of Housekeeping
allReviews.text: I have stayed at the Westgate in Las Vegas on many occasions without any issues. This recent visit was very different. I was visiting with 2 teenage grandchildren aged 16/17 straying in one room. The room itself wasn't on a level with others I have stayed in on previous visits. The cleanliness was disappointing. We arrived on a Saturday and by Monday had to find housekeeping staff to request clean towels as no-one had been to our room. I checked at reception what the room cleaning policy was to be told daily. I explained our situation and was assured a note would be passed to housekeeping advising our room was to be cleaned. This didn't happen. We left most mornings to do some sightseeing returning to our room after 17:00 to find the room as we left it nobody from housekeeping had been in. This was a daily experience. I did complain and said I wanted to speak to a manager but  no one contacted me. On our last day the housekeeping staff were only a few doors away.  I asked them to just leave clean towels as we were leaving the next morning. On our return there was a housekeeping supervisor on the floor. I spoke to her about the problems and asked her to come into the room to check what I was speaking about. Once again the dirty towels were still lying in the shower. She noted the problems with cleanliness and left to bring us clean towels. No one contacted me before we left. It was necessary to have clean towels as the weather was so hot a shower was needed in the morning then again on return. I did meet other people who had the same issue and had complained about the same issue.On the plus side the hotel despite being off strip is right next to the monorail which is perfect for traveling up and down the strip. I bought a 5 day ticket which gives unlimited journeys. It's cheaper to buy online. It's a quick way to  see all of the hotels and stops regularly.

allReviews.title: Mr Westgate

allReviews.title: The hotel ambience was great, everything else was atrocious
allReviews.text: Pros first. Great ambience. Felt like the prototypical Vegas hotel. The valet guys were awesome. On to the cons. The room was hot - I mentioned it when checking in and no one was sent to my room until well after midnight. At which point I was told that they could come back in the morning to repair - but we were leaving early so no luck there. The second point is especially vile. I paid in full with Priceline, a fact explicitly confirmed at check in, only to be told that because they had a vague “other fees” clause, they then could charge an extra $51.I get it. Hotels need to make $$$. But they need to be upfront about the total cost. According to Westgate they could have charged any amount as per the terms. I literally asked “Could it have been $200” and was told yes, those are the terms. So if you want to play roulette (ha) with the actual price you’re paying, stay at Westgate. Just like their casino, the house always wins.

allReviews.title: Soul of Motown is a fun, worthy show.

The four performers cover a comprehensive selection of Motown greats from Sam Cooke, Smokey Robinson and Aretha Franklin to Earth, Wind and Fire and Stevie Wonder and more. On the night I was there, the audience was enthusiastic and several times got up and danced. Compared to another Motown show in Vegas, “The Soul of Motown” is far superior. I rate the show 4.5 out of 5 stars.

allReviews.title: Rapidly went down hill

Some of the lights didn’t work, the rooms were not serviced for four days and only after complaint made. The water was shut off without any warning for a repair. The shower had less pressure than I could spit. The place is full of prostitues who pester you at the bar. Totally ruined my trip.I had to complain to seven people before getting to speak to a manager who more or less told me the issues were my problem. I asked if I could pay for a late check out until 6pm they said no but due to the issues I’d had they would give me a late check out until 3pm for free! Four hours more in the room for all of that trouble. Appalling service. Stayed in the hotel before but I won’t be back thankfully there is thousands of choice in Las Vegas

allReviews.text: Just back from an amazing week at the NAFCSC Convention. Great time with family and friends from Canada, US, Australia, Ireland and Scotland and made many new friends as we do every convention. Cant thank the Committee of NAFCSC enough and also all the great staff of Westgate for making it such a great time.Looking forward to 2027 which im sure will be even bigger and better.

allReviews.title: celtic convention in Vegas
allReviews.text: Great place to go , not far from the strip, but easily accessible on the monorail.really enjoyed it but the Celtic fans made it better.Hotel rooms large and very comfy all the staff were very helpful and courteous.facilities like the pool and fitness room were top class

allReviews.title: Unsatisfied with house keeping.
allReviews.text: As I walked in the room I saw a big coffee stain on the wall and crumbs of food in n the edges of the wall. Also dust bunnies everywhere including the night stand. The clock looked like it had not been wiped in months. Glad the microwave and mini fridge was clean.Check in was smooth and the best communication with explanations I ever had.  I actually felt a warm welcome upon my arrival.

allReviews.title: Jose the smiling doorman. What an asset
allReviews.text: Jose the doorman was a joyAlways smiling and spreading happiness.He is a total asset to the hotel.Bar prices are very expensive and need reviewed.Sports book cafe menu needs updated been the same menu for years.Would be good if they opened SIDS for dinner

allReviews.title: Don’t stay here
allReviews.text: The Westgate is a redo of the Hilton. First even though they say they do daily  housekeeping then skipped our room 2 of 4 days and had to call repeatedly to get service. Their pool is impossible to use as folks saved multiple chairs that were never used. The pool has cabanas that sat empty because they charge $100 on weekdays and $300 on weekends. They had one breakfast restaurant, Sid’s, where a standard breakfast was $24. I suggest you look for a different property to stay at.

allReviews.title: Favorite Place to play craps in Vegas for several years, finally writing a review.
allReviews.text: Been going to this casino to stay and attend their amazing annual super bowl party for several years.  Went in April for a Conference that was being held nearby and as always enjoyed my stay and especially the great craps dealers including Ed and Shaun.  Looking forward to my next stay already!

allReviews.title: Average
allReviews.text: We wanted somewhere off the strip but close enough to head over when we wanted - so in that sense, it was ideal. The hotel itself was clean and staff was super friendly. The convenience to the monorail was perfect. The eatery options were limited; however, the food was great. We ate at Sid's, Benihana and Fresco Italiano. The beds were incredibly loud and there was no door separating the sink. I understand separating the shower/toilet from the rest of the bathroom, but there was absolutely no way to get up in the morning and sneak out without waking the entire room. You could not brush your teeth without turning on a light that lit up the entire sleeping area. In addition, the seating arrangements at the pool had no comparison to the size of the hotel. People were waiting in the line for the pool to open and those that didn't make it upon opening, just laid their towels on the concrete everywhere you looked. Overall, our stay was fine but would likely not stay there again.

allReviews.title: Vegas golf trip.
allReviews.text: The resort is exceptional, I am recommending Westgate. The front desk helped with making this a memorable state. There's only one complaint, there's not enough no smoking area's. The sport betting area was the largest that I've ever seen. All of the guest services employees did a great job.

allReviews.title: Ooh La La La!
allReviews.text: Room rates were very good. Loved our suite..it was better than we expected. Highly recommend staying at this hotel. Valet os $20 per day..lower than average.  Decor is nice here too. They ate several restaurants located in this hotel including Benihanas.

allReviews.title: Hail hail
allReviews.text: Welcomed by all the staff while there for the Celtic convention. Big shout to José at the front door. Legend. Massive pool party. Recommend this for any Celtic fan. Thanks to all the staff for a fantastic week of madness. Your patience has been appreciated

allReviews.title: Looking GREAT for her age!
allReviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay. The Westgate is a well maintained and very clean classic casino resort. Its staff at all levels are professional and dedicated to its customers having a great time. They offer many types of eateries for all tastes and budgets. We tried out The Loop which is outside the main lobby and via a Tesla using an underground tunnel were transported to Resorts World on the strip in 5 minutes at a round trip fare of $6.25 per person. The International Bar featured nightly musical entertainment during our visit.

allReviews.title: Large, clean rooms
allReviews.text: Large rooms, clean, quiet. $12 uber to the strip/$6 monorail ride (not walkable).  Looks like a place out of the 70s but kept up really well. Pool is small and was crowded with a convention happening. Maria D. In the shoppette was great and very friendly. Good value for the money.

allReviews.title: Speaking my truth.
allReviews.text: Overall experience was great. I have the best host Martin Kunkel who always takes very good care of me.I’ve met a few casino floor managers since I’ve been visiting who are consistently warm and charismatic, namely - Robert, I call him OG because he’s got that smooth finesse about him, very helpful and calm yet carrying out his job efficiently. Nady ( not sure I’m getting the name correct but she’s a petite Asian lady) who is always warm and welcoming. Jacqueline is also very warm and welcoming and I feel as if I’ve known her for a very long time. Though they are working, you some how get the feeling that they are on your side and that’s how guests want to feel. Even though the realty may not be true but it gives some level of comfort. Last but not least, my favorite dealer Emma. She’s very polite, respectful and friendly. Empathetic when players get a bad beat etc, it is a good feeling for players. She’s the best, there are some good stick men and women in craps I can’t remember their name. Now I’ve highlighted the good. I also would like to mentioned one bad experience I had when I was winning. Victor as a Pitt boss should have a better poker face, his annoyance and disgust was too obvious and the players should never see that. It was a very big turn off because when I lose, I have a very good temperament so there is no reason I should be encountering that kind of behavior when I’m winning. When I’m winning I tip the dealers very well and I never get rude or anything. That was not nice and it’s my first time letting it known that I noticed. It was 2 gentleman, I cannot recall the other name but Victor was the worst.To make it even more weird, I was at a blackjack table loosing and rebought and then he wanted to be nice and funny about my movie star name, feel like it was so hypocritical that he could be nice when I’m loosing but was so disgruntled when I was winning.I didn’t even play craps for the rest of my trip because of that. Anyways that is just one or two people out of hundreds. I think the service is good overall.RB.

allReviews.title: Disappointing
allReviews.text: Quiet, spacious  room and some helpful staff. However, Priceline didn't disclose resort fee and Westgate Mgr Joann refused to allow check in to prepaid room unless I paid an additional $200. Since this violates the FTC's anti-junk fee rule, maybe Westgate needs to stop contracting with room sellers that (per Joann) they know may withhold fee disclosures instead of dumping the problem on unsuspecting guests. Also, room could be cleaner.

allReviews.title: Craig gets a raise!
allReviews.text: This is the second time that I have had so much trouble with my room, from the bed, the lack of air the hot water in my jacuzzi not working. In those couple of times the only one that has ever helped was Craig in the owner's C/I. This is the only man that is keeping me from seeking legal actions to get out of my contract for the lack of professionalism in the hotel industry. This man needs recognition for him trying to fix all of the problems the Westgate has given me.

allReviews.title: Will definitely stay again
allReviews.text: Excellent accommodations!  Great view of the Sphere!  Pool is wonderful.   Very quiet room.  Shower had ample water pressure.  Microwave and mini fridge is nice to have.  Also having a safe in the room was nice!  Would highly recommend staying at Westgate resort.

allReviews.title: Great Stay Westgate Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino was a great hotel. The front desk staff at check in were friendly and very accommodating. The rooms were clean and housing keeping did a great job. The casino staff were friendly and professional.Great place to stay!

allReviews.title: Let's improve customer service at the Las Vegas West Gate.
allReviews.text: The suite was the best part of the vacation.  Jimmy the bellhop was delightful.  The ladies (both) at the Wow desk are in dire need of Customer Service training.  They are rude and uncaring about your clients. We visited Edge and found the main waiter to be extremely uncaring with his remarks. We simply asked " how was the chicken prepared?" He answered it's a half chicken , you don't know? We left the restaurant and went to Fresco where we recieved perfect customer service.To sum it up....this place needs to take customer service serious.

allReviews.title: Concert
allReviews.text: I saw several concerts here, and I really enjoyed them because the sound system is great in the venue. They also have great artists that come to perform here. I have never stayed here, but maybe one day I will. I don’t have any more to say, but it won’t let me continue without saying something more.

allReviews.title: Staff are worth a return visit
allReviews.text: The staff was 5 stars friendly,  the lady  employee at the information desk went out of her way to show us where the restaurants were, Tim at the venue was super nice and made us feel at ease!!  The Venue staff were very pleasent.  The rooms were nice  and comfy

allReviews.title: Unfortunate…
allReviews.text: Venue was amazing. Service was great. Performance was unfortunate. Graham Russells voice definitely aged, as was his ability to performance.  His vocal range was very limited.  His age was definable evident, whereas Russell Hitchcock performed amazingly, creating the time warp that was hoped for.

allReviews.title: My ear buds were found and returned, im very thankful the food service lady was extremely rude and disrespectful t
allReviews.text: My ear buds were found and returned, im very thankful the food service lady was extremely rude and disrespectful t

allReviews.title: Good time
allReviews.text: Fun time. Amazing. Great experience rooms are dated. We had fun with Coco. She was amazing. I loved the experience. Fun trip with my friends. Old style hotel and amenities. Water issues at hotel the whole time, but were resolved quickly. It was fine

allReviews.title: Great service
allReviews.text: Dre and Rex were amazing at check-in—friendly, professional, and efficient. They made us feel welcome right away. Rooms were spotless and comfortable. Great service. Will definitely recommend this hotel to friends and family………………..

allReviews.title: Air Supply was AWESOME!
allReviews.text: Air Supply was an excellent show! I would see them again. The venue is small, and every seat is great. There is easy parking and great restaurant choices.  Air Supply rocked it. The crowd was singing their songs, and we all had a great time!  I will see them again in October.

allReviews.title: The attention of Mrs. Leda of the spa
allReviews.text: The service is great, the.facilities very nice but a little old. We helped Mrs. LEDA to process 1 limousine service and it was exceptional, we are very grateful. More staff like her make hotels great. THANK YOU

allReviews.title: Air Supply concert
allReviews.text: Air Supply was amazing even after wll these years! We wanted the show to go on all night! The Westgate is sn awesome venue for top quality events. The seating is awedome and the sight lines were great! We are looking forward to our next trip to Las Vegas where we can experience the sights and sounds only Vegas can provide.

allReviews.title: Absolutely a Must See Show !!!!
allReviews.text: Air Supply 50th anniversary show !!!  Fantastic !!!  Closed my eyes and I was back in my youth !!!  Absolutely loved the show, they are phenomenal after all these years.  Purchased the Meet and Greet package and would do it again; in fact, I am thinking of the October show so purchase your tickets soon before I take the last two !!!

allReviews.title: AIR SUPPLY 50TH ANNIVERSARY CONCERT
allReviews.text: Me and my husband of 31 years attended the 50th Anniversary concert of AIR SUPPLY and we were astounded.  Their performance was remarkably unchanged after all these years, even if I compare it to 2 previous Air Supply concerts I've seen during my college days in the Philippines in the 1990's era.My husband was impressed at our seating area on the left stage balcony, he thought I paid extra because there's a mini bar table in between us covered with black tablecloth... well voila, it's the VIP seating for Barry Manilow concert show!I just want to add that  this concert was the very first concert we attended as a couple after 31 years.  We were quite disappointed because Air Supply did not sing our love song, NOW AND FOREVER.As far as the Westgate Hotel, we give them a 4 star for having the concert venue not far from the main lobby/valet drop off. It was super convenient for both of us who are 100% disabled military veteran, because we don't have to walk too far. We will try to come back for some fun & games next time!

allReviews.title: Son's pool tournament
allReviews.text: Great show. They both sure can sing! I had an eigh track tape and cassette tapes of them when I was young cruising around. My son only knew a few songs but I knew all of them. Their band did really good also. Very talented bunch! If I ever got the chance, I would see them again. Not a bad seat in the house.

allReviews.title: Brooke Wilkes - Live music in Las Vegas!!
allReviews.text: Came to Westgate and heard this beautiful voice in the lobby area. Came over to watch the show and was blown away. Live music is so hard to find these days. And a free show right there for all to enjoy. Brooke Wilkes was so great. We will come again!

allReviews.title: Wonderful time & amazing staff
allReviews.text: We always enjoy our stay at Westgate Resorts Las Vegas! The staff is always polite and accommodating. The rooms are spacious and keep clean. I would like to specifically recognize Tammy and Delcia from the floor beverage service. They were exceptionally attentive during our stay, ensuring we were taken care of and our drinks never ran dry. Thank you for another wonderful experience.

allReviews.title: R&B soul, that you love that you can’t sit down on
allReviews.text: Michael speaks in the Westgate Resort,Casino, Resort, Casino, Las, at the international bar. Oh man he can  sing OK you sound beautiful oh dear God beautiful take me back to Motown. Sean, with the crown on match song selection is so diverse. I never knew what was coming next Doobie Brothers Michael McDonald even went back to Marvin, Gaye and Al Green. Please have them here every week once or twice a week is not enough.

allReviews.title: Westgate  weekend filled with entertainment
allReviews.text: I recently went to Westgate Memorial  Day weekend and Wrestlemania weekend. It was very close to the Convention  Center and perfect option. It is also located next to the tram, which can take you within walking distance  to Allegiant  Stadium on Haciena. It made for the perfect weekend. It is a very clean hotel, rich with history. Elvis Presley performed there, back in the day. The food was very good. I always get the Magerita  pizza at Fresco.The entertainment  was outstanding. Monday  night featured singer Kelly  Christian,  who played  a vast array  of classic rock tunes. It was packed. We always check his show out..I will be back again soon. Wrestlemania  is heading back in April.  The whole week last time was filled with Wrestle con.  Fourth of July  sounds like a good vacation too.Debora Alexandra

allReviews.title: Staff are nice!
allReviews.text: Mr. Rex Ricarte was very helpful and pleasant! We didn’t know where the pick up point of the hotel and he guided us happily! Other staff of the hotel including the housekeepers are also always happy to help! We had a fantastic stay because of them!

allReviews.title: Westgate Resorts and hotel great experience!
allReviews.text: The staff and all were extremely nice they went above and beyond to make us feel at home. Our hotel stay was awesome!  Beautiful Westgate rooms and lots of Elvis if you love Elvis! The hotel scenery and views from the rooms were sensational. Clean and spacious. Couldn’t ask for a better hotel!

allReviews.title: Dissapointed
allReviews.text: I have stayed at Westgate LV many many times and loved staying here every time however on my last trip to this hotel on 5/23 weekend it was absolutely embarrassing. I took a family member that is visiting out of the country and I had to constantly apologize to her, to start they are charging $20 a day for Valet,  we got 2 rooms on the central tower, horrible tower, there were crumbs all over the hallway and did not get cleaned the entire weekend, stains on the nightstand which I had to clean myself, water drip from the faucet, restroom did not have a vent, the shower tub was dirty and many other little things.. as if that was not enough they have hired young kids to run the check in without any trainings  by the pool who handled the customer service so poorly,  we rented a cabana by the pool and had even worst experience, we were treated so poorly without any guidance or service to know where I was supposed to go so we had to go find our way around and serve ourselves because the staff was busy playing around.   We addressed the issues with the staff management, and did not take anything they offered as I was not interested, I addressed it so they know that the experience guests are having is affecting their business, I was not the only one with complains, I met a group of people in the elevator who left the poolside to leave because they were so dissatisfied.  After this weekend experience I am very disappointed at the hospitality and  I will not stay at this hotel again.

allReviews.title: The Year-Round Halloween Suite is a Hoot
allReviews.text: The year-round Halloween Suite at the Westgate Las Vegas is a hoot:  a combination of funny and unnerving.  You'll laugh at how intimidated your friends are...while you're pretending you're not intimidated.  The Westgate's year-round Halloween Suite is the perfect place for a birthday party.

allReviews.title: Roulette
allReviews.text: Barry M. Made the experience at the roulette table fun it was my first time playing and he quickly and kindly explained the rules and had great conversation! I definitely will be visiting roulette table again!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

allReviews.title: Best Stay Ever
allReviews.text: I had so much planned for my trip to Las Vegas but once I got in my room and relaxed I decided to enjoy the resort instead. The bed was like sleeping on clouds. My view from the bed was amazing. Food was great, atmosphere was great, and staff were exceptional! Pool was so relaxing and I rode the Monorail which was connected to resort. I purchased a timeshare. I had a personal driver upon checkout to the airport. I highly recommend Westgate Resort.

allReviews.title: VNEA Championships
allReviews.text: Having a great time here at the Westgate.  Here to play pool for VNEA World Championships.  Great venue for that and had a great time after. I don't what else to say here. Not sure why I need more characters since I am over 200.  This 200 thing is annoying.

allReviews.title: Westgate
allReviews.text: Excellent place to  stay!  Cheryl Hayes is a great blackjack dealer, made the table fun and exciting.   Plenty of good places to eat in the Westgate,  and all the people that work there are super friendly, at least the ones we encountered.  Would stay here again.

allReviews.title: Excellent service!
allReviews.text: Deborah was the most pleasant dealer at the westgate! She has such a warm personality and the swing shift pit bosses were great as well!!!  Definitely will play the table games when she is dealing! Highly recommend playing when she is on duty!

allReviews.title: Worst experience in 23 years
allReviews.text: Hi yes. So after being told our spa experience will be put on our room I was charged an additional $100 as the manager explained “to make sure I could pay”. Something I have never experienced before in my 20 years of being an owner. This was disgusting and unnecessary. You can just say no pay in full. Now the night before my wedding you unnecessarily took more money from us and got my card flagged. Spoke to a manger who said “well you’re staying for a week so we need $200 deposits. I asked where it’s stated she said it’s not stated it’s how it is. She then said that to make sure we can pay they charge $100 over any costs put on the room over $100. I asked WHERE IS THIS POLICY STATED!  She said it’s how it is. “What would you do if it was your business? You would let people rack up $1000 bills and not pay?” This disgusting woman should be fired. I am seeking every avenue to sever any further involvement with Westgate including removing this new deed we recently engaged to purchase. This treatment is absurd and disgusting. Not sure if you saw two black men and thought yes just make sure they can pay. Despite me having been already charged a security deposit. Pathetic treatment of “Elite Owners.” I will not be ignored. Traveled 1400 miles to be disrespected on the eve of our wedding.

allReviews.title: Shelly H
allReviews.text: The Air Supply concert was amazing. The employee Shelly H was a wonderful help. She was very kind and personable. She exudes joy for her job and the costumers. Shelly H is an asset to your team. She is diligent and hard working. I was able to witness her working with customers and helping to organize the crowds/merch line. One can tell she truly enjoys her work.

allReviews.title: Disappointing
allReviews.text: My family and I love staying at Westgate, we’ve been staying here when it used to be Hilton, all of us are platinum members. However in all the years we’ve stayed here we never went to the pool until today. This weekend is Memorial Day weekend so I booked the hotel and booked a day bed to celebrate our first time using their pool. Unfortunately it will be our first and last time booking a day bed here. Nothing wrong with the hotel rooms, we love our rooms but the service we received from our cocktail waitress was disappointing. She kept forgetting about us and it took her awhile to check on us. By the time we were ready to leave, she never came back with our to-go boxes we had asked for over an hour ago + the check so we can close the tab. We had asked her 4 times for a to-go box and 2 times for the check and she ended up not coming back with either. We asked a nice lifeguard walking by and he got our to-go boxes immediately and brought the manager along with the check. The manager named Emma gave us her personal number and told us she would give us a drink on her at the bar. This was a nice gesture from her and it helped make the experience less disappointing. However we still won’t be purchasing another daybed in the future for our future stays here at the Westgate.

allReviews.title: Ushers Patty McCarthy & Valerie are real gems!
allReviews.text: Seeing Barry Manilo at Westgate Casino was a wonderful experience thanks to my ushersPatty McCarthy and Valerie. They were warm welcoming and very accommodating, not to mention doing their jobs with beautiful smiles Thanks, Patty and Valerie for adding to my wonderful evening with Barry Manilo. Hope to see you gals in the not too distant future. : )

allReviews.title: Always great
allReviews.text: We love staying at Westgate. Elenette at the front desk was very courteous and sweet. Housekeeping was great when we needed toilet paper. Love the monorail it makes everything so accessible. The food options are delicious. Can't wait to come back.

allReviews.title: Amazing EDC weekend getaway trip!
allReviews.text: Amazing trip! Couldn’t have asked for anything more. It was a one stop kinda vacation. Food, entertainment, shopping and a bit of slots created the best experience. We went for EDC and stayed extra days for the fun of Westgate! The location was convenient and the service was quick for such a packed weekend in Vegas. 10/10 recommend!

allReviews.title: The Westgate is a great spot for a Vegas Stay!
allReviews.text: The Westgate has been a consistently good experience for me over the past few years.  They are close to the convention center.  The various food options are good.  Whether you want a sports lounge (SuperBook), or Italian (Fresco Italiano)  or something fun (Benihana) there is something for you.  The bar up by the table games always has a great team working there.  Alex has been there for years and every time I am there he is kind and always does a great job.  The rooms are clean and updated.  I love the "rain" shower heads!  If you are heading to Vegas this is consistanly a good experience.

allReviews.title: A Nice Hotel Off the Strip
allReviews.text: My preferred hotel in Las Vegas is the Wynn, but they wanted $650 a night and we were there for Frankie Valli and the Four Seasons and they were at the Westgate.  The property is not in the strip but is on the monorail line with easy access.  It is clean and comfortable.  The newer pool area is very nice.  The front desk line was kinda long but they were very busy.  We would stay there again.

allReviews.title: Calling all Fanilows!  Stay at Westgate!!
allReviews.text: Large clean rooms and super friendly staff.  Thanks for the Sphere view. The monorail brings you to the front door. Many thanks to housekeeping and Kiasha Adams in lost and found for their honesty and integrity!! Love Sid's for breakfast. And DO see Barry Manilow!!

allReviews.title: Friendly Hotel and Amazing Employees
allReviews.text: Rooms are excellent, housekeeping, restaurants, the sports book so big. Winning the slots and table games was the most exciting part especially the roulette and the dealer (Ivaylo) very friendly and helpful for us but the most exciting is the pit boss (Rio) very funny, make us comfortable staying in a game all night. 5 stars kudos Westgate.

What a great experience. Westgate resort was very clean and staff was very friendly. Great atmosphere and high octane put on a great show! 10/10 This is our first time in Vegas and we are having a blast. Love all the live entertainment and performances!

allReviews.title: Great Customer Service/Great Food
allReviews.text: I attended a conference at the Westgate. The hotel team was AMAZING! Team members Rex and Jimmy were great ! Great customer service!Also, the food at The Edge Steakhouse, Benihana’s, and the restaurants were all great. The Elvis show was great! Very family friendly!!!!

allReviews.title: Excellent Security
allReviews.text: We were unfortunately locked out of our room but security was quickly there to let us in.  The security officer, Gay Magnuson, was very quick to arrive and very professional.  As we were going through the security questions to gain access we found out that she is also from our area.  Thank you Gay!!!

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow at Westgate
allReviews.text: Great concert and Valarie was our usher and she upgraded our seats, which was amazing! She was so friendly and this made our experience extra special. Barry still sounds great and is an incredible performer. Incredible that he can sing and move like he does at his age!

allReviews.title: Our room had a cockroach!
allReviews.text: There was a cockroach in our room! Overall, the room was not very clean and the staff was not friendly. Nancy, the front desk Manager was the only helpful staff member we encountered. The other front desk person we dealt with actually rolled her eyes at me when I showed her a picture of the roach in our room.

allReviews.title: Wonderful experience
allReviews.text: My friend and I were at Westgate to see Barry Manilow. Jose ... Mr Westgate met us at the lobby door and took our photos. We met up with other friends who were staying at Westgate. We had a wonderful time at the show & enjoyed seeing Barry Manilow.

allReviews.title: Loving all my Westgate stays!
allReviews.text: I stay twice a year and everyone is so friendly from the Valet to housekeeping. They remember who you are. Ots more of a family feel than customer service. Would recommend Westgate to all. Restaurant options are a variety. Casino is always a fun evening to hang out with friends or just gamble.

allReviews.title: Vegas Baby!!!
allReviews.text: Michael speaks duo in the international bar at west gate resort. The show is incredible and gaging. Had a grey time!!! His voice was amazing. The audience loved him. Will definitely come back. The live time international show is so entertaining and interesting

allReviews.title: Give Jonathan Castro a Raise
allReviews.text: Jonathan Castro from Facilities was awesome!  He fixed our AC issues like almost immediately.  Great work by Jonathan Castro and the team to fix all the issues within the building.  Place and rooms are nice.  👍🏾.  The view could be better, but I am not picky.

allReviews.title: Gotta Visit the Westgate Resort.
allReviews.text: Best resort to stay at ever!  The resort thinks of everything for your comfort.  Great places to eat, great shows, pool, casino, rooms, signage, taxi service, knowlegeable about the city, help no matter where you go.  Loved every aspect of the Westgate resort.

allReviews.title: Very pleasant experience
allReviews.text: This hotel and casino hosted the APA national pool tournament. They did a splendor job It was beautifully coordinated vendors were top-notch and then the casino very clean fun machines the floor help including drinks or top-notch They were very busy too we were there when Vegas was a little slow this week but they were busy and it says something

allReviews.title: Mr Westgate Jose
allReviews.text: We've been coming to this hotel for over 10 years now.  We love the atmosphere.  The food at the food court is delicious!  They have live music by the bar   my favorite part is seeing Mr Westgate himself Jose.  He's always greeting everyone with a beautiful smile when you walk into the hotel. He's always dressed so dapper!!  My favorite part! He's super friendly and gives everyone his full attention when you ask him a question.  I love seeing him every year ❤️

allReviews.title: Tyler T-Front Desk
allReviews.text: Tyler T.  at the front desk was amazing. He made my check in process easy. He was very very knowledgeable. He gave me information on how to get around  Vegas without a car. I did appreciate he said if I needed anything let him know. When you check in ask for Tyler.  Thank you Tyler

allReviews.title: Late April 2025 Westgate Las Vegas trip
allReviews.text: The staff is top notch at the Westgate Las Vegas. It all starts with the doorman, then the ladies at the check in front desk, the casino dealers and pit bosses, the sportsbook staff and bartenders at the sportsbook, and the the housekeeping staff…. All the staff was friendly, competent, and professional during my stay. The rooms are clean and good size. The Live music every night in the casino main bar area is awesome. I have zero complaints about my stay at the Las Vegas Westgate. The sportsbook is huge. I believe it’s the biggest in the world per square foot. Breathtaking the first time I saw the sportsbook in person. I will stay with the Westgate again and I would recommend to anyone looking for a nice place to stay in Las Vegas , go check out the Westgate Las Vegas. You won’t regret it.

allReviews.title: Mom’s bucket list trip to Vegas
allReviews.text: Antonio and Martha and Jemil  were unbelievable. They were our ambassador for breakfast. So welcoming they informed us on so many great things about the hotel. They’re super friendly and very attentive. You have a great crew. They deserve recognition absolutely 💯 we are on a family vacation from Miami having a great time.

allReviews.title: High Octane

allReviews.title: Old School Charm & Modern Style
allReviews.text: Oh Westgate, I can't wait to return to you. I am a history nerd, and so when I was going to Vegas for work conference at the Las Vegas Convention Center, and when I saw this option for this hotel I instantly took it because of its history. My dad was into Elvis, so I knew it was where Elvis' did his historic residency and so many more performers and artists I adore. I admit, I have a thing for mid-century American history. Staying there, though, it's clear that it is not the 1970s anymore. Everything is modern, but the decor still has that old-school classy Vegas charm. There is a really lovely mix of gold and black and everything is sleek and clean. I could totally see Frank Sinatra hanging out here, maybe to piss Elvis off. The beds are really comfortable and clean and for me it's the perfect size resort (I got very very lost going to a show at the Venetian one night. Beautiful but it's a village in a village). I'm originally from LA, I went to Vegas once twenty years ago, and I was pretty sure I hated it. But after staying here at the Westgate, I'm already booking my next trip. I can't wait to come back. With the monorail and the loop, plus honestly a lot of things are walkable. The LVCC is about ten minutes walking. I can't recommend this hotel enough. And if you are lucky enough to be there when Barry is in town, or when one of the King Comes Home shows is on, or an evening with Elvis' brother David Stanley, treat yourself. You won't regret it - and try to do the backstage tour of the theater! So cool, I am so glad I got to do it. Until next time....

allReviews.title: SID'S CAFE MANAGER TIARA THE BEST!!
allReviews.text: Excellent trip to Westgate Las Vegas! Great Property, Great Dining & Excellent Service Staff! While all my trips to WGLV have been fantastic, I felt it necessary to write this review due to one specific situation involving a specific WGLV staff member, Ms. Tiara of Sid's Cafe! One of the highlights of my trips to WGLV is weekend breakfast at Sid's and specifically their Buttermilk Pancakes (out of this world delicious)! The specific situation on my most recent trip visiting Vegas from Arizona began by going to Sid's this particular weekend for breakfast and indeed ordering (as usual) pancakes, however upon doing so my server informed me that pancakes were not available as they were only serving a "limited" breakfast menu. I mentioned to the server that I have always ordered the pancakes at Sid's and they were always available on the menu, and I was perplexed about what had changed. The server informed me that many breakfast items were no longer made available after 11am and only a few breakfast items could be ordered after 11am. I asked the server if there was any way an exception could be made and the server proceeded to inform me that he would ask. He then came back to my table to tell me the kitchen said no. Upon hearing this disappointing information, Ms. Tiara (the  Manager) came over to my table to inquire about the ability to assist. Upon speaking with Tiara and explaining the situation to her, she went into the kitchen to address this situation. Ms. Tiara came back to my table after a brief visit to the kitchen and informed me that a Hot fresh order of pancakes were being prepared in the kitchen and would soon be on their way to my table. A few minutes later a hot fresh stack of buttermilk pancakes were brought to my table for what turned out to be the BEST BREAKFAST EVER! Ms. Tiara is simply Professionalism Personified! Ms. Tiara's actions turned a disappointing situation into a professional opportunity to completely turn around a situation of disappointment into one of great pleasure and appreciation! Ms. Tiara is exactly what a management level employee in a hospitality setting should be, Professional, accommodating, courteous and going the extra mile for the guest! A big THANK YOU to Ms. Tiara!! WGLV Management, I have two STRONG Recommendations/Suggestions for you.... First, place the Pancakes back on the all day dining menu (you're in a Las Vegas market where people eat breakfast all hours of the day) and second, acknowledge Ms. Tiara's efforts at Sid's! People like her are hard to come by and are Difference Makers!!
