As soon as I walked in, Jose immediately greeted me with a warm smile.  I explained to him that I was having trouble checking in and he helped right away and was so helpful and knowledgable.  Lisette was at the front desk and gave us the room, she was also very sweet and welcoming.

allReviews.title: Great staff

allReviews.title: Amazing!  Loved every minute of it!
allReviews.text: What a great show!  Soul of Motown!  That was some great entertainment. Had us clapping, on our feet and dancing. A must to go see.  When I come back to Westgate, I will do it again, for sure. What a great performance and a great night. #soulofmotownvegas

allReviews.title: Excellent Service and Delicious Food, Westgate Hotel and Casino
allReviews.text: Went to Westgate Hotel and Casino for dinner at Benihana’s.  On arrival we were met by 3 hostesses who immediately found us a table for 5.  The server was there within minutes taking the initial order and we had a beverages within 5 minutes.  The server explained about the cooking grill and where the chief would be working.  Must compliment the ambiance of the restaurant, low lighting with ancient of red lights.  In the Center of the restraint is an indoor flowing stream with several fish.  The stream is in a lower level and is adorned with lighted trees, benches to sit and relax.  Our Chief came in and introduced himself, he went over again the individual orders of everyone in our party.  The chef explained the dipping sauces he had made for out menu order (ginger sauce along with Mustard ginger sauce) Then the Chef began his presentation of cooking and culinary talents.  Onion Volcano, onion train locomotive and the smoothest effort getting the vegetable onto the grill and seasoning them to perfection.    The steaks were cooked and seasoned well and when served finally cut into bite size portions, the sauce explained did enhance the streak on the pallet.  During the 5 course dinner both the chef and server were very personal engaging in conversation, asking what we were doing in Vegas and how long we were staying.  They offered suggestions on places to visit and to see while during our stay.     Lastly the manager of the restraint (Kit) came, introduced herself and inquired about the service she received.  We thoroughly enjoyed the evening, the ambiance added to the pleasure and ultimately the food was delicious and mouthwatering.  The service, hospitality and food received was well above what one experiences in Vegas Restraunts.  Highly recommend visiting and experiencing the staff, servers and chef’s at Benihana’s at the Westgate Hotel and Casino in Las Vegas.  You will not be Disappointed.

allReviews.title: Hospitality
allReviews.text: Sir Rex Ricarte is very friendly, accomodating and helpful to hotel guest. Since its our first time in vegas, He guided us on things that are very beneficial to us tourist. We had an excellent experience from the reception up to our wonderful room .

allReviews.title: Good rooms, great experiences.
allReviews.text: This was my second stay at the Westgate and it was great. Pro tip: get a room in the North or East towers. The Central tower hasn't been renovated yet and the rooms aren't as nice. Although they do not have a large number of table games, the limits and dealers/supervisors are great.

allReviews.title: Excellent customer service
allReviews.text: I bought my Mom tickets for Barry Manilow and unfortunately the show was canceled we thought we wouldnt be able to go at all.  My mother was upset. allReviews.title: Nice Hotel with great Views!
allReviews.text: Great hotel for the price.  We were able to get around Vegas pretty easily with the monorail.  The newer rooms with the view were fabulous.  We could see the sunrise and the Sphere.  Thank you for the upgrade.  The casino itself is smaller, but that was fine with us as we don't gamble much.  The pizza in the food court was delicious.  We loved that we could use the fridge.  This is huge since most of the strip resorts don't allow this without a charge.  The only downfall (and it is with all hotels in Vegas) is that they don't have an in-room coffee maker.  Most guests like to wake up slowly with coffee.  I would definitely visit again.

allReviews.text: My stay was good except no room cleaning during one day of my stay.  Plus, guest services never had any answers as to what was happening at the resort. allReviews.title: Fabulous stay at the Westgate Las Vegas Casino and Resort
allReviews.text: We stayed at the Westgate Las Vegas Resort and Casino during the National Finals Rodeo from December 8-15, 2024.  From the time we entered the building, we were treated very well by any staff we encountered.   The rooms were clean and comfortable.  We were fortunate to stay in a 2 bedroom villa and it was absolutely beautiful.   There were a wide variety of food options at various price points.  All the meals we had on site were quite good.   The Westgate partnered with the NFR to host watch parties every night.  The events were well organized, well attended and we had a blast!   We had tickets to the actual rodeo one night and were also able to easily catch a shuttle bus from the Westgate to the Thomas and Mack Centre where the Rodeo was being held.  Last but not least, I would like to mention the very easy access to the Monorail which runs along the Las Vegas Strip.   Great jobs Westgate Team!  We will be back!!  Corinne and Jerry B.

allReviews.title: Highly recommend
allReviews.text: First time staying at the Westgate for the NFR.  Was very pleased with the entire hotel.  Had great food options, a fun watch party, great after parties, and the casino didn’t smell of cigarettes which was wonderful.  Definitely will be booking with Westgate again.

allReviews.title: It was just okay…
allReviews.text: We did not have a horrible experience at this hotel, but it could stand some renovations. There was rust around the tub, and the knob was very hard to turn the water on and off. The nightstand on the side of the bed was also very dusty at the bottom. I guess you have to request room service each day because no one came by during our weekend stay. The only thing conveniently within walking distance is the convention center next-door. Any of the Vegas attractions would require your ride share apps or the shuttle. Pros: The staff was very nice and welcoming as soon as you enter. Beautiful Mountain View through the window. Decent casino and sports bar area.

allReviews.title: International Theater security team & ushers

allReviews.title: Great experience all around with the employees at Westgate Hotel.

allReviews.title: Try the Westgate and take the monorail to the Strip!
allReviews.text: The Westgate is a wonderful off-strip (but not too far off) resort with loads of LV history. It has been well kept up and has many great restaurants and amenities.  We had a great stay there.  The room was clean and large, the bed was very comfortable, the bathroom was very nice too. We had a Keurig in our room as well.  Their rates are always reasonable too.

allReviews.title: Évite—plenty of other hotels in Vegas.
allReviews.text: Terrible expérience.  When I arrived at this hotel I was convinced  to upgrade, which I willingly did. I was staying for two weeks.  I received a pretty big room BUT with a thermostat/air conditioner problem, only cold air and no way to heat the air or stop the fan.  I kept daily asking for repair. I eventually asked to speak to the manager, who was constantly “in meetings but would call me back!”  which of course he/she NEVER did phone back or even try to speak to me or to solve the problem. I could never even  speak to the same person.  No repair, despite being told it would be taken care of that day—I explained that it appeared to be a broken thermostat, therefore I had nonstop freezing air conditioning pumping on high day/night this is in Nov/Dec it was actually colder in my room than outside the hotel. I changed rooms one week later after contracting bronchitis.  Add to that the fact that I had to call on 3 out of 4 days to have any  cleaning service, towels etc.  Oh, almost forgot— two mornings with no hot water for a shower. One bank of elevators in the East Wing had only one elevator out of four working and very often not even that one. But since there was no notice posted you could actually wait indefinitely. I travel pretty frequently. This is the worst hotel.
