allReviews.title: A fun Barry Manilow trip!
allReviews.text: Shelley H was fantastic! Great customer service! The Westgate Resort & Casino feels like home away from home! We enjoy our stay at the Westgate Resort & Casino each time we are here to see Barry Manilow! Thank you Jimmy for always greeting us and making sure we are taking good care of!

allReviews.title: Manilow a true Legend.
allReviews.text: Stopped into Westgate last Wednesday. First visit in a few years . I had forgotten it still has the best Sportsbook in town . Casino was rocking with a mixture of Cowboys from NFR , Grannies for Manilow and the Suited and booted from whatever convention was in town . For a school night it was popping .The Mrs and I grabbed a Burger and a beer at Sids and headed home fat and happy.Thank you for a great evening. We will be back.Latsamy and William

allReviews.title: Excellence off the Strip
allReviews.text: The resort is welcoming, comfortable.and not overwhelming. The rooms are large and relaxing. Some rooms have a view of the Sphere. The Westgate  is convenient to the Convention Center and monorail. and has a shuttle bus  to downtown and the Strip. The casino has plenty of gaming choices, make sure you sign up for a rewards card.. There is quite a variety of dining choices from a coffee bar, food court and fine dining. I think the Superbook at Westgate is the best racing and sports book in Vegas. I visit several times a year and have never had any issues. I'm looking forward to a return trip in Feb

allReviews.title: Westgate Experience
allReviews.text: As Las Vegas locals we have many choices in restaurants, shows and casinos, but the Westgate never disappoints. The atmosphere at the casino is always amazing and you immediately start to have fun, whether it’s the live music playing or the amazing staff that greets you. We had dinner at the Edge steakhouse. Everything was amazing from the unique bread to start the meal and the great salad. The menu was rather large for an upscale steakhouse and the staff was able to explain all the options and ensured you had a great experience. The desserts were amazing. The milk chocolate sphere dessert was a work of art and a must have. After dinner we enjoyed Barry Manilow’s concert. The venue is the perfect size and there is not a bad seat. You will be entertained the entire time. Barry is an amazing entertainer and his band is as good as it gets. One of the best vegas shows. You will be not disappointed with your visit to the Westgate.

allReviews.title: WESTGATE always the highest standard of service!
allReviews.text: As always incredible service and fantastic food! WESTGATE is truly a cut above all! The staff and management are committed to the highest level of excellence. You can tell that the employees love their jobs by the way they treat their guests. It is my understanding that many have been there for many years and you can tell.

allReviews.title: Friendly staff
allReviews.text: Good times at Westgate for NFR. Lots of activities including live music and shows. The Staff were very friendly and did a great job handling the crowds. The room was clean, housekeeping checked in with us daily. The giant TV’s at the Superbook are incredible, and perfect for the college football and NFL games.  5-stars, I’ll be making another trip soon

allReviews.title: Fantastic holiday show!
allReviews.text: My friend and I went to the Barry Manilow show on Friday December 7th. We had a great experience and the crowd gets involved, it feels like a big party. Barry Manilow’s holiday show was amazing and so much fun! I highly recommend the show to everyone.

allReviews.title: Jessica gave me a fantastic mani/pedi express
allReviews.text: I saw Jessica for a $69 mani/pedi express. Regular price $100. So I thought it would be a quick, whatever service. But I needed my polish removes, cuticles cut and nails trimmed. Jessica was fantastic. My nails looked so good when I left. I was so happy. It included polish too but I was too impatient to wait for them to dry. She gave me a nice buff. Thanks Jessica.

allReviews.title: Great night!
allReviews.text: Amazing staff at the Barry Manilow show!! They were incredible to my elderly parents and my mom’s 80th birthday.  Shout out to Shelley from Australia.The head of the show… John?  And also Maria in the casino!! Thank you for your hospitality and helping is create great family memories.

allReviews.title: Trapped like a rat, avoid this place
allReviews.text: Stayed 8 days for a bridge tournament probably 500+ rooms rented for up to 11 days. Horribly understaffed, have to beg almost daily  to get your room made up, (day one room wasn’t made up, I asked at the checkin the morning of day 2, phoned housekeeping at 2:00, had to go stand in line at 6:30 and wait 30 minutes to get the hotel manager who then did send housekeeping to my room at 7:00), long waits at checkin and every shop and restaurant, very long walk to access uber, entire casino floor terribly stinky from tobacco smoke, prices in shops and food court restaurants are very high even by Vegas standards, elevators are so bad you have to go up to go down otherwise the full elevator passes right by you on its way down, no reason for the pool to be closed down when it’s 70 degrees outside, no coffeemaker in the room, long walk from pavilion to the only bathroom next to Benihanas, the place is so miserable that we spent almost 100 dollars including transportation to eat Applebees 2 for 25 meal deal and felt it was well worth the money, of the literally hundreds of attendees I talked to I only found 2 with anything good to say about the facility.

allReviews.title: Best night in Vegas!
allReviews.text: The staff was wonderful and very attentive. Laura gave us a backstage tour which was outstanding. Barry Manilow was amazing. He was funny, interactive, and highly entertaining. It was a magical experience.  I highly recommend attending this show.

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow show
allReviews.text: The Barry Manilow show is amazing! Known for his full scale productions, and awesome voice, this show has it all !Team member Shelley H. was a big help, very friendly! She explained the short delay opening the doors, and made everyone waiting calm and comfortable

allReviews.title: Excellent customer service
allReviews.text: We were helped by Mohammed in the EVS department. Very pleasant gentleman helped us in finding the Fed Ex shipping store. He was so kind, he didn’t just tell us where to go. He stopped what he was doing to walk us there ensuring we didn’t get lost. His dedication to customer service made our trip much easier and enjoyable.

allReviews.title: THE Casino to meet all walks of life!
allReviews.text: The Vast walks of life! The WestGate has conventioneers, regulars and locals all gambling,eating and partying together!  We always,always have a blast here. Be sure to hit the bars… ya’ll will meet some employees that have been working here for years.

allReviews.title: I Feel as Though We Are Part of Their Family
allReviews.text: My wife and I have been coming to the Westgate Resort and Casino twice a month for nearly 4 years. During that time, I have become a Diamond Player. My casino host, David Rosenwinkle always takes care of us ranging  from special events invites, Westgate's VIP Stadium Suite events (i.e. - Copa America), outstanding food and drink comps, suite upgrades, VIP Slot Tournaments, Blackjack Tournaments, free 18 rounds of golf, and more. From the valet, dealers, pit bosses, supervisors, managers, cage, food and drink servers, everyone that works there treat us with courtesy and respect. I feel as though we are part of their family. They have plenty of options when it comes to gaming. They have many table games including blackjack, poker, craps, and roulette. They also have all of the new slot machines that most always pay out. I always enjoy staying at Westgate. Thank you

allReviews.title: Id do it again!!!!
allReviews.text: A nice dinner, fun rewards,  and pleasant staff. The welcoming at the tournament was amazing.    The live band helped make the evening...thanks westgate!!! It was a night to remember for all. Enjoyed so much! Westgate always makes me feel welcomed.

allReviews.title: Robert Raymond
allReviews.text: Robert Raymond is the best security person at Westgate.  He is very sweet to us fanilows a Westgate and greets us with a hug every time we visit.  We are always very happy to see him and adds to our joy of seeing Barry Manilow at International Theater at Westgate.

allReviews.title: Legends Slot Tournament Finale!
allReviews.text: It was love at the first spin!What a fabulous time we had at the Westgate!  The Legends Slot Tournament was a blast. We had a fantastic dinner reception with great enetertainment, prizes and give aways. I can't wait for the series to start again next year.Thank you Marty Kunkel for being the BEST casino host in Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Horrible Experience Terrible Service Do Nor Choose This Hotel
allReviews.text: This is the worst hotel. The service is terrible. I had to complain to the manager and he was rude to me. My husband and I had breakfast in the restaurant - just an omelet each - and the bill was $80.  There is no coffee in the room. The tissue is single ply and scratchy. There is smoke smell everywhere.  The ceilings are low. The elevators don’t work. There are 6 elevators near my room and only one works. I asked for daily housekeeping and I have been here one week today and I have gone without housekeeping five days despite waiting at the front desk for 30 minutes to complain and then have the manager be condescending and rude.  The restaurants are open to the casino and the smoke wafts in. One must walk through the low ceiling casino full of smoke to get to the convention center and the smoke smell is in the air conditioning.  There is marijuana smell wafting in from outside too. The rooms have no insulation and you can hear everything from the hallway and the adjacent rooms.  Do not stay here.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Staff in spite of Aging building
allReviews.text: The staff at the Westgate are wonderful.nnRex Ricarte is  a friendly, helpful doorman, prepared to answer any of our wuestions. Paul in Sid’s dining area was an incredible member of the wait staff.  He always remembered our favourite orders.The hotel itself is showing its age, but the staff makes up for it.Traveller from Canada

allReviews.title: Great Experience!!
allReviews.text: I Had a Great Time at the Barry Manilow Concert. Joe B., our usher, upgraded my seats as it was my birthday!!How Awesome Is That??Thanks Joe for making my experience even better!!! Thank You Very Much!!!!The Concert Was Very Very Good!!!!!!

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow Christmas show was great!
allReviews.text: Linda M was terrific.  I bought a good seat in the theater but my seat was next to a gentlemen who was clearly over 300 pounds.  There was no way I could sit in my assigned seat.  Linda was excellent/very helpful and discreet in helping me to get a new seat.

allReviews.title: Awesome place to stay!
allReviews.text: I stayed at Westgate in July 2024 and then again in November 2024! Both times the staff were very polite and helpful! I will be staying here in the near future! Very clean hotel and so much to do there! Next time I will be bringing my sister and her family to stay as well!!

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow - A must attend show while in Vegas.
allReviews.text: He is called the "Showman of our generation" for a reason. Barry belted out all his hits and took the audience on a roller coaster of emotions from beginning to end.The highlight for me was a handshake on night 3.I have been enjoying Barry's shows beginning in July 1978. Each time is a whole new experience.

allReviews.title: Good hotel for conferences
allReviews.text: Westgate is a great hotel for a conference. Unfortunately they always up there prices of all items when a conference is in town. Way too expensive for what you receive.Rooms are nice and large, with plenty of room. Not like the newer hotels on the strip that have much smaller rooms

allReviews.title: Wonderful hotel. Will stay again.
allReviews.text: I was surprised to see so many shops in the hotel but most surprising was that there was a coffee snack shop open 24 hours. I forgot my pillow and the pillow on our bed were very hard and uncomfortable. We are used to much softer pillows. We received an online message the next morning asking how our stay was. I did mention the pillows but didn’t expect it to go anywhere. We had soft pillows on our bed that night. That and everything else offered in the hotel was wonderful, including the Thanksgiving buffet.

allReviews.title: Highly disappointed
allReviews.text: I have been staying at Westgate for over 8 years. I must say Westgates last visit was utterly disappointing and bias. Rewards member whose room rate was less than resort fees and my room was ridiculously embarrassing, dirty and old. A rewards member who comes out of town, giving an old room. Not a remodeled room with a walk in shower but a room that was ADA in which I was not, then complained and giving a utter disaster. Not to mention the check in reps attitude because I noted the upcharge.That stayed ruined my WHOLE TRIP! $300 of disappointment

allReviews.title: N.B:  Check-in security deposit includes resort fees
allReviews.text: The "security deposit" at check-in included a $50/day resort fee.The "resort" was closed all of one bad air day (fires in the area),and my pre-teens were not allowed in the gym.  Westgate chargedthe $50+tax nevertheless.  Westgate fought my chargeback with a signature bearing no resemblance to my own.  For me Westgate is a no go.

allReviews.title: It takes a Team
allReviews.text: This is not the fanciest place in Vegas but they blow the rest away with customer service.   Special call out to Greg in the Diamond check in he helped me navigate my room block.  Jimmy the door man he is old school Vegas, has been there 15 years but doesn’t age, great first perception.  Flawless room block execution from Carmen McLee and then the star player at my events-Shannon Athenos from in Room catering. With Shannon at tge helm I am assured that all our events went off without a hitch.  It takes a team to make this annual event happen and Westgate has it.

allReviews.title: Awesome Talent!
allReviews.text: Great show and performers. Was expecting a live band but the track worked well. The performers were extremely talented.  The venue was nice and intimate with great service.  I enjoyed the modern twist of the music while keeping the traditional sound.

allReviews.title: Rocktane Band Was Fun!
allReviews.text: Just had a lovely Vegas vacation and enjoyed the Westgate. Some hotel highlights were the impressive sports book area and the delicious steak house.We saw several nice bands performing in lounge but the band that really stood out was Rocktane on Thursday night. This band was talented and professional but also very fun and entertaining. We will make a point of seeing Rocktane again on our next visit.

allReviews.title: Casino lover
allReviews.text: Slots are my favorite , table games were fun as well got to sit down on a couple of $25 min blackjack tables but also some $10 min tables . Hotel rooms were nice and comfy they were also Clean and professionally dressed. The sports book area is a must see , the screens are massive and it was fun watching the Tyson fight there.

allReviews.title: High Rocktane rocks!!!
allReviews.text: We originally planned to leave Las Vegas onThanksgiving Day, but saw that High Rocktane was performing that night. We changed our schedule and stayed an extra night to see them. They are awesome!!! They play a wide variety of tunes, so everyone can enjoy. We will be back to see them again.

allReviews.title: Did not meet expectations.
allReviews.text: No coffee makers & microwaves!! There was no water for a few hrs. Elevators were glitching, but at least the room was clean.Harressment about time shares everywhere!. Probably would not stay there again,  just for the fact u can't make a cup of coffee in your room,& are forced to spend $8 for a 12oz coffee!

allReviews.title: Disastrous stay: broken amenities, poor service, and hidden fees.
allReviews.text: I had the absolute worst experience at this hotel. I was here for work, expecting a smooth and comfortable stay, but it turned out to be a complete nightmare. Here’s a rundown of the issues I faced:1.	Broken Amenities: The heater on the air conditioner didn’t work, and the elevator in our tower was out of service. We were relocated to a different tower, only to find that the elevator there stopped working the very next morning. To make things worse, the water supply was cut off shortly after.2.	Horrible Communication: When I returned from work at 3 AM, exhausted, the parking entrance and main door to our tower were both blocked. There was no prior warning about this. I had to walk all the way around the building to get in. When I approached the reception to ask why guests weren’t informed, Charlene at the front desk was shockingly rude. She told me the entrance is always closed at night and said, “This hotel has 600 doors; we’re not going to notify you if one of them is closed.”3.	Overpriced and Hidden Fees: The hotel is overpriced for the terrible experience it offers. On top of that, I was charged a $200 hotel fee that wasn’t mentioned anywhere during booking.4.	Facilities Closed: When I came back from work the next evening, the restroom was closed too.This hotel completely failed on all fronts—comfort, service, and communication. For the premium price they charge, this level of service is unacceptable. If you’re looking for a hassle-free stay, avoid this place at all costs.

allReviews.title: Great check in
allReviews.text: It's a great experience to check in at Westgate resort in Las Vegas,  Rachelle is excellent at customer service and able to accommodate our need. Your company is lucky to have her!It is a smooth process,  the hotel rooms very modern and nice, great view, clean and smells good

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow Show is a Must See!!!
allReviews.text: I saw the Barry Manilow on November 14th and what an amazing show! I also want to thank Joseph B for using me as a “seat filler” by finding an empty seat in row 3 when my ticket was for Row 15. He didn’t have to do that and when I offered to tip him, he put his hand up and said “I appreciate that but it’s not necessary.” Give that man a raise and a promotion for excellence in customer service!!

allReviews.title: EVS Department
allReviews.text: Mohammed was very professional and nice to me. Great great worker!! He is apart of the EVS department. I also saw him helping others as well. Mohammed is a great look for the Westgate hotel. Most definitely was the nicest person since I’ve been here!!

allReviews.title: Great Staff and Customer Service
allReviews.text: The husband and I had dinner plans at Edge Steakhouse for Friday night.  We arrived a little early and stopped at the I-Bar for a drink.  Our bartender Magdalia was an absolute doll.  She had the greatest personality and friendly as can be.  My husband and her shared something in common and it was great seeing her passion come out.  We then went to Edge for our dinner.  Our server Liman was another amazing employee.  He to was very polite courteous and knowledgeable.  He assisted us from picking the wine to great recommendations on the meal.  Westgate has great employees who clearly love there jobs and the place they work for.

allReviews.title: Westgate Timeshare Owners Customer Service Manager Sylvia is Awesome !
allReviews.text: Westgate Timeshare Owners Customer Service Manager Sylvia is terrific and awesome and very helpful to me during my stay at the Vegas Resort & Casino. It makes my visit this year worth the long trip.   I am very appreciative of her support and she is a very accommodating person. Awesome.

allReviews.title: Great service
allReviews.text: Westgate was a great time. And the door man Jimmy was the most friendly and helpful during our visit. I will definitely be coming back. Jimmy went above and beyond opening doors for us and making sure we were taken care of. He even assisted in taking our picture.

allReviews.title: Soul of Motown
allReviews.text: We enjoyed a great presentation of Motown music presented live by some very talented singers. They presented great music and encouraged audience participation in a very intimate environment without a bad seat in the house. The drinks were decent as well although priced typical of Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Always a Treat/Close to Everything but Peacefully Located on Paradise!
allReviews.text: Very comfortable stay ALWAYS, w/every detail of comfort at your fingertips…I am glad to be an owner for two years now, & everyone is so accommodating!  Fresco Italiano is a FAV each visit, with exemplary service this time from bartender Emre :-)

allReviews.title: Motown in Vegas
allReviews.text: The Motown Review in Vegas was a Great show. They sing alot of the Hits from the beginning. They give the history of Motor Town aka Motown. Competing with Barry Manolow, I think this Group holds it's own. They definitely fit the Vegas Atmosphere.

allReviews.title: Great Check-In experience
allReviews.text: Veronica G. Provided great service upon check in. She was able to get my group a larger room which I really appreciated. We were celebrating a couple of birthdays and she helped make our time at Westgate a good experience. Thank you Veronica!

allReviews.title: Phenomenal!!!
allReviews.text: I felt just like I was at home!! After hanging out on the strip daily, I couldn't wait to get back to my home away from home! I felt very safe when I slept...walking around the premises... was able to get late night snacks...I had no worries I cannot wait to return!!

allReviews.title: Soul of Motown
allReviews.text: I didn't stay at the hotel but attended The Soul of Motown. It was AWESOME! I was about to complain that there were no Jackson Five hits but they were at the end. The show started on time, the singers were amazing and brought back so many great memories and made me happy.Having a roving drink server would have been helpful so we didn't have to go to the bar.

allReviews.title: Great visit
allReviews.text: Fantastic service and the friendliest staff I’ve ever had in Las Vegas   From the front desk to restaurants to the cleaning staff. The room was very clean and the bed was fantastic. The pillows are the best. I will definitely come back to the westgate and tell my friends to come as well.

allReviews.title: Charged for extra night for which I did not book.
allReviews.text: I called the hotel to add two night to my booking and was told that the hotel was full.  When I arrived they said that I was expected two night prior.  I was charged for an extra night even though I did not receive any confirmation of the change in my reservation.  I was pretty much told that I was a liar because they were not willing to believe my side of what was said on the phone.  I would have booked my flight for 2 days earlier had I known my reservation was changed.

allReviews.title: Soul of Motown - Nice Trip Down Memory Lane
allReviews.text: I had a great time watching Westgate's "Soul of Motown" show. The performers sang many memorable Motown songs. I even danced along a couple of them, which the performers encouraged, btw. As a photographer,  I appreciated that I could take pictures provided that no flash is used.. Value for money. Would watch again.

allReviews.title: Mohammed from EVS f(environmental services)
allReviews.text: Super helpful! Mohammed took the time to take me where I needed to go. Stellar Customer service!!!! I highly recommend it to everyone. He was busy but he still took the time to spend it with me. Everyone has been great . Great experience. Has been coming for a long time.

allReviews.title: Awesome!
allReviews.text: Loved the band High Rocktane! They sang everything I liked!! I highly recommend catching them! They were awesome! Sat there for a couple of hours I will be back! The bar was packed with many people that were dancing and having a great time! love

allReviews.title: Employee appreciation
allReviews.text: Hello, wanted to mention your employee.  Joseph B.  He was the team member that helped us.  So friendly and courteous.  Very professional.  Wanted to make sure he receive a that a boy.   We had the best time.  I am an owner and appreciate people that care about their jobs/ guests.  The week was my birthday had wonderful time.  Thank you.  Cari L. Wilson.

allReviews.title: Sidney Patrick! Come see her!
allReviews.text: Sidney Patrick is amazing! Definitely go see her perform! Her voice is so impressive. She also has the best of the best shoes. She has a variety of music that she sings so there is something for everyone. Come see her if you are anywhere in the area!

allReviews.title: Sidney performance
allReviews.text: Saw Sidney and Billy perform at the Ibar.  They were great! The atmosphere was great, her voice was phenomenal.  Good sound system and friendly staff.  We hope to see Sidney perform again soon. It was a great experience for our whole family and friends.

allReviews.title: Evening at Fresco Italiano
allReviews.text: Everything was wonderful. The meal, the wine and the service. Our server, Emre, was the best part. He was knowledgeable and gave great recommendations. He was attentive and made the evening. We even went back a few days later to try other items on the menu.

allReviews.title: The King Played Here
allReviews.text: Westgate Las Vegas has been a pillar in the Las Vegas Hotel industry for many years. The updating and cleanliness of the property is impressive and the restaurants are among the best in Las Vegas. When you go, check out the Sports Book! Everyone we met was kind and professional.

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow is still Awesome!
allReviews.text: We went to the Barry Manilow concert and he did NOT disappoint!  His voice and his moves are still awesome and we had the best time when Joseph B helped us move to an upgraded seating section.  Go see Barry and tell Joseph hello when he helps you find your seats!

allReviews.title: A good show & worth the price!
allReviews.text: I liked the show. I rated it a 4 only because it wasn’t a must see again type thing. I liked that the crowd was able to sing and dance along. The lead female singer was good and she was beautiful with each dress/wig change!  Her male counterparts were also good. The show started on time. There was a bar inside for drinks and a few snacks.

allReviews.title: Birthday Weekend Celebration
allReviews.text: Sunday, Nov 17: Saw April & Brian at the Westgate Las Vegas. They gave an excellent show and are both great singers.  I was celebrating my birthday weekend. My friends and I had a great time. Stayed for two sets. Awesome show…a must see on your next visit to Vegas!!!!

allReviews.title: Front desk - above & beyond. Thanks Tonya.
allReviews.text: Tonya on the Front Desk was absolutely wonderful. Kind, helpful and cheerful and I’m sure she had had a long day! I know I did and she made me feel relaxed and welcome right away. She was knowledgeable about the Trade show I was attending and very helpful with ideas about unwinding after my travels.

allReviews.title: Now dated and it shows
allReviews.text: We had booked a room and we had written in the requests a room on the upper floors and away from the lobby because there is a casino inside , arrived at 21:30 give us a room on the 3rd floor and on the pool ... old room , ugly and dated and not so clean ... we return to the reception and after a bit 'of attempts (thanks to the manager ) give us a room on the upper floors with a beautiful view but still dated and cleanliness mmmmm ... too bad !

allReviews.title: Excellent choice for a Vegas Stay!
allReviews.text: This is a great choice especially if you’re in town for the convention center. It’s only 1 Monorail stop away. The rooms are recently renovated and clean. Comfy bed and nice showers. Good number of shops to get what you need. Excellent steak house, great sport betting area. Seeing Barry Manilow in their theatre was amazing. Thanks to usher Editha C. who was able to give a ticket upgrade. There may be more glamorous hotels, but this is an excellent choice!

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow
allReviews.text: A thank you shoutout to Carolyn Leslie who upgraded our Barry Manilow show tickets on Friday. My husband and I are over from England and enjoyed the concert so much but those seats were like hitting the slot progressive. Thank you so much Carolyn and the entertainment team who joined in with the excitement of the crowd.  We have memories to treasure forever.

allReviews.title: Barry or bust.....
allReviews.text: I went to see Barry Manilow and Jonelle was amazing and so helpful through our experience! What a great venue to see a show something you shouldn't miss out on.Great casino, not a bad seat in the house. Don't miss this opportunity to see this amazing show.

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow!
allReviews.text: Barry Manilow was Amazing! Great music from the 70’s til now! Timeless Tunes! What a show…The staff at the Westgate is simply Amazing! Especially Jose “Mr Westgate” that was right there to greet us when we waked in! Thanks for a great time! They also have really good live music all night and a nice Poker Room and Sportsbook!

allReviews.title: Always Amazing
allReviews.text: This hotel stands out everytime mainly because of it's amazing staff and leadership. From the valet to frontdesk to housekeeping to food & beverage places to the events planning and services - all the people make the visits enjoyable and pleasurable.

allReviews.title: Very good 5 stars I will hive them
allReviews.text: Very good place for price,food and shows,very helpful  at desk,they tell you everything about hotel,shows and how you can save money,Parking is good,next doors are all wonderful hotels to visit.Fountainblue,Wynn,Trump,Treasure island very near.in your walking around, you will have great fun.

allReviews.title: Great stay at the Westgate
allReviews.text: First time to stay at the Westgate Las Vegas.   In town for a convention and proximity to the convention center was important.   Can’t say how impressed we were with our stay.  Yes, it is an older hotel but it has been maintained and kept updated.  Our rooms were huge and recently renovated.    The restaurants were all great and service was spot on.    Check-in / out was quick and efficient.   Access to the strip was a 5 min ride on Uber or cab.  Convention center was a 10 min walk.  We will 100% stay here again.

allReviews.title: Bucket list fulfilled- thanks Racheal for being so awesome!
allReviews.text: Seeing Barry fulfilled a long time bucket list wish. What an amazing experience. Racheal (Entertainment) ensured we found our seats and enjoyed the entire experience. She looked out not only for us, but all other guests in her section with the challenging stairs and ramps. Racheal is a definite asset for the guests and venue!

allReviews.title: We saw Barry! 💙
allReviews.text: Joseph B. was AWESOME!  It was my birthday and we got upgraded! We had a blast and Joseph made sure we were having a good time.  We had a great time seeing Barry at the Westgate in Vegas! Not gonna lie it was an experience of a lifetime with my friends all thanks to Joseph B!

allReviews.title: An old place with few upgrades.
allReviews.text: This is an old casino with superficial things done. Bathroom is a good example. An old fiberglass tub.The room is fairly spacious and shows upgrade (unlike bathroom).The casino floor is small and ventilation is poor.The sports book is huge, well ventilated and the food good.

allReviews.title: Festival of Trees and Lights
allReviews.text: We come to The Festival of Tress and Lights every year. IVery great experience’. Thank you Ken and Team.  It’s our third year in a row.  Making our Special day memorable every year.  Table service and all.  We had the largest attendance this year at almost 500 guests.

allReviews.title: Complete Westgate review.
allReviews.text: Liked the casino floor, sports betting screens were amazingly large, buffet service was efficiently pleasant and delicious. Elder was such a joy the next morning at Sids, after a late night of gambling.The room was just ok, and the bathroom needs updating and more lighting.

allReviews.title: Horrible!!!!!!!!
allReviews.text: I would never ever stay at this hotel again! Unfortunately, I got Covid while I was there, and decided to check out a day early and come home so I wouldn’t get the rest of the hotel guests sick. I called to see if I could get the one day refunded and was told no, that I would have had to call 14 days prior to get a refund. How in the hell could I have known I would have gotten Covid while there? I guess I should have just stayed and got the entire hotel sick? I asked the representative the same question and she just told me there was a 14 day cancellation no matter the situation. Absolutely ridiculous, I’m sure the other guess would not have appreciated me staying and walking through the casino having Covid.   Also, my shower had mold on the ceiling, and the tub was rusted, and the silicone was all chipped out against the wall. This place is awful! Do not stay there if you have a choice!

allReviews.title: Trip saver Nancy Maglich General Manager of Westgate
allReviews.text: Our first trip to Vegas ever to see Barry Manilow almost turned into a disaster...we. were moved three times to different rooms due to a number of issues and then got caught in an elevator for around 40 minutes on our way to the concert making us around 20 minutes late...after technical difficulties and listening to only one song, the concert was cancelled...we had flights out the next day so it looked like the trip was a lost cause, but after explaining our numerous issues Nancy Maglich the general manager stepped up and corrected the problem.  Not only did she give us some credit on our room, but also gave us perfect seat tickets for the Friday show allowing us to stay one extra night for free and threw in $100 credit to our account, which we used for a wonderful dinner the night of concert.  Nancy also offered us a free room for another night, but we had already changed our flight.   As a result of Nancy's professional courtesy we were able to have a very enjoyable trip and a lasting memory of all that could have gone wrong...This is what should be done in all hotels, but this is not always the case.  We are very thankful  we had Mrs. Maglich step in and correct the situation.  If we go back to Vegas anytime soon, we will definitely stay at the Westgate...Mike & Melanie

allReviews.title: Sydney Patrick
allReviews.text: Finally, the Westgate brought some talent back to the International stage. Two years of suck, this duo is fresh, different. A pretty lady with a guitar and a solid beat boxer doing great arrangements of contemporary music, it takes a while to pick it out until you recognize the lyrics, they are OUTSTANDING! New and unique, I'm really glad I stayed.

allReviews.title: Westgate Resort & Casino
allReviews.text: The owners club at Westgate was very nice.  Aida the In House Greeter was awesome & very helpful.  She made our visit at the Westgate Club very enjoyable & relaxing.  The refreshments were good.  Overall the resort was excellent. The only negative no internet.

allReviews.title: Would definitely stay again!
allReviews.text: Great hotel, easy to navigate, all the amenities without being over the top.  Nice bar, great restaurants, good shops, sports bar and sports book area really good, casino was good without being toooo much. Easy to get to the strip from the monorail or grab a cab or Uber.  I would definitely stay at the Westgate again.

allReviews.title: Soul of Motown show in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: I went to the Soul of Motown show and it was outstanding me and my cousin that lives in Vegas had so much fun. She had not experience this great show even though she lives in the city so it was a great treat for us to be able to enjoy this show. I will definitely come back with friends and family please Westgate do not let these entertainers Leave your venue.

allReviews.title: Barry Maniolw
allReviews.text: My wife and I had tickets to see Barry Maniolw. My father decided he wanted to go also but we had to get a ticket in another section. An usher, Valerie, went out of her way to find three seats together. Valerie was very nice and escorted us to our new seats.

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow show
allReviews.text: Valarie, the usher went beyond and above, helping us to our seats. She had a constant smile and was so helpful blah blah blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah you go to see the show For Valarie she’ll help you anyway she can blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah

allReviews.title: Westgate Club
allReviews.text: My four day trip was a great experience during our stay in this hotel, especially in the members club. The staff at the members club  were very nice and approachable. Antonia, Aida, Fe and the rest of the staff, you’re all the best. Just keep up doing your best.

allReviews.title: Aida and Antonia are great!
allReviews.text: Aida and Antonia do a wonderful job in the Westgate Club room. The spread is great and they keep all of the drinks and snacks stocked all with very pleasant attitudes! The room itself is also spotless. They really go out of their way to make you feel welcome!

allReviews.title: BEWARE
allReviews.text: Arriving at 10pm on a Thursday night, there was a long line to check-in, but only one agent at the desk with about 20 open stations. Lots of employees were wondering around but no one seemed too concerned. The rest of the weekend, the lines were substantially longer. I felt bad for those folks. After about 20 minutes of waiting in a line barely moving, I called the number to the hotel to let them know. When I told the operator, she told me she was just the operator so she wasn’t able to help. I asked, “well, could you let a manager know?” She said she would. A few minutes later, about 3 more agents filed out from the office to assist. Finally with a check-in agent, we were told that even though we booked a king room, they had none available, so they would put us in a room with 2 beds. She blamed other booking agencies for overbooking - which I can sympathize with but that is not our problem. But no worries, tomorrow, we could go through the hassle of moving once a king room became available. We had to leave our luggage with the bellman the next morning before heading out. We picked up our luggage later that afternoon, went to new room, and it smelled of sewage upon opening the door. They moved us again and this room was fine. Listen, this is a time share hotel and they are vultures. If you go to Guest Assistance looking for the closest restroom, they will try to get you to book a tour. It’s really annoying. I will not stay there again for those reasons and its location. I’ll pay more and be on the strip. Also, like many other Vegas hotels, there are no coffee makers in the rooms. You have to get presentable in the morning to go get coffee or pay for room service.

allReviews.title: Sema Show 2024
allReviews.text: Westgate and all the employees do everything they can and go beyond expectations to ensure you have a fantastic stay. Richard Douglass in food and beverage is spot on the best! Thank you for always taking such great care of Monument Tools,Regards Tony.

allReviews.title: Manilow Weekend!
allReviews.text: Lynda at the front desk was by far amazing. Her customer service skills surpassed any other associate I encountered during my stay. As an owner, she made me feel genuinely welcomed! The Manilow show was outstanding. The venue was cool in temperature but seating was comfortable. Great show! Worth every penny!The Soul of Motown show had a lot of energy but left me feeling like it could use some tightening up. I felt like they were vocally too loud for the size of the venue. Not worth the ticket price for comparable entertainment. The corridors could be brighter but the actual suite was comfortable.Parking was easy and dining options were adequate.

allReviews.title: Valerie was amazing
allReviews.text: Best show experience ever our usher Valerie, so kind and amazing and so full of knowledge of the history of the building. BARRY Manalow sounded amazing and still looked sexy as hell. Talent and storytelling and still go some moves. Hope to be back soon

allReviews.title: Magical Evening: Photography, Character Team, and Barry Manilow's Timeless Performance!
allReviews.text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5 out of 5 stars)"Magical Evening: Photography, Character Team, and Barry Manilow's Timeless Performance!"While staying at the Westgate Resort, we were treated to an exceptional experience that exceeded all expectations. Let me break down this fantastic evening:Photography Experience:Davey and the photography team delivered outstanding service, capturing our memories with professional flair. Their attention to detail and friendly approach made the photo session both enjoyable and memorable.Character Team Service:The Character Team at Westgate deserves special recognition for their impeccable service. They went above and beyond to ensure every guest felt welcomed and valued, demonstrating the true spirit of Las Vegas hospitality.Barry Manilow Concert:The highlight of our visit was witnessing the legendary Barry Manilow in concert. At 81 years young, his performance was nothing short of spectacular! His energy level was incredible as he delivered hit after hit, including the iconic "Copacabana" and the heart-touching "Mandy." The way he commanded the stage and connected with the audience was remarkable - proving that true talent is timeless.Pros:Professional photography serviceExceptional Character Team attentionWorld-class entertainmentBarry Manilow's outstanding performancePerfect venue acoustics and atmosphereThe combination of Westgate's excellent service amenities and Manilow's electrifying performance created an unforgettable Vegas experience.Tips for Future Visitors:Don't miss the photo opportunity with DaveyBook your Manilow tickets in advanceAllow time to interact with the Character TeamHIGHLY RECOMMENDED! This is Vegas entertainment at its finest, proving that some experiences truly get better with age - just like Barry Manilow himself!Visited:  November  2024

allReviews.title: Great Service!
allReviews.text: Absolutely wonderful service from Greg in Diamond check-in.  He was courteous and extremely helpful. Saved me a ton of trouble by calling my host and taking care of me. Thanks to him from me! 5 Star service! I will definitely be returning to Westgate soon!

allReviews.title: Brooke Wilkes
allReviews.text: Watched Brooke Wilkes at the Westgate Hotel and Casino. Brooke has a great voice and was very entertaining. We had a great time listening to her sing and dancing to the songs! It was a great environment and a great way to end the night. The service was also very good.

allReviews.title: Wonderful experience with world class entertainment!
allReviews.text: Brooke Wilkes is the real deal! Tremendous vocals and stage presence!!! Her guitar accompaniment just happened to be the brilliant John Wedemeyer who is the lead guitarist for The Beach Boys!!! A wonderful duo that are the best of the best!!!

allReviews.title: Fabulous!!!
allReviews.text: We went to the Barry Manilow concert. It was fabulous! The usher Joseph B , and his cohorts, were very accommodating making our experience even better.they made sure we had everything we needed. We highly recommend the show and the venue. Thanks for the great time!

allReviews.title: Excellent customer service
allReviews.text: I stayed at the Westgate for a conference. I am giving a 5 star review for service that exceeded expectations. Rachelle at the front desk went above and beyond helping me solve a work problem I was having.  I really appreciated her eagerness to help me resolve the issue. The rooms are slightly dated looking but were spacious and comfortable.

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow Show
allReviews.text: Molly went above and beyond to accommodate us. Three sisters on a girl weekend. Molly made it very special. Blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah Blah blah blah blah blah blah blah wonderful wonderful wonderful wonderful Wonderful wonderful beautiful wonderful

allReviews.title: Annie’s Birthday Celebration
allReviews.text: Our experience at the Barry Manilow concert was absolutely amazing. Would like to give a shout out to team member ‘Valerie’ who upon noticing our matching birthday shirts , recommended us for an upgrade to a front booth, putting us much closer to the stage. Also, thank you to Joe B for for the excitement he showed us is being the chosen group.It was a very positive experience, thank you all !!!

allReviews.title: First Time in Vegas Show
allReviews.text: Loved every minute ❤️ of the show. First time visitors to Vegas my first show. I will definitely be back to see them. Big Sexy 💙💙. Family trip with my baby sister (45), my dad (79), my aunt (77) we did not stop singing and dancing until it was over.

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow show experience
allReviews.text: Attending the Barry Manilow show was an incredible experience, and Carolyn Lesla made it even better! As an usher, she stood out with her genuine friendliness and welcoming demeanor. Carolyn was not only informative about the show and venue, but her great personality truly shined through in every interaction. She even gave us some fantastic bar recommendations for after the show, which turned out to be spot on. Kudos to Carolyn for making our night extra special! 🌟 #GreatService #FriendlyUsher #LasVegasMagic

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow Concert and Star Usher!
allReviews.text: The Barry Manilow  Concert (excellent!) at the Westgate was made even better by the woman who seated us, Carolyn Lesla. Her warm smiling and dynamic personality set the stage (so to speak) for a great night of entertainment. What a treasure of an employee Carolyn is.

allReviews.title: Vacation Review
allReviews.text: We had a wonderful vacation at Westgate Las Vegas Resort and Casino. The customer service was excellent and made you feel like family. The rooms were very clean and the beds were extremely comfortable. If you are in need of a manicure/pedicure, I highly recommend Serenity Spa located at the resort. Soul of Motown was a fabulous show and brought back so many memories . A must see is The Magic of Jen Kramer, she is truly magical. The one thing I truly loved was having the Monorail right at the resort. We were able to explore other places without worrying about driving or parking.  We had a great experience at Westgate and would highly recommend.

allReviews.title: poor Housekeeping
allReviews.text: I literally just left and checked out a day early because housekeeping cleaned my room every 2-3 days and I stated at check in I wanted my room to be cleaned everyday since I was spending  9 days at the hotel working the Sema show .At first I thought they still had their go green initiative but after the second  day of no one coming to clean I called and got the same response .I will let the housekeeping manager know .So finally someone shows up to clean did a great job on Wednesday.that was the last time someone came to clean my room .So after another 2 days without housekeeping I call again 2 times once at 7 pm after Sema show and again when I get back to my room at 10 pm same response the housekeeping manager is aware of your first call .Nothing was done no one came to clean follow up nothing . I was supposed to stay until Sunday but I was out everything towels soap shampoo toilet paper So I checked out early because I felt like I would get sick if I stayed any longer and management their does nothing .Also the lobby smells like smoke .I will never stay at the Westgate Las Vegas ever again Jason

allReviews.title: Soul of Motown
allReviews.text: Excellent accommodations—clean rooms. Had great dining experience at BeniHanna. We saw a fabulous show “SOUL OF MOTOWN”. The best musical show in Vegas bar non. It was our second time to see this show. We were literally dancing in the aisles.

allReviews.title: Barry Manilow
allReviews.text: Joseph B made this amazing evening even better! This was the first time my sister and I got to see Barry together and Joseph brought the great night up a notch!! He upgraded our seats and made the night memorable. Barry of course was fantastic. We had such a fun night!

allReviews.title: Linda M. Is the best!
allReviews.text: We had a fabulous time and Linda made it extra special with her lovely personality and perfect hospitality. !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

allReviews.title: Great experience!
allReviews.text: I had the pleasure of being seated by Joseph, and I have to say, he is absolutely phenomenal! From the moment we arrived, his attention to detail and warm demeanor stood out. Joseph clearly knows his seating arrangements inside and out, ensuring that each guest is directed to their seat quickly and efficiently. He creates a welcoming atmosphere and goes above and beyond to make sure every patron feels valued. His professionalism and expertise truly elevate the entire dining experience. If you’re lucky enough to be seated in his section, you’re in great hands!

allReviews.title: Great time !
allReviews.text: Great fun at the Barry  Manilow show. Comfortable seats. Lively crowd. Had an Italian dinner which was delish. Loved the Pina Co Lola.!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

allReviews.title: Vegas baby!
allReviews.text: Linda M was awesome!!  Very friendly and professional.  Great dinner at Fresco and now seeing Barry Manilow with the best girlfriends ever.  Total bucket list item for me- I've had a crush on Barry since I was in junior high a long time ago!!!!!!

allReviews.title: Fantastic!
allReviews.text: Valarie has made our entire trip.  She is welcoming, friendly and made us feel so special.   She heard it was my birthday and was so sweet to give us a couple of drink tickets to help Thank you for making my birthday the best year yet!  Valarie is someone any staff would be lucky to have. Thank you!!!!!!!

allReviews.title: West Gate International Bar- SEMA Convention
allReviews.text: I was at the West Gate for the SEMA convention, I’m so glad we stayed to watch the band play. I had a great time! The drinks at the bar were strong and the band was rocking! I know where to go next time I’m near the Las Vegas strip. The band played some of our favorites, it was such a good way to end the night.

allReviews.title: Great band!
allReviews.text: Great band! Very engaged and energetic. The lead singer made sure everyone in the audience was engaged and having fun. Excellent musical ability! It is clear the band members have great chemistry. I had a great time with friends. Will be seeing High Rocktane again!!!

allReviews.title: Fun lounge next to International Bar
allReviews.text: I came with friends from work and jammed out to the coolest band, High Rocktane! They played some great songs from the 80s-90s-2000’s. The whole band had great energy the whole night. Seriously so talented! Westgate is awesome love this place!!!!

allReviews.title: Exceptional Customer Service in the Owner's Office
allReviews.text: I wanted to express my sincere gratitude for and appreciation for the exceptional support provided by Deondre and Sylvia in the Owner's Check in Office during my recent stay.  My reservation was somehow changed. I was supposed to have a 2 bedroom/2 bath villa and a studio villa. Including myself there were 7 guests.  When I arrived, I was told I had 3 hotel rooms with double beds (leaving me a bed short). The Owners Office was closed and nothing could be done until the following morning.  The next morning, I approached the Owner's Check in Office and was quite upset. Deondre immediately smiled, offered to assist, and began researching the reservation. He was patient and at the time moving with urgency to find a resolution. Sylvia came over to offer assistance and was also polite, professional, and sympathetic.  Together they were able to locate my original reservation for the villa and no details explaining the change. They quickly made the necessary corrections to ensure I was provided the appropriate accommodations for myself and guests.  Everyone enjoyed the space  of the villa and amenities of the resort. Thanks to Deondre's and Sylvia's professionalism and extraordinary customer service this will be the first of many girl trips to the  Las Vegas Westgate!!

allReviews.title: Awsome
allReviews.text: Everything was perfect the slots were loose and service was excellent parking was no problem the food was excellent service was prompt the view was awesome we where on the north wing and had a excellent view of the sphere it was very convient if you had to go to the Las Vegas convention center

allReviews.title: In house breeder/hospitality room for timeshares
allReviews.text: Aida, Jemiil, and Amanda are just a few of the AMAZING team members/hosts on the hospitality room for the timeshare holders. They have always shown us great respect, and hospitality since the day we stepped into the room. I love their little snacks they provide as well, and the breakfast is just enough to get me going in the morning. But the icing on the cake is the warm welcome we receive everytime we are greeted by one or all of these wonderful people. I look forward to it everytime I come to the Westgate, and makes my stay that much more enjoyable 😊 they always maintain an impeccable environment, and Westgate are very fortunate to have them on their team.

allReviews.title: Ms. Leslie
allReviews.text: Carolyn Leslie was amazing!! She went above and beyond for us and was the friendliest person I met in all of Vegas! The Westgate has a spectacular sports book but I really enjoyed watching the games in the Elvis theater. The slits were fun and the drinks were reasonably priced. I will definitely go back!

allReviews.title: Always a good time
allReviews.text: Hotel is very good. Long lines for two restaraunts.Everything from check in to check out was excellent.  Table games presonel were professional including supervisors.  I was satisfied with food and drinks.Mary S. is helpful and professional. Transportation department is always on time

allReviews.title: West Gate Club
allReviews.text: We are enjoying visiting the Westgate casino as Presidential suite owners, as our first time we were introduced to the West Gate club and we're created by two hosts (Mrs. FE, and Mrs. Aida) at the 5-7pm social club. They were very attentive to our needs

allReviews.title: Good location for a Las Vegas vacation, especially if you are not focused on gambling.
allReviews.text: We had a very nice week at the Westgate Resort for our first time visit to Las Vegas.  First the positives:  We had a great view of Sphere and Strip from the 17th floor.  The room was updated, generally quiet and comfortable with a great TV and Wifi.  Staff were very nice and helpful.  We appreciated the monorail access to the strip and the free parking.   There are quite a number of great day trips within a 2 hour radius.  We also enjoyed the lounge acts in the evening.Negatives: We would have liked a coffee maker and microwave in the room.  The casino was very loud from both the piped in music and slots, but we didn't spend much time there as we don't gamble.  Our biggest disappointment was that the pool was only open from Noon to 5 pm!   Never seen that before!

allReviews.title: Excellent and clean
allReviews.text: Jessica Carrera did a wonderful job taking care of our room. She even posed my daughter’s stuffed animal in a different and cute way every time she remade the bed! Jessica was a top notch employee and helped make our stay even better. Five stars for her work!

allReviews.title: Draft Sports Bar
allReviews.text: Mohammed with EVS at Drafts Sports Bar inside Westgate Casino was very helpful. I visited on a football Sunday, it was very crowded and Mohammed helped me find the perfect seat to watch the game. Thank you very much for your assistance Mohammed!

allReviews.title: Rachael the Fixer!!!!
allReviews.text: Racheal is a fixer! Confusion over our seats and she took charge and made it happen!!! What an asset for this casino!!! Very profesional kept her cool! The other couple were getting excited and she didn’t even flinch!!! Was very matter of fact and stated “ I will take care of this”!!! And she did!!! Great experience !

allReviews.title: Westgate Resorts in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: My family and I had a great time and really love the accommodations at Westgate Resorts! My son is an Owner with Westgate and he allowed us to have a great vacation in Las Vegas. We will definitely return very soon with more family and friends at Westgate.

allReviews.title: Short stay
allReviews.text: This was a short stay for us 3 adults and 1 teenager. Everything was as it was described. Hotel rooms were clean with good housekeeping. Good location smooth checking and out.

allReviews.title: Service above and beyond!
allReviews.text: Arrived at Trump International on a Saturday night. Quickly greeted by Nick in valet who handled my valet.  Kevin was there to greet me and offer to bring my bags up to my room.  My adventure begins. I check in and was given an upgraded room on a high floor.  Passing through security on my way to room only one of the key cards worked, no problem I was going to head back down to meet a friend.  The bellman was on the elevator with me, we arrived at room and neither key card worked. He quickly called security, and they arrived immediately.  Within a couple of minutes in the room, I received a call from Nick in valet.  My rental car would not start, strange the car was a 2025.  I went downstairs to meet my friend and check on car at valet. Nick asked me to call rental car company for a tow and not to worry about the car he would handle getting it loaded when truck arrived.  If you have to have a car break down, be sure to do it at a 5* hotel where they offer to handle everything and send me on my way.  Tow truck company called upon arrival, and I couldn't help but go out to valet. Kevin who handled my bags was there and we joked about this big flat bed truck navigating valet.  I couldn't help but laugh that within 10 minutes of arriving at hotel 5-6 employees knew me by name. All through my 5 day stay they greeted me and we would joke about my car not starting. My room was very comfortable as was the bed, couch and chairs. Plenty of room in the nice size bathroom.  Housekeeping came each day and took care of room. As a woman traveling alone, I felt very safe with someone greeting me each time I arrived back at the hotel.I couldn't ask for a nicer stay.  I do have to do a shout out for Nick and Kevin who handled my car situation amazingly and greeted me each time I arrived or left the hotel.  As well as all the security people I encountered.  I will be back next time I travel to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Horrible water - all hot no cold
allReviews.text: I got  3 night stay for $199, if I listened to Hilton Grand Reward Vacations time share   I said sure, never been to Vegas and took the bait. Hilton said only availability was Trump Hotel. They told us ot was a king size bed with kitchen teeth, sounded great!When we arrived they told us to room service, but if we needed something call.Room was on 34th floor and when we arrived it was a suite. Looked amazing with 2 bathrooms, 2 showers and a tub, and a full kitchen, overall we were happy and excited until...We used the water for a bath in the master bathroom in the jacuzzi tub.  It filled fine and we were enjoying it, but wanted some more cold water...there was none. Cold faucet ONLY produced HOT water. I tried, my boyfriend tried. The sink did the same.  We go to bed it was late and I use the master bath toilet in the middle of the night, weird the bowel feels hot.  Day 2 boyfriend uses shower seems fine although toilet it hot again. We gone al.ost all day a d arrive back to sleep. No shower that night.  We go to use shower on the 3rd day, scalding hot no matter what, toilet bowl hot and sink water.  Thankfully the 2nd bathroom seemed fine that was a showered only.I was thinking the pipes were just crossed and thankful for the 2nd shower. We left on the 3rd day complained and they told us they never had anyone complain about that before.  Well the whole thing really bothered me so I went online after getting home....sure enough a couple other complaints online about the SAME DAMB thing. This is a lawsuit waiting to happen.I would NEVER recommend this hotel to anyone. Yes the room looked amazing and we got a great price but at a cost. However, they have a major problem with the water.  Either all hot or all cold.

allReviews.title: Another great stay
allReviews.text: 2nd stay at Trump Hotel in Vegas. Like this hotel as it's non smoking. Massive rooms. Bed & pillows really comfy. Room was cleaned daily. Good location,  just a short walk down to the main strip. Staff really friendly & helpful. Reasonable prices. Would definately stay again

allReviews.title: A clean, well-lighted hotel -- with friendly service and good food
allReviews.text: We expected garish decor, but this hotel is tastefully designed and decorated, with muted off-white colors in the lobby. Our room was spacious and comfortable. Staff were polite and helpful. The steakhouse restaurant, though not inexpensive, served excellent food, and the breakfast was delicious. Valet parking was efficiently run. The location across from a shopping mall is convenient. This is a well-run hotel.

allReviews.title: W Trump
allReviews.text: Shiny, extravagant, spotless. I’d expect nothing less from Trump. 5 star experience done in a way only Trump properties can. Honestly it’s a great spot for families because there’s no casino.

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: Hotel was excellent. Service was excellent. Location is an easy 30 minute walk to the Sphere. It is across from the mall.

allReviews.title: Great place, location, service
allReviews.text: Room service kept room clean, all the staff were very kind and helpful, spacious room near the Fashion Show Mall and the strip

allReviews.title: EXCELLENT HOTEL WITHOUT CROWD OF THE CASINOS
allReviews.text: The location is excellent, the room is large and very comfortable. The pool is nice. Good service. I missed having a lounge in the lobby.

allReviews.title: Just perfect!
allReviews.text: The stay at the hotel was really nice! The room was clean and cozy, the staff very friendly and helpful. The location of the hotel was also perfect. Overall a very pleasant stay.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: The hotel is extremely well located, has a square in front, and is walking distance from theme hotels. Very clean and luxurious. The room is large and very complete. The staff is very friendly. Breakfast at an affordable price just like the restaurant. 10/10 in security. I'd come back.

allReviews.title: Room was great. Check in and Breakfast service took way too long!
allReviews.text: I have stayed at this property before. I really like the fact that it doesn’t have a casino and is conveniently located. However on this visit, check-in took 45 minutes due to a long line and lack of staff. The next day I had breakfast in the lobby restaurant. Service was also painfully slow due to insufficient wait staff. On the bright side, I really enjoyed my room. The quality of the bed , pillows, linens furnishings etc was excellent.

allReviews.title: Amazing Folks Representing the Brand,,,, BUT
allReviews.text: The people working at this location are amazing!Valet parking is included but PLEASE TIP THEM.  They do an amazing job taking vehicle and getting it when needed.Enjoyed not having casino on the propertyTrain tracks 500 yards from the property so check your room location...  Rooms on 16th floor have the lights, illuminating the entire structure, just a few feet below the windows so have NO expectation on having a room dark at night. Could read in ours after even using hangers to fasten curtains.Elevators are amazingly fast!Small bar in lobby at night. We were literally the last customers at the pool bar for this season so you needs to walk/drive to other locations to get a drink.STILL advertised the jetted tubs have been shut off in all rooms.View on side of sphere is cool. Other side.... not so much.The folks working here are very polite and professional.HUGE mall across the street and Las Vegas Blvd isn't too far to walk.  If you want fufu coffee good luck. Nice folks at the lobby coffee bar are kind but black coffee only. and $7.50 a cup.Bring a sharp knife if you think you will need to cut something and don't count on the ice maker in the fridge working. Each floor is supposed to have an ice machine. Didn't try restaurant or room service...Would suggest that you do DO NOT OPEN door to built in combination washer/dryer. Apparently not used much and extremely funky. Apparently no rules against "hitting the hay" outside entrance so don't be surprised.Saw lots of pets which is very cool.In spite of the positive engagement with the folks, we will look for another place to stay when in town.BTW:  if traveling between Oct and Nov 2025, reconsider your plans unless you don't mind screwed up traffic and blocked streets.  Getting ready for F1 race and it's a frigging mess!!!!!

allReviews.title: Nice.
allReviews.text: Mixed views on this hotel. The service is definitely NOT 5 star. We had a room on the train track side and the noise from the horn of the freight train  woke us three times.  The manager David promises things and then front desk try to wriggle out of what he promised.  He’s then suddenly “not available” or “in a meeting for the rest of the morning.”  Funny that when I literally could see him at front desk two minutes later. Lying and hiding  from guests is not a good look David. Anyway that aside after delays with room change and the rudeness of front desk they did eventually comp my resort fees but I had to fight for it.  They don’t like being told when things aren’t right and accuse you of “coming at them and making them feel uncomfortable”.  Complete nonsense - I was completely polite and calm but this is their way of deflecting. The room we were moved to was better. We were not woken by train noise so make sure you ask for a room strip side.   Rooms are well appointed.  Note that they have turned off the whirlpools on the bathroom so they don’t work. Not sure why - maybe they caused problems.    Didn’t matter - the bath was huge and lovely.  The shower is a proper powerful drench shower. Really nice high end toiletries in the bathrooms. Really liked that you had a mini kitchenette with coffee machine, complementary fridge, microwave.  Beds and pillows and linen were incredibly comfortable!   It’s quite a walk to the strip but good to get your steps in!

allReviews.title: Fabulous Corner Suite!
allReviews.text: The room was top notch in every way. We booked a corner suite and the views from the 46th floor were fabulous! It was a surprise that we had two bathrooms. The suite was absolutely huge. Loved every minute there.It was also so nice that it didn't have a casino and was nonsmoking. After walking through a couple other Vegas hotels, we were SO happy we had decided to stay at Trump International!It should be considered a business hotel rather than a resort. The pool is pretty but basic (and was not open in the evenings when we were there). The spa was closed half the week. The restaurant was fine for breakfast, but glad we went elsewhere for dinner since it's located right in the lobby and kind of noisy.Complimentary valet parking was nice but there was quite a long wait when all the guests checked out at the same time. The valet workers were running and did a great job, but it was not a luxury experience to be waiting wihle with crowds on the curb for our vehicle to appear. If we went back to Las Vegas, we would love to stay here again.

allReviews.title: Have water with you. The hikes are long and remember that Las Vegas is in a desert.
allReviews.text: We have stayed at the Trump Hotel on 2 occasions and both have been very satisfactory.Compared to the other 5 stars this is a very good price being an excellent choice for value for money.There is no casino, so you will find a much more relaxed Mood. It is a discreet luxury and the reference images that are put online are very faithful to what you will find there.The staff is very friendly and willing to help you. several speak Spanish, but those who still won't find a way to give you what you need.Spacious rooms, very comfortable bed, with kitchen and refrigerator, large bathrooms with double sink and bathtub for two people. It doesn’t offer a Jacuzzi anymore, but you’ll still enjoy a nice dip after long walks on the Strip.If you get a room on high floors facing the Strip, you will have another show there. The sphere itself is one that is active 24 hours.The location is correct, 500 meters walk from the Strip and in front of the Fashion Show Mall, which is the largest in the city.It also has free Valet Parking (very comfortable).

allReviews.title: Great Spot Just Off The Strip
allReviews.text: Trump offers great accommodations just slightly off the strip.  Without a casino, it is nice and quiet, but the rooms have a full kitchen which is great, and the restaurant is excellent.

allReviews.title: A good alternative in LV  but not 5 star
allReviews.text: We have just returned from a stay at Las Vegas Trump hotel. I chose it for a number of reasons. The price was ok. It is a non casino resort and is located off the Strip but is a 5 minute walk away. Check in was smooth and the front desk.staff were friendly and helpful. We opted for a high floor ( 51 ) with a mountain view.The room itself appeared a little dated ie old tech tv and no usb sockets. On the plus side the bed was very comfy and we made use of the kitchen facilities for our breakfast requirements. We didn’t eat at the restaurant but after chatting to other guests we were told the food was good but expensive. The pool area was a lovely place to chill and not crazy  like many other LV pool areas. Located across the road from the front entrance is a decent shopping mall which was very useful.

allReviews.title: Incredible hotel
allReviews.text: Great Hotel.  No Complaints.  Perfect hotel, wonderfull location!  Staff was there for everything we needed.

allReviews.title: Great, clean. Big poll
allReviews.text: Great Service big pool, great gym.all people are nice and normal. only valet parking, sometimes long wait until you can drop the key

allReviews.title: First time staying at this resort and overall experience is very good
allReviews.text: Room is spacious and comfortable. Living room sofa is a bit uncomfortable. Location is not the best as it is further away from Vegas strip. Staff is friendly. I would stay here again if I want a quieter place overnight, but if I want to be clsoe to shops and entertainment I would choose another resort.

allReviews.title: Fabulous!
allReviews.text: Amazing!Amazing!amazing!Everything was perfect:location, pool, rooms(amazing view), staff so friendly and accommodating.  The hotel is beautiful a clean, luxurious atmosphere.

allReviews.title: WOW
allReviews.text: WOW.Nothing really to say. There are all the comforts, large rooms, clean and sanitized daily, free valet Service, attentive staff to any need. Absolutely the best stay of our trip to the USA.Extra point for the fact that the hotel is has two steps from the Strip and does not have Casino inside.. which makes it quiet and even more exceptional

allReviews.title: TRUMP TOWER AN AMAZING EXPERIENCE
allReviews.text: Staying at Trump  Tower has always been on my bucket list.  It did not disappoint.  From the valet upon arriving to the check out process, everything was perfect.  The staff is incredible, everyone went out of their way to make our experience wonderful.I love the smoke free environment and the upscale class .  The room was amazing!!We will be back!

allReviews.title: QUIET HOTEL STEPS FROM STRIP
allReviews.text: To begin with this is not the typical Hotel and Casino, apparently some problem of compatibility between gambling and politics allowed Trump to build his luxury hotel but did not allow him a casino inside, therefore this is an excellent hotel without the bustle of hotels that have casino. The location is very good, almost at the end of the strip, facing the Venetian and Treasure Island. One of the amenities of this 60-story hotel is that it has at least 10 large elevators, which are divided by floor sectors. There are 3 that only go from the lobby to the 12th floor, then another 3 that go from the 13th to the 18th floor and so on. I was staying on the 58th floor so the elevators I took climbed dizzyingly to the 54th floor without stops and from there only stops on the floors to the 64th, this prevents crowding and makes you get much faster to the upper floors. The rooms are spacious and feature living and a kitchen area with stoves, fridge, coffee maker, electric kettle and microwave oven, the king beds are super comfortable and the bathroom is a luxury, with toilet and shower in separate cabinets, two pools on a large table and a jacuzzi, I stayed in room 5809 which overlooked the sphere. Complimentary bottles of water are being offered all the time and in the pool area, towels are available in bulk. It is also important to note that in the lobby we always find some employee who spoke Spanish, the wifi works wonderfully, it also has a restaurant where you can have breakfast, lunch and dinner, but this is not included in the reservation.

allReviews.title: Trump Las Vegas: More Carnival Cruise Than Luxury Hotel
allReviews.text: Let me begin by saying that as a proud Trump Card member, I actively seek opportunities to stay at Trump hotels and have always been treated exceptionally well, until this trip. On this trip, I booked two rooms and traveled with friends to celebrate my wife’s recent retirement, selecting Trump Las Vegas specifically because of the high standards we’ve experienced at other Trump properties. Sadly, this stay fell far short. We arrived at 2 PM to find the valet and drive-in area completely jammed. It took 10–15 minutes just to drop off our car, and we were told it was due to understaffing. Thankfully, the bellman was excellent, he took our luggage promptly and met us at our room as promised. Check-in was smooth, and the young woman assisting us kindly arranged a suite upgrade for only $50 more per night. The room itself was beautiful, with a fantastic view.Unfortunately, the atmosphere quickly soured. Each day felt busier than the last, and the clientele became increasingly loud and boisterous to the point it felt more like a Carnival cruise than a luxury hotel. This is not the refined environment we’ve experienced at other Trump properties.The valet situation was especially frustrating. We were told we could not call ahead for our car, and the “summon” feature in the app had been disabled, again, due to understaffing. Each time, we waited nearly 20 minutes for our vehicle. Completely unacceptable for a property of this caliber.While I look forward to visiting other Trump hotels in the future, I will not return to the Las Vegas location. I could have received better service at the Wynn, Four Seasons, or other nearby high-end hotels. I have always said that although I don’t have a billion dollars, Trump hotels make me feel as though I do. I sincerely hope that remains true at other locations, because it was not the case here.

allReviews.title: Best in town
