You can see the tower also from the famous Venetian. Room Service was also very quick. We def. Come here again.

allReviews.title: Not a convenient location
allReviews.text: This hotel was booked by accident on Hotwire. Was the room nice, yes.  Were the staff nice, yes.  The location wasn't convenient to the strip when the adjacent mall was closed. Police presence around the clock was bothersome. Never would have stayed at a Trump location in the current political climate had we known.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel
allReviews.text: This is a non-political review.Great location at the end of the strip. Service was superb, and the cleanliness was fantastic. Loved the room and had a great view of the sphere. The pool was nice, gym too. Only small thing I would like to see USB connections in the room. There are no gambling rooms/areas in the hotel, which we didn't mind, but if wanting that, then it would be best to look at other hotels. Overall, it was a really great stay, and we would definitely come back again.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: Location of the hotel was great, was nice to be a short walk away from the madness of the strip.. The lack of casino here is actually a big positive for us having visited the other hotels and seeing how busy they were and how it would probably be a nightmare navigating through everything to get to just get back to your room! Food here was great and our room was fantastic, only reason we can't rate as 5/5 is because of the train noise (loud horn!!) when you get the mountain view room; it woke me up a good few times during our stay and we were on the 25th floor! 😔

allReviews.title: Decentralized city hotel
allReviews.text: The hotel is ok. Slightly off the beaten track. Expensive and loud. Small pool, manageable breakfast. Railway line nearby. Large room and large bathroom. Roomkeeping only upon request. Very anonymous. No airport shuttle. No casino and that is very good.

allReviews.title: Beautiful food and service, gorgeous decor .
allReviews.text: We visited to have a look around during our stay in Las Vegas. The hotel is gorgeous, absolutely immaculate and the staff are amazing. We were dressed very casually and were a bit worried that we should have dressed better but nobody seemed to care. We checked out the gift shop and bought a few little treats. We had a look around and then had a look at the food menu. We were surprised at how reasonable the prices were so decided to have dinner there. As you can imagine, the service, food and drinks were top notch. The seating area was beautiful. The other patrons were all very chilled out friendly people, a mixture of well dressed and casual patrons. The bill was surprisingly cheap for what we got. We were very impressed, will definitely return and would highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Pamper yourself in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Located at the end of the Strip (so conveniently located), while still immense, this hotel offers a quieter and less chaotic environment than the facilities on the Strip with in-house Casinos. We stayed in a superior suite on the 56th floor really spacious and welcoming. Living area with kitchen, bathroom with shower and sitting area with double sofa bed; sleeping area with corner double bedroom and immense bathroom with bath and shower. All with a truly amazing view of the city. The hotel has a gym, spa and swimming pool. Very convenient that parking is included in the price, with a very fast service.

allReviews.title: Good value but dated
allReviews.text: Arrived as a family of 5 we had 2 rooms both were clean but dated no working phone sockets bedside jacuzzi baths in both rooms were not working lamps had to be unplugged to switch off but this hotel is good value compared to other hotels luggage took 45 Minuits to get a bell boy as they were too heavy to carry had to go up to desk 3 times as car was waiting allso nowhere to sit in lobby had to buy a drink from bar while waiting for luggage

allReviews.title: Peace and quiet in Vegas
allReviews.text: Comfortable hotel, close to the top end of the Strip. We appreciated the fact that there are no casinos, so much quieter than many of the big hotels, nice to come back to after the hustle and bustle of Vegas. Tried to sit out by the pool for an afternoon but had to abandon as the golden glare, reflecting from the hotel,  and the heat, made it unbearable for us. Bed very comfy. Hadn’t appreciated that we’d have no kitchen items, such as bowls, spoons etc, although these can be requested from housekeeping. Staff were all courteous and helpful, and got a lift one evening down the Strip from one of the team, instead of getting a taxi. He was a joy, just wish I could remember his name!

allReviews.title: An amazing timeshare exchange!
allReviews.text: Generally our timeshare exchanges have been for location with inferior quality rooms and service.  Not Trump Hotel! We had a great room, great service, and would absolutely exchange here again.

allReviews.title: Great rooms, staff...
allReviews.text: Currently here. Stayed here last year and loved it.Pros: Rooms are great. There is plenty of space.  Cons: On arrival, no help from staff with bags. They were too busy talking between themselves. Staff at the front counter were rude. Wife actually said   she's happy now after checking in, she won't have to deal with any staff members.  Not sure if we will stay here again next year after a few negative interactions with staff, to many other options on the strip.

allReviews.title: Exceeded My Expectations
allReviews.text: I recently stayed at the Trump International Hotel Las Vegas, and it exceeded my expectations. Initially, I was apprehensive about booking, unsure of what the atmosphere would be like. However, I was pleasantly surprised by the diverse and welcoming clientele. The hotel room was not only spacious but also impeccably clean and luxurious, with thoughtful decorative touches, including beautiful pieces in the glass built in bookshelves. The bathroom was absolutely luxurious. The staff were incredibly friendly and accommodating, making our stay even more enjoyable. The hotel's location is also a major plus, with everything we needed just a short walk away. I especially loved that the mall was right across the street.Everything about our stay felt top-notch, first-class, and yet it came at a fraction of the cost of other hotels. Overall, this was a wonderful experience, free of any political overtones. Everyone we encountered was friendly and respectful. I will definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Nice experience
allReviews.text: Very elegant hotel, clean and friendly staff.It is located slightly moved from the strip (easily accessible on foot) great thing not to be in full chaos. Swimming pool open all year round and indoor restaurant (very expensive). It has no internal mess.Recommended.

allReviews.title: Disappointing experience with inexcusable customer service
allReviews.text: Disappointing Experience with Inexcusable Customer Service at Trump International Hotel, Las VegasOur recent stay at Trump International Hotel in Las Vegas was marred by an appalling lack of customer service and poor management that I would never have expected from a hotel of this caliber.Upon check-in, we were assured that we wouldn't need to check out and check back in despite having two different rates for our stay. This was meant to simplify our experience, but it was only the beginning of a string of issues. Around 3 PM the following day, I received a call inquiring if we had requested a late checkout. I politely explained that we had discussed this with the front desk the day before and asked if they had reviewed the notes on our account. The response I received was rude and dismissive, setting the tone for the rest of our stay.When we returned to the hotel later that day, we had to get new keys for our new room. We were told that a bellhop would assist with the move in about 20 minutes. However, after waiting for what felt like an eternity, no one showed up. We were forced to move our belongings ourselves, which was both inconvenient and frustrating.To make matters worse, when we tried to go back to our original room to retrieve the rest of our belongings, the keys no longer worked. We called the front desk, only to be told that management was aware of the issue but no one was responding. This was a blatant disregard for our time and comfort. After going down to the front desk in person, we were informed that it would take 10 to 15 minutes for a manager to come out and assist us. This further delay impacted our evening plans, and despite the obvious inconvenience, we did not receive an apology or any form of compensation.Adding insult to injury, the room we were moved to had a view that was far below what we had expected—certainly not the quality one would anticipate from a supposed luxury hotel.In summary, the customer service at Trump International Hotel was abysmal. From the rude staff to the complete lack of communication and follow-through, this experience was a huge disappointment. I had expected a stay that was both seamless and enjoyable, but instead, I encountered nothing but frustration and poor service. I cannot recommend this hotel to anyone seeking a pleasant and professional experience.

allReviews.title: Wonderful hotel in Vegas!
allReviews.text: We booked two rooms here for our 3 night stay in Vegas and it was a wonderful hotel which we would highly recommend and would stay in again should we ever return. We had 2 rooms (a king bed with strip view and 2 queen bed room for my teenage boys). Both rooms extremely big, beautiful bathrooms and very quiet considering where we were! Yes the decor is slightly dated but everything was so big and so clean it was worth it. Housekeeping came every day and did a brilliant job. We chose this hotel as it has no casino and people didn’t come to walk around it as they do with the other big hotels. We all felt really safe there and appreciated the men on lift duty ensuring no one accessed the rooms unless they were guests.We used the pool, the bar and the valet and every staff member we encountered were polite and friendly. Based on this stay I would definitely choose a Trump hotel again!

allReviews.title: Absolute 5 Star customer service and attention!!
allReviews.text: Absolute 5 star clean hotel, quiet, with superb customer service!  We were in town early and needed a place for one night so stayed at the Trump Hotel.  There is not a casino, it feels much more of a private, high end resort. The restaurant DJT was delicious for both breakfast and dinner. Our service there, at the front desk and at the pool were all amazing!!  The room was very spacious and the bathroom was amazing!!  If you want to feel like a millionaire, stay here!!  Our best service in many years of travel to Las Vegas.  We will return.

allReviews.title: Will stay again, loved Trump hotel from Australia
allReviews.text: Wow! Love this hotel will stay again. Kerb appeal golden beautiful building with a lovely lobby very tasteful. There is no casino here which is what we wanted, so relaxing from all that is Vegas. Food ate breakfast every day the egg Benny is very nice, we also tried the oats and fresh fruit everything served perfectly. Had one evening meal tasty and reasonably priced plenty of vegetarian options. Restaurant staff were just so nice.  We arrived at 10am and they checked us straight in which was much appreciated after travelling from Australia 🇦🇺 The gym was good with clean towels as had the pool, hubby swam in there few times it was clean and very organised with lifey on duty. Rooms large, with separate lounge and chairs. Bathroom had separate shower and toilet behind frosted doors, the whole room was full of PowerPoints including a x10 light up make up mirror.The strip I’d read comments but literally it’s a 4 min walk to literally be level with the Wynn on the strip, safe at night. During the day to stay in the air con you can walk through the shopping mall, Nordstrom is opposite the hotel just walk through and come out on the strip, not sure when it shuts.Trump store good to look round and well priced. Also a coffee, pastries area in the lobby. Although the restaurant DLT didn’t close from early to late. Will stay here again.

allReviews.title: A great safe relaxing stay
allReviews.text: 2 adults 2 kids 10yrs old and 14yrs old . A great room  on the the 57 th floor over looking the mountain's.  The sun rise was spectacular to see  from the room . Clean spacious comfortable.  Small hob ,oven, fridge which was great . It was a great base for us we came to sight see and explore . No casino here . It's easy going pleasant and not rushed unlike the other hotels on the strip with the millions of humans inside them .Pool was great the life guards so nice and friendly . The bar staff down stairs were brilliant small bar but friendly and I had great chats with other guests. The food looked great bit pricey I thought untill we looked at other hotels . We walked to dennys down the Rd for breakfast 10 min away and stocked up with a few bits for the fridge too . Fashion show mall just across the road and we ate 3 times in calfornia pizza gotta say really good . Also ate at happy camper very good too . It's  close to wynn which has a great buffet too.We moved to another hotel on the strip for the kids to play in the pool park and to see what a casino hotel is like .it's not a patch on the trump . I can't recommend the hotel enough really ticked all our boxes. We all felt safe comfortable relaxed ,we also didn't get lost in it unlike the huge casino hotels .The train does go beat time with 3 too 5 honks of its horn but didn't bother us . Night time View was great too . Looking forward to visiting again .

allReviews.title: All That Glitters May Be Gold
allReviews.text: As you walk to the Trump International Hotel, you may be intimidated. The gilded exterior, the sidewalk that sparkles, the sheer height of the tower. These feelings will be debunked the moment you step into the elegant interior.and replaced by wonder. Each spotless corner is covered in detail from top to bottom. The service is lovely, as we were greeted with warmth and enthusiasm. Our suite was quite comfortable, as there was a stovetop, plenty of cabinet space, a stellar view of the Strip, and a high quality robe that I would quite possibly give five stars for alone. However, the factor that impressed me the most was that there is no casino whatsoever in this hotel For travelers looking for peace and quiet, Trump International is the accommodation worth staying at.Verdict: Elegant, peaceful hotel worth the price.

allReviews.title: POOL CLOSED-STAFF ARE LIARS
allReviews.text: POOL CLOSED FOR NO REASON. Hotels often do this to save money on staff or liability and then lie to patrons saying it’s “lightning” or “ mechanical issues”. It is 101 degrees outside with only a few scattered clouds and the concierge had the gall to tell me there was a “ lightning threat”.When I pay this kind of money for a supposed luxury hotel I do not like to be lied to or have the pool closed when it’s 101° outside just cause they don’t wanna pay somebody $20 an hour to hand out towels on a slow day. LIARS. This place is too far away from the strip anyway and it’s a miserable walk to get there. Hey Trumpster- your hotel is a LOSER

allReviews.title: Very clean
allReviews.text: The comfortable beds The hotel was spotless Many comforts Unlimited bottled water (not discounted in America given the costs)It's just very uncomfortable walking compared to the others that are right downtown.And the extra 10 minutes 15 minutes in crazy heat is toughPool staff not very nice children can practically only breathe.But at check in they give the gadget (backpack with things inside) Would stay again for cleaning but I think I would opt for something else in a more central location

allReviews.title: Normally this would have been a total non-starter…
allReviews.text: ….but there are only two five-star hotels in Las Vegas with both no casino AND no smoking on the property. One - the Four Seasons, was sold out, not that I was paying $600/night x 2 rooms for 3 nights (was traveling with my son to celebrate his 21st birthday). The other - this one - $100+ per night, per room ($200+) cheaper than any other 5 -star hotel in Vegas, essentially meaning one of the two hotel rooms was free.So, I really didn’t know what to expect and had steeled myself for the worst. Accordingly, I was very pleasantly surprised at how… normal… and nice… everything was. Valet service? Not super-fast (lots and lots of cars always coming and going), but efficient and professional. The lobby? Big, bright, very normal looking…totally appropriate for a 5-star hotel. The room? Also big...even though I selected the smallest, least expensive rooms available…and bright. Well furnished, lots of really nice touches (Sub-Zero hotel room fridge…nice. Wolf mini range top…also nice, even if you can’t use it by law…lol). Bathroom? Also big and bright, with all the 5-star hotel touches, like rainwater shower head, separate shower and tub, with the commode in a private closest area…plus the requisite double sinks. Absolutely my favorite hotel room ever at anything remotely close to this price point.Service? Competent at every turn. Not Four Seasons level of service - on multiple occasions it took forever for someone to answer my call, there with a minor housekeeping misstep (one of my calls...I had to call multiple times to get things made right) and no room service (Takeout pseudo DoorDash from the hotel restaurant ordered through a maddening app is NOT “room service”), but whenever I dealt with a person, they were pleasant and professional.I would not call this a 5-star property because of the room service shortcomings, but in every other way it certainly qualified as one. Again, the room was fabulous, as was all the other infrastructure in the hotel. Bright, well maintained. For the rate paid, I would consider it an outstanding value, and I wish I could repeat my stay (not that I anticipate going to Las Vegas again…first trip was to marry my son’s mother…second trip was to celebrate his 21st birthday…I don’t anticipate a third trip…just not my scene).But I can’t repeat my stay. Because…the cult members.There weren’t as many as I was expecting, but those that were present were certainly as loud (in both tone and dress) and as obnoxious as I imagined. Borderline vulgar t-shirts. Loud conversations at the bar about the way things “should be” and how they were going to be made right once their cult leader returned to power (let’s hope not). No, there was no J6 riot. But the J6 attendees were there. Not many, but boy did they want you to know they were there. One even confronted my son, asking him how he could afford to stay there (both my son and I are Black men).These properties for awhile were real bargains in every city they existed, as guests stayed away due to the unpleasant nature of their “owner”, and not wanting to be associated with him in any way. I had always thought that I’d be good with taking advantage of those market forces at play (given how well reviewed they were), but I never had because there was absolutely no way in hell my wife would ever stay at one of these properties (I didn’t even tell her my son and I were staying here until the day before departure, because I didn’t want the grief). So, I did it. Do I regret it? No. Would I go back? Also, no. The cult-members...can't stand them.

allReviews.title: Trump Hotel has it all location, comfort, amenities and attention to detail! Great stay!
allReviews.text: First time at Trump hotel and I must say it was an awesome stay met and exceeded all expectations.  On a trip with family we stayed at two other hotel / casinos days prior and was looking forward to trying this place out.  The location was great next to the mall and easy walk to the Venetian Harrahs and the main strip.  The place was super clean, elegant and the employees were all friendly and helpful.  The amenities are great as well gym, spa, pool that you can access without renting expensive cabanas.  The restaurant had great food and service but the best part is the ultra comfortable rooms huge clean luxurious bathrooms.  Very well appointed nice furniture, cabinets microwave and sink with garbage disposal.  Great stay.   And it is a bonus not having the casino to keep all the hustle bustle if anybody coming through.

allReviews.title: We’ve travelled a lot and this is a first - avoid and stay elsewhere when in Vegas!
allReviews.text: We’d traveled from Glasgow via London so we just wanted our room and some rest but that was scuppered on arrival when we were told our room wasn’t ready yet. Now I get that if you’re checking in before the allocated check in time or even shortly thereafter, but five and a half hours after the hotel’s check in time, seriously? We were given a credit on our room to use in the restaurant where it was suggested we wait until the room was ready. The restaurant was average and overpriced for what you got and soulless. After an hour we finally got to our room, which was decent enough. By that time all we wanted was a bed to fall asleep in. It was a nice enough hotel - typical huge Vegas monolith but as we were only staying one night before departing for our next destination it worked out being a very expensive bed for five hours rest! They need to up their service and organisation, but I guess get away with it being Vegas and all that. Definitely won’t be back and its location is a bit rubbish too, built on a bit of wasteland away from the Strip at the back of a shopping centre. All in all a bit of an odd hotel.

allReviews.title: Luxury in Vegas
allReviews.text: Lovely large rooms and comfy beds in a plush hotel. It is across the road from the fashion mall so we spent time shopping in there during the day and enjoying the a/c. It also provided a cut through to the main strip. We had a view of the strip too which included a view of the ever changing Sphere. Hotel is beautiful and was good value for money.

allReviews.title: Loved it.
allReviews.text: The hotel is excellent. The rooms are serviced daily and always a pleasure to return to each day. The facilities are very well maintained. Every member of staff was excellent, you couldn't really ask for more. The view was exceptional, you could see the strip, the surrounding area and the mountains from the front of the hotel. The hotel is off the strip but you can walk to the strip in 5 mins. You will be charged 500 USD for damages which is a reservation value booked against a bank card. Try to take a credit card, because if not, this will sit against your balance which may restrict how much you can then take daily from an ATM, depending on your daily limit, you can counter this by increasing your daily limit easily enough.Only thing I didnt like are dogs which can be barking in the lobby, to me it doesnt make sense even though I like dogs. It's not what you want to hear inside a building, but I guess you have to cater for everyone. The hotel has no casino which adds to its exclusivity. Will go back for sure!

allReviews.title: Beautiful and clean
allReviews.text: Beautiful, clean hotel. Friendly stuff. The rooms are big and quiet. Great location right across from the mall and a walking distance from the Vegas Strip. We loved our stay and would definitely recommend it to anyone who wants to visit Vegas but doesn’t want to stay right on the strip.

allReviews.title: Good hotel but requires more amenities
allReviews.text: In general a good hotel, very well located, but requires maintenance to hydromassage system in the tubs of some rooms that they say in the hotel have decomposed by failure of parts of the manufacturer. Improve the periodicity of the cleaning service, they only performed it to the room on a single occasion in a stay of 7 nights because they have it defined in their program that they deliver to you at the time of checkin. A railway passing near the Hotel emits perceptible noise in the rooms

allReviews.title: Best place to stay
allReviews.text: I recommend anyone to stay at trump tower. Best experience ever. I love the service from the valley to the front desk to the security to the housekeepers everything. Definitely recommend this place to families and friends

allReviews.title: Great hotel to relax at. Thanks again Savanna.
allReviews.text: Whilst having a long vacation in Las Vegas my wife Tracey and I (Mick) decided we needed to have a break from the manic strip and resort we were staying at and visit a more relaxed hotel for a chill out drink.So on the 23rd June 2024 we came across the Trump International Hotel and decided to visit. So glad we did and we had a great time relaxing at the lobby bar. There we were served by a lovely girl bartender Savanna who treated us so well with her fun and friendly manner that we decided to stay at the bar longer than we’d planned ! So we’d like to send her our best wishes and many thanks. If in the future we return to Las Vegas then this is the type of hotel, which looks great, we would definitely stay at.

allReviews.title: Beautiful 5-star hotel with poor customer service
allReviews.text: This is genuinely a beautiful 5 star hotel. However, they were drinking near my room for over 30 mins and work me up when I needed sleep! I called hotel manager and they didn’t como me in any way or even really apologize. An expensive 5-star hotel should have MUCH BETTER CUSTOMER SERVICE! Was utterly disappointed! Beautiful accommodations though!

allReviews.title: Quick stay passing through Vegas
allReviews.text: We stayed as a family of 4 in July in a suite room.The rooms are very large with kitchenette area in the living space.  Cutlery/plates/cups etc need to be requested on arrival which sort of defeats the objective of the space. However the fridge freezer is the coldest I've had in hotel rooms which is excellent.Views from the room are great, and it's location at the end of the strip is good but sometimes the walk around the area by the CVS on the corner is a little seedy.Ss it's just a hotel and not a casino it does all the basics right and is at a good price point.  The room was better than the average strip hotel I would argue.We will return.

allReviews.title: Great service
allReviews.text: The bellhop and other services were really on point.  The hotel is right across the street from a mall so it makes getting to other hotels easy and cool because you can stay mostly indoors for walking. The pool doesn’t look like the pictures it’s regular.

allReviews.title: Exceptional Stays at the Trump International Hotel Las Vegas
allReviews.text: My multiple stays at the Hilton Grand Vacations Club at the Trump International Hotel in Las Vegas have always been pleasant. The staff is superb, and the views are breathtaking. I chose this hotel for its convenient location near the Las Vegas Strip and a quiet environment for work if needed. The rooms are spacious, peaceful, and comfortable. The pool and surrounding seating areas are perfect for lounging, taking a refreshing swim, or simply soaking in the beautiful surroundings. Plus, the hotel features a nicely equipped gym for a great workout session.

allReviews.title: Flawless
allReviews.text: Extremely nice stay, really amazing and luxurious hotel. Fantastic bathroom with top bathroom. We really enjoyed our stay here. The hotel is a short walk from the Strip, easily walkable. Valet parking was well organized as is the whole hotel.

allReviews.title: Yasmine is the gem.
allReviews.text: During our Vegas trip, we stayed at Trump International Hotel and had an exceptional experience thanks to Yasmine's warm and beautiful smile. She welcomed us with such friendliness, which we had never experienced before. Despite the super hot weather and the traffic affecting our mood, Yasmine made our anniversary celebration special.Our plans had changed several times before the trip, and some guests canceled at the last minute. At the hotel, we heard other guests complaining about the lighting and pool access limitations. We considered canceling our stay due to the lack of a casino and pool, but Yasmine's cheerful attitude and funny stories lifted our spirits. She even suggested upgrading our room with discounts and perks, which turned out to be a fantastic decision. She sent goodies to our room, provided extra towels, and made our stay memorable. For the first time at a Trump hotel, we felt like VIPs.Her manager, Jake, and Lili P were also friendly and helpful, although one manager at the first-floor bar was rude and dismissive. However, Yasmine's exceptional service overshadowed any negativity. Although the bedding had some spots, which I usually make a big deal about, I overlooked it because of Yasmine.As world travelers, we have never experienced such outstanding service. If you stay at Trump International Hotel, ask for Yasmine, and you’ll be guaranteed VIP treatment. We heard other guests in the elevator praising her as well. Yasmine is a gem, and we will always look for her. She truly deserves to be the head of the Trump hotel, as her dedication and warm smile solve all problems. We will definitely continue staying at this hotel.

allReviews.title: Very nice, nice staff but in the room nothing works.
allReviews.text: Pension is very nice and well located, really nice and pleasant staff, everything is bling bling, golden ☺️. On the other hand, there are some signs of lack of maintenance, we had a room for 4, very large and pleasant with a breathtaking view, a huge bubble bath but not working, like the toilet, as well as the fridge. When we reported it at reception, the guy didn’t care, too bad.

allReviews.title: Nice big comfy room
allReviews.text: Very roomy and quiet unit. Location is good and very close to shops and other casinos. We will definitely comeback.

allReviews.title: The man knows how to run a hotel business
allReviews.text: Once again back to Las Vegas after 8 years to visit family and once again a stay at the Trump.  There is no casino and no smoke, only comfortable rooms and excellent service. Having a luxury experience at a reasonable value is all we ask. We've stayed at this hotel multiple times in the past and if given the opportunity, we will stay at the Trump again. The hotel is close to shopping and the Strip.

allReviews.title: Agradavél stay
allReviews.text: Good location , clean hotel , good reception , great facilities , very spacious unit , huge suite bathroom, which would fit 4 people very quietly and we were only in 2 people . The only thing is that in the unit we stayed the kitchen utensils were few in comparison to other enterprises of the genre.

allReviews.title: Excellent property
allReviews.text: We had a great time and the room was excellent and very clean. Service was outstanding! Will be back!

allReviews.title: Wouldn’t give us a refund after few minutes of making reservations. What’s this world coming to
allReviews.text: It’s our anniversary 40th anniversary. I made reservations last night to stay here and right after making them realized there’s no slot machines. My husband loves Vegas and gambling! A few minutes after making reservations, I tried to cancel, even sent them a text and they refused. So now I’m left with, figuring out, how to break the news to him. Thanks trump for refusing my request! You made my vacation/ anniversary the best one! 😭

allReviews.title: Five star quality!
allReviews.text: My whole family absolutely LOVED our stay at the Trump Hotel! It is very clean and family friendly hotel. It definitely has a five star feel. We truly enjoyed ourselves and we plan to make this our exclusive hotel each time we come to Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Perfect stay
allReviews.text: This is our 4th time to Vegas and we have never stayed at the same hotel. We decided to try Trump because they do not have a casino and have free valet parking. Upon arrival we were greeted by amazing staff, they took our car and a young bell boy took our bags and said he would meet us in our room.After check in which was quick and easy even at 16:30, not wait at all. The lady who checked us in was so helpful, curtious and smiling.Our room was on the 18th floor, very clean, large and the WC was of good size as well, Bathtub which we did not use and a huge shower, good pressure and some good toiletries. We only tried the breakfast once and it was pretty good and quick.The pool are is not the biggest but their level of service was excellent.In all the service was amazing, everybody  wanted to assist, security was also excellent.This is a quiet hotel and we will surely stay again when in Vegas, that is crystal clear.100% happy and thanks.

allReviews.title: Trump international is the best stay in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: First class all the way!  Great security.  All staff was very nice and helpful.  Great pool and nice restaurant.   The room was immaculate. Clean and so very nice.  Valet was very fast    I will for sure stay at the Trump international in Las Vegas again!!

allReviews.title: Last minute stay Vegas
allReviews.text: Easy checkin. Staff were very nice and helpful. Loved the rooms . Spacious room with great view of the Sphere. Coffee maker in room was nice since most hotels do not have them. Rooms and bathroom very clean. Bed comfortable and a spacious sitting area . A Trump gift shop for souvenirs. They had hats, drinking cups, and clothes. Would recommend hotel to friends and family.

allReviews.title: Trump Towers was AWESOME!
allReviews.text: From the minute we pulled up to Trump Towers, we knew that our stay was going to be AWESOME and it totally was!!!!

allReviews.title: Awesome Hotel!
allReviews.text: Very systematic and technology on valet parking as well. Very organized. Security is great when it comes to people going to elevator who have accessed card only with security personnel.

allReviews.title: Luxurious Penthouse Suite , Great Value
allReviews.text: A luxurious home away from home. We booked a 2-bedroom penthouse with 1700 square feet on the 64th floor for two nights. The penthouse suite was luxurious with one guest bath next to the foyer. The main master room had a fabulous bathroom and his and her closets. The floor to ceiling windows in the living room were outstanding, especially with the view from the high floor. The kitchen and dining room area was cozy. The pantry was stocked with all the kitchen wares you can think of. The other bedroom was great as well with floor to ceiling windows and a very good-sized bathroom. The only complaint with the high floor was with lots of helicopter noise during afternoon and evening from the local tours. One night, there was also loud club music till 2am and the front desk said that was ‘normal’ since there is large club venue next to hotel.  Maybe the other side of the hotel is quieter.  We ordered breakfast two days in a row from the downstairs restaurant and the entrees were all generously sized and delicious. Unfortunately, we had to go downstairs and order it from the bar and wait for it as there was no room service for that. Access to all parts of the strip was very easy by Taxi. Overall, a great value for a luxury penthouse suite and better priced than other 2 bedroom penthouse suites on or near the strip.

allReviews.title: Outstanding Hotel
allReviews.text: We stayed at the Trump Resort on June 18 -20. This was the 2nd time we stayed there. This is the only 5-star resort that does not have a casino. So if you want to get away from the element that hangs out in casinos and avoid the choking smoke, this is a great option. We paid an extra $25 per night for a high-level room facing the strip. The rooms are very comfortable and the view was excellent. We only ate breakfast at the hotel, but the service was outstanding. The food was very good and the portion size was large. We had cocktails at the bar each evening. It's a very nice bar and it was a true pleasure to see Fox displayed on both TV’s. The free valet service is very good – although there was some serious congestion in that area on several days. I am not sure if that is a staffing issue or a customer volume issue. I always tip on the vehicle drop off and pick up, as do most people. Although I witnessed a number of people who think “free” means you don’t take care of the valet people. Some people have no class and you can see them in Las Vegas – even at 5-star resorts.  Overall, the hotel is very nice, the staff is excellent, and service is outstanding. I recommend you stay here when traveling in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Perfect view of the room
allReviews.text: I stayed at the hotel for two nights. The hotel is very clean and works very well, the room was on the high floor and had a sensational view of Las Vegas, being able to see the whole strip and the sphere, which makes the experience much cooler.The parking is valet type and free, which is very good.I think it is one of the best options to stay in LV as it is an oasis in the middle of the bustle of the city.

allReviews.title: Top!
allReviews.text: Meraviglioso Trump! Room on the 56th floor, very comfortable bed, very large and really elegant bathroom, parking included in the price, staff all in all ok, although a guy specifically with whom we dealt at the beginning for check-in was not much "empathic".. indeed... very "about his" and "rigid". Luckily the other two girls were softer.Outside the Strip (about 1.5 miles)...No casino inside the Hotel, and that s good! Ne ripaga la tranquillità! Super promosso!

allReviews.title: Excellent place to stay!
allReviews.text: Excellent hotel!The beds are very comfortable and the pillows are like resting your head on clouds!  Excellent room - we stayed on the 52nd floor.  Besides that, staff was AWESOME!  The ONLY down side to it was the parking.  They had FREE valet service to park in their underground facility, which is nice, but if you forget something in your car - or go out multiple times a day, it gets cumbersome & I chose to tip each time.I've seen other reviews that said the fridge wasn't cold.  They turn them down to the lowest setting during non-occupied times.  If you change it, it gets very cold.  Our room had a stove, microwave, sink & cupboards.  They will send up all dishes and utensils as needed as Clark County code prohibits them from stocking each room with those items.Spendy stay, but an EXCELLENT HOTEL with EXCEPTIONAL STAFF that go above & beyond for you!Photos I posted are AFTER we had been there 4 days, so that's why it looks somewhat messy.

allReviews.title: Great experience.
allReviews.text: I’ve been to Vegas 3 times now and wouldn’t stay anywhere else. It was a great experience. From the first class room to amazing staff, we enjoyed our stay immensely. We loved the fact it is a no smoking hotel and didn’t have a casino and it’s kid friendly and they welcome pets! Oh and it’s very affordable, what’s not to like? We will be staying there when we go back no doubt.

allReviews.title: Very good hotel
allReviews.text: Free parking with a valet service who takes care of your vehicle upon your arrival.A room overlooking the splendid strip (option that I recommend) the other views are on the mountain side or on the sphere side.Very large, fully equipped bedroom with large shower and large jet bathtub.Free WIFI.Swimming pool small but sufficient because very well equipped with enough deckchairs.Possibility of having lunch on site (or pop-up bar in the morning with coffee and pastries to take away); two restaurants on site.Hotel right in front of a Macys Dillards shopping complex... with a large food mall.The hotel is certainly at the end of the strip so bring good shoes, the resort fees are 42 dollars per night and no surprises at check out 😉A very very good stay and impeccable cleaning!!

allReviews.title: BEST IN VEGAS
allReviews.text: This is our second year in a row staying at the Trump hotel and we loved it even more the second time! The hotel is so beautiful, upscale, and extremely clean! The service is very good and the staff is very friendly. We love that the Trump doesn’t have a casino, it’s so quiet and not packed with tons of people. It’s right off the strip, so you can explore and enjoy the madness all you want and then come back to the serenity of the Trump! We will definitely be back next year!

allReviews.title: Not the best experience
allReviews.text: The rooms are nice and the layout is very comfortable. I love the fact that there is no casino here.However, when checking in the staff focus on trying to convince you to upgrade your room and during the check in process there is no information provide about the hotel such as where the pool is or restaurants etc.  I had to call down to the front desk the get that information.  The straw the broke the camel's back is finding out, after the fact, that they charge $4 per letter for mail delivered to you at the property.  It may be difficult to find a better alternative in LV that does not overwhelm you with the smoke smell from the casinos.

allReviews.title: Gorgeous place
allReviews.text: We have stayed in many properties in Las Vegas including the Wynn, the Venetian and the Bellagio however the Trump is by far our favourite. Although it doesn't have all of the bells and whistles of the aforementioned hotels, it is spotlessly clean and the staff are by far the friendliest we've come across. It smells absolutely gorgeous as soon as you enter the hotel and the sense of elegance hits you right away. We've stayed twice now and look forward to our next stay. Thank you so much.

allReviews.title: Best stay in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: I can’t recommend this hotel highly enough, from the minute we checked in to the moment we left, the staff made us feel at home. The rooms are expansive, the health club is first rate and the pool was wonderful. This was our second stay here and I doubt we will stay anywhere else when visiting Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Trump!!
allReviews.text: Highly recommend this resort.  Top notch service.   All the staff were helpful and polite.   Would recommend visiting Trump resorts!

allReviews.title: Elegant, professional staff and nice clientele.
allReviews.text: We stayed in a studio for a week. We have stayed in one bedrooms too which if you get a corner unit the view is awesome. The studio is very spacious and includes a huge bathroom with jacuzzi and also a sofa and a desk. The mini kitchen has coffee, a spacious refrigerator, plates, wine glasses, a stove and microwave. Only negative thing I can say is I could see lots and lots of dust under the bed while sitting on the sofa. If you need anything, you call and they bring it right away. We didn’t use the pool this time because it was hot and the pool is all in the sun and we heard from others it was on the chilly side. We look forward to going back in a few weeks. Oh..the restaurant is great. We love the DJT burgers and the haddock. The server was professional and no fake friendly blah blah blah like other places. She was very friendly not overly gushy friendly waste time stuff.

allReviews.title: Dont use the valet
allReviews.text: The valet damage my car tire. The roim is clean. The showers are clean. Just dont use the vaket if you can

allReviews.title: Great accommodation option in Las Vegas!
allReviews.text: Hotel is practical as it does not have a casino. It has a large, clean and very comfortable room! Safe development and great service!

allReviews.title: Stopped on way to Hawaii
allReviews.text: Lovely hotel Large room with comfortable bed and beautiful bathroom including a jacuzzi. The staff were friendly, we had breakfast there a couple of times but not dinner as it is quite expensive.. as is everywhere in Las Vegas. The room had a kitchen area which is handy for washing up anything you buy to eat in. I just had to call housekeeping to bring up some plates etc. The housekeeping was brilliant, someone came every day.

allReviews.title: Fabulous place!
allReviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about this hotel. Besides the fact it is a beautiful hotel, it’s immaculate and was so quiet even being sold out we were told. So obviously a well built hotel. We ate breakfast every morning there and it was fabulous. Gorgeous place. Used the pool also which was great. I can’t leave this review without thanking a very special Individual at the bell desk, Miguel!!  He went above and beyond for us when we checked out and needed a ride to the airport.  There was another bellman who helped us with a ride the 2nd night we were there as well, but unfortunately I didn’t get his name. Almost every staff member at the hotel is amazing. We had a small hiccup when checking in, but it was quickly corrected. Bravo to the Trump managers and all employees here, you rock!!

allReviews.title: Hotel of wealth and prosperity
allReviews.text: Hotel of wealth and prosperity, I am a rich man from Du Bai. If you come to this city, you should not miss the hotel of the world's great President Trump. Professional service, beautiful scenery, beautiful space, delicious food. Come here with all your enthusiasm and passion for America.

allReviews.title: First Impressions......
allReviews.text: First time here as usual I called ahead to let the hotel know hey don't give our already paid for room away, we are going to be there just not until 1030 pm, we were flying in late hubby had to work, his bad right?! (Sarcasm) We get to the hotel just as I said. At first the girl at the front desk Ashley, as she will then repeat several times after this, is pleasant and proceeds to check us in. The hotel itself is beautiful, a little plain I was expecting more from Trump but okay. Ashley asks us the normal questions, how was our flight, our information etc..., then she looks puzzled and proceeds to whisper to her female go worker smiles at us and says she will be right back. We say okay and she walks away, a few minutes later she returns. Earlier we found out there was some music festival going on we had never heard about and all the hotels were crazy booked up. But I had concert tickets to Maroon 5 and had made these reservations months ago, so I was not concerned. Until Ashley proceeded to tell me about the inconvenience we were now going to have to go through because they had overbooked their hotel. Now I was okay with it UNTIL the attitude came out. I had mentioned that I had a feeling there would be an issue when I had called earlier during check in time to make sure that I called as a courtesy that I let them know we would be there but just later in the evening. Ashley stated well your reservation doesn't guarantee you a room, I stated my full payment does! She states you made that you made through a third party, in a very demeaning and degrading tone. Like third party was a dirty word I thought it was pretty sweet, considering she was someone who was working on the other side of the counter waiting on me at the time.  (no offense to anyone in the industry I was just mad at the time) I work very hard for my money which I am sure a lot of people do, in any case. She went on to say if I don't like it, I can find another hotel to stay at! Now anyone that knows me at this point knows I could have said a lot worse but all I said was this is BS but that is the short version. I told her you have no customer service skills. Ashley said Well you can speak to my manager if you like, and you don't need to curse at people. I said no one is cursing at you and then her co-worker chimes in and says you were cursing. I said because I said this situation is BS! It is! your hotel over books, she has an attitude and tell me if I don't like I can find somewhere else to stay at 11pm at night but I am not supposed to be upset about it, okay!! I said I didn't call anyone names; she gives us our room keys has the audacity to tell my husband thanks for being so nice about the situation and we go to our room. The hotel is nice the rest of our weekend was great, and the spa was the best the staff there were lovely, they need to get rid of some of their staff or train them on their customer service skills or they won't have repeat customers and the over booking is terrible. I paid for my room and expected to get what I paid for bottom line. I shouldn't have to compromise or be put out and you should take care of your guests. It shouldn't be the other way around and your staff shouldn't be ganging up on your guests. Customer service in key, I am seeing less and less of that now adays.

allReviews.title: Perfect
allReviews.text: A great place to stay, with a great location very close to the stripThe room is well equipped with many accessories and a very comfortable bed.Spacious and clean bathroom

allReviews.title: Very clean hotel
allReviews.text: Great customer service.  very clean hotel. New carpeting in the hallways.  clean room.  quick and free valet service.  quiet and doesn't smell like cigarettes.  i would definitely stay here again and recommend to everyone.  reasonable priced too.

allReviews.title: Good hotel, be aware of what you get for what you pay.
allReviews.text: We had a limited time in LV, so when we went to check- in too early (12:15) we were offered a two- corner suite for a $100 upgrade. SOLD!The 52nd- floor suite was huge and included a wetbar, dining table for eight, floor- to- ceiling windows on the south and east, a huge bathroom with a shower large enough for a party, and His and Hers closets with enough space for a three- month stay.Only one big downside: Above was a disco, and the thump- thump- thump was constant, from the moment we checked in until 3am. AND, there was no coffee machine, something that's standard in even low- end hotels. The $40 "resort fee" did not include the pool, for which another $25 pp was payable, so the resort fee was just a junk fee and brought nothing at all, beyond a slow internet limited to only two devices. RIPOFF.

allReviews.title: Never Again.  Terrible Service.
allReviews.text: Paid for a shuit that had full kitchen but no utensils, pots, pans, dishes provided by the hotel.  Can not order meals by phone.  Terrible or shortage of services.  Have stayed at Trump Las Vegas many times before, and had wonderful stays, it appears that this hotel is having to cut back on service to save money.

allReviews.title: Nica stay but could be better.
allReviews.text: Overall my stay at Trump International was a good one except for the noise disturbance from the contactors removing old carpets and installing new ones the floor my room was located and the floor above. They started the removal during the midnight hours. They left dirty debris on the carpet in the hallway and equipments in the hallway. The hotel management did not inform us this.

allReviews.title: Trump International Hotel Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Beautiful reception and organised friendly staff  Room was spectacular couldn’t fault anything bathroom also large with duel sinks large shower and bath , lots of marble and mirrors, toiletries supplied were superb Housekeeping did the room everyday, clean towels and toiletries, tea and coffee Asked for a room overlooking the strip which we received and the views where spectacular, from the front of this hotel you have great views of the sphere and the strip All the staff always greeted you with a smile  Very secure hotel,  security always looks at the passes before you enter the lifts There is a restaurant on site and a small cart,  of a morning selling coffee and pastries There is no casino here so no noise or smoke Small walk to strip through a shopping mall and if closed it’s about 10 minutes around the outside of the mall Wonderful experience in a wonderful hotel, fabulous thankyou for a wonderful stay

allReviews.title: Good non-casino option
allReviews.text: We stayed in the Hilton Vacation Club part of the hotel.  It was a suite very nicely appointed.  Granite  counter in kitchen.  Lovely, large master bath.  Also, a second bath.  Large sitting area.  Clean comfortable.  We loved the fact that there was no casino.  Staff was attentive and professional.  Particularly liked the fact that everyone must scan their room card to enter the elevators.  Nice security touch.  We had one meal in the only restaurant.  Very average breakfast.  We were not interested in the menu options for dinner so passed.  Would stay again.

allReviews.title: Chic, quiet premium hotel on Las Vegas Boulevard
allReviews.text: The Trump International Las Vegas offers a unique, upscale and quiet ambience on the Strip, making it a retreat where you can feel at home. Located on a side street of Las Vegas Boulevard, this non-casino hotel is a jewel of postmodern architecture, both inside and out. The rooms are clean and furnished to the standards of a five-star premium hotel. The service staff are consistently friendly, always attentive and helpful, and have the right answer for even the most difficult of requests, and respond extremely quickly to any inquiries. There is a small minus point for the housekeeping. Our room was only cleaned twice during our 7-day stay. In a hotel of this quality, I expect daily cleaning and changing of towels.

allReviews.title: 2024 vacation
allReviews.text: Me & My Wife Stay at The Trump International Hotel was so surprising Excellent I mean 10☆ Quailty & Service.5 or 6 minutes walk to the strip perfect location no smoking or gambling inside the Hotel! This is my favorite Hotel in Vegas now!!!!

allReviews.title: Beautiful resort
allReviews.text: The cleanest room I've ever stayed inFriendly staff made us feel very welcomeRestaurant food was goodVery nice pool area and gym areaWill return for sure

allReviews.title: The Trump in Vegas no complaints!
allReviews.text: First off let me start by saying that this is customer service at its finest!From the moment we checked in Ashley had a smile on her face and made check in pleasant and simple.Her mannerism even when I was actually a little hangry and cold was on point.She made my first impression a good one to say the least.The room is very spacious, the bed is actually very comfortable and the room clean. The view at night was insane as one wall is all window it’s really nice.The pool area is on the smaller side but beautiful and well kept and we found chairs everyday no issue.The kids that work at the pool are respectful, kind and helpful. Really nice to see that the younger staff also aims to please.We ate daily while at the pool and in all honesty probably the food I enjoyed most. It was fresh, tasted good and Decent prices considering Vegas and hotel food.Coffee station is perfect for a quick grab and go early in the morning and the staff is super friendly as well. The ladies always had a smile on their faces.Also the added security check before getting into the hotel elevators is very nice to see as added protection. Also always greeting you with a smile. The resort fees are the lowest compared to some of the other hotels and free internet.Maybe the only thing is it’s a bit off the strip but literally it’s about a 5 min walk to the Wynn and main strip. We love walking so this wasn’t an issue at all!The mall is directly across from the hotel and you can even cross through it. some doors open as early as 6am which you can grab Starbucks if you wanted.It’s not the most modern or biggest hotels like the other ones but it was what we were looking for.Also liked that it had no casino and no smoking. All in all for me it’s the Staff and customer service that I appreciated the most.Well done !! Keep up the good work!

allReviews.title: Ct travelers
allReviews.text: We enjoyed everything about our stay. It's close to everything. The pool staff is excellent, very attentive. The floors were very quite and clean

allReviews.title: If I went back to Las Vegas I would stay there again.
allReviews.text: Clean, no cigarette smell, conveniently located. The staff was friendly and helpful. The rooms were spacious and had great windows. The bathroom was very large and beautifully kept.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay if you're working a convention.
allReviews.text: After a long day on the convention floor, it's good to stay someplace clean, smoke free, that really is more of an apartment than a hotel. The restaurant is rarely more than a ten minute wait without reservations, the food is terrific, and the staff is exceptional. No walking through a casino, no smoke, no crowded restaurants, and it's easy to get a cab in the front back to the convention center (10 minutes @8am). Great view from the rooms also.

allReviews.title: American luxury
allReviews.text: We stayed 5 days in this hotel during our 2nd visit to Vegas and it was quite a good surprise.Certainly this hotel is not on the strip and there is nothing around it which is a shame (allow 5 minutes on foot) but we had a breathtaking suite on the 54th floor with a 180° view of the city and the mountains! Truly a magnificent spectacle.The room was very clean, sheets and towels changed every day. Kingsize bed with good bedding, 2 dressing rooms, a kitchen, a living room and 2 bathrooms all in marble, including a splendid one with a large spa bath opening onto a bay window, a large shower, 2 sinks with a huge mirror. Hair dryer ok, shower gel, soap, shampoo and conditioner every day. There is a spa in this hotel but we did not try it.The disadvantages of this hotel:- the swimming pool is not fun at all and not pretty compared to the other hotels on the strip, it's frustrating.- There is no attention that makes the difference in a hotel such as the provision of a bathrobe and slippers- There is no casino in this hotel- A single restaurant on the ground floor which is very expensive and austere.- This hotel is not well served by taxis.

allReviews.title: You will be impressed.
allReviews.text: First thing I did was send pics home of how nice the room accommodations are.  Was concerned not right on strip, but walk to strip not bad at all, and if you have been in Vegas before you know you are going to have to Uber downtown or to the other end anyway.   I will be back.

allReviews.title: Viva Las Vegas Trump Hotel
allReviews.text: The Trump was very clean and has an excellent location and spacious suites. We enjoyed our stay in a smoke-free hotel without a casino. The pullout bed was not comfortable (very thin mattress) and we ended up adding another room to our suite. If you have stayed in Trump NYC, be prepared for a less well appointed room and drastically reduced service however the price reflects that.  Overall, it was a pleasant experience.

allReviews.title: Is big but gawdy
allReviews.text: Needs to be updated and modernized , as this is not what I expected for a trump plaza. The place is comfortable and clean and quick roomy, but the gawdy gold Color needs to go, and the place needs to be refreshed. This is not a place I would stay again at , but my style

allReviews.title: Relaxing week with friends at Trump Int
allReviews.text: We vacation twice a year in Vegas at Hilton-Trump, as a safe and very clean resort with excellent service and large pool. Friends (older couple) joined us and were very impressed with what Trump has to offer. Large rooms, nice kitchen, hot tub, view of Sphere, security, etc. Short walk to casinos and Caesars, Fashion Show mall and restaurants across the street. No resort fees and complimentary valet parking.Reservations this month and again in the fall.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: Excellent hotel. Luxurious and quiet. They have rooms that face the strip and from our room we could see the Sphere. It has a pet relief area and inside the room it has an electric stove, microwave and minibar. Although there are no plates, glasses or cutlery in the room, with a single call to housekiping, they gave us all the necessary instruments to eat in the room.

allReviews.title: Super disappointed
allReviews.text: I was taken by surprise on how disappointing this hotel stay was.  I used my credit card's travel program to set up the accommodations.   I specifically paid for a room with two beds because I was traveling with my 13-yr-old old.   There was a less expensive king bed option, but I paid extra to have 2 beds.  When I arrived at the hotel, they had put me in a King bed room.  The gentleman at the counter very rudely stated that I paid for a king bed.  I tried to show him my emailed receipt showing otherwise and he wouldn't even look.  He then stated "well, we didn't approve it because we sold out of all of those rooms.  You will have to take it up with your credit card company".  I had no idea I had to be approved for something I specifically paid for, but his attitude was the worst part.  The room included a very uncomfortable pull-out sofa, so I called and asked if they could send additional bedding to make it more comfortable.   I wanted to go get dinner, but I waited for housekeeping first.  I waited about 45 minutes and had to call again because they never showed up.  The gentleman was very nice during both phone calls, but why did I have to call twice?  They came the 2nd time.We soon discovered that the jets in our tub didn't work.   We tried numerous times with different instructions from the staff and the tub was never functional,  so we asked for someone to come to take a look at it.  They said they would send "engineering".  We waited about 1.5 hours and then we had to leave.  Engineering never showed up and we never heard from them.I can't remember having such repeated poor service or being treated so rudely in any establishment.  I always greet people with a smile and I do expect the same, especially on vacation.  I had such high hopes for this hotel.

allReviews.title: Find a better hotel
allReviews.text: The hotel was outdated compared to other hotels. Our flight was canceled and they put us up at this hotel. I asked for any other hotel but this was the only one they had available. The staff was rude and unhelpful. Room was dated, smells bad like it was not aired out or ac was not turned on. Plus, the room seems dirty like it was rushed to clean. There was a stain in and around the kitchen area. We asked for another room and was told this what the airline paid for.  The food was over priced and not very good for the food credits we got. For a man think his hotels are great no so. Tasteless gold every wear. I seen new hotels and timeless hotels do a better job. I would so what a dump.  I seen a a basic Hilton hotel better than this. He run his hotels like he ran the country….crappy . Trying to screw everyone over. There are better deals and better places to stay in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Excellent Hotel
allReviews.text: As I am not fun of Trump,I ended in his hotel in Las Vegas!iI have to admit it is great hotel ,great service and if you prefer not to be that near noisy strap (10 min walk)this will be great hotel for you!There is no casino in and just cross a street is beautiful shopping centre with e coffee place !Definitely I would come back!

allReviews.title: GREAT
allReviews.text: I had already stayed with my family at the Trump in July 2022 and when we planned the new trip with Las Vegas on the itinerary, we chose the Trump again. It is well located, close to the Strip without necessarily being on the Strip. It is easily accessible. Parking is free, although it is valet. There are no casinos in the hotel, which is an extremely positive point when you are traveling with minors. The view is breathtaking! GIANT rooms, very well decorated, fragrant, complete! Microwave, minibar, stove, sink, dishwasher, bathroom with isolated shower and toilet, huge bathtub, countertop with double sink! Exclusive and high-quality amenities. In short: excellent! There is a resort fee, but when compared to what other hotels in Las Vegas charge, the price is perfectly acceptable! I recommend it with my eyes closed and I would definitely stay again!

allReviews.title: Not Good
allReviews.text: We have stayed at other Trump properties, and frankly, none of them were really up to snuff. But this one really isn't very good, so many nicer properties to stay at. It's tired and everything is a little worn looking. I mean, the shears were practically shredded.

allReviews.title: Very clean, great amenities!
allReviews.text: Very clean, great room amenities!For the room size, pricing and quality of this hotel, you really can’t beat it! We stayed here as a quick place to sleep before heading to Zion and it was only a 6 min Uber from the airport. Check in was a breeze and same with the check out. I love the kitchen option and all toiletries/amenities were great quality. If we come back to Vegas, I would definitely consider this hotel again.

allReviews.title: As always, our first choice in Vegas! However, they should renovate in the next few years.
allReviews.text: We stayed there for two nights for the fifth time in three years. Much of it was just as good as usual (see other reviews). Unfortunately, the receptionist was not as friendly this time as we are used to. The rooms were large and good as always - but they should think about renovating them in the next few years. The brown couch in the room and the carpet are probably no longer up to date or will soon have seen their best. In terms of rooms, there is NO comparison to the Trump Hotel in Chicago.

allReviews.title: It’s no Four Seasons.
allReviews.text: My husband & I were traveling for a work event. We typically stay at The Four Seasons, but knowing we weren’t going to spend much time in the room, we opted for something we thought may be comparable, but less expensive. We were wrong. It’s non-gaming & that’s about the only thing it had in common with The Four Seasons. The room was spacious but dated. There were some stains on the carpet. The water pressure was poor & when I turned the shower knob, it fell off into my hand. I just slid it back on. There weren’t any robes & the towels felt cheap. The windows aren’t soundproof, so I could hear the train & no one came to clean our room. The gym was nice. The customer service was excellent. If The Four Seasons is a 10, this is a 6. We wouldn’t stay again.

allReviews.title: Would never expect the experience from the Trump Brand
allReviews.text: I have stayed at the Trump Towers prior, always great stay. Until our door did not lock,didn't realize until night two. Contacted the front desk, security was there within seconds and very concerned. Due to a security issue, security asked us to move. The front desk didn't put us in a room comparable nor apologize for the issue. I asked for the sofa bed to made... it took over 20 minutes to respond.We didn't get a room that was comparable. I contacted a front desk to complain, and Lilly, Front Desk Mgr. hung up on me. I expressed my frustration with her, and she could not handle the call.

allReviews.title: A nice experience again at this hotel
allReviews.text: Always a nice stay at this hotel... I've stayed here many times over these past years both with family and solo. Upper floor room this time a bit more noisy, but not too bad... Too bad they don't have a few nice restaurants to make the stay more convenient.

allReviews.title: Trump still holding strong!
allReviews.text: The Trump just works.  Well located, well staffed, well priced rooms.  We’re here often and some of the rooms furnishings are getting long in the tooth but linens are very nice, great pillows.  Stay on the strip side unless you like train noise and a view of the penis museum and pot store!The strip side is amazing with a great view of the “Dome” and endlessly entertaining site at night.  (AKA The Sphere!),Coffee and pastries are not cheap.  The pool is staffed by pleasant bright young people who really try hard to keep the place clean and neat.  We calculate the elevator travels at an amazing 1350 feet per minute or about mph!Next week we’re at the Fontainblue for the next event.  Just giving it a shot because otherwise the Trump is just fine.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel and friendly staff. Wish they still had a free shuttle to The Forum Shops.  It’s great that the mall is across the street. Quiet except for the traffic noise even from the 22nd floor.  Food is very expensive but there was plenty of water and coffee in the rooms. When I asked for more water and coffee it was brought up promptly.

allReviews.title: Nice stay
allReviews.text: Nice hotel. Great location just off strip but easy to walk to everything. Near Wynn and Venetian. Less congested than casino hotel but still some Vegas hustle and bustle. Lobby and room clean. Nice pool area without party scene. Food at restaurant was good. Nice staff. So much better than the chaos of the casino hotels.

allReviews.title: Loved their bathtub and view of the sphere
allReviews.text: It was a great experience! I loved the view we had, the bathtub was fantastic, staff was friendly, the room was clean to my standards, free valley parking, no smoke smell, fast check in and check out, and would love to return.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel and even better People
allReviews.text: I wanted to say that the people that work here made a huge difference in my stay. The manager Lilly P. was so nice to me and she gave us a care package for my 8 lb Pomeranian. The rooms are fantastic and it is close enough to the strip where you can walk to the casinos but the mall is directly across the street to go shopping. I always say that you want the ability to go to the party but not have the party go to you. At Trump International, it does just that. Highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Put away your politics and go for the luxury
allReviews.text: The main reason to pick this hotel is the fact there is no noisy, smoke filled, obnoxious casino on the property. It is a luxury hotel, conveniently located with the friendliest staff. There is a great pool with attendants dressed smartly, not like cheap classless tarts. The rooms are over the top luxurious with kitchenettes if you so desire. Would not hesitate to recommend or re-book.

allReviews.title: Old world opulence
allReviews.text: Old world opulence is the best way to describe Trump International. They upgraded us to a suite which was huge! Seperate lounge and powder room and bedroom. The decor is very 1990s Dynasty all marble and chandeliers, perfect for Vegas. A bit off the strip but you can walk through the shopping complex across the road and it’s not far. Quiet , restaurant downstairs bit of a limited  menu but the food was good.

allReviews.title: Excellent place
allReviews.text: Nice and clean. First time to Vegas.Service great and employees are helpfulSort of hike to strip but nice and quiet at end of long day out. Great views. Very accommodating. Great valet services. Would stay again

allReviews.title: Service in decline.
allReviews.text: We recently stayer here on March 31 , April 2, 6 & 7. This is the second time we stayed at this hotel. It was much better the first time we stayed there. I will not be staying there in the future. Both recent stays required we had to ask for items that air listed as items that are in the room. When calling for your car the Valet would not answer the call.

allReviews.title: Cubitac group KBIS 2024
allReviews.text: I would give 6 stars if I could!!!The staff at the trump is top notch We were here for KBIS 2024 with Cubitac. A flawless experience with a large group. Thank you to Amy and her team for taking care of every detail of our stay!We hope to be back soon .

allReviews.title: Perfect hotel - class in every way
allReviews.text: Fabulous hotel, wonderful in every way.  We had a corner suite, which had a commanding view of the Strip, a bathroom as large as most motel rooms (and there was a second smaller one off the living room), and a full kitchen - complete with Zero King fridge.  Restaurant food was excellent with large portions.  The staff could not be nicer.  This hotel defines class in every way.

allReviews.title: Excellent place stay to stay.
allReviews.text: We had five nights at the Trump this week.  The weather was nice and sunny so we had a lot of time at the pool and exercise room.  The staff in the hotel is generally on top of the situation and come promptly when required.  The car valet service team is so attentive and recognize you almost immediately.   We stayed in the one Bedroom Suite with our own kitchen, dinning area and TV sectional, extremely comfortable.  The two downsides were the Hot-Tub bath in our Master Bathroom, the pump wasn't able working and the part was on back-order, along with the Hot-Tub outside on the pool deck was quite dirty!   The pool deck Hot-Tub needs to be emptied every night and cleaned properly even after discussing this with the attendants, they could do nothing but report it to Engineering, which do not show-up to maintain the Hot-Tub properly.Another thing was when we checked in, we were treated as non-paying client it seemed.  Although Hilton Grand Vacation Club owns a number of floors/rooms, the feeling was like we were not welcomed.  The front-desk person, was even aware that our room was flagged that the Hot-Tub in our room was not working, yet given the room anyways!  "AN OVERSIGHT"  so it was explained.  We were are on our 35th wedding anniversary trip around the USA, and we used a lot of prepared points to stay here per night.  Oversight or not, we didn't want to repack our clothes to move to another room, which was the only option.In general, excellent place if you don't want a casino on the ground floor, close to all the action, shows, Malls, and excitement.    We did not use the bar or restaurant as well love to cook on our 55 day trip "FROM SKI TO SEA TO SKI" anniversary drive.

allReviews.title: Trump does it right
allReviews.text: Where do I start? Check in was fast and easy. We stayed on the 51st floor and didn’t have any issues with the elevator, never had to wait for an elevator and got to the floors very fast.Rooms are getting dated but they are very clean and still very nice. Had a small kitchenette with stove and sink and mini fridge. Beds were comfortable. Room service was great. They cleaned up the beds and bathroom everyday. Stocked water. We had 1 issue when we got to the room with the safe. It didn’t work, so we called front desk and within 10 minutes they were there with a new safe to replace it.The employees were all great, they go out of their way to say good morning or hi. Disha in the trump store was great. Bartenders,  waiters/waitresses were all great. Food was excellent. Although they don’t have a ton of options for meals what they did have was good. Had coffees with breakfast then was able to get coffee to go when we finished breakfast and it was goof coffee.The location was fine. We were there for the IBS so it was a half hour walk for us to the convention centre. We also don’t gamble so we liked how the hotel didn’t have a casino and was smoke free. The strip seemed to be chaotic and loud so it’s nice to be away from that. Just go to the strip for dinner and night time then come back to the trump bar to unwind and have beer. Will definitely stay at a Trump hotel again! Thanks for a great experience!

allReviews.title: Exceptional
allReviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of staying at the Trump International Hotel in Las Vegas while attending the KBIS show with the Fabuwood group. From the moment we arrived, the service was exceptional. The staff went above and beyond to accommodate our every need, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable stay.The cleanliness of the hotel was impeccable, and the attention to detail in every aspect of service was evident. In particular, I would like to commend managers Amy and Laurie for their outstanding hospitality. They truly went out of their way to make us feel welcomed and taken care of throughout our stay.Overall, the Trump International Hotel is a beautiful establishment with top-notch customer service. I highly recommend it to anyone visiting Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Good option in LV
allReviews.text: Hotel that I appreciate and where I usually stay in LV.I don't understand the changes for the worse in the Hotel.Absence of luggage racks.Having to please ask to tidy up and change towels in a penthouse suite. It's not what I was used to.Hotel without Casino, which makes it quieter than most in LV.

allReviews.title: High-end hotel with 5 star service
allReviews.text: Service and staff were exceptional!I attend the KIBS show and was part of the Fabuwood group. Management went out of their way to ensure the group had everything we needed. Amy, Laurie and the entire housekeeping staff were amazing and provided us amazing service. We can’t thank you enough

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: Just stayed here with fabuwood during the KBIS show. Great hotel and accommodating staff going above and beyond making sure all guests have what they need. Special thank you to Amy and Laurie and the entire housekeeping staff for getting us whatever we need, whenever we needed it

allReviews.title: Awsome place
allReviews.text: The Hotel was great.Everything about it was just seamless.Nice & clean.Great service.Stayed with the fabuwood group for the IBS show, we really appreciate the dedication they gave to our groupShout out to Amy and Laurie, They just went above and beyond to make sure all was taken care of.Trump for the win!!

allReviews.title: High quality service
allReviews.text: I was a part of the fabuwood group & was amazed at how well we were treated.  I will def be staying here again.  Every single employee was respect ful and extremely help ful. The location is great as well. Being freaky close to the convention center.

allReviews.title: From Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Enjoyed an unparalleled stay with friends for a business convention. The service, rooms, and particularly the valet parking reception were nothing short of spectacular, exceeding all expectations. Absolutely flawless experience. Can't wait for our next extraordinary visit!

allReviews.title: Great experience!
allReviews.text: We’ve been coming back year after year. Well appointed large rooms. Extremely comfortable beds. Clean and open lobby. Great looking bar and restaurant. Pleasant and accommodating staff. Quiet block, right off the strip. It’s a Trump spot, it’s always gonna be great.

allReviews.title: Very pleasant experience.  Best hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: What a beautiful hotel! We came for the Kbis/ibs at the convention center. Our stay was s with fabulous. They were very accommodating and friendly.Thank you Amy and Laurie for great service.  Housekeeping was also si kind and they all went above and beyond

allReviews.title: Fonominal
allReviews.text: Unparalleled luxury and exceptional service! From the moment we arrived, we were treated like royalty. The opulent decor, plush amenities, and impeccable attention to detail made us feel like we were in a dream world. The staff exceeded expectations, catering to our every need with warmth and professionalism. Our room was a serene oasis, with breathtaking views and a heavenly bed that ensured a restful slumber. This hotel truly sets the standard for 5-star excellence. We can't wait to return and indulge in the ultimate pampering experience again!

allReviews.title: Review
allReviews.text: I had an exceptional stay at the Trump Hotel in Las Vegas during KBIS2024.
