From what I heard you shout out to Amy and Laurie provided outstanding service, and the entire housekeeping crew went the extra mile to ensure our comfort. The commitment to guest satisfaction and attention to detail make Trump Hotel a top choice for those with specific requirements. Thank you to Fabuwood year after year goes above and beyond.

allReviews.title: Amazing hotel stay!!!

The staff was super friendly and eager to please. The rooms were clean and very comfortable.  The location wqs fantastic and so very convenient.  I will definitely stay here again

allReviews.title: 100 Star rating

allReviews.title: Top notch!
allReviews.text: Well 1st of all I pulled up and the lily P was sooo nice to us and really helped us out with the reservation!!!2nd we got to the room and it was spotless clean and just beautiful and especially the room service will get you anything u need with a smile 😃 😊 Only the best Higley recommended!

allReviews.title: AMAZING

allReviews.text: The service was fantastic.   The staff were very accommodating to our group on the 62 floor. The rooms were spacious and the beds  were amazing. I told everybody I know that my experience was over the top.  Other hotels are right on the strip but this is way better.

allReviews.title: Comfortable
allReviews.text: We stayed at the trump hotel in Las Vegas the room was beautiful and clean The beds were very comfortable and the kitchen was very convenient. Amy and Laurie were very accommodating with Fabawood kbis 2024 we will definitely return and recommend to others

allReviews.title: KBIS 2024
allReviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at the trump hotel with fabuwood KBIS 2024The hotel was very accommodating and polite!The elevators are quick, lobby is nice and clean Highly recommend trump Las vages for your stay We had a great time in las vages!

allReviews.title: My last vegas stay at the trump
allReviews.text: I travel for business alot. Las Vegas is somewhere I go often.  I am so happy I did! The room was nice and the view was nicer.  I was here for KBIS 2024 and we had kosher food sponsored by fabuwood. The hotel went above and beyond in helping us keep kosher.  Thank you.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay
allReviews.text: Stayed at this Property with Fabuwood at the KBIS 2024.  All I can say we had the best accommodation,  Amy and Laurie was there to help anything we might need.    Clean rooms.  Great amenities, Great choice to stay Looking forward for next year KBIS at the Trump.

allReviews.title: Very accommodating great ambience
allReviews.text: We went with Fabuwood for the KBIS show and were looking for a hotel without the Vagos noise We found the Trump hotel and had a great experience the rooms were clean & ambience was great The hotel staff were very nice and accommodating.Thanks so much.

allReviews.title: Wonderful experience at The Trump International Hotel
allReviews.text: My stay at Trump International in Vegas was absolutely fantastic. I was in town for the KBIS show and was pleasantly surprised by the hotel's accommodation of kosher meals, courtesy of Fabuwood. This attention to my needs was greatly appreciated and made my stay even more enjoyable. The staff at the hotel were incredibly friendly and accommodating, and the room was impeccably clean. Overall, a top-notch experience that I would highly recommend to others.

allReviews.title: KBIS 2024
allReviews.text: Was here for KBIS 2024. Accommodations were great. I especially appreciate the accommodations make to allow kosher food to be provided during the show. It is not at all simple for a hotel to allow the setup and special arrangements. It was flawless.

allReviews.title: Kbis
allReviews.text: I want to express my gratitude to Amy and Lauria  Fabuwood for generously provided me with accommodations at the Trump International Hotel in Las Vegas during the KBIS conference. Despite being a guest of Fabuwood, the hotel's staff still went above and beyond to ensure my stay was exceptional. The housekeeping crew was meticulous, and the hotel's service was top-notch. A special thank you to Amy and Lauria for their kindness and hospitality  and the Trump International Hotel's excellent service made for an unforgettable experience!

allReviews.title: Super Great Service Again
allReviews.text: Our stay was with Fabuwood during the KBIS 2024 show and the service of the Trump Hotel Staff was SUPER! As by our stay in 2023. The whole staff especially Amy & Laurie went out of their way to help us and make sure we have a great stay!! Thank you!!

allReviews.title: Amazing hospitality!!
allReviews.text: Amazing hospitality, beautiful spacious comfortable rooms. Massive bathrooms  !! Best hotel to stay if you don’t want to have casino in hotel and quick access to rooms. Very clean hotel  , fast valet. Very friendly staff. Definitely recommended and will be back next time.

allReviews.title: 5 star
allReviews.text: great hotel and serves ..                5 star........very clean and nice the views  are supper  i would highly recommend for vacation and business.....  no casino is a big plus.   beds are great and clean.  great price for what you get......looking forward to my next stay.

allReviews.title: The Most Accommodating Hotel I've Been to
allReviews.text: Stay here if u want an oasis from the craziness on the strip, but still enjoy it and are relatively close to it. They accommodated out group very well and have been for the past few years. It's a classy place with NO Gambling, what a breath of fresh air!

allReviews.title: Outstanding Accommodation for KBIS Event
allReviews.text: I want to express my gratitude to Trump International Hotel Las Vegas for hosting the Fabuwood event during KBIS. As a kosher food service for Jewish visitors, the accommodations were exceptional. The community room was comfortable, clean, and provided a welcoming atmosphere. The service was impeccable, catering to every need. Thank you very much, #TRUMP2024

allReviews.title: Great views, good value
allReviews.text: The location is great, easy walk to the north strip.  Complimentary valet is particularly nice given that we wanted to hike at Valley of Fire.  The room views of the strip are amazing and worth the additional money.  The service was first class and the amenities were as well.

allReviews.title: Superb Hotel, Go Trump
allReviews.text: Just outstanding. We loved the location, the room is super spacious, staff very helpful, hotel felt upmarket, safe and staff were excellent No smoking was a major plus and we enjoyed the respite of no casino inside so you felt like you were heading back for absolute relaxation from The StripReal value and cannot say anything negative whatever!

allReviews.title: excellent
allReviews.text: I traveled with my family and had a great experience at the hotel, good location, you can cross the street and get to the mall, and easy access to the strip. Comfortable, large rooms with kitchenettes

allReviews.title: Freedom loving owner luxurious Hotel!
allReviews.text: We absolutely love the Trump hotel Trump store  restaurant & spa.  We only come here if we come to Vegas.  Jacuzzi bath tub & very happy & friendly staff. & freedom loving presidential owner! The rooms are really luxurious & everyone seems genuinely happy working here.

allReviews.title: MAGA blast
allReviews.text: The restaurant food and coffee in the room were good. Would have liked more pillows. Lobby is glitzy. Staff was friendly and helpful. The Trump merchandise was a hoot. I also enjoyed seeing the Fox News channel instead of CNN in the restaurant.

allReviews.title: Bad customer service
allReviews.text: Complained twice about the lack of room service. Reception promised me a $150 credit on my room number. Now my credit card has been charged, so the credit has not been posted. No one responds to email inquiries.

allReviews.title: Fantastic hotel
allReviews.text: Excellent hotel just off the strip.You can walk through the fashion mall which is about 100 yards away.It doesn’t have the hustle and bustle of casino hotels which is lovely.Hotel is spotless We had a corner suite room 5410 which had great views of the sphere.Room had a small kitchen 2 bathrooms. a pull out bed and large wardrobe spaces.En suite had the biggest bathroom I have ever seen.Fantastic pool area which was spotless and well serviced Free valet parking as well which was an excellent bonus If i had one gripe it would be our room wasn’t serviced during our 3 day stay and when I informed reception on check out they told me cleaning was in availability and i should have called 0 for service. I would have done this but just assumed it was serviced every day.Apart from that we Would definitely come back as it’s a great hotel for people who don’t want to hear noisy parties or idiots running up and down the corridors it’s also a great hotel for families too as it felt safe. Thank you for our stay

allReviews.title: Very clean and professionally run hotel
allReviews.text: Very nice place to stay. The positives:  Extremely clean, large size room with very large bathroom, wonderful bed, great jacuzzi tub, and wonderful shower. Front desk personnel were very nice and helpful. Loaned me an umbrella when it was raining. Only negative I have is that I wish there had been a coffee bar. I haven't been to Vegas for at least 20 years and was shocked at the prices. Everything is so expensive. So, the morning coffee I can't do without was $7 at the small stand in the lobby. The breakfast sandwich was about $12 but very good.  Never did eat at the restaurant. Too expensive. The location was good. About a 25 minute walk to the Bellagio.  A great option and the price was good.

allReviews.title: Very nice stay!
allReviews.text: Very nice registration system quick and easy. The staff were great! Room service was quick and very good food! Our room was clean and everything worked very well! Forty first  floor one bedroom suite gorges! Will so stay here again!Free valet parking in Las Vegas great deal! We had a car to go onto the strip so that was nice. Away from the strip and the madness but easily accessible. You can walk to the strip in about 20 min! Very worth the stay.

allReviews.title: Our home away from home
allReviews.text: As always, my home away from home when am in town. Convenient to everything and with great view at night, fully equipped kitchen when I feel like cooking for breakfast. Staffs were amazing and restaurant food was great. Room is clean and spacious.

allReviews.title: Unprofessional, bait and switch, nickel and dime, disappointment at the Trump Las Vegas Hotel
allReviews.text: We booked the hotel at Super Bowl prices. The upgrade charges I happily paid upon booking, it was one of the few times I booked with a live reservations  desk person in the past 17 years. 1. 11 am checkin2. Adjoining entry3. Upper floorWe are traveling and flew our kids in from out of town. Wanted adjoining entry so we would see them more and make sure they were okay. Arrived and they put us in a mid-level room (tried to claim it was a high floor when I complained but the *security* guard was the one who told us in was not. And it doesn’t match the high floor information on the booking website). One room smelled like sewage and we had to move rooms. I hoped paying for early check-in would let them identify cr*p before we arrived.  So now we are on a midlevel floor, rooms on different floors, still in a kind of stinky room,  and surly, uncaring front desk personnel. We got seven families associated with the team to book here. Totally regret the $40,000-50,000 we caused in revenue for them this weekend. And they charge for internet. Not what I expected. Never again.

allReviews.title: Amazing- one of nice hotels I have ever been too!
allReviews.text: An amazing hotel! Immaculate and well appointed! Service and food were excellent and the room was spacious. We will be back! A bit quieter as well with no Casino! We were pleasantly surprised as the hotel rate was well priced compared to other hotels in strip!

allReviews.title: Great view
allReviews.text: Nice hotel with perfect location. The rooms are extremely spacious and have great view (we had 58th floor!). There is a microwave, coffee maker, dishwasher, fridge etc. The breakfast is á la carte. Nordstrom or Macy' s are across the street.

allReviews.title: Old fashion
allReviews.text: Old hotel with dated room, windows are not properly isolated so we can hear anything happening outside, poor quality bed, no safe box….torn carpet…this is clearly not a 5* hotel Overpriced for what it is. Have been many times to vegas and this is certainly the worst hotel I experienced

allReviews.title: Amazing resort
allReviews.text: Trump International is THE place to stay. We love it. The staff are super helpful and the resort is so clean! We especially like that there is no casino in the resort but it is close enough to the strip that you can just walk to it.

allReviews.title: Trump
allReviews.text: Resort is lovely in a quiet location but still close to the strip. The suite was well equipped with a very comfortable bed. Our room was on the 31st floor with a view towards the Stratosphere and mountains. It was very easy to walk everywhere or catch the Deuce.

allReviews.title: Majestic hotel
allReviews.text: We stayed 3 nights at this hotel. It is not very central but it is very close to the center and can be reached on foot. Which ends up being more advantageous because even though we are in Las Vegas we are not in the middle of the “mess”.Points in favor- free parking and very friendly and helpful staff- very large rooms with many amenities- huge bathroom with hot tub and shower.- essential hygiene items, missing cotton swabs and make-up remover pads, hairdryer- daily bottle of water offered- good cleaning- there is a kitchenette but without any dishes or equipment (toaster for example) but we can ask if we want to eat something in the room- in the room there is an ironing board and iron, which is very useful for those who are travelingUnfavorable points- not having USB sockets because for non-Americans they don't have many transformers, which causes some discomfort when charging equipment.- they didn't have a continental breakfast, if we wanted to have breakfast we had to order à la carte which was very expensive.- not being a hotel with a casino, we had to go to competing hotels to be able to have some funAll unfavorable points are constructive criticism in order to improve customer service, and this is my perspective.Other than that, these nights were quite pleasant.

allReviews.title: Huge rooms and non smoking - great stay
allReviews.text: It's big. it's huge...and no smoking or casino so bonus points.Rooms are huge, bathroom is to with a spa bath and shower - and an exhaust fan - rare in the USA. Good location across the road from the fashion show mall but a little far from the strip - depends what you are there for.In room there are kitchen facilities but due to some law they cannot stock it or give you plates etc unless you ask - we did and ate breakfast in our room most days saving some money.

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel!
allReviews.text: We stayed for a long weekend after wanting to for many years.  This is a lovely hotel, beautiful lobby, pool, restaurant and rooms.  It is nice to have a mini fridge, microwave and mini stove although it was not needed with the options in the hotel and across the street at the Fashion Show Mall.  I love that there is not a casino in the hotel, no smoke or noiseyness to walk through.  It was also very quiet through the night, you didn't hear people walking the hallways.  It isn't too far of a walk over to Las Vegas Blvd but there are taxis waiting if you need it.  The staff went out of their way to help you with anything you need, especially the valet attendants.  I highly recommend this hotel.

allReviews.title: Trump International Hotel Las Vegas, 'Horrible Spa'
allReviews.text: Every year I come to Las Vegas for conventions and seminars like CES this past month and usually stay at Trump International.  This time I tried the Spa at Trump.  What a waste of money.  Amenities are cheap, service is below average and even if you complain about anything there is no one there who professionally knows how to resolve anything.  Save your money, go to any other spa in LV.

allReviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised
allReviews.text: I was reluctant to stay here candidly due to the name on the hotel but it did appear to be the nicest hotel option without a casino that we were able to choose from for a "stay and play" based soccer tournament for my daughter  (have to choose from a list of pre-approved hotels).  We were offered an upgrade to a suite for an extra $60 a night so we took that. The room (2706) needs to be renovated.  Bathrooms were clean and master bathroom giant but carpet very dingy and walls and furniture showing their age.  Unfortunately the first night when we pulled the sofa bed out for our daughters, it was broken.  They only had one rollaway left at that point (11pm) which they told us was their oldest and most beat down.  One daughter slept on that, the other on the couch.  Suffice to say, neither got any sleep that night.  Staff made a note and when we returned to the hotel the following afternoon they had a new room ready for us.  The new suite (5911) had been renovated and was fantastic.  Was a pain to have to pack up and switch rooms (had to take one elevator to lobby then get on separate elevator up to new room) but we handled it within 30 minutes or so.  Not sure why people complain about the staff at this hotel, they treated us wonderfully.  So the new room was great.  Other cons were:  the linens (sheet and towels) aren't as nice as what you would expect, the hot-tub closes at 5 pm, and there is only one restaurant that kind of sucks.  The menu is very limited, much of the food is pre-made/frozen and of course it is way expensive for what you get.  So again, as much as I can't stand the namesake, this hotel worked for us.  I just wouldn't take a suite "upgrade" again because the pull-out sofa is a budget motel quality and was one of the worst my kids have slept on.  Two other families from the team stayed here as well and all the sofa beds had issues with being broken so beware of the upgrade.

allReviews.title: Okay, but nothing special.
allReviews.text: Nice room, but a little disappointing. The passing trains on the nearby rail line are loud when they hit their horns every morning.  The bathtub water jets didn’t work, which was a bit of a let down to be honest. Hotel is very clean and the reception staff were polite and friendly. Didn’t use the restaurant so can’t comment on that.Perfect distance from the strip.

allReviews.title: Prime Location
allReviews.text: Enjoyed our stay and with no gaming it was very quite when needed. All the staff was very courteous and professional. When we called service for anything our needs were taken care of right away. I would recommend this hotel for anyone.

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel and very helpful staff
allReviews.text: Excellent value for money. One of the few hotels that continues to offer free parking. We liked the location, incredible view, large room and very large bathroom. Good amenities and good closet space. If you need kitchen utensils, just ask and receive quickly. Very kind staff. If we go to Las Vegas again, we will certainly stay at this hotel.

allReviews.title: Very nice visit to Vegas
allReviews.text: Great experience. No casino in hotel so no smoke, noise. Excellent security as room keys checked before access to elevators. Staff very professional and friendly. Daily housekeeping and hotel is kept clean and maintained.. Next time in Vegas, we are staying here

allReviews.title: Top Trumps for this hotel
allReviews.text: As travellers to Las Vegas who don't really want the casino trip, we decided on the Trump.  It has been a great decision.  The hotel is immaculately clean, the staff are fantastic.  We are not political in any way, so we didn't consider that when booking.  The room has everything you need to enjoy a week or more here.  If you are on a budget then there is a big microwave oven and you just request the number of plates and cutlery you require and it's delivered to the room.  We have not used the microwave, so can't say how good or bad it is, but it is available if needed.  The strip views are probably some of the best available as they can look straight down the strip as the hotel is built at a 90 degree angle to it.  There is also a great view of the Sphere from the strip side of the hotel.  We stayed on the 55th floor.  We were offered a low or high floor when checking in.  I would definitely stay in this hotel again and recommend it to friends and family back in the UK.

allReviews.title: Upscale suite in great location
allReviews.text: Wonderful, upscale property walking distance to the Las Vegas Strip, but just far enough off the Strip to be quiet. The staff provided excellent service and the one bedroom suite was spacious and comfortable. The kitchen has top of the line appliances, however lacks practical kitchen items such as knifes or measuring utensils. We didn't cook in the room but at minimum a shot glass for mixing cocktails would have been helpful. Mattress was comfortable, however the pillows are too flat/deflated and remain uncomfortable no matter how you fold/bunch them. We are hoping the resort might improve the pillow situation prior to our next stay. Overall we greatly enjoyed our stay and are looking forward to returning in the near future.

allReviews.title: Alright
allReviews.text: Very good service compared to other 5 stars in Las Vegas.This hotel is much more human than the others.The room was super spacious, with an incredible view of the Strip. It's just a shame that they don't provide little "amenities" like cotton, slippers or bathrobes. But it's just a detail.I would return without hesitation.

allReviews.title: Perfect
allReviews.text: I loved the hotel and the structures... I knew it was off the strip and far from the main hotels and casinos, but that didn't stop me from enjoying it a lot... I stayed in a high room facing The Sphere, as good as it gets!!!! I stayed for a week and, as a cherry on top, I met, talked and photographed with Donald Trump at the hotel (which is part of his hotel chain), hahaha I made my life go away.I recommend

allReviews.title: I loved!
allReviews.text: I loved! Beautiful room, spacious bathroom, everything clean, incredible view!! Ficamps on floor 52 with views of the Strip and the Mega Sphere. Attentive staff and the location is good for those who don't want the hustle and bustle of the central strip area. Would certainly stay again. Free parking.

allReviews.title: The best
allReviews.text: We love staying here. The amenities, the size of the room and staff are the best. We’re able to see the Sphere from our room window. It’s right across the fashion mall, the Wynn hotel. The only thing is they took away the shuttle service and no more buffet breakfast.

allReviews.title: Not like the luxury of Trump Waikiki
allReviews.text: This hotel is ok. The good is a reasonable location and very spacious clean  rooms. Parking included. The bad. Dated and certainly is not anything like luxury of the sister property Trump Waikiki (that we rated a five and love!). Kitchen had nothing in it. Nothing! Had to ring for every single thing (chopping board, plates, dishwasher tablet, a knife and fork, a pot, a salad bowl etc etc etc). Why don’t they have a pre built pack for the room sent up? Took so much time and we often had to ring 2-3 times. Then things were wrong. Charges for a sing the steam room - really? People were nice enough. Restaurant and bar were boring and expensive so we walked to the Wynn. Not terrible,  just not great.

allReviews.title: Not a real luxury hotel
allReviews.text: The good :- nice strip view when de luxe suite- free valet parking- good location - fitness room- large and comfortable king size bedThe bad :- sad hotel- poor check in- low quality cleaning room- De luxe suite : the second bed is the coach with the thinnest matelas! Real shame - dirty carpet- the hotel is a king of building with rooms owned by particulars and rented with some wardrobe locked! - toilets are inside the bathroom with a glass door. No privacy at all.I wouldn’t recommend this hotel at all. I ve been lots of times in Vegas and stayed in better establishments (Golden nugget, Palm, Wynn, Caesar).

allReviews.title: It's completely different from a few years ago
allReviews.text: The front desk at the hotel was expressionless, with a cold and impatient demeanor. The room service had a very poor attitude, displaying disdain when I asked for clarification. And despite being clear on the phone, some items were still missing from the order when delivered. During the Christmas holidays, valet services required a waiting time of at least 20-30 minutes, causing us to alter many of our plans. This wasn't our first stay at Trump. The service was exceptional around 10 years ago. However, unlike now, where ordering room service feels akin to receiving a delivery from Doordash. The high-end dining experience expected at a luxury hotel has completely vanished. In summary, don't come here unless you have no other place to spend your money.

allReviews.title: First time staying at this hotel
allReviews.text: Stayed at this hotel this time, I usually stay at Encore.  It I was a guest part of a group. Nice property, staff is amazing and my room was spot on, super clean and beautiful. It’s located right across a shopping mall. Food is not that great if compared to other hotels in Vegas but not a big deal as we went to other restaurants outside. I missed reading my digital magazines and newspapers, all hotels in Vegas offer this service via Pressiereader but trump is way behind on this matter, it’s a free service and I suggested the staff to add it. Food wise the hotel is also behind if compared to others. Other than that I’d stay again if my group of friends decide to stay again there,  it was a pleasant experience.

allReviews.title: Not worth the money
allReviews.text: Nice view but stunningly poor and unfriendly service at frontdesk and central housekeeping (NOT: the people actually doing the housekeeping). Took hours to make up the sofa bed for the kid (suite was reserved for three and we arrived late), room was not made on the following day despite us being out for ten hours and despite and explicit request. When we returned, I called housekeeping and again was treated quite snottily and told now it was to late to ask for housekeeping. Room ok, I am not a fan of the decor but that‘s personal taste. View of the strip was great but isolation is poor, so if you are sensitive to noise, not for you. Given we paid new year‘s eve prices I am hugely disappointed by what we got.

allReviews.title: A step back in Time.. classic elegance
allReviews.text: The whole experience was wonderful, from arrival to departure... Professional, Polite and attentive... the cleanest hotel experience... excellent service in all departments.Looking forward to returning... otel

allReviews.title: Nightmarish service. Management don’t care about customers.
allReviews.text: Terrible service. We booked ( through 3rd party) and asked for room with 2 beds. Checked in dec24thand they were nice enough to check in before 3 pm(2 pm) and gave us a room with single king bed. The gentleman at the reception said they are oversold and we will get a room on 26th with 2 beds. On 26th we paced all our stuff and came down to re check in-this guy name CRAIG( I I am not wrong) said there is no note put in by the last person and they are oversold. No apology - nothing as we showed that our initial booking confirmation shows for 2 people - 2 queen beds. He was eager to get rid of us as others were waiting to check in.We checked out with this girl name ALICIYA -she seemed upset to be at work and was not at all helpful - my wife said good morning we are ready to check out- she was not happy to get off her texting and help. We asked may we please speak to a supervisor or manager to at least tell them a what went wrong- she said no one except her was there and gave us a card for a manager.We have stayed at this hotel for last 7 years. Sadly the service quality have gone down. Rooms are dated now with worn out chairs. I know they don’t care if one guest don’t return as they have many repeat customers but Management should spend more time and effort to train the staff and treat repeat customers with providing what they paid for. This use to be an awesome hotel next to a mall/ great service and non smoking atmosphere- we that’s all gone now. Only good thing was that the housekeeping team was great- front desk service quality is same a motel 8 now.Stay away from this hotel - way better alternatives nearby.

allReviews.title: Vacation at Trump
allReviews.text: Excellent service and accommodation. Very convenient location especially to Fashion Show Mall and the convenience of the food court and restaurants. Only one problem, they promised to clean the room after the fourth night but this never happened. The pull out couch bed was very unconfortable.

allReviews.title: Not clean,  unprofessional and lack empathy.
allReviews.text: I just left this hotel this morning on December 30,2023. I am not sure if I will return. They took very long to bring  dishes and other things guess often request.  If they took long with  orders  they would claim they didnt have such a request.  We waited over 7 hours one night for items. The worst thing is they back each other up with their lies. My first room was in the middle tower. Beware of rooms 16-30's. They have horrible lights , bad commodes, hair all overthe  floors and no heat. The window vent was bent and wouldn't shut . My favorite part was the couch that had a bad . Oh my God,  the thing had sprints from the top to the bottom.  They moved me on the  third night ,and  we still had to deal with long hair on the floors. Simply nasty! The manager was shown a picture and he only said "I'm sorry".  He had no suggestions.  Maybe the maid had a bad day  is what he said to me as I was leaving. I told him my son does videos and blog.  He looked drained and said nothing.  So ,I am leaving this view . As promise my son will blog.   I showed pictures and no one in my family has that type of hair textures or color you can see below. Simply uncaring and not cleaning.  It is jo way you can mop or sweep and leave long pieces of hair on a floor . It is unsanitary and spreads germs.  We even found dirty socks in our room Near the bed . I am very happy I travel with cleaning items cause both rooms were nasty . My daughter was hurt at the  mall a cross the street, and the staff did not care one bit. I rushed out and forgot my key. They pretended they couldn't find me in the system. I told the manager this and he didn't care.  Only said he would talk to staff about it .  he said they didnt want to accidentally let someone in my room ,but I could  have shown ID .  Who would have been that detailed about how registrations were made and with my names. Smh ! If you can ,I would say just avoid them on  major events or holidays. They're the worst and can't keep up with guess needs.  BTW , I wanted to cook vs eat out for health reasons.  I waited 7 hours for them to bring stuff for me to cook with . I ended up going out . Never had this at a so called 5 star hotel in my life. I travel often .  Hair everywhere , dirty sock under beds and no knives for certain guess is why I left this morning instead of rebooting. No thank! I will be at a nice hotel on the strip for new years. 😌

allReviews.title: Great hotel near the strip
allReviews.text: Great hotel near the strip. Comfortable rooms, great staff and awesome views. Stayed in a suite….good layout and spacious for 4 of us. Love their pool and terrace area.Limited food options for vegetarian but the mall is right opposite with plenty options

allReviews.title: Not recommended
allReviews.text: The structure is certainly beautiful and very shiny as befits a hotel of that level in Las Vegas.I stayed at this hotel in August 2023.However, there were two things that lowered the approval rating.The first is linked to the fact that we added a night to our stay asking to keep the same room, a request which was granted to us, only that no one came to redo the room and we found ourselves with dirty used towels and without shower gel or soap, we called to say that the room had not been made up and that we needed clean towels and washing products and they didn't send anyone after a couple of hours we went down to have them given to us directly at the reception, an inconvenience that is not very acceptable for a hotel of this standard.The other problem was with the return of the deposit which was never refunded either on my partner's credit card for the first booking, nor on mine for the second booking, I wrote asking for explanations and I was answered after a month that they had made the refund but that perhaps it was a timing problem of the bank being on the European circuit.On December 29, 2023 I was still in Las Vegas and at the request of my bank I went to ask for a copy of the refund of the deposit for both me and my partner, as that money had never arrived on our two credit cards and I they gave a copy of the receipt already provided at check out in August and the statement with the indications of the withdrawal of the room payment and the deposit which took place in August, but no code or receipt of the refund, dismissing me by telling me that they only had that and that the problem was with my bank.However, if neither I nor my partner have received a refund of the deposit and in fact we have not received our money back, it is not possible to simply tell the customer that the problem lies with the bank because if they have withdrawn money that is not ours' been given back, it means that they still have them, they certainly didn't get lost along the way.Therefore I would not go back, nor do I recommend it because it was their duty to look into the matter further and provide the necessary elements to get the bail money back, not to close the matter in a simplistic way.It is clear at this point that we will never get the money back and this is really annoying, because it was around 300 dollars which is not a big amount, but if I plan a trip and estimate an amount of expense I cannot put the money at a loss deposit of a hotel is not correct.

allReviews.title: Great Experience at Trump
allReviews.text: We actually stayed in the Hilton Vacation Club portion of the hotel.  We had a one bedroom condo.  Very nice with all of the amenities.  Great to stay in a condo with the benefit of hotel room service.  Only drawback was they only have valet parking and we needed to allow 15-20 minutes each time to get our car since it was always busy.  Highly, recommend this hotel.  Great location by Fashion Show Mall and just off the strip.

allReviews.title: Great stay!
allReviews.text: Our rooms and hotel were beautiful. The staff was very kind. Great security. We felt safe walking to/from hotel at all hours. Enjoyed the large jacuzzi bath tubs and the outdoor pool/hot tub. Wish there were more food options in house but thats it!

allReviews.title: Experienced Luxury
allReviews.text: The hotel offers an excellent experience with a fantastic location and outstanding customer service. The room furnishings are impressive, featuring ample countertops and towel racks. The inclusion of a kitchenette is a nice touch, and the water pressure in the shower is strong. The spacious bathroom includes a large shower and a separate whirlpool tub. The elevators are notably fast, with minimal waiting time – never more than 30 seconds. The staff is exceptionally courteous, and the availability of free valet service adds to the convenience. The hotel's location allows easy access to roads other than Vegas Blvd, making it convenient for driving. Furthermore, the absence of a casino ensures a smoke-free environment, free from cigarette or pot odors. Overall, a highly positive experience.

allReviews.title: Huge room with a great view
allReviews.text: We booked this as it was one of the more reasonable hotels during Oct half term. We were upgraded on arrival and our room was huge, lavishly furnished and had a great view over the strip, The pool was lovely, cocktails great and the staff very welcoming and attentive. The location was fine for us, a few minutes walk to the bottom of the strip. We would stay again.

allReviews.title: Lovely and sophisticated
allReviews.text: This is a beautiful resort with spacious and well appointed rooms.  We had coffee and water available in room and a stove, microwave and refrigerator for eating in room.  Location is just off strip and easy to access many places by foot.  Valets are quick to bring out cars as needed.

allReviews.title: Great service and a beautiful room
allReviews.text: Pricey but we choose the Trump for our Las Vegas stays for one reason -  there is NO CASINO to navigate as you arrive.  You go straight to the elevators.  The concierge is very helpful and the service was excellent.  You have to request housekeeping service by calling each day but it is available without charge.  We reserved a king suite accessible room and it was roomy with 2 full baths.  However, the showers had a tendency to leak water and the marble floors become very slick.  We used towels to stand in the shower and walk out.   The fitness center is well equipped.  The pool temp is heated, but only to 75 degrees, not enough for us in December.

allReviews.title: Definitely Recommend
allReviews.text: There’s a lot of conflicting information on The Trump Hotel so I thought I’d share our experience!Location : Just barely (the tiniest bit) off the strip. 8-10 minute walk to TI, mostly down Fashion Show Drive which is a little empty at night. Closest hotel to the North is Resort World which is about a 15-20 minute walk.  Biggest complaint is definitely the proximity to the train. It can be loud. Hotel : Is it a little dated? Yes. Even being a little dated, is it still nicer than all the other places at a similar price point? Absolutely! It is clean, good quality, and the rooms and bathrooms are BIG with full size windows. The only complaint about the rooms is that the windows aren’t as soundproof as you might expect so there can be some road noise. House keeping came everyday but only remade the bed. Didn’t touch towels or throw away empty water bottles on bedside table. Dining : It is undeniably lacking for dining options. DJT is one half of the lobby. It feels like you’re eating at a Holiday Inn Restaurant. They serve the same small menu for lunch and dinner. There is a small coffee cart with expensive coffee and limited pastries for breakfast.  Very different from most Vegas hotels. Staff : 10/10! Friendly and helpful! Check in was super quick. The bellman was super fast and full of good information. Had a small issue with our key and they fixed it way faster than I expected!Atmosphere : WAY more quiet than casino hotels. Doesn’t smell like smoke, or perfume to cover it up. Felt incredibly safe. No shenanigans in halls at 4 am. We loved it!

allReviews.title: Most off staff do not care about you..
allReviews.text: My wife and I arrived at the Trump International Hotel in Las Vegas for a 8 nights stay. We thought very highly off the city and the surrounding Nationalparks. We had a great time when away from the hotel. We booked through Hilton Grand Vacations - you should never do that.. The front desk treated us like dirt. When in a hotel you expect them to come and clean the room, but because we booked through HGVC they did not want to do that. They told us that they would make a cleaning every 3 days. Guess what they did not so we went to the front desk to times a day after that and asked for a cleaning. They could not care less, they even kicked me out off the lobby on the 6th day for being rude.... because I asked if it is normal to harass people from outside the US. ( we are from Denmark)On the 6th day we received two large towels.On the 7th day we received a 3 min cleaning ( we waited outside ) She only just made the bed.The pool area was very nice, they served us very well here. Here you can easily take a day off..The Lobby restaurant is very expensive and very average.The boys in the front ( valet parking ) are the best, we choose to give them all the tip that we did not give inside the hotel. They loved it..Would we recommend this hotel to anyone? NO - not because of the above because I hope not they treat everyone like this. The hotel is old, outdated dark rooms. It is a bit away from the Action, expensive and snobbish.

allReviews.title: Trump International
allReviews.text: Great rooms, service and convenience. One of our favorite places to stay in Las Vegas. Easy to access rooms compared to walking through a Casino and convenient to all areas of town. Generally use a car service to move to the casino's although they are within walking distance.

allReviews.title: Trump Hotel LV was hands down disappointing.
allReviews.text: I was expecting so much more. We checked in today. No greeting, no bellmen, and a disheveled front desk. We have a three-bedroom suite: No fresh flowers, fruit, or champagne on arrival. They do not offer turndown, so strange for a luxury property.Coffee service is mediocre and skimpy for this size suite. Bar drinks are $23 with poor service but good quality.Rooms are bland and lackluster, sterile and uninspiring. So disappointed. This is my first Trump property. I was hoping for a true Trump-level experience.

allReviews.title: Amazing room , great service
allReviews.text: Was here for a conference and I notice over the course of many years I stay healthy staying here instead the smoke filled hotels on the strip.They always go above and beyond great security , really good fish and chips and just nice people.Jake the manager went out of his way to make me feel comfortable and I had a personal emergency and he did nothing but show empathy and care for me. Made me a lifelong customer here.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: Great place to stay. Room was excellent. Staff also excellent. They went the extra mile to make sure we had everything we needed including a room with a great view of the strip. We would stay here again

allReviews.title: Find somewhere else
allReviews.text: Horrible!!!Save your money and find a better alternative I guess there’s a reason why it’s so cheap.We asked to set the sofa bed several times over a 4 hour period and with no response. The room wasn’t cleaned over our stay. The drain in the bathroom is all clogged including in the shower. So disappointing

allReviews.title: Disappointed
allReviews.text: I checked in yesterday and mentioned in my notes that it was my son's 1st birthday as well as requested for a pack n play for his comfort. None of that was recognized, front desk look disheveled and unfortunately, the pack n play wasn't in the room when we arrived.Additionally, I had asked for some coffee cups and water, but even after an hour, they hadn't been delivered. I understand that sometimes things can get busy, but called 3 different departments to request something so simple. Up to now, it has not arrived, given that they said it has been "expedited". No apology for the delay was given. I also noticed that the room seemed a bit run down, which was unexpected given the reputation of Trump Hotels. I've always heard about the personalized service and Forbes service standards, but unfortunately, my experience didn't quite match up to those expectations.This has undeniably cast a shadow over the perceived value of staying at a Trump Hotel, and it is regrettable that the service provided does not align with the esteemed reputation the brand seeks to uphold.

allReviews.title: Fabulous Vegas weekend
allReviews.text: Wonderful hotel with excellent views of the Northern part of the strip.   Good option if you are not a gambler and prefer to have a cigerette smell free experience.  They also do free valet which is awesome. Suite was newly renovated and water pressure was amazing.  Great coffee bar in the Lobby in the morning with the best muffins.  Staff is very professional and courteous and as expected all good looking lol.  Shout out to Julia at the front desk who was very personable and helpful.  Would definitely stay here again.  Two thumbs up!!!

allReviews.title: Sanctuary off the Strip
allReviews.text: My wife and I spent three nights at TI during a trade show. It was a return trip and as always a pleasure. The furnishings are elegant, the restaurant truly marvelous and the employees so helpful and well trained. This is our place in Las Vegas from now on.

allReviews.title: Fantastic views across the strip.
allReviews.text: Easy check in & out. We stayed in superior room suites on the 46th floor, the views across the strip was amazing. As the hotel is tucked away at the edge of the strip we had a fabulous view of the sphere. Rooms were clean and cleaned daily. Elevators were prompt and quick to the higher levels. The pool was super lovely, although the water was a little cold but it is November. We ate in the restaurant and the food was served hot and tasty. All in all we had a fantastic stay at the Trump International.

allReviews.title: Great experience at Trump hotel Las Vegas
allReviews.text: My stay at the Trump hotel in Las Vegas was good. Its location is not so good if you want to get to the casinos and main hotels on the Las Vegas strip, but the location-price ratio is very good compared to the other hotels. The bedrooms on Very spacious and have spectacular bathrooms. The beds were very comfortable and the pillows felt like clouds. In the room there was a stove and dishwasher, personally I didn't use it but it looked of good quality. The bathrooms were very large, they had two sinks, a tub, a shower and a toilet. The water came out perfectly to my liking. The restaurant service was good and the food was excellent. I can't say much about Valet Parking because I didn't use it much, but the one time I used it it was fast and efficient. I think it is a great Hotel that I would recommend to friends and family. I am thinking about returning to Las Vegas and this hotel would be my first choice without a doubt.

allReviews.title: Bad room cleaning.
allReviews.text: We stayed for four days.  The room was not cleaned on a single day, despite our request.  Very bad service.  We also sent a claim no customer service and there was no response at all.  We will never go to this hotel again.

allReviews.title: Great off strip option
allReviews.text: Positives, value for money, great pool that stays open all year with an outdoor hottub.  The hotel is a short walk off the strip.  Directly across the street from the mall, which has several options for food, coffee etc.  The room is spacious and has a refrigerator, microwave and dishes upon request. The restaurant onsite was excellent as well.Negative - valet parking.  This is your only choice here and although it's free you should tip and have to wait 10-15 mins every time you want your car, which is annoying.  Just let me park my own car so I can come and go as I please! Also, the carpet in the room was visibly dirty.

allReviews.title: good non gaming hotel
allReviews.text: nice non gaming hotel..rooms are large and comfy..a little on the old side..but pretty clean even though drapes could use a deep cleaning. Service was ok nothing memorable..could use more restaurants very limited for a hotel of this size. pricing hight, $19 for a muffin and double espresso...$54 for a chicken caesar and coke with tip..I do not have to pay for Truism re-election campaign

allReviews.title: Attention they do not refund room deposit
allReviews.text: Great Room and view on the Strip. Unfortunately the room has not been cleaned during our stay of 2 nights (they simply put a bag with the beauty products on the door(photo). In addition I have been charged the deposit of 360$ for the room. This is simply impossible. I troed to contact them but no answer from their side. Avoid the hotel and if so do not let them charge any deposit on your credit card!!

allReviews.title: Anniversary trip
allReviews.text: Very pleased with the location and customer service but very displeased with the cleanliness of the bed linen and the pillows were very flimsy. The should also look into airport shuttle to and from the hotel

allReviews.title: Elegant, more than comfortable, and great casino-free respite!
allReviews.text: Beautiful elegant hotel with wonderful staff and guest attention. The pool was relaxing and so pretty, especially at sunset.  We loved that it is casino-free, a real respite from the craziness of being on The Strip.

allReviews.title: Great property if you don't want a casino :)
allReviews.text: The lack of a casino makes this property more relaxing, more clean feeling and a bit more upscale feeling.  The pool is lovely and the staff at the pool is very good.  The food and drink we had at the pool was very good, although more variety / more options would be nice.  Only real downside was that the pillows were paper thin.

allReviews.title: Poop smell
allReviews.text: This hotel is terrible.  It smelled of poop in my room.  The food was mediocre and the service was so slow when I requested new pillows due to the smell in the room.  It's far from the strip and around some bad areas.

allReviews.title: GOOD
allReviews.text: Easy to access hotel, large room equipped with microwave and hotplate but no dishes, large bathroom with separate toilet but glass door, quick arrival, valet parking only but included, easy to access and just in favor of the fashion show.Mattress finished, it was digging so much that my back hurts, the toilet was leaking, the shower handle remained in our hands, we were on the 50th floor and at night you hear club music, the train and sirens and even cars., far from everything so always a lot of walking. After 2 days, no one came to clean, I had to call to ask for clean towels and to empty the trash cans, someone came, gave us towels and a bag to empty the trash cans ourselves.I would have given 3.5 stars

allReviews.title: The worst hotel service I’ve ever had
allReviews.text: My friends and I stayed at the Trump Hotel in Las Vegas on October 27th and 28th, and my experience was far from satisfactory. 1. On the first day, we found a hair clip in our bed, which was not only unpleasant but also raised concerns about cleanliness and hygiene.2. We promptly informed the front desk about the issue, but to our disappointment, our sheets were not changed on the second day of our stay. This lack of response to a clear sanitation concern was disappointing.3. During our stay, one of my friends got injured when they stepped on a plant prick in the hotel's vicinity. This incident raises questions about the safety and maintenance of the hotel's grounds.4. To make matters worse, when we discussed our concerns with the front desk manager, he displayed a bad attitude and unprofessional behavior. He simply dismissed our complaints and mentioned that he had provided a $150 credit to our room as compensation, which hardly addressed the issues we encountered.Overall, our experience at the Trump Hotel in Las Vegas was marred by hygiene concerns, safety issues, and poor customer service. We expected better from a reputable establishment. It is essential for the management to take these issues seriously and implement improvements to ensure a more enjoyable and safe stay for their guests."

allReviews.title: Fabulous Service at Trump International Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Fabulous well run hotel in Las Vegas.  The staff in all departments are really professional and so nice from the pool staff to front desk to housekeeping, everyone is really welcoming and friendly.  One person in particular that I have to say is so amazing is this one lady in housekeeping who is incredible, her name is Yattou, she is does an amazing job.  Overall, one of the best hotels in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Terrific hotel, polite and attentive staff, with a wonderful location, just off the Strip.
allReviews.text: Terrific hotel, polite and attentive staff, with a wonderful location, just off the Strip.  Our room was spacious, well equipped, and had wonderful views.  Will definitely be back as we enjoyed our stay as well as our visit to the Spa.   Although there is no casino in the hotel, you’re only a block from the Wynn/Encore complex.

allReviews.title: Credit Card Charge
allReviews.text: Hotel was great but extremely angry with the charge of over £1100 that was taken from my holding card after I had checked out. It was only when I contacted them that they admitted they had taken this by “accident” and would take up to 10 business days to be credited onto my card. All I received was a lame apology and no explanation as to why this was charged to my card. This was after another incident where the hotel took money from 4 separate credit cards but then said they couldn’t process the payments their end but had already taken the money. One further transaction had to be made to pay the receipt and a refund was given to the 4 cards but again taking up to 10 business days to receive the refund. This all left a very bitter taste

allReviews.title: Appreciation and wonderful memories
allReviews.text: I can’t express enough how much we LOVED our stay at Trump International.  Amazing!!  We left our car with the complimentary valet parking, walked through the sparkling rotating doors, and into the pristine foyer with high ceilings and massive chandelier.  We were provided fast, friendly and efficient service at the front desk.  We had two rooms booked , one for my husband and I & another for our friends.  We hadn’t seen them for  long time and decided to rendezvous in Vegas. We had VIP status with Expedia and we were anticipating an upgrade…perhaps a higher floor or better view.  We were offered an upgrade indeed… a penthouse suite!  It was unbelievable!  We felt like royalty. The suite had 5 bathrooms, 2 jetted tubs, 3 bedrooms, a massive kitchen…it was incredible.  It gave us time to visit with our friends until late into the night in a beautiful settingThe master bedroom had a his and hers bathroom with a huge richly tiled adjoining  shower.  3 shower heads and luxurious amenities.  The suite had a full size kitchen with complimentary Trump water and a coffee maker.  We loved the freshness of the non-smoking establishment with no loud casino noise. The restaurant served a delicious breakfast including a perfect omelette.  Everyone at the hotel was so welcoming and accommodating.  We were all so impressed with the standards at the Trump International.  I can’t thank them enough for the amazing stay we had there.  It was an experience we will all hold dearly in our memories. Absolute excellence.

allReviews.title: Trump International Hotel Las Vegas, EXCELLENT
allReviews.text: Very nice hotel, excellent service, very cordial treatment, spacious, beautiful and clean rooms, I recommend it to rest because it does not have a casino and that gives a lot of tranquility and silence to the hotel.

allReviews.title: A Pleasant Stay for a Birthday at a Convenient Location
allReviews.text: We chose Trump International because we didn't want to be forced to walk through smoke-filled casinos to get to our rooms every night, but there are more reasons why this place was the perfect fit for me and my family! The staff was friendly and quickly attentive to our needs. The hotel is conveniently located at the top of the Strip, but not too far north like Circus Circus or the Strat, and it is a nice distance off the Strip, away from the hustle and bustle to decompress after a long day. It is certainly walkable, and we did a mix of walking and Lyft rides between the hotel and the Strip depending on how we were feeling at the time. We chose rooms with a Strip view, and the views from the 50th floor did not disappoint! We were also celebrating a birthday, and were able to effortlessly arrange for our cake and balloons order to be delivered to our room while we were exploring for the day. We also got the Zen for Men massage at Trump Spa as a birthday gift, and he raved about the experience! All in all, we can agree that we would stay here again!

allReviews.title: Disappointed
allReviews.text: Supposedly five stars, but I dispute that rating. The room could have been cleaner (hairs all over the velour covered hide a bed sofa). shower floor was so slippery, I can't believe nobody has fallen. coffee maker in room, but no coffee or tea provided. Furniture was worn and dated.  $16 for a PB&J. Never again.

allReviews.title: 2wks at trump
allReviews.text: Cleanliness great staff  very help but may be not enough valet extremely busy waited 20 mins at least. Kitchen could have been stocked had to ask for basics ie bottle opener. But delivered promptly when asked. Also no daily clean had to ask again just for rubbish to be emptied.  Pool not a place to relax sun lounges that close together could not move you had to climb on not good for elderly or disabled.  When we moved them told heath and safety and put them backNo buses to strip so lots of walking and short cut of mall shuts early. You can hear the train.and some traffic But other than that you don't hear anything from other staff or customers

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: Big, clean, luxurious, nice bedding, great pool area & huge master bath. Kitchen could use bigger skillet, pots & steak knifes. We always cook & maybe most people don’t in Vegas. Not a big issue. In our Florida stay we had to buy a skillet.

allReviews.title: Beautiful resort and good restaurant too.
allReviews.text: At first we were assigned  a room which obviously wasn’t finished being cleaned or something because soap was open and a used towel. Phone didn’t work properly. We were moved to a different one bedroom the next day and it was beautiful and had a wonderful view on the 41st floor. We both agreed the bed had seen better days and needs replaced but it wasn’t miserable. Bring earplugs! The street noise is loud even on high floors. Trains, loud motorcycles, etc. We ate at the restaurant and it was excellent! I had haddock which was huge and my husband had the DJT burger and it was the best burger ever. We will be staying here again. One can walk a few minutes to Resort World or Treasure Island, etc. The Fashion Show Mall is right across the street, a one minute walk!

allReviews.title: Great Stay in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: If you are looking for a quiet place in the middle of chaos, this is the one.  With no casino and no smoking it is a much quieter resort than any we have stayed at in Vegas. It is clean, spacious and staff attentive. There is no charge for umbrellas at the pool, which you definitely need if you want to protect yourself from sun. It is a bit of a walk off the strip, but during daytime hours you can cross the street and walk through the mall.

allReviews.title: Very Nice Hotel
allReviews.text: Top of the line service from check in to departure .  Lovely first class hotel with spa services, restaurants, gift shops.  Very professional staff. Great location  Rooms offered very nice ammenities

allReviews.title: I do not recommend
allReviews.text: I am outraged by this hotel. During our stay, everything went well, although they didn't clean the room even one day. But the big problem came later. I consumed snacks and drinks at the hotel pool, signing the notes, and that was it. To my surprise, when they released the security deposit, already deducting the consumption made at the hotel, I noticed that there was some extra charge, for the amount that was refunded. I contacted the hotel asking for the invoice so I could check it, and they placed two undue charges, which totaled more than 100.00 dollars. I asked the hotel for clarification and for them to check the signed notes, as I did not recognize that charge, and until today, almost a month later, no one has responded to me. The hotel simply ignored my complaint. I contacted Booking who said there was nothing they could do, as they were not responsible for this type of “problem” with the hotel. In short, avoid this hotel, because if you have problems of this type it will be almost impossible to resolve, and will prey on your money for undue charges. Very disappointed, as processing a hotel that doesn't have a branch in BR will be difficult.

allReviews.title: Good option for a less noisy hotel than casinos. Very good facilities
allReviews.text: A very good option if you are looking for accommodation with less noise and movement than in casino hotels. Although it is a little far from the center of the strip, it is in front of an excellent mall. Very spacious rooms and comfortable hotel.

allReviews.title: Level of service is sinking
allReviews.text: This hotel was on the top of my list but that was in the past. Now they have sunk to a level far below what they used to be. The building itself is fine, just like so many of the Vegas hotels but the 'service' is now sub-par. It WAS a friendly, welcoming part of arriving in Vegas, but like so many other establishments, it is operated by people and people sometime can have less than the best attitude and representation for their place of employment. It's unfortunate but true, expecting any level of quality and professional service these days is certainly not easy to find.

allReviews.title: Be careful not to end up in the Hilton Vacation Club
allReviews.text: The most important point: when checking in, make sure you get a room in the Trump Hotel. Some of the rooms have been sublet or sold to Hilton Vacation Club. If, like us, you get a generous upgrade to a suite, you will probably fall into exactly the same trap as we did and end up in a Hilton room like this. What's so bad about it? If you want a hotel room without daily cleaning or service, that may be right for you. Every time we asked for the room to be tidied, it was a big fuss. Sometimes they just did a refresh, which consisted of putting a plastic bag with coffee and shampoo on the counter in the kitchen and a few new towels on the chair next to it. Even a visit to the front desk and a conversation with the manager didn't help. Also notable was the arrogance of a certain manager on duty, who you'd be better off not letting loose on guests! He then explained to us that the Trump Hotel was NOT a 5-star hotel. The room itself was OK, but you could see its age. You immediately felt like you'd been transported back 15 years. But everything was intact and not broken.If you arrive by car, you should know that there is ONLY valet parking (free). But if you arrive at an inconvenient time, you will have to wait a long time for the car.But as far as all the rooms are concerned (due to the construction): noise. Yes, you really can hear every noise from outside. And because there are several large roads right behind the building, you can often hear engines roaring. Sometimes that wakes you up in the night. But that's not the worst part: the trains also go right through there. And every time, the trains use their horn, several times. You will feel as if the train is going right next to your ear. This is despite the fact that we had a room on the 35th floor. Sometimes the trains go through there at 6 a.m. and you are involuntarily woken up early. At the weekend, you can hear the bass from the club at the Hilton Hotel even though it is far away, but you could only sleep with earplugs.All in all: I would not recommend the hotel. It can't even compete with a 3 star hotel. It was my first and last time here!

allReviews.title: NOT A 5 star
allReviews.text: It is absolutely not possible to consider it a 5 star. Dirty rooms, UNprofessional staff.We waited more than an hour to be served for breakfast.The pool area has deafening music, no one comes to hand over towels.Absolutely NOT RECOMMENDED

allReviews.title: The BEST with a family
allReviews.text: Stayed at almost all 5 star hotels in vegas with the family. Trump is different. Very different:All valet parking. No fuss. No hassle. Located just off strip away from the trash but 30 seconds from the mall.High tower but small footprint.Great Gym overlooking pool.Lovely pool..amazing attentive service. Fair prices. Not pushy. No upselling. Free Iced water no problem. Big shout to Ernest.Dated yes but lovely room with terrific bathroom. Huge spa bath. Huge double sized shower. Fridge ( no mini bar nonsense). Microwave and hob.No smoking…and no casino…no teen trash. No hen or stag parties..just nice people. They have sold some of the units.. met owners..its their home…they want it well kept.Well done to all. Without hesitation this is the place to stay with a family.

allReviews.title: Excellent hotel, right at the end of the strip
allReviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, super luxurious and comfortable. Comfortable and clean beds, great shower and bathtub, beautiful pool (not so popular). The hotel is great as a whole. There was a lack of good service at the reception and a nicer restaurant for breakfast (the only restaurant option is very formal and the breakfast is not attractive and has absurd prices).It doesn't have a casino and it's almost at the end of the strip, so you need to walk a bit to restaurants and attractions. If you are with children or babies, you need to see if this distance makes sense, as it is quite hot. The shopping mall that cuts across the road also closes early.

allReviews.title: Anti-Woke Las Vegas Hotel
allReviews.text: This is a great anti woke hotel.  No Casinos, no smoking, Like minded Conservative guests.  Everyone is friendly and willing to do a great service for guests. We stayed here for our 50th Anniversary and were not disappointed.

allReviews.title: Great Stay
allReviews.text: From the minute you walk it you are greeted with friendly smiling faces. Beautiful decor. Security in place. Free valet parking. Great food on site. Clean beautiful rooms that meet all your needs. Mall is walking distance.

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel in lovely quiet location
allReviews.text: What a room!  Was offered an upgrade to a corner suite for a small daily increase of the room we had booked and were not disappointed!!  The room was huge, had floor to ceiling windows on all sides and even had a spa bath with Las Vegas strip view along with a huge lounge/dining area, kitchen, second bathroom and beautiful bedroom with dual aspect views.  An absolute pleasure to come back to after a very hot day in Vegas.  Concierge, Niko was really friendly and helpful and booked us reduced price tickets to the Cirque du Soleil show at Treasure Island and was a pleasure to deal with.  Location is great as lovely and quiet off the strip itself.  Only small negative was there was a notification in the room about room service and one afternoon we fancied a proper pot of tea in our room after a long day out.  However, we called the number on the telephone for room service, explained what we wanted and a few minutes later a lady arrived at the door with a plastic bag full of "tea pods" and plastic milks for our coffee machine along with cardboard cups!  We went down to reception and was told we needed to order on the App which we had attempted to use but when loading was asking us for a monthly fee to be paid so we cancelled it.  We managed to get a pot of tea in the restaurant in the end but really fancied a proper relax in our room with proper crockery!  Thought calling direct to room service would be more straight forward!  Otherwise, would highly recommend as the hotel feels very upmarket and luxurious compared to some of the other hotels on the strip which are so casino and fast food orientated.  Would definitely stay again.

allReviews.title: WOW
allReviews.text: My family and I spend 10 days at Trump International and loved every second of our visit! We stayed in a beautiful 3 bedroom penthouse, which was surely the most beautiful hotel room I’ve even been in! The staff here is extremely friendly and helpful. The atmosphere is perfect, it’s a very quiet oasis only steps away from the excitement of the Vegas Strip! We will definitely return to Vegas and will ONLY stay at the Trump!

allReviews.title: Not really a Trump property.
allReviews.text: Over the years I had stayed in other Trump hotels in NYC and DC so I was expecting a certain quality when I booked at Trump Las Vegas. This is a totally different level of quality, much much lower. The good: The property itself is beautiful, the rooms are spacious, nice pool, great new gym, and the staff inside the hotel is not 5 star hotel quality but friendly. The Bad: no real room service, you can get some food dropped in a paper bag to your room instead. The hotel is kind of a tacky hotel blasting loud bad pop music everywhere you go especially at the pool. I could hear the music from my room on the 40th floor. Only 1 basic hotel restaurant that makes the food for the entire property. The UglyNo self parking. You have to give your car to the worst valet service I have ever seen. I wonder if the valet is handle by a 3rd party company. It is a mess. Wait forever to get your car. Wait for ever to drop your car too. It is totally disorganized. If you have Tesla insurance this valet is going to cost you big as they drive like maniacs. They are also dirty and leave your car’s window open so you can get all that desert dust all over. My advice, avoid this property especially if you have a car.

allReviews.title: Modern and luxurious
allReviews.text: A 5 minute walk from Streep.Very nice, clean, attractive and spacious rooms with bathroom equipped with shower and jacuzzi tub.Large, cozy beds. No casino inside and free valet parking. Hotel also suitable for children.Inside you can find a swimming pool and a gym.

allReviews.title: Loved this hotel
allReviews.text: Loved this hotel! Everything was perfect from the room, the view, the pool and the staff. Valet parking is free of charge. We had a complimentary room upgrade with a view of the strip and a larger room which was lovely. Complimentary bottles of Trump bottled water in our room. Would definitely stay here again!

allReviews.title: Very well-equipped and quiet hotel (without casino)
allReviews.text: Very well equipped and quiet hotel. This hotel does not have a casino so it is a great choice if you are looking for a quieter and restful environment, since hotels with casinos have a lot of noise and people on the ground floor as well as people entering and leaving their rooms continuously. The location is very good, in front of a large shopping center and close to the Palazzo, Venetian, etc. The rooms are very spacious and perfectly equipped, with a very complete kitchen and no skimping on towels, bath gel, etc. Good value for money. I recommend it and would return

allReviews.title: Striking views and Beautiful Hotel
allReviews.text: Wow, been to hotels throughout vegas. This is one beautiful hotel. And very clean. Great valet at the front. Excellent service at the lobby. Service person at the elevator very personable and cordial.  And now the room. Clean. Doesn’t have the stink of drunk casino goers. Will absolutely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Not really on the Strip
allReviews.text: Good hotel, quiet, not having a casino, suitable if you want quality at a not exaggerated price and if you are willing to walk a bit to reach the Mirage - Cesar Palace area, as this hotel is located in a side street, all beginning of the Strip, the street with all the casinos and luxury hotels.Decent room quality and services. The catering offer is limited.

allReviews.title: Will definitely be back.
allReviews.text: Our 12th trip to Vegas and decided to check out Trump LV. Great hotel. Our room was fantastic. Huge shower, huge spa bath, and the room itself was bigger than expected. Staff were all friendly. Stayed a week there until we moved to a different hotel in the middle of the strip. The only down side was its a little far away from everything but we knew that before we booked it as we had a car and weren't really planning on seeing much of the strip our 1st week here. If you have a car there is no self car parking as it's all valet parking. This was great dropping the car off, but picking it up, you'll be waiting 15/20 mins for it, so just allow for this. Valet parking is all free except for the tip. Didn't try the restaurant, so not sure about that.

allReviews.title: A (relatively good) choice of hotel which does not endorse anything of the label, but which was intended to be rational...
allReviews.text: A (relatively good) choice of hotel which does not endorse anything of the label, but which was intended to be rational...

allReviews.title: TRUMP INTERNATIONAL HOTEL LAS VEGAS NEVADA
allReviews.text: The suite was absolutely plush and beautiful. We really enjoyed staying here. One issue, I left my portfolio in my rental car by accident. It was stolen by the parking attendent which it contained many receipts I needed. They took a report but nothing was "found" recommend don't leave ANYTHING in your cars EVER. They also challenged us stating we didn't have a rental car the next day. The attended mis-typed our rental car information in the database. Took us arguing over 4 hours before they would give up our car back to us. It clearly was retribution. Also should have contacted the police, but again the mgt challenged us non-stop not believing we had a rental car.

allReviews.title: Best hotel on strip
allReviews.text: This is the best hotel on the strip if you are looking for an oasis of quiet, an actual coffee maker, fridge and microwave in room (absent from other hotels), no casino , no smoke and they don't charge $30 for a drink at the bar.  We had late night sandwiches at DJT restaurant in the hotel.  Food was excellent.   Over the years, all vegas knows how to do now is price gouge everyone.  It is getting so obnoxious.   I have family outside of the area in utah...only reason I will go there anymore is convenience to airport.   Trump hotel 5 stars for not being obnoxious and for being next to fashion mall and convenience to shopping and restaurants.

allReviews.title: Housecleaning steals
allReviews.text: Housecleaning steals items left in room. I left an item on the bed when I checked out to leave and a few hours later I realized that I left my item. I did the lost and found report which I filled out 2 years ago. My lost item hasn’t been found up to this day I went here on 2021. If housecleaning really does take out the sheets of the bed then they would’ve seen my item. I’m tired of the housecleaning employees lying about not finding my item.

allReviews.title: NEAR BUT OFF THE STRIP
allReviews.text: The location of this property is ideal for allowing visitors to have walking distance access to the Mall and to enjoy the entertainment provided on the Las Vegas Strip, while having a quiet get away to relax at away from the hustle and bustle.

allReviews.title: Never again this hotel
allReviews.text: Catastrophic front desk I can only advise against visiting this hotel. I had paid for this booking in advance and was charged twice. The customer service was rude and refused to admit the error... despite receipts!!!! It was only with the help of the travel company that the money was refunded... then processing fees were deducted for their error!!! Now the complaint marathon continues... They also vehemently tried to charge the resort fee twice... even though it had already been paid!!!! Never again!!!!

allReviews.title: Mixed reviews
allReviews.text: We stayed here with our two girls and there are many positives about it. We loved that there wasn’t a casino in this hotel and it felt like you were escaping the hustle and bustle of Las Vegas. It was great it was right opposite a shopping mall. It was clean and easy to access the facilities.The downside was the restaurant for breakfast where the staff were fairly rude and the bedroom seemed a little tired and dated. But they were comfortable. We had to ask quite a few times for the room to have the daily clean, and Infact we had to go down at 11pm after our supper to come and make beds and clean as it wasn’t done that day. The swimming pool just felt like it wasn’t that clean either But overall it was an easy place to stay and comfortable.

allReviews.title: Staff could care less, just doing their jobs!
allReviews.text: Staff were not very friendly. The food was ok and very pricey. When you had a problem, staff were not good problem solvers. The room was very nice but my head was slanted back because the mattress was not even and flat. The location is not good for walking to the strip. You will have to Uber everywhere except the mall located just across the street.

allReviews.title: The nicest hotel we’ve ever stayed in in Vegas, but not the most expensiveThe nicest hotel we’ve ever stayed in Vegas, b
allReviews.text: The nicest hotel we’ve ever stayed in in Vegas, but not the most expensiveThe nicest hotel we’ve ever stayed in Vegas, b

allReviews.title: Fantastic hotel for family holiday
allReviews.text: Fantastic hotel, easy parking, very comfortable bed, massive suites, 1 1/2.bathrooms, comfy sofa bed, comfy roll-away bed, comfy king-size bed, lots of storage, full kitchen with massive fridge/freezer, prompt room service, fantastic staff, clean, nice smelling, non-smoking, perfect temperature control, fantastic views of the strip, excellent pool area, not too expensive, ATM with reasonable charge for Vegas.  What is there not to like?

allReviews.title: Not a Five Star Experience
allReviews.text: If, like us, you are booking Trump expecting a highly rated five star hotel at very reasonable rates (no doubt due to issues with the Trump brand) you will be disappointed. If however you are comparing it to similar priced 3-4 star hotels, then it’s probably a good option. We stayed here for one night only (luckily) having stayed at the Palazzo and the Wynn in previous visits. There is no comparison. Trump might look five star from the outside, but it fails to deliver the five star experience. The rooms are large but dated and tired. Ours had a kitchenette which might be useful if you have kids or are staying a while. The bathroom was large and had a jacuzzi bath and a shower. however only two very small bath towels, very basic shower, basic toiletries, two tiny water bottles, thin, rough toilet paper etc etc. we didn’t really use the resort, but the gym or pool, both looked small compared with the other resorts we’ve stayed at before (Wynn and Palazzo)On the plus side, location is good and no hidden extras such as for parking (a big bonus if you are staying a long time). Trump isn’t a bad hotel but it doesn’t come close to the other five star options on the strip.

allReviews.title: The Trump International Hotes in Las Vegas is great!!!
allReviews.text: We stayed at the Trump Hotel for our family vacation in Las Vegas this year.  We had two wonderful suites on the corner and loved every minute of being there.  We ate at the hotel restaurant the first night, and it was delicious.  Service was excellent as was ALL the services.  The valet parking was great, the pool beautiful and refreshing.
