We especially liked the extra security near the elavators.  Someone was always there to make sure only guests and authorized people were allowed up to the rooms.  All in all, the hotel was wonderful.  It was close to everything, but yet out of the way.   We plan to go back!

allReviews.title: Room was not ready
allReviews.text: My reservation was July 7, but our flight does not get in until July 8 early morning. I called front desk two days before our check in date and informed them about this, I was told it should be ok, they will put a note late check in and hold the room. when we checked in our room was not ready and waited for 3 hours, even after I called and informed them our arrival time and paid for the night of July 7

allReviews.title: Wifes birthday party
allReviews.text: I threw my wife a birthday party last Oct 2022 at Terrace 16 at Trump Int'l Hotels in Chicago. The Director of Private Events, Maria Bejar, really took care of us and did an excellent job!  She was great in communicating with us, and everything went off smoothly without a hitch. She sat all twelve of us in a semi-private room, which allowed us to enjoy the evening with some privacy. The food was excellent and well-priced. Maria sent my wife a nice birthday cake! We had a great time, and felt welcome at Trump. Thank you, Maria and team Trump! M Duque

allReviews.title: Shiny exterior doesn’t translate to shining service
allReviews.text: I have stayed here 2 previous times 2016 & 2018 and was quite impressed with it all. Now, the exact opposite is true. Their service has definitely lost its luster and there is NO way this is even close to a 5 star hotel now. I should have known something was amiss when upon check in I wasn't asked if I wanted to upgrade, even at an extra cost. Next was the room with the uneven bed that made me feel like I was rolling off the side every night. The street noise from the 45th floor sounds as if we don't have windows at all, and yes the fresh air vents were closed. Next, room service is now a 2GO scanning app with limited items and a DoorDash delivered feel. They even cut out the free shuttle that used to run from here to Caesar'sBut the worst part was ZERO housekeeping service. Stayed for 4 days and had to call twice to get fresh towels and garbage picked up, absolutely ridiculous; and yes we hung the SERVICE REQUESTED sign each day we left for hours on end. Super 8's turn their rooms more often.Sadly, if I visit Vegas again, this will not be on my list of places to stay. Do better, I've seen it.

allReviews.title: Great Couple Experience
allReviews.text: Not being big gamblers, this hotel was perfect. Great pool. No casino in Trump International but only steps away from the Fashion Mall. RTC Deuce double deck bus has a stop at Fashion Mall. Lots of reasonably priced food venues for breakfast and lunch at the mall and great service at the hotel.

allReviews.title: We look forward to returning
allReviews.text: We loved the Trump hotel! The staff was exceptional. We always felt welcomed and well cared for. The insulation/soundproofing was wonderful. We never heard any neighbors. Everything was clean, the bathroom was beautiful, and the bed was comfortable. The pool could have been more inspired, but it was fine. They could hire more valets; be prepared to wait for your car for awhile. Overall- it was a stellar experience.

allReviews.title: Fabulous hotel and restaurant
allReviews.text: Amazing hotel! Luxurious and beautiful. Great restaurant good and service. Every employee acts like it is their hotel/restaurant - empowered to answer all of your questions, get you whatever you need/want, and have great personalities.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: Staying at this hotel exceeded my expectations, the rooms were clean and spacious.  The hotel had good facilities and the staff were very friendly. The pool was fantastic, the staff extremely helpful and the water was the perfect temp.The gym was being refurbished and the temporary gym was a bit disappointing but understandable.Only thing worth commenting was that housekeeping only came to clean the room once during our 4 night stay, I think it should be a bit more frequent. The hotel is a little set back from the strip but right opposite the mall which turned out to be great.

allReviews.title: GREAT HOTEL GREAT LOCATION  EXCELLENT STAFF AND HOUSEKEEPING. VERY NICE AND SPACIOUS ROOMS. Good food at DJ RESTAURANT..
allReviews.text: GREAT HOTEL GREAT LOCATION  EXCELLENT STAFF AND HOUSEKEEPING. VERY NICE AND SPACIOUS ROOMS. Good food at DJ RESTAURANT..

allReviews.title: Sin City with a twist
allReviews.text: Trump hotel is located at a convenient location. Great for ppl that wants value and not looking to spend all day and night gambling. We went to Vegas to party and sight seeing so trump hotel is perfect. Staff was awesome, room is awesome. Overall super happy with this trip.

allReviews.title: EXCEEDED ALL EXPECTATIONS!!!
allReviews.text: The Trump International Hotel at Las Vegas was an absolutely awesome experience! The entire staff from the valets, to check in, to the bell hops and security were all top notch.  Everyone was extremely professional, organized, conscientious and accommodating.  This hotel stay is one of the nicest experiences I've had and the staff was extremely accommodating and pet friendly to our large breed dog who joined us on the trip. The room was very spacious and clean, the beds and pillows were incredibly comfortable and the small kitchenette was a definite plus for our week long stay.  The view from the room was panoramic and you can see the LV Strip and the mountains in the distance. It's easy to get off and onto the interstate from this location and there are so many things to get to within walking distance.  I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Las Vegas and it is an extremely pet friendly hotel with lots of amenities and a very accommodating staff.  Thank you so much Mr. Trump and your staff for a wonderful week in this beautiful city!

allReviews.title: Amazing Place To Stay
allReviews.text: Amazing!This is by far one of the best hotels in the city. The staff are great, the hotel is kept up very well, and the rooms are expansive and comfortable. Our room was very large, had a fridge and stove top, plenty of storage areas, sitting area, huge bathroom with jacuzzi tub, double sinks, separate restroom area, huge marbled shower. This was our second stay here and I will be returning. The pool was big and luxurious and the staff there were attentive and super nice. I can't say enough good things about the Trump Resort. Thank you Mr. Trump and your staff!

allReviews.title: I wouldn’t stay anywhere else in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Best hotel I have stayed at in North America so far.  It was beautiful, clean, friendly staff, excellent food in the restaurants.  The pool was great with very helpful staff that find you a good seat, lay out your towels and immediately bring you ice water and anything else you may want.  Our hotel room was beyond great, beautiful views, super clean, full kitchen with stove, microwave, dishwasher, full size sub zero fridge with ice maker and my husband’s favorite; two bathrooms.

allReviews.title: Fantastic hotel, great views
allReviews.text: - Good location, opposite Fashion Mall- Great Views from our hotel suite on 42nd floor- Good security at reception, you need to tap in before going up on the elevators- Great amenities such a pool- Bathroom was great, fixtures were made of quality- Kitchenette in hotel suite, however you would need to call reception for plates and cutlery.- Walking distance to Venetian, Palazzo, Treasure Island etc- Walking distance to Linq Monorail- please note, there is a resort fee charge added to credit card… but well worth itWe made a great choice of booking into a hotel that doesn’t have casino at the bottom - ease of check in and check out.  I recommend making your own judgement about booking hotels with casinos by watch YouTube blogs on them!Can’t fault the Trump International Hotel

allReviews.title: Definitely not 5 star
allReviews.text: Pros:- No casino- off the strip, but close enough to walk (recommend going through the mall. Walking down fashion blvd is trashy, smelly and a construction zone). Still close to the hwy and it can be noisy on the back side. - the pool area is quiet and lovely. They all work very hard to keep chairs rotated. There is a fee for the cabanas poolside. - double sinks in the bathroom are a plus. Large tub and generous walk in shower. Cons:- biggest complaint was housekeeping every 3 days unless requested. Must request consumable replacements every day. We stayed 3 nights. They serviced our room once - the bed was made and towels replaced but the room was not cleaned and coffee not refilled. It was disappointing. - the rooms are showing their age. The upholstery is a little nasty 🤮 - if you have sensitivity to fragrance, bring your own toiletries!In general, we were not informed that housekeeping was still on Covid level frequency. Don’t charge top rates and provide subpar service.

allReviews.title: Expected better.
allReviews.text: We are currently staying on a week long booking and so far (day 3) are very disappointed with our stay.  We have  encounted problems with poor house keeping and rude barman (Saturday night in the lobby bar) Here's the issues so far: unclean room - mould in the shower and dirty and dusty carpet. Bath towels are too small and thin (not worthy of a 5 star hotel). Shower is either too cold or too hot. You have to stand there playing with the tap for 5 minutes to reach anything close to comfortable. No kitchenette equipment like glasses, cutlery and other basics. Only one disposable cup for coffee making. No "do not disturb" or " make up my room" options in our room also.Our issues at the bar where when we couldn't get 2 spots together at the bar, we walked around to the other side to another lounge area but were then told that the area was "closed". We then attempted to move a bar stool to the other end of the bar to sit together  before the barman advised this was not allowed? He made no suggestions for alternative seating and promptly decided to serve our cocktail and Shiraz in plastic cups (expecting us to walk away I presume) On a positive note,  the situation was saved by a friendly wait person that suggested we sit at one of the tables already set for meals.  BTW this all happened at 9:30 on a Saturday Night.  Not a very good experience so far from a supposed 5 star hotel. Probably not 5 star anymore as the rooms are becoming dated and worn. After 15 years it may be time to refurbish the rooms. Here's hoping the rest of our stay improves.

allReviews.title: Outstanding Property with top notch staff!!!!
allReviews.text: This resort is our go to resort when we go to Las Vegas. Absolutely love everything about it. Total class and professionalism from everyone !!!! We will be back every year!!! No casino so it’s a wonderful reprieve off the busy strip!!

allReviews.title: Exceptional Staff and Clean Beautiful rooms!
allReviews.text: This was a wonderful experience! Every single staff person that we encountered were kind, helpful and friendly! We ate at the restaurant just once, but it was delicious!  I had the avocado toast for dinner (yes for dinner) and it was incredible! The rooms were clean and beautiful and very spacious! We had 3 adults females staying in our room, and I though we would be fighting over the bathroom. Nope, they have the bathroom segregated with frosted glass, so one person could be in the shower while another was in the Toilet and the other was getting ready at one of the double sinks. It was perfect! the A/C was on point and we were able to adjust it to our liking! It did have a mini fridge and a microwave which was nice. It also had a 3 burner stove top, which we didn't use. There were no pans or items in the cupboards but with how helpful everyone was, I'm sure they would have brought us what ever we asked for. We had them bring up safety pins and scissors one day while we were getting ready for one of our nights out for the bachelorette. "absolutely, no problem"  was always the response. There were NO BED BUGS! I say that in caps because it's super important me, especially in Vegas to be in a bed bug free hotel. They had zipped mattress covers. I pulled the sheets off both double beds and lifted each mattress to look for rusty droppings. NOTHING! Totally clean! The pool is clean and quiet which is rare in vegas! Also, we got to ride in the Trump 2 escalade to the airport, so much fun. PS our driver was amazing and super friendly!  I will definitely stay at this hotel again!

allReviews.title: Trump International was beyond our expectations!
allReviews.text: We recently went with family and friends and stayed in 5 rooms at the Trump International in Las Vegas.  Everyone had an amazing time.  It was very relaxing and had plenty of access to everything that Vegas has to offer.  The rooms were immaculate, even my mom had no complaints!

allReviews.title: It’s okay
allReviews.text: Try to get the view that you can see the Main Street of Vegas, otherwise it’s boring. The room is very big, and that’s about it. It feels very old, the pool is not impressive and it’s small. It’s about 7 minutes walk to the nearest casino and eating place which is in the Wynns. And Macy’s is right across the street from Trump International. If you can get the room in the high level with the good view of the street, go for it, other wise it’s okay. Though it’s not as busy and noisy, away from the chaos of Vegas. About 40 minutes walk to New York New York.

allReviews.title: 5* Indeed
allReviews.text: We we’re n room 2207 and it was amazing. Corner room and 5* doesn’t do it justice. Living room, bedroom, 2 bathrooms, full size kitchen, ect… Velet parking was a breeze, and everyone was ready to assist in any way possible. Can’t wait to get back soon

allReviews.title: Excellent hotel away from all the noise and riff-raff
allReviews.text: My wife and I stayed her for four nights.  Away from all the noise and crowds but a ten minute Uber ride from anywhere you want to go.   Our room was excellent.  We liked having a fridge but didn't use the stove.   Across the street was a shopping mall which had multiple restaurants so this was handy.  If you want to see some sights, catch a few shows, go out for some nice meals and do a little shopping then this is a great place to stay.  It is too far to walk to the main area of the strip especially with the hot weather.  We have stayed at Delano and Vdara before and we liked those places but this was better.  Maybe not the best choice if you want to drink party and gamble.  Then again drinking partying and gambling are not the best choice anyways but eventually you will figure that out for yourself if you have not already.

allReviews.title: Classy hotel, good location
allReviews.text: Very classy hotel in a great location just off the strip. The staff were all professional and knowledgeable. Our room was huge and quiet. The cocktails at the restaurant were amazing. We still talk about them months later. I would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Donald Trump would not be Happy with the degradation in service.
allReviews.text: The building is still magnificent, but there are some major service issues that I have yet to experience in the past. They no longer service your room daily. So I called on day 2 to have our room serviced, and they kindly agreed but failed to do so. On Day 3 I called to get our room serviced, and they kindly agreed but DID NOT do so. Only on day #4 did they clean our room, provide new sheets, and remove the waste in the garbage cans. DJT, would never stand for this! They also have a major parking issue. On Friday note at 8:30 PM,  we waited 25 minutes to give our car to the valet. Cars were backed up on each side of the street out in front of the Hotel. Not having a person directing cars and the lack of staff often leads to this mess. It is not the Trump Hotel of the past. Sadly it will be my last stay.

allReviews.title: Our Trip to Vegas
allReviews.text: This Resort is one of the best we’ve stayed in and we’ve had timeshare for 37 Yrs and used it all over the world.The resort is a five or six star resort with all the amenities you could wish for from Gym Spa, Pool ,great restaurant which you could order your meal to go, which families did with small children.Our unit was on the 22nd floor which was huge with everything you needed in it. The staff went above and beyond to make sure all your needs were met so you could relax and enjoy your stay.When you first arrive you are met with the most beautiful chandeliers everywhere.A fun place to stay and can’t wait to return some day…

allReviews.title: This is are go to place for LV
allReviews.text: Say what you want about the man but he sure knows how to build Hotels. Get the strip view rooms. Ours was on the 47 floor and what a view. The only disappointment was the bathroom, it had a combined tub shower. The other room we had was separate. It also had a kitchenette.

allReviews.title: Just average
allReviews.text: Pros:1) Big rooms/ big bathrooms2) Not modernized as Wynn 3) Comfortable bedsCons:1) Restaurant has ONLY ONE vegetarian dish on the menu ( Avacado toast) + Juices are from the can :(2) Service is slow in the rooms3) Hotel does not arrange cabs

allReviews.title: Overall, a good stay
allReviews.text: Check in, valet, bell boys all excellent..Room slightly dated, good sized, comfortable bed, great spa bath, large but rather weak shower.  Sink was slow to empty. Room was clean. Coffee making facilities. Bell boy organised for tea to be sent up but this did take chasing. No robes or slippers which we had to chase. Slippers arrived, no robes, had to chase again.. Had a pool day, which was very nice, excellent pool staff, and nice pool with seating. Came back at 2pm and room not serviced. When we phoned down were told it might not be serviced before 6pm as standard unless specifically requested early service?? Never had this anywhere before. We requested towels and left room unserviced. Short walk to the strip. Nice that there was no casinoBarman was rather surly. He was on his own, so maybe stressed, but didn’t acknowledge we were waiting for quite a while. Liked the extra security, though there are no safes. Would still recommend and stay again. Small niggles really.

allReviews.title: Real 5 Star
allReviews.text: I've stayed at most of the hotels and casinos on the strip, the Trump hotel is the best, true quality.  Friendly staff and good location.Close to great shopping, too.Lovely pool area. The food is fantastic, I recommend Capitol Grill 2 minutes walk from here.

allReviews.title: excellent
allReviews.text: Everything very nice, the only thing is that they don´t clean every day, only every 4 days...the rest was great....................................................................................................

allReviews.title: Luxury shopping and trains
allReviews.text: The hotel services were great! the fashion mall nearby was a great escape from the casinos. As a kid always enjoyed the trains sounds as they are passing by. the vales were very efficient and truly safe guarded our vehicle!

allReviews.title: Tired rooms and non existent housekeeping, nice pool, great security staff
allReviews.text: Stayed at Trump International 21st to 25th April. Check in was quick and easy. Was asked if we'd stayed there before and as we hadn't, was given an info sheet on the hotel. Security is fab and you have to scan your room key via a security guard to gain access to the lifts to get to your room. The room unfortunately was not 5* standard, it was very dated, drab and to be honest battered, but it was clean. It was a decent size though and had a nice bathroom, but I wasn't sold on the glass toilet door, but maybe that's just me. Having a microwave and refrigerator was a bonus, we didn't use the kitchen area other than that but if you want to, you have to request untensils, plates and cutlery. There was also free bottled water provided and a coffee machine with a few coffee pods. This would have been a nice thing to use but as we only saw housekeeping once, on our first day, and never again, we never got any water or coffee refills. I did query this with reception and they confirmed housekeeping should have been daily and insinuated the problem must have been mine and did I have the do not disturb sign on the door. That would have been hard as there wasn't one in our room. They did eventually refund 2 days resort fees but it was a fight to get anything. The pool area was very nice and the pool attendants can't do enough for you. They do whip your towels back quick if you turn your back though. I popped back to my room to get something and when I returned, 10 mins later, my sunbed had been stripped. If the pool area was full I could understand it, but it wasn't. The hotel itself advertises itself as a strip hotel, it is not. It may only be 1 block off the strip but you do have to navigate past the homeless people and a dirty great open lot/piece of scrubland. We did walk it as a couple but I wouldn't walk it on my own. For us, it was also at the wrong end of the strip. We didn't think we would miss having a casino right downstairs, but we did. That's just our view and others might like the casino free environment. All in all, would we stay here again, it's a definite no.

allReviews.title: Great overall for right person
allReviews.text: Overall we really enjoyed our stay at The Trump.  Large clean rooms, incredibly fast room service, quieter slightly off the strip location, very fair prices, nice pool and great spa.   The only downside is the dining on site is limited.We would happily stay there again.

allReviews.title: Trump does not disappoint
allReviews.text: This was a trip that I put together for my entire family and we have been looking forward to for the past year.  The Trump resort made it possible for us to travel to several destinations and take in so many of the sights that surrounds Vegas.  We were also within walking distance of the strip without the hustle and bustle of the casinos.  The staff was kind, friendly, and helpful.  10 out of 10 recommend!

Such a beautiful, clean hotel with friendly staff! We stayed for the week and had an easy check in/ check out. Our room got upgraded and it was very spacious with a kitchen and living room, big bathroom with a tub. I can’t say enough good things about Trump Hotel.

allReviews.title: Our favorite hotel
allReviews.text: Everything about this hotel  is 5 star. The service is outstanding. The rooms are spacious, clean and has everything you could need. Stayed 5 days. We dont need the casino so this is great and quiet. Always come here when in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Wonderful!!
allReviews.text: We loved our 900 foot square suite. We had 2 bathrooms and 2 showers. The view of the strip was wonderful. We had a full kitchen as well. The room was quiet on the 56th floor. The higher floors had a separate elevator. We appreciated the water each day and coffee in the room. The main bathroom was huge. A huge tub as well and double sink vanity. Comfy robes were provided as well. I really enjoyed staying at the hotel. In the morning in the lobby a nice selection of coffee and pastries are available to go. Or, you can eat at the restaurant which we found was very good. The coffee, cappuccino, and almond croissants were excellent. I asked for a late check out and they were gracious. Non smoking, non gaming, and quiet. Perfect!!!

allReviews.title: Middle of the road Trump
allReviews.text: Located a little off-centre, Trump International is well located over the road from the extensive Fashion Show Mall and for those intending to partake of the Wynn Buffet. Rooms are clean and spacious with a taste of luxury in the bedding and bathroom. The rest is pretty standard hotel offering, perhaps just a bit dated and with an unnecessary huge bank of drawers and cupboards. Reception is efficient as is concierge. Breakfast was not tried.

allReviews.title: Noise is an issue
allReviews.text: The noise from the bands that are at adjacent hotels is beyond safe noise levels. We were on the 41st floor and the beat from base drum   permeated our room. The noise went on way into the night. Ear plugs are a must for a good night's sleep.The jets in the jacuzzi tub did not work even after hotel engineering attempted twice.The employees are courteous and helpful and that's the only good thing about the hotel.Think twice before reserving a room here.

allReviews.title: Fantastic
allReviews.text: As always another fantastic stay at the Trump Hotel Las Vegas. I appreciate the early check in and the the staff is always top notch. I do however, wish they would have the shuttle to the Wynn and  Caesars Palace.

allReviews.title: On the whole an amazing Hotel.
allReviews.text: Trump International is an amazing hotel, lovely spacious rooms. Marble bathroom with large whirlpool bath and large shower cubicle.Staff very friendly but professional easy check in with no issues. Pool lovely area my only gripe would be the waiter who seemed to favour certain guests took him 3 days before saying “you guys ok?” Yeah we were ok and could manage to get ourselves off the sunbeds and get our own drinks thanks!We had breakfast most days in the DJT restaurant lovely food eggs Benedict was awesome and we had 2 dinners at DJT first meal was excellent however the second was not such a good experience tbh, we were still eating our starter when a strange waiter brought our mains over and although I was still eating moved my soup bowl over, when later asked if our meal was ok but our regular waiter I did comment about the service and the fact the food was cold, he offered complimentary desserts which we declined, it had spoilt the meal by then. Bit disappointing considering the cost of the meals quite pricey!Other than the 2 comments and issues I would have given top scores and if I do ever return to Vegas 🤷‍♀️I will definitely be staying at the Trump.

allReviews.title: Outstanding staff making a memorable stay.
allReviews.text: Excellent stay on two separate occasions during our trip.Beautiful hotel in good location.We found the staff outstanding and were polite, friendly, reactive and always smiling.Special thanks to both Jason and Ian to whom checked us in on each occasion. They were professional, polite and made us feel very welcome.Very reassuring to have friendly staff checking key cards on entering room elevators.We booked both rooms overlooking the strip and were large, very well equipped on firstly, the 48th floor and secondly on the 50th floor.Only issue we experienced during second stay (5 nights) were the lack of regular house keeping. This was addressed during our stay and satisfactorily resolved.

allReviews.title: Very good experience.
allReviews.text: We are staying here several times and every time is a great time and experience. Highly recommended. Good location, great rooms, great service, everything is great, not a single complain. I hope to be back soon.

allReviews.title: Very good
allReviews.text: Very good hotel, the only problem is that it is not on the strip.The rooms are big, the bathrooms are great, the gym is spectacular and the pool is also very good.I would also hire someone speaking Spanish or Castilian to help visitors

allReviews.title: Trump Tower Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Was best stay ever and loved the service the room was huge for 1 bedroom was first class all the way.Would go back anytime we could loved it felt special staying there.Came here last year will come back next year

allReviews.title: Amazing
allReviews.text: Very very clean, nice finishes, good quality hotel. Slightly worn over the years but nothing in the hotel is cheap. Staff are wonderful and extremely friendly, breakfast was top notch. Would 100% stay here again, plenty of pool loungers, pool large and not busy even when the hotel is busy.

allReviews.title: We loved it!
allReviews.text: Read some of the negative reviews on here and was a bit worried about our 7 night stay here. Really no need the hotel and it’s staff and facilities are excellent! No casino, no smoking and a short distance from the main strip made this the ideal location for us. Room excellent, bed comfortable and the nice little touches in the room made our stay really enjoyable. Seen previous comments about the lack of housekeeping, absolute rubbish, just press the button by the room door which alerts the staff you want your room cleaned and bingo! Ours was cleaned every day, fresh towels, linen and water / coffee etc… Pool was excellent and beds available any time of day, staff were efficient and polite and you were always asked if you wanted drinks / food etc… For us, we couldn’t fault it. We wouldn’t hesitate in returning in the future.

allReviews.title: Absolutely Horrible Experience!!!!
allReviews.text: We received an offer from Hilton Grand Vacations (HGV) for 4days/3 nights in Vegas at the Trump hotel. We decided to make this our annual anniversary trip and extended it to 6 nights, through HGV. We also elected to go through the hotel itself and add another 2 nights. My wife had never been to Vegas before, so we made plans to go to Hoover Dam, Grand Canyon, and doo stuff around town. We're not big gamblers, but obviously there are a lot more things to do there then that. I booked 1 bedroom suite through HGV and when I went through the hotel for the additional 2 nights, I asked the lady if we could stay in the same room with 2 different confirmations. She said yes, as long as you book the same kind of room, which we did. Upon arrival, we found the staff to be friendly. We had rented a power wheelchair for my wife that was delivered the day before we arrived. They kept it in the back for us. So, all was well starting off. The room was spacious and we really liked the suite layout have a living room, dining area, kitchen with dishes/silverware/cookware, full size fridge with ice maker, and separate bedroom. It was odd, but the fridge turned off several times a day. It also had 2 full baths. We are not much on bring home dirty clothes, so when we stay where they have washer/dryer, we do our laundry before traveling back home. This suite was equipped with a washer/dryer combo. After our 5th night, we decided to do laundry, but could not get the machine to work. We called downstairs and they were going to have someone come up there and show us. After an hour, I called back and was told the washer/dryer in that room was out of service. They offered for us to move suites at the other end of the hall, which we did. Upon getting settled in, I found the ice maker didn't work and the ice machine was at the other end of the hotel. So, I had to make trips when we needed ice, not the end of the world. After our 6th night of our original reservation with Hilton, I stopped by the desk on the way out to make sure all was well with transitioning into the other reservation. The lady told me I had to move rooms, to which I responded with a firm "no, I'm not!". She went and got the manager, Jake Jacobsen, who told me that there are rooms there that are owned by HGV and the others are owned by the Hotel, that's why I had to move... again!! This time I went from the 44th floor to the 52nd. I explained to him what I was told by the lady I spoke with making the reservation and he had a smirky smile and told me "I'm sorry, that was not accurate information and we had no choice but to move again."We were one the way out and I told him we weren't moving anything until we got back, which would be later that evening. That didn't seem to be a problem. So, we packed up again and moved up 8 floors to an identical suite. Upon getting settled for a 3rd time, in our 3rd room, we noticed the door in the bathroom was locked where the washer/dryer was located. We also noticed there were no dishes/silverware/cookware, nothing in the kitchen at all. I made another trip down to visit Mr. Jacobsen to ask about this. He proceeded to tell me that booking through the hotel, you don't get the same amenities that you get when booking through HGV. There is no washer/dryer in these rooms. You have to request dishes/silverware and all that upon making the reservation. I proceeded to ask Mr. Jacobsen just how long he planned on my laying down and taking the bull$h!t he has handed me over the last couple of days. He stood there smiling, which elevated my anger even more. At this time, I was weighing out the options of satisfying my anger with this guy and going to jail, or walk away. Thankfully, I chose the latter. Mr. Jacobsen offered me to bring all my clothes downstairs by 9:00a and he would have them laundered and back by 5:00p. I asked him how in the hell he expected me to trust him at this point. Again, he just stood and smiled. Seeing how they ran their hotel, there was no way I would trust him with my personal belongings.I would strongly encourage everyone to avoid this hotel like the plague. We chose not to let it ruin our anniversary trip, but this place absolutely sucks! You only get your room cleaned on the 5th day. Any options for service before then results in an upcharge. If I could give them negative stars, I certainly would. I'm glad Trump ran the country far better than his people run his hotels. Typing this out makes me angry all over again. You have 1000 options for hotel stay in Vegas. I chose Trump hotel. Don't be like me. Go somewhere else.

allReviews.title: Over an hour waiting to check in
allReviews.text: We did an RCI timeshare trade to get into trump International.   RCI gave them the two names.  but Trump only put one name on the reservation.  We had a booking confirmation with both names, but since the Trump folks only put one name into their system, they would not let us check in.  We had to  contact RCI, Hilton vacations,  etc.  To have them resend the reservation info to Trump.  But the trump front desk would not accept the email until their "system " updated" two hour waiting in the lobby for a system update.  Never coming here again.

allReviews.title: Good Hotel
allReviews.text: A great hotel.  Clean, beautiful, secure.  Downsides are railroad tracks nearby and access for drop-off and pickup is chaotic.  The restaurant was pricey, but there’s a mall across the street with many food options.

allReviews.title: Best Hotel, Best President, Best customer service bar none.
allReviews.text: Take it from someone that has been going to Vegas for parties, golf, and concerts for 40 years. This hotel has the best customer service in Vegas. I hate outting this place because I would rather keep that on the down low.

allReviews.title: A giant neon advertising sign for ya Man.
allReviews.text: Please understand that this Hotel is NOT on the Strip. It’s disconnected from anything at all. No Casino, no real bar, just a small restaurant in the lobby. So you will be getting Uber/Cabs/Walking. A lot. Pricing in the Vegas hotel market is very efficient, so don’t be fooled (like I was) by the suggestion that this is a 5-star bargain. The rooms are spacious but a little rough around the edges. An older crowd here than the strip hotels, so you might want that? Constant Country music drove me to leave the pool area, which is otherwise the best thing about this hotel.

allReviews.title: Terrible
allReviews.text: Only the facade of the hotel is luxurious, the interior neither works nor looks like it should. If you stay more than one night don't expect room cleaning because they don't do that!! So you ask them to at least bring clean towels, you call after another 30 minutes to remind them. You get them in an hour. The rooms have old furniture and dust everywhere, no bathrobe, no slippers, coffee machine not working. THIS IS FIVE STARS?!?!

allReviews.title: Would have given this hotel 5-stars if the night time front-desk people had been actually helpful and not rude.
allReviews.text: Would have given this hotel 5-stars if the night time front-desk people had been actually helpful and not rude.

allReviews.title: 5-Star Hotel with service that is not up to the standard
allReviews.text: The Hotel is rated as a 5-Star Hotel. The Installations are clearly up to it, but the service is not. We stayed two nights, our room was not cleaned when we came back the first day. The reason given was a lack of personnel which is clearly unacceptable. After having spoken to the Housekeeping Manager he promised to send somebody to at least get some amenities and towels. We even agreed on a time, but nobody showed up. Only after the second call we received towels. This is the main reason for the low qualification .

allReviews.title: May be the best place to stay for conventions in LV
allReviews.text: Quiet, Clean, no casino, no smoke. Easy 5 min. cab or rideshare to LVCC. Full kitchen (bring your own pan, cups, and utensils) with Keurig style coffee maker. Dishwasher (bring some dishwasher pods) and our room even had a laundry machine. The restaurant food was delicious and the staff was friendly. There was no wait for breakfast or dinner any night we were there, saving us time compared to the big casino hotels we normally stay in.

allReviews.title: There’s no place quite like it!
allReviews.text: This is now the second time we stayed at the Trump International Las Vegas and it just keeps getting better. This time we were on a Make-a-Wish trip for our daughter and the staff couldn’t be nicer. The room was immaculate, and the staff from valet to front desk were so thoughtful and professional knowing how special this trip was for us. With its unique location, just off the strip, you never few like you are in the middle of all the craziness. It was really a trip of a lifetime. Thank you Trump International for making our last visit so memorable!

allReviews.title: Classy Place with Great Service
allReviews.text: This is my third visit here. It is such a great place to stay. Love that it is a Hilton affiliate. We have a one-bedroom suite on the 26th floor, overlooking the Las Vegas Strip. The room is top-notch quality. Two bathrooms, but the Main Bathroom is palatial  - just gorgeous. So glad there isn't a casino attached or a bunch of kids running around - everywhere!

allReviews.title: A Very Good Experience Overall
allReviews.text: Good:1. Kitchen (Fridge; Stove Top; Microwave)2. Free Water3. Nice Spacious room4. Jacuzzi5. Security - You have to scan your pass to get to the elevator section (we notice not every hotel does this)6.Quality - Room Quality is as good as Luxury Hotels7. Price Point - I felt we were getting Luxury level quality but at a reduced price. We used the money saved on other things while visiting Vegas.8. Clean air Bad:1. Some items were not working initially but were fixed (specifically the Stove Top, Jacuzzi and Table Lamp).2. Lack of USB ports. Our initial room had a clock radio that had 2 USB in it but our other room did not. Having said that, some may argue that it should be USB-C now, so maybe it was smarter for the Hotel not to put any for now. Just make sure to come prepared with wire and the proper plug in.3. Location - It is not on the Strip. To get to the strip will depend on what time of day. During the day, you can go thru the Fashion Show Mall and get to the Trump via Nordstrom. But during the night, the Mall is closed and you could either take a taxi/uber or just walk (the walking is around 10 minutes & there is less people in that area).4. No Casino - This is not necessarily a negative, some may see it as a positive.5. Only 1 Restaurant - If you are looking for something other than the Trump Hotel Restaurant, you can always go across the street to Fashion Show Mall and get some other food. For cheap eats (there was Earl of Sandwich close to the Nordstrom which I liked) & there are some some highly rated restaurants in the Fashion Show Mall as well.Overall, a very good experience. The negative points were very minor in my opinion. I Recommend the Trump International Hotel to anyone that is reading this.

allReviews.title: A Vegas Haven
allReviews.text: I was comped three nights at another hotel on the strip, but I was so repulsed by the smell of pot and cigarettes everywhere that I left after one night and checked into Trump. What a difference. All class at Trump. Beautiful rooms, professional staff and good food. The pool is ideal for those that want a relaxing day with very comfortable loungers (free umbrellas even, imagine that!) At night the bar provides good strong cocktails to accompany quality dining. A nice peaceful breakfast too. I am too old for the new Vegas of pot smoke and pool parties. Trump is my new go to in Vegas. If I want a casino, I’ll get an Uber for $9 and wade through casinos with smoke and noise and the people that like that stuff. Also, directly across the street is a mall with some food offerings and lots of stores. The security at Trump is phenomenal too. Very nice and protective of the guests. Great experience!

allReviews.title: Dirty and no management
allReviews.text: Overall, dirty hotel. We stayed 4 nights, we had our room cleaned once. Ended up having to call for service because of the lack of room service. Ran out of clean towels, toiletries, etc. Even the vent was caked up with dust. Management doesn’t care about the condition of rooms.

allReviews.title: Island of elegance and great taste
allReviews.text: We dropped in just for coffee & tea & ice cream &pastry. The place is outstandingly elegant and the prices are reasonable. The staff is exceptionally friendly and helpful.  We bought some souvenirs at the little shop where the lady was absolutely wonderful.

allReviews.title: This resort ticks all the boxes! ✅
allReviews.text: The checkin was flawless, with our one bedroom suite ready at our arrival around 2 pm. The suite was quite large with a separate bedroom, 2 bathrooms and 2 showers, and a full kitchen.  We did not have maid service daily, but it did not bother us.  We did have a towel refresh midweek only.  We really enjoyed hanging by the quiet pool.  Getting chairs is never an issue, it is quiet and very clean.  We always spend on drinks and food by the pool, so we would rent one of the $100 sun beds, and that gave you a $100 credit to use on purchases. Perfect!  The service by the pool was very efficient and the bloody Mary’s delicious served with bacon and a large shrimp.  We ate in the restaurants only once for breakfast and had the best Huevo Ranchero Eggs, yum!!The hotel is perfectly situated in our view, across the street from the high end mall and the Wynn Hotel.  Be aware that there is a train track near by that whistles around 4 times a day or night.  Takes a few days to be able to ignore it ans sleep through that annoying sound.

allReviews.title: Employees Make it Great
allReviews.text: Can't wait to visit Las Vegas and the Trump Hotel again! We did not want to stay in a casino hotel with all the smoke. This was perfect for us, close enough to the strip to walk over to have dinner. The room was nice, especially with the kitchenette, but the greatest strength at this hotel is the employees. Everyone was friendly and helpful. It was weird they didn't clean daily but they brought fresh towels, coffee, etc whenever we requested. We also noticed the people staying here were friendly which made it an even more pleasant stay. I appreciated security key check before allowing you to go up to the rooms.  The pool is beautiful and the pool attendants were helpful. One thing to change would be the pillows, no support at all, I had to use three. All in all, it will be our first choice when looking for a hotel in Las Vegas next time we can get away.

allReviews.title: 5 star experience. Look no further
allReviews.text: Excellent place to stay in Vegas. I was looking for somewhere to stay in Vegas that met my needs. Non smoking, quiet, close to the strip, great price and value. Trump international met all those from the smooth check in process, upscale rooms, 5 minute walk to the strip so I was still close to the action but at night I had somewhere quiet to get some rest. Definitely staying here again. Final comment. Everyone that works at this hotel is so nice and you can tell they enjoy working here. Just book it! It’s one of the few hotels without a casino which cuts down on the foot traffic.

allReviews.title: An OK hotel, but just the worst (lousy) service, very disappointing.
allReviews.text: This stay was to be very special for us and way stretched our budget but seemed a bucket list opportunity. Nice room but trying to order room service tonight took two hours and was an absolute debacle. Room service would not send us a menu (despite the order app being down) and told us bluntly to go down to the bar and order, your meal will be delivered to your room. OK, did that, but then got told that we had to return to the lobby and pick up our own dinner! It was in a paper sack like Uber eats and stone cold. All this while being treated like a third world citizen. We are so unhappy with the service that we considered checking out but that would cost more than we can afford. All I can say is that the hard product is quite nice but the customer service is absolutely appalling. We will be sure to eat elsewhere during our stay.

allReviews.title: Not a 5 star hotel, 3 would be generous!
allReviews.text: This is the first hotel I have stayed at in the world where “housekeeping” only appear upon request and then only if you are lucky. Stayed here for 4 nights after a cruise, no comparison. Towels changed twice a day on the cruise, once in 4 days in this hotel. Bottled water & coffee not replaced after day 1. Only good point is the pool……..plenty of beds and well staffed. Up your game Donald !!

allReviews.title: Double charge with no resolution
allReviews.text: Hello I stayed at the hotel in Las Vegas with the above reference number .My booking was made via booking . Com and I paid for the booking on the 27th March 2023 which was $1077 . The booking includes the room total and the resort fee as attached .However on upon check in I swiped my card as the damage deposit and for any charges that may occur during the stay . Upon in check out the receptionist stated there was nothing to pay as everything was pre paid .However on the 6th April you charged my card ending 2012 the full amount of $1077 again as shown belowThis is an incorrect charge as I have already paid for the room and resort fees and all taxes on the 27th and as per the booking conditions .I called the hotel on the 9th April and spoke to Eric who explained the charge was in error and would refund the stay but was unable to refund the resort fees as this is only ever paid at the hotel . I explained multiple times that my original booking included resort fees and taxes and sent a picture of my booking confirmation and he stated I was wrong ….I explained that if there was an additional charge how come both booking.com and trump charged me $1077. He couldn’t answer that and stated I needed to take it up with booking.com . I stated that Trump charged me incorrectly .I have currently been refunded $855.92 but I require the additional $221.10 (resort fees and taxes ) to be refunded , as this was included in the original booking fee.Additionally I have now enquired additional charges for this error . As I’m from the UK I got charged £25 in a foreign transaction fee that i require to be refunded as you can see circled belowAlso I have incurred a phone call charge from calling your hotel to get this rectified , which is £52. You can see this below with your telephone number statedThis additional cost of £77 at current exchange rate is $95So I require $221 dollars and $95 to be refunded to me .This is very frustrating as I have stayed at Trump twice now , and last year I stayed for my wedding . I did have another booking for September that I have now had to cancel as I’m concerned I will be charged twice , and even though I have illustrated the overcharge I am yet to be compensated .I messaged the hotel today and they provided this email .Thank youNikolay Ivanov

allReviews.title: Easily A 5 Star Rating
allReviews.text: This is the best hotel we have ever stayed in.  Service and security are beyond anything we have ever experienced anywhere else we have stayed.   We stayed in a “ superior” King room on the 52nd floor that had both a shower and jacuzzi tub.  The bathroom was huge and had a double bowl vanity with storage places below.  The restaurant was the best that we experienced in Vegas.  Service was excellent and seating is spaced far enough apart so that you can enjoy a conversation while dining.  Overall a fantastic hotel that is well worth the price.

allReviews.title: Relaxing week at Trump Int
allReviews.text: Resort was 5 star, excellent and very well maintained. Courteous, professional staff. Quick sign in/out, no resort fees. Large studio, double closets, safe, 12x15'bathroom (oversize 2 person jet tub/ large shower). Large pool, hot tub and exercise facilities were very well maintained. Fashion mall across the street with restaurants, food court , ABC store, etc. 1 block to Wynn and Venetian, 10 min walk to Caesars and center of the Strip. We are booked for Apr and Oct this year

allReviews.title: Trump for the win!
allReviews.text: From check-in to check-out, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Trump.  Just 1/2 block off the strip made this a perfect location without all the craziness of non-guests walking in and out of the hotel.  I'll return to the Trump for all my future Vegas stays.

allReviews.title: Nice place for a short stay
allReviews.text: We chose the property because of it's closeness to Resort World and availability while in Vegas for a concert.  There was nothing wrong with the hotel.  It was very busy while we were there and if you use the complementary valet parking (the only parking option available), it can become an inconvenience having to wait for your car or for traffic to clear out of the driveway.  Dining is limited and it is a little more than a short walk to the next closest options.  We had a flexible schedule but only stayed 3 nights (was reserved for 7).  All staff we interacted with were exceptionally friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: Disappointing Stay
allReviews.text: We have stayed at the Trump several times before. This time we had 2 units..one unit was never cleaned during our 7 day stay. It took 3 attempts to get a feather free room as only partial job done in the beginning and lack of language understanding. If i hadn't noticed the comforter i would have had serious health issues

allReviews.title: Definitely NOT Like Trump Chicago
allReviews.text: I guess I should have known with the cheap prices that this would be a “Hampton Inn” like hotel. Don’t get me wrong the lobby is beautiful and the DJT restaurant was amazing but the service and the rooms SUCKED! We were actually downgraded just to get a room. They didn’t even comp us in any way. The carpet in the rooms was not soft (yes that sounds petty) but it reminded me more of burlap. We are visiting Vegas again in December and will NOT be staying here. But will visit DJT for dinner.

allReviews.title: Terrible value
allReviews.text: Not a good value.  So many other places in Vegas were a better value for the price.  This Hotel has a smell to it and needs refreshing.   0 stars.  Would not recommend.   The only thing good was the location, but there are better options.

allReviews.title: Needs some work! Lost it's touch.
allReviews.text: We have stayed here a couple of times prior and it was amazing pre-covid. It is simply not as good as it was. Check-in was easy, got upgraded due to Expedia gold vip status, was quick and easy. The carpet in the room was filthy - we can deal with that, the hotel is getting a bit old and things wear down. We asked for some dishes and they brought them up quickly. The main issue is with housekeeping, they ask that you notify them if you require housekeeping daily and we notified them daily. We did not come to Vegas to make beds and clean up!! We did not pay to stay at a hotel to clean up! Everyday there was at least one issue with housekeeping, no vacuuming, robes taken and not replaced, sofa bed not put away, no decaf coffee pods, the list goes on and on. Then a call to the front desk and magically the next day everything is completed. We should not have to call the front desk every day to complain about housekeeping. After covid there is no excuse to not do this daily. Pool was a bit cold (if the weather is not above 20 be prepared to deal with a cooler pool). We didn't mind much as we are use to the cold but lots of people did not enter the pool as they were not use to the cooler temperatures. They say it's heated to 84 degrees, but the pool doesn't retain the heat when it's cold and windy. They should pump it up for those days but do nothing. No outside food allowed onto the pool deck, I don't remember this being an issue prior - food choices are not good for kids, and a smoothie for kids is $14-16 + tax + tip, ridiculous pricing for a kids smoothie. Save your pool chair and money, and go across to Nordstrom to get the kids smoothies. Other than a few of these issues the stay was great. No noise at night, did not hear the train, ask for a high floor, mall has improved their food choices over the past years, easy walk to the Wynn...no more shuttle service to Caesars or the Wynn, that was a nice feature with kids. Resort fees are too high especially if housekeeping is bad and you don't park a car, and you can't bring any outside food or drinks to the pool. We will likely not stay here again, has lost it's touch. We stay here mainly since there is no casino and no smoking but I think housekeeping is a must and being flexible with kids at the pool with food is required. No door man anymore either. Gym is convenient and close to pool which is a nice feature.

allReviews.title: Getting run down
allReviews.text: We have been staying at the Trump hotel for the last several years and it's been very nice. Although still nice I believe it's gone from a five-star hotel to a four-star hotel. The carpeting in the room was dirty there is no house cleaning service for 3 days while we were there the bath room itself was not as clean as one would expect from a Trump hotel.Eric if you're listening time for a remodel.

allReviews.title: Trump Hotel so very nice!
allReviews.text: Wonderful experience. Everyone was pleasant and helpful. Didn’t lack for anything. Pool was lovely and well maintained. Lifeguards on duty!The suite was lovely and well appointed. We called for pans, dishes and utensils since hotel doesn’t stock them in room. Kitchen had full size refrigerator and appliances. View was amazing. We loved the bed and bedding and nice soft water. At the hotel were couples, business folks, conventioneers, families with children and of course lots of dogs! They had wonderful valet parking, too!

allReviews.title: Shocked at how many stars this place had
allReviews.text: I was woken up all hours of the night because the street behind the hotel is a common drag racing street. This was verified by a porter at the Wynn but when I spoke to the manager at Trump he acted like I was crazy he said this is an isolated complaint that they’ve never had before so it’s invalid and they wouldn’t even comp a resort fee but that’s fine although it would have been nice if he acknowledged it and didn’t act like I was crazy. The rooms are similar to an extended stay but if you want a kitchen it’s good, the seating areas in the room  are all cloth, not ideal. The bathrooms were beautiful and it was a great price. Staff is pleasant as long as you don’t have an issue, then it changes. It might be a good place if you have to bring children to Vegas (which I don’t recommend) because there is no casino/smoking inside but another bummer is the pool closes at 7:00 pm, too early.

allReviews.title: Great trip for fun and relaxation.
allReviews.text: Nice rooms, good service, coffee makers need to be upgraded and bath robes are missing. Tubs and showers are great, the rooms have very nice fridge,Cool too stove and microwave. The roomHas a great amount storage and drawers. The View of Las Vegas is beautiful. The Hotel has none of the cigarette smell like The casino hotels and the hotel is a short walk fromThe strip so the location is very convenient.

allReviews.title: Great place!
allReviews.text: We loved this hotel. It is not a casino so it felt way more relaxing. The rooms were large & nicely laid out. I especially liked how quiet our room was. No noise from other guests in above rooms. Our room was beautifully cleaned every day. And huge bonus…right across the road from an amazing mall!

allReviews.title: Busy and Noisey
allReviews.text: Too close to train tracks.   Trains blowing horns at 12-2am that cant sleep throughEntrance to difficult.  No taxi/ uber stand to cut down on cars in entrance. Valet works hard but never enough.   Pots and pans were horrible— worn out

allReviews.title: 99.9% perfection
allReviews.text: Fabulous hotel in every way..The rooms are first class. The service is first class. The views from the room are brilliant ( we had a city view). Try a Bllody Mary from the bar.! It contains things you just wouldn’t expect but which actually complement it. I shan’t give the surprise away.And that lift - almost as fast as the space shuttle taking off.

allReviews.title: Jets in the hot tub
allReviews.text: Disappointed with jets in the bath didn’t get fixed. Contacted service attaché three times and final response was we don’t have the parts to get that fixed. They could’ve offered a different solution but unfortunately didn’t happen.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas Vacation
allReviews.text: No housekeeping was provided during the 3 night stay. The room was lacking paper towels, water bottles, coffee/ tea pouches etc. They charged me more than what I was supposed to pay. I had to call the hotel to get it reversed.

allReviews.title: Beautiful to look at, but lacking in intelligence!
allReviews.text: Perhaps the most "beautifully appointed" timeshare we've seen in 38 years, but there ARE many weaknesses also.  The kitchen has a Wolf range, Bosch dishwasher, and Sub-Zero refrigerator, but was missing a wine opener, tall water glasses, steak knives, butcher knives, a regular coffee pot (not a Keurig), at least two more wine glasses (need 4 not 2).  Stunning bathrooms with gorgeous marble and large showers, (2 full baths), but the smaller bath was not bright enough, there's inadequate shelf space for belongings (no cabinetry), there was no hairdryer, and there was only one small towel bar (does not accommodate a second couple).  Neither bathroom provided hand-towel rings or bars for convenience, and the paper products were the cheap thin rough tissues unworthy of a Trump property.  The mattress was very good, but the bedding was cheap and unimpressive.  South facing rooms see the strip, but north facing rooms hear the freight trains several times per day and sirens.  Good large modern TVs, but NO DVD players provided, unlike most other timeshares!  Room coffee, via Keurig, was terrible (KONA).  Hot water was rarely hot enough in showers.  Downstairs restaurant was truly EXCELLENT!  Staff was very friendly throughout.  Location was great, across from Fashion Mall, a couple of blocks off of the strip.  The drive-up entry was chaotic and disorganized due to lack of signage, which could easily be fixed by management.  The hotel is like a beautiful woman or handsome man with no "brains", great to look at but lacking.  The rooms should be top of the line, but management has obviously never stayed in their own property to see what is lacking.

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: Our experience at this hotel was excellent. It is located within walking distance to the strip and has shopping malls directly across the road. The check in and check out process was quick and smooth. The rooms are spacious and very clean. The staff were courteous and professional and valet parking is included in your stayWould definitely recommend this hotel if staying in Las Vegas

allReviews.title: Expected more
allReviews.text: Stayed two nights in a one bedroom corner suite.  Room was spacious and well appointed. The hotel is just off the strip but easy to access. While the room was nice I expected more dining alternatives. When we were there (2 weeks ago) they only had one eating area. Having stayed at other Vegas establishments this is definitely on the light side. Overall I found the Trump experience under whelming. Suggest folks book something on the strips at one of the popular venues.

allReviews.title: Valet stole souvenirs from our rental cars trunk
allReviews.text: Checked rental car on Monday left it there until checked out on Friday. Friday we discovered our souvenirs were missing from the trunk of our rental. The only keys to the car were in the valets hands. They STOLE our souvenirs from our car!Security was notified. I don’t believe anything will be done. Not comfortable booking here again!

allReviews.title: Musty smell in the room 4014
allReviews.text: I am not sure if all rooms had the same issue, but my room 4014 was musty and had a mold growing in the corner of the shower. Pool was great, service was awesome, but I am allergic to the mold and got an asthma attack after the night sleep.

allReviews.title: Had better experiences at 2.5 star hotels
allReviews.text: Room smelled like sewage.  I reported to front desk, but they could do nothing as were sold out.  No other attempts at satisfaction were made.  Room cleaned once during stay (M-F) - had to call to get that.

allReviews.title: Vegas Business Trio
allReviews.text: The hotel staff was very nice. The room was clean although off of the strip, it is well located. The lack of casino makes it a quiet place to relax. May need a little updating soon would benefit from a couple of other options for food on site.

allReviews.title: Amazing view of the lights of Vegas
allReviews.text: Wonderful experience at Trump for my mother and IClean, quiet, comfortable, safe, every amenity available for our comfort.Any questions were answered fast and  accurately before our stay. Our room on the 52 nd floor was superb. Fast elevators that were always readily available. The housekeeping was perfect everyday. Loved coming back to a spotless room that smelt lovely. Loved everything about our stay and would highly recommend. Also loved that there was no casino at this hotel ( although one not far away) and that it was totally smoke free.

allReviews.title: The golden hotel.
allReviews.text: My experience was great!, room size and amenities were excellent, just make sure your room is not facing the back of the hotel, you won't enjoy the view. otherwise, it is a good hotel. the restaurant does not offer a big variety of meals but the food quality is there.

allReviews.title: Trump Disappointment
allReviews.text: This is no where near a luxury hotel. The room was outdated with the furnishings being worn and dull. I do not understand having no glasses in the room and having to request more bottled water. And a resort fee for what? If you don’t use their parking it is just excessively charging the guest.

allReviews.title: Great overall stay
allReviews.text: Great overall experience. Nice hotel. Great location across from fashion show mall. Having the little kitchenette in the room is a good feature when travelling with kids. Housekeeping staff was great and accommodated  all our needs.

allReviews.title: Awesome stay
allReviews.text: I cannot believe I am giving this hotel a five star rating. The reason being I had called and cussed out Hotwire because I had booked a hot rate not knowing it was the Trump. I was totally wrong please believe the hype it is clean and better than expected. The only negative is that it is not really on the strip. I love that it is non smoking and that it does not have a casino. The rooms are clean and huge. I gotta tell you I have no problem with Trump I just wanted to be on the strip but I am happy that we stayed here. Kudos to the staff who are always friendly.

allReviews.title: Incredible Stay
allReviews.text: I will only stay at Trump International Hotel Las Vegas when in Vegas. I was very impressed with how professional the entire staff is and the incredible environment. I enjoyed every minute of my stay and will be back soon!

allReviews.title: Very high end hotel.
allReviews.text: Enjoyed it overall. Top high end hotel. Fashion Show mall across the street. About 5-10 min walk to Treasure Island (for location). No casino, but I wanted that. The rooms are HUGE, clean and the staff friendly.

allReviews.title: Wow, what a treat in Las Vegas without the casino and smoke?!
allReviews.text: Wow!  What an incredible hotel and service. Best views in Las Vegas. Our very own @trumplasvegas !  Brian and his team are here to serve you with the highest hospitality. Well done!  Don’t forget to check out the spa and the fitness areas as they are very nice.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: Good facilities, friendly staff, delicious food. Good location, away from the noise of "The Strip".                                                                                   We loved it.

allReviews.title: Make Hotels Great Again
allReviews.text: We stayed at the Trump International hotel for one night as a way of varying our stay in Vegas. This hotel is much taller than many of the other hotels in the area and our room was located over 55 floors up, which gave incredible views of the strip and surrounding areas. There are rooms even higher than ours. Must be amazing views higher up. The hotel is cheaper than others located nearby but is still meant to be high quality.Check in was quick and simple. The two young men working at the check in desk were friendly and helpful. All other staff we met and spoke with were great and helpful too. The lobby is really very clean and beautiful looking. It made a nice change to not have to walk through a crowded and smokey casino to get around as this place doesn't seem to have a casino at all, which is fine for me. The location is a bit further up from the strip and takes about 10 minutes to walk to the top end of the strip where the casino hotels are. This would be a lovely hotel anywhere in the world. It stands out a bit in Vegas for not having shows, a casino etc depsite being very close to the strip. But that was fine for us. It has a pool, gym, restaurants etc so it was still very good.Our room was huge and spacious. The bed was great. The room had so many cupboards and drawers. I have never seen this in a hotel before. It appears that these rooms can be purchased as apartments so that would also explain the small kitchen included. No cooking items are provided but these are available on request.We had a fridge provided that was empty so this is a nice change to being filled with expensive minibar items that no one ever seems to buy. The bathroom was also enourmous with a huge jacuzzi bath tub. The provided toiletries were very nice also.Sadly, it wasn't all positive though.The furniture in the room was dated and quite badly scuffed etc.The A/C inlet was dusty and in need of a clean (see photo)We were provided with two small clear plastic cups (the style and size you would normally give to children) for any and all drinks we might have. No mugs or glassware. I don't remember having this in any other hotel, ever. This can't be good for the environment either, to have to throw away more plastic. An in room coffee machine was provided with a paper style takeaway cup and lid. This seemed like a great idea for those who wanted to start their day with a free drink when they go out. But we had only been given one cup and two lids. So this hadn't been checked properly.The views were affected by filthy windows which didn't appear to have been cleaned for some time.The soundproofing to other rooms seemed fine but to outside was shocking. As well as general noise that could be heard clearly, I was woken by a train going past at 0100hrs despite being nearly 60 floors above it and several hundred metres away. I could also hear police sirens which I could see were coming from the strip - again, some distance away.The bathroom had mould on the ceiling (photo) and also mould in the silicone around the shower cubicle.Under the bed was filthy with a thick layer of dust (photo), despite it being a high bed and it would be easy to clean underneath.The ironing board was broken and very dirty (photo)The toilet roll holder was broken and couldn't really stay in the position it was meant to be in.The shower didn't drain properly so when I went to have my shower, some hours after my partner, the first thing that happens is I step into her cold and stale water from earlier. In general, the whole room could do with a clean / refresh. Many of these issues could easily be rectified. I would consider staying here again in the future. But right now, this is not a 5 star hotel experience as advertised.

allReviews.title: Stay through hotel,not HGV
allReviews.text: Enjoyed 4 nights at the Hilton Grand Vacation Club at the Trump.  Lovely hotel, appreciate the location, kitchenette and bottled water.  Very friendly security.  Also appreciate that ride share is at main entrance.  Not many food options in the hotel but across the street from Fashion Show Mall and a 10 minute walk to Resorts World.  The negative for us I think was from being a guest through HGV.  No daily housekeeping but we could get a room refresh with clean towels and more water.  We called every morning before we left to request one and every evening when we returned, no one had been there.  The last night we had to call again twice over an hour after 11:00 pm.  Not sure why these calls go into a black hole.  I would certainly stay here again but only through the hotel and not through HGV.

allReviews.title: Nice
allReviews.text: Nice hotel and being across from the mall with a tween made it all the better! I would say again, it was a nice stay. The rooms are very nice, we had a studio which has a kitchenette, microwave, and refrigerator.

allReviews.title: Nice place to stay
allReviews.text: I had a good time while staying at the trump. Really don’t have any complaints. Any issues that we had, they took care of them. It was kinda cold so unfortunately we couldn’t experience the pool but everything else was cool. Just note that trump name is everywhere. 🤣

allReviews.title: Fantastic stay in Vegas: highly recommend!
allReviews.text: Absolutely fantastic room- super clean, spacious, gorgeous spa-like bathroom. Free convenient valet parking. Courteous staff. Nice pool area and workout room. No casino, no smoking makes it a quieter alternative to the main hotels on the strip. Close to everything but not too close. Comfortable bed, great room appointment and amenities (coffee, microwave, safe, toiletries etc). We are picky about hotels and this was top notch

allReviews.title: Nice decor but not clean
allReviews.text: Arrived to a great looking building with lovely décor. lovely welcome from Ian on reception.On arriving at the room the carpet edge all around the room had not been hoovered for years under the bed was the same. The kitchenette had no utensils or cutlery you had to request them from reception. The restaurant did not meet the level of the hotel looked more like a cafe.

allReviews.title: Great Value for a Real 5* Hotel
allReviews.text: I loved this hotel from the moment I got inIt is valet only parking and it can get very busy in the hotel drive way. But, I see these valet guys really running to cope. They deserve a TIP and they are very thankful. You need to plan for 15 minutes wait till they bring you back your car. But I was very happy with their service and it is FREEThis is not a typical Las Vegas hotel with huge lobby and gambling halls. The hotel has no gambling and no smoking. It is a quiet, safe and family friendly hotel. Yet you are 10 minutes walk to the Strip where you see all the action.Check in was very easy, I was offered a room upgrade to be facing south looking at the strip for $25, on 57th floor, I took it. The north facing mountain view is also nice if your room is high enough (above 40th)The room was very nice, clean and well maintained. The little kitchenet was very handy in heating our left-over take away food. The housekeeping did provide everything we requested. It would take them 45-60 minutes, but this is OK for a hotel of this size.The room is very large and well furnished, the bathroom is Huge, but I would have loved a bidet toilet. The bed mattress was perfect  and the room has good noise insulation. I could not hear any noise from the other rooms. Of course, there is some noise from police cars, and the train but nothing really bad Right across the street there is a nice high end mall (Fashion Show), where you will find one convivence store ABC. I did buy some beverages and sandwiches before our drive to Zion National Park. This mall has a lovely Italian gourmet restaurant Maggiano's and a high end grill among many other fast food restaurants

allReviews.title: 3 Nighter
allReviews.text: Great hotel in a quieter, off strip location. You can see it from most points on the strip so easily located. We walked through Fashion Show Mall or got an Uber so easy to get to the action. Lobby big and well marshalled. DJT restaurant was available all day with great service and delicious food on offer. There's a gift shop selling Trump tat as well as drinks and snacks. There's a 'to go' collect or room service menu option which was well worth it.  Entry to the elevators is via key card and security.  Room was massive on 23rd floor with a side view of West Vegas to the Red Rock Mountains. Pretty impressive despite not being the premium strip view. The bed was huge, the kitchenette wasn't used, the coffee machine and fridge were. Free bottled water too. Safe in the room was in a bottom drawer but was also free. Bathroom was also big with toilet and walk in shower in adjacent cubicles and a deep jacuzzi bath. No cleaning over the 3 night stay but not biggie. Check out trouble free. Only real downer was the train 'toots' whilst going through the level crossing towards the freeway. Not much they can do about that really so it didn't detract from the stayAlthough Vegas wasn't for us we did very much like the hotel but if you want the strip action then pick an appropriately located one.

allReviews.title: Great Hotel, Great Staff
allReviews.text: It was a little expensive and not in a perfect location, but the Trump International is an outstanding hotel.  Super clean, large modern rooms.  All hotel amenities are very convenient.  Excellent gym, highly efficient (free!) valet parking, and the best hotel staff in Vegas.  The hotel is off the strip but we never paid more than $10 for an Uber ride anywhere.  Highly recommended.

allReviews.title: Exceeded all my expectations!!!!
allReviews.text: The hotel totally exceeded my expectations. The check in staff were very welcoming, the lobby is clean and  was excited about free valet parking. Yes!!!! Free valet parking in LasVegas!. The rooms are clean and spacious. The decor is nice. Loved having a fridge, microwave,coffee maker, stove top. extra pillows,sheets and blankets. They have Cooking utensils available upon request as per the sign in the room.  Seating area with a couch & table are a great addition. The bathroom is amazing. The shower is wonderful. The fashion show mall is right across the street. Gift shop & restaurant in the lobby.  The only negative was the uncomfortable bed.. overall it’s a wonderful non casino smoke free hotel and loved the short walk from lobby to hotel elevators. The hallways smell good. I enjoyed my stay here.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Hotel with Amazing Staff
allReviews.text: Hotel has everything you need but a casino. 100% smoke free, pet friendly. They have great buffet breakfast, fantastic food and bar, pool, spa, and gym. Friendly staff, walking distance to the strip and shopping!

allReviews.title: Trump Tower Las Vegas

allReviews.title: From wow to oh no! Could have been better...
allReviews.text: We checked in on Christmas day  at 7pm and had to be moved twice from Rm  5622, 5811 and finally 5411. The problem has always been the broken sofa bed. When we saw the first suite, we all said wow!  Very spacious living room, with dining area,  kitchen  and the master's bath was really something .Then came the broken sofa bed and the wait for room transfers and I thought Trump hotel just messed up our Christmas. And to think we booked for five nights.Talked with Jenna on Dec 26 and asked whom I can speak to about customer satisfaction. She's a good front desk staff, so patient and sympathetic, Told Jenna about our experience and  moving forward, January 1st is around the corner and I don't want future guests' holiday to go wrong. If sofa beds are a problem, please tell your housekeeping to check on them now. I mentioned to the housekeeper last night if she can coordinate with Front Desk for some complimentary drinks like soda to cool us down and she said  "no we don't do that" but offered water. I did tell her to mention it to Front desk. The Trump brand is synonymous with excellence and that reply was a disappointment with regards to customer satisfaction. I did suggest to Jenna that in the future, a plate of cookies or any of those small gestures will probably calm down an inconvenienced guest. I eventually sent an email to the Front Desk Manager Jake Jacobsen who apologized on the room changes and offered to provide us a couple of soda in the fridge.Tuesday morning, I  requested Jake  for  a desk clock for the bedroom  and for the room to be  serviced. The housekeeper came in the afternoon and gave us  a bag of toiletries, coffee pods and sugar and towels for the next couple of days. I figured there will be no housekeeping for the rest of our stay.  ( It's a good thing I brought disinfectant wipes so I wiped  the toilets seats) . When the housekeeper handed me the clock she said, they have tested it and it's working, I concluded that the problem in this hotel is the Housekeeping.  They should have checked all  sofa beds are functioning,  curtain rods are in place, supplies are adequate for the number of guests registered. If there are three guests, shouldn't there be three complimentary water bottles and cups?  Don't say no instead say,  " let me see what I can do about it".On the positive side, the front desk ( Jenna and Julia) were all very nice and gracious. The checker before you go  to the elevator was also nice. The valet staff were all very friendly.  Even the security who came to our room to get a statement from my son after he suffered a cut in the gym was very nice and helpful .  We liked that the lobby is so close to the elevators, smoke free. Getting food in the mall was convenient.This was our first stay in a Trump hotel  with so much expectations, but five nights  in a 1 bedroom suite with no housekeeping? It could have been better for a brand known for excellence.  Unfortunately,  I cannot recommend the hotel right now.

allReviews.title: Never more!!!!! Stay away
