allReviews.text: The Valet service was the best everyday! Those guys /gals really responded quickly to get the cars in and out! The hotel maid service could of emptied the trash every other day after a 5night stay. That was disgusting.

allReviews.title: Nice pet friendly hotel in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: We stayed with our dog. The hotel is beautiful, room is clean and spacious, and dining is yum and pretty reasonable price compared to other Las Vegas hotels. We could walk to Wynn, Venetian, and Fashion Show mall in August. We’ll stay again.

allReviews.title: ALMOST 5*
allReviews.text: Everything was perfect except for the sofa bed, very springy and looks old. The staff were great again except for one by the elevator, acting like in a military field, lol. U can be strict but nice and kind

allReviews.title: Family vacation
allReviews.text: Very nice hotel with a friendly staff, close to the strip. The only complaint that we had was that there was no room service between day one and two. The coffe was filled up immediately once we called the front desk

allReviews.title: Without my recommendation
allReviews.text: We are staying in this hotel, we were travelling all day and nobody made up our room, then when we went for a dinner I called and asked for making up our room, so they just dropped towels on the table… terrible and ridiculous performance… no dressing gowns in the room…

allReviews.title: Great location and hotel
allReviews.text: Great little spot if you want to be close to the strip but away from all the noise. It was very peaceful and relaxing by the pool and the hotel is right across from fashion show mall so you have access to my choice if you enjoy shopping and quick bite to eat . Overall great experience and would stay there again. I wish you could call down ahead of time fro valet parking instead of waiting around in the hot sun for your car but parking attendants where really great and tried there best to move quickly in such a busy environment.

allReviews.title: Enjoyed the size of the guest suit and bath
allReviews.text: We visited for vacation and stayed at the property already 4 times at least, returning again. It's located in convenient place close to the Fashion Show and Strip, Wynn etc. I like the idea that there is no casino there and as a result - no crowd and no smoking inside of the building. This is a kids and pet friendly hotel. This year they extended hours for dining and we were able to dine when arrived really late. Also bar is available until 12 am or even later.  We usually take corner suite, it has 1 large bedroom and guest room, panoramic views from all rooms, full kitchen and 2 full baths, 1 is in master bedroom and it has a huge bath with 2 sinks, large shower and huge bath tub where you can enjoy the view from it to the Strip, we easily fit together with tall husband. We also tried SPA with massage, facials etc in Trump's hotel and were pleased with the experience. And not the last thing for me also - quality of sleep, the master bed has good quality mattress and pillows, you literally do not hear neibours, thanks to the soundproof walls (it's my guess). Strongly recommend for the peaceful and enjoyable stay to everyone, couples, families. dogs etc.

allReviews.title: Great first impression
allReviews.text: Great first impression when we walked into the room. Plenty of room for 4 adults. Check-in was swift although we weren’t sure where to go when we pulled up as there were many cars in the entrance. Swimming pool experience was wonderful.

allReviews.title: Ok but dusty and missing the spark
allReviews.text: We stayed at the 59th floor with an amazing view on the city and desert (not on the strip). Rooms are very spacy and also bathroom is very spacious. Beds are very comfortable. The room includes a small kitchen. However, there was quite some dust on the room and in the cupboards. Also the additional 'spark' which could be expected from a 5 star Trump hotel was missing. No bath ropes in the room available, no pens or slippers available. What a missed opportunity. In combination with the Trump logo on amenities (logo was nowhere found in the room) this would have given it a luxury experience. Late check-out was not available at this hotel.

allReviews.title: All gold everything!
allReviews.text: The trump hotel is upscale, quality and the staff are all tremendously helpful and professional.  The room was cozy and traversing the building couldn't have been easier.  Loved the pool side feels and amount of people were all within a comfortable level.  Ol Number 45 always keeping it classy!

allReviews.title: Worst Experience Ever
allReviews.text: I had one of the worst experiences while staying in a hotel.I booked my stay for 4 (my wife along with my old parents) for one night (8/6). The room which I booked had a double bed and a sofa bed as we needed 4 people to sleep.When I tried opening the sofa bed at night, it did not work and I called room service. After waiting for 20 mins, they came with a pillow and bed sheet. The staff told me the sofa bed is broken and he would get me a roller bed. I waited another 30 mins, then I received a call from the front desk saying there is no roller bed as well and they are fully booked. Basically I was told to somehow manage and the front desk told me they would take off resort fees. My wife and I could not sleep even when we tried sleeping on the floor. On top of that, when we tried putting the bed sheet which we got from room service, even that was torn. After all these mishaps, the front desk has the audacity to charge me completely for my stay and just take off resort fees? This is highly unacceptable and I demand a complete refund of my stay.From my experience of being a business traveler for a long period, I can confidently tell this is a very serious mishandling of a reservation.

allReviews.title: Terrible expierence at Trump Las Vegas Hotel
allReviews.text: The corner one-bedroom suite spelled like sewage, the carpet was old and dirty, the trains blow their horns all night when they go by the hotel (obviously not Trump lovers), and the spotlights that shine on the hotel at night light up the rooms.  Terrible hotel... and I used to stay their in years past, but never again.

allReviews.title: Amazing, super clean the front of the House staff was super attentive.
allReviews.text: Security was on point, loved the valet parking as well.  The pool vibe was relaxing and all the staff was professional and observant if your needs as a guest.  The best part is having the feeling of Vegas without the Casino crowd when you need to rest.

allReviews.title: Great Place to Stay!
allReviews.text: We upgraded to a suite and glad we did.  Great view! Beautiful room, with a bathroom as big as my home bath, toilet area and shower combined.  Bed was very comfortable.  We were on the 47th floor, and each room has small air vents on the window ledge, which I suppose are for air pressure during a storm.  It rained several times while we were there…something we have never seen in LV, and the windows whistled some, but not bad and not for any prolonged period of time.  There was some signs of wear on the carpet between the bedroom and living room, but nothing to turn us off..The staff is great! You can hear the pool and noise from the strip on that side of the building, which faces the Strip, but it’s not bad, Make sure you have extra cash for tips, as they don’t stock the kitchens with anything and you need to order stuff.  We are so use to traveling with our bank cards, but they have a teller downstairs.  The hotel is directly across from the Fashion Mall, and Nordstroms, so you just walk across the crosswalk to it.  Very convenient!  The staff was excellent, the new items added to the menu were lovely..try the fish and chips!  We will stay there again.

allReviews.title: Rooms and service at the level you would expect of #45, Donald Trump.
allReviews.text: From the parking Valet to the Desk Staff to the Housekeepers to the Restaurant Personnel, this Hotel was like a finely tuned machine, with every part perfectly in sync. So, it's not right on the strip. This is Las Vegas and it's close enough without being in the middle of the craziness. So, it doesn't have a casino in the middle of the lobby. Thank you very much for that one, sir. We loved it and will be back again.

allReviews.title: No customer service ethic
allReviews.text: Yes it was somewhere to rest but the lack of customer service ethic was profound. No-one to offer help with luggage. At check in i received no guidance on where the room or lifts were and had to ask. Having booked for 3 people there was only one bed in the room and when i called to ask for the extra bed to be made up i was told it’d be a one hour wait (not great with a tired daughter after long uk flight). Then room service did come but they literally dropped two pillows and some sheets on the coffee table and walked out - they didn’t offer to even make the bed up. On day 2 when i called at 4pm to ask when the room would be made, the staff member said they ordinarily don’t clean rooms daily but could put in a request for me! Definitely not the Vegas experience we hoped for. Thankfully a great Canyon experience and show at Bellagio helped compensate for a really poor Trump International experience

allReviews.title: Filthy Carpets!
allReviews.text: Seriously? This is Trump Hotel. Why are the carpets, especially in the elevators and hallways, and even my 1st room...dirty. Not acceptable.Also the valet service is free. That's great. But when I have to wait 35 minutes to get my car from one of them...not great. My vacation was waiting! Hire more people please.

allReviews.title: Don’t Bother
allReviews.text: The show valve came off in our hands, the air conditioner made a high-pitched squealing noise constantly and never actually cooled the room. The hook was missing off the back of the bathroom door. The Wi-Fi was so slow, I couldn’t even check email. I complained and the lady on the phone told me I could upgrade the Wi-Fi I was already paying 40 bucks a night for. The gym was small and did not have a good variety of machines. And, as usual, the “valet” parking is a complete disaster. We will NEVER return.

allReviews.title: Vegas Getaway
allReviews.text: Nice hotel!  Comfortable, clean and quiet.  Good breakfast but pricey.  Staff is friendly and helpful.  Valet takes 15-20 minutes to get car.  It’s valet only.  10-15 minute walk to Encore, Wynn and Venetian.  Across from Fashion Mall which is a good short cut to strip.  Will be Back!

allReviews.title: Trump International Hotel
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel with amazing amenities and great customer service. The rooms are spacious and very comfortable and the pool/spa was so relaxing. We will definitely stay again our next trip to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Best hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: Stayed here for 1 night after travelling around California. As soon as you walk into the lobby you feel relieved to not be surrounded by a casino floor. Everything is immaculate. Staff are friendly and efficient. Rooms are big and clean. Pool area has a really nice vibe. Feels more upmarket than the rest of the hotels in Vegas and the clientel are sober. Also the hotel doesn't smell of cannabis like most of the others.

allReviews.title: Honest review
allReviews.text: I was there on 08/01/22 to 08/04/22 and all was good and I had a nice stay with my friends until I checked out and forget my new sneakers at the room 4217, I came back a couple hours after and they let me look at the room, there was nothing , the room was already clean and they say there was nothing in the room, I was pretty sure that the shoes where there , I can’t believe that this happen to me in a TRUMP HOTEL, the shoes were expensive they even ask me for a purchase receipt that I already sent them , anyways I will never go back to this hotel that’s for sure , can’t believe they made me change my mind just for a pair of shoes

allReviews.title: Absolutely recommendable!
allReviews.text: We travelled to Vegas making it the end of our family road trip. Nice experience, price quality is guaranteed! Spacious and comfortable rooms. Finally a Hotel with sufficient seats around the pool! Would book Trump Int again without hesitation.

allReviews.title: Best Hotel in Vegas
allReviews.text: Huge rooms, super clean, full-size products, plenty of large towels, great internet. Free valet parking.  Nice pool!Full kitchen with nice coffee maker and great coffee!Free internetreally nice place to stay!

allReviews.title: NOT STAY IN HERE
allReviews.text: The service is terrible, the rooms are old, and the hotel walk to the strip is far and dangeorus, also the service from the people in here is the worst, rude people and fees they neverk ask you for paying

allReviews.title: You have to make your own bed
allReviews.text: This is billed as a luxury hotel. I have stayed in many luxury hotels but have never had to make my own bed. On returning to our room on day one, the room had not been made up, towels replaced and coffee and milk replenished. I called house keeping and they informed me that rooms were only made up and cleaned every three days!! Seriously!, this is not mentioned on the website, reception do not tell you when you check in and it is not on the information sheet that reception issue.

allReviews.title: Wonderful
allReviews.text: The hotel is in a good location, we were happy that there wasn’t a casino inside, the hotel is pristine and the customer service was fast and friendly.The rooms are big and super clean.We used the pool and the gym and it was very nice, excellent to bring your family and a have a break from the overwhelming outside.

allReviews.title: Amazing stay with great views of the strip!
allReviews.text: Right off the strip.  No smoking. No casino. Quiet adult focused stay with super clean rooms and amazing views of the strip if you opt for that.  Beds were SUPER comfortable.  Huge jetted tubs were great after a long day of work. Staff is amazing and super friendly and helpful. Great places to eat are nearby if you do not eat here.  Rides in and out of the hotel are super easy and available.  A friend recommended this place and it definitely did NOT disappoint! We will stay here from now on when in Vegas.  Truly awesome!!

allReviews.title: Staying with the Trumpster
allReviews.text: It’s a great place to stay. A casino is a short walk from the hotel if you want to gamble. The pool and outdoor jacuzzi was very nice. Plus they  are dog friendly. We will definitely stay again while in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Customer Experience
allReviews.text: I would love to recognize DISHA. She made us feel at home. Overall it was a great experience. The hotel did not smell of cigs, the staff were inviting, and the valet was very speedy & consistent. I love the drop off/ pick up system valet has going on. The pillows were amazing & the room was pretty sound proof.

allReviews.title: Las Vegas / Trump
allReviews.text: Very Good Hotel with large e clean rooms. Good location few steps from  the Strip. Pool is ok but not very big. Car valet for free is fantastic. In front of a new commercial center: No Casino inside and no shops.

allReviews.title: Great for families!
allReviews.text: Rooms are spacious and family friendly, our room had a nice kitchen.  This is a great place to stay on the Vegas strip if you are traveling with children.  Very safe, very easy to get in and out of, great pool for young kids.

allReviews.title: Excelent
allReviews.text: Very clean , the staff were very courteous and loved to help . The hotel location was great . right in front of the Large fashion mall . staff were exceptional. the food was fresh and was brought to the table quickly

allReviews.title: Pleasure
allReviews.text: It was absolutely beautiful loved every bit the bathroom in the hotel room was Devine and the restaurant in the trump hotel was very yummy good food too I just wish the pool was deeper then 4ft that is my one and only complaint

allReviews.title: Old, yellowish, smelly pillow, blanket
allReviews.text: I was first very impress with valet parking, room size come with mini kitchen, nice clean bathroom.  However, they need to replace yellowish smelly pillow and blanket or at least wash them!  We booked two room, after requesting to exchange clean pillow for the first room, we found out blanket of the second room is so dirty and smell, we have to sleep with the smell the first night.  Even wr request room to be refresh before we left hotel the second day, we came back after midnight and saw towel thrown on counter, shampoo, soap, toilet paper, water all put in plastic bag and left on floor by bathroom door.  This was very bad experience staying here!

allReviews.title: Amazing as always
allReviews.text: This hotel is the only place we stay in Vegas. Rooms are so big and beautiful, staff is all so happy and we love there isn’t a casino filled with smoke. We keep coming back! Only a short walk to the strip.

allReviews.title: Bad service
allReviews.text: Never had such a bad experience. They never cleaned our room and we stayed for 5 days. They didn’t even tell us they weren’t coming to clean the room. They just stayed away. Then we staye 2 more days and were promised a specific room. And when we got down in the morning. Suddenly the room weren’t available. And then he filled me a lie about the room was broken. But we saw other people stay in the room instead. I felt so sad. Why lie. I will never come back.

allReviews.title: Terrible Service
allReviews.text: Great disappointment.They changed the room booked, gave no alternative, claiming that the Hotel was crowded, my 2 adult children had to sleep on the sofa bed, nor extra bed was offered to us.Besides, we didn't have room service, a shame. Reception staff were arrogant and unwilling to help, lousy service.Restaurant options is very poor and slow service, the meal was ok.We do not recommend Trump International Las Vegas

allReviews.title: Trump Las Vegas Needs Improvement
allReviews.text: We had stayed at Trump Las Vegas in the past and had very good experience and room cleanliness.  Upon checking in at 2:45PM we were told that our room was not ready and will be ready in 1/2 hour to 45 min.  We wait for 40 minutes without receiving a text that our room would be ready.  Upon checking in with the front desk we were told that our room was ready.  We had booked at corner room with strip view.  The room definitely had odor as if some one had used the room, but was not cleaned.  We asked for a different room, but was told that it would be on a much lower floor.  We ended up upgrading by paying a lot more for a higher floor room.  Room cleaning services didn't always replenish all items such as coffee, clean cups, and coffee stirrers daily.  We stayed in a Presidential Suite!  Definitely much improvements are needed.  We have recently stayed at the Trump Waikiki and definitely there is a huge gap between both of these hotels.  The Waikiki facility was more superior in all regards.

allReviews.title: Close, but No Cigar...
allReviews.text: First:  Not a "bad" place to stay, let's get that up front.Room:  That said, my room was large, nicely furnished and had a great view of the Strip; yet, the furniture was a bit threadbare ~ The bath area was quite nice though the shower control was a bit finicky and getting a good mixture took a bit of getting used to; not a big deal...Arrival:  to put it bluntly, and I'm betting you've heard this previously, the "all valet" parking is a disaster ~ The valet crew were running their butts off and trying to provide the best service they could; they were polite and responsive ~ It's the system/plan which needs overhaul ~ Arriving vehicles stack literally into the street and guests wait~n~wonder; that's not good ~ Vehicles brought out of the parking garage add to the confusion and the delays; again, not good ~ I am literally surprised no one has been hit by an errant vehicle ~ I'm not a parking engineer, hence what do I know; I'd suggest, though, this issue be studied toward the end guests self park, as is common on the Strip, or avail themselves of the valet.Issue:  I hit the road for a day trip only to come back and find my room had not been serviced ~ When I went to dinner, I advised the desk clerk who apologized and said she'd send someone up ~ When I returned, no service had been done ~ "A" or "B"; "A" signals got crossed which happens but doesn't make a good impression; or, "B" it's Trump policy rooms are serviced only at end~of~stay to prep for new arrivals [I hate this, but it is what it is...] ~ In that case, the clerk flat out lied to me rather than advising me of the policy; that not good...Departure:  I went to the concierge desk and to speak with the on~duty manager and, after getting grilled as to why, and advising I'd speak to the manager about that, I was pointed to an area and told to wait ~ And wait i did for a few minutes, asked again and was told he was "on the phone" and told to continue waiting which I did for a few more minutes; maybe ten (10) minutes in total ~ No manager appeared whereupon I left not a happy camper.Bottom Line:  These are fixable issues; again, not a "bad" experience, but certainly not up to Trump standards.

allReviews.title: Family Fun In Vegas
allReviews.text: We stayed in a twin Queen room as a family of four with two children (10 & 12) for 3 nights. The room was large with a kitchenette and fridge which was perfect for our jet lagged needs of needing to eat at random times. The bathroom was enormous, with the toilet and shower separated from the main bathroom area in their own compartment accessed by dividing doors. There was also a gigantic bath with massage jets that could easily fit 3 people!We found the hotel to be spotlessly clean and that it always smelled fresh.We made use of the gym and the staff were perfectly happy for children to use the equipment under supervision which made a refreshing change to other places.The pool area was also clean and family friendly with children allowed to play with pool toys/ balls all day. The pool is open 7am -9pm which was great unless there are strong winds in which case it can be closed. We ordered food from the pool menu and found it to be very reasonably priced for a 5* hotel and also of really good quality. Would definitely recommend this hotel and especially to those travelling with children as there is no casino here and it is a no smoking hotel. Although the hotel is not on the strip itself, you can walk to the strip through the shopping mall that is directly across the road from the hotel.

allReviews.title: A great choice.
allReviews.text: Having been to Vegas before, I knew the location of this hotel (difficult not to miss a gold tower block stuck out on its' own) This is an easy walk to the strip (Wynn/Venetian are 5 minutes or so) either straight down the road or through the Fashion Show Mall. The hotel does not have a casino, so doesn't attract hordes of tourists, which is a distinct plus point.A nice pool area with great staff and the staff generally were very pleasant and helpful.Apart from the outside of the building, there is very little "bling" in the hotel, compared with the other main hotels on the strip. The rooms and corridors are spacious and well cleaned/serviced. Water flow in the shower was only just adequate, which was a shame in a nice large shower area, but water is something of scarce resource in Vegas! The hotel was generally quiet during the evening/night.I only ate breakfast in the hotel, but what I had was fine with an adequate choice.Security staff checking access to the lifts makes you feel secure.I asked for a cab to the airport, but was taken in one of the "Trump" registered limos. Very nice, but wasn't sure if people thought I was a celebrity or a legitimate target!There is a very noisy train track behind the hotel. The track has multiple road crossings, so the engines sound their bull horns almost continuously when passing. The trains are very long, sometimes pulled by three locomotives, so the noise of the trucks can go on for up to 5 minutes. They pass by both during the day and night.Overall a great choice and will return.

allReviews.title: First Class
allReviews.text: Everything was First Class! Check In Process was smooth and easy! Loved how they had someone monitoring who had access to elevators. The dining option had a great assortment and priced perfectly. Everything was extremely clean! Bathroom was a great size. Bedding was comfortable

allReviews.title: Best Hotel
allReviews.text: I loved the bathroom and spacious room and the view is amazing in our room (city view). Valet parking only. If you are driving Tesla, they’ll need the key. And put it on valet mode if you wish. Would stay there again definitely!

allReviews.title: Trump Hotel
allReviews.text: All the hotel was clean and lovely, I booked two rooms for my family and they put us four floors apart and it required us taking two different sets of elevators and we couldn’t share any toiletries or items etc. since I have children on this trip this was very disappointing. The staff at the front desk made no attempt to help remedy the situation.The positive side is it had a very nice upscale bathroom and a lovely view of the strip which was gorgeous in the evening. Well it was clean and luxurious, I’ve had better service at the comfort suites.There’s no self parking option, so you also must wait for complimentary valet parking which can take 15 to 30 minutes and is also a bit of a nuisance.

allReviews.title: Best hotel
allReviews.text: We travel pretty much. This hotel was the best. Not expensive and a really 5 star hotel. I can’t complain of anything. Rooms were really good. Jacuzzi worked perfectly. Beds comfy all clean. We came for one night and stayed 3.

allReviews.title: Perfect hotel neer the strip
allReviews.text: Perfect hotel neer the strip, very goed service and without all the people from a casino, vallet parking works verry good, room was on 34 and the other time on 59. Both with room to the strip, it was a perfect place to stay for some days with my family

allReviews.title: Trump delivers a great hotel experience
allReviews.text: The hotel was everything you expect with the Trump name. Excellence. Staff was friendly and great. Room was very spacious and clean. Beds were so comfortable I didn't want get out of it in the morning.

allReviews.title: Honest review!!!!
allReviews.text: First time staying at Trump and would definitely stay there again. Pet friendly, clean, location and price in that order. Pet price was the best in Vegas hotels, I looked at them all. They even surprised us with treats for the puppies!! We ate at the hotel twice. Burger and French dip sandwich-Great!! Chicken sandwich and salad could’ve been better.

allReviews.title: Great View of the City
allReviews.text: We arrived about 1:30 in the afternoon. Even though check-in time was scheduled for 3:00. They had a a room available. Check-up was fast and friendly.The view was spectacular on the mountain side of the hotel.  The room spacious came with a cooktop, microwave, large mini- refrigerator, walk-in shower, and spa tub. There are two options for breakfast. The first option is a small coffee bar near the elevators. This bar had coffee, breakfast sandwiches and assorted pastries. The other option is the full-service restaurant.                                 Had the eggs benedict with smoke salmon and diced potatoes.  Both the bar and restaurant food were hot and fresh.The hotel was Pet-Friendly.  There is no casino at this hotel.  Which was a nice quite change of pace.

allReviews.title: Fantastic room with great view on the Strip
allReviews.text: We booked a suite for my wife and myself and a standard room for the children. Both were adjacent on the 59th floor with a fantastic view on the Strip. The suite was very spacious, which allowed us to spend a great evening with the children, dinner in the room, playing cards with an amazing view.Great experience !

allReviews.title: No Housekeeping
allReviews.text: If you stay more than one night, do not expect housekeeping... When calling reception: "this is our new policy. No housekeeping". Yes but you don't advertise it anywhere: "yes I understand. But sorry, that's it"... 5-star hotel ?And no room service. App is not working. When calling: "you have to come downstairs".Trump... what a lie.

allReviews.title: Meh.
allReviews.text: This property is 3-star. Very average, especially when compared to other Vegas choices (Wynn, Venetian, Aria, Cosmopolitan, etcetc). And if you like not having a casino, the Vdara is more upscale. Plus things are not what they seem here; whenever I thought something was marble, gold, or granite, I looked closely and found plastic and imitation. Whenever I really “took a look under the hood” all the furniture and furnishings throughout the property was cheap and cheaply made. I guess it’s worth it if it’s under $150 per night. Pretty blah stay.

allReviews.title: dripping spa faucet
allReviews.text: Never fixed.  Called on it 3 days never sent anyone up to fix.  Ended up with water all over bathroom.  Never offered to change our room and it was on bedroom carpet.  No dishes or silverware in the kitchen.  Had to call for a robe, extra blankets.  We rented 2 rooms with one upgrade.  They moved our room to be on the same floor as our. second room with our daughters.  Did not happen, different floors.

allReviews.title: Cost-Effective Hotel
allReviews.text: Excellent service and staff, all areas clean, comfortable beds and rooms with kitchenette.  They accepted pets in all areas.  Free valet parking 24 hrs. Prices are goods. They made us feel valued.Great Experience!!!

allReviews.title: Trains Trains Trains
allReviews.text: I’m only giving 3 stars because of the train noise and because our key had issues 3 x where security had to reset the lock which took a lot of time and aggravation.  Otherwise the room was very spacious and comfortable. Humongous bathroom! The train horn noise was ridiculous, 230am, 430am, do they really need to make such a loud noise? If you are a light sleeper I would suggest staying elsewhere. The pool was very nice, nothing special compared to other resorts in Vegas, but good service for drinks! Wish I could recall our server’s name as he was fabulous. The gym is also very nice. Skip the restaurants if you can, they are pricey! $8 for apple juice! Starbucks is in the Fashion Mall right across the street as is many other restaurants

allReviews.title: Room with a View
allReviews.text: Awesome hotel and better yet NO casinos!  Also, the staff couldn't be more accommodating!  It is child and pet friendly which we were not totally happy about but seriously, was not an issue.  We will stay here again.

allReviews.title: Classy
allReviews.text: One of the best hotel stay’s we’ve ever had. Exceeded our expectations. Stellar staff. If your going to stay at a hotel without a casino in Las Vegas I would definitely choose this one. A very memorable experience.

allReviews.title: near railway
allReviews.text: room near railway so noise during night if not pay extra to upgrade to room facing street. kitchen in room but no any cooking wares. valet parking sometimes cause problem l, I have to wait 30 minutes cause they could not find my car even I have the parking number.

allReviews.title: Great Experience
allReviews.text: I had a great experience….. just Nothing to complain. The room was beautiful , the staff was great and the quality of the room wasImpressive. I enjoyed the beautiful shower and the views of the strip of Las Vegas from my room.

allReviews.title: Great stay at the quiet end of the Strip
allReviews.text: The Trump took great care of us, didn't charge for parking and the staff was awesome. Being right across from the fashion mall, yet far away from the noise of the Strip was perfect for us. When we come back to Vegas, we'll stay again.

allReviews.title: Great hotel just off the strip
allReviews.text: Big contrast here between the Trump Hotel we had left in Miami Beach and the next day we arrive in Las Vegas - this was a quality hotel, great staff, great rooms, great pool staff who were on duty before I arrived at 7am to swim. Its a little of the strip so be prepared for a little bit of a walk but compared to the Virgin hotel we stayed at in Vegas later in our trip this was a small walk and very well located hotel with Fashion Show Mall 30 steps across the road which was great. Would thoroughly recommend this hotel, lived up to the expectation of the brand!

allReviews.title: Vegas or Bust
allReviews.text: Great hotel. Marble tile and real porcelain sinks, jacuzzi tub, separate large marble shower. Large apartment luxury style design. I gave 3 stars for location, but it is not the fault of the hotel. Unless those on the boar support liberal candidates and their policies. Vegas is at a fork in the road of either going towards the way of Portland and Seattle or towards the way of Florida. Choose wisely.

allReviews.title: disappointed
allReviews.text: I took my spa staff to a conference in Las Vegas and used hotwire to score a 5 star hotel deal.  We were excited to stay at Trump International.  We went to the pool at 4  on Saturday night and there weren't enough "free" chairs for the 5 of us.  They charge $50 a chair if there aren't enough free ones and this pool isn't big enough to seat its guest for the size of the hotel.  They also closed the pool at 5:30 every night which seemed ridiculous to me.  To just use the sauna was $30 a day because it was inside the spa.  When we got home there was an additional $500 of charges on my card.  I called and was told there were resort fees for the extra amentities...I explained we couldn't use the pool or sauna and they didn't care.  I also left a new Apple charger in the room and called before I took off on a plane.  I filled out all paperwork and never received it in the mail.  This is the first hotel that's  not returned something to me.  We won't stay at  a Trump hotel in the future because of the poor service.  The $21 hamburger was the best part of our stay!

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: Stayed for 2 night in this beautiful hotel. Yes, it’s off strip and away from a lot of attractions, but couldn’t resist trying it. We had tickets to see Jimmy Buffett at MGM and what a great show Jimmy put on.Service was amazing. Friendly staff. DJT had lots of options at affordable prices. Pool was beautiful. This hotel completely changed my outlook and lives up to a higher standard. I would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Tub is to die for!
allReviews.text: Truly enjoyed my stay at this unit. It has everything I need including the mini kitchen. The staff was gracious enough to provide me with what I need, since the cleaning for my unit is after 4 days of stay. I wished they cleaned it daily, but I guess that is the rule for this type of timeshare accomodation.

allReviews.title: Disappointing
allReviews.text: The bed was extremely firm & very uncomfortable. The jets in my tub wouldn't work for most of our stay. The room service was bad. They forgot our drinks & cutlery so our food got cold waiting. The suite has a kitchen but no dishes are provided. The woman who answered the phone to fix our room service issues seemed irritated with me instead of apologetic that I just spent $100 on a cold meal. The pool was nice & the elevators are super fast to get up to the top floors. I don't plan on staying again but I think they can do better with the right staff changes.

allReviews.title: Great hotel!
allReviews.text: Service was amazing. Friendly staff. DJT had lots of options at affordable prices. Location is great. Pool was beautiful. This hotel completely changed my outlook and lives up to a higher standard. I would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Traveling for vacation
allReviews.text: The best hotel experience at Las Vegas I would like recommend this Hotel with excellent costumer service and delicious food and very quiet compared with others with casinos inside .The best hotel if you are traveling with family

allReviews.title: Pampered Stay
allReviews.text: First class from the time we arrived-until the morning that we left. It didn't matter who they were....what job they had.....what position they had achieved......everyone bent over backwards to please us and wait on us. So very impressive-especially today. We were there 8 days and enjoyed everyone. Not necessarily Vegas.....but the Trump Hotel. Sadly, we left the day before President Trump arrived. Hated that. Probably won't go back to Vegas...but will surely look for more Trump properties. He never does anything halfway. Thank you, Marsha Nordyke

allReviews.title: Awesome
allReviews.text: The room was spacious and comfortable. The ability to cook something to eat to break up eating hotel food all day was nice. The bathtub was a perfect addition to relax my mind and body. The staff were kind and helpful. Overall the hotel was quiet and peaceful. Awesome experience.

allReviews.title: Unfortunately more Cons than Pros
allReviews.text: This is a very nice Hotel, but too many cons to give it more than 3 stars.We visited as a family and these are the pros and cons.Pros: Great rooms, Not too crowded, Good Attitude, Close to the Mall.Cons: Location (You need a car or a cab. Either way it'll cost you at least $60 each time you leave, and it's huge time consuming), Proximity to adult content (Sits right by all the Gentlemen Clubs, and next door to the Penis Museum), No real room service (They deliver from the only restaurant, and even then until only 10pm).Next time I would stay closer to the strip, away from the Penis Museum, and won't have to pay over $100 a day to leave the hotel.

allReviews.title: Frequent Vegas Vacations
allReviews.text: I go to Vegas at least once a year using my timeshare points. This was the first time staying at Trump Hotel under RCI exchange program. The hotel is set back a little ways from the strip but is directly across from Fashion Show mall if you need some retail therapy. Valet service is free, just make sure you go down there about 15 minutes before you need to leave so you won't be late to your destination. Had a view of the strip on 33rd floor, room was near the end of the hallway (#142). Overall, the hotel was quiet, a few instances where you can hear the train (as others had mentioned), but it did not bother me. Wifi was good, used it for school twice during the stay. Rooms were large, nice bathrooms (two showerheads in the master bath). Only negative was one showerhead had a fluctuation of temperature, where it would alternate from cold to hot, and back to cold, so I just used the other showerhead...no issues there. I used the kitchen appliances to cook a few meals which was not bad. I did have to go out and buy a frying pan, potholder, and some utensils to help with making meals....maybe they have an option to borrow the items at front desk, but we never asked. I just took the frying pan and other stuff I purchased and brought them home with me.

allReviews.title: One of the Best Hotels I've Ever Stayed in
allReviews.text: Trump International Hotel has truely been one of the best hotels I've ever stayed in. From the outside the hotel is truely buetiful, and the inside is no exeption. The Food in the restraunt was absolutly wonderful. We stayed on the 59th floor and our room was VERY nice, including a huge shower and luxury jet tub. The room had every little detail you could imagine like, personal robes and slippers, and a curved screen TV so you can see it better. Our room also had a great veiw of all of Vegas especialy at night. The fitness center was nice with many workout options and nice eqiuptment. The pool could be cooler seeing some of the others in Vegas, but it was cool because it was on a platform above the entrance, so it was elevated of the ground. But out of all of these things one I loved the most. The staff and employees. Every employee we met was very friendly and helpful, from front desk, restraunt, store, and everywhere else. The location is good with a short travel to everything there is in Vegas. Before we left we stopped at the gift shop and bought two pairs of Trump slippers, a chocolate bar in the shape of a gold bar that says Trump on top, and a refrigerator magnet of Trump's Boeing 757. Trump International Hotel was truely a great stay and I highly recomend staying, especialy because of the amazing staff.

allReviews.title: Weekend get away
allReviews.text: Hotel is within walking distance to the Vegas Strip. Yet it was far enough that it was calm and family friendly. Best of all, rooms were comfortable and spacious. The gym is overlooking the pool area and is well equipped with weights,ellipticals, and treadmills. The staff was also very friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: Incredible First Stay
allReviews.text: After a long road trip we decided to treat ourselves to a few nights at Trump International.  So glad we did.  All of the employees were courteous and respectful.  Our king suite was on the 47th floor with city views, and complete with living space, small kitchenette, bathroom with double sinks, jacuzzi tub and large shower.  Comfortable bed and well maintained furnishings.  Fashion Mall is across the street.  We had lunch at the restaurant, and as others have stated the menu is somewhat limited but the portions certainly are not.  We hope to stay here again.

allReviews.title: Great experience
allReviews.text: The hotel was amazing would stay next time we visit . All areas are easy and the room we had you could see the strip . Room is laid out well and a kitchen if needed . Bath and shower . Staff all very willing to help

allReviews.title: July 2022 trip
allReviews.text: We had the best time at this hotel.  The service is first class and very affordable.  We had a great time at the pool and Ernest, our server was the best.  We will be staying here every time we will go to Vegas.

allReviews.title: TOP TOP TOP TOP TOP
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel, very elegant and very Rock 🎧. The staff is amazing and really welcome. Very Middle East standards. You have valet, they will take care of you from check in to the check out. All very very very kind and very professional.  Very clean and full of amazing amenities. The restaurant and the cocktail bar just WOW. Last things, we met and saw Mr. Trump, which was in Vegas for a political event.

allReviews.title: Perfect, clean, quiet (kinda), spacious, convenient
allReviews.text: Rooms clean. Check in was quick and professional by Leo. Staff always greets you when you come by lobby. no noisy casino floor. clean pool area with Corntoss game, grills, shade or sun. pool table inside. we stayed in north tower. Flamingo GO pool did have lots of music bass during day but i napped through it. mornings and evenings were quiet. monorail and big red bus tour, and complementary parking garage all within in 5 min walk.  1/2 block from strip. Ballys shopping site and CVS and Linq promenade within 10 min walk. one of best RCI exchanges i have stayed at. They did not ask you to take garbage out to garbage chute or strip beds or do dishes like others do sometimes (we did though). We have 3 teenager's and each had there own bed in 2 bedroom unit. will stay again. Only petty suggestion would be to take a pressure washer to parking garage steps.

allReviews.title: Surprising let-down if staying longer than 1 night…
allReviews.text: Stayed here pre Covid and was truly 5 star hotel. Post Covid, standards have slipped. If staying longer than 1 night - rooms are NOT serviced daily & we were not advised at time of booking nor at checkin. After a long day out in 109degree heat a fresh room and towels are always a plus but sadly not here any more. Need to ask for service & housekeeping seem not to please about it as photos will show.  Restaurant menu is very limited. I think it’s time they invested in USB ports in the room also. It’s the small things that make the lasting impression & for this trip they’ve dropped the ball. Not sure I’d come back to this hotel again despite the draw card being that it’s non-smoking

allReviews.title: Imperfect stayed the second time
allReviews.text: The reason of returning to Trump International was the convenient to the Strip with the shuttle bus. Disappointed to find out the shuttle bus was no longer available due to COVID. The assigned unit has ;ot of noises from the passing train.

allReviews.title: King Suite is a great value
allReviews.text: The Trump's King Suite is the way to go if you want a spacious, clean, well-appointed and quiet place to stay in Vegas. It's a short walk to The Strip. Every staff person at the Trump was friendly & courteous. Unheard of these days. Housekeeping stocked the kitchen with everything we requested at no extra charge. County ordinance prevents them from stocking in advance. The pool & staff were wonderful. Would definitely recommend  the Trump.

allReviews.title: Horrible management - not responding appropriately to strong Marijuana smell in room
allReviews.text: I am truly disappointed in the Trump hotel at Las Vegas. I stayed there with my family including an infant and a toddler and their grandmother during the July 4th weekend 7/1 to 7/4 on our vacation with hopes for a relaxing trip. It was anything but due to our unit reeking of a strong Marijuana smoke smell.We were exhausted after a Saturday out seeing different hotels on the strip and were quite surprised by the extreme unpleasant marijuana odor that hit us in the face when we opened our door. I understand marijuana is legal in the state but this is supposed to be a SMOKE FREE hotel and should have been enforced. We are sensitive to the odor and soon developed a headache and sore throat and could not tolerate being in the room. We contacted the front desk and talked to the manager who stated there were no other rooms in our room type (a 2 bedroom lockout consisting of a 1 bedroom and a studio suite in the same unit). This was extremely frustrating as there were other 1 bedroom and even 2 bedroom suites available on their website! The best he could offer us is to spray the unit with fragrance or downgrade us to a studio room. He stated that he could give us a $75 room credit and get us a new room the following day. We were frustrated about the situation but were tired and decided to see if the febreeze would help. It took 3 calls and over an hour before a housekeeper came to the room and just sprayed multiple puffs of their house febreeze mix which did nothing to cover up the marijuana smell!. Due to the strong smell even after the febreeze we all had to squeeze into the studio unit for the night as the smell was mainly in the 1 bedroom unit and it was already close to midnight.On the morning of Sunday 7/3, around 9:30am we asked the front desk about the new room. They said they had no idea about this and had to talk to the on-shift manager and they said as they had no rooms available at the time, but that it would be for sure ready by 4pm and to check back then. We packed all our belongings in anticipation for this room change and came back at 5pm that day to find out that the room was not reserved for us and there was no room available. I couldn’t believe that they didn’t reserve the room switch for us! We asked to speak to the manager on duty, who was Josh, and he said that he didn’t know about the request for a new room. We expressed our frustration. Apparently, the day and evening managers and the front desk staff don’t communicate! We were obviously very frustrated with the lack of management and them being unable to accommodate us as promised. Josh said that he couldn’t change rooms as there was none in our type, and that he could only downgrade us to a studio unit – even though again, on the website, there were 2 bedrooms in the hotel. This is poor management service as they had space to accommodate! He verbally said he would give us two $75 credits for all the inconvenience which would be a total of $150. We were unhappy  with the situation but agreed to getting credit again. So, we suffered through another night with our room smelling like marijuana and couldn't even sleep in the room that we paid for.The next day we AGAIN, were blindsided on checkout as they had only given us 1 of the 2 $75 credits we were promised on our room. We spoke to the day manager (Jacob) and asked about the situation, which I patiently explained. After looking at our room charge file, he was very rude saying there’s nothing he could do for us, specifically saying he wasn’t the one who promised the 2nd $75 credit. I asked him if he had the ability to add the 2nd $75 credit as a manager and said that he could add the $75 credit but wouldn’t because he inferred we could be lying just to get more credit. Do NOT expect any type of quality service at this hotel. Management will promise you one thing and NOT deliver. And when questioned, make us look like we are the liars! We wouldn’t have ordered breakfast at the hotel if we didn’t have a room credit! It’s like adding insult to injury! And worst of all, if you are ok with exposing your little ones to marijuana smoke and the hotel management do little to nothing, then this is the hotel for you.

allReviews.title: An oasis
allReviews.text: All class, clean, treated well, and loved the freshness of the lobby-no smokey casino to navigate through to get to rooms. Always an Uber within 1 minute. Loved the food in the restaurant and the Trump Vineyards Chardonnay. Will definitely stay again.

Overall good experience - hotel and the personnel were excellent - expect the older pool "boy" who selected who to serve - he selected who is served by him, his service doesn't belong to Trump hotel.Room was not cleaned every day which was a surprise

allReviews.title: Top Notch!
allReviews.text: Incredible experience at an amazing hotel. The staff are incredibly friendly, polite and eager to help. The room was immaculate and spacious. The pool-side drinks were tasty and the bar tender was very friendly. It was our first time trying out a Trump hotel and we were shocked at how incredible the experience was. The room was reasonably-priced compared to nearby Vegas hotels but the quality and cleanliness was astounding.I can say that when we travel again and need a hotel, we know where we’ll want to stay.

allReviews.title: Very nice hotel just off the strip.
allReviews.text: Clean rooms, friendly staff and the lack of a casino makes this an attractive getaway. It is a great hotel for families who can come and go without having to deal with crowded casinos and bars to get in and out.

allReviews.title: Classy Trump
allReviews.text: Everything was very classy. Really enjoyed our stay. I was really impressed on the service and all the little extra amenities. It was like everything was above and beyond what was to be expected. Loved it.

allReviews.title: Stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: Nice to stay in a hotel and not a casino close to the strip.  The fact that we didn’t have to walk thru a casino and cigarette smoke was a extra for me.  Room service was the fastest I have ever experienced.   Rooms were nice and staff was always helpful.

allReviews.title: Excellency
allReviews.text: I had an early arrival 830am I was at the hotel and they checked me in anyway no questions asked and no extra fees, that was awesome. The staff was excellent, at the restaurant, the pool good services.

allReviews.title: Great Experience!
allReviews.text: Always great when we stay at the Trump! Easy to check into the hotel. We love the valet parking. The pool is very nice, not amazing, but nice. Rooms are always clean, conveniently located near many popular things in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Family vacation
allReviews.text: Pros: easy check in, room big with kitchen. Great for families. Cons: no housekeeping services for 5 nights unless you call. No one told us this on check in. Pool and fitness center closed at 7pm. No one told us this at check in. No signs posted with hours. Kicked out of fitness center by rude employee. Charged full resort fee. Full staff at pool standing around talking to each other.  No one offered food or drinks at pool. Had to get out and order inside. Pool opened at 7am with blaring loud music that woke us up. Food and drink menu limited, expensive, and not very good.

allReviews.title: Clean, quiet, no hidden fees
allReviews.text: Very nice option for your stay in Las Vegas. Quiet - there is no casino downstairs. Free valet parking and no hidden fees like there usually are in some other neighbor hotels. Nice restaurant on the first floor. Great stuff, fast elevators, rooms are very good and clean

allReviews.title: Great experience!
allReviews.text: The hotel is very beautiful, we checked in earlier with no extra charge. The customer service was really great, the room was very clean with lots of closet space, amazing restaurant, the food was excellent!

allReviews.title: Trump hotel doesn't trump some of the others
allReviews.text: While this hotel was very nice looking and at first blush, is beautiful in all appearances, the missing part was the small details.  Surprisingly, a hotel owned by a man who's all about services and details, doesn't have it.  There were stupid things overlooked in our room, that basically were housekeeping issues.  To begin with, hotel provides "kitchen area" facilities in the rooms, sink, stove, microwave, refridgerator, etc.  They also provide bottle of water free...all great.  However, because of "COVID", they have signs up that say they don't provide any of the equipment needed to cook...no pans, no dishes, no cups, etc.  You have to call and ask for any of that.  No toaster etc, nothing that you could really use for breakfast or whatever.  They could've at least put paper goods.  Coffee provided but maybe two paper cups, no stirrers, supplies were short.  The blowdryer in the bathroom was filthy and dusty, phone in our room was filthy, dusty.  Valet service provided for your vehicle was a nightmare, not enough staff to work it.  Driveway was always full of cars, you had to wait almost 25 minutes if you were going anywhere and needed your car, so you need to account for that wait (think reservations).  Only one restaurant in the hotel and definitely not for kids.  Hours are short as well, should be a 24/7 operation but probably can't get staff like most of the other hotels.  When I called housekeeping about the blowdryer and told them about room cleaning, they did clean the room when I left, but guess what, forgot to bring me a blowdryer.  Also my ice bucket disappeared and I had to call down for that.  I stayed for 4 days, my room was only cleaned twice.  Apparently, they don't clean on a daily basis, but forgot to mention that.  We were gone all day and came back to a dirty room, that we needed our trash removed and fresh towels.  I had to call down for those so we could shower after a long day in the heat.  Swimming pool closes at 7 p.m. and we had young children with us.  Why is a pool closing that early in the evening?  Hotel is a little off the beaten path, you would be better served staying at something on the strip and save some money with parking at hotels and attractions.  Almost all of them charge $15 to park for a minimum of 1-4 hours, more money spent.  Also, be aware that marijuana is legal in Las Vegas and it is EVERYWHERE.  Smell is overwhelming in the streets and if you bring young children, it's not a good thing.  Good luck!

allReviews.title: Excellent Service!
allReviews.text: Service, cleanliness, free parking, reasonable rate in Vegas all A+  We felt safe, comfortable as home, which is sooo important on vacation. Would definitely stay again! Never saw so much cleaning going on all the time. Spotless!

allReviews.title: Clean and peaceful
allReviews.text: The staff was helpful and quick to respond to requests. The establishment is clean and quiet and I appreciated being on the Strip without having to pass through a casino to get to my room. The location is perfect for attending conventions and having access to entertainment.

allReviews.title: Vegas Trump make a hotel great again first
allReviews.text: I haven't received an amazing service. I had to request all the time what I need in my room, like another bar of soap, bathrobe, shampoo, cups and coffee  and cleaning services. I was felling like I need to write down a list for request and  explain people in hotel how to work. By the way I got to Vegas for my Birthday party the first time of my life and i did not receive any greeting from hotel even a card. This hotel is extremely boring, I guess for business people or who coming in Vegas for work and conference probably is ok. I would say we must do a Trump Hotel make great again and after a whole America.  Why i choose this hotel , because a name Trump - but I did a mistake with hotel.

allReviews.title: Best Non-Casino Resort in Vegas.
allReviews.text: This has got to be one of the best non-casino hotels in Vegas. It is quiet and relaxing as soon as you walk through the doors as opposed to the noisy and crowd filled casino hotels. Its in a great location at the top of the strip right opposite the Wynn an across the road from the shopping mall. The staff were fantastic. The rooms were spacious, very clean and luxurious. The restaurant was lovely and the pool area is very relaxing with ample seating and food/beverage selections. Would definitely stay here again. Best resort in Vegas.

allReviews.title: Perfect Non-Casino Hotel
allReviews.text: We loved everything about this hotel. It does not have a casino, so it is more quiet than most. But it’s still within walking distance of attractions on the strip. The studio room was very large and included a kitchenette. Room service was delivered quickly and was always delicious. The pool was fabulous with many covered beds available for a $50 minimum food/drink charge. We also liked the extra layer of security they had with an attendant checking key cards at the elevators. Would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Great hotel
allReviews.text: Excellent hotel right off the strip most locations are well within walking distance.  Great mall right across the street from the hotel.  Pool area is great and the gym / fitness room is a great setup.  Trump towers is a great hotel.

allReviews.title: Best hotel in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: I have been to Las Vegas several times and had free rooms on almost every trip. I also had free room offers for this trip but decided to pay for my stay at the Trump Hotel and I am glad I did. Everything from booking to check out was awesome. This was one of my best trips to Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Don’t ask for late check out even if you checked in 10 hours late.
allReviews.text: Checked in 10 hours late due to flight.  Requested a late check out.. was offered 69 min no more.  He actually said we’d have to pay for an entire day if we needed more than an hour.  The room was nice and it’s next door to a great mall.  The strip isn’t too far but not really within walking distance.  Overall nice trip with valet parking too.  Really wish the late checkout was more reasonable considering the circumstances.

allReviews.title: Recent stay at The Trump International Hotel
allReviews.text: Excellent location and outstanding facilities and service. Would stay here again. Very suitable for families. There is no casino onsite which we preferred but the hotel is very proximal to access the main strip

allReviews.title: Stay at Trump Tower
allReviews.text: From the time I checked in to the time I checked out. My check in and out was quick and easy. My stay was incredible. The hotel is very luxurious. My room was nice and spacious. Any time I needed anything, resort services sent it right to me. If I had any questions they were answered. Due to them having valet, my car was safe and didn't have to worry about anything happening to it while staying there. When I needed my car it was less than a 5 minute wait for valet to bring me my car. All hotel staff was responsive and attentive during my stay.

allReviews.title: 24 hrs to relax
allReviews.text: We had several things to take care of on our trip and only had 24 hrs for fun. Trump International definitely came through for us. We had the best time! We will absolutely stay again and make this our destination

allReviews.title: Had a great visit
allReviews.text: Trump International Hotel was a great experience. We don't gamble so it was nice to have a hotel just off the strip that was not dark, dingy, and full of smoke. The hotel was bright, clean, and the service was exceptional. We will stay there again when we return. -Calder

allReviews.title: What a wonderful place to stay.
allReviews.text: If you are looking for a place where the casino is right in your face, this is it. Casino's are mere minutes away and shopping is across the way. Trump also provides in room dining and rooms with kitchenettes so you don't have to rely on restaurants or fast food.

allReviews.title: A below 3 star experience
allReviews.text: Hotel does not qualify as a 5 star. Just one restaurant with limited service. No buffet. Very slow service. Rooms are NOT CLEANED everyday. Takes a long time to get your car back during checkout. Avoidable properly. It is off the strip and has none of the attractions of the other hotels.

allReviews.title: Trump International, need I say more?
allReviews.text: Great location at the end of the strip with great city and strip views. Valet parking and extra large rooms and bathrooms. There is a full kitchen set up with cooktop, sink and fridge. Tons of storage if your planning on moving....lol ... Will be back again.

allReviews.title: trump international
allReviews.text: everyone very helpful and friendly and hotel and pool were immaculate . did not have any issues at all. everything went smooth with check in and check out. only thing i thought could have been better was the work out area

allReviews.title: Weekend Getaway
allReviews.text: Casual Atmosphere. Excellent Service. Close to the strip and restaurants. The fact that there is no casino in this hotel is a bonus. Check in was fast and easy. It has a very nice pool area. Drinks were a little expensive.

allReviews.title: Trump International Hotel Las Vegas
allReviews.text: One of a life time experiences at the trump hotelyou like president trump and want to be treated like king and queen, then this hotel is for you. Friendly and professional staff. The price is reasonable. We stayed on the 63rd floor in a presidential suite!!! It’s 1500 square feet!!!! I have to run around in the suite all day. It’s so big!!!

allReviews.title: Great room poor service
allReviews.text: Service poor - we had to request bedding and make up one of our own beds, no assistance offered for our 5 cases, room serviced only once in 3 night stay. The suite was well appointed with great views. This property is possibly more suited to longer more residential stays.

allReviews.title: New favourite
allReviews.text: Stayed here for 4 nights June 13-17. Loved it. In the front doors and up the elevator in seconds, no casino to wander through to get to elevators. Prompt check in with one person ahead of us in line. Very reasonable upgrade to a huge suite with 2 bathrooms, full size fridge, comfy sectional, dining room table. Close to the Strip, Fashion Show Mall, Wynn/Encore. I did hear a train during the night, lovely wife slept right through it tho. I'm a light sleeper.  Very friendly staff. Security at elevator asks for room card to prove you're a guest. Felt very safe. Housekeeping each day too. Very well done, Folks.

allReviews.title: Ok if you want away from the strip
allReviews.text: Nice hotel, we chose it for the location so we would be just out of the strip madness and it did the job.I would say this hotel is geared more to business trips, it certainly lacks the wow factor you get in the other hotels. Pool area  is pretty basic and the pool  bar feels more like a cafeOnly the one bar in the lobby, again didn’t look too appealing so we never tried it.The room was lovely, we did get one vey dirty towel left for us and a door handle hanging off the cupboards, only highlighting this to lower expectations of what you are gettingIt is cheaper than most other places but easy to see why when you get there I would stay at the Wynn if I came to Vegas again

allReviews.title: business travel
allReviews.text: excellent staying with fast and reliable services. Room are well kept, breakfast service is super with a 10 minutes avarage time of waiting and good quality of food. I will suggest it for every business trip

allReviews.title: Great Hotel
allReviews.text: First class hotel & service. The full kitchens are great for a family vacation. Nice not to have a casino within the hotel but close enough to the strip to allow you to play.  The valet service is great. No worry about parking.

allReviews.title: First Time Trump Stay
allReviews.text: Excellent experience from the moment we checked in to the departure. First class customer service.Enjoyed a few perks for booking direct.Fantastic experience at the pool. No crowds, plenty of seats and very good service from the people working the pool. Most definitely will stay again at the Trump Tower again.

allReviews.title: Perfect for business and personsl
allReviews.text: Wonderful hotel. Rooms were large and with full kitchen. Good pool and spa services and food at restaurant was excellent (great burger). If you can live without a casino on-premise no better place in Vegas

allReviews.title: Best in Vegas
allReviews.text: I travel for business. Free valet. Free bottles of water. Great staff, great bar. You're foolish to stay anywhere else. Try it. I bet your stay will be excellent. Try the smoky old fashioned. Best drink.

allReviews.title: Wonderful stay without the Casino Crowds
allReviews.text: The hotel is beautiful. Every employee was very welcoming and friendly. The pool was a bit chilly, but the desert sun warmed us right up. Walking to the strip is easy from here. Didn't eat at the restaurant.

allReviews.title: A phenomenal view from my penthouse suite!
allReviews.text: I had a very pleasant stay at this hotel.  The one-bedroom penthouse suite I booked for two nights was outstanding!  I had a view which literally went straight down the Strip, and with the ceiling to floor windows, the lights from the city and the Strip were amazing to see at night.  I'm not a great fan of valet parking, but the service was smooth, and the drivers were all very pleasant.  I liked the fact that the hotel is within a short walk of the Strip, yet not directly on the Strip.  Other reviews mention the sound of the trains running by the hotel to be annoying, but this was not a problem for me at all.  I actually enjoy hearing the sound of trains!  This was my first time to stay here, and I would definitely be interested in staying here again.

allReviews.title: Worst hotel manager We have ever encountered. Room was not done during one of the days. Room smelled of cigar smoke.
allReviews.text: Worst hotel manager We have ever encountered. Room was not done during one of the days. Room smelled of cigar smoke.

allReviews.title: Terrible service - Rude employees
allReviews.text: We booked a suite for 5 nights and paid the obligatory resort fee.  No where during the booking process or at checkin with (rudest agent ) had we been advised that you must beg to have your room serviced by housekeeping!  I have spent the past hour being hung up on and getting the run around in an attempt to obtain basic Motel 6 service!  Absolutely shocked this resort does not even offer basic housekeeping service.  The front office will not even provide with the name of the general manager!  I am truly disappointed with Trump International in Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Choose carefully!
allReviews.text: Was an overall disappointment.  Restaurant closed too early for being in a Vegas hotel.  No room service, no booklet of information for alternate food opportunities or general Vegas activities or shows. Nasty stains on drapes.  Nothing special here as far as amenities. The bed and room were clean otherwise.  But lets be honest that's expected at any nicer hotel.  There are so many options in Vegas.  I recommend  choosing another.

allReviews.title: This has always been our favorite in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Spacious room, great location for our needs, excellent staff that always rates 5 stars.  My wife and I have stayed here several times and have never had a problem.  The valet parking service is excellent. An enjoyable experience and stay. We even brought our friends along this time and they were impressed. Highly recommended.  I wish other hotels would take lessons from here.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Holiday
allReviews.text: Great holiday at the Trump. Highly recommend. Wonderful room, hotel and pool area. 8 minute walk to the Strip and 2 minute walk to Fashion Show Mall. We did not use the restaurant at all as the menus were not to our taste but we did eat at the Pool most days and the meals were great!! We will be back very soon

allReviews.title: Terrible room service
allReviews.text: Keep in mind Vegas is hot, staying on this hotel will be inconvenient if you want to go and walk. The hotel is far away from the most popular places. Terrible room service. I was told they are short staff, reason for which the room was not made for the past 2 days. Attached a picture of what they brought me, once I requested to have my room clean. They did not event bother to pick up the used towels IF YOU ARE SHORT STAFF, YOU CANNOT CHARGE FULL PRICE FOR A SERVICE YOU ARE NOT ABLE TO PROVIDE. Also carpets in the hallway are old, dirty with bad smell. A/c does not work properly, room is always hot. Spend your money in a better place. We request a meal to the room, and it was brought in a paper bag, like if I were ordering from McDonnals. I paid for a premium suit, and end up that the room does not even have bath robs, even thought it has a kitchen, they do not provide any dinning wear. They told me I had to request it. I did and they never send it. Hopefully this kind of reviews help the company to improve their service.

allReviews.title: Truly a 5 Star Experience
allReviews.text: Your treated like an exclusive at Trump. Regardless of skin color believe it or not. The only place to stay on the strip. I feel a little dirty sometimes staying at a smoke filled casino on the strip.

allReviews.title: Great stay
allReviews.text: Great stay wonderful customer service very clean. Pool was relaxing not crowded room was bigger than I thought and tub was very nice! View was amazing. Customer service was great, check out was super easy.

allReviews.title: Great!
allReviews.text: Staff is friendly. The pool is great! It’s not too busy. The food and beverage is delicious. The menu is designed well. The hotel is far from the strip, which provides some relief from the hustle.Thanks for a fantastic stay.

allReviews.title: Awesome Hotel
allReviews.text: The Trump Hotel was fabulous!  It was a great place to relax and refresh after being out and about.  Any time I return to Vegas,  I will be staying in the Trump Hotel.  The staff were very respectful and efficient.

allReviews.title: Family Road trip
allReviews.text: We stayed here for two nights on a cross country trip from TN to the Grand Canyon. I chose this hotel for the great reviews I'd read and because it was close to the Strip, but not right on it. We enjoyed our stay. Rooms are a bit dated, but very spacious. We noticed a coffee stirrer on the floor, but it wasn't worth a call to front desk. They do charge a resort fee, but the valet parking is required and "free." We were with our kids and not interested in being out late. That being said, I have never been to a hotel where the gym closed at 7:00 pm.

allReviews.title: Not a classy hotel anymore
allReviews.text: I adore the Trump brand, and would have liked to write a better review. Having had a fantastic stay a few years ago at the Trump Waikiki, my expectations were high. First the good: Staff were friendly and responsive. The hotel has hired some great people. Location was good, because I enjoy going to the mall across the street and the Wynn a short walk away. Uber pickups were a breeze, as they were allowed to pick up right in front of the building. I appreciated the security at the elevators always checking you had an active key card, and the pool area was nice. The negatives included very worn out furnishings in the 1-bedroom suite. Scratches would have been easy to cover, but no effort had been made. Curtains had multiple visible dark stains. The carpet had a huge black stain next to the bed. A large tile in the shower was loose and dislodged - a real hazard I did not notice right away. No dishes or utensils in the kitchen, which made it unusable! They could ask as part of check-in if stocking it was desired. No housekeeping services for 3 days, and I paid cash for the stay. No robe and slippers. Bath amenities were of poor quality - not the Spa at Trump quality I had experienced at the Hawaii location. I was given two shower gels and a conditioner in the master shower, but luckily could get a shampoo from my other bathroom. Sloppy work. Lamp shades were dirty and bent. No glass tumblers in the bathrooms, only disposable plastic cups. Hair dryer was cheap and dirty. Prices were very high at the restaurants: over $20 for chicken wings and $25 for a pina colada in a plastic cup. I don’t mind the high prices, it’s just that they did not reflect the otherwise economy class of the hotel. Not sure why the Trump Organization allows the hotel to go downhill like this. It surely was a beautiful property once, and could be restored to its former glory. One morning music started blasting at the Trump pool at 5am and woke me up. Pool does not even open before 7! The loud music played until 5:45am, at which point it was turned off. It was very odd. I knew music could occasionally be heard from the neighboring Resorts World, but I did not expect it to be played at the hotel pool at 5am.

allReviews.title: In decline
allReviews.text: My wife and I decided to celebrate our June birthdays at Trump, having experienced wonderful service and amenities during our previous stays. This time was different. Upon arrival, we were met by a cheerless, almost listless front desk attendant who, when we mentioned the reason for our stay, responded by saying nothing, absolutely nothing. Then she assigned us a room which was not what we had reserved. We discovered that AFTER entering the room. Returing to the lobby and after dealing with a rather defensive response from her adamant manager, we were then given the room size we had reserved. What did we notice during this most recent stay? First, the hotel no longer offers shuttle service to the Forum Shops. No reason given. No newspapers either. Fewer staff. A new key card reader which must be swiped before going to your room each time, ensuring that your every move is recorded for posterity, a true invasion of privacy. Since we were staying as part of a Hilton Hotel package, no housekeeping services were provided. And last night, when we requested additional toiletries and while we were taking showers someone from the hotel actually came into the room without our permission and left the items on the table. If there was no answer from the guests after ringing the bell several times, the package should have been left AT THE DOOR, no excuses!!! This intrusion was unacceptable. At checkout, apart from releasing a good sum of money back to the credit card, no gesture of thanks was offered. The memories of staying at a classy hotel where the principles of a warm welcome, anticipation of needs, and a fond farewell, hallmarks of the former Ritz  Carlton before the Marriott purge, were not rekindled at Trump and it's rather sad to see the decline. And 4 dollars for a single banana, 8 dollars for a muffin from the food cart in the lobby, well, that's just outrageous and stupid. You can and should do better.

allReviews.title: Fabulous
allReviews.text: Stayed at this hotel for a week. I was really impressed, from the moment we arrived it was pure class. The lobby is impressive and elegant, the rooms were huge, the pool had great chilled vibes. I prefer to stay in a hotel without a casino in vegas so this was perfect. I felt secure and safe the whole time as they have 24hour person only allowing guests in to the elevators. If I was to say a negative it was a little bit back from the strip so maybe a little too far to walk for some aside from that it is a top class hotel in my opinion.

allReviews.title: No 5* experience
allReviews.text: Had a spacious 1 bedroom suite on the 46th floor, great bed, grand bathroom especially enjoyed the jacuzzi tub, kitchen with subzero fridge, top notch toiletries.  Security officer on the spot. Hotel never feels overcrowded. Great pool area with comfortable lounge chairs and free flavoured water. Hardly any children during our stay (always a plus for us). About 10 minutes walking distance from the strip, mall right across the street (cheap foodcourt there). Liked the Trump gift shop in the hotel.Class casino-free hotel, but what took away from the 5* experience:- had a prepaid reservation, but they double charged our credit card. They refunded me quickly after informing them, but no apology whatsoever was made- could have paid more attention to the fact that we were there for our 13th wedding anniversary, travelling from way overseas- no housekeeping during our entire 3 night stay- no bathrobes nor slippers available- overpriced food; 7$ for a croissant pastry is simply over the top- view from our room, overlooking the flashy Resorts World and some sort of scrap yard below, took away from the suite experience. Would have appreciated a strip view.- too bad there was no tv in the bathroom- sofa could use replacement- room was noisy from time to time during the day, think it came from the music/daytime club at Resorts World

allReviews.title: Excellent Hotel!
allReviews.text: We loved staying here! And loved how it is slightly tucked away from the madness of the strip yet close enough to enjoy. The hotel security is spot on and everything felt like luxury! The hotel restaurant and bar were top notch.

allReviews.title: The only hotel I will stay in when in Vegas
allReviews.text: Trump Towers has become the only hotel I well stay at when I’m in Vegas visiting family. The staff is phenomenal, it is clean and quiet. No smoking and no loud gambling machines. We love it. We will return again and again.

allReviews.title: false advertising
allReviews.text: no in room dinning had a full suite room with no dishes when asked for dishes got PLASTIC silverware had to ask for more coffee kerege cups everyday even though we asked for 10 the first time and the rooms carpet was stained, chipped paint and the couch was old very disappointing and to top it off when we checked out we agreed to an e-mailed receipt that we never got so i checked my bank account and they were over charging us over 3,000 dollars WTF had to file a claim against them at my bank

allReviews.title: Asphalt runner
