allReviews.text: Will always stay here when In Las Vegas!Upon entering the hotel the fragrance of light floral is in the air. Love it!!Food was flavorful. The service, the staff were friendly and accommodating. Rooms are spacious !

allReviews.title: An oasis of calm off the Strip
allReviews.text: Our stay was not perfect. Rooms were not serviced every day and when we arrived late on our first night, there was nowhere to eat and we had to make up the bed settee ourselves. The bed settee is also not very comfy. We didn’t try and get cutlery or dishes for the kitchen and used the paper and plastic cups provided which felt very cheap and not in-keeping with a luxury suite. However, after extensive research into Vegas hotel options, we chose a corner suite in this hotel as it offered us, travelling as friends, a way of getting a separate bedroom and bathroom each in one room (which also means only one resort fee to pay). We switched mid stay so we each experienced the king bed with enormous en-suite and then the bed settee with the smaller shower room off the kitchen/ living area. Arriving at the hotel each day was lovely as it is smoke free and relatively uncrowded. You have to use your room card to get to the lifts so it feels secure. Wi-Fi is good. The pool is really nice with a mix of families and couples. Basic loungers are free or you get fancier ones if you spend a minimum of $100 on food and drink. Over the road, in the Fashion Show Mall there is an ABC store where you can stock up on wine, beer and soft drinks for the full size fridge in your room. Free water is provided. The mall also has a decent food court for breakfast or snacks.

allReviews.title: Wonderful stay at an elegant 5 star hotel.
allReviews.text: The staff was very helpful and professional. It was an absolute pleasant Experience . Will return.We had great time and enjoyed an exceptionally pleasant stay.  Valet parking and attention was just great.

allReviews.title: Poor service
allReviews.text: Staying at the trump hotel currently for a weekend trip. We loved the trump hotel in Washington so chose to stay here. After being gone 6 hours our room has was not cleaned no big deal- so I called down and room service came up and asked us to put towels and bedding in trash bags for them as they provided replacements. There are no restaurants on site and room service stops early. Compared to the 8 other strip hotels we have stayed at we would not pick this one again

allReviews.title: Poor Experience
allReviews.text: Over priced for an off strip hotel.  Below average service,  it appears that the staff is either overwhelmed or dislike where they work.  Limited dining options with average quality food and service that is over priced.Hotel and rooms were clean, no maid service second day of stay.  Property is in need of updating the whole feel is you stepped back in time to the 90's  to someone's interpretation of what elegance should be.  First time and last time,  I've had much better experiences at the standard on strip hotels.If you're just looking to sleep and don't care what you eat, this hotel might be for you.When I go to Vegas I go for fun, which this place certainly is not.

allReviews.title: The best
allReviews.text: I really enjoyed the stay. Room was large & clean. The room had a Kitchen and 2 bathrooms. It was convenient. The hotel doesn't have shops but Nordstrom was across the street. Strong recommendation!!!

allReviews.title: Great location, nice atmosphere without smoking and casinos gaming
allReviews.text: We have stayed here before and liked the location, the services and the fact it is non-smoking and no casinos.The decor, rooms and services are above par.DJ restaurant has the best French dip sandwich meal I have ever had!!! 😋The pool area is very nice and comfortable. Housekeeping was courteous and did a great job 👏 My one suggestion is they bring back the shuttle to downtown Vegas to save on taxi fares and wait time for a ride.

allReviews.title: 10/10 Stars
allReviews.text: My hubby and I had a great experience at the Trump hotel. It is just slightly off the strip but during the day you can cut through Fashion Show mall for a quick walk to the strip. It is walking distance to planet 13 and what I believe to be the best breakfast in Vegas at La Trece. We were offered a cheaper upgrade on arrival and ended up with a suite with great views of the strip. I wouldn’t recommend getting coffee downstairs in the morning as it is the same price as Starbucks or Coffee Bean which is just inside Fashion show mall.

allReviews.title: Awesome Staff
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel, all the staff are very attentive and nice. It is good not having all the noise from a casino on site. The main lobby is very elegant, looks like a place of royalty. The breakfast, lunch and dinner food is delicious. Heated pool!

allReviews.title: A top-shelf experience
allReviews.text: Staying at the Trump International Las Vegas was an 11 on a 1-10.What separates this property from other hotels is simple: attitude with a smile. From the door greeters, to those staffing the registration desk, to the bartenders, travelers are in for an experience like none other. The rooms are fabulous - and quiet. There's a reason for this: no gaming on the premises keeps the noise level down. The masseuses and masseurs at the Spa are also first-rate. We enjoyed a Swedish massage that was better than anything we'd had before.

allReviews.title: Trump Intl Las Vegas NV
allReviews.text: It is refreshing to come to a hotel in Las Vegas that doesn't have glaring lights, stale odors, and smoke haze hanging in the air. I have stayed here several times now and each visit has been of the most professional and welcoming nature. If you want some real "down" time, this is a good place to do so. The on-site restaurant has courteous staff and well-prepared food to offer also, and its "vibe" invites you to come in. Recommend to all of my friends and family!

allReviews.title: TRUMP HOTEL LV
allReviews.text: Our stay at the TRUMP Hotel was perfect. We were pampered and treated so well.  Recommend for any length of stay and very reasonable on prices. Quality and excellence abound at this five star facility.

allReviews.title: Great staff, nice room, okay amenities
allReviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and well kept. Checking in/out was great, very easy. Our room was spacious and the bathroom was well designed.  It is located across from a mall in case you forgot anything.The fitness center is very lacking. It is tiny and the equipment is dated and not all in good working condition.  The pool is basic.We only stayed one night to see a show at the Wynn. We would definitely stay here again.

allReviews.title: Very nice stay
allReviews.text: Non gaming hotel, a little bit off the strip but quite nice.  Bit of a walk to the strip however.  Right across the street from Fashion Show Mall.  Staff were very accomodating.   Only disadvantage is, you’re not in the center of the action.

allReviews.title: Stress-Free Mini Vacation
allReviews.text: Upon arrival at Trump Int'l Hotel after 5 hours of driving, we were able to breeze-thru the check-in as there was no line presented and it was quick.  This experience reciprocated at check-out as well.  We ate at DJT restaurant for breakfast and dinner and the services as well as the food qualities were excellent!  We enjoyed our French toast and Eggs Benedicts for breakfast and NY & Ribeye steaks for dinner.  Both times, the servers were attentive.  The room was spacious and there is a full kitchen (love this feature) and the bathroom were well stocked. We also visited and hang out at the pool.  It was calm and relaxing and the servers came by to take orders and refill drinks often.

allReviews.title: Travel to Las Vegas for Eagles' concert
allReviews.text: We traveled to Las Vegas for Eagles' concert. We loved our stay at the Trump International Hotel. The room size was fantastic, cleanliness, valet parking, overall service was great, and the rate was the best.

allReviews.title: Wonderful Hotel
allReviews.text: This is a wonderful hotel!!  Everything about this hotel screams luxury.  This is the only place that I would stay in again in Vegas.  Will look for other Trump hotels to stay in for the future.  Incredible views out of the hotel.  Would recommend to stay higher up if you would love to see the strip.

allReviews.title: My Birthday Oasis
allReviews.text: Trump International Hotel-Las Vegas is the place where I celebrate my birthday.The safe and restful ambiance I get when I enter the complex is excellent. I am not a gambler and I do not smoke and travel solo. The location is prime to where ever I desire to go visit. The associates are all equally respectful and attentive.

allReviews.title: First class resort and staff
allReviews.text: Exceptional staff, very nice workout room, pool and spa.   Bed and pillows were so comfortable.   Everyone of the staff was extremely helpful and pleasant.  Nice bar and restaurant.  Located a block off of the strip so quieter setting.  First class resort!

allReviews.title: Just call us loyal Republicans
allReviews.text: We stayed four days at the Trump International as part of a Hilton promotion. The hotel is beautiful, situated about a hundred yards from the Strip, across the street from the Fashion Show Mall. To avoid the heat we would walk to the Strip through the air-conditioned mall. But the large lot next to the hotel is empty, and since the mall closes as early as 8:00 PM on weekdays, we would take an Uber back to the hotel from the Strip, because that hundred yards between the hotel and the Strip is dark at night, deserted and potentially dangerous. Unfortunately the hotel no longer offers shuttle services to the Strip or the airport. Staffing issues, they said. Our room at the hotel was a studio facing the not so scenic north. There is no casino in the hotel so the hotel itself is relatively quiet, but noisy, nearby freight trains late at night would sometimes disturb our sleep.The bathroom contained a tub which could be used as a jacuzzi, but the shower in the tub was not as strong as we like. There is ample closet and drawer space, but the closet had no space to hang full length clothes like my wife's skirts. Though there was no regular room service, the front desk did provide us with coffee and towels when we called for them. The one time we finally did receive room service, on the last day of our stay at our insistence, they did not clean the room, they did not make our bed; they simply brought some more towels and emptied the already overflowing trash cans. But despite the hotel's deficiencies, we would still stay there again if the price was right. Just call us loyal Republicans.

allReviews.title: Elegant/Secured Hotel
allReviews.text: It's perfect for family who doesn't like chaos loudness. Peaceful, clean, housekeeping service is very good and accommodating. The whole experience was amazing.  The restaurant is great... the people are very friendly.

allReviews.title: vegas getaway
allReviews.text: amazing stay at Trump Las Vegas. great service and comfy beds. Location is perfect and smoke free.Great hotel with like minded people who stay there. The pool is exceptional with a nice poolside restaurant

allReviews.title: stay here if you like amazing service
allReviews.text: this hotel is perfect!  the staff treated us like royalty. the rooms are clean and comfortable and there's nothing you need. i can't wait to return to this hotel. The Four Seasons better take notice, this place sets the benchmark

allReviews.title: Absolute Pure Class!!!
allReviews.text: Best hotel ever I've stayed in.  Elegant all the way.  Professionally treated at front desk, if need anything bell boy brings it right up.  The room was outstanding.  Everything was done with detail.  Bathroom was stunning.  Hallways are stunning.  Fitness center outstanding.  Hotel next to mall with food court.  Pool very relaxing.  Powerful waterfall shower!  Porcelain bathroom floor.  It's worth coming to Vegas just to stay in this hotel.  This is a 5+++ hotel.  Shows the class of President Donald Trump!  Hope he gets re-elected!

allReviews.title: Very pleased!
allReviews.text: This is a very nice hotel.  Our room was roomy, well appointed and clean.  The view of the strip was great and can't think of anything the room was lacking.  Our room did have a kitchenette but has no dishes, silverware etc so you have to ask for that type stuff.  Otherwise, the room was perfect.  Great, large bathroom was a really nice touch.  Whirlpool tub big enough for two with separate shower.  Pool area was nice and service at the pool was excellent but the drinks were weak and the food bland.  This hotel is about a block and a half from the strip but it's an easy walk.  We used Lyft for transportation and it worked flawlessly.  No casino in this hotel but the Fashion Show mall is directly across the street.  Closest casinos within walking distance are the Wynne and Encore.  If you are looking for quality, class and a bit quieter place but still near the strip, this is a great place.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
allReviews.text: I love staying at this hotel… The service was amazing, the food was delicious, pool is so large , plenty of chairs and umbrellas, lemon water poolside .. the gym was well equipped . I felt so safe traveling solo staying there. I would definitely stay there again!

allReviews.title: What has happened to Trump's service?
allReviews.text: We have been staying at the Trump from the time they became a hotel.  I know covid has upended many things.  We don't stay in Airbnbs because we like daily maid service.  We like having our bed made and fresh towels every day.  We checked in late. The next day our room still had not been made up.  We called around 5:30 and asked.  They said they would send someone up.  I asked if we need to call every day.  They said no.  The next day no one came.  We called the thrid day.  No one came.  I happened to see a cleaning woman in the hall so I asked if we could get our room serviced.  She said she would call it in.  It was clean when we got back that night.  The next day, same thing no cleaning.  We were leaving the next morning so we didn't bother calling.  When we checked out I asked again if we need to call every day for cleaning.  I was told if you want "priority" cleaning, you need to call.  We don't care what time the room is cleaned, we just want it clean.Hotels say they are short staffed, but we've also heard that staff complain that they aren't given the opportunity to clean as much as they would like because the hotel is cutting costs. I hope this is not the case.  Trump not only had daily maid service, they also used to have a nightly turn down service.  I can sort of understand cutting the turn down service if they are trying to save money, but it would be nice if they and other hotels get their act together and start cleaning the rooms again.  Otherwise the hotel is still very nice.

allReviews.title: Beautiful, but lacking
allReviews.text: Everything was nice, except the mattress on the fold out couch had a huge stain and I had to call for bedding for it. The room was huge and had plenty of storage. Bathroom was amazing, but the shower head was a little on the short side for me (I'm 5'9").

allReviews.title: Returning to Las Vegas
allReviews.text: We were married in Vegas, so we decided to go back for our 23rd. wedding anniversary.The check in was fast, and after mentioning that we were returning for our anniversary, the receptionist offered us an upgrade to a corner suite for a reasonable price. So did it, and I have to say that it was worth it. There were 2 full baths, but master bathroom alone, was the size of an entire standard room. The rooms were very clean, smelled clean, and the window views were awesome. Also, the staff wear pins denoting their military service, and we thanked every one of them when we saw them.

allReviews.title: Absolute class! Vegas doesn't get better than this!
allReviews.text: This hotel is absolute class. The entire facility is sparkle-ingly clean, customer service was friendly and helpful, the room was huge and the bathroom was so cool! It even had a coffeemaker, which is unheard of in Vegas! The restaurant was delicious and quick. Everything about this hotel was efficient, classy and clean. I could not have asked for a better place to stay.I love that anti-Trump people won't stay here. They don't deserve this kind of treatment.

allReviews.title: Very satisfied
allReviews.text: The staff was welcoming at our arrival. Helpful to explain how to get around the hotel. The suite was very clean and the view was great. We had some drinks at the bar and took the food up to our room was delicious. We also did some shopping at the gift shop and the staff was helpful and friendly.

allReviews.title: Very Clean and nice. Pool is nothing special.
allReviews.text: 9 overall. The hotel and the room itself was very nice and extremely clean. We had a great visit and experience with all the staff. We would definitely come back. The only thing that was not over expectations was the pool. There was nothing wrong with it, but it wasn’t anything special, and didn’t feel like a pool that’s supposed to be on the Las Vegas Strip.

allReviews.title: Disappoitnig
allReviews.text: No maid service unless requested on a daily basis.  Advised hotel was short staffed and that the hotel was completely booked.  When I stated the hotel was advertised as being a '5' Star Hotel the front desk manager replied "well we aren't a five star and never have been."

allReviews.title: Excellent Stay Overall
allReviews.text: After a very long journey from the UK the last thing you want is an issue at check in. We were advised on checking in that there was a slight issue in so much that our prepaid booking had been cancelled for some reason. Before my tired brain could process and react they had made a plan, sorted the problem and assigned a great room with a view over the strip - greatly appreciated.  As it seems with all Hotels in the USA they had to obtain a card authorisation which seemed to go through no problems. Alas that was not the case and in addition to the regular authorisation my card had also been charged a further $450+  we discovered the following day. Unfortunately in the receptionists attempt to rectify the issue a further $450+ was also authorised putting a significant amount of my available funds out of my use for a large part of the holiday.However everyone everywhere makes mistakes from time to time and it’s how it is corrected that matters. The Receptionist went out of her way to make amends by waiving several additional fees/charges and in addition provided $100 credit against our room. We used the credit to take Breakfast in the restaurant and it was absolutely superb with wonderful service and more than made up for the error.  Subsequent breakfasts were obtained from a pop up counter available on weekends only we gathered where you could choose from a selection of pastries, croissants, muffins and coffees. The hotel in my opinion is well located just off the main Strip road. It was lovely after a day of sightseeing to return to a cool, calm lobby away from the chaos we had witnessed at some of the main strip Hotels.  In a morning If it’s after 10am you can take a shortcut through the shopping mall literally just across the road to save a few steps. Whilst we walked pretty much everywhere on occasion we needed a taxi the Valet’s were happy to oblige and we never waited more than a few minutes for the cab. Our room was on the higher floors and it was comforting to observe that all guests had to swipe their room card prior to entering the loft area of the foyers. Coming from the UK & it being our first time in Vegas we were taken aback at the size of the room - it was huge with a massive amount of storage though a few more coat hangers would be helpful, a fridge, coffee maker, microwave (though no instructions) and a spacious bathroom, with some lovely complementary toiletries. The bed was super comfy and extra pillows were delivered promptly at our request. The housekeeping did miss one day however after a phone call (or 2) fresh towels etc were delivered to the room. Having been and viewed the other well known Hotels on the strip we were happy we had made the totally right choice for the price charged and wouldn’t hesitate to book here again should we ever return to Vegas or recommend it to friends & family.

allReviews.title: Poor service
allReviews.text: The shower was not working properly, the least they can do is to check the rooms before they are assigned to the guest.The staff are not very friendly, very long wait for valet parking as they don’t offer self parking.

allReviews.title: Fabulous!
allReviews.text: I'd often wondered what Trump's hotels would be like so decided to stay here instead of on the strip and wow!  This hotel is so elegant!  We chose a penthouse with a view of the strip and loved everything about it.  First class all the way.  The staff was wonderful.  The breakfast in the lobby restaurant was excellent.  The pool area with cocktail bar was perfect.

allReviews.title: made to feel so special
allReviews.text: We had the best time we've ever had in Las Vegas. The location was amazing and my elderly Mom was able to walk (through The Fashion Mall, right across the street!) and on to Wynn Casino. We will only stay at Trump International from now on. The rooms were gorgeous with way more than we expected. Such luxury, service, and security. The Trump Store, both restaurants, and the pool were nothing but fun

allReviews.title: Great place
allReviews.text: Very nice hotel, clean, spacious and well located. comfortable and beautiful rooms, pool and spa are great. attentive and friendly staff. Hotel offers good services in restaurant with lunch, breakfast and dinner. In the pool and spa area there is an excellent bar with a great menu.

allReviews.title: My favorite hotel in Vegas.
allReviews.text: Always clean, no smoking, no casino, just a beautiful hotel property that always exceeds my expectations. The staff is always courteous and the food at DJT was better this time than the last time I visited.

allReviews.title: Very very nice
allReviews.text: Hotel was well located, very well kept and clean. Staff was very friendly and helpful. Accommodated all requests and helped with luggage storage. Rooms were nicer than I expected and very clean. Enjoyed views of city from room

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: Clean, safe, quiet, kind and professional personnel. Highly recommend. Our plane landed early in the morning ( much before check in time) and hotelPersonnel went the extra mile to place in a room as early as they can. Rooms are big and tastefully decorated. Clean to satisfy picky customer like me.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Hotel /nice views
allReviews.text: this is a great hotel  nice very clean however staff need to improve/trained  on customer service skillno one here has hospitality skills   simple welcome /good morning/how is your day going / staf just don't give a crap about guess staying at hotel

allReviews.title: Beautiful but too far
allReviews.text: There is never any cabs. The restaurant downstairs is insanely over priced. $20 for two medium sized pancakes! Pool is too small and shallow. Learned the cabs boycott the hotel because there's no space for them to park. Better off staying closer to the center of the strip.

allReviews.title: Extremely clean, friendly and non smoking
allReviews.text: I stay here often because the rooms are extremely clean (a priority for me), service is always top notch, its quiet, and within walking distance to many great shops. I always enjoy my stay at Trumps! 👍❤❤❤❤

allReviews.title: Best kept “Secret” in Vegas
allReviews.text: Our family enjoyed our stay at Trump International Hotel mostly because of the service that was provided to us since our arrival until our departure. From the valet parking, bellboy, registration, the room and facilities provided were the ones that fulfilled our expectations. Most importantly was the location, not too far from the strip that provided quietness at night. Great place and highly recommended to other family members and friends.

allReviews.title: Excellent standard and gorgeous hotel
allReviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at the Trump hotel.  It was lovely to step into a reception without casino and without smoke, to be warmly greeted by Jordan on reception, who was just excellent.  Would highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Outstanding service!
allReviews.text: This was our first time staying and the experience exceeded our expectations.  Service was outstanding, provided by helpful and friendly staff. Everything was clean, organized and there at our fingertips.  Will always choose this hotel when we are in Vegas. Great job!

allReviews.title: Overall good experience
allReviews.text: The place it self is beautiful and well designed. Room we stayed at was large had everyth we needed and more. Furniture in the room looked a little old and worn. Restaurant food and service have room for improvement.

allReviews.title: Great quality hotel
allReviews.text: Lovely huge room. Hotel itself is very well maintained and staff were attentive and helpful. It was since not having a Casio attached to the hotel! Was a 30min walk to main strip so keep this in mind, however was nice to have some peace! I wouldn’t recommend the restaurant for breakfast, overpriced for the quality, portion size and service experienced during our stay.

allReviews.title: Lovely room but so very noisy
allReviews.text: The room was amazing. Big. Comfy bed. Great bathroom which included a shower and jacuzzi bath. Kitchen (microwave, fridge, hob). Settee and chairs. Free water every day.Most of the staff were lovely. But the reason I scored low was the noise. There was zero sound insulation at the back of the hotel. So every noisy car. Every train. Every thump of the music. Could be heard. Not so bad mid week, but at the weekend ... ... ...The chap at reception told me I should have asked for a room at the front. I would say you shouldn’t have to do that in a hotel with such a status.In addition, walk to hotel goes past a vacant lot. Although you can get to front via the mall opposite, this actually shuts earlier in the evening. So it can feel dodgy if you are walking back.

allReviews.title: Great location & room size
allReviews.text: Great location across from Wynn at half the price with large rooms, nice undercounted refrigerator and electric two burner wolf cooktop-we didn’t use- and great wall of wardrobes and drawers. Large marble bath with double sinks, huge soaking tub, toilet with separate water closet, Keurig in room. Like there is no smoking and no casino. Very friendly and attentive staff. Very nice and friendly pool staff. Strangely you have a mini kitchenette along wall of built ins but due to County regulations, had to request wine glasses, coffe cups (paper was already provided) and bottle openers, which were immediately delivered to the room.

allReviews.title: Cari-Lynn
allReviews.text: Excellent service all the employees were extremely friendly.  The rooms were top notch, it was a great experience I would stay here again. The valet service was great and always very fast never waited very long at all.

allReviews.title: Gorgeous & Peaceful
allReviews.text: Our room was super luxurious and the whole experience at this hotel was relaxing. The staff is super friendly and excellent- the security at the elevators always made me feel safe! Our front desk check in and check out experience was easy.

allReviews.title: Excellent hotel, large rooms
allReviews.text: Brilliant stay at the Trump hotel, not too far from the strip. Rooms are huge and large kitchen in the suites. Lack of restaurants, could do with a cafe so you can pop in for breakfast. Staff are very friendly and can’t do enough for you.

allReviews.title: The Trump Experience
allReviews.text: This is the nicest hotel we have ever stayed in. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. We were impressed by how courteous the staff was, and how well they performed their duties. We felt like they were old friends, and enjoyed conversation with them. We have never used valet parking before, and now I think it will be a "must have" at any place we stay in the future. They never failed to ask ,"Is there anything else I can do for you?" Really nice.

allReviews.title: Honey moon
allReviews.text: My wife and I wanted to go to Las Vegas for are honey moon and stayed at the Trump tower, we had the best experience and was offered an upgrade to the penthouse. Well worth the stay and the employees are so nice and helpful.

allReviews.title: Decent Hotel, Lovely Staff, Very Basic Amenities
allReviews.text: When you first walk in the lobby looks fantastic. The staff were all great. Checkin was easy and we were kindly upgraded to a suite due to a very special occasion. The suite was huge and impressive with great views. There was an amazing kitchen area and in the middle of the counter paper cups and a cheap little black coffee machine such as you get in any cheap motel in America! Not even proper mugs! No kettle to boil water for tea that doesn't taste like coffee. Not even a cloth to wipe the side down. There was a notice about some law preventing them fully stocking the kitchen. Fine, I would never expect a fully stocked kitchen but I would expect the ability to make a good cup of plain tea (not Earl Grey which is an acquired taste) or coffee. As they have staff shortages and no daily room service I would also expect enough tea and coffee to last more than one single use!As is the case is most hotels in America the air con is either on and noisy or off. The room smelled really musty as there is just no fresh air. The tiny vents in the window let in some air but the noise was incredible so we tried to close them again. Unsuccessfully!The restaurant is nothing more than a huge canteen with big TV screens everywhere. Certainly not where I'd like to sit and have a nice meal to celebrate. I'd read up about these hotels and really did expect some feel of luxury. It was a shell that could have been any hotel, anywhere. Shame. The lobby was the nicest part.

allReviews.title: Amazing place to stay
allReviews.text: This place is such a beautiful hotel. Clean, smells great and the rooms are amazing. The pool is super relaxed and has such a nice vibe, it isn’t people posing. It’s real people with a nice friendly feel. Garrett who works serving around the pool is INCREDIBLE he absolutely made our stay, talk about making people feel valued and appreciated. What a guy. Also the whole team around the pool, checking in, moving umbrellas for us, always friendly and nice. The staff here are amazing. We had a corner suite which was really nice and spacious. My only gripe (and I don’t think it deserved for a star to be dropped) is that you have to request all crockery and cutlery for the kitchen area in your room, I had to ring 3 times. Once for crockery/cutlery. Then again for mugs for coffee. Then again for washing liquid. Then we still didn’t have half the stuff we needed for the kitchen to be actually useful. No tea towels, no dishwasher tablets. Also plastic cutlery. Really? Come on guys, I’m paying a lot to stay in this suite. Bring me some proper cutlery. But that’s it, that’s my only gripe. Other than that our stay here was great.

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel
allReviews.text: Great staff and amazing rooms…restaurant at hotel was great also. It was nice to get complementary valet parking at Trump international too. A++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

allReviews.title: “Mike Lindel”
allReviews.text: Mr. President,I know you always like feedback from your constituents and or customers of your facilities. The only suggestion I have is that you get pillow toppers, from My pillow pillow for the beds. The valet service, the rooms, the pool and a hot tub area are incredible. We will be back whenever we visit Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: Great location
allReviews.text: Workout room never had sanitizer to wipe down the equipment during 3 separate workouts I did . Why pay that much of a resort fee if nobody monitors that area! The rooms and hotel along with the pool area are nice location is excellent across the street from the mall!

allReviews.title: Mostly Pros, a few cons. Still my favorite Vegas Hotel
allReviews.text: Pros: No Casino ( we don’t gamble, so it’s a pro for us) no smoke to walk through. DJT restaurant is amazing!Off strip, so no riff-raff coming in off the street. Directly across from Fashion Show Mall!Still good proximity to stripPool is perfect size Guests are very diverse and respectable and happy to be there. Great for families or couples or singles!Plenty of food offered at all hours. Pool restaurant is nice. Decor is luxurious and very upscale!Gift shop is awesome!Cons: There are 3 marijuana dispensaries next door, so constantly smells like weed when you’re outside for any length of time. Room service was not being offered. No full-length mirror in the penthouse suite!Hostess was rude to my 17 year old daughter when she tried to get seated at DJT for coffee while we waited for our food that I ordered from the bar, to go. First I’ll tell you my husband and I stay at The Trump in Vegas often, at least once a year. This trip he surprised me with an upgrade to the Penthouse Suite for Mother’s Day. The suite is amazing!!! Except for ONE thing. In all the halls and closets there isn’t one single full-length mirror. For a huge Penthouse suite where guests spend thousands of dollars to stay, we can’t even get ONE full length mirror??? I was shocked! Obviously when one travels to a place like Las Vegas, there are events and shows and dinners that people get dressed up for. It would be nice to have a full length mirror to see the whole view. I’ve stayed in plenty of other Penthouse Suites in Vegas and every single one of them have a full length mirror. This is just absurd to me. Other than that we love it here! We feel spoiled and pampered every time we come.

allReviews.title: Best hotel in Vegas!
allReviews.text: Best hotel in Vegas and best hotel experience I have had: atmosphere,  beauty of the hotel, staff service and dining/bar... all top rated. This hotel is VERY different from the carnival atmosphere of most Vegas hotels. First rate all the way!

allReviews.title: Great Stay As Always
allReviews.text: We had a great view from the room of the strip. Jacuzzi tub was nice to relax in on our arrival night and did the full spa experience the next morning with steam room, massages, and hair cuts then grabbed a drink at the pool bar. It's super close to the fashion show and Capital Grille for some great steaks.

allReviews.title: Trump International is a Must Destination
allReviews.text: A 5 star destination with exceptional customer service and beautiful features. Off of the strip, quiet, with great security, and wonderful meals. Personnel were top notch, pleasant, and attentive. Will not disappoint!

allReviews.title: Wonderful Stay
allReviews.text: This hotel is beautiful and very comfortable. Our room was large and very clean, and it had a gorgeous view of both city and mountains. The staff is friendly and helpful, and the location is away from the noise of the strip, yet close enough to walk. We loved our stay!

allReviews.title: Beautiful hotel!
allReviews.text: Wonderful place to stay!  This hotel has valet parking which was so nice. Big beautiful clean rooms. Short walk to Wynn casino. Ate breakfast at the restaurant and it was delish!!  Best of all, they welcome pets!! I can’t wait to go back!!

allReviews.title: Fight trip
allReviews.text: I came to Vegas with my brother to watch the Stevenson vs Valdez unification fight. My stay at Trump could not have went any better. Every part of the entire hotel smells phenomenal, the restaurant is top of the line in both service and quality, and the pool is one of the most relaxing I’ve been to.

allReviews.title: amazing place to stay
allReviews.text: Perfect place to stay in Vegas. No smoking, quiet, amazing rooms and service, still close to everything. My wife and I stayed here for our 20th wedding anniversary and had a fantastic time. We stay at Trump every time we visit Vegas.

allReviews.title: 12th Year Anniversary
allReviews.text: My husband and I will definitely be coming back to the Las Vegas location sooner than later. We felt so welcome by staff. In particular. Scott and Perry went above and beyond expectations. We had an early morning flight (6am). Scott and Perry arranged for us to be picked up from dropping off our rental car the night before AND gave us a ride in the luxurious Trump vehicle to the airport at 4am. Top notch service. Russell and Amanda Alfaro.

allReviews.title: Best Hotel experience
allReviews.text: We have stayed at some very "high class"  hotels and Trump Hotels have never disappointed us.Staff are always friendly and helpful. The rooms are always clean. We will always stay at a trump hotel if there is one where we are visiting.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel!
allReviews.text: A nice hotel which doesn't have a Casino so it is quieter at the night!We had a nice view from the room and it was a high floor also!The room was beautiful and clean and the price was relatively cheap

allReviews.title: Fabulous
allReviews.text: Just perfect the staff could not do enough for us and the cleanliness of the hotel was exemplary. I would definitely recommend staying here if you’re heading to Vegas close enough to the strip but far enough away to be quiet

allReviews.title: Our Second Stay at this Wonderful Hotel!
allReviews.text: We stayed again at Trump International because of its outstanding service, elegant atmosphere, quiet rooms and NO casino gambling/smoking.  It is an extremely well-run hotel with exceptional staff and beautiful decor.  Uber makes getting from and to the hotel very easy and convenient.  We will definitely stay at Trump International on future Las Vegas trips.  It is wonderful!!

allReviews.title: Went for the deal / don’t make same mistake
allReviews.text: Pay a little more stay o byte strip in a nice hotel spa closed Tuesday and Wednesday no room service no housekeeping or only every other day no open windows stuffy old food is terrible very depressing left early

allReviews.title: Experience of a lifetime!
allReviews.text: We wanted to take opportunity to express our sincere thanks during our recent stay at the Trump International Las Vegas. The entire staff were incredible! From every aspect of our vacation, the Trump International Las Vegas exceeded our expectations.Knowing this was our first exposure to Las Vegas as a vacation destination we did quite a bit of research determining which was to be our best option for our vacation stay. And as a wise Grail Knight once said, “We chose wisely!” Thank you Trump International for making our dreams come true, especially for our daughter, who had the occasion to celebrate because this was her Make-a-Wish wish and her opportunity to see her favorite singing group, BTS.Thank you for being a part of this magical experience.

allReviews.title: Great place to stay for working Conventions
allReviews.text: We just spent a week working a convention in LV, and this was our first stay at the Trump. It was great to have the kitchenette, and the restaurant had great food and was available - something we'd had trouble with in the large casino hotels. It was quiet and smoke free, and the staff was friendly. The room was clean and well appointed. Bed was very comfortable, shower easy to use, we found it very relaxing. They could do a better job with Valet in the morning, however we took a cab or ride share to the convention center most days so that didn't matter much. Overall it was a great place to unwind after a long day.

allReviews.title: Most relaxing stay in Vegas
allReviews.text: The Trump is in the ideal location. The hotel is close enough to the heart of Vegas, but also far enough away where you can still relax. The staff is very friendly, helpful, and professional. The hotel is clean and has a great restaurant, spa, and pool. I highly recommend.

allReviews.title: Very Pleasant Stay
allReviews.text: We really enjoyed staying at this hotel. It exceeded our expectations, loved that even I was greeted on the TV welcome screen, very special detail. The bathroom awesome, we used the hot tub after a nice workout at the very well equipped fitness center. Even tho we didn't use the kitchen we were glad it had a mini fridge to cool our drinks.The beds were great, very comfortable.Everything felt so luxurious. We just loved it!.

allReviews.title: Decor is a little tired but still good quality and value
allReviews.text: We stayed here in April 2022 for my wife's birthday trip to Vegas. We had booked here for the first and second nights and then again for another night later in our Vegas stay. Check in was going ok until they couldnt find any reference to our Agoda booking. An hour slipped by while they checked confirmation codes etc but couldnt find anything. They said it was Agoda's fault - and it probably was! They gave us a room anyway to avoid further inconvenience. The room was a good size - they put us on a high fllor and the views were fantastic - right up The Strip to Mandalay Bay. The furniture in the room is starting to show its age but everything worked and we appreciated the extra space. We turned the seats around to face the window and that's where we enjoyed quite a few hours. After we departed (for another resort) we were surprised to find a $500 plus charge agaiants our credit card. This was because they couldnt find the booking through Agoda and charged us the top rack rate!! without telling us!! Anyway I went back to the hotel and Jazmin helped immediately and efficiently and mpt only found the room booking and payment but credited the money back to the credit card. We enjoyed the hotel as the staff were friendly and the bed very comfortable. It is out of the way and was a fair walk to the centre of The Strip but the payoff was it was quiet with no casino and hardly any passing foot traffic. The shopping centre opposite has a great ABC convenience store and a food court so we had everything we needed close by. One thing we heard at night was the train using its horn - not sure why but that isnt the fault of the hotel.

allReviews.title: Lovely hotel,  let down by disorganised valet service
allReviews.text: Room great.  The best view on the street.  Great location. Pool is a good size with plenty of sun loungers.  Staff are attentive and welcoming. Really clean hotel. Room was not serviced during our stay despite reception telling us it would be,  which was fine but we had to ask for coffees, towels etc each day. What let this down massively for us was the compulsary valet parking.  Despite ordering our car before we came down,  our car wasn't brought out until about 20 to 40 minutes each time after we actually presented ourselves at the valet desk.  Cars were literally dumped at the entrance,  there lacked organisation in this area.  Taxis dropping off couldn't just drive through as there were 4 lanes of cars either dropped off for parking,  or delivered for the guests.  It was fairly chaotic and based on this alone we'd not stay at the Trump international Las Vegas again.

allReviews.title: Surprisingly Wonderful, But...
allReviews.text: First the positives:  this hotel is in a great location for freeway access to outlying sights (Red Rock Canyon and Valley of Fire).  Our room on the 47th floor was very quiet, clean, and comfortable.  The room itself was spacious with a mini fridge, stove top, and microwave for the nights we decided to take it easy in our room.  The bathroom was also quite spacious with a jetted, large tub and a large shower, separate toilet and two sinks.  We felt like we were at home.  Housekeeping cleaned every-other day and did a great job, unlike our experiences at many other hotels.  Our room was super quiet at night.The negatives:   Upon check-in we were skipped over after requesting help with our bags up to our room.  Valet parking (the only option) was super slow.  Every day, and at different times of the day, it would take AT LEAST 10 minutes for our car to be brought to the driveway.  There were two to three valet employees for this extremely busy hotel.  We were taken aback at the treatment of the employees used to check room keys at the elevators.  These people were required to stand 8 hours per shift; there were no stools offered for these people to sit at their station.  We found this cruel and attributed this, as well as the shortage of valet employees, to greed.  Many hotels are trying to "recoup" their losses from the pandemic.  This greed is taken out on the customers.  Someone standing in one spot for 8 hours at the elevators does not hurt a customer, but it does reflect on the management and owner and the priorities thereof.  Not impressive.The next time we are on vacation in Las Vegas we will not choose this particular hotel strictly because of the two negatives described above.

allReviews.title: Luxury, Views & Relaxation at The Palms.
allReviews.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ A Perfect Las Vegas Stay! Luxury, Views & Relaxation at The PalmsWe had an absolutely wonderful stay at The Palms Hotel in Las Vegas. From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by the free parking and the wide range of high-quality dining options available right on the property. The buffet deserves a special mention, despite the huge variety of dishes, everything we tried was fresh, flavorful, and well-prepared. It’s rare to find such consistency in a buffet of this scale.Our room in the new tower was spacious, modern, and comfortable, with an unforgettable view of the Las Vegas Strip. We spent hours just sitting by the window, watching the city come alive, the lights, the movement, the energy… it’s something you simply can’t look away from.Each morning, I’d take the elevator downstairs to grab a great cup of coffee from one of the coffee shops in the hotel, and we’d enjoy it quietly in our room while taking in that spectacular view. Las Vegas is vibrant and full of life, but at The Palms, you can also find peace and relaxation when you need it.The service was friendly and professional, and the rooms were spotless. It truly felt like the perfect balance of excitement and comfort. We’ll definitely stay here again!

allReviews.title: Safety Concerns and Dishonest staff.
allReviews.text: Stay at the Palms Casino Resort – 9/26 through 10/1Rooms: 16201 & 17202I booked two rooms months in advance for a company work trip. About a week before arrival, I received an email from the Palms advertising a 5-day promotional rate. Out of curiosity, I checked — and found the rooms were listed at roughly one-third the rate I had already paid.I immediately emailed reservations with screenshots, and they told me to call. When I called, the reservations agent said they could cancel and re-book at the lower rate, but it would be “better” to just wait and have the front desk handle it when I arrived later that week. This was on a Tuesday; I was set to arrive Friday.Check-In and Room IssuesWe arrived Friday around 1 pm (two adult couples). I went straight to the front desk and explained the situation to Manager Luz Corona. She asked me to email her the screenshots, which I did on the spot. She told me she’d call me back with an update. She never called. Two days later, I went back down to follow up and was told to text the screenshots to another number. (Palms, if management is reading this, it was a company phone — I can provide the number to confirm.) Again, I was told someone would call me back. Again, no call ever came.As for the rooms themselves:My room was ready around 2 pm.My parents’ suite (Fantasy Corner Salon) was not ready until 4:30 pm — even though we were told multiple times it would be ready by 3. At one point, an agent admitted that the delay was because “VIP guests” had blocked other rooms and my parents’ room was still being cleaned. My parents are in their 70s and have trouble standing/walking long periods. Watching VIPs who hadn’t even arrived be prioritized over paying guests physically waiting in front of the desk was insulting and disappointing.When my parents finally received their key:The suite was missing towels and washcloths. They had to call to request them.The bathroom doorknob literally fell off, making the bathroom unusable. It took a full day to repair.We were told the delay “would be compensated” with a $100 resort credit. This never appeared on the bill.Safety IncidentOn our third day, while we were napping, an employee walked directly into our room. No knock, no explanation — just walked in. I stopped him, and he quickly apologized and ran out. I immediately called the front desk, waited on hold for 20 minutes with no answer, and finally walked down myself. (There was no line when I got there.)After explaining the situation, I was told the employee “didn’t speak good English” and had mistakenly been told to clean carpets on another floor. That excuse didn’t line up — he wasn’t carrying carpet-cleaning equipment. I was told the resort fee for that day would be credited. Again, this never appeared on my bill. When I called after checkout, the incident wasn’t even documented — meaning no record of an employee entering a guest room unannounced and uninvited. That’s not just poor service — it’s a major safety and security concern.Billing ProblemsWhen I finally received my bill, there were three separate minibar charges for items we never touched. When I called to dispute them, I was told they couldn’t remove the charges until the minibar attendant confirmed the items hadn’t been used. So the Palms’ policy appears to be: charge first, verify later. Guests are effectively billed for whatever’s missing at the moment of checkout, and only refunded if someone verifies later.Overall ExperienceTo be fair:The rooms themselves were nicely designed and comfortable once issues were addressed.The views were great.Gambling at the Palms was excellent — among the best anywhere.But none of that outweighs the repeated dishonesty, lack of follow-through, and safety failures we experienced:Multiple broken promises (rate adjustment, resort credits, compensation).Delays and excuses that left senior guests waiting hours for their room.An unlogged, uncorrected incident of an employee walking into our room uninvited.Incorrect minibar charges treated as valid until we proved otherwise.The Palms clearly prioritizes VIPs over paying guests already standing at the counter. And while mistakes can happen, the repeated failure to follow up or honor commitments — paired with a total lack of accountability on a safety incident — makes it impossible for me to recommend this property.The amenities were not enough to outweigh the lies, dismissiveness, and security concerns. Unfortunately, I will not be staying at the Palms again.Imagine a female alone here and someone entering their room while they are sleeping.   Then there be ZERO documentation of the incident.

Always spots open I just didn’t see alit of people winning or getting excited because they won. The high limit room paid out quick for a jackpot. The one thing I didn’t like was the players desk. We had free play added to our cards and free buffets but if you didn’t swipe your cards at the kiosks you wouldn’t have known to activate. They just weren’t forth coming with info . A lady who was In line told us how it worked after the second day . Would have been helpful to haven someone explain how things worked and gave out free cards . Pool -people were always walking around for drinks and food . Drinks crazy expensive . 20.00 for a regular size cup. Food was very high as well . It was very hot and not a whole lot of umbrellas . Nice music and vibe though.you do need to watch what door you have to go in and what door you come out of. This needs to be labeled better. Buffets- very good food and service . We only went for breakfast and we had a buy one get one coupon. Crab legs and steak were hot and flavorful. Loved omelet station . Expensive if you didn’t have coupons . Long gone are the days of cheap buffets . 42.99 brunch, dinner 46.99. Lobster was 80, and prime rib and crab day was 52.99 a person .

allReviews.title: Run! Don't waste you money!!
allReviews.text: Congratulations! This hotel has truly redefined what “hospitality” means. I always thought Las Vegas was famous for its impeccable service, but you’ve proven me wrong in ways I couldn’t have imagined.Let’s start with the front desk experience. I arrived late at night, exhausted, expecting a warm welcome. Instead, Arianna greeted us with a glare and an attitude so unfriendly that I genuinely wondered if being an Asian guest made me unworthy of even basic courtesy. Watching her warmly interact with other (non-Asian) guests later only confirmed that suspicion. The fact that she “accidentally” assigned us two completely uncleaned rooms at 11 PM feels less like a mistake and more like a deliberate insult. When I came back to complain, Nicole, instead of helping, was too busy laughing and chatting with other staff to even acknowledge us. Is that your signature service style?We were then “upgraded” to a room with a broken shampoo holder and a delightful lingering stench, just to remind us of your attention to detail. A quick glance at Google Maps shows Arianna’s name proudly mentioned in multiple negative reviews—proof that this isn’t a one-off but a consistent pattern of poor service that management clearly ignores.As someone who has worked for Marriott, I’m truly shocked. I thought this brand stood for excellence, but this property seems to specialize in discrimination, neglect, and indifference. Based on our treatment, it’s clear that Asian guests are not valued here; we’re just a revenue source you don’t even pretend to respect. Maybe that’s why your team doesn’t bother replying to complaints or reviews—when you’ve decided some guests don’t matter, why engage with them at all?If your goal was to make guests feel invisible, disrespected, and unwelcome, congratulations again—you’ve achieved it. Unless someone enjoys paying premium prices to experience racial bias, broken facilities, and indifference, I’ll be sure to warn them to book anywhere else but here.

allReviews.title: Did not feel safe was ripped off.

The first day there the 2 young girls returned to their room to find 4 men standing in it unannounced saying they were fixing the Wi-Fi. regardless of what they were there for they should have permission and not just enter a room were 2 young woman are staying.  We had them moved to the 12th floor after that we had the same issue with people trying to enter the rooms to fix Wi-Fi??   Had a room cleaner just open the door and walk in unannounced when I was standing in a towel looking for something she left behind. Other security issue involves the pool area. On the Sunday it was overcrowded with people who were not staying there but had a day pass. One of which was aggressive and vulgar, and we had to get security to remove him. We felt un-safe while staying there.The hotel charges 48 a day in addition to the nightly rate as a resort fee for the pool, Wi-Fi and parking. For that fee the Wi-Fi should work and you should be able to have a place to use the pool.   They charge you for coffee in the room.They charged us for mini bar and snacks THAT WE DID NOT CONSUME. Beware that each time you even touch or open the mini fridge you are charged. There are way too many choices in Vegas to choose Palms only to be left to feel un-safe and ripped off.

Otherwise, the dining options were plentiful and I loved that the food court area stayed open super late. The staff was very friendly and always helpful. allReviews.title: Disorganized and disappointing for a milestone celebration
allReviews.text: I booked a group spa’rty for my 40th birthday — my first-ever spa experience — and left feeling disappointed, stressed, and honestly embarrassed for choosing this place.The issues started early: no response to my outreach for two days, and when I finally got someone, they booked six of us together but left the seventh person scheduled 90 minutes later. She felt uncomfortable and canceled — which should’ve been my first red flag.Despite multiple follow-ups with several different staff members (I spoke to eight in total), we never got the picnic info or food menu we were promised. On the day of, we arrived to confusion and zero communication about what the $20 spa’rty upgrade even included. Turns out it was just an eye mask — which one of my guests who didn’t even pay for the upgrade also got.The food situation was equally bad. We were told we couldn’t order anything unless we left the spa (in robes!) to pick it up ourselves. Eventually someone brought us a printed-off internet menu and a blank piece of paper to write on. We gave up.Two hours in, we still hadn’t been offered the champagne that was supposed to be part of the spa’rty. Someone finally remembered while we were in the sauna. It was laughable by that point.Also, the hot tub was out of service — something I was never told when booking, even though reviews now show it’s been down for months.The massages and facials were great — no complaints there — but everything else was disorganized, poorly communicated, and far from the elevated experience I was promised. For the price we paid, I expected a lot more.The staff did remove the spa’rty charge and gave a small discount, but that doesn’t make up for the lack of communication, missing amenities, and overall awkward vibe (including being stared down by a staff member when we left).If you’re just looking for a massage, you’ll probably be fine. But if you're booking a group or expecting a special experience? I’d look elsewhere.

His warm hospitality, attentiveness, and professionalism truly set him apart.Erno consistently creates opportunities for memorable experiences, whether it’s helping with reservations, offering thoughtful perks, or simply checking in to make sure everything is perfect. Thanks to him, I’ve been able to enjoy everything Palms has to offer in the best way possible.It’s rare to meet someone so dedicated and genuine. I’m truly grateful for all he’s done to make my time at Palms so special. Thank you, Erno!

allReviews.title: Erno Mabini
allReviews.text: I wanted to take a moment to talk about my host, Erno Mabini.  Erno, is by far the most attentive and gracious host I have ever encountered in my 30 plus years of gaming.If you are an avid gamer I would suggest looking him up for your host needs.

allReviews.title: Elevated experience
allReviews.text: If you need a casino host ask for Erno!! He is one of the best in town.  Ease of access to venues and amenities.  Clean and organized, consistent and professional.

allReviews.title: Great price and not far from the strip.
allReviews.text: Visited last week at palms casino, the hotel it self so beautiful and clean, buffet have an amazing variety of food to offer. Casino cage cashiers name  Daniel Ricardo was amazing, he is very helpful . Housekeeping always friendly. Love my stay to this hotel.

allReviews.title: From Yaamava Casino regulars to Palms Las Vegas first timers - Great trip!
allReviews.text: This was our second trip to the Palms. My wife and I had celebrated both our birthdays in a previous stay and were delighted with the room that Albert Ayala at VIP desk requested for us!  Very clean and spacious with one of the best beds I've slept in. Parking was free and the elevators from the hotel landed directly to the casino floor. There is the Serrano Vista cafe right off the elevators with Starbucks coffee... perfect for my morning wake-up.We met our host Erno Mabini that trip and told him we were coming back for our wedding anniversary.  Expecting a very nice King room - we were met with a huge suite!  He went above and beyond to insure our special day was special.   Every staff member we encountered was friendly, professional and very accommodating. The food was great in the food court, and over the top at the steakhouse. Neither of us missed being off the strip.  If I had to use only one word to describe the hotel and casino - Clean!  We will definitely be back and already recommended it to our extended family back home.

allReviews.title: Pleasantly surprised!
allReviews.text: My husband and I visited for  2 nights and wanted a budget friendly stay because we only wanted to gamble and were looking for low table minimums.  We booked the Palms and were satisfied with the hotel overall.  The room was clean, but dated.  The bed was very comfortable and we had everything we needed for the 2 nights we were there.  The casino was wonderful and the waitstaff serviced us frequently.  There are several eating options from casual to fine dining and the restaurants we tried were great!  We never went to the pool, but it looked clean and inviting.   They also have a spa for massages and facials etc. If you’re looking for a budget friendly place  and can overlook the dated rooms, this is a great stay.  If you’re looking for luxury and newer looking rooms, this is not it. We would definitely stay again if we’re looking for a place to lay our heads when gambling is the goal.

allReviews.title: Excellent casino and staff
allReviews.text: Excellent host, Erno Mabini. Catered to us ,like family. Staff are genuinely friendly and helpful. Rooms are super comfortable. We've enjoyed every stay. Our host,  Erno is attentative during our stay.  The Palms has become our favorite casino.

allReviews.title: Exceptional host!!!
allReviews.text: We’ve enjoyed our stay every time we stayed. Erno Mabini is our host and he attends to us as if we are like family.  Very attentive to details on our visits, and available if we need something. Palms has become our favorite casino, the staff as well is attentive, and your shuttle staff are friendly.  Oh, by the way, we’ve hit great jackpots!! ‘ Erno , see you real soon!’

allReviews.title: Outstanding Host at the Palms Casino!
allReviews.text: Erno Mabini is an exceptional host at the Palms Casino. He’s kind, thoughtful, and handles every detail — big or small — with care and professionalism. As a Diamond member, I’ve always been treated incredibly well, and with the utmost respect. Erno consistently goes out of his way to ensure everything is perfect, making each visit smooth and enjoyable. He’s a big reason why I choose the Palms every time. Highly recommend!

allReviews.title: Favorite Vegas Hotel/Casino & Casino Host!
allReviews.text: I’ve been to The Palms nine times in the past year, and a huge reason I keep coming back is because of my casino host, Erno Mabini. He seriously makes every trip feel effortless and enjoyable. His customer service is top-tier — professional but also super warm and personal.Erno always makes me feel like a priority. He remembers the little things I like, checks in ahead of time, and is always quick to respond if I need anything. It’s rare to find someone who’s not only great at their job but also genuinely kind and easy to talk to.Having someone like Erno looking out for me just makes the whole experience better. I always know I’m in good hands when I book a stay at The Palms.

allReviews.title: Drinks and fun
allReviews.text: Had a great time at the Palms! We hung out at the shark bar in the middle most of the time. The DJ was awesome played some great music and was good at reading the room. Summer and Beto are awesome! They made us laugh all night long! The bar manager that night Casey was very nice! Everyone we ran into took good care of us! When we roulette Misha took great care of us sweet girl! You guys just have a great team!

allReviews.title: Ruthless and Discriminatory Customer Service
allReviews.text: June 17, 2025Palms Casino ResortGuest Relations Department4321 W Flamingo RdLas Vegas, NV 89103Subject: Miss Behavior Management Staff Regarding Disrespectful Customer Service and Misinformation at the Rewards CenterDear Palms Casino Resort Management,I am writing to formally express my extreme disappointment and distress regarding a recent interaction with your customer service team at the Rewards Center on Tuesday, June 17, 2025. The experience was profoundly disrespectful and unacceptable, particularly given the high standards of customer service expected in the Las Vegas hospitality industry.My issue began when I approached the Rewards Center to inquire about misinformation concerning promotional points I had earned. I was not provided with clear information regarding the promotion's terms and conditions beforehand, specifically that my earned points would not qualify under your rules. As a loyal customer, I believe it is incumbent upon Palms Casino Resort to provide complete and accurate promotional details upfront.What truly escalated this negative experience was the subsequent handling of my inquiry by your staff. The supervisor, Medalyn, addressed me with a ruthless and disrespectful demeanor. When I respectfully requested to speak with a manager, Roslyn, the situation unfortunately deteriorated further. Roslyn appeared to take my explanation of the situation as a personal attack. Instead of offering a clear resolution or engaging in a productive conversation, she threatened to call security and summarily dismissed me without providing any satisfactory answers.I was made to feel incredibly small and insignificant, as if I were a pauper begging for a trivial gift worth no more than $10. In my many years of experience within the hospitality sector, both as a customer and observing industry practices, I have never encountered such a profound lack of respect. I have always held a strong belief in treating all individuals with respect, which I consider a fundamental aspect of customer service. Roslyn's behavior made me feel akin to someone homeless, undeserving of basic courtesy despite being a patron of your establishment for several years. While I may not consistently spend millions on gaming, I frequently visit your property with family and friends to dine or watch movies.The way Roslyn held a grudge against me while I attempted to explain the situation was appalling. Her comment, implying that this was the "first time Medalyn did that," suggested that she believed I was fabricating the incident and merely seeking a "cheap gimmick." As a manager, her conduct and communication skills fell far short of the professional standards one would expect from a leading hospitality establishment.I have never felt compelled to file a complaint of this nature before. While I believe this specific incident may not be representative of the entire company, a repeated pattern of such dismissive and disrespectful behavior from both a supervisor and a manager is deeply concerning. If this is the prevailing work ethic and customer service standard at Palms Casino Resort, it severely undermines your standing in a city where exceptional customer service is a cornerstone of our economy.I am extremely upset and feel profoundly disrespected by the behavior of your employees. Their conduct is unacceptable at any level. I urge you to investigate this matter thoroughly and take appropriate action to address these serious deficiencies in customer service.

allReviews.text: The Palms has been my go to casino and enjoyed the staffs services. I normally  give good tip. However, one time having ran out of cash due to playing, got some coffee and ROSA RUDELY and loudly said, "Today we received nothing but Thank you!!!."

allReviews.title: Gaming Fun

allReviews.title: Went to Palms to gamble

allReviews.title: Free parking
allReviews.text: Second time staying at The Palms this year. First time during MLK weekend, we got 2 queens in a corner suite. The door was massive like a private entrance. It was a corner unit with large windows over looking The Palms towers. This time, Memorial weekend, we got a king bed in the Fantasy Tower.It’s clean, modern, bright beige color palette. The digital clock has a wireless charging pad. The mini fridge is not for personal use. You must request for a fridge if you want one. Otherwise, it has a timer and will charge you if you remove items or open for too long.Although slightly off strip, the advantage is free parking, cheaper gambling, and better blackjack odds. Next time, we will need to try AYCE buffet.

allReviews.title: Bita the incompetent/lying front desk manager
allReviews.text: We checked into the Palms in Vegas & they gave us the wrong room. Instead of admitting it or saying sorry and offering to switch the room for us, the manager tried to cover herself by saying that room doesn’t exist. We told her we’ve stayed in it before, she tried to convince us we hadn’t. We showed her pictures and confirmation numbers from last time, she still didn’t believe us. She kept telling us “there’s no need to switch rooms.” I said, “to which room? The room you’re saying doesn’t exist?” She said if we wanted to wait another day, maybe someone would check out and we could take their room. So I said, “the room you’re saying doesn’t exist?” I asked her to confirm the larger room exists, she said she couldn’t confirm that because she “hasn’t personally seen every room of the hotel.” I told her the room was available & showed her on my phone that it was still available online. She said the website must’ve made a mistake. She then admitted that sometimes the overbook. I asked what would happen if I bought the room right then online, and she said she would have to give me a refund because they were sold out. She tried to cover herself because she knew she was caught lying to our faces. We stayed at the Palms for about an hour and a half just to fight with Bita- the manager. She said the best she could offer was to check us out. Worst customer service ever. We checked out immediately & are never coming back to the Palms. This incompetent manager, Bita, says she’s worked there “for over a month,” as if she clearly knew what she was talking about… she couldn’t even print out our receipts, forgot to give us a pen to sign them, and had to ask the other front desk employee for help several times. These are the differences between the two rooms. one is considerably bigger, the other has a smaller couch, lower ceilings, and only one restroom. We will be suing the Palms for false advertising, specifically because of Bita- the incompetent manager who lied to our faces. She eventually admitted she found a confirmation number confirming we had stayed there before, but offered no apology, no discount, nothing. I only wish I could personally sue that lying incompetent waste of breath- Bita, for lying to our faces, gaslighting us by trying to make us believe we never stayed in the hotel before, and offering the best she could do- to check us out immediately. We’ll never stay there again specifically because of her. Do yourself a favor, take your business somewhere else where you won’t be lied to your face by Bita.

allReviews.title: Favorite Resort in Vegas!
allReviews.text: The staff are all so great, they are so friendly and helpful. They have a great selection of slot machines and table games and the restaurants are all delicious. If you go, be sure to visit The West bar and Tonic bar, they have the best bartenders!

allReviews.title: Awesome cocktail waitress
allReviews.text: Meily,You are truly an awesome cocktail waitressAlways all smiles and brightens my day when I see you You are always a ray of sunshineThank you for making me feel comfortable every time I’m here Keep doing you girlThank you for being so Amazing Xoxo Diane

allReviews.title: Only Very Dry Complementary Wine Choices Served
allReviews.text: The complimentary wine selection is AWFUL.  Very dry white and red wine. I was able to get a glass of White Zinfandel or Pinot Grigio in the past.  Not anymore.  But you can go to Gold Coast, The Orleans, Red Rock Casino, Palace Station Casino and ANY local casino and you will get complimentary White Zinfandel and/or Pinot Grigio while gambling.  There are Great bartenders at The Palms Tonic Bar - Elias, Enrique, Tracee, Kim, Omar, Danny, Angela, ect.  They said they tried and was not able to get a wine back behind the bar that was not so dry and nasty.

allReviews.title: Fantastic stay at the Palms!
allReviews.text: I had an amazing experience at the Palms Resort and Casino! From start to finish, the staff was friendly, welcoming, and made me feel right at home.A special shoutout to Ame T, one of the hotel receptionists, who was incredibly kind, professional, and accommodating. He made check-in smooth and stress-free, and went out of his way to make sure everything was perfect. It’s always a great sign when someone at the front desk sets such a positive tone for your stay.I stayed in the new tower, and the room was spotless, modern, and very comfortable. Everything felt fresh and well-maintained.Throughout my stay, every team member I interacted with—whether at the front desk, in the casino, or elsewhere—was consistently courteous and helpful. The Palms truly delivers excellent service across the board.Highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a relaxing, enjoyable, and memorable Vegas stay. I’ll definitely be back!

allReviews.title: HORRIFIC
allReviews.text: ABSOLUTELY HORRIBLE IN EVERY WAY!! We checked in and got to our room after riding on a squeaky questionable elevator. The “Fantasy Suite” smelled like old cigarettes The ice machine on our floor wasn’t working so we called the front desk and instead of helping they wanted to tell me how much a bucket of ice and delivery would be? There’s a coffee pot in the room with cups that had Starbucks pods in it and water. No sign, no censors but then they tell you the pods are 3 dollars and the water is 5 dollars? So so guess you get a suite with a coffee pot for looks. After spending money at The Palms we decided no more and went to Cesar’s and gave them our money. I went to VIP services to explain our disappointment and her response was I’mNot losing any money so I don’t care!!!! We didn’t even stay long enough to use all our dining voucher. That’s how bad it is!! I run  a business and we were dumbfounded and honestly couldn’t wait to leave The 1 star is for 2 workers that were kind. One of them AMAZING!! Otherwise I would  have given ZERO stars!!

allReviews.title: Having an enjoyable time.
allReviews.text: Amanda the cocktail waitress was with it a doubt the nicest person I've met while gambling in Vegas. I'm a local that has lived here for fifteen years. I've never written a review in my life. Even though I was losing money she made my time at the palms and experience I still enjoyed. She was very friendly, polite, and promptly brought me drinks.

allReviews.title: Jerry at Palm Player Card Rewards center
allReviews.text: I've been going to San Manuel/Yamava since 1997 California then moved to Las Vegas September 2020 Summerlin. Yamava bought Palms 🌴 casino 2022 and I appreciate how Yamava runs Palms 🌴 casino and this is my main go to casino in the entire Las Vegas strip and local casino's.Having been to many casino's in California and Las Vegas player cards rewards centers I have been pleasantly surprised with the professional service from Jerry at Palms Rewards CenterThis man needs to be Rewards Center Manager someday. He is great with people and very knowledgeable of their computers systems along with understanding of offerings, player points, promotions, etc given by Palms 🌴 casino.

allReviews.title: Palms Eats
allReviews.text: We had a wonderful meal and experience at Serrano Vista Cafe. We were greeted by Dan and seated. Vanessa came and took our orders and our meals came quickly! All I can say is melt in your mouth delicious! We had breakfast and everything was cooked perfectly! Because of Dan and Vanessa and the delicious food its a definite yes to a return here!

allReviews.title: Uncomfortable accommodations
allReviews.text: The hotel was clean and I guess newly updated. I enjoyed the fitness center and the pool area wasn’t busy during the week. However I guess they regulate their AC. They don’t get cooler than 72 and that is HOT if you are a middle aged female. I slept awful and will never stay there again.

allReviews.title: Not pleased
allReviews.text: The casino was beautiful. However the room wasn’t what I expected . It was cleaned properly . And needs new furniture the bathroom needs updated as well. And wasn’t the cleanest! The price didn’t not match the value. Also was located off the strip.

allReviews.title: The palms needs assistance.
allReviews.text: So first off... who doesnt wanna drink in vegas right? I get it.. mini bar rocks except itll cost an arm and a leg! And if u open the fridge it automatically charging ur room. Whether u drank anything or not.. WHAT?! Also, i live in a state where it rarely sees 75! And i come in 90 degrees and cant keep anything cold bc there is no access to a fridge! Totally sucks!  Specially traveling with kids and need to keep water/milk fresh and COLD! No customer should have to pay to use a fridge.. period! We checkd in which went smooth minus the 90 something resort fee AND a 200 hold fee... then we get to headin to our rooms with our bags..  security wont let u thru unless u show ur key card... ok, let me empty my hands to dig in my pockets for u....  they have 1 ply tp.. sad times.. and no trash bags in the rooms. Also sucks u cant even use the coffee machine to make a cup when u wake up.. its 10 bucks for 1 cup outta a kuerig! The parking lot and elevators were dirty and had glass everywhere. Another thing.... why are we a smoking ok environment??? I wouldve stayd elsewherr with my kids had I known the casino was ok for smoking. I will say the room itself is big and spacious. The bathroom is very nice as well. However, we will never stay here again.

allReviews.title: Palms Casino Resort 4321 West Flamingo Road Las Vegas, Nevada
allReviews.text: This is in regard to the NFL Raiders Draft Party on Thursday 4-24-25. I spent $3,400 on tickets for this event for me and my 3 friends. It was out at the pool, and it was so jammed pack you could barely move. The beverages were free, but we stood in line for over a half hour to get our first drink and they had a limited beverage menu. One of the rounds of drinks we got were from a cocktail server. We thought it was better than standing in line. When she came back, she told us she works for tips and waited for us to tip her while staring at us. She was plain rude. I had some choice words for her, but my friends said let it go. We then went to get some food and had to stand in long lines. They ran out of food very quickly and most of the time half the serving dishes were empty. They also ran out of plates, so we had to wait again. Of course there was nowhere to sit. Halfway through the first round of the draft they shut off the audio and blared music way to loud. Some of us were there to enjoy the draft announcements. For the money I spent really this is the kind of service you get. Whoever was in charge of this event failed on all levels. NEVER AGAIN.

allReviews.title: Stay where you feel at home and welcomed .
allReviews.text: I have been staying at Palms Casino resort for over 20 years. There are many options in Vegas to stay at. For me , it’s about the staff and the service .
