I recently stayed at Palms and had a great visit . The staff in the vip services department really set the tone for my stay. In particular Desie and Valerie. They were very welcoming and helped me get settled in. I will be staying at Palms this summer without hesitation and highly recommend this property !

allReviews.title: Liberty rocks give her raise
allReviews.text: Liberty helped me tremendously she rocks I  gamble here and frequent numerous restaurants at Palms she is awesome: wish more locals are like her please promote to ceo asap or I will  spend my money at Harrahs much closer to my home happy Easter God Bless

allReviews.title: Uh-Maz-Ing!
allReviews.text: Everything was amazing! From Valet, to check in, our stay and to check out was smooth and wonderful. Desie in the VIP Lounge went above and beyond with the "Red Carpet" treatment and hospitality. Started our day with refreshing cocktails at the Laguna Pool at Palms Place, had a late lunch at the delicious Tim Ho Wan restaurant and then danced the night away with a beautiful view of the Strip at The Ghostbar. Everyone was courteous with great customer service. Highly recommended to stay here and definitely returning. Summertime at the pool will be fun, yet relaxing. A great getaway to escape for a while. Thank you, Palms Casino Resort!

allReviews.title: Nice hotel, nice casino, good times!
allReviews.text: Lovely rooms, good size, comfortable bed, clean and tidy, good bathrooms, nice mountain views.Complimentary valet parking was great.A little outside noise can be heard at night. Nice casino down stairs.Lovely roof top bar, good views and they gave me a ticket for a free glass of bubbly.However, because my husbands shorts didn’t have belt loops he had to change…. He wore lovely smart black shorts, but had to change to ripped skinny jeans that had belt loops….. silly (only for the rooftop bar).Busy pool with a nice bar and good vibes. Unsure why they only had 1 pool open, this meant many people had no where to sit so couldn’t stay at the pool. Good food options available.We really enjoyed our time here.

allReviews.title: Palms  casino becoming less local friendly
allReviews.text: The Palms when it opened was the best place for locals to gamble . New managers and marketing  are dropping the ball with the offers/ customer service . The highest player card was sent 5$ offers which is down right insulting not a good incentive to keep customers coming back. Lots of changes and cut backs are noted plus I see lots of people resigning . That personalized experience being greeted with a hug or handshake is gone . VIP players got to know the general manager as well as managers from all departments now everyone is MIA .

allReviews.title: Sing Noodles
allReviews.text: Went on our weekly Palms jaunt and had dinner at Send Noodles. The restaurant was full with the exception of the 3 tables which hadn’t been cleaned yet. The take out line was long so Jessica the Hostess was assisting them and let us know waiting in line for a table she would get the tables cleared soon. The take out orders were all picked up but the tables still hadn’t been cleared by the wait staff so Jessica asked us to to give her a moment and went and got a tray then began cleaning a table for us. We thanked and tipped her and said we know it isn’t her job to do that but we appreciated her helping the team.  After she sat us, she went and cleared a table for the next set of guests waiting in line. I asked another employee if there were comment cards but he said to leave a review on here. I hope management sees this and recognizes Jessica for her positive attitude and willingness to help.

allReviews.title: No class for a high limit room stay away! All they do is stand around and not work and talk and ruin guests experience.
allReviews.text: No class for a high limit room stay away! All they do is stand around and not work and talk and ruin guests experience.

allReviews.title: Great birthday celebration
allReviews.text: Celebrated Jaime’s 50th Birthday for 2 days with friends & family.  Thoroughly enjoyed the rooms, cabana/pool, hanging out at the casino, Mabel’s, and kudos to Kevin who helped with all accommodations. The entire staff were friendly & professional. This 50th birthday party was such a success, thanks to the Palms. Can’t wait to go back!

allReviews.title: Best time
allReviews.text: My Las Vegas favorite luxury hotel. Not being on the strip, still vey close, is a blessing. The view from the room is beautiful and breathtaking: the Red Rock mountains and a snowy landscape.The room is great very spacious and I really appreciate the modern design.A special thanks to Desire at the VIP reception. She is always gracious and helpful, making you feel appreciated and welcomed.

allReviews.title: Personal touch in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: The room was spacious , super clean, wide TV screen and specially a great shower. Desire at the VIP reception is the most of the host. She makes you feel welcome at the second you step in the room and will go above and beyond to accommodate your needs. Definitely will be back for another great experience

allReviews.title: Another Satisfied Customer
allReviews.text: The hospitality at the Palms Casino Resort is second to none. Checking in was a breeze with the friendly staff. We had a blast at the poolside cabana during the day. The servers took care of us - took care of our drinks and appetizers, and the were nice enough to help us get the March madness games we wanted to watch on our TV in the cabana. Dinner was great, we enjoyed some good BBQ at Maybels, even got a tour of their smokehouse. Our rooms were perfect, my brother was celebrating his 50th and the penthouse at the Palms made us feel like royalty. What a fun weekend, thanks to all of the support staff from top to bottom that took the time to make our stay a special one!!

allReviews.title: Perfect Surprise 50th Celebration!
allReviews.text: We spent the weekend here to celebrate our friend's surprise 50th birthday, and every aspect of our experience, from check-in to our pool cabana and the various festivities, was exceptional. Kevin, the manager, ensured that all our needs were met, and the service at the cabanas was outstanding. The food and drinks were abundant, and our dinner reservations at the barbecue restaurant were equally delightful. I highly recommend this venue to anyone visiting Las Vegas or looking to celebrate any special occasion.

allReviews.title: Kimi deserves a raise!
allReviews.text: Kimi at the front desk provided some of the best customer service I’ve ever seen. Vegas has gotten really greedy and corporate but the palms and specially my experience with kimi was flawless. I had a tiny issue with my room (not the palms fault) and kimi fixed it and provided a solution immediately. Incredibly refreshing experience.

allReviews.title: First-time Experience
allReviews.text: As a first-time card member, I'm extremely satisfied with the outstanding service of Ms Shirly Manuel at the Rewards Club - she's the 'manuel' labor that makes customer service shine brighter than the Palms Hotel's bright lights. She went beyond her customer service by giving me and my sister the options about the hotel promotions, and was diligent and very detailed, explaining the offers with the precision of a hotel 'check-in' genius. Thank you Palms Hotel for making our stay a delightful experience that was the 'pick' of our vacation. We will definitely be back for a 'suite' deal.

allReviews.title: Good stay
allReviews.text: The room was comfortable with a good view. Sarah Alcantara cleaned our room during our stay. Very clean and very put together. I’m only giving it 4 stars because the A/C did not cool the room enough so we woke up sweaty both nights we slept there. Bathroom was beautiful and it was very comfortable.

allReviews.title: Cafe staff is awesome
allReviews.text: Every morning I come down and have breakfast at the cafe. Mike/Michelle runs the counter area/bar. He is really the center piece of the restaurant. He really does an awesome job, super polite and helpful. Stop by and say hello to Mike/Michelle

allReviews.title: Outstanding stay.
allReviews.text: My husband and I celebrated our 46 wedding anniversary.Our room was beautiful and our housekeeper Violetta Osario was outstanding!She was very friendly and very detailed oriented. We enjoyed all of the restaurants here at the Palms, great service, and outstanding foodWe enjoyed our stay at the Palms.

allReviews.title: Excellent staff
allReviews.text: Outstanding staff.  You gave certain expectations of a Las Vegas institution, and the Palms did not disappoint.  The bartenders and security staff were friendly and helpful.  None of us ever felt like a burden to them.  Would happily return to this hotel again.

allReviews.title: Highly Disappointed
allReviews.text: The service, cleanliness, and maintenance were seriously lacking.  The resort felt like a motel 6 resort compared to the other resorts on the strip.  My room had cobwebs, nonworking hair dryer, road noise from outside, smelled of weed throughout the hall, and my door wouldn't deadbolt.  The staff checking in was less than friendly and even making the reservation to stay there was difficult.  The bell people were kind.  Skip the buffet and take a taxi to the Bellagio's buffet.  For $6 more you get amazing selection and great food.  The Palms buffet lacked heat (temperature) and options.  Couldn't even get the correct soft drinks or get them refilled.  I hope I never have to stay there again.

allReviews.title: Palms Casino Resort/Las Vegas
allReviews.text: My experience with VIP for the 1st time went smoothly.  Desi checked me in and out. My room was very spacious. My bed was very hygienic! I was able to loge at the tower of choice. Noise level ws none! My shower was excellent. I also had brunch and breakfast at the Laguna Pool House & Kitchen. The food was excellent. The staff was A-1. The view of the pool and amenities was excellent. They also have excellent wine choices too! I also dined at Scotch 80 Prime. Go there with a big appetite. The food was excellent. Small bites were served, but looks are deceiving. You won't have room for dessert!

allReviews.title: 6 Fabulous days @ The Palms Resort @ Casino
allReviews.text: We had an amazing experience staying at the Palms Resort & Casino.  The resort, casino, staff, cleanliness and luxury features of the room - were all incredible.A special shout out to Ice from the front desk who was exceptional and went above and beyond in making us feel very welcome.

allReviews.title: Amazing Stay!
allReviews.text: I am so impressed with the cleanliness and attentive staff at the hotel. We stayed in a suite in the fantasy tower that was spacious and well appointed. They have top quality restaurants and the best gaming experience I’ve had in years. The Palms is the best value in Vegas!

allReviews.title: Fun and relaxing
allReviews.text: I am a local, but did a stay vacation Our room was very spacious.  (IVORY Tower) The cooling system might be a little old school, but it worked! My biggest thing was how attentive the bellman, valet and housekeeping were. My only thing was wishing they had mini fridge and microwave in room. Everywhere we stay normally does. Even the older hotels in Laughlin.

allReviews.title: Great service and hotel
allReviews.text: Beautiful hotel room’s spacious and clean customer top notch restaurants very good great place for off the strip but still close to strip highley recommend the quost bar rooftop best view of all Las Vegas would return again the cafe is great for breakfast and the steak restaurant is to die for we wish we was available for the wed  or thurs lobster steal all you can eat buffet but didn’t make reservations in time and we had a show it was only $65pp I heard next time I will definitely do that one I like lobster and the hubby loves steak

allReviews.title: Great Service!
allReviews.text: Reservation and bell desk were exceptional! Pleasant, helpful, competent, responsive! Special kudos to Rean and Maria Galang - what professionalism!! Team was patient and polite. Additionally I appreciate the fact that he asked Maria for assistance when he was posed with a challenge! I would be more hopeful for the hospitality industry if all of the representatives behaved like Rean!!!

allReviews.title: Great experience and value
allReviews.text: Overall good experience for someone who has never stayed at the Palms. We stayed from a Monday to Thursday so the experience may be different during a weekend but overall it was a great experience. It's off the strip but close enough to drive to anything on the strip. I would recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a good spot with access to good food, entertainment, spa, and value.

allReviews.title: Great stay!
allReviews.text: We had a wonderful experience at the Palms Hotel. We enjoyed the steakhouse Scotch 80 Prime, the buffet & the Serrano Vista Cade. We had a fabulous room &the staff were all great, especially Paige working the check in desk. Look forward to visiting again.

allReviews.title: Palms PERFECTION. !!!!
allReviews.text: Superior service by geraldo or was it gerardo , you’ll see in pic . always a bright smile and knowledgeable about the casino . He remembered me from “Sammy’s ISLAND “ opening . (sore going to miss that EXCEPTIONAL POOL ART DECCO AND FOOD MENU . only ther kitchen was too limited on hours but all else was SENSATIONAL !!!) at Stuff i forgot , Holly and her co workers made sure i did NOT forget . went away with very comfortable and matching attire and answered my questions w prompt service . look 4ward2 coming back !!!!

allReviews.title: Big money players go somewhere else
allReviews.text: As a Vegas local, Palms started out with generous free play, prizes and slots.  However, as of February 1, 2025. If you are big money players, I'd recommend somewhere else. Sure the little 88 cents hit small amounts, but not big 880 players. They have become so tight, you could stick a piece of coal up the CFO and it'll come out a diamond.  Rooms are nice in Fantasy tower.  Older tower, not so much. Recommend, based on my experiences the last 3 months,  if you are on the strip, no need to come to palms for slots.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: In all honesty, I was on the fence about staying here but I had a wonderful stay. The room was beautiful and the staff was lovely. The hot water in the shower could've been hotter but that's my only complaint. Everything you need is under one roof, so you don't miss out on being on the Strip. At any rate, you're only a few minutes from the Strip. I would definitely stay at the Palms again.

allReviews.title: Bad Experience
allReviews.text: Came to Palms Casino on a comp from my neighborhood casino. (Bally’s - they’re messy too) I’m disabled and was offered a king bed room by the elevator during booking. I received a 2 full beds room the farthest from the elevator for myself and my husband. (Only key to be found for a room) The mattress was slanted and lumpy so, I kept sliding towards the floor all night and waking up stiff and in pain. Comp came with $50 per night food credit, which no one seemed to know anything about. Like I was only person using this comp. (Buffet food was TERRIBLE and EXPENSIVE anyway!) False charges for the mini bar (sensored for theft), lost thousands in 2 1/2 days because the slots were awful. (came Sunday after 8 and left Wednesday morning) and the room cleaner threw away my shower cap!!! Probably the worst mini vaca I’ve ever had. And on my last morning there, I met Paige (Front desk rep) and I finally felt like an invited guest. Paige fixed EVERYTHING!!! She fixed it without breaking a sweat, without getting angry over my meltdown, and with knowledge and class. Paige should get a promotion because she “Stands on Business”  5 stars for her ONLY. Because of Paige, I actually had a peaceful breakfast on my last morning there. Thank you everything Paige 💜

allReviews.title: Top notch concierge at VIP Registration
allReviews.text: I have stayed at Palms Resort and Casino several times since the reopening in 2022. At the beginning of each stay the first person I meet is either Charlie or Alexis. I love how welcoming both of them are by recognizing me each visit. They handle the logistics of handling the check-in process flawlessly and make sure my needs are met each time. The professionalism just sets the tone for an enjoyable visit each time. A++ I highly recommend staying at Palms to people I know. There are many others that serve their patrons beyond normal expectations.

allReviews.title: The Palms is amazing!!!
allReviews.text: I never write reviews but just wanted to say how much I love the palms and just a few reasons why They have all the latest slot games They always have great concerts with current artists they have the best players club value (free gifts weekly free food weekly and easy to win free buffets for two way more free play than most hotels and great comps on rooms too) I feel like I have more fun at the Palm's bars than most others I've been to in Vegas That's all thanks to their amazing bartenders I loved talking to all of them Tracy at the sports bar was my favorite with her friendly attitude and adorable smile I wish I remembered everyone's name because they were all so super cool!!! Even the security guards would stop by the bar and chat a little from time to time Everyone there just seems to have a super good inviting attitude I highly recommend the Palms and look forward to my next visit hopefully soon!!!!

allReviews.title: Where have you been Palms?! Wow!
allReviews.text: I’ve been coming to LV for 20 yrs and although I’ve gambled at Palms, I’ve never stayed in one of their suites — and it is absolutely perfect. Check in was so easy, friendly and efficient. Was able to check into my room an hour early to wash up and take advantage of all the amenities and casino - the art and personal touches are outstanding, huge Cali king bed with tons of pillow options, large marble bathroom with soaking tub… This suite has it all and I’m just bummed and didn’t make this my home resort years ago. Beautiful spa, tons of restaurants and almost walking distance to Las Vegas Chinatown. It’s a perfect spot! And the band is setting up! Special thanks to Kimi for the welcoming smile and above and beyond attitude. Really appreciate you!

allReviews.title: JERRY!! A true asset!!! At the rewards desk he came through like a total champ when I needed some assistance!!
allReviews.text: JERRY!! A true asset!!! At the rewards desk he came through like a total champ when I needed some assistance!!

allReviews.title: Velma Husic is a jewel 💎
allReviews.text: Palms is always clean and inviting environment. There’s a lady who is always warm and friendly when providing service, Velma Husic. She’s always smiling and very pleasant. Others don’t compare to her… she’s a jewel. 💎 I’ve been coming for years and each time recognize her. I hope she gets to train others!

allReviews.title: The best staycation!
allReviews.text: We had the best experience at the Palms. We started out the day with playing the slots and winning, then went to the lobster buffet and used our reward points for most of it, and then spent a luxurious night in the room. Great views of the strip and very comfortable beds. Great service all around!

allReviews.title: Fantastic property!
allReviews.text: The Palms is our favorite hotel in Las Vegas. It is off the strip but has beautiful views of the more iconic hotels on the strip without having to deal with the traffic. And Free parking! As a resort it is not equal to the premium properties like the Fontainebleau: but the Palms is every bit as elegant and professionally run as many of the famous hotels owned by MGM and Caesar's.

allReviews.title: Top Casino Ever!!!!
allReviews.text: Once you're at Palms Casino, then you'll be stucked there the whole duration of your stay as they're just Awesome. Service is top 1 especially Des and Anna at VIP lounge. For gaming benefits, you sure get a lot of those free food and free play that goes on weekly. Keeps me coming back.

allReviews.title: Awesome time!
allReviews.text: Earned points to get a complimentary 2 nights. Stayed from a Sunday - Tuesday..had an amazing time! Compared to where we stayed before at Gold Coast, (their rooms you could hear everything in the halls and next door, very upsetting) this was a major upgrade. Thought we were being treated to a suite. Turns out these are the regular rooms. Love them!!! Did not hear a thing around us. We got a good nights sleep. Even if we didn't get comped, these rooms are easily affordable. Yes I checked! We met so many great people, a lot of whom worked there. My buddy on the casino floor was Ranko, who always stopped to say Hi! and was always welcomed because he was my good luck charm while playing the slots. We finally ate at A.Y.C.E Buffet and it was worth every penny. Our server Salvador and staff were on their toes and constantly on the go, clearing tables, serving tables and checking in on you to see if you needed anything. We had the great opportunity to meet Sou Chef Carlos Vejar. Super sweet and generous person who gave us tips on what to taste in the buffet. We met the Housekeeping Supervisor Paco who made sure our room was up to par. If we stayed at Gold Coast we would hit all the nearby casinos. This time we stayed the whole time at the Palms. SO much for us to do. We went to the movies, we earned points to get a Emeril Lagasse cookware giveaway, we had good luck on the slots on Sunday where they multiplied our points by 5X, we had breakfast at Serrano Vista Cafe and ate lunch at the Palms Pizza place. I wish we could go back for the holidays. They were in the middle of decorating the casino and hotel for Christmas. We asked to speak to a manager before we left. Manny came out to chat with us thinking something was wrong. We actually just wanted to let him know we loved the Palms and we were so comfortable there. Everyone made us feel so welcomed and to thank his hotel for a relaxing experience. Hope everyone has a great experience just like us.

allReviews.title: Very pleasant
allReviews.text: Jacob G was amazing. He was so helpful ensuring my 30 relatives were all on the same floor and had an easy check-in after a long road trip. I had called several times and no one could assist me but Jacob made the experience better. He was patient, kind and considerate while training Victor C and Andrea T who were also very friendly.

allReviews.title: Lovely hotel but sewage issue
allReviews.text: I love the Palms casino. It's a beautiful space and has excellent staff. We stayed in a King room in the Fantasy Tower. Again, beautiful hallways and room was sparkling clean. Then, around 3 pm the next day we heard a gurgling sound from the bathroom, then another, then something like an explosion of water from the bathroom. Then the smell of sewage hit us. We walked into the bathroom and saw all kinds of purple particulate in the sink, like an ink pen had exploded. The smell was god awful and unmistakably sewage. My toiletries were on the counter and I was certain they had been in the range of the sewage geyser. We called front desk and they said they would send an engineer up. We had to leave the room immediately the smell was so bad. We also explained to housekeeping what had happened. We returned that evening and the bathroom was sparkling clean, like nothing happened. So housekeeping saved the day! But there was no further response from management. No offer of any comps or discounts. That is the reason why I will sadly not stay here again. When something like that happens, amends need to be made financially. Period.

allReviews.title: Recently renovated facility, casino and pool very nice.
allReviews.text: The room was very large on the 11th with a beautiful view. We spent a half day in the pool which has all the facilities (towels, bar, various food, music with DJ set) but you can not bring anything from outside even water.The casino is very nice and not shabby at all (as we found others from Las Vegas) with minimum wagering acceptable to all types of players (even $15).We liked the attention of the staff in always requesting the card key for the rooms before accessing the elevators and the room top of ghostbar where we went on Friday night

allReviews.title: Good, but Michelle the waitress above all.
allReviews.text: I had a wonderful morning breakfast at their Serano Vista Cafe, food was good but Michelle our waitress was above & beyond other employee there we intertwined with during our stay. Hardworking with a smile as an individual overall it made our stay at the Palms much better even after finding out about a few "mini bar" extras we didn’t use and this added $42 "resort fees/ plus tax total of $47 above the hotel room per day added cost, much easier to swallow.

allReviews.title: Meily Rocks!
allReviews.text: Meily(cocktail waitress)was really welcoming and outstanding.  Great customer service from her. Nice and friendly and took great care of us. It's  people like her that makes me want to keep coming back. Thank you Meily! Keep up the good work.

allReviews.title: Best server in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Totally enjoy going to the Palms to play the slot machines with my roommate!!! Amanda Gutierrez is a phenomenal server!!! She remembered me even after being gone for two months!  Best server and service ever!!! I give Amanda a million star review!!!

allReviews.title: Dirty rooms and rude, passive-aggressive bellhop
allReviews.text: We went for the American Film Market and stayed a full week at the hotel. Our experience was mixed and I kind of hope they change hotels next year. We wouldn’t stay there again either way. The rooms were spacious, but not very clean. There was food or blood on the corner of our bed when we arrived and there was actual poop on the outside of our toilet—again, on arrival! 😱 One day, we came back to our room and found housekeeping had left the minibar open and left our trash bags outside the room. I had to call the desk as the minibar has some kind of sensor and I was worried they’d try charging us.Serrano Vista Cafe has great oat milk cappuccinos and avocado toast, but expect to pay Vegas prices, of course. Staff were friendly and helpful there though! Meanwhile, some hotel staff were super helpful and friendly too, while others were average,  but then there was one bellhop who was shockingly rude and passive-aggressive, even going so far as to lie to us tonight about where our Uber driver would pick us up, trying to get us to carry our luggage across the hotel without a trolley. Thank god, I called the driver first. Living in Europe, we weren’t aware of certain tipping customs and didn’t even have many USD on us when we landed anyway. We had to look up the norms after we arrived. While we gave the bellhop what would’ve been a normal tip in Italy or the UK when we arrived, it was apparently less than recommended in Las Vegas. Upon leaving tonight, he commented about “remembering us,” while being extremely rude. The irony is that I tipped his colleagues this morning for the luggage storage (the morning bellhop was super lovely all week!) and I planned to leave the rest of my USD to him tonight ($20) when collecting the luggage. His appalling behavior meant I left him nothing and had a very happy Uber driver instead. If PCR reads this, whoever the head of your bell desk was at 5pm on 11/11/24, he needs a different line of work. Your morning guy though is ace—super smiley and kind!

allReviews.title: Serrano Vista Cafe
allReviews.text: Serrano Vista Cafe is the place to go for Breakfast at The Palm! Mary Ann is just fantastic and runs the floor with energy and a smile!  You get a very good variety of food. From anyway you like em eggs to pancakes, French toast and waffles. Health conscious? No problem! Oatmeal, fruit parfait and avocado toast. And the coffee is good and strong and lest I forget the bakery items!  Donuts that'll carry you over through lunch. You're at the Palms for a convention or to gamble Serrano Vista Cafe is a very good way to start your Vegas day.

allReviews.title: Club Serrano, Reward Center. Kindness!
allReviews.text: Can’t say enough about Jan Jan (Janise) and Jerry of Club Serrano. They both were totally awesome! They were so nice, patient, kind and knowledgeable. They took the time to help my self and Ersel. We learned so much from both of them. They represent some of the very best at the Palms Casino! Great job you two. Thanks again for everything.Regards, Vikki & Ersel

allReviews.title: Amanda G. The G stands for Great!
allReviews.text: Amanda G was the absolute best! We have never had such great service from a cocktail waitress the whole time we have lived in Vegas. She was so kind and thoughtful and was the reason we stayed and gambled longer than originally planned. She deserves a raise!

allReviews.title: Palms is The best !!
allReviews.text: Palms is the best !! The hotel room , comfortable , clean , perfect , food delicious wherever you eat in there, cafe salmon the best ! Ghost bar , ladies night , like a dream , dancing , laughing , great crowd , DJ, best views ever of strip and Vegas , outside patio , I love it at the palms , thank you Michael at front desk for all your help , you are awesome personality   , professional , kind , excellent customer service , always smiling , very helpful . Thank you Nicole at front desk , sweet , great customer service , help with a great room , and thank you Tavaris ,  you are professional , great personality , always helpful , awesome, you are  a great team at front desk , great assets to palms , each deserve a big raise , they were all definitely part of my perfect , great stay at the palms , I will be back , thank you I highly recommend the palms !!!!

allReviews.title: Stay elsewhere!
allReviews.text: Awful! Run-down and dirty property. Stayed in the Ivory tower as part of a conference group. Unfolded the bath mat to find several dead bugs in the towel. Antiquated heating/cooling controls so it made it very difficult to regulate temperature. Extremely uncomfortable bed and pillows

allReviews.title: Nice rooms, but...
allReviews.text: I stayed here for the last night of my USA trip. My room was large and comfortable, with amazing views, and I had a great night's sleep. The only disappointment was the restaurant. I decided to treat myself to their upscale Italian restaurant, Vetri Cucina, on the 56th floor. Unfortunately, half the restaurant was partitioned off by an (open) glass door, with an extremely LOUD corporate drinks reception on the other side. Imagine music thumping away and 40 or 50 people talking over it at the tops of their voices, just feet away from where you're trying to enjoy your meal. The waiter and I had to shout at each other to be heard. Why they hadn't warned me about this when I booked, or even just closed the restaurant for the evening, I don't know. The food itself was reasonably good, but nothing like as good as the prices might have you imagine - clearly priced for the location, rather than the quality.

allReviews.title: STAY AWAY!!
allReviews.text: It is absolutely ridiculous that not only did I not get the hotel I reserved, but also did not get the room type I reserved. I had to go to two different places to get checked in. When I arrived at Palms Place, their front desk first said that they couldn't find my booking. Then I proceeded to call Expedia, but no one answered the phone. The only response I received was through the chat. The rep in the chat said my booking was fine and asked me to try again. The front desk finally found the booking using a name instead and gave me the 5 digit confirmation they kept asking for, but couldn't be provided by Expedia. Then they proceeded to tell me that my hotel got switched from Palms Place to Palms casino and asked me to go over there to check in. They assured me that the 5 digit confirmation number would be correct. When I got to Palms casino, I had to wait in line again to only have their front desk tell me that the 5 digit confirmation from Palms Place was actually wrong. They were willing to give me a room in the Fantasy Tower, so I figured that would be comparable to the Studio Suite that I booked originally. The Studio Suite was supposed to have amenities like refrigerator, microwave, cookware, and utensils. The casino side claimed that they didn't have such a suite type of room but it would still be a two queen. After an hour of back and forth trying to check in, we went up to our room only to find out it only had one king rather than two queens as promised. I called the front desk and they said they would have someone bring me the room keys for a two queen in the same tower. I waited another 20 minutes and no one came. They called saying they didn't have a room in Fantasy Tower anymore and only had a two queen in the Ivory Tower, which is the old tower. We didn't want to wait anymore and we told the front desk that we would just go downstairs to get the new keys. We entered the room at the Ivory Tower and noticed that the A/C was super loud. We requested to switch to another room and this time the A/C was normal, but the bathroom tub was horrifying with paint peeling and rust. It was like a tub you'd get from Motel 6. By that time, we had no more energy to tell the front desk anymore. Also had to call housekeeping to get a DND tag. On checkout day, housekeeping freaking knocks on your door with the DND tag hanging and it was before checkout time at 11am.  This stay has to be the worst ever we've had in Las Vegas and we come here quite often.

allReviews.title: Gambling Cocktail Service
allReviews.text: DeSantis was  wonderful casino floor  waitress!  She paid attention to us and was a joy to have serve us. We have had her service  many times while gaming and always does a great job.  Looking forward to  seeing her the next time we come in.  She brightens our nights.

allReviews.title: Overall good stay but needs improvement
allReviews.text: This is a nice place to stay on Vegas off the strip. But there were a few things that need improvement. I waited 30-45 minutes for check in at around 7 pm. While two female employees were trying to check in 15-20 people as many as four other employees stood around the bell desk doing nothing for the entire time. As most of the front desk staff were women it looked like gender discrimination problem in addition to resulting in unnecessary waits for guests who were exhausted from travel. Also I like that they offered veggie options but there were not enough and they did not taste good. Clearly no vegetarian cooks ensuring it actually tastes good. If you’re going to do it do it right. Also I would never bring family here because no fridge in the rooms and big fine if you put your stuff in the minibar. Last they need a year round pool.

allReviews.title: Great location. Room is better than most. Some opportunities for improvement
allReviews.text: Large room, well maintained and clean. Good customer service. Lots of food options at the hotel. Parking is a bit sketch.  One of the largest rooms that I've stayed in Vegas. And, had a nice view of the Strip. Close to Chinatown, which is where I eat often. Check-in and out was quick and efficient, however, when I checked-in, there was no one at the front desk. After about 5 mins, one rep finally stepped out. The biggest challenge is parking. I stayed in the tower on the east side of the hotel. There is a parking lot directly adjacent. Even though there are multiple floors, there are only a small number of spaces available, if you're not a casino VIP.  It's quite dark and I didn't see any security in the lot, during my 3 days in the hotel. I would recommend parking in the large parking lot of the west side of the casino, but it's a considerable walk from the hotel towers.

allReviews.title: Palms Rocks!!!
allReviews.text: Danny is by far the best bartender in town!  The staff at the Palms is on another level. I will be back soon!!  Great experience!  The spa is also a must when at the Palms!! Fine dining at both scotch and the Italian restaurant were on point!  Pool was also a great place to chill!

allReviews.title: Summary of our visit
allReviews.text: The rooms were beautiful, so were the pool and the casino. The service was amazing - Rean, our receptionist was kind, polite, helpful, and he even upgraded our room for free. The hotel was really clean. The breakfast at the casino restaurant was super delicious!

allReviews.title: Great hotel away from the bustle of the strip
allReviews.text: We stayed in an Ivory Deluxe room. Very comfy bed, good space and spotless. It’s a 10 min cab ride or 30 min walk from the Strip which makes it a little less busy . Busy enough, good vibe and atmosphere but not as rammed as the Strip casinos. Pool area is excellent, food options ranging from McDonalds, BBQ joint to fine dining. It’s an LV casino, so nothing is free (actually parking is), but being off the Strip makes it noticeable cheaper. $10 for a G&T is half the price of Caesars or the Belagio, etc. The Ghost Bar is worth a visit with a view of the LV skyline that you just can see from the Strip hotels. My only gripe was the lack of a late checkout option. Would stay again.

allReviews.title: Great Customer Service
allReviews.text: MARY ,friendly employee at Players Club was soooo helpful & nice.I hope they give her a raise.Every time we go there & she is working she is always sweet & even if it's busy she has a Smile on her face.The employees at the Players Club really work hard !

allReviews.title: The palms remodel is awesome
allReviews.text: Jessica at the front desk went above and beyond to get me a room in new tower. It is a real Fantasy being in the Fantasy tour. I won't stay anywhere else. I was upset with my stay last time here but I'm very happy this time. I was also very impressed with tim ho wan restaurant for the dim sum meal.

allReviews.title: Amazing trip to Vegas!
allReviews.text: Maria at the front desk was amazing!!! We had so many different request for her. She was so accommodating and was able to achieve everything that we asked of her! She also was so knowledgeable! The hotel stay was great but I would come back because of Maria and how nicely we were treated! Everyone should have a Maria at there front desk!

allReviews.title: Nice place away from the main strip
allReviews.text: Really nice restaurant, away from the strip, nice city views and amenities. There was a spa however due to busy period I was unable to book treatments at the spa, which was disappointing, there were great bars and food places with good choice. Nice place to relax after being at the strip

allReviews.title: Our housekeeper Sarah made our trip exceptional!
allReviews.text: Sarah Alcantara was our housekeeper and she was exceptional. She was very kind and was always on top of whatever we needed for our business accommodations. She is the type of person you want taking care of things. She deserves a really good review.

allReviews.title: Decent hotel and value
allReviews.text: This is a lovely hotel off the Strip. It's not too big so quick and easy to get to your room. We stayed in the Ivory Tower and the room was good. Bed very comfortable and we had a great view.Drinks and food were reasonably priced compared to other hotels on the Strip.Biggest complaint was that they shut one half of the pool area in the week with no explanation, in fact reception staff pleased ignorance to it even happening! This meant guests were squashed into one part of the pool that went into shade by 2pm.Uber / Lyft to Strip ranged from 8 to 18 dollars which got expensive when we were going in and out day and night. We chose to get the bus on a number of occasions which was right outside and much cheaper.

allReviews.title: It was a great and fun experience.
allReviews.text: The services and amenities are excellent. The place is clean and well kept. It doesn’t smell smoke like in some hotel casino resorts. It has  beautiful views inside the hotel. I recommend the place and would like to come back to stay for a vacation.

allReviews.title: A petty bs extravaganza.
allReviews.text: Skip this place. They will nickel and dime the hell out of you. They won't even let you take your little water bottle to the pool that they just charged u $5+ dollars for at the kiosk next to it, despite the fact that your group has a whole pool booth booked. It's the type of petty bs that will annoy the hell out of guests. Do better!

allReviews.title: Best Experience at the Palms
allReviews.text: The best service!  Got aconplimentary rooms and Alexis at the VIP Lounge got me an uograde.  She is as nice as she is beautiful 😀The Fantasy Towers was my room.  The executive suite looks brand new and modern.  has a huge window, dining table, a room with a king bed, and the couch outside that turns into a bed.

allReviews.title: Excellent Stay Off-Strip
allReviews.text: The Palms has quickly become our go-to Casino and Resort to play and stay at when we make trips to Vegas.Location-wise, it is off-strip but a very quick drive if you need to head out that way for a show. There's a really nice view of the strip from Ghost Bar, too.The rooms are relatively clean and updated. I would recommend staying in the Fantasy Tower over the Ivory Tower if available as they feel a bit "fresher" and have larger TVs. Security always checks your room key so you feel secure. Dining options are fantastic here. Scotch 80 is an incredible steak house and a dinner favorite for us. I still hope they will bring back the scallop crudo - one of the best bites I've ever had. You can't go wrong with the bone-in filet mignon and all of the appetizers and sides are fantastic, too. Tim Ho Wan is great for dim sum, and there's also an Italian restaurant, 24 hour cafe, pizza place, and fast-casual restaurants like McDonald's and Panda Express. They also have AYCE, a buffet with lobster special on Wednesdays and Thursdays.There are plenty of slot machines and they change up the layout and add new machines frequently. Table games are also solid with a good variety of baccarat, blackjack, pai gow, ultimate texas hold'em, craps, roulette, and more. We always have a good time, win or lose.Shout out to our host, Erno, who always takes care of us and is just the best host ever! We wish he could be our host everywhere. We also adore Velma on the casino floor, who is super sweet and friendly. She makes sure we stays hydrated so we can continue gambling ;)

allReviews.title: Palms Has Gone DownHill. Not Resort Vibe. No Shopping, Pool Sucks, Vibe Sucks, Has Gone Downhill.Ghostbar has same music
allReviews.text: Palms Has Gone DownHill. Not Resort Vibe. No Shopping, Pool Sucks, Vibe Sucks, Has Gone Downhill.Ghostbar has same music

allReviews.title: Convenient location
allReviews.text: It’s a very nice hotel with spacious clean room. The location is convenient- not far from the main strip but we still took a taxi to get there as it is bit too far to walk.  There is a casino on site and a lot of restaurants to choose from but is also a pharmacy and shop nearby. The staff is helpful and polite. Unfortunately due to the windy weather the pool was closed. If you enjoy night life than this hotel with casino is definitely for you!

allReviews.title: Liberty at the Palms!
allReviews.text: The Palms is an amazing property as they've persevered and flourished. The staff is amazing especially Liberty who is quick with the drinks and always with a smile. Great dining options, pools and theaters. So many reasons to just stay on property

allReviews.title: Kind customer service from Haben!
allReviews.text: Haben (at the front desk) was such a kind person and he went the extra mile to get me a complimentary upgrade for my birthday! I was so happy and surprised! His effort made all of the difference in my trip. Instead of being in the old tower we were able to go to the new one.

allReviews.title: Tracey at the Tonic bar was great!
allReviews.text: At the tonic bar near the sports book, Tracey served us. What a great personality, so sweet and bubbly and funny. She took such great care of us, and had everyone at the bar laughing and happy. We will definitely come back to see her when we visit Vegas again!

allReviews.title: Cocktail server
allReviews.text: Palms Casino is great. I have to say Liberty the cocktail server is the best. She is on her game and always giving the best service. Every time I have got to see her she's running around with a smile and always so pleasant. Thank you for doing a great job

allReviews.title: Outstanding service
allReviews.text: Amazing service from Liberty,Dee Dee, Kim at tonic sports bar ! Cyrus. Britney always a pleasure to have them take care of us . We’re regular guest be back in September for a concert. Look forward to seeing them again. Your casino is blessed to have them

allReviews.title: Chic & Peaceful Vegas Style
allReviews.text: From the time I arrived, Michelle at the front desk was super helpful and accommodating in the most professional way. She was a welcome experience after a long drive from Pasadena. Our suite was spectacular—spacious and with everything we needed. Including an ice maker! Loved our space and the shared spaces throughout. I especially loved walking over to the adjoining Palms for a more expansive Vegas vibe: casinos, food courts, movie theatre etc, and being able to retreat to our cozy spot at the end of long days of basketball games. This is our preferred space when we travel to Vegas.

allReviews.title: Nice Property but poor service
allReviews.text: Nice property but no service. Room was not cleaned once during a 2 night stay.Nice food court with a McDonalds and Earl of Sandwich which I liked and used a few times. Had $50 food credit but didn’t use it as preferred to pay for the restaurants I liked in the food court.Checking was easy and quick.Room clean on arrival. Wi-Fi didn’t work and shower water pressure very poor.Nice TV with YouTube.Check out took ages as only one member of staff on duty.

allReviews.title: Very nice hotel & casino
allReviews.text: I decided to surprise my husband with a belated anniversary staycation & dinner at AYCE Buffet. I reserved a comped king room in the Fantasy Wing. I received a notification that our room was ready a few hours before check in time so we arrived earlier than expected. Paige greeted us at the front desk. She was so pleasant & very professional. She offered us an upgrade to a corner suite for a few dollars more. Except for a few housekeeping & maintenance issues, the suite was nice. Views were great. Wish I had booked it for more than just an overnight stay but I really just wanted to have a room to sleep in after overindulging at the AYCE lobster & crab buffet! LOL We will definitely return in the future.

allReviews.title: GREAT HOTEL AND CASINO
allReviews.text: GREAT HOTEL! CLEAN ROOMS! STAFF HOSPITALITY WAS EXCELLENT! POOL CABANA IS A MUST! VERY RELAXING. EVERY RESTAURANT AND THE FOOD WAS AWESOME! SOME WILL SAY VEGAS NEVER PAYS. PUT MY PALMS CLUB REWARDS CARD IN THE SLOT MACHINE. WON SOME $$$.... I WILL ALWAYS STAY HERE IN VEGAS...DON'T STAY ANYWHERE....SEE YOU NEXT MONTH PALMS!

allReviews.title: $7.77 Breakfast is GONE! NOOOOO!
allReviews.text: We came to the Serrano Vista Cafe for the special breakfast $7.77, affordable, great quality and quantity, only to find out they stopped the special on August 6, 2024. So disappointing, the cafe is now empty with servers just waiting for customers. Palms was finally a place that felt like old Vegas, total let down. Won’t be back. We did stay and ordered the cheapest meal, porridge for $9, boring. Our server Michelle was great, super friendly, observant and kind.

allReviews.title: OUR DAUGHTER BIRTHDAY CELEBRATION
allReviews.text: NICE HOTEL DID NOT LIKE NOT LIKE  HAVING NO DOORS ON THE SHOWER OR BATHROOM AND THE ROOMS ARE WAY TO SMALL BUT THE ROOMS ARE CLEAN AND POOLS ARE VERY NICE THE KIDS ORDERED A CABANA AND THEY LOVED IT!!! THE FOOD WAS REALLY GOOD ALSO BUT I DONT THINK WE WILLL RETURN BECAUSE OF THE SMALL ROOMS .

allReviews.title: Outstanding Customer Service
allReviews.text: The check-in line was long on Sunday August 18, 2024 and my wife was waiting for assistance. Charlie from the VIP area came to help move the check-in process. Charlie showed my wife to the VIP area and when I arrived she was sitting comfortably and checking in. Charlie fixed us up with a beautiful room and we had a great stay. Also this was my wife's birthday and we played and enjoyed the dining venues too. Thank you Cherlie for your professional and friendly manner.You are a credit to the Palms organization

allReviews.title: Sammy's Island Sundaze
allReviews.text: returned to Island Sundaze at Sammy Hagar's pool at the palms.  I finally ordered the nachos which are more than enough for 2!  We also indulged in the chicken tenders which came with a variety of fried potatoes, including tater tots and french fries.

allReviews.title: Best hotel for kids
allReviews.text: Best resort for kids.  We are used to the Wynn where there is not much for kids.  We booked a room and cabana this trip.  From the dining venues to the pool my three kids, aged 8, we were welcomed with opened arms.   We have been here without kids and had similar awesome experiences.

allReviews.title: The casino a dangerous place caused by security
allReviews.text: Be careful and my suggestion would be never to set foot in the palm's casino resort I've gambled there . loss Lots of money and I thought that I would be treated with. Respect. But the security are overbearing Thugs They are Beyond rude and they bully everybody There are numerous other casinos that treat people with the utmost respect. So there's no reason you need to go to the palms and put yourself in that Environment

allReviews.title: Don't do it.
allReviews.text: Staying here and all the pools are closed. Ridiculous. They have 3. One closed high winds, the other a jud pooped in, the 3rd has been blocked off for no reason. It's 100 degrees. Everyone is pissed. Also got here at 5 since that's when its bearable to be outside. Just found out pools close at 6. The whole place is tired and ghetto.

allReviews.title: Great to see Tracey back at the Tonic sports bar
allReviews.text: I visited the Palms on July 23 and 24, and it was great to see your bartender, Tracey, back at the Tonic sports bar.  She is consistently friendly and attentive to her customers, including a lot of regulars who stopped by.  She makes great cocktails and she has a great sense of humor.  She works very hard but still takes the time to be attentive to her guests.  I'll be back in August -- can't wait to see her at my favorite sports bar in Vegas, the Tonic!

allReviews.title: Clean,  friendly,  convenient.
allReviews.text: Eat at the Serrano Vista Cafe! Delicious food. Our server Michelle B. Is incredible and provides exceptional service.  Super friendly and polite. A+ . Hotel is clean, good food options,  night life, etc. Staff is friendly,  nice bars and lounges.

allReviews.title: Best Sports Bar in Vegas!
allReviews.text: Visted the Tonic Bar at the Palms Casino today and luckily the fantastic bartender Tracey was working!  She does an outstanding job with a smile on her face and makes you feel at home.  The staff there is awesome and total pros, thank you Kim, Omar, and Brittany, all of you rock!  This is the best sports bar in Vegas and I can't recommend enough.  Can't wait to go back and see staff, they are the best!

allReviews.title: Love Serrano Vista Cafe at Palms
allReviews.text: We ate at the Serrano Vista Cafe in the Palms Casino and the food was delicious. Their menu had such a great variety from Mexican, to Asian and traditional American meals.  Server Michelle was so friendly and courteous. She made the experience so enjoyable .  I would recommend this place to anyone as it is the best experience of any I have had in Vegas for dining.

allReviews.title: The Palms Rock
allReviews.text: Staying with family and enjoying the hotel and all its amenities, including the pool. Great place to stay for the weekend! Tracy at The Tonic Bar made us our yummy favorite drink with a friendly sweet smile, would recommend the Tonic bar to chill and relax .

allReviews.title: Excellent 5 STAR 🌟 customer service!
allReviews.text: Today I had an amazing experience at the Tonic Bar with great customer service provided by bartender Tracey!!She provided excellent above and beyond customer service!!Five Star 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟!!I highly recommend stopping by and saying hello!

allReviews.title: Clean resort and nice staff
allReviews.text: We had a pleasant stay at the Palms resort. The rooms were clean and the resort was well-maintained. The staff was friendly and thoughtful. Oscar, one of the staff members, was very helpful and contributed to a great experience during our stay.

allReviews.title: You won’t be disappointed!!!
allReviews.text: Everything about staying here was amazing starting with Ana she was amazing!!! The room was immaculate and the bed was just what I needed!!! The Shaggy concert was perfect!!! Can Yall please tell me where the Nachos we ate at the pool came from lol This will be where I stay anytime I’m in Vegas!!!

allReviews.title: Never a dull moment
allReviews.text: The hotel was beautiful, the restaurant had great food and the staff was very friendly. Especially Ana McIntyre, she was very attentive and made everything so smooth possible for us.  Her recommendations made our trip worth wild and highly recommended. Her service was immaculate.

allReviews.title: Great! stay at the Palm
allReviews.text: great stay at the palm! we came from the UK to Vegas to get married and the Palm is where we decided to stay for five nights. we came in August and it was very hot. we stayed on floor 18 of the ivory tower. the room was very spacious and clean and the view from our window was amazing. you could see Vegas part of the strip and mountains. the only downside to the room is that there was no tea and coffee making facilities and the mini fridge that is in the room is full of stuff that you have to buy, being from the UK. I would like a kettle to make a cup of tea in the morning, it wasn't the end of the world. casino grounds itself are amazing and huge. all the staff are really helpful and friendly. there are lots of slots and games to play and there are a variety of food and drink places within the casino to eat breakfast, lunch and dinner. we only briefly went out to see the pool area which is a nice size clean and look like a good vibe. but unfortunately since it was 45° here there was no chance we were sitting out there as it was too hot. the only thing to moan about is when the cleaner came in and cleaned our room. they didn't empty the bins which was slightly annoying but again not the end of the world. the rooms are fully equipped with irons and hair dryers which is a bonus for our skills so we don't have to pack it. they have vending machines and ice dispensers on every floor which was a lifesaver in this weather. the hotel itself is off the strip. I'd say it's a 45-minute walk or a 5 to 10 minute Uber journey. wear it slightly more out of the way it is quieter which we enjoyed. would definitely recommend booking this hotel.

allReviews.title: Great food Great services
allReviews.text: Had amazing lunch today at Serrano Vista cafe at the palms food was amazing and our server Aquila was great and friendly.  Aquila recommend the mimosa flight omg delicious. Thank you for amazing time we will definitely be back best cafe. Thank you

allReviews.title: Kindness
allReviews.text: Joanna was kind, friendly, and professional, helping us have a positive check-in experience. The bell staff was accommodating and quick. Now my mouth is watering, we just got in the room and we are all excited to eat a juicy steak at Scotch 80!

allReviews.title: The Palms cars
allReviews.text: The staff here really cares about their guests. I’ve been staying here now for years and they are always accommodating and always try to make sure that it’s a pleasurable experience. Thank you to Michael and Muhammad for doing such great work.

allReviews.title: Rooms need attention
allReviews.text: I love the Pearl, and the free parking is a nice perk. I stayed in the hotel for the first time recently and my experience started to decline. The front desk agent was nice and the room was big and quiet. Unfortunately the room left much to be desired. The shower was dirty, the thermostat was so old you couldn't set the temperature, the mattress was hard and the room had a smell I couldn't place. I'll definitely be back for concerts, but I don't think I'll be staying there again.

allReviews.title: Excellent. I can't wait to come back
allReviews.text: We loved the room service rendered by this employee Sarah Alcantara. She was very sociable and kind. She kindly attented to our inmediate needs and left our room very cleaned. I would love to come back to this elegant and pleasant room 17205.

allReviews.title: Outstanding service and excellent experience
allReviews.text: The room was extremely clean and the bathroom was exquisite. The shower had a lot of power and all the amenities. The room was very clean and the view was great. The room attendant, Jenifer.O., was outstanding and clean the room very professionally. She worked extremely fast and hard. I was very impressed. The casino is very organized and clean and all the help very accommodating. The restaurants are all very good. Getting ready to go down to the pool area for the day, I would highly recommend this place as one of the top places in Las Vegas. The machines are much looser than the casinos on this trip.

allReviews.title: New Home in Sin City
allReviews.text: We have been staying at the Palms for our last seven trips to Vegas. We love it!  The entire experience is consistently great. Awesome restaurants, friendly employees and wonderful accommodations. If you gamble they have the best comps we've seen. Check it out...

allReviews.title: Very nice, but we did have one problem.
allReviews.text: We stayed at the Palms last summer. It was very nicely laid out, very clean, and the staff we dealt with was friendly and helpful. We did experience one problem. The mattress in our fantasy king room was extremely soft. It seemed to be worn out. Very uncomfortable. I placed a call to the hotel after returning home. We are booked there again, so hoping that we have a more comfortable bed to go along with the otherwise positive experience that we had in our first stay.

allReviews.title: Comfortable stay
allReviews.text: Great very spacial room, nice views and convenient location. Hotel was very clean and had all the amenities. The staff members are nice and professional. Special thanks Manny (at the reception) for the service! Very reasonable price for what you get.

allReviews.title: Great vibes
allReviews.text: We were here to celebrate my husbands birthday and 4th of July. After much research, we decided to book Palms because they had great amenities and prices for the rooms was great. I had a very pleasant check in experience with Oscar, he advised on the best ways to enjoy the property. Sadly, the 4th of July rooftop fireworks was sold out, we should’ve booked it when we booked the room. But the rooftop bar was amazing, and so was playing at the tables. The dealers made it really fun, and responsible gambling is emphasized here. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and we will be coming back.

allReviews.title: 30th Anniversary Trip
allReviews.text: We are annual Vegas travelers who have never stayed off-strip but often visited the Palms and wanted to give it a try for our 30th wedding anniversary. After a rocky start (room keys not working, assigned an occupied room, and a broken television), Krista at the front desk absolutely made our trip amazing! She upgraded us to a corner suite and made it even more special with decorations, wedding cake and champagne! She was absolutely a joy to work with and made this a special and memorable vacation! The only reason that I'm rating the Palms four stars is that the air conditioning simply couldn't match the Vegas heat. Both our room and the casino just didn't cool down enough to be totally comfortable. We will definitely return, and our most heartfelt thanks and appreciation to Krista. She is awesome!!

allReviews.title: Looking forward to returning to the Palms
allReviews.text: The Palms is my new favorite place to stay! Far enough away from the overloaded strip, but close enough if you want to venture out that way! The hotel amenities are great as well as the cleanliness of the well appointed rooms. All the staff members are on point. Special shout out to Loreto at the Serrano Vista Cafe. She was very sweet and helpful and a delight ! C Sweikhart

allReviews.title: Joanne was amazing!!
allReviews.text: Joanne Who was working at the front desk was so patient and kind with me as I was trying to figure out my Charges to my room on my credit card. I was worried because it looked like there was a lot of unauthorized charges. She went above and beyond to break down the bill and explain to me what the charges were and how I would be able to get my deposits back she even even rode everything down on a card line by line. She was so amazing. I just really wanna make sure that she gets credit for what a great job she did.!!

allReviews.title: Sammy's Island Experience
allReviews.text: My family rented a cabana at the pool.  I just think it could have been cleaner for how much $$ we spent.  The cushions were all over the place and dirty with crumbs and hair from yesterday's guests I suppose?  We were there at 11:30 am so I think we were the first of that day to use the cabana.   On a good note:  The staff were friendly, working hard and so were the bartenders at the Tequila Bar!

allReviews.title: Wonderful Vegas Resort
allReviews.text: This resort was fantastic! Clean, great food, wonderful room (we got the strip view rooms) and even better staff! We made it a point to mak it to the Seafood Buffet and it was DELUXE! We had great food, wonderful company and truly enjoyed our time. We will definitely be back!

allReviews.title: It was a great stay. I want to acknowledge one particular staff who stood out (Paige at the front desk).
allReviews.text: It was a great stay. I want to acknowledge one particular staff who stood out (Paige at the front desk).

allReviews.title: Great Saturday
allReviews.text: Had a great time at palms pool.  In a time where local resorts are getting greedy with covers and such, palms offers free pool days on weekends.  Reasonable drink prices.   Awesome staff.   Shout out to Patricia @the unknown lounge for being absolutely amazing.  Will for sure be back!

allReviews.title: Got a penthouse, I left being accused and charged with stealing.
allReviews.text: After getting a Penthouse for my girlfriend's 50th, the trip went downhill. We were ready to leave, and I noticed all these bogus mini bar charges. After clearing that up and leaving for home, I noticed a charge for $150. I called and the lady at front desk told me "I see here in the notes you stole a Keurig Machine, so there's a charge for room damage of $150." I couldn't believe it. Instead of enjoying my time and celebrating a birthday, I was forced to be on the phone with agents who got worse and worse. After TWO DAYS of getting home and trying to clear these charges, I got a call that they were. No apology, no remorse, nothing. I was accused, insulted, charged and stressed. I tried emailing and telling them about my experience, and I got no response. This was all I needed to know. I'm a big spender, and they lost me over $150.

allReviews.title: Great off strip propery
allReviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at the Palms. The room was clean and comfortable. The casino is clean and has a nice selection of slots, VP, and table games. Mabel's was closed which was a bummer. The brunch is definitely worth the $33 price, especially with the bottomless mimosas!Shout out to Paige at the front desk for being so friendly and helpful. Also, Pam at the VP bar who got me well prepared for my flight (scared of flying) with a few stiff drinks. All of the staff was friendly and helpful.

allReviews.title: Look no further book here.
allReviews.text: This is the spot!!! It was our first trip to Vegas ever! This was a family trip and we couldn’t have ask for a better hotel or area! The staff was very tentative. Our sink in the bathroom stopped up and they immediately came to fix it. When they finished they made sure housekeeping came to keep it up. The pool hours are kinda odd 10-6 I would suggest they be longer due to the heat. You aren’t allowed to even take water in the pool area. To me that seems a little bit too much. They will give you water at the bar but it gets hot before you can even drink it. The parking is free so that was a plus. The only negative thing I have to say is the AC in the room would no go below 68. We kept it set to 50 at all times. But 68 seemed to be its peak. I guess that maybe due to the extreme heat there. Also if you book through TripAdvisor/Expedia the rooms are much cheaper!! Over all it was a wonderful stay off the strip but close to enough. I would give it a 10/10 for cleanliness in the rooms.

allReviews.title: Great Experience
allReviews.text: The palms really delivered! It was a great room, Check In experience, and the shower was fantastic.  The pool staff was extremely friendly the food and dronk selection was on point.Rean at the Front Desk was quick, efficient,  and thorough. Really great job Palms.

allReviews.title: Alexis is the bestest
allReviews.text: Alexis in the VIP Lounve checked me in, she is very Profesional. I really appreciated her help today, super sweet and kind I will definitely be coming back to the palms! Not to mention  she called my host and got me an upgrade!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

allReviews.title: Honeymoon
allReviews.text: Amet was amazing! He helped us upgrade our suite to start off our honey moon perfectly! It was a smooth and excellent check in experience because of him. The room was fantastic and had an incredible view of downtown Vegas strip and the mountains surrounding. Thank you!

allReviews.title: Awesomeness
allReviews.text: Tammy at Reservations was AWESOME..  TAMMY PROVIDED Great Service. SHE Got a Great room. THANK YOU.. I WILL DEFINITELY BE BACK TO STAY AT PALMS In LAS VEGAS.. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.. ROOM WAS AMAZINGLY CLEAN.. ABSOLUTELY NO COMPLAINTS...CAN'T WAIT TO BE BACK

allReviews.title: The New Boss of Vegas
allReviews.text: If you are looking for an off strip property that treats you like a family member do not hesitate to book a room here.Everyone on the property from the housekeeping staff to security to the cocktail servers on the casino floor were friendly and inviting.The Hosting is old Vegas where you are a person and not an offer number. Matt could write a book on how to host a player and his boss Greg could edit it and do the forward! Engaging and hospitable, and made you feel like you were welcome visitors in their home. Even the Casino Manager Ray stopped in at dinner to say hello. World class all the way around.The room was a suite on the 33rd floor…Spacious, spotless, with a connecting room booked to accommodate my teenage girls so they could have some privacy (thanks especially for that). Bathroom was well appointed and housekeeping was on the spot.The Steakhouse was WORLD class with impeccable service and offers some of the best cuts in a town where great meat cuts are standard. The buffet was excellent and my only complaint was they didn’t have twist ice cream on the desert bar (should’ve been a one star yah lol).The cafe had great service and good food for the price point. Dining is AAA+.The casino is well stocked with all the latest and greatest games. I have played in places with higher payback but for Vegas the casino was very generous and I had a great time playing there. Cocktail service was outstanding and EVERYONE I encountered on the gaming floor was incredibly friendly and helpful. They do have a download system that allows you to turn handpays into tito’s instantly. I got to use that feature a lot so yay for loose machines! Thank you to the slot manager Brittany for her help with that!I have played and stayed in casino’s from Macau to Manila to AC to California and everywhere in between… this is by far the BEST venue I have ever had the pleasure of staying and playing in. Thank you to Ray and his incredible staff there for a world class time! We have a new favorite venue in Vegas!

allReviews.title: The Palms Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Located just off the strip, a decent hotel with all amenities accessible.Large rooms.Good pool area only negative is the pool restricted opening hours which were 10-6. Should be 8-7 in our opinion. Very strict security.Plenty of restaurants and bars on site.

allReviews.title: Stoked to come back.
allReviews.text: A great off the strip hotel/casino. Can’t wait to come back. Great food options. A lot of different games. Clean and feels safe. Good energy, a lot of people and plenty of space as to not get kicked around. If you need help with something, talk to Jerry… he gets it done!

allReviews.title: Excellent service
allReviews.text: the service , the room & friendliness  that Raquel Caldo that she show are so excellent, I can't wait to get back soon again, wishing it will be the same kind of service & hospitality that she show me. looking forward to reserve a room again in the future,will want to make business with you , thanks

allReviews.title: Horrible customer service!!
allReviews.text: The worst Customer Service!!! First and foremost they NEVER pickup the phone at the hotel. The reservation desk is overseas and they have no idea of anything “at the hotel”. I have been on hold for over an hour on 2 occasions!! Just awful!! The Air conditioning in both rooms made this loud noise that prevented us from getting a good nights rest (we were attending a convention and had business meetings the following day and had arrived at the hotel past midnight on Wednesday). The front desk staff said they would only remove the resort fee on both rooms, nothing else. Now when I see my credit card charges they only removed the resort fee on one room, not both and they still do not answer the phone at the hotel. Horrible!!This time around the “operator” could not put me through to someone who could help with this and again put me through to the front desk at the hotel. The hold is FOREVER, nobody answers the phone.

allReviews.title: Beautiful inside and throughout
allReviews.text: Ari at the players club was very sweet and helpful she even complimented me on my nails .We all had a blast and can’t wait to go back and actually book a room there and try their buffet. Also slots paid out and even though it was a Friday night I was still able to play my favorite machine fire link.

allReviews.title: Thee best hotel in  Vegas
allReviews.text: I will never be able to get over the professionalism Paige has shown any time we decide to stay at the Palms. She goes above and beyond to ensure we’re comfortable. She definitely deserves a raise or three! We will always make the Palms our first pick when vacationing in Vegas because she’s made the stay so pleasant.

allReviews.title: PAIGE is the best! ❤️
allReviews.text: I love The Palms and my stays  are always the best experiences, especially all the great dining available. But what makes this experience most importantly are the employees. They are all wonderful but one that really shines way above is Paige at the front desk. My first encounters with her was so delightful and welcoming. Her smile was warm and friendly. I was attended with such professionalism and I left feeling like she was my best friend. Each trip I always jump for joy when I see her at the front desk. I did once have a problem in my room and she solved it so smoothly turning   a bad situation into a happy one for me in no time. I always look forward to seeing her on my visits hoping she will be there that day to greet me at the front desk.

allReviews.title: Outstanding
allReviews.text: We arrived 6 hours early for our reservation. We were greeted at the front desk by Ms. Paige! Paige was excellent, she accommodated our time difference with checking in and ensured we were able to access our room in a timely manner while also enjoying the amenities the hotel has to offer while waiting. Paige gave my party and I several suggestions for the hotel and surrounding areas for entertainment . This was our first time in Las Vegas and at the Palms Resort and she made my party and I feel extremely welcomed and comfortable. You all struck GOLD with hiring her! The Williams Party thanks you Paige!

allReviews.title: Amazing Night Out
allReviews.text: Beautiful casino with great food, friendly and helpful staff and amazing entertainment options. My family and I wanted to see a comedy show and eat at the seafood buffet and was unable to find where to purchase tickets. Paige  was able to help us get our tickets for both the concert and to the restaurant. Paige was very patient, attentive and friendly while helping us navigate through this process. Paige is a reason we will come back again

allReviews.title: Alexis @vip
allReviews.text: Alexis was amazing we really appreciate her checking us in in VIP we love coming to the palms!!  There is no one else we would rather have check us in. We will definitely come back to the palms!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

allReviews.title: Five Star Experience
allReviews.text: My family stayed at the Palms recently, and we had an amazing experience. Everyone was so nice and helpful. Paige at the front desk was very attentive and made sure all of our needs were taken care of. She gave us great recommendations for restaurants and entertainment. She made the experience a great one. We'll definitely be staying here again before the summer ends.

allReviews.title: Paige Palms Place
allReviews.text: Paige per usual always goes above and beyond! I have worked with her many times and she treats each time like it is the first connection, it makes it a truly exceptional and seamless experience. Whether it is transportation or just a general questions she makes it happen at the drop of a hat. Palms is lucky to have someone like Paige, a great representative for the brand and culture. If you have a chance make it a point to ask for Paige on your next visit to Las Vegas!

allReviews.title: Best experience ever
allReviews.text: Paige was bery awesome! She rocks!!!! I love how she handled my reservation. Everytime im in Vegas, i will always choose Palms!  Paige and host Vai Thai!! Kudos to you and everyone else. The experience is always amazing! I love coming back to palms! I will surely come and visit whenever

allReviews.title: Thank You Paige
allReviews.text: I was at the Palm Hotel Last month. I was there with friends for a meal. We went up to the Front Desk to ask questions about what was the best place to eat. There Paige greeted us with a smile, ask could she help us. We told her we looking for a place to eat lunch. She told us about the different choices and directed us how to get there. We thanked her for her help and told her how much we appreciate her helping us. We chose the Buffet it was wonderful. Thanks Paige for a wonderful experience.  Arnez.

allReviews.title: Great experience
allReviews.text: We were helped by Paige at the lobby. Felt very welcome, great service! Very impressed by the hotel too: the casino is very large downstairs. The pool is impressive with music and bars. So far, really impressed even though we only just arrived.

allReviews.title: Best customer service in a long time!
allReviews.text: Paige was amazing and very accommodating! I always stay at the palms and always have an amazing experience! I have been coming to the palms for years! I got in a little earlier but they were able to get me in a little early! I would definitely recommend 10/10!

allReviews.title: Movies and buffet
allReviews.text: Shout out to Paige! She was so helpful during my visit! This place definitely is a one stop shop! I ate at the buffet with my husband and we received a coupon book with 2 free movie tickets at the theater from the front desk. Will absolutely be returning!

allReviews.title: Local friendly
allReviews.text: Visiting the palms for a staycation and planned to go to the pool. I stopped by the front desk & spoke with miss Paige. Little did I know that locals receive a free cabana. She was able to assist with all the questions I had and gave me great advice. Will definitely be returning with more friends and family.

allReviews.title: 100% awesome 5stars
allReviews.text: Signed up for player card with Jerry he was awesome, super helpful and accommodating. I will come back next month to build up my points. We plan to come back next i loved the food and hotel pool and the sports book area was nice also we took a uber out front also it was very easy

allReviews.title: Great Front Desk Check In!
allReviews.text: Absolutely delighted with the exceptional service provided by Justin at the front desk! From the moment we walked in, Justin greeted us with a warm smile and a genuine willingness to assist. His professionalism, efficiency, and friendly demeanor made the check-in process smooth and enjoyable. Justin went above and beyond to ensure our stay was comfortable, offering valuable recommendations and promptly addressing any requests. It's rare to find someone so dedicated and personable in customer service and we look forward to returning because of his outstanding hospitality.

allReviews.title: Top quality stay not to far from the strip
allReviews.text: Our 4 day stay was excellent! When we got in the front desk clerk Paige did an amazing job with assisting us with our stay, was very courteous and even gave us several recommendations on things to do and places to go! The hotel was busy but not as crazy as most directly on the strip, definitely staying here again especially because the prices were very reasonable.

allReviews.title: Great experience, will go again.
allReviews.text: Paige at the front desk was a great help in getting us a room and cabana and explaining all the amenities at the Palm's. Our time at the pool and cabana was wonderful. Our children loved the private pool and it was easy to keep an eye on them. We will definitely go back for future staycations. 5 stars all around.

allReviews.title: Paige at Front Desk
allReviews.text: Paige at the front desk provided exceptional service. She provided hotel information, accommodated our requests, and provided insight as to how to maximize the hotel services and benefits as Las Vegas locals. We stayed in May 2024 and again in June due to her great assistance.

allReviews.title: Go Paige!
allReviews.text: Paige at the front desk was amazing! We arrived way earlier than initially planned and she was incredibly accommodating! Love the room too! We opted for an upgrade and let me tell you it was way worth it. Please see photos below for a reference :)

allReviews.title: The best service in Vegas
