No warmth or fríendliness - just rules, harshness, rude interactions.  I’ve been to vegas 8-9 times but likely won’t return.

allReviews.title: CHANEL!!!
allReviews.text: My very first visit at Palms Casino, was amazing! The service that I received when I came here was very nice and  I would love to come back again! - CHANEL THE SERVICE WAS IMPECCABLE!!  Definitely my #1 recommendation!

allReviews.title: Modern and Spacious Rooms
allReviews.text: Very modern spacious rooms. Very friendly staff (thanks Chanel). There is a food court as well as high end restaurants. Very relaxing pool area. Ideal if you enjoy walking. Walking distance from the main strip.

allReviews.title: Badly Needed an improvement!
allReviews.text: The Facade of the hotel is excellent, It has a solid perfumey hotel scent inside. The Guest service was not accommodating and didn't smile either. Guest Service badly needed an improvement at check-in. The room was decent, and the bed was clean and comfy but the bathroom was a nightmare, they didn't replenish a bath gel, and they have the entire amenities half used, there were hairs all over the shower and toilet and some yucky stains on the wallpaper. I can tell rooms are dilapidated, again the facade of the building was excellent, I hope not just the facade :(When I was about to shower I noticed that there was no hot water, so I did call the front desk to notify the issue as well as the bath gel. The guest service advised me to wait for like about 5 minutes and if still not getting hot water then I should call back so she could send the maintenance and, she would send someone to bring a shower gel as well. Then an attendant came up and didn't even greet me ( Which is fine ) with like about 20 bottles of shower gel, I was so shocked at how wasteful that would be. I don't find it generous at all, they are aware there were only 2 people, and yet they brought 20 bottles?! so we just left all those. I hope they could improve their service. Not all the people coming to vegas are just there to gamble, we wanted to have a great experience in a nice hotel too.

allReviews.title: Excellent
allReviews.text: Hotel was amazing. Rooms were clean and nice setup, and beautiful view of the city. Great customer service and really enjoyed our stay. My husband played a games of black Jack and he loved our whole stay there. We also did a couples massage at the Palms Spa and it was amazingggg :-)

allReviews.title: Wouldn't stay here again.
allReviews.text: Room was OK, stains on the carpet but apart from that it was clean. Main reason for 2 star rating is that out room was left open by the cleaning staff. The saftey bolt was pulled across so the door it wouldnt close. How did they not notice this?!! We arrived back at around 11pm after spending the day on the strip, luckily nothing missing!! Not the first review of issues with doors here from what I have read! Was offered a late check out for the inconvience which we didnt need. Had also read previous reviews about the pool noise ... I had thought hey its Vegas! ..... But it is incredibly loud. We didn't use the pool at all during our 3 night stay for this reason. Wouldn't choose to stay here again.

allReviews.title: Awesome Experience
allReviews.text: We have visited the Palms many times in the past. We recently checked it out for the first since the new owners re-opened it. We were not disappointed with anything. Excellent customer service, food, cleanliness and beautiful rooms. Great variety of slots and food venues. We will definitely be returning!

allReviews.title: Great Casino
allReviews.text: This is a great casino off of the strip. It is extremely clean and well laid out. They have a lot of slot machines, it's not as crowded as the casinos on the strip. They have a lot of great dining and game options. I highly recommend this casino, if you want to do something off the strip.

allReviews.title: Much needed vacation
allReviews.text: We were staying at TI so took an Uber to The Palms.  I thought it was beautiful & seemed to have plenty of various slots. I particularly enjoyed the AYCE Lobster/Crab Leg special buffet. It wasn't cheap but it was SOOOOO GOOD!  The lobster tails were fantastic! Desserts were lacking but the people working at Desserts were very friendly & welcoming. The bar pictured had a shark sectioned across the bar.

allReviews.title: Went back to my room and found a stranger sleeping in my bed!
allReviews.text: I came here for a work conference and it was a 3 night stay. On night number two, I  had left the hotel for a few hours and when I came back to my room, there was an adult stranger sound asleep in one of the two beds! A person! Sleeping in my room! With all of my stuff just sitting there for the taking. This person did not notice me come into my room so I went back downstairs to grab security. They then had to verify who I was, what room number it was, etc. etc. Another security guy came over and asked if I was Steve. (I am not.) They said there was a "Steve and guest" added on to the room. I said that I was there by myself and had no guests staying with me. There should not be a "Steve" on the room. He walked away -- with MY license -- to the front desk to verify all this info and see how Steve got added to my room. It ends up there was no additional guest added to my room. So how did this person end up in my room? They said, "Well your door must not have been closed all the way." I said that I'm sure that is possible but the door is self-closing and closes shut by itself every time I've used it. It's a good explanation but seems unlikely. Anyway, after about 45 minutes from start to finish, they extracted this drunken stranger from my room. They said he was actually a hotel guest but went to the same room location on the wrong floor. Innocent mistake, sure. But how did my door get unlocked for him? They said his key did not work on my door. Also, he did "not get under the sheets" in my room so basically they said they would notate the event and I said I would talk to a manager the next day. So I went to sleep (in the other unused bed) since I had to be up early for a conference in the morning.I calmly went to the front desk today and explained the situation to a manager. I also told him I tested my door and I can close it and then open it without the key, even though it is fully closed. He said that's not normal and offered to have a maintenance man come check my room. He asked if there was anything else. I said, "Yes, I would think the hotel would offer me some kind of compensation considering what happened." I was offered a $100 food and beverage voucher. He said my room was already paid for and had no balance. I said that was because I already paid for it! I mean, c'mon! He said since it was paid through a third-party, he couldn't offer any kind of room credit. The only other option was an "investigation" and that it would take 7 days for somebody to get back to me. So I am in the same room, no food and beverage credit (since I opted for the investigation) and I have to wait 7 days for management to review and get back to me. And who knows if they will even call me or do anything about it. I'm not a big complainer, but I thought this was egregious, the manager at the front desk seemed ill-equipped to handle the situation and he wasn't even going to offer me anything besides having somebody check my door locking mechanism. I just want to remind you I came back to my room with a drunk person sleeping in my bed. I'm not complaining about a hair in my bathtub or a dirty sink. This was a personal safety issue that could have resulted in a physical altercation, personal items being stolen, etc. Thankfully, it did not. But I'm disappointed in the way the hotel is handling it. (P.S., the engineer did come to my room and confirmed there was an electrical short in the door and he is replacing the body of the lock.) Security had guessed that maybe my door hadn't been closed all the way which I felt was passing blame onto me, but it turns out that the lock did have an issue.

allReviews.title: Free Valet & Great Buffet
allReviews.text: Four of my favorite letter FREE. Where everyone else has high valet charges and resort fees, this off strip property was great. Ubers into the city were easy for the 2 trips you take day and night otherwise huge casino, plenty of food options, and lovely staff. Specifically Monique at the Front Desk helped me handle a last minute travel schedule where they accomodated my requested and saved me from a flight change. I couldn't be happier with their customer service, their check in lines also moved way faster than any other casino, they had a defunct nightclub that now is the hotel pool are which is awesome because it's MASSIVE so get over there and check it out before they realize they're sitting on gold. Rooms are a great size and all remodled with the new renovation. Can't way to go back!

allReviews.title: Stunning and absolutely awesome !
allReviews.text: I’ve been waiting patiently for The Palms to reopen and believe me, it has definitely been worth the wait. I switched to The Palms year ago after always staying on the strip every time I was in Vegas. I had a four nights stay recently and the minute I stepped onto the property, I felt like I was home. On arrival the first thing I noticed was how happy and positive the staff were and the whole facility was so clean and nicely refurbed. Everyone I interacted with were so kind and helpful. I booked a standard Fantasy Tower strip view room. I checked in and was assigned my room. I opened the door to my room and my first impression was WOW !. What a nice surprise, I had been upgraded to an absolutely beautiful corner room. The room was huge and was stunning as was the view. The breakfast buffet at A.Y.C.E was I think the largest and most comprehensive I had seen anywhere in the world, my jaw dropped literally when I saw what was on offer. Another great alternative is the Serrano Vista Café on the gaming floor, great menu with a nice relaxed atmosphere. Parking is free (another bonus). I am returning in February 2023, coming from New Zealand and I can’t wait. Well done The Palms, you’re awesome !

allReviews.title: Housekeeping didn't clean room upon arrival
allReviews.text: The hotel check-in staff and the room was great! However, upon check in there were bobby pins in the shower, used soap in the shower, the shampoo and other bathroom give-always were 1/2 used. Clearly housekeeping didn't clean the bathroom or check the items provided by the hotel.  I thought about complaining but that only means that there could be retribution during out stay.

allReviews.title: Palms best hotel in Las Vegas!
allReviews.text: From the minute we pulled in to the minute we checked out the Palms staff were hands-on and made sure our experience was one to remember.   We had a blast,  make sure to check out the penthouses and suites such a fun experience for a friend's birthday bash!  We had the best birthday all over the property.   Mabel’s for dinner, ghost bar, and cabana the following day at the pool.   Every time staying at the Palms and referring all my friends!Kevin Glass and his team made us feel so special on our special weekend getaway!Also Cisco’s team at the pool!

allReviews.title: Summer of Dreams
allReviews.text: This weekend getaway was more like a week away from  worries and stress! A summer of Dreams!This immense property with its sparkling pool area, concert venue and multiplex movie theater recently gained new ownership, purchased a few months ago by the Yaamava Resort and Casino at San Manuel.  The staff is so warm and friendly, you can tell they enjoy their work, starting with gracious service from my host Jennifer and from my driver, Jason to the food servers at AYCE. The one exception to this was Serrano Vista Cafe, where I found the service to be lacking the same warmth and friendliness as the other food venues. The food is also not quite up to par as the flagship location at Yaamava, although the giant cinnamon roll with chocolate covered bacon was a fun surprise.  The penthouse was beautiful, with its unsurpassed view of the Vegas skyline, its curated art on the walls, 24-hour private butler service, glorious bedroom, dining room for 8 and galley kitchen, perfect for entertaining. Our butlers, Mark and Lee, provided exceptional service from extra blankets to a cosmo in the late evening. They knew what we needed before we did!  The bathroom is bigger than my entire living room but it’s in the marbled bathroom that the real sparkling jewel of this penthouse is contained - the experiential shower. Equipped with a rainfall shower, two traditional side-by-side showerheads, a handheld shower head and three additional wall showerheads that shoot straight out in front, this contraption will immediately purify you and wash away all of the sins of your lifetime at once. I never felt so clean!!!  We were also given a sneak peek at one of the exclusive sky villas which run for more than a i make in a year for one night! To say that it was luxurious is an understatement! So many pillows and furs!!  Wonderful Sunday brunch at the AYCE buffet, the freshest selections accompanied by a lovely mimosa. With names like Smoke and Fire, the Hearth, The Greenery, and it’s dessert section Sweet & Light, each describes its sections and division of food perfectly.  My party and I also visited Scotch 80 Prime steakhouse for dinner and the most gracious Chef de Cuisine Marty came out to welcome us! He even promised to send out a special surprise for me.. We finished our delicious meal - seafood mini tower served on hot stones in a cast iron skillet and with a compound butter our amazing server Oscar flambéed right in front of us.  But then the surprise arrived!  It was a dessert of dreams!! It was a s’mores dish a chocolate sphere served with graham cracker ice cream dusted with graham cracker fine crumbs and served with a thin delicate flame-shaped cookie! Then they flambé the sphere with flaming rum to reveal a molten chocolate cake with marshmallows!! There was also a second dessert, a crispy Italian merengue filled with a lemon and lime Custard!  So come on down to Vegas and make your reservation at Palms Casino & Resort, Las Vegas for your own dream getaway and tell them Ms. Ross sent you!

allReviews.title: Mom's Birthday
allReviews.text: The Palms may be my new favorite casino. We were greeted as VIP'S. Every employee greeted us, stopped and conversed with us as we walked thru the casino and as we sat at a slot machine. The food at Scotch 80, Mabel's BBQ and the Serrano Cafe was amazing.  The rooms were very nice as well.

allReviews.title: Brown fecal matter towels/housekeeper came the next day 2 hrs before checkout
allReviews.text: Nice spacious room but housekeeping was awful. They gave me wrinkled brown stained (fecal matter) towel/face cloths. Service was requested twice after this incident but they didn't arrive to my room until 10am as I was about to walk downstairs to check-out. I had to use my own face cloth that I bring when traveling to shower with. Dropping found in the corner of the room. Countertop stained. Around 4am, I noticed there was no linen for the sofa bed and it took them about 1 hour to arrive so I could go to sleep. The "free" wi-fi required a credit card. There was only one sheet to use on the note pad by the phone. I had to write down reminders for myself using random pieces of paper from my purse. I feel ripped off.

allReviews.title: Okay, fair stay. Stayed 9/9-9/11. Needs improvement
allReviews.text: The good: First off Ken at the front desk was very helpful and A+ service. We had trouble with our reservation with Expedia and helped us best he can. The hotel is very accommodating. Pool area nice, highly recommend the buffet for breakfast.Danielle at the front desk was helpful too. Room was nice, beds very comfortable, Plenty of security on site.Bad: The service at the pool bar was terrible. The Bartenders do not pay attention.. we waited 30 minutes for 2 beers. Other patrons showed up after us and they were immediately helped before us. We felt ignored and it was a fact. Very unacceptable. I expressed we felt ignored. The bartender guy gaslighted me saying “other patrons are waiting”  at the time we were the only ones still waiting.  Please train the pool bartenders to do better.Ice machines out of order, found that inconvenient.Ugly: Wi-Fi is terrible…  the “free Wi-Fi” is very slow and unresponsive. I do not recommend this resort to  anyone here for a business trip.

allReviews.title: Loud rooms on the pool side
allReviews.text: I’ll start with saying I do know where I am. I lived in Vegas for over a decade and am in town for work. I asked for a quiet room on a high floor, I’m on the 19th floor but above the pool. Arrived on Labor Day and the pool DJ is really loud in the room. Before unpacking I called the front desk and asked to move to the other side of the building. I was assured that the DJ was a special event and after 7pm the pool noise would not be an issue for the rest of my stay. Two days later, around 9pm the music was even louder. I called the front desk and was told a commercial shoot would wrap around 11pm, no later than midnight. And of course the pool wouldn’t be a problem for the rest of my stay. It is now the following day at 7pm and it’s so loud AGAIN. Again, I know where I am, but not everyone comes to Vegas to party 24/7. I specifically stayed here wanting to support the new tribe owners. The room is nice enough, though there are a lot of stains on the carpet. An employee let himself into my room just as I was about to undress for a shower… not sure what that was about but he apologized and left. I’m really disappointed that they weren’t just honest with me the first day so that I could change rooms and have a better experience.

allReviews.title: LIKED IT BUT ALSO HAD FLAWS BUT MAYBE NOT FOR YOU
allReviews.text: I stayed at the Palms September 5th through 7th 2022.  Let's start with the good.  It is now owned by different people and the rooms have been refurbished.  Very clean and comfortable.  I got a decent offer and it was worth what I paid.  If you want to play video poker definitely stay here.  All denominations and types available.  A very nice slot floor over all and easy to find people if they wandered off.   We ate at the BBQ place which was great and very filling.  The buffet for breakfast was also quite good.   We did do Earl of Sandwich at the food court and also really good.   Easy access to the strip with Uber or Lyft and not too costly.Now a couple of other points.  The buffet was good yes but it also is much higher priced than the couple of times I stayed here before it was bought.  Not strip high but still 70,00 for dinner for two people so we only ate breakfast as we had a food credit per day which made it reasonable.Since I was with a relative I wanted to know if my points for the room food etc we earned could be divided and was told their tier system is not set up yet so the money we spent on the room and food did not go toward our points at all and I was not thrilled with that.So I would say overall we enjoyed our time there and given the right offer would stay again.   I like video poker so it's a big draw for me.  The food could go either way for you depending on what you like.   I will tell you the employees are very friendly and we were very impressed with I hope I got the name right (Jaqueline) at the buffet.  My sister had forgotten her id the day before when we wanted to charge it to the room and had to go back and get it.  The next day she recognized us and even remembered our room number within one number.  Pretty good I thought.   I liked the Palms with a few reservations which may or not bother you.

allReviews.title: Best bartender ever
allReviews.text: I was in Vegas for work last week, stopped at the bar for a drink in the palms where I met this bartender named Tracey. She was so great. Kept me company for hours and took care of me. I don't usually stay there but will from now on just for her.

allReviews.title: Go see Kim at the Sportsbook Bar!
allReviews.text: Kim's very pretty and super accommodating! :)Mabel's BBQ by the great Ohio Chef Michael Symon is right next door as well! The Palms is nice in general and it's great to see them back after CO-VID, etc...

allReviews.title: Beautiful place, nice staff
allReviews.text: So far the entire hotel is beautiful, good customer service and I like it, especially the pool area, my only thing was nowhere to store our  food we bought from the pool and all my food spoiled, atleast every room should have a mini fridge to will be great.

allReviews.title: Frankie Moreno show
allReviews.text: What an incredible show! The KAOS venue is the  perfect place to showcase Frankie Moreno! Not only is the music incredible, the show room is magical. The man is music!!!  #Kingofvegas®️ Make your plans to join the #fmarmy®️ ASAP!

allReviews.title: Quick trip to LV
allReviews.text: Great room with view of the Strip. Very clean and newly updated rooms. Good restaurants and the casino had pretty current games.  I did not get out to the pool but expect that would also be top notch.  Great stay.

allReviews.title: 5 days in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: My stay at the Palms Las Vegas was amazing. Our room in the Fantasy Tower was great. It was clean and it was comfortable. The two restaurants we dined at were really good. (Mabels BBQ and Send Noodles)I think what sets the Palms apart from the rest are the employees. From checking in with DeeJay to Tommy in Valet remembering our names when the rental was retrieved to John the Bellman always greeting us upon our return to Ronnie in EVS who is so happy and proud to work at the Palms, its clear that this property is different in the most positive way. I also don't want to forget Katy who was so gracious with my Son and I. This property is considered off of the Las Vegas Stip but thats a good thing!. Getting in and out is easy and the property has all the amenities anyone would need. Thank you to the staff for making this trip so special.

allReviews.title: Amazing Off Strip Gem
allReviews.text: Palms was everything we could want in a hotel. Romeo was a SUPERB VIP manager, super attentive and collaborative months leading up to our trip (I put him through an endless stream of asks!). The butlers we interacted with (James and Darren) were always there when you needed them and were extremely helpful (perfect request ninjas that didn't hover).The property itself feels very well kept. Those renovations really shine. Ghostbar lived up to the hype. The pool was set up spectacularly. The food options were diverse and tasty (and priced reasonably $15 for a tasty breakfast sandwich delivered poolside?? sign me up!!).Jason at the bell desk was a great smile/attitude to be greeted with and a great person to take us to the airport. Perfect bookend.We will definitely be coming back to the Palms. It's only a $10 uber/lyft away if walking the strip is something you're eager to do. With the money you save on staying in a reasonably priced room, it's a no-brainer of a trade off.

allReviews.title: Guest
allReviews.text: By far, the best hotel on or off the strip.  Staff courteous and professional.  Excellent on site amenities.  Room clean and inviting, with great views.  I can’t brag enough about my stay.  Convenient transportation via Uber RTC.

allReviews.title: Such a beautiful stay!
allReviews.text: We booked here because our friends were staying here for a last minute overnight stay. The hotel feels like the best of the Strip and Downtown in a nice, clean, energetic, happy spot. When we went to check in, the host told me that I had been randomly selected as a VIP Guest and he walked us to VIP check in. I whispered to my Hubs, "I hope they don't try to sell us a timeshare!" Instead we were pleasantly surprised that they had upgraded our room to a suite and gave us late check out. The room was gorgeous! (Our friends room was in the Fantasy Tower and was equally beautiful) We loved the mix of available food choices in the casino. We ate at the food court right after we checked in, as well as at Send Noodles restaurant and the  pizza place in the casino. In the morning we ate at the brunch place (They had gluten free options too!) We enjoyed the pool and casino while we were there. I was bummed we didn't pack any nice clothes so that we could check out the Ghost Bar (but now we know for next time!) We already decided this is where we will stay again because we enjoyed it so much, even without the VIP treatment!

allReviews.title: A place with some warmth:  refreshed, clean, fun spot with super friendly staff.
allReviews.text: If you want to stay at a fresh, fun place where you feel welcomed this would be a great place. Stayed here for one night and had a really great time. Rooms were clean, large and modern. Ended up switching to stay in the fantasy tower after the room next to me was way too loud through the communication door.Suite in fantasy tower was amazingly spacious, and had great amenities. Everything was new, and bed was super comfy.Staff throughout hotel were incredibly friendly in a genuine matter, and had many great interactions. Front Desk staff and pizza place were exceptionally friendly.Pool area definitely had a more of a party vibe to it, but it was quiet enough for a few families enjoying the area. Entire place seemed fun and more down to earth energy than some other giant soulless properties. I felt like the staff here were actually happy to have me as a guest instead of a number. Would happily stay here again.

allReviews.title: Chanel and the Palms team are the best!
allReviews.text: I had one of the best check in experiences ever when arriving at the Palms! Upon arrival Chanel welcomed us with a big smile! She helped answer any questions we had about the Palms and also made sure that our check in process was seamless! Thank you Chanel and the palms team for making our brotherly get together successful!!

allReviews.title: Tracey Lall -bartender at the Palm, Las Vegas, made my day/wk/month 🎈🎈🎈🎈
allReviews.text: Thank you to the beautiful young bartender at the Shark bar, at the Palm, who made my birthday an extra special event. Very entertaining and loved my special 🍹 drinks 🥤 . Thank u Tracey Lall🙏. Outstanding customer and I will definitely be visiting Tracey again.

allReviews.title: Our Stay at Palms
allReviews.text: We always have stayed on the strip, but based on so many positive reviews, we decided to give the Palms a try.  Getting there is easy and parking is free. Check in was easier than the strip as there was no line. The room in the Ivory Tower was beautiful and clean and modern. Honestly it was better than any similarly priced strip room.  The Serrano Cafe and buffet were both 5 stars in food and service.  The pool was ok, but lacked shaded areas. The casino was active at all hours. Generally they had one roulette table going and 2 or 3 baccarat as well as blackjack.  The sportsbook is run by William Hill. There are several days per week that you can earn extra points on your players card playing slots.  Though I didn't notice any of my table play being recognized in terms of points or tier credits.  There is also a VIP lounge where you can get free drinks and snacks. Unfortunately this has really limited hours and we were only able to use it twice.  It should be open 24/7. I say this honestly because at Caesars for example, I get 4 daily drink vouchers that can be used anytime. Overall, it was a wonderful stay. I would definitely consider it again.

allReviews.title: Loved our Stay
allReviews.text: We would highly recommend Palms  ! It is a beautiful hotel ..so modern ,clean ,sparkly ,bright and airy. We ate at the Buffet and Scotch 80..both were really good. It is a cheap Uber ride to the strip or a 20 min walk. Way better than the overcrowded hotels on the strip.Big shout out to GERALDO , the bartender at the Shark Bar ! What an amazing person he is who gave top quality service  ! We really enjoyed meeting him and appreciated his kindness. I hope the management realizes what a STAR GERALDO is  !

allReviews.title: The Palms is back and better than ever!
allReviews.text: My girlfriend and I spent the night in the Fantasy Tower for our anniversary. We were blown away by the upgraded amenities in the room. The staff went the extra mile by providing complimentary champagne, macaroons,  and chocolate dipped strawberries with a Happy Anniversary card. Between this, the pool Palms’ Place Pool (more low key than the main pool), and dinner at Mabel’s BBQ, we will definitely come back. Thank you to Brandon and the rest of the staff for making a memorable experience!

allReviews.title: The Gem in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: It is so hard to find to find a good hotel, with all the bells and whistles. The Palms Casino Hotel did not disappoint. As soon as you step through the front entrance, the  excellence starts. This hotel is light, airy,  and beautifully decorated, not drab like others. Customer Service is not a thing of the past with Tiare, Romeo, and the entire Palms staff. The Palms Casino Hotel has been recently renovated, and their rooms are quiet and beautifully appointed. The Palms offers entertainment , theatre, and a nice variety of restaurants, Thank you for making my stay at the Palms - Perfect!

allReviews.title: Shark Bar Tracy
allReviews.text: I stopped  in the Palms Because I was staying right down the street and wasn’t happy with the property what so ever. Let me tell you what a beautiful place you have there and I absolutely loved the Shark Bar . My Bartender was a young lady named Tracy Lall who was super attentive and very friendly and helped turn my whole trip around with her amazing service and beautiful smile… I will definitely be staying at the Palms my next trip to Vegas… Great How guys and what a amazing property. ❤️❤️❤️

allReviews.title: My favorite resort on the strip
allReviews.text: Forgot how incredible this hotel is relative to other options along the strip!  The staff was beyond friendly and helpful…the casino was immaculately clean and my room was perfect!   It was well appointed, clean and also loved the amenity line (forget the name).  This hotels management team has taken service to the next level and I’ll be back again soon!

allReviews.title: The Palms is an Amazing Experience!
allReviews.text: I had one of the best experiences at the Palms Casino Resort!  From the moment I walked through the door every staff member I met couldn't have been more helpful and friendly!  The interior is beautiful and spacious, and there is nothing that  I wanted that I couldn't find!  The rooms were spacious, tastefully decorated and spotless! The drivers, Jason, Petra, & Chris were so hospitable and anticipated all our needs.  We ate at several of the Palm restaurants and had awesome service and delicious food.  I have stayed at other Las Vegas properties but the Palms Casino Resort is by far the best!   Whether its for business or leisure in Las Vegas, I would definitely recommend this hotel to everybody!

allReviews.title: Awesome Visit to The Palms
allReviews.text: My wife and I had such a great weekend at the Palms. One of the managers Kevin Glass helped us with our room. He was very helpful and courteous. Our room had been renovated and was modern. The pool area had a great atmosphere and plenty of seating. We ate at the Serrano Vista Cafe. The service and the food were great. We really enjoyed ourselves and had a incredible time. We can’t wait to come back!

allReviews.title: Bad Service for HL player
allReviews.text: I was in HL and the waitress passed me up 3 times.  I went to the bar to get my drink.  She finally stopped and said “are you going to want anything for the rest of the night” with an attitude.  I did tell the pit boss and even the dealer confirmed.  I believe her name was Amanda.  Unacceptable.

allReviews.title: Best Hotel
allReviews.text: Our visit was nothing short of AMAZING.. Our room was clean with awesome view, pool is resort style with great music. I highly recommend the restaurants & room service. I will definitely be back.  The Palms Hotel is my new favorite in Vegas

allReviews.title: Bussiness & Pleasure
allReviews.text: I travel to Las Vegas every six weeks. I cannot tell you how refreshing and amazing it is to stay at this property - Gym, Restaurants, Parking, front desk, and HOUSEKEEPING is on POINT! Cleanest rooms I've had since Covid began - seriously. I don't write reviews often but I had to on this one. It's my new second home for work, see you again in four weeks!

allReviews.title: The new Palms!!
allReviews.text: Came to vista Yaamava’s new Palms hotel in Vegas and was not disappointed! Enjoyed the VIP Lounge check in with Alexis and host Jennifer. Feast your eyes on the Shag gallery and refresh yourself by the amazing pool and lounge area! The cabanas are amazing! Scotch 80 prime steakhouse is nothing short of heaven with its delectable seafood tower and saffron tartar sauce and the delicate rainbow tirado and milkbread. The brie fondue was a fun surprise served in a hot skillet with its thick cut bacon pieces, reminiscent almost of a queso fundido.  Our table service by Keesha and Tommy and a visit by the wonderful Chef Marty was the highlight of my stay! Loved the AYCE buffet brunch with the top notch service from Ele and the kindness of Devon and manager Facia.Try the brunch, take in a movie from their full service movie theater and try your luck at the slots and tell them Ms. Ross sent you!

allReviews.title: Valet staff
allReviews.text: This is our 2nd time staying here at the palms and Justin Potez has been nothing short of excellent. He even remembered us from our last trip. After day 2 of our stay, Justin already knew our basketball schedule and made it easy and fast pulling our car up! Everytime I stay in Vegas I will be staying @ the palms.

allReviews.title: Tracey at Shark Bar
allReviews.text: Met some friends over at Shark Bar and Tracey was our bar tender.  She was the most attentive and fun bartender I have had there.  Her attitude, memory and skills are exactly what will keep me coming back.  She’s not just another beautiful girl behind a Vegas bar,  this girl backs it up with top notch service.  I was never waiting with an empty glass before she offered me another cocktail, her vibe was fun and all around she is a star.  Thank Tracey for a fun time and will be back for sure!!

allReviews.title: Great Service
allReviews.text: No complains at all. I loved the view at this location as well as the cleanliness.  Resort has a few interesting decorations to see. Hard to believe I got it for under $100. I would recommend this Resort. It's in a nice quiet area, it's about 1.5 mile from the Vegas Strip

allReviews.title: Best value in Las Vegas. Palms is a must stay!
allReviews.text: WOW my stay was remarkable.  The rooms are gorgeous & the food outstanding.  The grounds sparkle. Great value. We gambled, went to the movies, ate well and enjoyed walking around this stunning property.Extra special thanks to 2 employees who take great pride in serving customers.Nina Dixon the Manager @ Front DeskFacia Dibenedetto Manager @ AYCE BuffetThese phenomenal ladies are the best in the business.  They are hard working, professional and courteous.  They make a DIFFERENCEBook your future stay with confidence.

allReviews.title: PAIGE
allReviews.text: Seeking a break from “aggressive” Vegas, Paige was warm and understanding upon encountering an issue with my initial booking. Her willingness to assist in my comfort was the best part of a busy day.  The Palms has a different feel.

allReviews.title: Rich the man
allReviews.text: Rich is an amazing employee or management . So helpful and friendly.he made my birthday trip so smooth. I really felt welcomed here. He needs a raise or promotion  a.s.a.p.  I will be returning because of rich

allReviews.title: 4th of July Celebration
allReviews.text: Well after being closed since the pandemic, then repurchased by San Manuel and re-opened, It has been a pleasure to re-visit the facility. The place has gone through some great changes and upgrades. The room was greatly accommodating with a great view from the 26th floor, The casino has a great variety of table games as well as a huge selection of most current latest and greatest slot machines. The casino is delightful to walk around in as it has a fresh air feeling as it does not smell like cigarettes' like most other casinos do.   There is a great variety of things to dine on in the food court as well as some great restraunts as well. did not have a chance to get to the pool but we will check that out in a couple weeks when we go back.

allReviews.title: Shark Bar Was Awesome!
allReviews.text: Second time to Vegas and loved the Shark Bar.  This awesome girl named Tracey took care of us nonstop!  Wish we had bartenders like her in my hometown!  Atmosphere and vibe was great as well.  Highly recommend this place and her if she's there!

allReviews.title: Perfect Stay
allReviews.text: To say that our family enjoyed our stay would be an understatement. We were greeted with a smile from the friendly staff at the front desk. We got up to our room and were pleased to enjoy the comfort of the air conditioning that was on. Our family was able to enjoy a couple of hours down at the pool, again where we were treated kindly by the wait staff for beverages and snacks. For dinner, we had many options to choose from. We ended up eating at the SEND Ramen noodle house and were very satisfied with the cuisine. Overall, the Palms is a luxury resort that we will return to the next time we stay in Vegas. It is only a few minutes off the strip and it offers many advantages for its location.

allReviews.title: Great service / atmosphere
allReviews.text: Group of friends and I stopped in and checked out the palms this past weekend - wanted to take time to report it was worth the stop. There was a bartender named Tracy at the unknown bar that really was top notch. She definitely made sure we were all well hydrated and having fun.

allReviews.title: Awesome bartender Tracey
allReviews.text: I was really excited to check out the new palms hotel and in the time I was there I met Tracey at the shark bar. She was extremely friendly and recommended lots of things to do in Vegas like my own personal tour guide. She also introduced me to to a green tea shot which was awesome because I love whiskeyI would recommend the palms to anyone especially if Tracey is working because she made me feel like family with her contagious smile and laugh

allReviews.title: Shark Bar!
allReviews.text: Be sure to stop by the lobby bar, aka "Unknown," and explore that unknown with awesome bartender Tracey and her pet 13' female tiger shark.  Two neat sagittal cuts present three beautiful sections of this prehistoric perfect predator in glass, steel, and formaldehyde.  Why pay over $12M for this work of ocean art when you can observe it for free . . . at the Palms . . . enjoying libations with lovely Tracey.

allReviews.title: OK
allReviews.text: The Buffet was great at the hotel - stayed at the Plams Place and the room was worth the price we paid but the pool was way too warm and closed at 7pm or not open at all. We used the resort pool once way too loud for our liking. Would stay here again

allReviews.title: Amazing hotel and staff!
allReviews.text: Great hotel and location! Our favorite part was the pool. J our server was very attentive. Pool is well kept and clean. Food and drinks were great and prices were very reasonable compared to other Vegas hotels!

allReviews.title: Tracey at the Unknown Bar is awesome
allReviews.text: The Palms is a beautful resort casino.  This is my first visit and I was very impressed when I walked in. It feels very open and well lit. I love the shark bar in the front. I guess it's called the unknown bar. Tracey is an awesome bartender and made me and my guests feel more than welcome.

allReviews.title: Absolute Perfection!!! Our daughter’s 16th birthday couldn’t have been better!
allReviews.text: Our daughter’s 16th birthday celebration couldn’t have been any better. From the amazing pool cabana to the beautiful newly renovated rooms to the delicious dinner at Mabel’s BBQ. Not only were our expectations met, but they were exceeded in every aspect. The staff and service are also wonderful. The hotel, casino, rooms, restaurants and pools are absolutely gorgeous with all of the new renovations.

allReviews.title: Best hotel to stay at in Vegas
allReviews.text: I’ve stayed at a few hotels in Vegas before and nothing compares to the Palms. From the casino, pool, room service, hospitality, and restaurant options - it was all so wonderful! Wish I could’ve stayed longer. Will definitely be back!

allReviews.title: Great place! Great staff!
allReviews.text: Stephanie at the Palms Casino Resort was super helpful in providing great info on the villas, and some great trip advice! She was super friendly and I’d love to work with her on my next stay! Such a beautiful spot!!!!

allReviews.title: Aces at The Palms !
allReviews.text: The Palms reopened at the end of April, 2022. I just spent a few days there as a "staycation".  CAN YOU SAY FABULOUS !!!????  This casino resort is CLEAN- CLEAN-CLEAN.  Great staff, from Melissa in the buffet, to Brian at the bar, to Neil in security. So many wonderful folks. The two garages are spacious and well lit. There is open air parking as well. I was in the fantasy tower. Again, CLEAN. The housekeeping staff does a phenomenal job. Large bathrooms, with a walk in shower and bench. Well lit modern lighting and back lighting for the room. Huge television and comfortable bedding. A nice chair and desk, and a couch to sit on. Th a/c heat unit in the room is modern- you set a temp, and IT STAYS ON THAT TEMP- this was a great feature. A large closet and in room safe are very handy. The mini bar and some snacks are provided- at a cost of course. There are certain elevators for sections of floors, so no waiting around for that. The pool area is very nice. There is a small food court, and buffet and dining room restaurants. A.Y.C.E buffet was well run- you wont come away hungry. There are specials certain days- check with them for updates. The Serrano Vista  Cafe has a great menu, something for everyone- and a nice morning grab and go coffee bar and pastry selection at your leisure. Gaming is plentiful. Again- clean, and well run. You cant go wrong with a stay here, or even just a visit. You can check out on the tv screen , and there a re quite a few channels and movies available.

allReviews.title: Girls Just Having Some Fun
allReviews.text: What a FUN place to go for a staycation with your Best Friends!  From the time of our arrival to the very moment we were leaving, we sure felt like a bunch of VIP's.  Our room was a spectacular Suite.  Very spacious with a view like no other, especially at night with all the Strip lights.  Our room was very clean and well appointed.  The shower was huge and the vanity area very accommodating, TV's and sound system to listen to music great!  The Palms Hotel and Casino's Spa was most amazing.  From Shakira at the front desk to Annalisa and Sandi who were attentive to our needs while using the facilities, they could not have been more helpful or pleasant.  There were 5 of us on this trip and we all had massages.  My massage therapist Patrice was wonderful.  Our Dining experiences were a treat.  Lunch at Serrano Vista Cafe and Dinner at Mabel's rounded out our evening.  Food was very good and service friendly.  I can't wait to return back to The Palms Hotel and Casino for more fun!

allReviews.title: The best hotel for the quality of service, cleanliness and entertainment!
allReviews.text: I recently stayed at the Palms with friends and had the most incredible experience. We were special guests of Kevin Glass and he went above and beyond to make our stay memorable! The staff were extremely polite and accommodating. Our spa experience was exceptional and the therapist and staff were excellent! I have vacationed at a lot of hotels in Las Vegas and this was by far the best!

allReviews.title: Impressed on my first visit.
allReviews.text: The Palms was still closed on my 2020, and 2021 visits to Las Vegas so I was happy to see that it had reopened in 2022. I had heard so many good things about the resort that I wanted to check it out myself. While Zi myself did not stay here a friend was staying in the Ivory Tower and the room was fantastic. For what he paid to stay at the Palms I paid quite a bit more yo stay at a strip resort and his room was much nicer and cost a decent amount less per night. The resort itself is very clean. There was a good amount of people in the casino and they had a nice selection of restaurants in Jose. The palms will definitely be on my short list of places to stay when we return in Zi Tibet if this year.

allReviews.title: Business/Pleasure
allReviews.text: Rooms are bright, very modern and comfortable!!  Large TV’s are the best!  Love walk-in showers!!  The staff are extremely friendly and make you feel at home!  Restaurants (favorite one is Mabel’s BBQ!) are delicious- must try!!!  Aroma and fresh smell of new renovations is breathtaking- does not smell like smoke !!  Many bars and pools, very fun atmosphere!!

allReviews.title: The palms is back in Vegas
allReviews.text: Had to make a reservation for one day only as we had to stay away from home 7 blocks away from the palms. so let’s call it  a staycation and a short one at that .most hotels in Vegas were charging 240.00 for a decent room plus resort fee. We found comparable room if not better for half the price .Called in for reservation and Anthony was very helpful in securing the room and gave the local discount.very gentlemanly manner and in command of customer satisfaction.as we arrived the next day we checked in and a gentleman Name Rich was very helpful with check in process which minutes without any wait.the room was very spacious we had free parking and Peter who delivered our luggage was fast and efficient and offered and got us us.Service at palms hotel and casino is wonderful because the people we encountered in our we will make a habit to go to the palms to stay and gamble we just Loved this Place again .congratulations to the staff and management for running a superb place and thankevery one who work there for making this day memorable

allReviews.title: Love the Palms
allReviews.text: Can get to the Palms by bus. Quick ride from Las Vegas Blvd. Catch it at Flamingo Blvd. It's now open again and updated. I liked it before the update. Has a good food court. Excellent gaming floor with a huge variety of slots. Of course, table games and craps. This casino is worth the bus trip.

allReviews.title: Security harassed us out of the 6th floor pool!!!
allReviews.text: We were escorted out of the pool bc my husband brought a coke from the McDonald’s purchased in the HOTEL!! A man told us we cannot bring Outside drinks even though this is NOT posted anywhere on the posted pool rules. Then he came after us again, brought a supervisor and then Security told us we must leave the pool area. We were treated like criminals, not hotel guests for bringing a Coke purchased from the hotel. I would NEVER EVER recommend this hotel to anyone because of their ridiculous policy not listed and how we were treated. The other main pool is VERY loud with annoying hip hop music ALL day and needs a good Hepa vacuum on all the furniture. Do not stay here!!!! Stay where you are treated with respect. Not the Palms. Also food court sucks.

allReviews.title: If you are an off-strip property you better deliver - and Palms doesn't
allReviews.text: There are tons of options for properties of this same class, at similar prices but that are far better located right in the middle of the action on the LV strip. If you are an off-strip property, like Palms, in the middle of nowhere you better deliver something special (like for example the great Red Rock Hotel/Casino does). Palms just isn't ready...they are not staffed up for the reopening. When I checked in on Friday my room was filthy. The housekeeping manager had to come to inspect and then it had to be cleaned (not exactly a great first hour of my time at the property). Then Saturday I was gone all day from the property and my room never got cleaned - strike #2. On Sunday I noticed my room also didn't get cleaned so I called housekeeping. I was told, "We are not cleaning rooms today, only checkout rooms". What? I paid almost $400 for that Saturday night and I don't get housekeeping? Their response was "We are sold out and we don't have the staff". That sounds like a "you problem" that you're making a "me problem". If you are sold out then take the cash and figure it out. Also, the main pool was closed on Sunday of Memorial Day for an all-day private event (again that benefits the Palms pockets, but does nothing for me). I decided to give Palms a chance to see if it had some of the same mojo as when the Maloofs owned it and it was a hot spot. Sadly it does not. You have so many better options in Las Vegas - choose them instead.

allReviews.title: Stay far away unless you want the atmosphere of a Travis Scott concert !!Including trampling .
allReviews.text: On weekends and holidays the palms is a high crime area . There are many police cars ( many are empty ) but that stops nothing.  This is not a place for kids , for elderly , or for anyone that doesn’t love pot smoke .   I don’t think the san Manuel tribe knew what happens there when they bought it . The clientele does not spend money . They don’t gamble and they don’t eat at the hotel restaurants . There are ten people jammed into each hotel room .  It becomes the worst hotel I’ve ever seen in my life . Word must be put in La county jail and the projects in la to stay at the palms.  I just don’t think it’s fair for the people who travel far to Las Vegas to get stuck at this hotel . It has an F- rating .  Raise the prices on rooms to 500 a night if you want your san Manuel atmosphere .  It’s not happening otherwise .

allReviews.title: 50th at the Palms
allReviews.text: My wife and I visited the palms with 3 other couples for my 50th.  Upon arrival, we were greeted by Vegas veteran Kevin Glass.  I Can't say enough about Kevin and the staff at the Palms.  From Geraldo the bartender at Serrano Vista Cafe to Tony Chang the pit boss everyone went above and beyond to make us feel special.  The rooms are clean and spacious and house keeping was responsive.  Like most hotels now you have to request a cleaning.Gambling was great!  I was happy to see 3-2 payouts on ALL the blackjack tables.  The casino bar Unknown was a great place to take a break from the tables and watch a game.The pool was a fantastic way to end a long weekend.  Great music and service at the cabana.The Palms delivered in all areas and I highly recommend a stay.

allReviews.title: No housekeeping, weak and spotty wifi, pool access denied due to pool party all day.
allReviews.text: We came to Las Vegas for a basketball tournament, so we were not in need of the casino or other entertainment.  We did expect the items they specify as amenities, free high speed wifi, free parking, and a pool.  We are staying 3 nights and so far no housekeeping for the first 2 full days, wifi speed is 5 mps download speed, and today no parking or pool access due to a pool party from 11am to 6pm.  The party was not disclosed to us until the day before its occurrence.  We have decided that we will not come back.

allReviews.title: Incredible experience, fabulous pool!
allReviews.text: A recent weekend stay at the Palms was better than I ever expected. From the moment we pulled up in valet, it really felt like a true VIP experience. Check-in was seamless and the staff were so attentive. The rooms were redone beautifully with upgrade features and true attention to deal. Dinner at Mabel’s BBQ was incredible. The food was delicious and service was so fast, if you are looking for great BBQ I definitely recommend Mabel’s. The pool area was spotless and again the staff was absolutely amazing.  They made great recommendations for drinks and were always there whenever we needed anything. I would highly recommend staying at the Palms to anyone coming to Vegas!

allReviews.title: Spacious and nicely renovated!
allReviews.text: The resort had just been renovated and we found the room to be immaculate, spacious and even smelled new. Since we were only staying one night, we didn’t miss seeing the strip which would have required a car to reach. We also really enjoyed the Saturday brunch in their dining venue. Food was excellent and Belinda our server was friendly and conscientious per our needs. The casino is spacious and the food court is right near the slots which made it convenient.

allReviews.title: Casino only review  -  Terrific
allReviews.text: Did not stay at hotel only played in the casino.  great lively and fun casino, lots of slots to choose from, great drink service, clean.  had a band going in the sportsbook late at night.  Had a great time,  highly recommend and will return.

allReviews.title: Wow what a Change
allReviews.text: We stayed just after the reopening in April 2022, what a change. the resort was clean and well maintained and not full of crazy people. The resort had a chilled feel and the change in the pool policy is great so now we can all use it.  Highly recommend it for the excitement of the strip without the craziness of the strip

allReviews.title: Not like the old days anymore
allReviews.text: Dirty, smells, pool closes at 6pm, valet is closed, casino is closed until at least 2022. The balconies are closed and that's was 70% of the value. They refunded me $800 but it should have been twice that or more.

allReviews.title: Can be rowdy but nicely renovated
allReviews.text: Palms was somewhat rowdy when I visited (i.e. a lot of younger drunk people) on a Friday night, because the club was in operation at that time. However, it has been really nicely renovated, and for someone who likes to check out off-strip or near-strip casinos, I felt that it offered a nice experience.  The Station Players card also provides a discount at the Buffet, and there were plenty of new slot machines.  The food court was kind of weird (i.e. kind of a low rent food court located very prominently/visibly in the middle of the length of the casino slot floor).  I also highly recommend taking a taxi to/from here back to the strip at night (i.e. the walk is a bit sketchy in parts).  However, all in all I enjoyed my visit here and thought this a nice facility.

allReviews.title: MONEY STOLEN, MANAGEMENT USELESS, HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE
allReviews.text: I stayed at the Palms and had money stolen out of my room. I reported it to the staff and I am not exaggerating, they could not have cared any less. When you are spending that type of money on a hotel, the least you could get is an i'm sorry. They sent me through hoops talking to all these different people and not a single person I spoke to could help. I understand that you have to follow procedures but the least you could do is comp one of the night stays. Nope! I couldn't even get a manager on the phone. Every time I asked to speak to a manager I was told there wasn't one around, or that person can't help, or I'll have them call you back. I have never felt so disrespected by an establishment in all my life. DO NOT GO HERE. WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE. Spend your money on a hotel who cares about their guests and actually empowers their employees to help instead of everyone just saying it’s not their problem. It is too bad because I was going to recommend this place to my friends, now I will boycott and make sure everyone in my family and friends does also. WORST EXPERIENCE!

allReviews.title: Zilis
allReviews.text: I was in my bedroom and I heard a noise coming from the living area, so I walk over and found a guy walking around. I asked who he was and he claimed to be taking inventory of the snacks.  He claimed he knocked but there is no way. I had no TV or radio on. He didn't even apologize.  He stated, well I'm here so I'm going to take inventory.  I called the front desk. I thought they were going to comp my room. But when checking out the claimed he said he knocked. I was given nothing for this. He obviously was in a hurry to get his job done or maybe going to take things. Not sure, I feel this was a big invasion of my privacy and they made it look like this is normal.  I still plan on bringing this up to Steven Thompson CEO of Zilis. Maybe others had similar issues.

allReviews.title: Construction Expo/Con-Agg
allReviews.text: Checked into the Palms Resort on Tuesday March 10th. Although nicer than the Flamingo Hotel be ready to be underwhelmed by the staff. This is a place to go if you don't want to be acknowledged. You would think that the Corona Virus would be an opportunity to go above and beyound for guests. Not at the Palms. When the property is not that busy as it was during my stay March 10 - 13th you would think you would exerperince the very best they have to offer. I didn't.  I was impressed with the restaurants on the property. I ate at a couple of good ones. But not enough for not making me feel special for driving up and selecting to stay there. In a word, underwhelmed.

allReviews.title: What a nice surprise
allReviews.text: We didn't stay here, but we had such a good time and positive impression of the casino, we will stay here during our next visit to Vegas.  We came for the Billy Idol concert and enjoyed dinner at Mabel's while there.  Our impression of the Palms?  New, modern, clean, and open.  The oppressive smoke and overwhelming noise you'll find at a lot of casinos wasn't bad here.  In fact, we didn't even notice the smoke. There's a really impressive selection of restaurants, though we do highly recommend trying Mabel's.

allReviews.title: Palms Hotel review
allReviews.text: I stayed 4 nights in hotel. I love  this hotel and the rooms.  They are large, modern and beautiful.  They have great restaurants and the coffee shop is amazing.  I am a player so I love the gaming!  I highly recommend this hotel.  The Palms Place is connected to this by a walkway and it is more like a condo.  My family stayed there as we were there because my granddaughter was in a competition for Cheer Gymnastics. There is no gaming there and it is for families.

allReviews.title: Great room for honeymoon!
allReviews.text: We went here for our honeymoon and it was a great experience. The room was very big and had a fantastic view of the mountains and the Las Vegas strip! The restaurants downstairs were very nice, I'd especially recommend Maybel's BBQ (the burnt end brisket was FANTASTIC!), A.Y.C.E breakfast buffet and Lucky Penny. The funky Shark Bar is definitely one to see too.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel off the strip
allReviews.text: Nice hotel off the strip. We went for a wedding in the View and reception at the Moon.  Fabulous staff, even more fabulous food, and a wonderful time with stunning views!!Only thing I didn’t like was no mini fridge unless you want to pay a $30 surcharge.

allReviews.title: Pros and Cons
allReviews.text: We recently stayed at the Palms Resort.  Good and bad.   Start with the not-so-good, then end on a good note:Cons:The mattresses were sunken on both sides.  They need new mattresses.The shower water pressure was bad.Off the strip, but this is only minorPros:It's not a huge place so it's easier to get around and you don't have to walk 20 minutes just to get to the lobby or to your roomGood size casinoThe room was clean

allReviews.title: Palms is this AC
allReviews.text: First time in the Palms. Definitely feel disconnected from the Vegas vibe. Nice property but turn hard right and once in the main casino it felt like AC. Nice room with great shower. Small gym and pool area odd. Next time definitely staying on the strip.

allReviews.title: It was ok
allReviews.text: Had trouble checking in at first then finally got in . Once we got to our rooms we noticed there was dry urine on the toilet seat and our Alfredo we ordered had under cooked chicken  , we asked room service to please freshen up the room at least twice and they never came in the 4 days we stayed there , otherwise beds were comfortable and well that’s all . Maybe we just had bad luck here rooms are nice though and mirrors in the bathroom were great for putting on make up .

allReviews.title: Nice room first time staycation
allReviews.text: First time staying here and the room did not disappoint!Very nice and reasonably priced even upgrades were offered at a good rate but standard room in Fantasy Tower was good.Highly recommend you take advantage of good room rates for a staycation if you live in Las Vegas.We usually enjoy visiting their food court, AYCE buffet, Brendan Theaters and other restaurants they have to offer.

allReviews.title: AYCE
allReviews.text: Went at 11am. Didnt get seated until almost noon, wasnt that busy, just slow service. Food was ok. Was reasonably priced so that made up for it. Lunch was under 20$. Could have been more vegetarian friendly options.

allReviews.title: Alternative to major strip hotels
allReviews.text: Using homeaway staying for a week at the Palms condos for a week on business was a pleasant change to the high priced hotel scene. With our own kitchen we could enjoy making our own coffee without paying $25 for room “service“. No more $50 breakfasts. Walk in a covered walk way to the palms casino. A movie theatre awaits and a mall style food court awaits with under $10 lunches. Nice pool and spa. Free covered parking!

allReviews.title: Outstanding room and service
allReviews.text: I have stayed at the Palms before but since the renovation the property got 5 stars from me.  New rooms are very nice, super clean with lots of amenities. The bathroom had great products and the new shower heads are very ice.  Nice assortment of liqueurs etc should you need any.

allReviews.title: Just ok......
allReviews.text: Room was ok... not the cleanest......casino was small and hardly payed out anything.  Construction was occurring and affected the atmosphere.  Seemed to have to wait for a cab longer than usual, bell hops were condescending if they thought you didn’t have money for a tip🤔

allReviews.title: MY FAVORITE PLACE IN VEGAS!
allReviews.text: This is my favorite resort. From the music they play and drink service to the table games. Another really cool thing is that they have a retractable dome over the pool so you can swim year around. Go to my YouTube page "WhatUPwithDJ" and check out the video of the room.

allReviews.title: Fun Place
allReviews.text: This is a fun place off the strip.  The views from bars on top are great.  Also the bar with a shark cut up is cool.  I would highly recommend visiting this place.  Especially if you want to get off the strip for a minute.

allReviews.title: Terrible room service
allReviews.text: I have the room for 3 nights and today is my last day. I called house keeping few times to remind them before I went out. No room service comes. I came down and complained to front desk manager but nothing happens. It is really bad service. Never come back.

allReviews.title: Wrong room received, customer service desk pathetic
allReviews.text: When I checked in I received the wrong room type, I had booked a King bed. I had to speak with various people on the phone, 3 in total who said the room is a "request" only and not guaranteed - that I could receive a King or a 2 queens room, which I find extremely disturbing and disorganized. What if I had a family of four, and received a king? No, that would not make sense. Vice versa, I am on a romantic getaway with the hubby and we would like to sleep in a King as that's what we sleep in at home (as well as what we booked). Unacceptable that I received this type of answer from the Palms staff that the room you book is a "request." Also, I had in writing, an email directly from the Plans concierge desk from 4 days previous the trip as I had made sure specifically that the bed type was done properly. The email stated "Your king room in the ivory tower is confirmed". Confirmed to me means 100% confirmed. The staff and then manager I was speaking with then proceed to continue to tell me that the room type is not guaranteed - well then how do I pay/purchase a room that IS guaranteed? And what does "confirmed" written directly from the desk mean to you - NOT confirmed? Quite ridiculous. Finally after the third person agreed to understand our situation and honor the email written by Palms to me confirming my room, they were able to put us in a King room in Palms Place. I don't believe it should have taken three people to understand this simple situation when the customer is merely asking for what they purchased, what was booked and what was "confirmed" by the hotel 4 days earlier. The issue was finally rectified but still took us an hour+ of wasted time when we just want to get to the room after a long flight, and speaking with three people. In the end, the Palms Place room was nice, I enjoyed the large jetted tub and balcony, and I would recommend Palms Place over the Palms Casino rooms. The other down-side though would be the resort fees, about $45 per day, for internet and fitness/pool use - however, it's cold outside in December so you cannot use the pool, and I feel the fees should be adjusted. also I was using the internet and playing my Spotify, and it kept stopping songs in the middle etc, so I simply used my 4G LTE and it played much better - same with web browsing, it was slower than your regular phone service, so not needed. You should be able to opt out if you don't use those services - most people simply go to Vegas to have fun in the town, not go to the fitness center/pool when it's 35 degrees outside. So consider the extra $45 per night when you book the room and compare prices to other hotels.

allReviews.title: Palms
allReviews.text: I often stay at the Palms when I go to Vegas, and I would say "very good" is an appropriate rating. Staff are friendly and helpful. There is not much of a "spectical" at this casino much like other casinos - no fancy entrance or decorations or anything. However, the rooms have always been nice and clean. They have always had spectacular views. I adore the bathroom which has a lovely shower. I am dissapointed that there is not a small fridge in the rooms (besides the one full of mini drinks to pay for) that one could put food left overs. We enjoy eating out a lot in Vegas, and it is frustrating that we cannot take left overs back to the room for later. The Palms has many eating opportunities that have been great when I have visited. Shark, their restaurant by Bobby Flay, is by far one of the best restaurants I have ever been to in my life. They also have the Lucky Penny, which is a 24 eating spot and great for 2am cravings. Unfortunately, the pool leaves a lot to be desired. It is in an enclosed area which we thought would be great as it would be heated when it was cold outside, but they don't actually keep it warm enough inside to wear a bathing suit and swim, which I believe defeats the purpose. Overall:- Pros:Clean roomsGreat viewsBeautiful bathroom and shower Good restaurant optionsNice staff- Cons:No mini fridge in room for left oversPointless poolNot on the strip (could be a pro considering on what you are going to Vegas for!)No spectical

allReviews.title: New Palms is the same as lousy old Palms
allReviews.text: Stopped in to see the renovations and gamble a bit. What a disappointment. The addition of the West Casino extension is a crammed hallway with old machines. The slots are tight. So tight that $40 brought absolutely 0 in return on two machines. Got a ticket from one machine that could not be used. Had to bring to cashier. Several machines had no volume. The casino is small. Simply not worth the trip.

allReviews.title: First time visit, pleasantly surprised
allReviews.text: Sure I've been to Vegas and I've stayed on the strip many times...  This was my first time at the Palms.  I liked the ease of self parking.  I liked that I could get from the parking structure to check-in and to the elevator to my room without having to walk through the whole entire casino floor.  I was easy to get around and find my way.  The room was very large and well appointed.  I did find the mirror on the ceiling a little odd (yes, mirror) - even for Vegas.  I mean it was a standard room...  Anyway, the bathroom was also large and clean.  Our sink was clogged when we first arrived and we called maintenance.  They came and took care of it and cleaned while we were out.  Great service.  Over-all it was a great stay.

allReviews.title: Horrible
allReviews.text: Came with a group of friends 9 of is to be exact to Celebrate their Birthday once we got here it took almost a hour to check in because the room we booked for they sold to some and the. Acted like it wasn’t their fault. At first they didn’t even want to compensate for their mistakes then after a hour they finally checked us in and compensated us. The only good thing is they have very comfortable beds and the buffet was good especially the breakfast

allReviews.title: I guess.....
allReviews.text: I've been to Vegas numerous times and stayed at various hotels. The Palms is by far my least favorite. The staff was very friendly and attentive but the atmosphere of the hotel is not the best. I felt very cold and uncomfortable in there and every one stares at you like you have horns and a tail. Not much to do at the hotel since it is off of the strip. WiFi is NOT free. It is only available for 24 hours during your stay. The resort fee was unnecessary as it didn't feel like a resort. I can tell why the rooms were a steal. It is not an ideal hotel to stay at in Vegas. Our friends were staying at Ceasar's and we should have followed suit.

allReviews.title: Secret luxury
allReviews.text: What a great spot, close to the strip, surprisingly affaordable (just remember there WILL be a extra $50 Las Vegas fee per day).I got a magnificent room with a view of the Bellagio and they upgraded me (after I asked nicely) to a room on the top floor, with an even better view. The staff is friendly, the rooms were spotless.Close to supermarkets and liquor stores if you don't want to spend the bank on restaurants

allReviews.title: The Palms Vacation Stay
allReviews.text: The Palms is a great place to stay. Food was fantastic and the staff was great as well. The few downfalls was the smell of weed at times as people are not courteous. Overall, it was a great place to stay, but it is about a 10 min drive to the strip so be aware of that. If you rent a car they have free parking and parking garage. You do get free alcohol served to you as you are gambling, however, in our experience we didn’t have a single person come up to us and ask/serve us drinks. This was the same situation in most parts of the casino and we don’t drink much but it would’ve been nice to know that our presence was acknowledged even though the areas were not busy.

allReviews.title: Best las Vegas Hotels/Casinos
allReviews.text: The staff is very courteous, attentive and helpful and go out of their way to assist in every way possible. The rooms are comfortable and spacious and the housekeeping staff is excellent. Many different food choices and the ambiance is perfect. Centrally located and easy access.

allReviews.title: Large room
allReviews.text: From the on-set, the staff is most pleasant and helpful. Smooth check-in. Always willing to provide services whenever possible. Ask. My first night happened to be the same night as some video game event. Loud DJ music at the pool area, and I was on the 21st floor. Party went quiet before midnight. Great sleep.

allReviews.title: Unorganized Nitwits
allReviews.text: These jackasses through a party for 20,000 convention people.  They “forgot” let their hotel guests know.  They clearly didn’t plan properly.  Suddenly hotel guests couldn’t be dropped off at the front lobby.  Had to walk across the parking lot.  Hotel security was extremely aggressive.  The security people are the worst.  I’ve seen it in several reviews about Kaos, but now it has spilled over to the hotel side.  I guess these folks will never learn how to treat guests.  No wonder they have lost $$$millions!  The Palms is doomed and quite frankly they deserve for not listening to their customers.  Don’t stay here, y’all!!! It sucks!

allReviews.title: Will nickel and dime you horrible
allReviews.text: We are seven star at harrahs but had family staying at this resort so wanted to stay in same hotel.Not never been to such a bad resort and we have been all over the world.   Not only was the bed horrid as we needed a noon check out and he demanded a $50 fee for it.  (We had booked a sightseeing flight and needed the extra hour so we paid it. Along with the high room rate.    Also if I had wanted aCome from the mini bar it would have been $35.00Ridiculous Lastly the penny restaurant for breakfast and I ordered chicken fried steak and eggs.  I got a beef fried steak and when I asked was told that is what they consider chicken.    As we took our kids there did not want to be embarrassed by sending it back so just did not eat itI will never stay there and willl recommend to all our friends who gamble to stay away when in vegas

allReviews.title: Soooo disappointing!!!
allReviews.text: We stayed 3 nights in room 11202, a corner king junior suite. The only positive thing I can say about the experience is that the view was absolutely amazing! As soon as we came in the room we noticed that the carpet had obviously not been vacuumed because there was crap all over it and filth around the toilet & hair all over the floor in the bathroom. It was obvious that, other than the bed being made, nothing was done in this room! Upon  closer inspection we found a huge hole in our sheets and dust almost a 1/4” thick on all the window  sills in the bathroom. Under the bathroom counter there was broken glass! When you use the shower you were standing in filthy standing water that stayed there for an hour after you got out! The next day when we got back to our room the bathtub had hair in it and when you use the shower you were standing and filthy standing water that stayed there for an hour after you got out! The next day when we got back to our room late afternoon they had come in and made the bed but didn’t bother to take our dirty glasses and replace them with new ones. They had not swept the floor or cleaned the shower or any of the other basic things that they should’ve done. When I stopped one of the maids in the hall later that evening and asked for glasses and explain that we didn’t get any she seemed offended but begrudgingly gave us two! We had a late flight out on Thursday and called down to ask if we could possibly have a late check out and they offered two hours for an additional $40. We declined and left. I also have to mention that we had other people from our company staying at the Palms as well and their experience was equally as bad. So much so that they changed rooms on the first night and ended up with an equally bad room the second time around… Same issues as ours with standing water in the shower and filth. We would never stay at this hotel again and certainly never recommend it to anyone we know.

allReviews.title: Next time, I'm staying here.
allReviews.text: Just a review of the casino floor and restaurants, but it is a really great casino. The renovations gave this place a clean, fun vibe and I loved it. We had pizza at Side Piece (can't recommend enough -- excellent). Just a good place. Will try and stay here next time out.

allReviews.title: Spacious rooms with spectacular view
allReviews.text: I love this hotel, so exquisite, modern and two huge screens. It's a fun way to wake up in the morning, hungover. It will give you a generous view of Las Vegas. However, the balcony was locked. I was to hungover to try the breakfast. Will definitely consider the same place when I go back to Vegas.

allReviews.title: What a rip-off Hotel
allReviews.text: I booked and paid for a room for the Halloween weekend at this hotel on a third party web site. When I arrive I was told that I would only be charged the daily resort fee of $39. Now that I have checked out the hotel told me the online reservation was cancelled and that they are charging the me the full amount of my stay which is over $700. At check in I was never told my reservation was cancelled or the amount that I would be charge daily. I will never stay at this hotel again, Very bad business practices.

allReviews.title: Nice stay
allReviews.text: Always warm welcome from FO team it’s make more happy I hope I gonna see this people again I like to say special thanks from Concierge team prem Ananth for their support nice breakfast nice view rooms fully clean

allReviews.title: Nice hotel, great night stay
allReviews.text: My boyfriend and I planned a last minute trip to Vegas. We had all of our rooms booked except one night, which we ended up picking the Palms! I just read a lot of really bad reviews before posting this, but must say I dont have anything bad to say! We arrived early for check-in and asked if it was possible to check in early. The guy at the front desk was very nice and allowed us to check in early. He was super friendly to us! The curb appeal was great and they had a lovely photo OP area out front that said "palms" with big balloons! Our room was nice and clean! Only down side wa s no coffee or water included. We were on the 16th floor and had a nice view of part of the strip.We didn't find it noisy but the pool was also close  during our stay which kind of sucked because we are Canadians and even in October Vegas weather is pool worthy!The only complaint we would have is the distance from the strip. If you are looking for a nice hotel close to the strip but not right on it this is it. There were food choices that range in price to allow selections for all.There was a staff member checking at night to make sure anyone going up to the rooms had room keys which was a nice security feature.

allReviews.title: In Town for a Conference
allReviews.text: Property was very nice and would have rated excellent if not for construction noise outside of my room all night every night. Very clean and up to date furnishings. Property has everything you need to stay away from the strips traffic.

allReviews.title: Very unwelcome
allReviews.text: We stayed in the hotel and I never had such a bad treatment at the front desk, I took my parents for the 40 anniversary and they treat us like a motel. They send me and email to see how was our stay and I gave my feed back and never respond anything. I guess they don’t careWe will never come back

allReviews.title: AWFUL MANAGERS !!!!!!!BLOODY BAND AID FOUND ON BED DRESSING & TOWELS IN MY EXECUTIVE SUITE. NOTHING DONE ABOUT IT
allReviews.text: AWFUL MANAGERS !!!!!!!BLOODY BAND AID FOUND ON BED DRESSING & TOWELS IN MY EXECUTIVE SUITE. NOTHING DONE ABOUT IT

allReviews.title: Simply Average
allReviews.text: 10.23.19Was here for NBAA event place is dated now needs overhaul.Went to the club drinks tasted water downed and weak.the Doctor Hit me with some BIG LOVE ❤️💕 and a helpful VOTE!Written  10.23.19  the Doc!
