allReviews.title: Would stay there again but would rather try something else instead (HORRIBLE WIFI)
allReviews.text: Overall I would describe my 4 day stay as an average hotel experience for Vegas. My room was good, great bed and I even had a bit of a view over the strip. But the hotels WiFi is the worst I have ever had in a hotel and it almost seems like they are trying to force you to pay for the 30/30 connection.They advertise it as a 10/10 connection but it can not even view a normal YouTube video on low 420p with out stopping multiple times to load for a really long time.It has to be said that whilst I was there the day club, and pool area was closed which was a bit of a disappointment. A map of the hotel would have been nice as well or at least some info about the second pool they have now that the normal pool was closed.

allReviews.title: Stayed for business & conference - pre reno I think
allReviews.text: There for business in adjoining conference area - super convenient - was in one of the non-renovated rooms so won't comment - was clean but pretty outdated.  Generally service was great.  Would come back and look forward to experiencing the new renovation.  Location off strip was still central and easy to car share to.

allReviews.title: Just don’t- better options out there!
allReviews.text: Had the displeasure of experiencing an expensive evening at the Palms for a friends birthday party and leaving unsatisfied. We are locals and decided to stay for a night since we were doing dinner and the Billy Idol concert.  Our $200 room rate deal turned into $320 after all the taxes and resort fees.  The room was average at best – I recently just stayed at a Courtyard Marriott which was more plush and comfortable than this room.  Furnishings were minimal – not even extra pillows on the bed (only 2 per) and no extra pillows/blankets in the closet. There was some weird funky waterproof mattress protector that made crunchy sounds every time I moved.  Rooms were sparse yet neat, but nothing that should be commanding a high price - more of a budget suite.  Lots of attitude on the casino floor from the bar staff-doesn’t matter if you were a man or a woman they were clearly too busy doing whatever instead of paying attention to the guests and serving drinks in a timely fashion.  The food at Mabel’s barbecue was excellent and a good value but the service there was average at best.  Thank goodness Kaos was closed - I’ve heard from several locals that the room windows rattle and the complaints are nonstop from all the noise. I guess that’s why they’re trying to build the dome! LOL. From all the reviews I’ve been reading they need to focus more on guest services and cleanliness instead of another night club in town.

allReviews.title: Very disappointed with view of concert!!
allReviews.text: The sole purpose of our visit to Vegas was to see Billy Idol in concert here at the palms.  I was extremely upset and very disappointed with the view I had.  I am a full-time wheelchair user so was sat at the back behind the last row of seats.This was a great view until.............The concert started and everyone stood up to dance!  Great, all I could now see was peoples shoulders and bums!!!!I asked the usher if I could move and sit behind the stairs leading down to the seats, he said no.  I explained how I could see absolutely nothing of the concert and reluctantly said ok as long as I sat up against the wall.This was better, well if you call better by everyone up and down the stairs to go to the bar/toilet or whatever and me having to wait for them to pass to carry on watching Billy!!!  Oh, let's not forget the people who chose to stand on the stairs too.If venues insist on placing wheelchair users up at the back, at least make it so if/when people do stand to dance, they don't block the view.The irony was, that to my right, they had wheelchairs sitting on what looked lie a balcony, so no view obstruction possible!!Wouldn't want to repeat this experience!!

allReviews.title: Ok, but disappointing
allReviews.text: PROS: plenty of good food/drink options for all budgets, easy to park/get to rooms, big suitesCONS: condescending ape at the reception desk, remodeled rooms feel amateur in design/execution, lots of random hairs throughout the bathroom

allReviews.title: Horrible experience, NOT WORTH IT
allReviews.text: This was my first time staying at the Palms without having the room pre-booked through someone who works for TAO group. If you aren't associated with a "high-rolling" party, you will be treated like absolute garbage. Management has no manners, doesn't cater to guest needs, and we were greeted with SO MUCH ATTITUDE when attempting to figure out the room situation for our large party which the hotel messed up upon booking. Long story short - we had to switch rooms multiple times during the trip, had to bicker back and forth to at least get resort fees waived after one of our rooms flooded when using the bathtub, and don't even get me started on one of the night managers who essentially suggested we "go stay somewhere else if we are not happy with the rooms" on a sold out weekend during Life is Beautiful fest...horrible. Just stay on the strip and save yourself the stress and annoyance associated with pretty much every single person who works here. Would recommend a professional hospitality training course for all management staff, y'all need it.

allReviews.title: New look Palms Casino Resort.
allReviews.text: Having witnessed vast changes to Las Vegas over the last 16 years the phenomenal upgrading of the Palms is right up there with the best. Seemingly nearly $700 million has been injected to move it into the 4/5 star bracket.Magnificent decor, rooms, restaurants, buffet, casino layout etc. It is now a Station Casino and well worth a visit.If you are not driving you can walk up West Flamingo Road (approx. 25mins.)at the side of the Bellagio or take a 202 bus. A third alternative is the shuttle service which leaves from the stop behind the 'Wheel' at the Linq and you can stop off at the Gold Coast Hotel which is right opposite the Palms Resort.

allReviews.title: Just okay.
allReviews.text: Kaos was closed thank goodness, so no noise issues. I didn’t mind staying off strip, definitely cheaper to use Uber btw. The casino was clean, service was very nice. Late evenings we sat at the bar at the Lucky Penny, bartenders were great and my husband loved the lobster roll. We were in the tower next to the social club and it really needs an update. They room was plain, nothing particularly special but nothing bad either. As a lady, my biggest complaint was the bathroom didn’t have a vanity mirror and the counter was too small for two people. Probably wouldn’t stay again, but wouldn’t say no if I got a good deal.

allReviews.title: A Comfy and Art-Filled Complex
allReviews.text: I had never stayed at this hotel in all my trips to Las Vegas and was a little nervous when people said it was no longer owned by the Maloof family. I was very pleased with my stay and it wasa great experience. The late check-in was easy and the room in the Fantasy Tower was pretty great (29th floor). Very nice bathroom, a sizeable mini bar, and perfect bedding. The only thing I thought was strange was no in-room coffee. For the price of these rooms, you'd think they would have pod coffee/tea or something. The breakfast from room service was very good and as much as I was annoyed a pot of coffee was $18, it was really good coffee. All of the food was excellent, and staff from The Lucky Penny, Greene Street Kitchen and the Damien Hirst bar were wonderful, as were the Pearl Theater staff. It's a little off the strip but nothing an Uber couldn't solve, and I kind of like that it was a bit out of the crazy zone. The art collection is quiet something, and they even have a James Jean mural at Send Noodles. The pool is under construction, but that's not a scene I would have taken part of, so I can't say anything on that.My only real complaint is how ridiculously loud the music is everywhere you go. I guess that's fine in the lobby and casino areas, but it was obnoxious at restaurants and in bar areas. It causes everyone to shout over the music because you can't hear anyone you might be sitting with -- so the noise levels get even worse. I'm retired from the music industry and go to gigs all the time, but I don't need blaring music from a speakers all around me while I'm trying to eat or have a drink with friends.

allReviews.title: Cigarette smoking overpowering need air purification system.
allReviews.text: We stayed at a nonsmoking hotel nearby. Just walking through the casino I had to cover my nose the smoke was so thick. By the last day my body took a few hours to regain full breathing capacity. And I am very healthy! I spoke to the conference organizers about changing the venue for next year because of the smoke. The only reason I didn't give a 1 rating is that the food the hotel provided for dinner was excellent! Especially the desserts! First class.

allReviews.title: Let me count the ways to utterly F up
allReviews.text: I’ve stayed multiple times at this property; had yet to have a seamless experience. This stay takes the absolute horrible cake:THREE ROOM MOVES IN 1 DAY; finally had to take whatever was available - I booked a double. My roommate ended up staying elsewhere since no space.Utterly sh*t housekeeping standards - all 3 rooms had hairs all over the beds. Misplaced, found, lost again a large package - took 4 days to receive after I had to call again on the 4th day. Managers that can’t execute, no SOPs for different departments to talk to each other.Previously had less than stellar cleanliness in rooms - hairs on bathroom floor, etc.All of which led to me spending 8HRS NO FOOD, NO WATER, NO REST, NO SHOWER. This visit: Had to request new pillows since both beds had pillows that smelled “lived-in”. Very lived-in. Called, was given run around and then told by front desk erroneous hrs to visit business center office (which was closed). 2 days of waiting for a package they said they didn’t have, despite tracking info I had.Next day; had late night and found minibar not replenished with water (no turndown service). Turned on faucet to take medication - no cold water. Contacted front desk to ask about minibar & to report water issue but DO NOT SEND ANYONE until I call next morning. Get knock on my door right after I fall asleep. Poor engineer is just doing his job so I groggily waited until he left. Wake up next morning to find still no cold water. Hotel requests to move my room & keys will be delivered ASAP. Rushed to pack...no one came with keys for almost 2.5hrs. They still can’t locate package.After the initial room move (into a smaller room), was told emphatically that I must be present and available to receive package - they found it. Waiting, can’t leave - so no food or water. No answer to when it is coming but it’s “on it’s way”. Exhausted since very little sleep. Find pillows in new room “lived-in”, crusty stains on the middle bedside console & bathroom counter top. I order new pillows, ask for housekeeping to pls clean up a bit & update on package delivery. After another hr; decide to just lay down; FIND HAIR - long curly one just under the covers. Call front desk to request new room.Get extensive apologies from the various ppl that I have been talking to - they offer a larger room. Go in, bed area smells like bacon. Half the pillows stink. Bathroom mat is visibly dirty with black marks and footprint. Crusty bedside table top. Exhausted so I just want to lay down. FIND HAIRS BOTH BEDS, AGAIN - eyelashes and small curly hairs inside first bed. Second bed has even more hairs; short thick ones like someone just got a haircut and some long curly back ones. Have been very pleasant until now; finally flip out since I haven’t been able to leave hotel or room(s) to get food or take a shower to wait for keys and this package due to arrive any minute - which is missing yet again. Fielded call from irate bellman asking if I made a mistake since nothing in package room.Front desk apologizes yet again, asks if I need double room or if single will do. At this point I have barely slept, haven’t eaten, no water or showered for over 8hrs. I take whatever room. I request housekeeping manager to come up and view the sh*tshow personally. They lmk they are sending person up to view immediately. They end up hustling me into new room so I don’t know if anyone came up to see the disgusting mess. New room has a stained pillow but I just pulled it off because I can’t stomach moving a 4th time.By that point already canceled my entire day and dinner plans. Completely exhausted so just order room service - order a bottle of wine of Joel Gott; they bring me a glass of house red. The next day; not a peep from anyone, no message, no note nothing. Also still no package. I finally get a hold of someone at business center who says not their problem since they said they had it but different area, etc. - that whoever contacted should have known to email since they aren’t in office to answer the phone. I finally arrange for delivery to the room myself; FOUR DAYS LATE.Was offered piecemeal over all the calls to waive my resort fee and half my room rate, comp the water I took from minibar...I would prefer to send them an invoice for my time & patience wasted. Leaving a very thorough review since this is pretty unspeakable on all levels. Waited 2 days for someone to contact me. Kind of shocking since this is supposed to be the signature property for Station Casinos. Coming from someone who was part of luxury hotel opening team (front office), this is just completely unforgivable. Not to mention not trained dealers; had my 2nd terrible, grouchy, unfriendly unengaged dealer last night. AVOID this property COMPLETELY, do not pass go.(Pls do not send a sh*tty insincere canned reply from the “owner” like the ones being copied and pasted to yelp. It’s insulting & infuriating).

allReviews.title: Exciting Weekend in Vegas
allReviews.text: From the moment we had the valet park our car, we were treated as courteously and professionally as possible. Front desk personnel were efficient and quickly got everything ready for checking in. Upon entering elevators a security checked for room keys and added an0ther level of security for the guests.  the rooms were modern, spacious and comfortable. The views from all rooms are expansive and enjoyable and the choices for dining are extensive and cater to everyone's choices. The casino is large and comfortable. All in all an enjoyable visit and resort property. The show room is comfortable and intimate in comparison to thers.

allReviews.title: We slept with one eye open all night.
allReviews.text: we had killed two Roaches in our bathroom, one in toilet area other in main bath area. We reported this to the management and Housekeeping manager and never did they offer to move us to another room or even call us to get more information or see how we felt? the room had the past occupants trash and fast food wrapper still in the cupboard next the bar. All the shelves had lots of dust balls and there were little black dead bugs all over the floors. This may be isolated but examine you room real good b4 u unpack!

allReviews.title: Buyer Beware...horrible management!!
allReviews.text: I don’t usually complete these with negative reviews as I am generally a really easy customer to please, but the Palms really pulled a horrible stunt so I had to share to warn people who are thinking about staying there…Stayed at the Palms Resort with 5 friends for a bachelor party the weekend of 9/20/19-9/23/19.  We arrived at the Palms, and to our surprise, they informed us that a voluntary decision was made to close the Kaos day-club pool just a few days prior to our arrival. Given that this was a key amenity and a main reason why we booked at the Palms, which is off the strip, we did what any normal, reasonable guest would do…we asked for a very modest refund, or at the very least, a small amount of comps to use at the hotel in the form of a dining credit.  We paid several thousand dollars for the rooms, and would have been satisfied with just a small fraction of that in comps…we thought that was more than fair.The Palms management staff was completely unreasonable in this request.  They told us that they would not provide any sort of refund, nor would they provide any type of comp for dining, etc. So at the end of the day, the hotel advertises the Kaos pool as part of their amenities to us (which is one of the major reasons we booked), then VOLUNTARILY closes the pool immediately prior to our arrival. They provided us with ZERO advanced notice that the Kaos pool was closed, and when we asked for a modest refund or comp, provided us with NOTHING. They argued that another pool was still open within the resort and available to guests.  This pool, the Palms Place pool, is located about a mile away from our hotel room (Kaos is about 30 feet away), is significantly smaller, did not have a DJ, and is not even close to the same at the Kaos day-club pool.My advice would be to stay somewhere else.  If Palms is willing to, in my opinion, falsely advertise amenities to guests, then provide no advanced notice that they are closed prior to the guests’ arrival, they could easily do it again. Don’t put yourself in that position where they can screw you….just book somewhere else.  It really put a damper on the whole weekend when they not only told us that the pool was closed, but that they also wouldn’t provide us with any sort of refund/comp as a gesture of regret or good faith.  Buyers Beware…better off staying somewhere else!

allReviews.title: What happened to the 650 Reno?
allReviews.text: First I want to say I was booked at another hotel that had a better rating and was less expensive but I really wanted to see the Damien Hirst Demon and other treasures so I decided why not just stay here then I don’t have to leave the hotel. I booked via phone. When I arrived I told them I was here just to see the Demon and they made a face and informed me that the Kaos pool, the main pool where the demon is, is under construction! There is nothing on the website! I was so upset! Upon checking into my room I noticed that the renovation in the ivory tower was missed, so the the cleaning! The white crusted DNA on the lounge was gross! The front desk told me there was nothing they could do about the pool and would offer no adjustment, they claimed it was on the webpage and I checked again and it is not. As for changing the room it was 10 at night and apparently it was a big deal to get a room change. I was too tired to fight them it was a long drive! BEWARE. I’ve included pics from my room. Disappointment is an understatement, I should have stayed at the Cosmo. :-(

allReviews.title: Perfect place to stay
allReviews.text: This place was perfect as we went to a show there and had dinner there two nights in a row. Ate at Mabel's one night and at Shark the next. Both were fantastic. Very clean and very nice rooms. Rates were great also.

allReviews.title: UNIQUE WEDDING PARTY
allReviews.text: My daughter wanted a different type of wedding so team bride and team groom travelled from Queretaro Mexico to Las Vegas . The wedding ceremony was  in Palms Casino Resort amazing black and white chapel designed by Joshue Vides and of course what would a wedding be in Vegas without Elvis. But even better the Elvis wedding ceremony was  on the Moon and View terrace with breath taking views of the Vegas Strip.  We then had the reception in the Greene St Kitchen restaurant in Palms hotel and casino in a great private section .Our theme was black and white and they set up our tables with white table cloths, black napkins and even elegant black cutlery. The foood was sooooo good..... melt in your mouth salmon and filet mignon.. oh and did I mention the lobster mash and the tuna pizza. Totally gourmet food at its best.The wedding party didnt stop there there we carried on partying in one of the Palms penthouses also wonderful. Although the air conditioning in one area of the suite wasnt functioning correctly. We would like to thank all the Plams  Casino staff for making the wedding a unique experience  and all our guests who came from Mexico, Texas and Manchester UK and our wonderful wedding planner.  This is my first ever review  ever of anything on trip advisor and I dont know how to post photos. I will try and get someone to help me.

allReviews.title: Too Noisy!
allReviews.text: Had a room in the newly remodeled Fantasy Tower with a room facing the pool. Horrible room to be in if you want sleep before 4am! During the day, you hear the day club music. At night, you hear the night club music until 4am! It was so loud, I could have had my own club in my room. Changed rooms the next day to the other side of the hotel. Much better. So if you plan on staying here, make sure you ask for a room that isn’t facing the club. Parents had a room here too. Light in the middle of the beds wouldn’t turn off. Informed them and they said they’d send up engineering. Called 4 times in the span of 12 hours. Still no engineering. So they had the light on all night. Bad customer service! Stay somewhere else!!

allReviews.title: Terrible - Music from the pool shaking the rooms until 4am
allReviews.text: If you plan on getting any sleep, or mild even relaxation in between nights, do not stay here. The music from the pool was unbelievably loud, even 28 levels up. Our room was literally shaking from the noise until 4am each night. Pretty unbelievable that this doesn't have to be disclosed prior to booking.

allReviews.title: Kaos Night club - phone thieves
allReviews.text: We came to see Marshmello and the venue was great. We used my phone to take a photo. Maybe 10 mins later it was stolen right out of my purse. We think we even know who stole it - there were a couple of guys around - one always stood next by all creepy and the other was in our faces. I knew exactly the moment when my phone was gone and my friend went to the security to ask for assistance but they didn’t want to help. I am sure my phone wasn’t the only stolen phone that night. Hopefully, the security will do something about it if they receive enough complaints.

allReviews.title: Party Hotel
allReviews.text: If you want a property with loud music and overwhelming base cadence that permeates through the entire hotel until early AM, then this place is for you!  If you prefer a property with nice updated amenities that you, significant other & family can reasonably enjoy, then we suggest you stay during the week or search elsewhere.  For our weekend birthday celebration we didn't realize a popular DJ was performing or that the hotel & pool would be monopolized by approx. 1K people.  When that show concluded another began at rooftop bar.  No escape from the intrusive base and we witnessed vocal complaints from young & old plus neighbors who lived in apartments next door.  The Palm Place pool was a suggested alternative but it was closed the day we wanted to use it.  Our room was on the street side, the bed was a sink hole, lavatory would not drain & the safe had to be reset by Security before it would function properly.  On the upside for 3 Star Rating, the hotel & Security staff are top notch, the restaurant selection is great, and hotel has upgraded contemporary decor.  We don't deny anyone a good party because we've been there -- just wish we'd known before making hotel selection for our special occasion.  Lesson learned...

allReviews.title: Terrible
allReviews.text: I have never had a room this loud before.  Make sure you stay away from the pool.  Between the loud air conditioning and the music, plus the vibrations from the bass, I may as well have been sleeping on a bench in a train station.    Awful.

allReviews.title: Best customer service!
allReviews.text: The customer service at this hotel is amazing!! Matthew at the font desk was extremely helpful and attentive to our needs! He got us checked in expeditiously and ensured we had everything we needed to celebrate our friends 30th birthday weekend!! -The Girl with the Hoops-

allReviews.title: Small Casino
allReviews.text: I stayed here recently for a conference and while it is relatively close to the strip, the casino in the hotel is small. There are a bunch of slot machines and a few table games but compared to some of the larger hotels on the strip this is just a small fraction of that. If you here purely just for work like I was, its ok. If you're here for gambling, you might look else where if you want variety. The good news is the comps come easy since you don't really need to be a high roller to get some free comp nights at the hotel.

allReviews.title: Good But Surprised...
allReviews.text: My friend and I precooked  our room months in advance for our conference, so I was surprised that after we were asked to upgrade for a price and refused, we ended up in an accessible room. It wasn’t a big deal but showering in an accessible bathroom that has just a shower curtain soaked the entire bathroom, leaving blow drying your hair or curling it a tad dangerous and awkward. The bath mat and floor was soaked as well as clothes. I also couldn’t help but wonder if we were in a room, that somebody could actually need and that bothered me. We are scheduled here again for our conference and I’m a bit disappointed. Our room and floor also smelled like weed the entire stay especially at night. Our smoke detector battery also started going off because it as dead.The hotel itself is nice. Great restaurants and easy access to get to the strip via Uber. Nothing stood out. This was my 11th trip to Vegas and my 1st at the Palms. Wasn’t overly impressed compared to everywhere else I’ve stayed.

allReviews.title: Won’t be back
allReviews.text: We had a concert at the Palms so we decided to stay here as well. ( the venue Is great) We thought the accomodation would be great too. At check in the music is pumping which makes it hard to hear what you are being told, such as room upgrades at a cost . We where an hour early for check in and we didn’t get our room until two hours later. Our credit card was changed twice for resort fees and a deposit on the room which is charged per night. This we weren’t credited back until later in the week. I think the resort fee should be in the price. You are just a number at The Palms so if you don’t want personalised service and want to feel like you are being changed for everything stay here!!! The place looks fantastic, just no one really cares..

allReviews.title: Nice Resort a Mile off the Strip
allReviews.text: Located on Flamingo Road, the Palms Casino Resort is three large buildings which are very spread out so be prepared to walk!  My wife was there for a recent conference so my daughter and I got to play tourist.  The rooms are large, nicely appointed and very clean.  The price varies greatly if you're there for a conference or not, check the websites.  Parking is free but there's a $41/night "resort fee", I found that was a little expensive as it covers wifi and a free newspaper if you remember to ask for it.  The Concierge tried to be helpful but didn't sound too familiar with a lot of my questions.  Lots of smokers which surprised me.

allReviews.title: The Best of Las Vegas Resorts
allReviews.text: Staff is very accommodating and courteous and go out of their way to be helpful and ensure your stay is the best possible. Good service in dining areas and upgraded rooms and general areas are excellent. An enjoyable resort and comfortable, and situated in close proximity to the Las Vegas Strip and numerous other Hotels and Casinos.

allReviews.title: Palms Casino
allReviews.text: Even located out from Strip at not walking distance, it´s a nice place to stay and get some fantastic portrait from Strip skyline. A great pool area to take a sunbathing or have some fun with a party.

allReviews.title: Business Conference
allReviews.text: The conference room was great, had no problems hearing speakers. Restrooms were large. Only 4 stars as I felt this was too expensive for a place I wouldn't have a chance to explore. Stayed across the street for half the price. If you are here for fun and can afford the rooms, it may rate a 5 star review.

allReviews.title: Palms Casino resort
allReviews.text: A nice hotel with one caveat.  No coffee machines in the room!  If you want to start your day with some coffee, it'll cost you $8.50 for a pot for room service [plus a tip].  Or you can get a large cup from The Lucky Penny for $5.00.  The restaurants are high quality.  I had breakfast at The Lucky Penny three times and wasn't disappointed.  Omelettes ran $12-$15.  The All You Can Eat buffet is another decent deal - $18 for lunch and $25 for dinner.  The only drawback is there's almost always a one-hour line.  I went at 2:30PM and was seated in fifteen minutes.  If you want to get around and don't have a car, Uber is the answer. It's half to two thirds the price of a cab - from the airport as well.  If you want to save a little on the hotel, the Gold Coast is just as nice and is right across the street.  The Rio is also an acceptable, cheaper alternative.  The ambient temperature was 105 - 113 during the day.  Dry or not, it was hot!

allReviews.title: Birthday celebration
allReviews.text: It's a fun place but you must be 21 not 41,too many young kids.. also no winnings, like I said no spenders,clean,nice view but try not to sleep by the kaos pool, only if your 21. Other than that it was okay.

allReviews.title: The reviews here don't lie
allReviews.text: Called before traveling, left message for manager to call me back as I had read some disappointing reviews and wanted to confirm room location etc.  Nobody called back.  Called next day spoke to front desk asking for room away from night club.  Arrive can't find reservation- oh they found a room right above night club.  Not what we asked for. Too bad.. Nobody cared. We left to go to a real hotel with service.  Goodbye Palms..  would not step foot back in that place.  If I owned that hotel and read this and other reviews I'd be over there asap to fix it..

allReviews.title: 1 Star Review from a Vegas Local
allReviews.text: This review is the subjective opinion of an individual traveller and not of Tripadvisor LLC nor of its partners. Tripadvisor performs checks on reviews as part of our industry-leading trust & safety standards. Read our transparency report to learn more.

allReviews.title: Under poor management.
allReviews.text: Unfortunately this hotel has lost its identity after the Maloofs sold the property. The pool area was built for the original tower, There are now 2 towers. Which isn't as problematic as you would think ifthe management company that runs the pool didn't close half the pool area. Yes... It's a management company, so going to the front desk to complain about anything, they tell you the pool is a private entity, seperate from the hotel. Meaning, you cannot take a drink into the pool 77jjeven if you are staying at the hotel. Buying a drink at the Bar or receiving a free drink while gambling must be consumed before entering the pool management area. The selection of beverages are limited. Sorry, they 7gdrinks.To top it off the pool area has the most incompetent bar tenders, that couldn't remember if you ask for a check or ketchup. Therefore, making the resort fee a scam. I hope this place changes, and soon.

allReviews.title: Disappointing resort usage
allReviews.text: Recently stayed at the Palms Casino and resort for four nights. On one occasion we used the pool and were immediately told that the pool was closing and that we had to leave due to the fact that it was rented out by a company. This forced us not being able to have pool access for an afternoon/evening. Also while checking in we were told that our room was not available due to the fact that it was given away and that we had to settle for a double bed room versus the king room we reserved unless we wanted a smoking king size bed room. Not quite sure how our room was given away after it was booked over a month in advance. I will say the room we got was clean and the casino appeared to be clean as well. Once bringing the issues to the attention of staff during checkout, they offered excuses and no resolution. For this, I will not be staying at this location again.

allReviews.title: VETERANS BEWARE/WORST PLACE EVER!!
allReviews.text: Disabled veteran forced to go up and down 14 floor because you can’t bring food/water to room? No fridges?  I’m from Washington and it was 110 degrees!!!  Food restrictions and forced to but THEIR food/water?  Thanks Palms and Shelby in customer service (who could work on her sincerity) for making my first visit most likely my last! You get no stars from me. There was way more wrong with the stay.... foul smell in hallway on 14th floor, no fans in bathrooms? 🤢Most of staff was rude and the rest was ok.Most had no idea not allowed food in rooms which Shelby said they should have known! 🙄Anyway, you’ve been warned.  I also called to speak to a real manager we will see if they even call!

allReviews.title: no fridge and no coolers allowed
allReviews.text: This newly remodeled casino has a lot of things going for it. The rooms and amenities are very nice and beds are comfortable. Valet parking is complimentary. It's also a bit off the strip so much more quiet then most places on the strip and easy to get to.This could have been a solid 4 stars unless you are not willing to pay $ 45 for half a bottle on Justin Cabernet from the mini bar. Nobody at the VIP check in told us that coolers  weren't allowed but the security guard at the elevators turned us around.  And the only fridge in the room is stashed with over priced crap from the mini bar, no room to put any of your own perishables. This practice gets a big fat thumbs down from me.

allReviews.title: Never Again!
allReviews.text: Unless you are under 30 and don't mind being ripped off, don't stay here.  They advertise the beautiful new pool area, which is beautiful, but they don't tell you guests cannot use the pools Friday, Saturday or Sunday, unless they pay to get it (around $30 a person).  Then, they don't tell you that even if you pay, you aren't allowed to sit on any chairs, unless you pay $1,000 or more for beverage service.  The pools on the strip are very nice and included in your stay, 7 days a week.  They charge a resort fee, but the only amenities are the pools you can't use and a mediocre at best fitness room.  They blast EDM music nearly 24 hours a day, so we paid $100 extra per night for an upgrade to get away from the noise so we could sleep.  It ended up being as expensive, or more expensive, than the Cosmopolitan or Aria on the strip, but not nearly as nice.  The staff were friendly, but no one knew anything and gave wrong answers to questions.  Truly pathetic.

allReviews.title: Vacation
allReviews.text: The Palms is a nice place and newly remodeled. My experience has always been great except for my last visit. If you travel by vehicle as we always do we were in for a rude awakening. We went to bring in are coolers with food and drinks when we were stopped and said they weren’t allowed anymore in the rooms. (We have always been able to do this for all the years we stayed) I asked what about the perishables we have, answer was we don’t care and it your problem if they perish. The security guard made sure we put them back in our van. We stayed are stay but I was to scared after that to eat there and even gamble. When we made the reservation we were never told this. If traveling by vehicle I don’t recommend!

allReviews.title: Nice Hotel with good young vibe- but YOUR PLAY will not be rated well and you won’t earn much
allReviews.text: Nice Hotel, with Great Young Hip vibe and Energy,  good room comfy bed,  The carpet not cleaned well.    For Sure you Want to ask for a room AWAY from the pool as it is very loud.   Did not bother me, but for most people it would.   My one big disappointment is I played craps for over 2 hours and got a total of $18.00. Or 2000 points on the stations system —- this has happened many times to me—- Very clear message to me is this is not the Hotel to actually gamble in....sadly.     But overall I like staying at the hotel.

allReviews.title: Awesome
allReviews.text: My family and I loved it. When we first came, the bellboy was sooo nice. He offered a rolling cart and made sure that we know where is the pool, spa, etc... After, we came into the room. It was amazing. The view was great and it smelled like lavender. The bed was soo comfortable and the couches were so clean. The pillows were nicely done and the furniture were dusted properly. I hope that my family and I can stay here again. 👏😍👏

allReviews.title: Nice, but aways from strip
allReviews.text: Stayed here with the wedding party. N Beautiful hotel and casino. Nice rooms. Convenient food court and restaurants. Didn't use the pool. Easy invite to Club Apex upstairs, which had nice views of Vegas.  Had a great stay. But Lyft is your friend.

allReviews.title: Nice hotel but far too much noise
allReviews.text: Nice hotel. Good rooms and a comfortable bed. We stayed at the ivory tower at 14th floor. The music from Kaos night club woke us up several times during the night even though we had earplugs in. We went to the reception and got a new room at palms palace. The receptionist told us that this was a common problem in both the Ivory and Fantasy tower. This should be informed about when booking.

allReviews.title: Very nice and clean
allReviews.text: We had an issue at Rio so we moved across the street to the Palms and were super glad we did.  The Palms is modern (which some hotels in Vegas are not), clean, convenient, pretty and a good value.  I would recommend this hotel/casino and will stay there again.

allReviews.title: Worst in Vegas!
allReviews.text: My husband and I usually stay else where when visiting Vegas but because of a domino tournament here thought it easier to stay at the Palms.   Biggest mistake ever!  At check in, there were three people behind the counter who were extremely slow; one of who was more interested in socializing with the people he was helping.   The young lady who checked us in advises that our room was near the club and we “might” hear the music. She moved us up a couple of floors and I asked her how bad would it be? Her response was “We like to tell our customers when they check in.”.   What she should have said was you won’t be able to sleep in your room.   The music was so loud and the bass so strong that the cordless phone fell off its base.  I mentioned this at checkout and the guy who was helping us couldn’t have cared less!  Only good thing about the place is Bobby Flay’s restaurant!  Excellent seafood!  I know we’re not their target market (based on all the half naked girls who hang around in the casino) so it’s back to Mandalay Bay for us!  Never again!!!

allReviews.title: Party Hotel
allReviews.text: Reviews are subjective and all depends on what you're looking for. If you're looking for a weekend party hotel, this is the place to go. If you are looking for a quiet place to relax, this is not the spot. With the newly updated hotel, decor is very modern and should I say Vegas tasteful tacky? I had a one bedroom suite and also a studio room, both were spacious and nice overall. The studio had mirrors on the ceiling and and the wall for those that are looking for a boom-boom room and they still serve porn on TV for those that are interested ;) On the down side, weekend are loud and even on the 30th floor could still hear the bass from the mega club Koas and feel the building vibrate. Bring earplugs or drink enough to pass out! As for Koas, very cool spot and Vegas crazy to be expected. What impressed me the most was the sound! I'm a Dj and have been to many mega clubs around the world and this place was impressive. Probably why the whole building shakes! The food here was pretty amazing and never had a bad meal. The poolside breakfast sandwich was great for a hangover and found good comfort foods at the Luck Penny. Try the shakes and waffle grilled cheese sandwhich if you're not afraid of carbs. It's Vegas....go crazy!

allReviews.title: Not worth it
allReviews.text: Came here for a dayclub event to see Marshmellow. It was so crowded we could barely move and there was no room to get in the pool. Drinks prices were sky high. A small beer was $13! It felt highly pretentious and just not worth the money.

allReviews.title: Not happy
allReviews.text: The room was updated- but the good qualities end there. Room service was horrible, asked for a vegetarian pasta dish- they put meat in it. And then asked if we could get a microwave or there's any way they can heat up some cold soup that we ordered and they said no. Paid hundreds for the room service items and was sorely disappointed. Also, took forever to get anything like towels. The MOST annoying this was that you could hear the music from KAOS, their nightclub from our room, all. night. long. Good luck getting any sleep!

allReviews.title: Current tops in Vegas
allReviews.text: The $600 mil renovation last year basically resulted in a new property.  The nightclub, Kaos, is on par with Encore or anything else in the city with a great crowd (young, high end but not too snobbish/high end like XS) - it functions both as a day club and nightclub.  The renovated rooms are fantastic, feel completely new with high end finishes and nice views of the strip.  At this resort, you get a high end experience without the price gouging of Wynn/Encore and the Caesar's and MGM properties.  The lines to get in the clubs are not as obnoxious, the covers are lower, the room prices are lower - but you are getting at least 90 percent of the experience you get at those places.  They also have budget food here, a decent food court and a buffet that provides all the options but is a fraction of the price of others on par with it in Vegas.  Maybe because it is owned by Station Casinos and not the big 3, you don't feel the intense corporate squeezing of your pocketbook here that you do elsewhere in the city rn.  A key example - free parking, free valet.  If you are at all price conscious this is the best value in Las Vegas at this time.

allReviews.title: Not as good as it used to be.
allReviews.text: This place has gone down hill, and I was really disappointed by my entire experience there. I’ve stayed here several times over the last 8-10yrs and was always fairly happy with my stay, despite the high resort fee. Check-in took awhile even though there were not a lot of people checking in. Despite some recent updates the overall condition of the hotel isn’t great.   The hall smelled strongly of damp and cleaner, and the carpet showed stains throughout. The door appeared to be recently painted, but it was badly done.Updates in the bathroom were also not well thought out. You have to stand in the shower to turn it on, so you will get hit with a blast of cold water.  The new tile and  glass didn’t look very nice because they were next to a countertop and mirror that had seen better days.  Add this to sink that was slow to drain and a toilet that didn’t flush and the overall bathroom was a miss. The sleeping area was also a combination of old and new.  The new graphics on the wall don’t really go with the dark worn furniture and peeling wall paper. I will Day that the beds were comfy and the room was fairly clean.  Another issue was that they had an event at the pool one night and the next day the pool opened late or maybe not at all l didn’t go back. Overall I was not happy with my stay, and I will not be back.

allReviews.title: great transformation
allReviews.text: I love the new look of Palms- well done! Plenty to do at New Palms. Several new restaurants and bars opened. I like the lighting and decor. great customer service at check inThe rooms have been renovated

allReviews.title: Palms stepped up their game
allReviews.text: Impressed with recent updates, particularly the restaurants. Great meals at Shark, Scotch Prime and particularly at Vetri. Room was adequate, nothing fancy but the bed was comfy and the view of the mountains was a nice change from strip views elsewhere. Gym is small, cardio machines dated and was packed early with my co-East Coast-ers. Pool by Palms Place had unnecessarily loud music, but opened at 9 vs 11 at Palms pool. Food at pool bar in Palms Place was not good, brown soggy lettuce. Overall experience better than expected, won’t hesitate to book for future conventions.

allReviews.title: Such a cool place
allReviews.text: We stayed here 2 years ago and absolutely loved it having a Vegas feel but not the craziness of people everywhere like the strip. And nice that every 30mins there was a free shuttle for the 5min drive to Caesars. Visited recently again to check out the renovation and wow it’s impressive! Everywhere is really cool and modern. We went to the pool which is now the nicest in Vegas and saw Marshmello. Simply awesome. Can’t wait to go back.

allReviews.title: Even better
allReviews.text: Lots of upgrades and makeovers have made this off strip property even better than before. Buffet is quite excellent, especially comparing the prices to the strip. Casino big, up to date, and pretty smokefree.

allReviews.title: Certainly a destination resort....
allReviews.text: About $300 million into a major remodel; the rooms in the Fantasy tower are extremely comfortable and well appointed. The restaurants are among the best features - nearly every menu available for the most discriminating palate. Scotch 80 - phenomenal steaks; the Lucky Penny - reasonably priced and excellent entrees open 24 hrs; Mabel's for great bbq. All of the team members were extremely hospitable and service was outstanding and personal. Definitely a destination resort - concert venue has first class entertainment. Stay, entertain, indulge, all while walking. My new favorite venue in Las Vegas.

allReviews.title: No craps table
allReviews.text: Actually the was one craps table open in the entire casino but it had a minimum of 100 Dollars. I visited the Palms at a midweek afternoon. I like to play craps at Station Casinos and do not any other Station Casino that has only Craps tables with a 100 Dollar minimum.The Palms is no place for locals that like table games with a reasonable minimum.That sayed it really looks nice after the renovation, therefore I give it 2 stars.

allReviews.title: No craps table at the Palms unless you are a millionaire
allReviews.text: Do not go to the Palms if you like to play Craps. I wanted to play Craps there on a Tuesday 2 PM. There was one table open: MINIMUM 100 DOLLARS! I like to play at Station Casinos but I can simply not afford to play at 100 Dollar minimum tables. Sad to see that the Palms is only a Casino for high rollers.

allReviews.title: Worst trip ever!!!!!
allReviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the Palms hotel we had to have surgery on our dog’s acl. We found out we had to stay another night. When checking  in we asked about staying another night.  The room rate went from $90 dollars to $275. Unhappily we agreed. We were told it was Electric Daisy Carnival not know what that was we checked in to our room... We really like the pool at the palms so Thursday morning we get ready to go to the pool and are informed there was a concert and to get in to the pool it would be $75 for my husband and $35 for me. I was so frustrated I asked to speak to the manager. When she came out and said there was nothing she could do! She was young and had no concern about how I was feeling where has compassion gone? The whole experience Unbelievable frustrating!! Andrea Van Zago Skrocki

allReviews.title: they bait and switch you
allReviews.text: sad im a las vegas native i recieved there flyer come to the palms get you free bowl went last week recieved a nice bowl went into the casino to get this weeks free gift and was told ooo no you cant have i as you have to earn 300 same day points... i did not have to have them last week.... my female roommate gets free gifts every week even thou7gh she never plays at the palms.... this is a classic bait and switch place...unless you gamble or a female dont ever think you will get your free gifts. very crappy place im glad there are over 150 other casinos that want my money.. PALMS CASINO IM DONE GIVEING MY MONEY. will have to sadly find another buffet to goto now as i will never be back

allReviews.title: PALMS Staff is Amazing!
allReviews.text: Out with the old because the new PALMS is a great vibe! Everything is new $500MM+ renovation.  Stay on upper floors if wekend club music bothers you.  Matthew at front desk was superb and he went out of his way to accommodate us!  Taylor and Blair at the pool kept the food and drinks coming with genuine care for us.  All in all this place is heading back to its Vegas glory days and we will be back soon.

allReviews.title: Awesome Stay
allReviews.text: We have been to The Palms 3 times over the past few years. This last time we felt was obviously the best. The upgrades that were recently done make a big impact for my future stays as I’m sure to return. The customer service was outstanding. The restaurants were top notch. The casino floor was extremely clean and didn’t smell. The floor wait staff was attentive. To top it all off The Pearl Theater was the best venue my wife and I have ever seen a concert at.I would place the Palms resort in the same category as the Cosmopolitan, heck I’d even go as far to say better (maybe because I’m not a fan of the clutter on the strip)All in all we will be back.

allReviews.title: The Palms fridge scam
allReviews.text: The mini-fridges at The Palms are sensor based (no signage on the fridge or told during check-in), therefore removing an item and putting it back results in being charged, even if you do not consume it.Due to the extortionate prices inside the mini fridge, my partner and I went to the local shop and purchased water and placed them in the fridge. Therefore we removed items that will not be affected by being outside the fridge, eg. pop. Leaving items such as orange juice and items such as jello-shots inside the fridge. When we finished our stay at the Palms we proceeded to place the items back in the fridge – consuming zero items.Once leaving the Palms we received an email invoice where we were charged EVERYTHING inside the fridge, totaling at over US$400. Speaking with the front desk, they explained about the sensor mini-fridge, and he told me it happens quite often. Hmm. He made a note on file and said the cleaners will check the items are there then we'll be refunded, as I knew I put the items back I thought there shouldn't be a problem and left to catch our flight.What proceeded was weeks of calls with and receiving dismal customer service. The Palms said we consumed the items because the sensors were triggered and called us liars. It's an utter scam to charge customers for something they did not consume. - what if I removed an item to look at a label due to dietary restrictions?- what if a child opened the fridge and moved some items?#FaceInPalms

allReviews.title: Newly renovated and beautiful
allReviews.text: My husband and I came here for a few days for my birthday to get out of the Colorado cold we’ve been having in early May. We booked through the hotel site, Bc, well, that’s how you get what you want. Not a Vegas rookie. Also for all of those reviewers that were disappointed in rooms and noise....uhhhhh you’re in a giant Vegas resort, during the Summer season, what did you expect, Palm Springs?At any rate, we reserved in the newly renovated Fantasy Tower and the room was beautiful and modern. The view was overlooking the pool and again, fantastic! We did arrive prior to check in, and our room wasn’t ready, so I gave them my cell # and they called as soon as it was, which as about an hour before actual check in.The newly redone pool was gorgeous, but there is a second pool at Palms Place, lots of little kids (who brings small kids on a Vegas vacation??) and it’s much smaller, and not nearly as nice as the main pool at Kaos, which does turn into a day club Fri-sun, as most big Vegas resort pools now do on the weekends; it’s cash flow people, that’s why they do it. The drinks poolside are pricey....but....it’s Vegas and unless you’re off strip, you’re going to pay.The breakfast place (Lucky Penny) was great, quick, and had lots of options. Vetri Cucina on the top floor was fabulous for dinner, fantastic views of the strip and the food was exquisite!All in all a great stay, and would totally come back!

allReviews.title: We would not recommend staying here.
allReviews.text: This is our first time at the Palms. Arrived on 5/7/19 (today) with a three night stay booked. We were disappointed to discover that the King Executive Room was not as pictured or described, the bathroom was small, no towel racks (only 2 towels in the bathroom) and no tub (description said it had a separate tub). Left the room and sat down to play a couple of table games while we waited for the restaurants to open at 5pm and it took 40 minutes for the waitress to come over to take our drink oder. We asked the pit boss if the waitress would be coming over and he said he would call for her. After about 15 more minutes (about 30 minutes had passed now), we asked the same pit boss if the waitress was coming and he got pretty irate yelling that he already called for her and what else can he do and he can't go get her and he's already gotten complaints about this today, etc. Not very helpful or professional! After about 40 minutes the waitress finally came to our table. We decided to go to the front desk management and inform them of our initial bad experience and the front desk manager, Shelby, didn't care about the room not being as described, she told us that's the risk we take when we use other sites to book our room, like Trivago or Prestigia, and we should have booked our room through Palms.com. The manager also said she doesn't control the casino side and she'll just make a note about how the pit boss responded to us. Shelby, the manager, clearly didn't care about our initial experience and made several snide comments about what type of room we booked and we got exactly what we paid for - a standard room, and how strange we thought there was a tub, etc. REALLY BAD first impression of the Palms and how they handle and value their guests and customers. It's just our first night but so far definitely not worth staying here with so many other options off the strip. We plan to ask if we can get a refund so we can stay somewhere else for the remaining two nights!

allReviews.title: Not as bad as I thought
allReviews.text: Judging by previous reviews I was very skeptical about staying here but I had free nights from my local casino so why not. We are a mid 50's couple so we were definitely not the norm here as it is a younger crowd for sure but at no point did we feel out of place or uncomfortable.As others have stated they should open up more parking as a lot of it is reserved for Vip's. At check in the manager I believe Elaine checked us in which was at 130 and they had a room available. The better part was she told us about the night club and made sure we got room on other side of building. We got King room that was newly redone and was extremely nice and we did not hear anything from night club during the night. We went to both pools and obviously the pool with kaos club was packed and loud so we went to pool over at palms place which was small but fulfilled our needs. The casino isn't bad as they have large variety of video poker which we enjoy playing. Drink service contrary to other people's experiences was excellent all four days we were there. The buffet for breakfast was $10 and we'll worth it didn't try it for dinner. So all in all we had great time and were glad we went just be aware there are alot of younger people there but none one them were obnoxious and take precautions to stay on side away from night club.

allReviews.title: Updated room is nice...but it's not enough
allReviews.text: Showed up to check in at the hotel early, my room was not ready, which was understandable.  I went to the pool (there are 2 one is a CLUB, like stand in line club) the other is comparable to a Holiday Inn pool.  Filled with kids, not enough chairs, bad sun exposure.  I kept checking with front desk, at 4:30 my room was still not ready, they insisted they would call me, then I checked back and they said the room was ready at close to 5 pm, (they never called) the negative is i apparently requested a king room, maybe they only have 3 of these at the hotel? Anyway, I get to my room which is over the club pool and the noise was UNBELIEVABLE.  I called and asked how long this lasts, they said they shut down at 6 and reopen at 10 pm.  I was here for a work conference, not to party with my boo's.So, I asked them to change my room (granted in an extremely agitated state, my apologies) and asked to speak to a manager.  The front desk manager, Elaine, evaded my calls and avoided me in person--she was on the phone, she was at lunch, yet, i saw her chatting away with the concierge, it can't believe someone so unprofessional could be running the front desk of this resort. Finally they changed my room, but they only had a queen available.  The updated room is nice, it is much more quiet, the hotel does not have huge hallways like some hotels in Vegas, so it is a quick trip to the elevator.  So, my advice is if you are not here to party, and you want a decent pool and a decently run service area--do not stay here. If you have to stay here, and do not want to party, request a queen room on the opposite side of the pool and maybe you will get lucky.  By the way, they also add gratuity automatically for everything, even for a party of one or 2 people.  Double check your bills, maybe they are counting on drunk people not checking it.  There was no price list for items in the mini bar, and/or what is included in it.

allReviews.title: Earplugs
allReviews.text: Party casino but not everyone wants to party Every night till 4am. The outside music you could literally hear in the hotel rooms across the street with the tv volume at 70. Maybe do the outdoors till 2 then take it inside, or at least not 4am outside every night,  or get better

allReviews.title: Wow the unbelievable noise until 4am
allReviews.text: They opened their night club this weekend. If you'd like to hang out at the pool Friday Saturday or Sunday there is now a fee to enter, with Cabanas going up to $20,000 depending on the location. I stayed on the 27th floor of the newly renovated Fantasy Tower, which is the tower farthest away from the new nightclub KAOS.... the noise was unbelievable until 4 a.m. each morning Friday night Saturday night and Sunday night. When I called the front desk they were very apologetic, I think they must have got an awful lot of complaints. They offered to send some earplugs up to the room. Really? That's your solution to your $600million renovation. I liked this hotel, have stayed here, three times the first six months of the year. Unfortunately, this will obviously be my last, unless I come on weekdays only.

allReviews.title: 2nd Review
allReviews.text: So after the $600 million plus renovations,  i decided to give it another review. First, the self parking area is approximately 70% reserved for VIPs. Makes self parking a horrible experience. None of the renovation money went into the parking elevators. Next, the remodel is enticing visually,  however when you try to walk the floor, you can't walk through the aisles. They have stuffed so many slot machines on the floor you would think they are trying to re-coop the renovations in one week. Then you will notice the most machines appeared to be dollar machines, followed by penny and few quarter.  I don't even recall a craps table. The food court and restaurants are very nice. The center bar is a Cosmopolitan knock off.  The sports book is about 40%reserved for VIPs. Screens are newer but its no Westgate. Lastly, I didn't see the rooms nor stay, but I sincerely hope a lot of that money went into them.

allReviews.title: Not overly impressed with Palms Resort Hotel
allReviews.text: We stayed with a conference that was being hosted at the Palms Casino and the check in was quick as were the people that brought our luggage to the room.  We had a problem with our AC not turning on and the water in the new bathroom dripped all night long.My wife tried to go to the pool and they gave her flack about not fitting in with the crowd.Convention space was pretty good and there were great views of Vegas. Our room was Smokey and we requested non smoking. The resort fees were astronomical, and don't expect good Wi-Fi unless pay handsomely.There are plenty of good restaurants that serve a great meal.

allReviews.title: beautiful Hotel casino with lots to do!
allReviews.text: This place is really beautiful and the gambling is only so so but for only a $100 deposit a night and a $30 resort feet it's really nice when they give you free rooms, supposedly they have to pools now but the only time I've been to one they charge $30 a drink so drink for free on the slots 1st which is really dumb advice because it takes over an hour to get a drink lady. But the place is pretty and if you get a free Room I recommend it if you have to pay I don't recommend it.

allReviews.title: Great New look and Service!
allReviews.text: My first time at Palms and was very impressed! Room was spacious and beautiful. I like every thing about the room! The restaurant Lucky penny was delicious. The casino is clean and nice. I look at the new pool KAOS and it looks awesome. Cant wait till next time to visit! Highly recommend this hotel!

allReviews.title: Hate the casino -- Love the hotel
allReviews.text: I don't like the casino.  They have poor machines and often play extra loud, obnoxious music.  However, their rooms are wonderful at The Palms.  Beautifully decorated.  Stayed on a Monday and Tuesday night.  Could not believe how quiet it was.  Heard almost no noise of any kind when staying there.  Slept solid through the night for the first time since I don't remember when.  Bed was super comfortable.  Bathroom was nice and the shower was huge.  The only problem I encountered during my stay was the internet on the first night.  It was very sporadic and actually went down twice for quite a while.  Everything else was delightful and I would definitely stay again on weekdays when there is no wild club crowd.

allReviews.title: Beautiful Room to NOT sleep in!
allReviews.text: I stayed at a newly renovated room It was gorgeous. Sleek, modern, clean. Remote controlled curtains, large marble shower and girnormous flat screen tv. Everything was perfect the first night. Second night, not so much. The music coming from their nearby club, Kaos, was LOUD. Until 3:00 am...I called the Front Desk and was told a manager would call me back..never happened. Had to try to sleep with ear plugs & pillow over my head. How in God's name can they book suh an obnoxiously loud DJ? I know it's Vegas and people want to party, but damn I paid to sleep too. Also kept getting charged for mini-bar purchases I didn't use...they did take the charges off promptly but wouldn't book again because of the music and no response from the manager (not that it would've done any good I guess). Anyhow, gorgeous room to stay in if you want to stay up all night!

allReviews.title: Good Off the Strip Hotel
allReviews.text: We were excited to visit the Palms after reading about the recent $600 million renovation and the Hotel did not disappoint! Stayed in the Fantasy Tower and was upgraded to an executive king room and it was really nice. We ate at Mabel's BBQ which is a Michael Symon restaurant of the show Burgers, Brew and Q. The food was great! We also had breakfast one day at the AYCE buffet and the was pretty good as well. The drinks at the main bar with the Shark bar expensive compared to the other bars in the hotel. We didn't here any noise from onsite construction. Overall good stay at the newly renovated Palms! We wouldn't hesitate to stay here again if we catch a good deal.

allReviews.title: Growing pains are keeping the reviews poor
allReviews.text: Stayed here for a slot tourney. We typically stay at Red Rock or Harrah's, but I was a little excited to try out Palms for the first time.Construction makes it hard to navigate around the casino floor and is blocking up part of the route in and out of valet. It is dangerous if you are trying to walk out to Flamingo and valet does not help you out there.Check in was smooth, and we received a brand new room in the Fantasy Tower, which is right off the casino floor. Gorgeous new rooms, great bathroom, decent views, almost too-hip decor (what is with all those pillows?).While the room was really nice, the bed was was too soft for our liking. The shower was great, though. The one thing that bugged me about the bathroom is the awkward door. Why they didn't put in a cool sliding or pocket door, I don't know. You have to open the bathroom door, then close it, then open the potty room door. If someone comes in, you are going to have to bang those two doors together. And forget about easy access in the dark if you like to tiptoe into the bathroom not to disturb your loved one.We ate at the new BBQ restaurant, which was very good and decently priced, although the music was a bit too loud. I like our server, he may have even been management. We also ate breakfast at the Lucky Penny Cafe, which was good, but service was very slow, even when there were only a few parties in there. The Shark bar in the center of the casino looked interesting.The main issue I had with this casino is the floor layout and machines. They had part of the casino floor closed and the rest of the machines seemed to be laid out haphazardly, with no clear path. The variety was not any where near the standard of Station casinos, and they had zero video poker that had decent paytables. The majority of the table games were Pai Gow or Baccarat, and we couldn't find a seat at the one game we typically play.I might give them another try later in the year when they have finished their construction, but the outlook isn't great for gaming here.

allReviews.title: Beautiful club but no seats and horrible service!
allReviews.text: This is definitely an absolutely beautiful night club. It’s also truly massive. I think they said they had 7500 people expected for the Cardi B event. It was full of beautiful and rich people and the music was great for the most part. I didn’t like that techno music at all. Why I will not give them a 5 is because of how they treated the customers. We paid over $100 a piece for tickets that were supposed to be expedited and there was nothing speedy about this! We waited over 2 hours outside in lines that were a mad house of disorganized mess!!!! You can’t charge people a fortune and then handle them like this. I was infuriated by the time I got inside.... and then it gets worse!!! There is absolutely no where to sit expect for the tables which were going from 5 to 15,000!?!?! Say what.... hell no! Not one single barstool. And then we got there at 10:30 and didn’t get in until after midnight! And then had to stand until almost 4:00 am because that’s when Cardi finally performed. I was in literal pain after leaving here. Bottom line if they can’t organize the line better and get some seats I will not return.

allReviews.title: Palms makes a huge impact
allReviews.text: The Palms resort is not what you would expect. The strip gets tired and old - too many people and the prices ?!?! The Palms is a $15 dollar cab ride away from the strip. The resort is stunning. The art is amazing. It’s got everything you would need plus plus plus ! Rooms and food combined with all the conveniences ....yes we will be staying again !

allReviews.title: Beautiful Casino Horrible Service
allReviews.text: I frequent The Palms at least 2 or 3 times per week. They are having a special promotional happy hour bonus game that goes off every half hour. 3 times it went off my machine would not allow me to play the bonus game. As myself and other players sitting around tried to tap numbers to enter my selections. After the second time I was a little upset. So I pressesd service for a slot attendant. She came over and told me that someone would contact me after taking my information and left with an attitude. The third time it came and I was unable to play play again. Before being able to tap the service button a service person passed. I stopped her and advised her this is now the third time a bonus has went off and I have not been able to play. Everyone around me has won upwards of 35-75$ in these bonuses. The service attendant says. Its alot of promotions going on and the machines are not working I dont know what to tell you. So now im furious nothing in this place is free meaning I have spent money in the location how dare you speak to me in this tone. So I go to security. He calls for a supervisor. She comes over, places her hands on my shoulder guides me out of her way and tells me the manager is going to say the same thing go sit at your machine ill come fill out another slip. Lord knows my blood boiled. Because had I done that I would have been escorted out of here and asked not to return. If you are not customer friendly do not work in the public. I come in here too much to be disrespected such a beautiful hotel and casino with such bad attitudes.

allReviews.title: Kaos pool/nightclub, and hotel changes with new ownership
allReviews.text: Awesome pool, updated new design. It is good to see the Palms back on the map. I have been coming here for years. Ever since the station and new owners took over the property, it has been amazing! Reminds me of the olden days. Much needed facelift. Lots of good energy here. Rooms are all redone, and smell brand new, with updated design. Food is awesome! Even the dealers at the table are full of new energy! The staff is awesome, music could use some fine tuning, but considering how quick they built the new pool, I am super impressed. Highly recommended!

allReviews.title: Great buffet!
allReviews.text: A little away from the strip but worth it for the buffet!  Take Uber for $10.  Lots of choice; great desserts; great service.  Just take note: We went on a Thursday evening, 7PM and there was a 50 minute wait!

allReviews.title: NCAA tournament 2019
allReviews.text: The hotel has been remodeled. The lobby looked and felt 5 star. The rooms were very nice as well. Fully updated with new fixtures. I will say though that the water closet floor was cleaned that well. This was on a Thursday, I thought it would have been busier. But overall nicely done.

allReviews.title: Terrible ventilation system - extremely smokey
allReviews.text: I have been to cruddy atlantic city casinos that have better ventilation systems. This entire hotel reeked of cigarette and marijuana smoke. Other than my room and Mabel's patio, there was no escaping it. Not the elevators, not the hallways, not the restaurants and not the corporate meeting space.   It was a brutal work trip. The gym is all the way over in another tower, 5-10 minute walk. What I did like was that the rooms are large (no bathtubs if that matters to you), the views from the meeting rooms are spectacular, and the food options are nice, especially having the option of cheap eats at the food court.

allReviews.title: Terrible employees at brendon Theatre
allReviews.text: They rope out four lines for concession and i approach one line an employee at that line states shes not open so i move behind second line and get to the counter and she says shes not open so i stand behind the 3rd line and the third line opens up so i rush to that line and he tells me i need to stand in line behind four other people and i explain to him that i was in line ahead of those people and he called me a liar so i decided not to buy a movie ticket and walked out and will never return to that theatre again pls learn from my experience those employees are not happy and they display it with the customers.

allReviews.title: A six dressed up like a Nine
allReviews.text: This hotel does not try hard enough.  A lack of staff from the Entrance to the Front desk to personnel on the floor. The Resort Fee is a total scam. $49.00 per day and all I got was two Newspapers that I had to ask the bellman for. When I asked about it the clerk showed no interest at all. The restaurants are overpriced but their are chain fast food places in the hotel to compensate. We ate our Restaurant meals across the street at the Gold Coast Casino. What was most annoying was the $75 A DAY charged to my credit card for things that I might charge to my room. I understand the reasoning behind this but it did make me feel untrustworthy. It is reversed when it is apparent that there were no late charges.  There was a notice in the room that I would be Charged for any of the overpriced items in my room if I even inspected them and also a $25. charge if I even opened the the mini fridge in my room. The bathroom was a mystery, a huge shower stall that you could hold a party in.  No bathtub, not a winner when you have ladies in your party, Only two bath towels, two hand towels, and two wash cloths. Is housekeeping told  how many guest will be in the room and then put in the appropriate amount of linens etc. We have been to Vegas on a number of occasions so were not looking for the "VEGAS" experience. This was not our first choice for a hotel, it came a part of our "Continental Cup Curling" package.We will look for something closer to the Strip" or downtown on our next trip.

allReviews.title: Not my first choice
allReviews.text: This wasn't my choice to stay here and after the complete remodel it might be better. I heard construction all morning while I was hungover from the night before.  Definitely not great.  The club upstairs was pathetic, and the casino was boring.  I had a better stay at Treasure Island for less and on the strip.  I love my room though, great space and very comfortable beds!

allReviews.title: Disappointed at hotel.
allReviews.text: Expensive, out of the way, inadequate amenities.Stayed for 3 nights at a business convention. First impression lousy. No automatic doors at entrance and no doorman to help get luggage unloaded and inside the double set of glass doors. We struggled, 3 ladies with 2 suitcases each and hand luggage. Late afternoon arrival and only staff were security people.No coffee or fridge in room. Dim lighting in rooms. Main entrance light bulb out. No bathtub.Wifi poor quality, in and out constantly.Overall, not impressed and unlikely to return to the Palms

allReviews.title: WORST HOTEL IN VEGAS
allReviews.text: I have stayed at numerous hotels in Las Vegas and the palms is by far the worst hotel I have stayed at. I won a radio promotion package trip for a one night suite, vip tickets for a lady antebellum show and $250 resort credit. The check in staff was very rude and unhelpful. Upon check in we were told that we had a regular standard room which they switched without even lettings us know from the suite that we had won. I had to contact the promotor that set me up with my package and she had it changed back but we had to switch from our standard room to a suite which was very inconvenient when it should of been the original suite room we had from the beginning! We were told that the $250 resort credit could be used for food and drink in the hotel yet I was told I could use it anywhere in the resort by the promotor. I figured that using some of the credit in the palms OWN GIFT STORE would of been fine but NO we got charged for everything we bought in the gift store and they refused to take it off when we checked out. If we can't use credit in the gift store then we should of been told that, we were told of no such thing until it was too late. The manager was NO help when she came out, we were told they had no way of removing the charges since they can't see the purchases we made in their own gift shop even though I had a receipt for everything we bought in there! I was then told she would call me and have it figured out which she never did! VERY unprofessional! We were treated horrible that whole weekend just because we won a promotion package and we had free stuff? Our weekend that we took work off of was ruined because they wanted to change EVERYTHING that was included in our package. Our concert tickets were even changed from suite tickets to back row seats!!! Unbelievable! I don't know how a hotel can treat guests that way and just do whatever they want and change all of our CONFIRMED things. I found out later by the promotion company that gave me the prizes I won that they changed all the plans she gave the palms hotel without even letting her know! The rooms are not even great here, its ghetto and run down inside and frankly they let people out from the street (homeless and drug addicts) into the hotel, I did not feel safe the whole time. There was construction going on and places to eat there were limited. Buffet was cheap but the food was horrible! The service at this place is horrible and everyone that works there is miserable with their life and hates their job. I still have not heard one word back from the hotel refunding the charges that they should of removed for not being clear about what we could spend a credit at in their OWN hotel. I would never stay here again or recommend anyone to stay here but to stay somewhere on the strip at least, places like Treasure Island and Stratosphere have better service and are actually cheaper than this horrible hotel! Save your money and stay somewhere else! When the manager of this crappy hotel wants to let us know why they changed our confirmed plans of what was supposed to be a fun relaxing trip to a horrible money scam and give me back the money you charged, then let me know! The promotor already said she would be looking into it as well and will not be working with this resort anymore for radio contests!

allReviews.title: UTX- Snowing in Las Vegas
allReviews.text: Can you believe it! Snowing in Las Vegas after more than 10 years!Came in early on Wednesday to Las Vegas for an UTX event on Friday. Woke up to this beautiful Snowy Thursday morning!  It was like being in a winter wonderland with the graceful falling of very large perfectly shaped snow flakes from the heavens! I marveled, "How beautiful ! How Amazing"!And yes, it snowed in Las Vegas again around 3 pm! First looking like heavy rain, only to be miniature falling snow balls.Never seen anything like it, but very happy and grateful to say, "I saw it first hand for myself in Las Vegas"!

allReviews.title: First time at Palms
allReviews.text: We stayed there during Christmas holiday.Lots of changes from my last visit to the casino.Casino area seems double in size what used to be. Good casino atmosphere. We used the buffet for breakfast twice, with players card we had discounts. Room was very clean and indoor parking garage. Long Walk to casino area still was under renovation. Away from Vegas strip but walking distance to Gold Coast and Rio.Overall very satisfied.

allReviews.title: Expensive, lots of construction = inconvenient place to stay
